tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 3 gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas stsal ba'i bka' slob phyogs bsdebs

tei:div.tei:p: gleng brjod/ra༅༅// srid zhi'i 'dren mchog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog nas/ phyi lo 1959 nas 1999 bar btsan byol bod mi ser skya rgan gzhon rnams la 'phral yun gyi blang dor lam ston bka' slob rmongs mun sel ba'i sgron me dang / yid gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi/ 'dod rgu 'grub pa'i nor bu lta bu shin tu rtsa che mtha' yas pa zhig stsal ba'i khongasanas/ rgya che'i ser skya mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba khag khe gtsang phyogs bsdebs/ pod gsum pa/ 'di dag sku sger yig tshang gi bod yig sde tshan nas phyogs sgrig dang / skyid grong gra 'bar ru 'og skal bzang phun tshogs kyis /ma pu ṭar nang 'god 'jug gis deb gzugs par gzhi bskrun/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags 'brug bod zla 1 tshes 14 nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang rtsepho brang po ta lar 7rgyal mchog sku phreng gong rim gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te mi lo drug cu tham pa 'khor ba dang / lcags stag bod zla 10 tshes 8 nyin 7gong sa mchog gis bod rgyal khab kyi lugs zung chab srid thugs khur bzhes nas mi lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor bar bod 'bangs yongs nas bka' drin rjes

dran zhu ba'i dus tshigs khyad par can dang bstun te/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas par bskrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i rang rigs ser skya mang tshogs rnams nas snying du bcangs 'os 7rgyal ba'i bka' slob dgongs don khag la slob sbyong nyams len tshul bzhin gnang ste/ rang rang 'di phyi'i bde thabs 'chug med sgrub pa dang chabs cig snga dus shar glingaspe sha ya'i nang snyan grags ldan pa'i rlabs chen bod rgyal khab dang / bod mi rigs/ zab cing rgya che'i chos dang rig gzhung bcas pa mi nyams dar rgyas yun gnas yong ched lhag bsam blo rtsal zung 'brel gyis 'bad brtson che bskyed yong ba'i re skul bcas/bod rgyal lo 2127 rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags 'brug zla 5 tshes 23phyi 'o( 2000 zla 7 tshes 24 la//
rdoraglingaranga'atshobazo grwar —bde don gyi las sdom 7snyan zhu gsan rjes bka' slob stsal ba/
sbre gachenachosagling gtsug lag khang du sgrol dkar tshe dbang bka' drin che skabs bka' slob stsal ba/
—'a lnge snor+sha rge skye rgyal ṅge hūṃ rmesno bar zhi ba'i gom bgrod du bskyod mi grangs brgya dang brgyad cu slor la stsal ba'i bka' slob/
—bsaralhamal ya'i nang pa'i tshogs pa dang / b.layul gyi nang pa rnams nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bcar skabs stsal ba'i bka' slob/
gsungachosarabarabartanabazhug rme 'bul bcar bal yul mi mang dang bzhugs sgar mi mang bcas la stsal ba'i bka' slob/
arini'uyogatunyeskoranarme ———bcar 'joms bod mi sum stong sgor la tso ba'i bka' slob/

༄༅༅// spyi lo 1992 zla 10 tshes 14 nyin/ a rir gzhis chags su bskyod mkhan khag gcig la stsal ba'i bka' slob/a rir gzhis chags 'gro mkhan tshor sa gnas gang nas yin min dang /da phan las rigs gang byed kyi yod min bka' brtsad gnang /tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ phyi rgyal la gzhis chags su 'gro mkhan tshang mar ngas rtag par shod kyi yod/ pha gir phyogs gcig nas gang ci'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa dang / gnas stangs yag po yod pa red/ de'i stod kyis rang la las 'gan yang che ru 'gro gi red/ rgya gar nang bod mi mang po yod pa'i rkyen gyis do snang byed mkhan gcig byas na nyung ba yod kyi red/ pha gir da lta bod pa gzhis chags len mkhan sa khul so so nas bod par do snang chen po byed pa dang / a sar lta bu shugs chen po yod pa'i skabs la de rtsis khyed tsho tshang mas gzab gzab byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ yag po zhig byung ba yin na yang lam seng snyan grags yong rgyu'i phan thogs yong gi red/ yang sdug chag cig byung ba yin na yang lam seng tshags par nang thon yong gi red/der brten gzab gzab byed dgos/ nga rang tsho ༄/da phyi nang gang duyin rung / so so sdod sa nye rgyang gang du bsdad yod kyang / gang ltar bod rigs yin pa de skyes pa nas ma shi bar du bsgyur bcos gtong thabs med cing / nga rang tsho bod rigs shig yin pa de nam yang brjed rgyu med/ da gin bod la 'gro mkhan de rnams nga sto thug dus mang po zhig gis ngu gi 'dug mig chu btang ba des sems nang gi sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba de mngon yong gi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i bod 1

lung pa gnas stangs thabs skyo nga 'di 'dra zhig gi ngang la bsdad yod/ da gin khong tshor lab rgyu byung / nga rang m+mu bod lung pa'i nang la bod pa khyon nas cha rgyus med mkhan mi gsar pa zhig slebs/ kho tshos bod pa'i lugs srol ni shes kyi med pa dang / de bzhin bod pa'i lo rgyus ni shes kyi med/ bod pa'i rig gzhung ni shes kyi med/ bod skad kyang shes kyi med/ de tsho rwaped nang slebs pas ma tshad dpon po byas/ da dung gdug rtsub che thag chod byas te/ kho rang tsho'i bsam ྾ nang la gang yod pa de dag bod par ran gyi yod rung / ran gyi med rung / u tshugs rgyab ste de'i sgang la 'gro dgos pa'i btsan po dbang yod shod mkhan dpon po de 'dra zhig slebs bsdad yod ces bshad payin/ bod nang gi mi de rnams dka' ngal de 'dra zhig gi 'og nas nga tsho btsan byol du yod pa'i bod par tshur re ba bcol te sdod kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho yin na yang sems shugs bskyed sa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i re ba rgyag sa'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs de bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams red/ khong tsho'i sems shugs da lta bar namasang ma chag par bsdad yod pa de ni nga si ma rtsa lta bu zhig red/nga rang tsho bod phyi nang phan tshun gnyis gas rten 'brel ltos grub kyi thog nas bod nang gi sems shugs 'phel ba la nga tsho'i byed stangs kyis khyad par yong gi red/ nga rang cho ༷/da kyi phyi rol du yod mkhan tshos sa cha gang du bsdad yod pa yin na'ang so so bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam cho de ma brlag par gzab gzab byed dgos kyi red/ rang nyid bod mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas bod pa'i 'os 'gan zhig 'khyer dgos/ rgya gar nang logs la bod mi mang po yod pa 2

dang mi 'dra bar/ phyi rgyal lung par bod pa med sa'i sa cha zhig la nga rang tsho bod mi nyung nyung zhig slebs yong dus rdog khres dang 'gan khur che ru 'gro gi red/ gzab gzab byed dgos kyi red/ phyi rgyal lung pa'i nang gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan de tsho tsam du ma zad/ mi sgor pa'i thog nas kyang bod pa'i gnas tshul la do snang byas te lo rgyus skad cha dris mkhan yong gi red/ bod pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung gang 'dra yod med/ deng sang btsan byol gyi gnas stangs gang 'dra yod med/ btsan byol gzhung gi 'gro stangs gang 'dra yod med de tsho'i gras brtsad dpyod byed mkhanayong rgyu yin dus khyed rang tshos de rnams tshang ma shes pa byed dgos/ snying po nga tsho 'dir sgrig 'dzugs gang 'dra yod pa dang /gzhis chags dang / slob sbyong sogs las don byed stangs gang 'dra yod pa de tsho'i gras khyed rang tshos shes pa byed dgos/ bod pa'i lo rgyus kha sang lab rgyu byung / bod nang nye char brtsams pa don kun grub pa mi shigs pa'i rtsom deb de tshor khyed rang tshos do snang byas te lta rtogs byas na so so yin na yang gnas tshul mang po shes rtogs yong rgyu dang / mis skad cha dris dus shod rgyu yod na so so spobs pa byed chog pa zhig red/ mis skad cha dri dus 'di shes kyi med/de yang shes kyi med ces lab dgos byung na ngo tsha po red/ bod don skor do snang byed mkhan dang / skad cha dris mkhan rim pas rim pas tan tan yong gi red/ bod pa'i gnas tshul de dag bod nang gi gnas tshul yin yang rung /phyi rol gyi gnas tshul yin yang rung / rgya gar nang la sgrig 'dzugs 'gro stangs dang / ma 'ongs par gal che shos bod mang gtsor 'gro gi yod pa dang / 'gro 3

stangs gang 'dra byed kyi yod med de tsho'i gras nga tshos yig cha zhig bzos yod pa de rnams la phag po zhig do snang byas/ shes pa byas/ sa cha gang du slebs pa yin na yang bod pa'i sku tshab lta bu byed thub mkhan zhig byed dgos kyi red/khyed rang tsho nad pa phyi rgyal du bsdad mkhan rnams phar tshur sa gnas re zung re zung dus dus la 'dzoms 'dzoms byed rgyu dang / nga rang tsho bod pa'i dus dran skabs dus dus la mnyam 'dzoms thub pa byung na yag po yong gi red/ nga rang sto gcig gis gcig la dran gso skul te sems 'gul thebs rgyu dang /bod pa'i gnas don la dus dus su dran gso byed thub pa byung na so so yin na yang skyid po yong gi red la/ de tshor gnad 'gag chen po yod/ shes song ngam/hur thag byed dgos/ngas kha seng 'gro mkhan tshang mar bshad yod/ deng sang nga tshor nyen kha gsar pa zhig reg dug gi na tsha'i rigs gcig yong gi 'dug phyi rgyal gyi mis nad gzhi de ni 'dzam bu gling yongs rdzogs la nyen kha yod pa zhig la rtsis kyi yod/ nga rang phyo bod pa'i nang la da lta phan chad de 'dra ha lam yod pa ma red/ khyed rang tsho a mi ri kur gzhis chags su phyin te rjes su nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la na tsha de rigs bskyal na yag po yong gi ma red/gzab gzab byed dgos/ rtsa ba nga rang tshos log g.yem zer ba yag po min par brtsi ba de'i thog nas gtsang ma zhig yod yod pa red/ yin na yang gzab gzab ma byas na bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang nad rigs de gras khyab gdal byung bayin nas mi ri kur gzhis chags su phyin te 'di 'dra byung ba red ces thabs 4

sdug chags kyi red/ shes song ngam/ gzab gzab byed dgos/phyi rgyal du rgya mi thug mdog kha po red/ rgya mi gang du thug pa yin na yang rgya mir phar rnam 'gyur ngan pa bstan na mi 'grigs/ rgya mis bod la sdug sbyong btang ba dang / thabs sdug byas pa rnams cha tshang shod dgos/ sgor gyi ngos nas grogs po bzos/ kho tshor bden pa bden thub kyi gnas tshul gang yin rung shod thub pa byung nayag po yod pa red/ rgya mi tshang ma sdug pa min pas khong tshor g.yol nas ma bsdad par thug 'phrad dang 'a brel ba byed dgos/rgya mi'i nang drang bden la rtsi 'jog dang / nga tshor sha tsha byed mkhan mang po yod pa shes dgos/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' stsal// //

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1992 zla 11 tshes 16 nyin 'bri gung byang chub gling dbu 'byed skabs stsal ba'i bka' slob/de ring 'dir sa skya bdag khri rin po ches dbu mdzad pa'i/ skyabs gnas chos rgyud kyi dbu khrid rnam pa tsho dang / de min gyi grogs po lhan rgyas/ lhag par mnga' sde'i gtso 'dzin bcas tshang ma'i thog la zhu rgyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi lung gis zin pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi zhing bod kha ba gangs can gyi jongs la/ nga rang tsho spyi mthun skye 'gro'i bsod nams dman pas gnas tshul ya nga po dang / thabs skyo po zhig byung ba'i 'og nas nga tshog nad mi btsan byol ba dum po gcig rgya gar nang slebs yod/ nga tshor dka' ngal dang 'gal rkyen mang po zhig gi 'og nas slar rang yul rang dbang slar gso yong ba dang / de dang 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba yod pa 'di dag nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yag po zhig yong thub pa'i don dag la/ tshang mas sgo gsum gyi nus pa gang yod bton nas 'bad brtson byas dang byed bzhin pa'i gnas tshul dang 'brel ba'i skabs 'dir 'bri gung gi bstan pa'i rmang gzhi bshad grwa dang /sgrub grwa zung du 'brel ba zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i sngon ma 'char gzhi bting / da cha gang la gang tsam zhig 'grub te de ring 'dir sgo 'byed gnang rgyu'i sar ngos rang bcar rgyu byung ba ha cang dga' po byung / gtso che 'dir thugs khur zhes mkhan rin po che rnam pa gnyis dang / yang sgos 'dir phyag las gnang mkhan tsho tshang ma'i thog nas ga40 ga sems shugs dang / lhag bsam/ sngon gyi thugs 6

bskyed smon lam gyi bden mthu/ de 'dra'i rkyen mang po zhig gi 'og nas/ gang ltar gra 'grigs thag chod 'di 'dra ba'i grub 'bras byung bar ngo mtshar skye gi 'dug bya ba bzang po sgrub par rjes su yi rangs yod/ gal che shos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba de phyi la yod pa zhig min par nga rang tsho'i nang gshis rgyud la yod dgos pa zhig yin par brten/ shes rgyud la rgyal ba'i bstan pa sngar med gsar du bskrun/ sngar yod gong nas gong du spel ba la thos bsam sgom pa zung 'brel gyi thog nas 'gro dgos pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ 'di ga'i bshad grwa dang / sgrub grwa de gnyis kyi thog nas lung rtogs kyi rgyal ba'i dam chos spyi dang / lhag par bka' brgyud/ de'i nang tshan 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po nas thun mong mayin pa'i rang rang so so'i man ngag gi rgyun yod pa 'di dag dus mtha' 'di 'dra zhig la rmang nas gso thub par tshang mas thugs khur bskyed de hur thag gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/nga tsho 'dir brten gzhi 'di 'dra zhig zin nas ji srid bar 'dir sdod rgyu'i dmigasayul min/ nga tsho so so'i rang yul bral te mi'i lung par dmigs yul dang bsgrub bya nges can zhig bzung te tshang mas 'char gzhi dang go rim sgrig ste las ka byed kyi yod pa yin dus/ 'dir gra sgrig byas pa'i rnam dpyod gtong sa de phyin chad rang gi lung par gtong dgos pa zhig chags bsdadayod/so so mi sgor gcig gis thar pa dang tha mas cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i don dag gcig pu ma yin par/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel 7

ba'i bod kyi don dag dang 'brel ba yod pa 'di'i ngos 'dzin gsal po zhig gi thog nas de lugs thugs bskyed dam bca' dang / tshang mas lhag bsamathugs khur che bzhes gnang zedags zhes zhu rgyu yin/de ring 'dir nga rang tsho bod pa tsam ma yin pa'i phyi rgyal gyi sku mgron mang po zhig dang / de bzhin la dwags sa khul gras nas kyang mang po zhig phebs yod pa red/ nga tsho 'dir 'dzoms pa 'di spyir btang spyi tshogs kyi dus chen 'dra po dang / ltad mo phar lta tshur lta de 'dra'i don dag la yong pa ma red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya seng ge'i rjes 'brangs gcig gyur yin pa'i cha nas de ring 'dir nub 'dzoms byung ba red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sngar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos go myong thos myong med pa'i sa khul de 'dra nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam bzang la yid 'phrog ste do snang byed mkhan gang sa gang nas yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i dus tshod la nga rang tsho ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs bston med yin pa tshos bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab bya gnang ba rnams nga rang tshos shes pa byas/ shes pa de gshis rgyud la sbyar te bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs bsam pa rnam dag ngo lkog med pa spus dag po byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de byung na rang rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas yong gi red/ rang rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas na mi de'i rnam 'gyur dang sgo gsum gyi spyod pa zhi bde bag yod la gnas thub pa yong gi red/ de gang du yod sa'i sa khul de la phan gyi red/ de 'dra'i spyod lam 'di'i thog nas ston pa'i bslab bya'i snying 8

wa de mtshon yong gi red/ bstan pa spel zer ba de gtso che shos so so la rag las yod/ so so rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nus pa'am dge mtshan mngon thub pa byed rgyu de ha cang gal chen po 'dugamanga' sde'i spyi khyab blon chen nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i chos kyi snying po zhig gsungs song / nga rang tsho de ring 'dir chos tshogs kyi slob gnyer khang zhig sgo 'byed kyi rten 'brel byed kyi yod pa red/ yin na'ang da lta sku mgron gtso bo mnga' sde'i spyi khyab blon chen gyi thog nas bod rang dbang bden don gyi thog la rgya gar mi mang gi dngos gnas bsam tshul gang yod pa de ngag thog nas bton te gsungs pa la nga rang ha cang dga' po byung / khong gis gsungs don bzhin/ 'phags bod gnyis kyi 'brel ba de thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ 'phral sel gyi chab srid dang /dpal 'byor sogs kyi gnas tshul 'og nas dka' ngal ci rigs pa zhig 'phrad srid pa red/ yin na yang gzhi rtsa'i thog nas nga tsho 'phags bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba dam zab yod pa 'di khong gis zub tu med pa zhig dang /'gyur du med pa zhig red ces gsungs pa de bden pa red/ gang ltar 'phags pa'i yul dang bod kyi gnas stangs 'di dge rgan dang dge phrug gi 'brel ba lta bu red ces bshad bsdad kyi yod/ skabs re ngas rgya gar gyi grogs po tshor rtsed mo dang sbrags deng sang dge phrug la gyong gun chen po byung ste dka' ngal chen po 'phrad pa'i skabs la dge rgan gyis thugs snang phran bu gnang dgos kyi 'dug ces zhu gi yod/ de dīng khong gis dge rgan gyi tshab cig gnang te bka' 9

mol gnang ba der ngos rang ha cang dga' po byung bas thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yin/ khong gis gsungs pa bzhin/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rang bzhin gyis 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi yod/ 'gyur ba de ltar 'gro ba de mi la lhan skyes kyi rang dbang dang / drang bden dang / mang gtso bcas la dga' po yod pa 'di'i rang bzhin gyi thog nas byung ba red/ de las dog pa'i btsan dbang dang / thub tshod byed pa/ rdzun dang khram pa byed mkhan la rang bzhin gyis mi su yin na'ang dga' gi ma red/ mi tsam du ma zad blo gros dman po dud 'gro mo yang dga' gi ma red/ dper na khyi 'dra po zhig la mdun la ngo cig bstan/ rgyab la dbyug pas brdung na/ khyis kyang dga' po byed kyi ma red/ bsam pa rnam dag gis brtsi po byas pa yin na khyi tshun chad dud 'gro tshos kyang de la brtsi bkur dang / dga' mos byed rgyu zhig shes kyi 'dug de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la btsan dbang dang /ham pa skyag rdzun bshad nas mtha' 'khyol thub thabs rtsa ba nas med pa dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang la 'tham bu gling gi lo rgyus thog nas ngo sprod gsal po byung tshar ba red/ nga tsho bod kyi bden don de yang ring por ma thogs par gsal thub pa'i re ba chen po yod/ gtso ༄༄ rga bdag bod pa rang nyid dang / yang sgos bod nang yod bsdad pa'i gzhis lus mi mang de dag gis lhag bsam rnam dag dang zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs thog nas da lta bar du so so'i bden don brtsod dang rtsod bzhin pa red/ nga rang tsho phyi rgyal rang dbang lung pa'i nang yod pa'i bod pa tsho'i ngos nas kyang tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag sems la 10

bcangs nas skabs su babs pa'i byed sgo gang yod da lta phan la hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yin na yang rang don rang gces byed dgos/ rdo don yang snying bod rigs spyi bo gnam bstan su dang su 'dra zhig yin na yang / bod spyi pa'i don dag gi rdog khres re re so so'i mjing pa'i sgang la 'khri bsdad yod pas/ so so'i sgo gsum gyi spyod lam gang gi skabs la yin na yang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod bstan srid kyi don dag de snying la bcangs te sems khur len rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/'dir nga tsho bod kyi bden don gyi thog la dmigs bsal do snang byed mkhan khyed rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi nang pa'i grogs po mang po zhig gis bar lam bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di khyed tsho'i rang don dang khyad par med pa byas te khyed rang snur nas dmigs bsal gyi sems khur blangs/ gom bgrod byed rgyu dang / skad 'bod byed rgyus mtshon pas de 'dra'i thabs lam brgyud nas/ khyed rang tshosasems nad kyi tshor ba gsal por bstan pa'i thog nas rgyab skyor gyi rnam pasang ki dang po byas byung bar thugs rje che zhes de ring gi go skabs 'di zin nas zhu rgyu yin/ da dung yin na yang mu mthud de rgyab skyor byed rogs zer rgyu yin/de nas 'dir phyi rgyal gyi grogs po mang po zhig slebs 'dug khyed rang tsho rigs gcig gis bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la do snang byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas bod pa'i bden don la rgyab skyor byed kyi yod/ khyed rang tsho rigs gcig ni mi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi mi gcig gis gcig la thub stod bshad 11

te nyam thag pa zhig mthong ba yin na/ de la rogs ram byed 'dod dang de la brtse zhen byed 'dodayong ba mi'i chos nyidayin pas bod pa stom chungs rabs de 'dra zhig la dbang yod bshad pa'i gnas tshul mthong stabs rang bzhin gyis sha tsha slebs pa'i thog nas nga tshor rgyab skyor byed kyi yod pa red/ gang ltar yang snying 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa'i don dag la rgyab skyor je mang je mang du 'gro ba'i dus tshod 'dir de ring 'dir sku mtho la dum bu cig slebs bsdad pa khyed rang tsho la yang thugs rje che zhes zer 'dod byung /de nas nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so gsum lhag tsam de'i ring la/ nga tsho btsan byol ba'i rkang pa badzugs sa zhig dang / sdod sa thob pa tsam du ma zad/ bod pa rang gi rig gzhung mu mthud nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu'i go skabs dang / bod pa gzhon skyes tshor deng dus kyi shes yon yong ba'i don dag la rgya gar gzhung gis dmigs bsal thugs khur bzhes yod/ lhag don paṇa kri ta ṇi ru zhugs pa'i skabs la/ chab srid kyi gnas tshul jog nas mdzad dka' chen poyod kyang / yin na yang rtsaba'i rtsadon gyi thog la/ rgya gar gzhung gis phugs rgyangs ring po'i 'char gzhi ldan pa'i thog nas rogs ram dgongs bzhes gnang yod/ de dang 'brel ba'i rgya gar gyi mnga' sde khag gi sa khul mang po zhig nas bod pa'i don dag la rgyab skyor gnang nas nga tsho rwa1da pa btsan byol ba tsho 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam yong thub pa 'di gtso che shos rgya gar gzhung gi bka' drin dang / yang sgos mnga' sde so so'i bka' drin red/ de ring gi gnas tshul 'diyangs ji'i mnga' 12

sde'i rgyab skyor dang rogs ram 'og nas byung ba yin dus/ de ring go skabs 'di zin te ngas tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ da gin mnga' sde'i blon chen gyi gsung bshad spyi dang / lhag par bod don sgor la gsung bshad gnang ba'i skabs la khyed rang cho rangad pa mang po zhig gis lag pa brdabs te dmigs bsal gyi dga' po byung ba'i rnam 'gyur shugs chen po zhig bstan song / ngas 'dir byes la 'khod bsdad pa'i bod mi tsam du ma zad/ bod nang la yod pa'i bod mi sa ya drug da lta sems kyi nang gi tshor snang de kha nas shod mi nus par dngangs skrag de 'dra zhig gi 'og la bsdad pa'i bod mi de rnams kyi tshab byas te/ ngas khyed rang la dmigs bsal mjal dar zhig 'bul gyi yin/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas snga dro nas yong ste do snang chen po byas par ha cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yin/ bkra shis bde legs// //13

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1992 zla 11 tshes 21 nyin 'bri gung byang chub gling rten dang ston pa gsar bzhengs kyi sgo dbye mdzad sgo'i skabs 'du 'dzoms byung ba'i la dwags pa sogs hi ma lasa'i ri rgyud mi mang dang / bod nas gsar 'byor ba bcas mi grangs lnga stong brgal bar bod kyi gnas stangs skor bka' 11ba rgyungapa ba/tshang mar 'tshams 'dri yod/ kha sa kha nyin nyi ma gnyis dang / de bzhin 'chams kyi skabs bcas la mi mang che ba slebs zin yod kyi red/ da res 'bri gung chos tshogs kyi ma dgon sgo dbye'i mdzad rim khag thog mtha' bar gsum gra 'grigs posag po byung song snyam/ khyed rang la dwags nasayong mkhan tsho gang 'dra byung / 'di gar gnam gshis bsil zhing tsha dub med pas/nyin shas ring khyed rang tsho skyid po byung yod shag gang 'dra byung ngam zhes bka' 'dri bskyangs/de ring nga rang tsho tshang ma nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dad pa gcig gyur dang / yang sgos bod kha ba gangs can ljongs la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa'i chos tshul 'di nyams su len mkhan gcig gyur yin pa'i cha nas mnyam 'dzoms byung ba red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs payin dus rjes 'brangs pa rnam dag gcig bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ nga rang tshos lus kyi cha nas bcom ldan 'das la kha phyogs te dad gus byed kyi yod kyang / sems kyis bcom ldan 'das la rgyab phyogs te bsdad pa lta bu byas na yag po med/ lus kyi cha nas bcom 14

ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi zhes thal mo sbyar/ ngag nas smon lam brgyab pa ltar bsam khra'i thog nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab bya gnang ba de dag dang phyogs ma 'gal ba bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ nga rang tshos kha nas skyabs su mchi zhes brjod kyi yod kyang / skabs re don ngo ma'i bsam blo gtong stangs de bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab bya dang rgyab 'gal gyi spuzo lta bu chags yong dus/lus kyis skyabs gnas la kha lhungags kyang / sems kyis skyabs gnas la rgyab phyogs pa lta bu chags grabs byed kyi 'dug 'di 'dra byed rgyu med/ nga rang tsho tshang ma rtsa ba chos byed dang mi byed rang mos red/ chos byas phyin rgya che chung dang / rlabs che chung ni yong gi red/ yin na'ang phyogs gang sa nas ston pa'i rjes 'brangs zhabs 'dren mi zhu mkhan zhig bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugade ltar yong ba la slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ kha sang bka' chos skabs bshad pa bzhin spyir btang nga tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs dang / la dwags pa sogs hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul gyi spyi tshogs nang chos byed pa tsam zhig spyir btang yongs khyab tu yod kyang / chos slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i thad la do snang de tsam med cing / chos kyi nang don gang yang ma shes par ma ṇi dang gzungs sngags 'dra bgrangs pa de tsam gyis chog shes nas 'grig gi yod par brtsi ba 'di nor 'khrul yin/ chos kyi shes tshad yar rgyas gtong ma thub na rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i dad pa med par sngar gyi goms gshis rgyun 'jags lta bus dad pa byas pa yin na/ de ni dad pa brtan po zhig yong gi ma red/ deng dus kyi shes yon yar rgyas kyi mthong rgya thos rgya che ru phyin pa'i skabs la chos kyi gnad don 15

thad dogs gnas mang po zhig slebs te de dag tshod dang 'dod dang / zhib 'jug byed 'dod cig rang bzhin du yong gi red/ shes yon slob sbyong gis nga rang tsho mi'i bsam blo'i nus pa sgo 'byed kyi yod pas/ ji tsam slob sbyong yod pa de'i tshod kyis do snang che ru 'gro ba dang / de'i phyogs nas gnas tshul dang / rgyu mtshan la dpyod 'dod kyi tho zhig skye bayin/ de'i mtshams gnas tshul yag po ma shes na/ lan gyis phongs nas chos zhes pa 'dir rgyu mtshan gang yang mi 'dug snyam pa zhig yong nyen yod/ spyir btang 'dzam gling jog rgyu mtshan de tsam med par dad pa kho na gatho rwa1 byed pa'i chos lugs rigs kha shas yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di shes yon yar rgyas phyin pa'i skabs la chos lugs kyi dad pa nyams 'gro ba'i gnas tshulayong giyod/ ma gzhi chos lugs tshang mas dus rabs mang po'i ring 'tham gling mi mang la phan thogs byung yod la/ da lta'ang mi mang por phan thogasayod/ dper na/ lhan du dang /ye shu/ kha che/ 'ju'u/ 'jen sogs chos lugs 'dra min de dag gis mi sa ya mang por phan thogasayong giyod/ yin na'ang spyir btang nas bshad na dad pa kho na gtso bo spud pa'i chos lugs de tshor do snang byed mkhan nyung du 'gro gi yod/ 'di 'dra zhig gi skabs la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di 'dzam gling thog gi mi bsam blo gting zab po gtong mkhan tshos tshan rig dang mthun che shos red brjod kyi 'dug dper na/ ngos kyi ngo shes tshan rig pa kha shas kyis nga la brjod par/ kho rang sgor gyi cha nas chos la dad pa med/ gal te chos shig byed dgos byung na ngas nang pa'i chos la dad pa byed kyi red/ gang 16

yin zhe na nang pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs tshan rig dang mthun pa ma zad/ 'grel bshad kyang tshan rig dang mthun pa'i gting zab po zhig rgyag rgyu yod pa dang /dngos gnas kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs dang / rgyu mtshan la brtag dpyad byed rgyu yod pa zhig red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nga'i bka' la brtag dpyad byed dgos gsungs yod pa de ni shin tu ngo mtshar chen po yin pas/ ngas chos shig byed dgos byung na nang pa'i chos byed kyi yin zhes brjod mkhan mang po yong gi 'dug de tsho'i mthong tshul nas 'dzam gling thog chos lugs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod pa'i nang nas deng dus kyi tshan rig yar rgyas phyin pa dang mnyam du dpung pa gshibs nas 'gro thub mkhan nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'ba' zhig yin pa gsal po yin/rtsa ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa brtag dpyad gang 'dra zhig kyang byed sa yod pa zhig yin/ yin na'ang chos la dad pa byed mkhan so so rang ngos nas chos kyi gnas tshul ma shes na mi 'grigs/ lhag don nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi dgon pa khag nang yod pa'i dge 'dun pa tshos chos slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ ma gzhi deng sang de'i thad yar rgyas phran bu phyin yod/ da dung yang shugs ston brgyab ste slob sbyong yag po ma byas na/ yul pa tsho'i nang la deng dus kyi shes yon phar bzhag ming rgyab 'khur gyi chos phyogs kyi shes yon 'di yang skyo po zhig la lus na rang bzhin dgon pa'i nang gi chos dad de so so rang ngos nas rgyu mtshan yag po ma shes pa'i dbang gis rmongs dad lta bu chags rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ de ltar rmongs dad 17

lta bu skyabs su mchi zhes bsdad na nam ring sgrung gis 'khyol mi thub pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ der brten nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di ha cang gal chen po yin/ chos byed dgos pa shes kyi yod na chos slob sbyong byas te lag len ji ltar byed dgos lugs shes dgos pa las/ slob sbyong gang yang ma byas par skyabs su mchi/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod nas bsdad na mi 'grigs/ nga rang hi ma la ya'i sa khul gang du slebs kyang rtag par ngas de ltar skul ma byed kyi yod/ chos slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/ khyim tshang so so'i nang gi rgan rgon tsho yin na'ang zhar dang zhor la don gnyer byas te dpe cha klog shes thabs dang / klog nas de'i nang don shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po yin/ de ring nga rang tsho 'dir 'dzoms pa'i go skabs byung stabs tshang mar bskyar tu 'bod skul zhig byas na snyam pa ltar bshad pa yin/shes song ngam/ la dwags sa khul gyis mtshon pa'i lha ma la ya'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i nang pa'i chos dad pa chos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di slob sbyong byas te nyams len byed dgos pa zhig dang / slob sbyong ma byas par chos nyams len spas dag cig yong thabs med pa ngos 'dzin gsal po thub pa dgos rgyu gal rdzun po yin/ dper na kha sa kha nyin nyin gnyis ring chos 'brel byas pa 'dis de tsam phan gyi ma red/ de ni 'phral sel gyi kun slong bcos pa lta bu zhig ma gtogs nus pa thon pa zhig yong ba la/ dus rgyun ldan nas zhar dang zhor la dpe cha blta dgos la/ dpe cha shes mkhan la skad cha 'dri ba sogs lo nas lo bstud de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi go sku gas je mthor 'gro ba'i 'bad 18

brtson byed dgos pa las/ da res 7rgyal ba rin po che'i drung nas bka' chos thob song snyam te nyin gnyis bka' chos thob pa 'dis go chod pa zhig rtsa ba nas min/ kha sa kha nyin 'grel bshad brgyab pa ltar khyed rang tsho do snang gsar pa slebs pa de tsho'i gras mu mthud dpe cha blta dgos/ma gzhi kha sang tshogs 'du'i sar skad cha byung la/ khyed rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi mi sna de dag gis dngos gnas nga tsho bod la rkyen chag 'di 'dra zhig yong ba'i skabs la khyed rang tshos sems khur blangs ste rang don khyad med kyi thog nas bod kyi bden don la rgyab skyor dang / sems khur blangs rgyu'i thad tshang mas hur thag byas pa der thugs rje che zhes brjod rgyu dang / da dung yang tshang mas da lta phan byas pa nang bzhin ma 'ongs par yang mu mthud bod kyi bden don thog la rgyab skyor byed rogs zhes 'bod skul byed rgyu yin/ de ring 'dir bod nas gsar du 'byor ba tsho khag gcig yod pa red/khong tshor gnas lugs phran bu 'grel bshad byed rgyu yod pas la dwags dang /hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas phebs pa tshos zur nyan byas te nga tsho rwabad pa'i bde sdug gnas stangs gang 'dra 'dug khyed rang chos kyang yag po nyan rogs/da res bod nas gsar du 'byor ba sku zhabs tsho dang / bod mi rgan byis gang 'tshams shig 'dir slebs yod par nga rang shin tu dga' po byung /nga rang tsho 'phrad pa red/ khyed rang tshos kha sa kha nyin nyin gnyis chos phyogs kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig thos yod/ nga rang tsho dngos gnas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi lung gis zin pa'i bod kha ba gangs can ljongs kyi nga tsho'i mi thog 19

'di dngos gnas bod kyi lo rgyus nang dka' ngal che shos kyi dus tshod nang skyes pa'i mi thog cig chags yod/ 7rgyal ba rin po che la cha bzhag na 7rgyal ba rin po che sku phreng bcu bzhi pa nga'i mi tshe 'dir bsam blo gtong skabs sems shin tu skyo / 'dug so nyi shu rtsalnga tsam nas so so'i lung pa dang bral te miyal la gyar nas da cha lo lnga bcu nga brgyad la slebs te mi tshe mang che ba so so'i lung par bsdad ma thub pa dang / de yang mi tshe'i nang gi dus tshod yag shos 'di mi'i lung par bskyal dgos byung ba red/ so so'i las dang bsod nams kyi thog nas bod kyi bstan pa dang / 'gro ba'i don dag la zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu rang gi las smon gyi 'brel ba yod la/ bod mi mang tshos kyang nga la yid ches dang dga' mos chen po 'di 'dra byed kyi yod pa red/ yin na yang nga rang de dag dang mnyam du bsdad de shugs rgyag rgyu zhig ma byung yang / ngas phyi rgyal rang dbang lung par bsdad de gangathub kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / yang sgos bod gangs can ljongs kyi bstan srid spyi don la sgo gang sa nas phan jogs kyi las ka gangayong ci yong byas pa yin/ rang gi nus pas ma ldeng pa'i gnas tshul ni tha dad red/ 'dzam gling thog so so'i ngos nas bsam pa rnam dag dang /drang po drang bzhag cig byas payin/ spyir btang mi'i chos nyid la drang po byed mkhan dang / bsam pa rnam dag byed mkhan la dga' po byed pa chos nyid yin dus nga rang sger gyi ngos la cha bzhag na 'dzam gling gi sa gnas gang sa nas sems thag nye wa'i grogs wa 31 mthun mang po zhig rnyed byung /bod spyi pa'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas bshad na'ang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i thog nga tsho phan tshun bsam pa 20

rnam dag gis thabs shes byas pa dang / so so'i thad nas bsam pa rnam dag g.yo zol med pa byed dus byed stangs 'di la rang bzhin gyi dga' mos dang brtsi bkur/ sha tsha/ rgyab skyor bcas byed mkhan 'dza ma gling thog lo re bzhin je mang je mang du 'gro gi yod/ de ni nga tshor sems gso dang skyo rogs byed mkhan yag shos shig chags yod/ de ltar phyogs gcig nas bsam blo gtong dus dngos gnas sems skyo dgos pa zhig yod kyang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam blo gtong dus gang la gang 'tshams go chod yod bsam nas spro ba 'phel gyi 'dug yin na'ang gtso che shos bod nang rgya mis btsan 'dzul byas pa nas bzung dus da lta bar du dngos gnas gtor bshig dang / nyams chag ha las pa zhig byung yod/ dper na rgya mi thog mar yong ba'i skabs nga tsho'i sa mtshams khag la 'dzings res gang la gang 'tshams shig btang yod pa dang / de rjes shugs che ba phyi lo 1955 lo'i lo mjug nas 56(57758(59 mtha' ma drug cu re grangs bar du rgya dmag dang 'dzings res byas yod/ thog mar khams dang / de yang li thang khul nas 'u thug thabs zad kyis rgya dmag dang 'dzings res byed 'go tshugs nas phyi lo 1956 lor khams khul dang /1957758 'ob de tshor mgo log khul/ a mdo'i khul/ mtha' ma 1958lo dbus gtsang khul nas byas te 1959 lor bod chol gsum gyi sa khul yongs la rgya mis drag gnon byed pa'i gnas tshul 'di byung ba red/ dus de nas bzung phyi lo 1983 lo bar du bod mi dus min rkyen 'das ji song gi gnas tshul nga tsho'i lag tu 'byor ba khag la gzhigs na/ dper na/ phyi 21

lo 1959 lo'i zla 3 nas 1960 lo'i zla rdzo bar lha sa'i nye 'khoral rgya mis drag gnon byas te bod mi dmar gsod btang ba'i grangs 'bor rgya mi kho rang tshos h+pho bkod byas pa'i yig cha gzhi la bzhag na bod mi brgyad khri bdun stong bsad 'dug de ni rgya mi kho rang tshos tho bkod byas pa'i yig cha ngo ma rgya mi'i dmag dpon zhig gi lag nas nga tshor thob pa de'i nang gsal po 'khod 'dug de bzhin phyi lo 1983 phan chad bod kyi sa khul mang spro zhig nas 'di phyogs mi sna yong ba tsho dang / 'di phyogs nas kyang bod nang lta stor dang /gnyen 'phrad mang po phyin yod pa sogs gnas tshul 'byung khungs mang po zhig gi gnas tshul la nga tshos phyogs bsdoms byed dus phyi lo 1983 lo phan la bod mi dmar gsod btang ba dang / 'thab 'dzings btang nas bsad pa/sdug mnar ma bzod par rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba/ ltogs shi thebs pa/ lhag par mdo smad kyi sa khul mang po zhig la phyi lo 1957758 nas 'go tshugs te mu ge byung yod pa dang / dbus gtsang khul la phyi lo drug cu re grangs nas mu ge byung ste rgya mis bod mi tshor zla ba gcig gi lto chas tshad gzhi bzos pa des nyin bco lnga nyi shu las ma ldeng par/ de 'phros kyi nyi ma rnams sngo ldum dang / shing gi lo ma/ rang byung gi sa 'jam po bcas zas nas sdod dgos byung 'dug sngo sdum yun ring za mkhan de tshor skrang sbos kyi na tsha phog ste ltogs shi thebs pa 'bum phrag kha shas byung yod/ bosang gsal gnas tshul gyis rkyen pas ྅/da mi dus min 'das grongs song ba bsdoms na sa ya gcig dang 'bum gnyis tsam zin 'dug bod mi'i rtsa 'bor sa ya drug brjod pa de'i nang nas sa ya gcig 22

lhag tsam shi ba de ni ha cang mang po red/dgon pa dang / lha khang drug stong nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig med pa bzos nas bod kyi snod bcud la nyams chag ha cang chen po bzos pa ma zad/ dus da lta'ang bod mi'i lus srog rgya mir dbang ba lta bu'i gnas stangs su gnas yod/ bar lam rgya mi'i srid byus skabs re phran bu ltod du 'gro ba dang / skabs re dam du 'gro ba'i 'gyur ba zhig yong gi yod kyang / de ring kha sa sngon ma'i gnas tshul la ltos te phran bu rdzod du phyin nas dza drag gi gnas tshul med pa dang / dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs kyang cung zad bza nga du phyin yod/ de bzhin bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la brtsi 'jog yod mdog gi rnam 'gyur bstan nas bod pa zhes brjod dus sngar lo rgyus nas byas rjes sku(da pa'i mi rigs red ces bstod bsngags phran bu gtong gi yod pa red/ kho rang tsho'i bsam ngo ma rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs thon nas bod ces brjod dus ches mun nag dang / ches rjes lus/ ches kla klo/ ches gdug rtsub can zhig red bshad nas bod kyi snod bcud yongs rdzogs phan thogs med pa'i dngos po lta bu zhig la ngos 'dzin byas yod/ de tsho'i thad bar lam phran bu brjod stangs 'gyur yod/ yin na yang spyi skusnangs kyi cha nas bshad na rgya mi'i dbang sgyur gyi 'og rim pas bod mi rigs dang / bod kyi rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsa༄ brlag 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha tan tan yod/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs bong tshos 'char gzhi ldan pa'i lag len bstar yod/ de ring kha sa de lta'i 'char gzhi ldan pa yin min brjod mi thub kyang / rgya mi phon che bod du slebs pa dang / rgya 23

mis dbang sgyur byas pa'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og las rigs phran bu gal che rnams rgya skad bed spyod byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul yod dus rang bzhin bod yig gi brtsi mthong brlag 'gro ba dang / so so'i mi tshe'i mdun lam zhig 'tshol dgos byung na rgya yig ma bslab thabs med chags pa/ bod yig gi shes yon ji tsam yod kyang mtha' ma bod pa'i slob grwa khag nang dge rgan byed rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ de las lhag pa'i mdun lam rgya che ba med pa chags yong dus rang shugs kyis bod yig gi mthong brlag 'gro gi yod pa red/ pha ma bod pa'i rig gzhung la zhen khog dang / gus brtsi yod kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul gyi 'og nas phru gus rgya yig gtso bo ma sbyangs thabs med chags yod/ mtho rim slob grwa zhig la 'gro dgos byung na yig tshad gathorwa na rgya yig gi thog nas gtong gi yod dus/ dma' rim slob grwa nas bzung / 'bring rim slob grwa bar bod yig thog la shugs brgyab nas slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi slobe phrug de tsho mjug tu rgya yig yig tshad ma yon par rjes lus thebs kyi yod/ de ltar spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul nas bshad na bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsa brlag 'gro ba'i nyen kha'i nang gnas yod/ dper na/ nang sog la cha bzhag na nang sog rang gi yul mi sa ya gsum tsam yod gnas brjod kyi 'dug yul mi sa ya gsum tsam yod pa'i sa cha de'i thog da cha rgya mi ji tsam slebs yod ce na gnas tshul kha shas nas rgya mi sa ya bco brgyad dang / kha shas kyis sa ya nyi shu slebs pa brjod kyi 'dug gang ltar yul mi sa ya gsum yod sar rgya mi sa ya bco lnga las brgal ba zhig slebs yod/ gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas 24

rim pas yul sog yul yin kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul rgya yul chags 'gro gi yod pa red/de bzhin bod lung par cha bzhag na/ rim pas bod yul rgya yul ngo ma zhig chags rgyu'i nyen kha'i gnas tshul ha cang gsal po 'dug nga rang tsho phyi logs sdod mkhan bod rme tshor cha bzhag na'ang btsan byol byas te rang yul bral nas bsdad yod/ khyod rang tsho so so'i lung par sdod mkhan tshor cha bzhag na'ang dka' ngal 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og la mi thog sbrel te bsdad yod/ de ltar nga tsho bod mi dus rabs 'dir skyes pa'i mi thog 'di stor bsam blo gtong dus sems ha cang skyo po zhig 'dug da lta dngos yod gnas tshul bod pa zhig gis bod par zhen khog byas na de khrims 'gal la 'gro ba dang / bod pa zhig gis rgya mir zhen khog byas na de yar thon la brtsi ba bcas kyi gnas tshul yod pa de ni ha cang skyo po red/ rgya mi gung khran la cha mtshon na de ring bshad pa sang nyin cha 'dzin med pa/ kha nas rang gi srid byus la 'gyur ba med/ rang gi srid byus thog mtha' bar gsum du yang dag pa yin/ 'gyur ba med ces brjod kyi yod kyang / nyin re bzhin 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul ni rlung po brgyab pa ltar yid brtan med pa zhig red/ de lta bu'i chab srid gdug rtsub can/ yid brtan med pa zhig yod dus/ de ring gi srid byus 'di'i 'og nas skad cha 'di 'dra zhig shod dgos kyi yod kyang / sang nyin srid byus 'gyur nas de ring gi skad cha 'dir nag nyes gang 'dra zhig 'khel yong bsam nas mi tshang ma blo g.yeng dang dogs zon kho na'i ngang sdod dgos kyi yod pa red/ nga tsho bod pa zhes sto 25

chas za stangs tha dad dang / bsam blo gtong stangs tha dad/ goms gshis tha dad/ lo rgyus tha dad yin pa rnams smos ci/ rgya mi kho rang tsho'i nang la cha bzha ga na'ang mang che ba yid thang chad de sdod dgos pa chags yod/ dbang sgyur mkhan de 'dra zhig gis bodayul dbang bsgur te bsdad yod pa de ni dngos rgonas sems skyo po red/ dpon po gsar ) ne rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang /ya rabs lugs bzang byed mkhan zhig yod na rang dbang bral yang phran bu blo gtad sa zhig yong gi red/ dper na/ rgya gar dbyin ji'i 'og tshud skabs ma gzhi mi ser spel yul byas te ha cang skyo po yod kyang / de skabs khrims sa zur du yod pa red/ dper na/ matāta ma lhan rdis rgya gar rang btsan gyi las 'gul gnang skabs des rkyen pas dbyin ji'i do dam btson 'jug 'og bzhugs dgos byung zhing / de skabs khong rang gi lta ba rgyas bshad dang / rgya gar gyi rang btsan thob thang bcas pa khrims sar rtsod chog gi yod pa red/ rgya mi gung khran gyis mtshon pa'i dmar wa'i ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul 'di'i 'og la de 'dra'i skad cha bshad sa gtan nas med/ khrims sa dang / las rigs tshang ma gung khran tang rang gi bkod sgrig dang / stangs 'dzin 'og sdod dgos/ khrims sa lta bu rang btsan zhig zur tu med pa 'dis rgyu mtshan bshad sa med pa red/ ngos nas rgya gar gyi grogs po kha shas la 'di ltar brjod kyi yod/ sngon ma rgya gar dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul gyi dbang sgyur 'og tshud skabs dngos gnas gdug rtsub myangs yod/ khong tshos mi gsod khyo yod la/ drag gnon yang byed kyi yod pa de ni thabs sdug red/26

yin na'ang deng sang phyogs yongs nas bsdur na/ dmar po'i rgyal khab kyi mi ser spel yul 'di de sto las kyang gdug rtsub che ba yod ces bshad kyi yod/dngos gnas nga tsho bod pa'i da lta'i mi thog 'di phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na thabs skyo po sems skyo dgos pa zhig red/ khyodags gzhan zhig nas bsam blo btang na ji tsam dka' ngal yod pa de tsam gyis mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa 'don rgyu'i go skabs yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ nga rang la cha bzhag na/ da lta brjod pa bzhin phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na nga rang dus tshod shin tu skyo po zhig gi sgang la skyes te mi tshe 'di ga'i ngang la phyin song bsam pa skabs re dran gyi 'dug rung / bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus nga rang dngos gnas dus tshod dka' ngal can bod mi rigs chags 'jig gi mtshams la slebs skabs skyes pa'i mi zhig chags yod/ skud sos nus pa bton te byed rgyu zhig sku(da pa yin na/ bod mi rigs chags 'jig gi mtshams la thug pa'i dus tshod 'dir zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu'i go skabs bzang po zhig yod pa yin dus/ dngos gnas las ka byas na byed rin yod pa zhig dang / nus shugs bton na 'don sa yod pa'i dus tshod cig la skyes pa 'di ni gzi brjidari red 'dug snyam/ nga rang tsho bskal bzang lugs bzang gi dus tshod la skyes pa yin na/ dmigs bsal rnam dpyod kyi nus pa 'don sa gang yang med/ nga ra nga tsho bod kyi lo rgyus gnyan 'phrang can zhig dang / bod mi rigs 'jig la phyogs pa'i dus chod 'di 'dra zhig gi skabs la skyes pa'i mi yin dus/ dngos gnas nga tsho'i thog las 'gan chen po zhig slebs yod/ nga rang tshos nus shugs bton 27

te las 'gan 'di 'grub thub pa zhig byung na/ de ni nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid yin/ bod mi rigs kyis rang la rang bzhin lhan skyes su yod pa'i rlabs chen nus pa rnams 'don dgos pa'i dus la slebs yod/ de ltar phyogs gcig nas bsam blo gtong skabs 'gal rkyen ji tsam mang ba de tsam gyis nga rang tshor rnam dpyod dang snying stobs 'don rgyu'i go skabs shig yong gi yod/da lta phan chad bod mi mang sems zhum med cing / so so'i srog gi nyen kha'i 'og tshang mngan sems shug ma chag pa byas te bsdad yod/ bar lam grwa btsun dang / slob grwa ba sogs gang 'tshams shig srog dor dgos byung ba dang / mang po zhig btson la tshud de sdug sbyong khrims gcod tshad med btang nas/ mdor na lus kyi zung khrag tshun gtsags pa sogasaganas tshul ha cang thabs skyoge nga mang po myong bzhin yod/ de dag gi sems shugs ni dngos gnas ha las pa zhig red/nga tshos dga' spro byed dgos pa zhig la phyi lo 1949(50 'ong de tshor rgya mi thog ma yong skabs khong tshor gdong len byed mkhan gyi mi thog rgan pa rdzogs zin pa dang / de rjes phyi lo 1959 nas 62 bar rgya mir 'thab rtsod gdong len byed mkhan gyi mi thog de dag kyang gang 'tshams lo na rgas po chags te da cha lo 60770 slebs nas mi tshe rdzogs la nye ba'i dus la slebs yod/ deng sang rgya mir mu mthud bsun po bzo mkhan ni gzhon skyes mi rabs rnams yin/ nga rang tsho'i mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod kyang / mi rabs gsar pa tshos mu mthud 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di'i thog nas dngos gnas bod mi rigs 28

kyi rlabs chen gyi snying stobs mtsho na gyi yod pa gsal po yin/ rgya mi tsho'i thog ma'i bsam blor spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang 'tshar longs byas pa'i mi thog de dag gis gsar brjer ngo rgol byas pa ma gtogs/ mi thog gsar pa de tshos gsar brjer dga' bsu byed kyi red bsam pa'i yid ches byas te mi thog rgan pa rnams rdzogs rjes khong tsho blo ltod yi ngang rang gi 'dod pa ltar bod dbang sgyur byed thub kyi red bsam pa'i re ba zhig brgyab kyang 'grub thub med/ dedro sang mi thog rgan pa tsho las gzhon pa tsho sems shugs che ba yod gnas brjod kyi 'dugami thog rgan pa'i gras kha shas snying rje/ sngon ma sdug sbyong shin tu chen po myangs pa'i rkyen gyis da cha snying stobs phran bu chung ba yod bzo 'dug gzhon skyes de chos rgya ro zhes shod rkyang dang tshang ma sems shugs me ltar 'bar ba zhig yong gi 'dug de dag gis nga cho ༄bad mi rigs kyi snying stobs mtshon par byed kyi yod pa de ni ngo mtshar skye 'os pa zhig yin/ da phan nga chorwa 1da mi rigs kyi snying stobs 'di rgya mis med pa bzo thub med la/ da dung yang gnyan 'phrang gi dus tshod 'dir tshang mas ngar shugs bsgril te bod kyi bden mtha' gsal ba'i don la zhum med kyi snying stobs rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu gal chen po yin/bar lam lo shas nang 'dzam gling thog 'gyur ba ha cang chen po byung yod/dper na/ 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i zhal gdams bka' slob nang / yang sgos dmar wa'i las lugs ches cher bdo bas rje btsun dam pa'i skye srid rtsad gcod mi chog pa dang / chos byed dgon sde khag gi mchod rgyun rtsa 'phrogs kyi dge 'dun pa dmag mir bcug pas mtshon 7rgyal bstan 29

ming med du bcom pa nā khu ral gyi las lugs ji byung go thos byung dang 'byung mus kyi srol ltar 'byung 'gyur bod jongs chos srid gnyis ldan gyi zhing 'dir yang phyi nang gang sa nas lhags par nges pas zhes sogs bka' gnangaspend la/nga rang tshos kyang de snga.u ru su dmar po zhes zhed snang chen po byed pa'i lung pa der deng sang ha las pa'i bsgyur bcos phyin nasayongs su phyi nang logayod/yo rob gling chen nang btsan dbang mkhan gyi dmar po'i rgyal khab gcig kyang lhag med/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na'ang dper na/ phyi lo 1979 lor las 'gul mngon gsal dod po'i sgo nas 'go tshugs pa dang / de rjes phyi lo 1986787 'ob de dag gi skabs su slob phrug tsho'i mang gtso'i las 'gul gyi nus shugs mngon gsal dod po zhig byung ba des rkyen pas mtha' ma hu'u ya'o pang gra ma 'grig gi gnas tshul thonayod/ de rjes phyi lo 1989 lor gnam bde sgo mo che'i mdun du mang gtso'i las 'gul gyi gnas tshul bon nas 'dzam gling gis mig lta bzhin pa'i skabs su rgya mi 'u thug ste gdong pagasadabral nas mi bsad khrag sbyor gyi drag 'thab lag len bstar ba red/ las 'gul des rgya nag mi mang dang / lhag par shes yon can dang / slob sbyong gi go rtogs phran buyod pa'i rgya mi de tshos mang gtso gcig sdud zer ba'i btsanadabang lam lugs la zhen pa gting nas log ste rang dbang mang gtso'i don gnyer shugs che byed kyi yod pa'i rtags mtshan gsal po bstan pa dang / rgya nag nang 'gyur bshin tu chen po 'gro gi yod/ phyogs gzhan nas dpal 'byor srid byus lhug gtong gi gnas tshul 'og 'das pa'i lo bcu grangs nang rgya nag 30

gi dpal 'byor yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po 'dug da lta rgya nag srid gzhung gis dpal 'byor srid byus lhug gtong dang /chab srid thad shin tu dam bsgrags byas te gnas thub pa'i re ba rgyag gi yod kyang / 'dzam gling gi mkhas pa mang pos brjod par gzhigs na dpal 'byor yar rgyas kyi tshad gzhi nges can zhig la slebs skabs chab srid kyi rang dbang shugs che ru ma btang na/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro mi thub pa zhig rang bzhin du yong ba de ni chos nyid red brjod kyi 'dug der brten rim pas lo shas nang 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i gnas tshul gsal po red/ tshur phyogs bod rgya che'i mi mang tsho'i sems shugs dang / chol gsum yongs rdzogs kyi sa khul nang rgya mir zhen pa log nas mi dga' ba byed pa'i bsam sdud pe cher 'gro ba dang /'dzam gling thog bod pa'i gnas tshul la do snang byed mkhan je mang du 'gro bzhin pa bcas de dag la bsam blo gtong skabs lo kha shas nang 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu dang /nam langs rgyur mngon du phyogs pa ltar mgyogs myur bden mtha' gsal rgyu'i re ba chen po'i dus la slebs yod pas tshang mas sngar bzhin sems shugs ma chag par rig pa bsgrim rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/de ring 'dir dge 'dun pa mang po 'dug da lta bod nang chos sgo phye ste sa khul gang sar dgon pa dang / lha khang nyams gso'i las ka zhig brel 'tshub ngang byed kyi yod pa de ni rtsa ba ha cang yag po red/ yin na yang spus dag po yong bar tshang mas do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de'i thad lhod yangs shor na dgon pa nyams gso byas te grwa pa brgya phrag gsar zhugs 31

byed thub pa byungayang / spus g.yag po ma byung na mjug tu dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red/ rtags cha lugs 'dzin thub tsam zhig ma gtogs ngo ma'i bslab pa slob gnyer dang / nyams len thog dang po nas mig ltos bzang po zhig 'dzugs ma thub na/ rjes su dgon pa'i nang grwa pa ga tshod yod kyang de dag don ngo ma'i thog chab be chob be lung pa gang chags pa yin na yag po med/ mang ba las spus dag pa gatho rwa1ra 'dzin dgos/ da lta dgon pa nyams gso byed dus sngon ma grwa pa brgya tsam yod pa zhig la thog mar 'go tshugs skabs grwa pa bcu bco lnga las med na'ang de dag spus dag po bos bsam slob gnyer dang / 'dul khrims kun spyod gang thad la blta bzo yod pa'i gzhi yag po zhig tshugs thub pa byung na/ rim pas de jog lnga'am/ bcu/ nyi shu ston ma brgyab kyang spus ka zhan du ma song ba rang 'jags sdod thub pa yong gi red/ de min ha be hob ber phru gu tshos kyang grwa pa byed kyi yin zhes brjod nas dgon pa'i nang 'dzul nas mtha' ma phyi'i rtags cha lugs brjes thub tsam zhig ma gtogs/ chos kyi slob sbyong de tsam med pa dang / nyams len kun spyod kyang med pa de 'dra chags na da lta'i dus tshod 'dir phyogs gcig nas dpal 'byor thad lasang phran bu gnod kyi 'dug da lta nga tsho'i mi mang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs phran bu bzang du 'gro ba'i skabs la de dag bod kyi khyon yongs kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thad shugs rgyag dgos pa las/ dngul phran bu byung ba de lam sang dgon 7/'i zhal 'debs la 'bul gyin bsdad na/ ma gzhi skad cha 'di ngas brjod rgyu mi 'tshams pa lta bu 'dug kyang dngos yod gnas tshul 32

la yag pospe yong snyam pa dran gyi 'dug sngon la lung pa spyi yongs kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas yong ba'i thog la shugs bsgril thub na/ khyon yongs kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin pa'i skabs la dgon pa dang / lha khang bzhengs rgyu rang bzhin lhun grub du yong gi red/ da lta spu phran bu skyes te yong ba'i skabs la lam sang rtse gtog rgyag rgyu shugs che drags na gang byas yong bsam te blo g.yeng yong gi 'dug la/ dpal 'byor gnas stangs thog kyang gnad 'gag chags kyi 'dugaganas 'gag gzhan zhig la phar phyogs nas bod mi'i skye sgo dbang shed kyis bkag te phru gu mngal nas 'don pa dang / lhag par sa khul khug kyog kha shas la bu mo lo 14(15 de 'dra yang skye sgo bkag pa'i gnas tshul ngas thos byung / de rigs mang po med na 'ang / de tsho'i gras bod mi rigs kyi phru gu rtsa ba nas skye rgyu med pa bzos pa'i gnad don zhig yin pa las/ 'char ldan bu btsa' zer ba'i phru gu grangs bcad kyi gnad don ma red/ dngos gnas byas na rgya mi'i mi 'bor shin tu chen po yod pas kho rang snub skye sgo mang tsam bkagatshur phyogs nga cho rwa1da pa dang / sog po sogs dngos gnas mi grangs nyung nyung yin pas gnas skabs skye sgo ma bkag par bzhag na 'os po 'dug kyang / de ltar mi byed par dbang shugs kyis skye sgo 'gog gi yod pa dang / nga rang tsho tshur phyogs nas kyang dang du blangs nas tshad longs spus dag med pa'i grwa btsun mang po byung na/ da lta nga tsho+o'i mi rigs rtsa brlag 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha yod bzhin pa'i skabs la de yang nga tshos bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad 'gag cig 33

chags yong gi 'dug lhag par yul gru chung chung nang gi bu mang po zhig dgon par zhugs nas grwa pa byed pa dang / yang khag cig rgya gar du yong ba de 'dra byas nas grong gseb de tsho'i nang bud med mang zhing / skyes pa nyung ba'i gnas stangs 'ugyur ldog gis rim pas grong gseb de dag rgya mi sdod sa lta bu chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten chos sgo phye ba'i dgon pa de tshos dang po nas grangs tshad gtso bor mi 'dzin par spus tshad gtso bor 'dzin rgyur do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de nas dgon pa cho'i nang / dper na/ se rwa dang / 'bras spungs dgon pa de tsho'i nang phal cher slob grwa yod 'dug pa de ni ha cang yag po byung 'dug ma 'ongs par dgon pa khag gis chos kyi slob sbyong sprod dgos pa ma zad/ spyir btang shes yon gyi slob sbyong sprod rgyu de yang gal chen po yin/ dper na/ nyi hong gi nang pa'i dgon pa dang / lha khang chen po de tshor rang gi khongs gtogs kyi slob gra mang po yong gi 'dug de ni ha cang yag po red/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub pa dang chabs cig shes yon yang zung du 'brel te zhabs 'degs bsgrub thub pa zhig byung na phan thogs ha cang chen po yong rgyu red/ nga rang tshos ma 'ongs bod kyi dgon pa khag gi nang deng dus shes yon gyi slob sbyong gi mthun rkyen yod pa zhig bzo rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ 'dir grwa pa gang 'chams yod stabs 'phros bshad byas nas bsnyungad pa yin/de nas bar lam bod nang gzhi rkang bod kyi rig gzhung gi shes yon yod pa'i mi rabs rdzogs 'gro gi yod cing / 'on kyang da lta nyung shas yod pa de 34

tsho'i gra sa kyis bar lam bris pa'i rtsom deb 'dra min mang po thon pa de tshor lta dus dngos gnas bsam blo mang po btang ste hur thag byas 'dug mngon gsal dod po'i skad cha shod sa med kyang / so so'i mi rigs kyi rig gzhung gting zab yod pa 'di'i rnam pa gzengs su thon pa yong ba'i don la tshang mas hur bskyed byas par nga rang dga' po byung / mi de tsho'i gras mang po lhag med la/bar lam khong tshos sdug sbyong mang po myong dgos byung yod/ da cha tshe mjug 'dir gzhi nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi don la so sos rtsom yig gang yong bris te zhabs 'degs sgrub kyi 'dug par ha cang dga' po byung / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa der 'dzam gling gi sa khul mang po'i nang do snang gsar pa zhig slebs bzhin yod/ dus chod 'di 'dra zhig gi skabs la bod nang cha bzhag na lha sa sman rtsis khang gis mtshon pa'i mdo stod smad khul du yang gso ba rig pa slob sbyong byed yul khag kha shas tshugs yod pa de tsho ha cang yag po byung 'dug de bzhin sger gyi slob grwa dang / kha shas kyis las zhor slob grwa btsugs nas bod yig slob sbyong dang / cha rkyen yod mkhan gyis dbyin yig kyang slob pa de tsho ha cang yag po yin/ de mtshungs sger so sos dang dod byas te sman khang chung chung de 'dra gnyer nas sman bcos thad zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan 'dug pa de dag kyang ha cang yag po yin pas rjes su yi rangs yod/gal che shos da lta nga tshos rang dbang ched 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di dka' ngal mang po brgyud dgos pa zhig yin pas/ ma 'ongs par rang dbang gi nyi ma shar skabs nga rang tshos gang 'dra byed dgos pa'i thad da lta nas go sgrig bya 35

rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ nga tsho btsan byol du yod pa'i ring phyi lo 1962lo tsam nas 'go btsugs te bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i rtsa khrims shig bzos pa de'i gzhi rtsa mang gatsho'i thog bzhag yod/ de'i nang 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang cha de 'thus mi sum cha gnyis kyi 'os shog jog nas bsgyur bcos gtong rgyuyod pa zhig bkod de mang gatsho'i rang bzhin ldan pa zhig chags yod/ yin na yang mi mang po zhig gis 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang char bsgyur bcos btang na mi 'grigs pas thag gcod 7rgyal ba rin po ches byed dgos zhes bkod de da lta bar lo mang po zhig song zhing / de'i ring 'gyur ba mang po zhig byung yod par brten/ da cha sngon ma bzos pa'i rtsa khrims de dag mang gatsho'i ngo bo cha tshang ldan pa zhig tu bzo bcos bya rgyu skabs su babs par brten/ ma 'ongs bod kyi byed 'char stor la bar lam gzhung 'brel gyi yig cha zhig gtan 'bebs byas yod/ de'i nang gi snying don ni nga rang tsho ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang byung ste gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung mtshams ngas bar brgal srid gzhung zhig bsgo 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / 7rgyal ba rin po cher lo rgyus thog nas yod pa'i dbang tshad rnams bar brgal srid gzhung der rtsis sprod bya rgyu/ bar brgal srid gzhung des lo gnyis kyi nang tshud du rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bsdu bskong bya rgyu dang / 'thus mi tshogs chen de ni rtsa khrims khrims bzo lhan tshogs shig chags kyi yod pa des ma 'ongs bod kyi mang gatho'i rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs bya rgyu/ rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs byed skabs bsam blo'i dpyad gzhi yong ched 'dzam gling thog rang dbang mang gatsho'i lam lugs mi 'dra ba mang 36

po yod pa'i nang nas/ dpe mtshon snying bsdus kha shas shig da lta go sgrig byas dang byed bzhin pa yin/ gang ltar nga tshos ma 'ongs pa'i bod de rang dbang mang gtso mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yong ba dmigs yul du bzhag ste 'char gzhi de 'dra bkod yod/bar brgal gyi dus yun de'i ring da lta bod nang rgya mis bkod sgrig byas pa'i las khungs khag nang las ka byed mkhan gyi bod mi tshos dmigs bsal gyi 'gan 'khyer dgos/ las byed pa de tsho'i nang nas mi kha shas bar lam rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs phran bu spyon pa lta bu'i las ka byed mkhan kha shas yod srid pas/ mi de tsho'i gras la nga tshos rgya mi'i skad cha bzhin sngon byas la rtsad gcod med pa'i srid byus 'dzin rgyu yin/ mi de tsho'i gras mang po zhig ni dbang med dang zhed snang 'og rgya mi'i mdun la sprel lad 'khrab dgos byung ba zhig yin pa dang / kha shas ni rang gis gnas tshul ngo ma ma shes par rgya mis 'khyog bshad byas pa'i phyogs gcig gi gnas tshul kho na thos pa de la yid ches byas pa zhig tan tan chags yod/ sho rwanin snying wa deng sang bod nang yod pa'i bod mi las byed par cha bzhag na ha lam brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu rgya mir zhe log nas bsdad yod/bod kyi sa khul khag dang / de bzhin pe cing sogs sa khul 'dra min la yod pa'i bod mi gnas rim gang 'tshams mtho po slebs pa 'di 'dra nas rang rigs dang / de min phyi rgyal mi sna bcas brgyud de 'di phyogs kha lan dang 7skyabs zhu bskur mkhan yong gi 'dug des gang mtshon gyi yod ce na/37

khong tsho rgya mi'i phogs zas nas rgya mi'i las khungs nang bsdad yod kyang / nang don bsam ༄༄ ngad pa rang byas te bsdad yod pa gsal por mtshon pa yin/ nyon chad smyo mchongs rgyag mkhan de 'dra yod na'ang / de ni gong du brjod pa ltar de'i tshe de'i dus gnas tshul gsal po ma shes pa dang gcig gnyis nas rgya mis tsha 'ded mnar gcod btang ba'i 'og zhed snang gis byed dgos byung ba zhig yin dus da lta nga tshos bsam blo gu yangs po gtong dgos/ rigs kha shas kyis bod nang rim pas 'gyur ba phyin na de skabs nang khul du gsod res btang mi yong ngam snyam nas zhed snang byed kyi 'dug nga chos gnas tshul de 'dra rtsa ba nas mi yong ba'i bsam blo da lta nas gtong dgos/ don med nga rang tsho nang khul sdug po gtong res byed pa'i gnas tshul byung tshe de ni ha cang thabs skyo po yin pas de ltar mi yong ba byed dgos/ 'dzam gling gi sa cha kha shas la gnas tshul de 'dra yong gi 'dug thog mar thun stong nas rang btsan rtsod len byas te rang dbang byung ba'i mtshams la rang dbang gi bde skyid la longs spyad de bde tod ngang ma bsdad par/ nang 'khrug brgyab ste nang khul sdug po gtong res byed mkhan yong gi 'dug nga rang tshos de dag nas nyams myong blangs te ma 'ongs par nga rang tsho dngos gnas chig bsgril dam zab tu gnas dgos pa las thal cha'i las ka mi spongang ba'i bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen po yin/de nas deng sang mdo stod smad kyi 'brog pa'i sa khul de 'dra la rtsa chu'i don gnad chung ngu la 'khrug pa brgyab ste rgya mis ri dwags rngon ched du sprad pa'i me mda' yang bed spyod byas nas nang khul gsod res gtong gi yod 'dug a 38

mdo khul la de 'dra byas pa'i gnas tshul thos byung / de ni shin tu thabs skyo po red/ nga rang tso nang khul phran bu mi mthun pa yong skabs bsam blo rgya che sa nas gtong dgos/ gnad don chung ngu zhig gi thog lam sang lag pa bkyag ste gsod res byed pa ni bsam blo rgya chung thag chod pa'i thabs skyo'i bya ba dang /bod mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren yin/ ma 'ongs par nga tshor rang dbang thob mtshams tshang ma'i nus pa spyi pa'i thog bsgril te chung tsag rigs snang chung du btang nas nga tsho'i bod 'di zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig yong ba'i ngas smon lam tshun chad brgyab nas 'bad brtson byed kyi yod/ zhi bde'i bsti gnas zhes pa 'di 'tshe ba spangs pa'i lung pa zhig dang / mdor na bya byi'u tshun chad kyi srog chags tshang ma zhi bde bag phebs la gnas thub pa zhig yong bar 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de 'dra zhig yong ba la nga rang tsho'i mi mang gi spyod pa 'di dngos gnas ya rabs shig dang / byams brtse'i tshor snang gi khyab pa zhig dgos pa las/ phran bu 'grigs ma 'grigs la lam seng gri mgor lag pa 'chang na gtan nas mi 'grigs/ 'di ha cang gal chen po yin pas tshang mas shes dgos pa dang / sems la 'jags pa byed dgos/ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs ni brgya cha brgya thag bcad de rang dbang mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro rgyu yin/ deng sang rgya mi tsho 'u thug nas/ nga tshos phyi rgyal lung par bod kyi bden don ched yib rtsod byed pa 'di'i dmigasayul spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed rgyu de red ces brjod kyi yod pa de ni khong tshos ched mngags rdzun bzo 'khyog bshad byas pa zhig yin pa las/ nga tshor dmigs 39

yul de 'dra rtsa ba nas med/ 7rgya la ba rin po ches 'go khrid pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyis spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi gang zhig gding gi 'dug gam zhes su la skad cha dris kyang bshad rgyu med la/ de skor dogs pa tsam yang byed mkhan med/ phyi rol du nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba phal cher chig 'bum sum khri skor yod pa 'di'i nang ma 'ongs par bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong rgyu phar bzhag rmi lam la yang rmis mkhan med/ de ni rgya mi tsho'i ri bong gnamabardib kyi sdug bsngal red la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas nga tshos de 'dra byed kyi med pa rgya mi tshos shes kyi yod na'ang /'u thug thabs zad kyis shes bzhin du rdzun dang ham pa gang 'dra zhig bshad na dga' bsam nas bshad pa zhig red/ nga tsho ni ma 'ongs par mtha' gcig tu rang dbang mang gtso'i lam la 'gro rgyu yin/ ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang byung mtshams ngas las 'gan 'khyer gyi min zhes tshig thag bcad nas bshad yod/ 'di ni nga sems shugs cha ga pa dang / yang na las g.yol byas nas bshad pa zhig rtsa ba nas min/ da lta brjod pa bzhin nga rang tsho las dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin dus/ nga rang ma shi bar du bod rgya che'i mi mang dang / bstan pa dang / 'gro ba'i don la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu 'di so so'i las kyis ba〈(sa pa'i las ka zhig yin pas ngas dus nam yang blos gtong thabs med/ yin yang srid gzhung sgrig 'dzugs byed skabs ngas de'i nang ma bsdad par phyi rol du bsdad na phugs rgyangs ring po'i cha nas phan thogs che ba yod/ nga tsho ma 'ongs par mang gtso'i 'os bsdu'i lam nas 'gro dgos/40

'dzam bu gling thog 'di las brtan pa dang spus dag pa med/ de ltar byas te nyams myong rim pas gsog thub pa zhig byung na yag po 'dug gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la nga rang lo na drug cur slebs rgyur thag nye zhing / dru ga cu nas bdun cu/ brgyad cu/ dgu bcu bcas mjo na lo sum cu tsam sdod mi sdod cig las/ de las brgal te sdod mi thub pa sus kyang shes kyi red/ 'di 'dra yin dus ma 'ongs par da lta nas brtsis pa'i lo nyi shu'am/ sum cu nang tshud la nga rang tsho'i mi rabs nas bod yul 'di chos srid gnyis ldan gyi rang dbang mang gtso'iyul lung zhig bskrun rgyu'i 'char gzhi go rim khag lag len ngo ma'i thog nas nyams myong bsags te snying 'jags sra brtan zhig bzo thub pa ma byung na yag po med/ nyen kha mi 'dug gam/spyir 'dzam gling lung pa gzhan dag nang la'ang rang dbang mang gatsho'i lam la dngos su 'gro dus mang gtso'i nyams myong byang chub pa zhig ma chags bar dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad kyi 'dug nga tsho 23da la'ang de ltar dka' ngal mang po 'phrad srid/ de 'dra'i skabs su ngas gzhung gi phyi la bsdad de 'a 'ub ma 'dus pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad skabs ngas bslab bya rgyag rgyu dang / byus gtogs byas/ de min 'os bsdu byas nas bon pa'i mang gtso'i srid gzhung des 'gan cha tshang 'khyer te 'gro gi yin na/ nga rang ma shi gong nas de'i thad rgyus mnga' cha tshang yod pa zhig dang / lag len byang chub pa zhig chags nas yag po yong gi red/ de min ngas gang 'khyol bar 'gan 'khyer te bsdad na/nga ni lo sum cu'i nang tshud la 'gro rgyu ma gtogs sdod thabs med/ ha mtho 41

na lo brgya tsam sdod thub na lha rgyal red/ dus nam zhig nga'i mi tshe rdzogs nas med pa chags rgyu red/ de skabs ha be hob be byas te 'dra min byung ba yin na de ni brtan po med/ ngas gzhung gi 'go khrid de bsdad pa yin na/ 'phral sgang bod mi mang po'i bsam blo zos bde zhing bag phebs pa zhig yong rgyu yang /don gyi cha nas drin chung la 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten ngas tshig thag bcad de ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang byung mtshams ngas bod gzhung nang las 'gan 'khyer rgyu min zhes shod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra yin/ nga rang tsho'i ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs ni phugs rgyangs ring gro'i cha nas bod 'di zhi bde'i bsti gnas su 'gyur ba bya rgyu de yin/ nga rang gi mi tshe'i tshe lhag gang yod pa de'i ring spyir 'dzam gling thog rim pas 'tshe med zhi ba'i srol gtod thub pa zhig dang / yang sgos rang yul bod lung pa 'di 'tshe med zhi ba'i bsti gnas su 'gyur rgyu'i smon lam tshun brgyab ste 'bad brtson bya rgyu yin/de nas da res tshang ma 'phrad pa'i zhor la gnas tshul chung tsag kha shas brjod rgyur/ bar lam lo shas gong nas bod nang chang rag 'thung mkhan mang du song ba des rkyen pas lus po dang / dus tshod chud zos su 'gro ba'i gan sa tshul mang po yong gi 'dug mi de cho'i gras kyis bsam blo rgya che sa nas gtong dgos/ ma gzhi sems ma skyid pa dang / khong khro langs pa'i skabs nyin ma 'khyol thabs su chang rag 'thung ba zhig yin pas/ gnas tshul la bltas na khag med pa lta bu yang / phugs nas bsam blo btang na rang gis rang la drin chung btang ba zhig yin/ des rkyen pas las ka ma spyid par 'thus shor ba dang /42

so so'i lus por yang na tsha phog pa bcas yag po ma red/ chang rag tshod med 'thung ba dang gcig gnyis nas deng sang bod nang tha mag nyal thag 'then mkhan kha shas yong gi yod sa red/ de 'dra rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med/ de bzhin rgyan po 'gyed pa'i rtsed mo ma chang rgyag mkhan mang po yod pa ma zad/ da dung de la sa phag rtsig zer ba'i ming gsar pa zhig kyang btags 'dug ma chang brgyab ste bsdad na yag po med/ lhag par na ning gnas tshul zhig thos byung /de cha tshang bden pa yin min mi shes kyang / pha ma gnyis ka ma chang rgyag par phyin te phru gu khyis zas pa red brjod kyi 'dug de tsho'i gras ha cang thabs skyo po red/ 'di 'dra byed rgyu med/ ma chang brgyab nas nyin mtshan gang 'gro mi shes par bsdad na las ka dang / lto gos la 'thus shor 'gro rgyu smos med khar phar phyogs rgya mi la'ang ngo tsha ba mi 'dug gam/ nga rang tsho tshur phyogs nas bod mi rigs 'di rgyal rabs lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ nga tshor rang dbang dgos zhes shod kyi yod/ nga rang tsho'i kha thabs 'di 'dra zhig las med na dngos gnas nyen kha yin/ 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med/de bzhin yag nyes la ma ltos par rgya mis btsugs pa'i slob grwa de tsho'i nang phru gu slob sbyong du gtong rgyu gal shin tu chen po yin/ dper na/ mtha' mtshams sa khul kha shas la rgya yig ma gtogs bod yig slob kyi med pa de ce'ire gras ha cang thabs skyong nga red/ yin na'ang snga 'phros rgya yig ma gtogs slob cikyi med kyang slob sbyong med pa las yod pa legs pas phru gu slob grwar gtong dgos/ de nas las rigs 'dra min khag nang yod pa'i bod mi tshos las ta'i 43

thog do snang ma byas par de las g.yol te nyi ma gang 'khyol du sdod rgyu med/ rang nyid rgya mis bkod sgrig byas pa'i las rigs gang zhig tu yod kyang las rigs de'i nang hur thag byas te nyin re bzhin nyams myong bsags nas/ slad phyin las rigs de'i 'gan cha tshang rang gis 'khyer thub pa byed dgos/ nga chos rang dbang dgos zhes rtsod pa ltar nyi ma gcig nga tsho rang khyim rang bdag dang /so so lung pa'i 'gan cha tshang bod pa rang gis 'khyer dgos pa'i dus shig shar skabs nga rang tshos 'gan 'khyer nas las ka byed ma thub na zhabs 'dren chen po yin/ da lta rgya mi yod bzhin pa'i skabs la rgya mis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces brjod de skad brgyab/ nyi ma gcig rgya mi lag rtsal pa de tsho med pa chags nyin 'khrul 'khor gyis mtshon pa'i las rigs khag nga tshos mu mthud mjug skyong byed ma thub par cam bzhag byed dgos byung na de ni shin tu ngo tsha po yin/kha nas rgya mi rgyugs ces bathedad rgyu las sla po yin/ de dang chabs cig rgya mi phyin pa'i rjes su nga tshos 'gan cha tshang 'khyer thub pa'i bsam blo da lta nas gtong dgos/ der brten las rigs sna tshogs su yod pa'i bod mi tshos las shar g.yo zol med pa'i hur thag byas te nyams myong bsags nas phyin chad so 11sa 'gan 'khyer thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/spyi yongs nas rgya dang / bod ces nga tsho lo rgyus thog tha dad so so yin/gal che shos rgya mi bod nang slebs nas da bar yar rgyas phyin yod/ dper na/ gzhung lam dang / slob grwa/ sman khang sogs 'dzugs skrun byas skor shog thog yig char 'khod par bltas na rnam grangs mang po zhig 'dug yin 44

na'ang de'i khe phan mthar thug gang du 'gro gi yod ce na/ de ni rgya mi tsho'i lag par 'gro ba ma gtogs/ bod pa tshor rgya che ba'i khe phan thob rgyu khag po red 'dug paṇa chen rin po che sku gshegs kharayongs bsgrags gsungs pa'i nang /rgya mi bod la slebs nas yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin yod kyang / gtor bshig btang ba de dag dang bsdur na gtor bshig btang ba shin tu mang bas/ yar rgyas phyin pa des de'i tshab do thub med ces gsungs yod/ gang ltar bod nang yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin pa de phyi rgyal mi sna'i mig sngar khra khra zing zing mthong rgyu yod tsam zhig las/ ngo ma zhib tshags po'i jog nas bod pa'i khe phan la bsam blo btang na dngos gnas nga tshor gyong gun chen po sku/ga yod/ nga ra nga tsho'i chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces de dus nas srid byus gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ ngas rtsed mo dang sbrags nas rgya mi tsho chu'i nang gi 'bu srin chung chung rigs bza' rgyur dga' po red/ de rigs kyi thon khungs bod la med/ rgya nag la ya rtse dang / dung dkar/ nya rigs 'dra min sogs yod/ kho rang sto rgya nag la bsdad na skyid shos red/nga rang tsho bod pa ni bod yul na skyid gsungs pa ltar bod la tshag sha dang / rtsam pa yod pas de dag zas te bsdad na skyid shos yin/ sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces gsungs pa 'di dngos gnas rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang / bod rgya gnyis rkar khe phan yod pa zhig yin/da lta bod nang rgya mis dbang bsgyur te bod yul rgya yul la bsgyur rgyu'i las ka byed skabs rgya mi tsho gdong pags mthug drags pa ma gtogs 'dzam 45

gling thog ngo tsha kha skyengs ngang sdod dgos kyi 'dug rgya nag gi phyi 'brel srid byus gang 'tshams yar rgyas phyin nas rgyal kha phran bu thob yod kyang / bod don gnas tshul thad rgya nag gi phyi 'brel srid byus la ga dus yin yang pham kha 'khel nas dka' ngal mu mthud 'phrad dang 'phrad bzhin pa red/ bod rgya mis bzung ba'i ring la bod pa tsho sdug pa smos med khar/ rgya mi sto yang rtag par rdzun bshad nas sdod dgos pa zhig chags yod/ de 'dra byas te sdod pa las rgya dang / bod gnyis tha dad so so yin pa ni dngos yod gnas tshul la bod pa'i za stangs 'gro stangs dang / rgya mi'i za stangs 'gro stangs gnyis rtsa ba nas 'dra gi med/ tha dad so so rang khyim rang bdag byas te sdod kyi yin na gnyis kur khe phan yod/ nga tshos sngon chad rgya mis nga tshor sdug po btang byung zhes 'khon 'dzin byed kyi ma red/ dper na nga rang la cha bzhag na/ rgya mis da lta phan chad nga mor sdug po btang byung bsam nas rgya mir 'khon 'dzin bzung ste sdug pa zhig byed bsam pa rtsa ba nyid nas dran gyi med/ de ltar byas te phan thogs med/ da lta brjod pa bzhin/ rgya mi chos kyang sngar byas la brtsad gcod med ces brjod kyi yod pa bzhin nga tshos kyang de ltar bya rgyu yin/da lta phan chad nga tsho'i thog ha cang thabs sdug gi gnas tshul mang po zhig byung yod/ de ni phyogs gcig nas sems can spyi mthun gyi las dang / yang sgos nga tsho sku( sos bsags pa'i las las byung ba dang / phyogs gnyis nas rgya mi spyi byings tsho yang dbang med du 'go byed 'ga' shas kyis ded pa lta bus sdod thabs med pa chags yod/ nga rang tsho mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bod 46

rgya khyim mtshes byas tespend pa 'di 'khrug pa rgyag mi dgos pa zhig dang / gal che shos nga tshos ma 'ongs par bod dang / rgya zhes khyim mtshes byas te phan tshun 'cham po'i ngang gcig gis gcig la rogs byas te sdodathub pa'i dmigasayul bzung dgos pa las/ gcig gis gcig la sems gnag byed ma dgos pa zhigayong rgyu de ni gnyis ga'i khe phan yin/ da phan 'das pa'i lo bcu gsum lhag tsam gyi gong ste phyi lo 1978 lo'i lo mjug dang 79 lo'i lo 'go nas bzung nga tsho dang rgya nag gzhung dbar thad kur 'brel ba byung zhing /thog ma'i 'brel ba 'go tshugs skabs ting zha'o thing gis gsungs pa'i nang /bod rang btsan zhes pa'i skad cha 'di phar zhog de min gnas tshul gang yin kyang nga rang tsho go bsdur byas te dka' ngal tshang ma sel thub kyi red ces gsal yod/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho bod dang rgya zhes tha dad so so yin pa gzu bor gnas pa'i yig lam tshang ma'i nang gsal po yod/ dngos yod gnas tshul la'ang bod dang rgya tha dad yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi 'og nas mi'i bsam blo'i bag chags bcas pa'i gnas tshul tha dad du yod/ de ltarayod pa'i dbang gis dper na/ rgya mis bod dbang sgyur byas nas lo bzhi bcu brgal ba 'gro gi yod kyang / bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas yin zhes ma ṇi bgrangs pa nang bzhin bgrangs dgos kyi yod pa red/ de ni dngos yod gnas tshul min pa zhig dngos yod gnas tshul bzo dgos dusaya tshugs brgyab na ma gtogs bya thabs gtan nas med pa red/ bod 'di rgya nag gi cha shas bston med cig yin na lo yun de tsam ring mu mthud nas bod rgya nag 47

gi cha shas yin zhes ma 'tshams bzhin dus tshugs rgyag dgos don med/ dngos yod gnas tshul la bod dang rgya tha dad yin pa ltar/ ngas sngon ma snga rjes rim pa bshad yod/ mtha' ma nga tsho bod kyi chab srid thob thang gang 'dra zhig gi thog tu 'gro dang mi 'gro thag gcod byed pa'i bab 'os bod kyi rgya che'i mi mang la yod/bod rgya che'i mi mang la rang dbang ldan pa'i thog nas thag gcod byed pa'i go skabs shig snga phyi ma gtogs yong dgos la de ltar yong skabs thag gcod byed kyi red/da lta'i dus tshod 'dir dza drag gi gnas tshul gang yod ce na/ dang po/bod mi rigs 'di 'jig 'gro ba dang gcigabod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams 'gro ba dang gnyis/ bod lung pa'i nang gi shing nags rnams gcod 'breg byed pa dang gsum/ sa gter khag sngog 'don byed pa dang bzhi bcas yin/ sa gter bton pa de tsho 'ga' zhig bod pa tshos shes kyi med/ bod lung pa'i nang rgya mi yong nas bod lung pa'i phyi'i pags pa bshus/ nang gi khog pa brus te sa gter rnams rgya nag la 'khyer 'gro gi yod pa de ni rkun ma'i byed stangs rang red/dngos gnas byas na bod pas shes pa byas te bod kyi sa cha 'di la thon khungs 'di yod/ gter kha 'di yod ces bshad/ rtsa ba'i rgyu nor gyi bdag po bod pa yin pa'i cha nas bod pa tsho la yang rin gong phran bu sprad de/ bod pa tsho la'ang lta rgyu yod pa zhig dang / rgya mi kho rang tsho la'ang gter dngos de tsho nas khe phan phran bu yod pa zhig byas na byed stang sa sdug pa la dpag pa'i phran bu bzang ba yong gi red/ 'on kyang khong tshos de las rdog ste gter kha phran bu gal gnad 48

che ba yod sa zhig yin na/ de'i sar bod pa gcig kyang gtong gi med/ rlangs 'khor kha lo pa tshun chad sa mtshams nas brjes kyi yod pa red/ dper na/jag pa rgyag mkhan zhig yin na mngon gsal dod po yod/ de ni rkun ma'i byed stangs rang red/ de 'dra'i thog nas nga tsho'i lung pa pags pa bshu gi yod pa ma zad/ bod mi rigs la mthong chung 'di lta bu byed kyi yod/ gnas tshul 'di dang / 'di 'dra'i 'og nas bod mi rigs 'jig 'gro ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung rtsa brlag tu 'gro ba'i dus tshod la slebs yod/ der brten da lta'i gnas skabs la dza drag gi dgos mkho che shos ni/ bod kyi mi rigs dang / bod kyi rig gzhung gnyis skyob thabs byed dgos pa de yin/ bod kyi mi rigs dang / bod kyi rig gzhung 'tsho gnas thub pa zhig byung na/ bden don nga tshos rim pas rtsod chog gi red/ sngon la mtha' ma'i bden don rtsod pa'i gong la nga rang tsho'i mi rigs rtsa brlag tu 'gro ba'i nyen kha 'di 'dra zhig yod pa yin dus/ da lta'i dus tshod 'di ngas dza drag cig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ bod nang rgya mis khrims dang mthun pa'i 'gro stangs gang yang med par rang snang gang dran gyis bod mi slo bur 'dzin bzung byed pa dang / 'dzin bzung byas phyin nyes brdung drag po btang ste mi nad gcong bzo ba/ mdor na lus kyi zungs khrag gtsags pa bcas kyi thub tshod tshad med gtong ba de dngos gnas 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang dang 'gal ba'i bya ba red/ der brten kho pa tshos nang khul la'ang gsang ba chen po byed kyi 'dugadaper na nam phyed mtshan dgung la rgya mi'i nyen rtogs pa slo bur bod mi'i khyim 49

tshang nang 'dzul nas de'i nang gi mi zhig 'dzin bzung byas te da dung nang mi tshor khyed rang tsho'i mi 'dzin bzung byas song zhes gzhan la bshad mi chog ces brjod kyi yod 'dug de ltar brjod dgos don gang yin nam/ drang bden gyi bya ba zhig yin na de 'dra brjod dgos don med/ las ka tshang ma rku rdzun gyi las ka sha stag byas stabs kho pa tsho ngo tsha dgos pa'i ma bde ba zhig yod par brten/mi 'dzin bzung byas pa nang mi tshor phyi la bshad mi chog brjod pa ni ha cang btsan shed kyi skad cha red/ de ni 'dzam gling spyi'i 'gro ba mi'i thob thang brdal bshig btang baspo cang cang / kho rang tsho nang khul la'ang lkog tu gsang ba byed dgos pa las/ mi gzhan la brjod mi nus pa'i gnas tshul yod pa de tsho'i gras ha cang thabs sdug yin pas nges par du mtshams 'jog yong ba byed dgos/gnyis pa/ bod kyi rig gzhung med pa bzo rgyu deng skabs 'char gzhi ldan pa zhig yin min da lta brjod mi thub kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul la da lta gong du brjo da pa bzhin bod kyi rig gzhung nyams brlag dang / rim pas rtsa 'thor 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha chen po slebs yod/ nga tshos dngos gnas bshad na/ 'dzam gling thog deng sang rgya nag gi rig gzhung dang / bod kyi rig gzhung gnyis bsdur na 'dzam gling thog phal che bas bod kyi rig gzhung 'di nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang mi'i snying stobs 'phel zhing / sems kyi zhi bde bskrun rgyur phan thogs chen po yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed pa las/ rgya nag gi rig gzhung de phan thogs che ba yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed mkhan med/ don dam du nga tsho'i bod kyi rig gzhung 'di 'dzam gling nang 'gro don che ba chags yod/ rgya 50

nag gi rig gzhung khyab gdal che ba kha zas tsam dang / de min ngo mtshar du brtsi ba'i lag rtsal rig gzhung rnying pa khag yod kyang / des mi'i sems la zhi bde sbyin thub kyi med/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i nga tsho'i bod kyi rig gzhung 'dis mi'i sems la zhi bde sbyin gyi yod/ mi tha mag nyal thag la skyabs bcol mkhan de 'dra yang / bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la brten nas sems la zhi bde slebs te kun spyod gtsang ma chags pa de 'dra byung yod/ des na bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di nga tsho bod par phan pa tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling spyi la'ang phan gyi yod/ phyin chad bod kyi rig gzhung 'dis rgya nag mi mang la'ang phan thogs chen 11 byed thub pa tan tan sku(nga gi red/da lta phan chad gnas tshul dka' ngal dam bsgrags 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og tu'ang / dper na/ pe cing dang / hrang had/ tang kra'o/ drin tu sogs sa khul mang por sngar nas nang pa yin pa'i rgya mi de 'dra 'dug la/ lhag par deng sang slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan nang spyir nang pa'i chos dang / yang sgos bod kyi nang pa'i chos la do snang byed mkhan deng sang je mang du 'gro gi 'dugade chos gsang ba'i thog nas bod pa dang 'brel ba byas te bod kyi dpe cha la do snang byed kyi yod pa dang / de bzhin bod kyi nang chos phyi rgyal skad yig la bsgyur yod pa de rigs phyi rgyal gyi mi brgyud nas rag thabs byed kyi yod pa ltare phyi rgyal mi tshos kyang rgya nag nang 'khyer 'gro gi 'dug da lta rgya nag nang chos byed mi chog zer nas 'dzems zon byed dgos kyi yod la/ 'dzam gling phyi nas ni 51

de bas do snang byed mkhan yong gi 'dug der brten bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di yag po zhig srung skyob byed thub na bod par phan pa tsam du ma zad/rgya mi kho rang tshor yang phan thogs yong ba dang / 'dzam gling spyi la'ang phan thogs yong gi red/ de ltar phan thogs yod pa'i mi'i rigs kyi rig gzhung 'di bdag po rgyag rgyu'i 'gan nga tsho bod par yod pa tsam du ma zad/ dngos gnas byas na rgya mi kho rang tshor yang 'gan yod pa zhig yin/ mdor na/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung rtsa brlag 'gro ba'i dus 'dir nga chos de dag srung skyob byed thub pa bya rgyu gal chen 11 chags skusad/gsum pa/ bod kyi khor yug srung skyob byed rgyu'i thad da lta gong du brjod pa bzhin/ nga tsho'i lung pa pags pa bshu gi yod tsang / de yang 'char gzhi ldan pa zhig med par ga sa ga nas shing nags gang byung gcod pa'i byed stangs 'dis dngos gnas nam zhig bod kyi gnam gshis dang / 'byung ba'i gnas stangs la 'gyur ba phyin pa yin na/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud rgya gar gyis mtshon pa'i yul khag mang po'i char zhod kyi gnas stangs la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa rgya gar gyi tshan rig mkhan de 'dra nas brjod kyi 'dug bod kyi gnam gshis kyis rkyen pas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi lo re lo re'i dus bzhi'i gnam gshis kyi 'gyur bar 'brel ba ha cang chen pogad/ bod sa mtho'i dbus su gnas pa de'i rdzo byang gnyis sa cha dma' bas rlung gi 'gro phyogs thad de nas cha bgos byas te 'gro gi yod pa'i skor rnam kun 'grel brjod byed stangs shig yod cing / gnas tshul de'i 'og nas bod sa mtho'i gnam gshis la gal srid 52
