'gyur ba phyin pa yin na/ bod kyi g.yas g.yon du gnas pa'i sa khul khag gi gnam gshis la 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa dang / der ma zad lha sa'i gtsang pos mtshon pa'i rma chu dang / 'bri chu sogs chu bo mang po zhig shar la rgya nag dang / we ti nam/ lto la rgya gar dang / pa ki si than sogs sa khul mang po zhig nang rgyug gi yod pas/ gal te bod kyi gnam gshis 'gyur bas rkyen pas da lta'i rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyi gnam gshis la slo bur 'gyur ba chen po zhig phyin pa yin na/ yul de dag gi chu mang po'i chu rtsa bod la thug yod dus khong tshor chu'i dka' ngal chen po yong rgyu gdon mi za ba yin/ dper na/ chu log chen po thon pa'am/ yang na chu rtsa skam ste chus ma ldeng pa bcas kyi dka' ngal yong rgyu'i nyen kha tan tan yod/ der brten bod kyi khor yug srung skyob bya rgyu de bod pa'i khe phan tsam du ma zad/ rgya gar dang / rgya nag the ba'i sa khul mang po'i rang byung khor yug la 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags yod/ gong gsal don tshan gsum po de dza drag gi gnas tshul du mthong gi 'dugade dag skor da lta nga tshos rgya mi dang mnyam du skad cha byed pa 'di nga tsho bod pa gcig pu'i khe phan ma yin par rgya mi'i khe phan yang chags yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog rgya mi tsho gdong mdzes po med kyang mdzes po zhig bcos te bstan nas rgya nag rgyal khab stobs chen yin pa dang / srid byus yag po yod cesa.u tshugs brgyab ste shod kyi yod/ bod kyi gnas tshul thog rgya nag gzhung la srid byus ran po zhig rnyed thub pa byung na/ rgya mi tshorayang phan thogs yod/ 'dzam gling thog rgya nag gi ming yag tu 'gro gi red/ bod kyi gnas 53

tshul thog rgya mi tshor thabs lam yag po rnyed pa dang / bod na nga gnas tshul lhing 'jags pa zhig byung ba yin na/ dong kong gi mi sa ya drug gi bsam blo'i nang zhi bde slebs bub rgyu dang / des rkyen pas phyi lo 1997 lor hong kong rgya nag dang zla bsgril gtong rgyur dka' ngal med payong gi red/ de bzhin rim pas the wan gyi gnas tshul yang rgya nag dang zla bsgril gtong rgyu'am/ de min gyi gnas tshul thad shugs rkyen chen po zhig thebs rgyu red/ de ltar ma byas phyin bod kyi gnas tshul 'og nas dka' ngal mu mthud 'phrad rgyu red/dper na/ da lta hong kong dang / the bon gyi mi tshos rgya nag gzhung dang yig cha 'dra chags po gang 'dra zhig bzhag kyang der cha gnas kyi ma red/ dper na/ bod dang rgya nag gzhung dbar gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zer ba zhig bzhag yod pa der cho gang 'dug gam zhes de dag dpe blangs nas shode kyi 'dugade ni dngos gnas red/thog mar bod kyi gnas tshul thad rgya nag gzhung la dngos gnas nyan shes go shes yod pa zhig dang / bsam blo rgya che sa dang / gu yangs sa nas btang ba'i thabs lam srid byus shig rnyed thub pa byung na/ hong kong dang the wan gyi gnas tshul thog phyin chad phan thogs chen po yod la/ rgya nag gi rgyal spyi'i phyi 'brel thog la'ang phan thogs nges can zhig yod/ 'on kyang khong tshos de'i thog bsam blo gtong gi mi 'dug de ni phyogs gcig nas bsam blo sbug srub dog drags pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas 'jigs snang lta bu byed kyi 'duganga'i ngos nas bar lam lo bcu gsum lhag tsam ring bsam pa rnam dag gi skad 54

cha bshad pa yin/ ngas bsam pa rnam dag gi skad cha bshad pa'i nyer len gyis bod mi nang khul nas kha shas kyis 7rgyal ba rin po ches bod kyi thob thang chorang gi 'dug ces shodz+wa mkhan byung / ngas bod kyi thob thang btsong pa gang yang min/ngas snga rjes bshad pa'i skad cha'i nang bod 'di rgya nag gi cha shas red ces nam yang bshad med/ ma 'ongs par yang bod 'di rgya nag gi cha shas red ces gang 'dra byas te brjod thub bam/ nga mi gcig gi kha nas bshad pa yin na'ang lo rgyus dang / rgyal rabs la bsgyur bcos 'gro thabs med/ lo rgyus ni 'ong rgyus rang red/ lo rgyus zhes pa 'arin byung zin pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin pas de med pa bzo mi thub/ dper na/ u ru su dmar po'i rgyal khab kyis de snga'i u ru su'i lo rgyus dang / 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa la sogs pa'i u ru su dang 'brel ba yod pa'i lo rgyus mang po zhig la 'khyog bshad byas te bsgyur bcos gtong ba'i thabs shes byas yod kyang da cha pham nyes la phyin pa red/༄gung khran tang gis dbang cha 'dzin pa'i rgya nag rgyal khab la cha bzhag na lo rgyus de tshor bsgyur bcos gtong 'dod yod kyang gtong thub kyi med pas na/ ngas skad cha bshedade bsgyur bcos ji ltar 'gro thub kyi red dam/ des nga rang rdzun pa chags thub tsam zhig ma gtogs lo rgyus la bsgyu ra bcos 'gro gi ma red/ bod dang rgya tha dad so so yin pa lo rgyus thog gsangal po yod pa bzhin ngas kyang bod dang rgya tha dad red ces brjod rgyu ma gtogs/ bod rgya nag gi cha shas red ces brjod thrub thabs med/ gal te brjod kyang des rgya mir phan mi thub par/ nga rang rdzun pa bzo thub tsam skurdzong rgyu red/ rgya mis nga la bod rgya nag gi cha shas 55

red brjod dgos zer gyi yod kyang de ngas brjod mi thub/bod dang rgya tha dad so so red/ yin na yang nga tsho thun mong mos pa mnyam pa zhig byung na mnyam du bsdad chog gi red/ de ni bod rgya nag gi cha shas chags pa zhig min par/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi bag ma bsu len byas pa lta bu zhig yin pas/ nga rang ces mnyam du bsdad nas mnyam za mnyam 'thung byas te bod pa'i ngos nas rgya nag la khe phan sprod dgos pa sprad/ rgya mi'i ngos nas kyang nga tsho bod par tshur mthong dang brtsi 'jog cha tshang zhig byas te rogs ram yag po byas na/ nga tsho mnyam du las kha/ byas te lto gos khyim tshang gcig nang bzhin byas te sdod thub kyi red/ des bod rgya nag gi cha shas chags thub kyi ma red/ yin na'ang mi kha shas kyi nga'i gros 'char 'di phran bu rin thang chung drags 'dug ces brjod kyi yod/ ngas bod kyi bden don rtsod ched bar lam rgya nag dang mnyam du da lta bar thabs shes byas te phyi lo 1987 lor zhi ba'i gros gzhi don tshan lnga dang / de rjes phyi yo/ 1988 lor yo rob kyi 'thus mi'i gros tshogs sar gros gzhi bton pa snu'i nang ngas phran bu gu bshangs byas drags 'dug ces kha shas la bsam tshul byung yod/ nga'i bsam tshul ni 'di yin/ gang ltar da lta dza drag gi gnas tshul yod pa 'di las skyob thub pa zhig byung na/ bod pa cho'i bsam blo'i 'khon sems phran bu chung du 'gro rgyu dang / 'dzam gling thog kyang rgya nag la mthong tshul yag tu 'gro gi red/ de mtshams nas rgya mi tsho yang nga tshor 'tshig za dogs 'drog byed ma dgos pa dang /nga rang tsho yang sems nang 'u thug gi gnas tshul 'di phran bu lhing 'jags pa 56

zhig yong rgyu'i re ba yod/ de nas rim pas skad cha bshad rgyu yong gi red/ rdo don snying po bod par khe phan yod pa zhig dang / rgya mi tshor yang gang 'tshams kyi blo bzhag sa yod pa'i gnyis mos kyi lam zhig rnyed kyi red bsam gyi 'dugade ni da phan nga tshos 'bad brtson byas pa dang / ma 'ongs par bya rgyu'i bsam blo'i 'char gzhi go rim sgrig stangs rnams yin/ da phan rgya mi'i ngos nas brda lan yag po zhig byas ma byung / de las ldog ste nga'i bsam pa rnam dag gi gros gzhi 'dir bod mi nang khul nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches gu bshangs byas drags 'dug ces brjod kyi yod la/ dngos gnas ngas kyang gu bshangs byas yod/yin na'ang rgya mi'i ngos nas de ni rang btsan dang / phyed rang btsan/ rnam pa bsgyur ba'i rang btsan bcas kyi las 'gul red ces tshur bsnyon 'dzugs byed khyo 'dug de ni kho rang tshor gnong yod pa des ma bzhag par bsam pa rnam dag gi gros gzhir ming 'dra min btags nas khag 'dogs byed sa bzos te bde lan bya rgyur nyin 'gyangs zhag phud byas te da bar bsdad pa red/ da bar nga tshos 'brel ba byas pa 'di'i thad bod mi nang khul dang / 'dzam gling phyi rol bcas nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi lhag tsam ring bzod bsran chen 11 gang sku(nga ci yong mes 'tshig mer gtugs kyi thabs shes gnang bar tshur phyogs la grub 'bras gang yang thos med pa dang / phar phyogs rgya mis bod nang da dung rkang brkyang lag brkyang mu mthud byed kyi yod pas 7rgyal ba rin po ches gu bshangs ji tsam gnang yang phan thogs mi 'dug bod nang rgya mi rkang brkyang lag brkyang mu mthud byed du bcug na/ des 'dzam gling 57

thog gi bod par rgyab skyor byed mkhan rigs kha shas phran bu sems shugs chag rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug ces brjod mkhan 'dug la/ skabs re dngos gnas de 'dra yong gi yod bzo 'dug der brten slad phyin nga tsho gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi thog 'gro dang ma 'gro rgya mi'i byed phyogs la rag las yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bsam blo phran bu gu yangs tsam zhig btang nas gu bshangs byas pa yin na/ nga'i ngos nas da lta bar du gu bshangs kyi bsam blo btang ste gang sa nas thabs shes byas pa yin la/ da dung yang mu mthud de mjug skyong byas na bsam pa yod/ gal te rgya mi'i ngos nas bsam shes med par mu mthud 'bu ches chung zos kyi ngan gshom byed stangs de ga'i thog phyin pa yin na/ don dag son rung ma son rung bsam blo gzhan zhig gtong rgyu red/ da lta ngas bod 'di dza drag gi gnas las skyob pa'i dgos mkhestsore 'og nas gu bshangs kyi bsam sdus btang yod/ ci ste nges med da lta'i dza drag gi gnas las skyob pa'i dgos mkho'i thad nus pa thon pa'i phan thogs shig ma byung na/ phugs rgyang ring wa'i nga tsho'i bden don gyi thob thang rtsod rgyu 'di gal chen po yin/ de ni gnas tshul 'gyur 'gros la bstun gyin du bya rgyu'i las ka zhig yin pas da lta thag gcod bya rgyu min/ da lta phan chad ngas bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs skor la bsam blo gang 'dra zhig gtong gi yod pa dang / de bzhin 'char gzhi go rim gang 'dra zhig sgrig sku(da pa mdor bsdus nas bshad na 'di 'dra yin/ shes song ngam/nga'i skad cha mang drags ma song ngam/ skad cha mjug ma bshad dus 'go rnams brjed ma song ngam/ gong gsal rnams khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byas/58

bod la log 'gro mkhan khyed rang tshos khyed rang tsho'i grogs po grogs mo nang khul ngo shes pa khag la phran bu brgyud bsgrags byed thub na yag po red/'dir rgya gar nang bsdad de grwa sar 'gro mkhan tshos dpe cha yag po bltas/ sgrig lam yag po khur nas hur thag byed dgos/ de min phru gu chung chung slob grwar 'gro mkhan yod na de ni dka' ngal gang yang med/ de nas da lta 'phral sel dza drag gi btsugs pa'i sbir slob gra'i nang yod pa de 'dra yod na bar lam slob grwa der dka' rnyogs phran bu byung ba de ni don med spro thung dang /dogs pa rnam rtog byas nas zhabs 'dren phran bu zhus pa red/ de rjes sgrig 'dzugs gsar pa bzos te sgrig lam phran bu dam du btang nas da lta nying 'jags yod pas/ khyed rang tshos kyang sgrig lam yag po 'khyer dgos/ 'dir yong ba'i dgos don slob sbyong bya rgyu 'di yin pas slob sbyong hur thag dang / rnam kun snyoms chung byed dgos/ khyed rang tsho gnas bskor te log 'gro mkhan tsho sems skyid wa'i ngang blo bde bag phebs byas te log chog da lta gong du brjod pa bzhin nga tsho bod gzhis byes gang nas bsam blo btang yang nga rang tsho'i mi rigs 'di sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas bzung chos dang rig gzhung rlabs chen yod pa'i mi rigs shig byas te dus da lta bar gnas yod/ slad phyin ma 'ongs par yang nga rang tsho 'dzam gling gi mi rigs 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig byas te gnas thrub pa yong ched da lta bar du tshang mas dngos gnas 'thus ma shor ba hur thag byas yod la/ da dung yang tshang mas hur bskyed mu mthud byed dgos/ blo bde po gyis/ nga'i thad khyed rang tshos sems khral rtsa ba nas 59

byed mi dgos/ nga sems shugs chag med la/ gzugs po yang bde thang yod/ rgas po lo gang 'tshams sdod ring bod dang rgya mi'i mi mang la bsam pa rnam dag gi zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i nga'i bsam 'dun la g.yo ba gtan nas med/ khyed rang tsho blo bde po gyis/ lo kha shas nas bod la gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms yong ba'i re ba yod pa red/ tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/la dwags kyi grogs po tsho/ nga chorwa 1da kyi gnas tshul shes song ngam/ de ring ngas bod pa'i gnas tshul bshad pa 'di dag khyed rang tsho rang gi yul du slebs skabs yul mi ngo shes tshor deng skabs hi ma la ya'i ri bo'i byang phyogs la yod pa'i bod kha ba gangs can gyi ljongs zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing de rgya nag pos zin te gtor bshig dang / nyam chag gang 'dra phyin yod pa rnams 'grel bshad yag po rgyag dgos/ bod mi mang 'gyel sa nas langs thub ched da lta bar du tshang mas snying la rus pa bcug ste dka' las brgyab 'dug la/ da dung yang dka' las brgyab ste khong tshos bden mtha' gsal thub pa'i bsam blo gtong gi 'dug ces shod dgos/ da phan hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud mi mang gis mtshon pa'i rgya gar mi mang dang / 'dzam nyi ri gi phyogs gang sa'i drang bden la dga' ba'i mi mang tshos bod pa'i gnas tshul ma shes na ma gtogs/ shes phyin chad la sha tsha zhig rang bzhin du slebs yong gi 'dugad dung yang de ltar yong thabs la tshang mas shugs ston brgyab ste rang rang skabs su gang babs kyi zhal 'debs che gzhogs chung gzhogs rgyag rgyu gal chen po yin/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' stsal// //60

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1992 zla 12 tshes 14 nyin mon go 'dod rgu gling gzhis sgar ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir nga tsho las bsdoms tshogs 'du'i thog la zhib khra'i las bsdoms gsal thag chod dang / rtsis khra'i skor yang ha cang gsal po gtsang ma yag po byung song / sngon ma las bsdoms byas pa de nas da lta bar du las ka mang po zhig byas dang byed bzhin pa rnams yag po byung 'dug 'di ga'i las ka byed mkhan tsho dang / sa khul 'dir lo nas lo bstud de dka' las rgyag mkhan mi mang tshang mas hur thag byas nas grub 'bras thon pa yin dus tshang mar thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ de nas nam rgyun ngas bshad mus ltar/ yag sa la bstod bsngags mi gzhan dag gis btang na 'grigs kyi red/ nga rang tsho nang tshags bstod bsngags byed dgos don mi 'dug skyon cha yod pa 'di tsho'i gras kha kyog sna kyog la ma phyin gong nas yid gzab byed rgyu gal che na po red/ nga tsho'i ga zhis chags nang la sa zhing 'debs skyong byed rgyu'i thog la 'thus shor 'gro gi yod sa red/ zhing las kyi thog la dka' las phran bu yod pa dang / de las sud krar tshong bar phyin pa yin na des skabs 'phral dngul lam seng bzo thub kyi 'dug bsam/ so sor sa skal yod pa de la bdag gces yag po byed ma thub pa'i 'thus shor zhig yong gi yod sa red/ da lta sus krar gyi tshong las des lam seng lam seng dngul phran bu zhig bzo thub kyi yod na yang / gzhis chags nang gi sa khang la bdag gces dang / thon skyed las rigs la 'thus shor phyin 61

pa yin na skyon chen po red/ sud krar tshong las ched rgya gar grong khyer sa khul 'dra mi 'drar slebs te mthong rgya thos rgya che ru 'gro gi yod pa dang / gnyis nas khra khra zing zing 'dra min byed rgyu la do snang zhig slebs/ mu mthud nas sa zhing thog dka' las rgyag rgyur do snang chung du phyin gsum nas mi rigs 'dra min mang po la 'dris gshibs yong dus ham rdzun dang / g.yo khram byed pa'i mig ltos ngan pa de 'dra 'jags rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa red/ lhag par du slo nad kyi rigs 'gos pa yong dang yong bzhin pa'i thog de sang rgya gar nang la log g.yems kyis rkyen pas reg dug lta bu'i na tsha phog pa phal cher mi sa ya kha shas shig yod pa dang / nad de phog na nyen ka shin tu chen po yod lugs bshad kyi 'dug da lta bar du bod pa'i nang la de 'dra'i na tsha phog pa ha lam med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig red/ 'on kyang nyen ka med pa min stabs shin tu gzab gzab byed dgos pa zhig red/ mdo don snying po ngas zhu rgyu ni sud krar tshong las mi bya thabs med yin na yang / gzhis chags nang 11 sor sa cha zhig yod pa de bdag po yag po rgyag thub pa zhig dang / de'i thog nas sgor bed gang 'dra zhig spyad dgos kyi 'dug gam/ zhing kha btab nasalge drag yang shing 'bras de 'dra btab nasalge drag de min thabs shes gang byed rgyu yod kyang rdzod yangs ma song ba byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po 'dugade nas spyi yongs mang tshogs nas shes yon gyi thog la do snang byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ phru gu yar 'dzin gra kha shas slebs pa'i mtshams la sud krar tshong g.yog la 'khrid pa dang / khyim tshang nang gi las ka bskul te slob 62

sbyong mjug skyong ma thub par 'thus shor phyin pa yin na ha cang phangs po red/nga rang tsho 'dir 'phral sel rgya gar nang la mi tshe skyel rgyu'i don dag min par phyin chad bod lung pa'i nang la slebs pa'i mtshams su bod kyi spyi tshogs yar rgyas gtong rgyus mtshon pas las 'gan shin tu chen po zhig mi thog rje sa ma de dag gi thog la slebs yong gi red/ da lta phan chad bod nang rgya mis dbang bsgyur 'og la 'tshar longs byas pa'i gzhon nu pho mo cho'i shes yon dang / nga tsho shādir btsan byol ba'i gzhon nu pho mo tsho'i shes yon cha snyoms byas na nga tsho rgya gar la phran bu'i drag pa ma gtogs skyo ba yod pa ma red/ de 'dra'i gzhi ma gcig yod pa'i thog la slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs lhod yangs chud zos btang na ma 'ongs par bod la slebs pa'i skabs la so so'i phru gu de shes yon gyi thog nas rjes lus thebasdo/ rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa red/ phru gu do bdag so so'i ngos nas slob sbyong byed ma thub pa dang / slob sbyong gi re ba med pa de 'dra yin na ni gnas tshul tha dad red ma gtogs/ re ba yod mkhan 'di cho'i gras 'dzin gra bcu gcig bcu gnyis byas te gang ltar mtho rim gyi slob sbyong byed thub pa'i thog la pha ma tshos sems khur do snang byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/de nas 'dir chos sde khag 'di dag da lta bar du yag thag chod red/bod nas gsar 'byor yong mkhan je mang du 'gro ba'i khongs nas/ chos sgar la 'gro gi yin zer mkhan tshang ma gtong yul zhig byung ba red/ chos sgar 'di dag la mthun rkyen dmigs bsal gang yang med pa'i dka' ngal chen po yod na yang ris su ma chad pa'i chos sgar khag mdor na bon dang bcas pa 63

tshang ma'i thog nas rang don rang gces kyi bdag sprod dang / slob sbyong sprad de tshang mas hur thag byas pa ha cang yag po red/ thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ de snga phan chad bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gnas tshul la mtshon na su gcig la smon mi dgos pa zhig yod pa red/ sngon rgya gar gyi na lan ṭa dang /bi ka ma la shi la/ de tsho nas byung ba'i bslab pa slob gnyer gyi 'gro stangs shig bod la dar/ dus rabs brgya phrag mang po'i ring la nyams myong gsog gin yar rgyas phyin pa ha las pa zhig yod pa red/ deng sang nga rang tsho btsan byol la yod pa'i skabs tsam du ma zad/ ma 'ongs par bod la slebs pa'i gnas skabs la yin na'ang 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs la 'brel ba chen po zhig slebs yong gi red/ chos pa bya bral ri la bsdad mkhan zhig yin na gnas tshul khag khag red/ de min dgon pa'i nang la bsdad mkhan dang / slob gra khag gi dge rgan khag spyi tshogs kyi nang la chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung gi las ka byed mkhan tshos 'tham bu gling gi spyir btang shes yon gyi gnas tshul shes dgos kyi 'dug sngar yin na bod lung pa 'dzam bu gling phyi logs la 'brel ba med pa byas nas bsdad pa red/ ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling spyi yongs la 'brel ba yod pa'i thog nas bod kyi chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung 'di dag 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la ston thub pa zhig dang / 'dzin thub pa zhig byed dgos stabs nga tshor shesayonye phyogs tshang ma nas phun sum tshogs pa dgos mkho chen po 'dugadaper na gzhis chags khag nas yong mkhan gyi mi phyo dang / chos sgar khag nas yong mkhan tsho mthong rgya thos rgya nyung drags pa'i skyon gyis bsam blo phran 64

bu sbug srub dog pa lta bu yong gi yod/ de ga res lan pa red zer na/ skabs babs nyin zhag phrug gcig gi byed sgo sngar nas yod pa de ga rang la mgo 'khor nas bsdad pa ma gtogs/ deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul 'gyur ba chen po 'gro bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs par 'brel lam gsar pa yong rgyu'i gnas tshul la do snang byed rgyu ldang gi med pa'i skyon min nam bsam gyi 'dug ma gzhi sngon nas kyang lab yod/ chos sgar khag gi nang / nang don rig pa tsam du ma zad rig gnas gzhan dag 'di tsho'i gras kyang shes dgos kyi 'dug ces sngon ma nas skad cha byung yod/ de ni nga rang tsho bod skad rang gi nang la yod pa'i shes yon skor bshad kyi yod pa red/ de tsam du ma zad da cha 'dzam gling phyi logs kyi shes yon sgor la yang nga tshos do snang che ru gtong dgos kyi 'dug bod nas tshur gra rgyun gsar 'byor 'di tsho'i gras gnam gshis tsha grang dang / lto chas za stangs/ yul dus dang bstun pa'i 'phrod bsten byed sgo mang po zhig gi thog la dmigs bkar gyi do snang byas/ slob gso btang / rgyus yode kyi thog nas 'grel bshad 'thus ma shor ba byas na ma gtogs/ lhod yangs kyi thog nas nad mnar dka' ngal 'phrad rkyen byung na mi 'grigs pas do snang yag po byed dgos/ spyi yongs kyi dgon pa chos sde khag 'di dag spyir btang slob sbyong byed pa gcig pu ma yin par/ gang ltar dge 'dun gyi sde chags bsdad yod/ dge 'dun gyi sde de rtags cha lugs brjes pa tsam gyis mi chog par nang bsam blo'i 'khyer so dang / phyi'i kun spyod gang ci gzhan dang phran bu mi 'dra tsam zhig dgos rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin pas dgon pa'i nang la 65

yod pa'i dge 'dun rnams spus dag po zhig yong thabs la 'bad rtsol sgo gang sa nas byed dgos/ re zung re zung la 'bod bskul byas pa dang / slob gso ji tsam btang yang yar rgyas 'gro rgyu med pa de tsho'i gras dgon pa'i sgrig khungs la bzhag rgyu yod pa ma red/ de 'dra byas na/ rim pas rim pas dge 'dun gyi sde spus dag po chags yong gi red/ dgon pa'i sgrig khungs su zhugs pa'i rjes la sprus dag po zhig yong rgyur tshang mas do snang byed rgyu gal chen po 'dugangs bar skabs mkhan po dang / dge bskos tshos tsha tsam byed dgos zhes bshad yod/ de ni sdang po byed dgos/ nyes brdung gtong dgos zer ba min/ tshang mar bslab bya yag po rgyab/ bslab bya nyan gyi mi 'dug na phebs rogs gnang zhes bshad nayag gi red/ gang ltar sgrig khrims dam tsam byed dgos kyi 'dugadaper na/ bod nang la'ang phal cher yong gi yod sa red/ phran bu'i chos dad kyi go skabs yag tu phyin pa'i skabs la gra rgyun gsar zhugs mang po yod kyang /spus dag po med pa/ chos kyi shes yon dang / rgyud dul ba gang yang med pa'i gra pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam chags pa yin na bstan par mtshan shas yong rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam gling gi sa khul gang sar shes yon yar rgyas phyin yod pas sus kyang dad pa dag snang byed kyi ma red/ skyon dang 'thus sgo ma tshang ba yod pa de mthong / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi legs cha gting zab de ma mngon pa'i skabs la chos kyi che mthong brlag 'gro gi red/ nga tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan 'di dag phyin chad bod la slebs nas bod kyi nang la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 66

spel byed rgyu'i las 'gan 'khyer mkhan yin pa red/ nga tshos dka' ngal chen po'i 'og nas chos sgar khag btsugs/ dka' ngal chen po'i 'og nas 'tsho skyong byed dgos pa 'di dag gi nang la gra pa spus mi dag pa mang drags na dgos pa mi 'dug gang yod pa de dag spus dag po/ phyin chad bod nang so so'i sa khul gang 'dra zhig tu slebs pa yin na'ang mi gos chod mkhan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub mkhan de 'dra'i mi zhig bzo dgos kyi yod pa red/ dper na snga mo bod la 'bras spungs la cha bzhag na/ bdun stong bdun brgya zer gyi yod pa red/ deng sang nga tsho'i chos sgar 'dir gra pa chig stong lhag tsam/ nyis stong ma zin tsam las med kyang / yod pa 'di dag ma 'ongs pa'i dge rgan gyi dmigs sgo'i sbyong brdar sprad kyi yod bsam pa zhig byed dgos/ 'go 'khrid tsho dang / dge rgan khag slob gnyer byed mkhan tshang mas de 'dra'i bsam blo btang / ngos 'dzin de 'dra zhig byas te slob gnyer byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de ltar byas na phyin chad dus tshod shar ba'i skabs la mi re ngo res 'gan re re 'khyer nas rtsa ba dang yan lag nying lag byas te khyab spel thub pa yong gi red/ nga tsho'i chos sde khag da lta gzhi ma zhig tshugs nas yod pa 'di dag spus ka dag po bzo dgos/ shes yon slob sbyongs byed rgyur bsam blo gu yangs tsam btang nas 'dzam gling phyi nang gi gnas tshul gang yang rtogs thub rgyur do snang byed dgos/ sgrig lam kun spyod kyi thog la shugs gnon dang / bslab pa slob gnyer gyi thog la shugs gnon rgyag rgyu de dag gal chen po red/ slob gnyer byed mkhan phal mo che ni tsha ba dang / 'gal rkyen 67

sna tshogs la ma ltos par slob gnyer la 'bad brtson chen po byed kyi yod pa ha cang yag po red/ ngo mtshar chen po red/ yang de dang chabs cig rigs kha shas spyi g.yol bar gaskurdzol byas nas bsdad mkhan yang med dam bsam gyi 'du+og khyed rang tshos yin gcig min gcig slob gnyer la shugs gnon rgyag dgas/gra sa gra tshang gcig gi nang la las ka byed rgyu mang po zhig yong gi yod pa red/ byung na de tsho'i thog la dpe cha ma blta mkhan dang / dpe cha de tsam rang blta ma thub mkhan mos las ga'i 'gan rkang blangs/ dpe cha blta thub mkhan tshos dpe cha kho rang gi thog la shugs gtso bo rgyag gi yin na khyed rang tsho phan tshun tshang mar gcig phan gcig grogs yong gi red/ gang ltar gra pa byas pa'i mjug la slob gnyer byed dgos/ slob gnyer byed pa sems 'dul ba'i ched du yin pas sems dang spyod lam zhi zhing dul ba zhig yod dgos/ dge 'dun 7skyabs su brtsi gi yod pas/ don gyi cha nas blo gtad yid ches 'pher ba byed dgos/ nang nas ma dul na phyi nas ga tshad gcun pa yin na yang / mabe| bde dran 'phrul su yin na'ang byed shes kyi red/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches byas nas sgrig khrims nang nas bsrung na phyi nas btsir dgos don med/ spyi tshogs kyi nang la rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs 'dzin mkhan gyi mi zhig yin na de la blos bkal chog pa dang / des gnod pa bskyel dogs med mkhan/ des ham pa bshad kyi dogs med pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red/ de dag tshang mas mkhyen mkhyen pa red/ ma mkhyen pa zhig ngas gsar pa zhu rgyu mi 'dug ste gal 68

po che la nan tan byas te ngas zhus pa yin/de nas nga tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag skor bar skabs lo sum cu so gsum tsam phyin pa'i ring la 'gyur ba mang po phyin yod/ 'gyur ba 'ga' shas ni nga rangatsha'i blo yul las 'das pa'i 'gyur ba phyin pa red/ de dag nga rang tshos nus pa bton nas byung ba zhig ma red/ gtso bo las 'bras kyi 'phen shugs yin 'gro/ gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la btsan dbang zer ba de mi la rang bzhin gyi ran gyi med par brten/ gnas tshul de'i 'og nas gang ltar btsan dbang ring lugs de dag la 'gyur ba chen po phyin pa red/ rgya nag rang gi nang la cha bzhag na'ang / phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya brgyad cu gya dgu'i lo la gnam sde sgo mo che'i mdun la sdig pa mig btsums kyi drag gnon byas pa ltar/ gang ltar dmag dpung gcig pus zin bsdad yod pa ma gtogs/ kho rang tsho'i kha nas bshad pa bzhin mi mang gi mthun bsgril 'og nas 'tsho bsdad yod pa ma red/ lhag par du yang 'dzam gling phyi nang gi gnas tshul shes mkhan shes yon can gyi nang la gung khran ring lugs dmangs gtso gcig bsdus zer ba der zhe thag pa nas yid ches brlag zin pa gsal po red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gcig byas/ tshur phyogs 'dir bod pa'i ngos nas bshad pa yin na yang /dper na/ phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga grangs nang la dmangs gtso ༄ra ba dang / dmangs gatsho'i bsgyur bcos zer ba/ spyi tshogs ring lugs zer ba sogs skad cha snyan po bshad pa'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas bod mi 'ga' shas rgya mis bshad pa der dga' po byed mkhan dang / yid ches byed mkhan byung 69

yod na yang / da cha gung khran gyi byed stangs dang / lhag par du'ang rgya mi gung khran gyi lta ba'i thog la yid ches gting nas brlag ste yang snying bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang smos ci/ lhag par du rgya mi'i las byed bod mi'i nang nas brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu so so'i mi rigs kyi don dag bsam bsdad mkhan yin pa gsal po 'dug phyi la bcings dkrol dmag mi'i chas gos gyon pa dang / rgya mi'i tang yon yin pa/ las byed go ming gang la gang 'tshams yod pa zhig yin na yang / nang gi bsam khra'i nang bod pa yin bsam pa zhig spyir btang tshang mar rang bzhin gyis slebs bsdadayod pa red/ de 'dra'i phyogs mang wa'i gnas tshul 'di dag gi 'og nas lo kha shas kyi nang la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro rgyu'i re ba lta/da pa red/ tshang mas sems shugs ma chags par rig pa bsgrims nas nus pa bton rgyu gal chen po 'dug mang tshogs nas dus rgyun du bod kyi chab srid kyi gnas tshul thog la do snang byed dgos/ nga tsho mang gatsho'i sgang la 'gro gi yod pas/ mang gtso'i don dag gang 'dra yin pa/ mang gtso yag po zhig yong ba la don gyi bdag po mi mang rang gi ngos nas 'phral phyags rgyang gsum gyi gnas tshul la bsam blo gtong ba dang / 'dir do snang byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug chos byed dge 'dun tshor cha bzhag na'ang / nga tsho chos pa yin zhes bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur ma blangs pa min par/mdor na skya ser dbye ba med pa bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur che tsam dang / do snang che tsam byed dgos/ nga tshos rtsod gleng byed pa 'di bod mi rigs rang dbang gi don du red ma gtogs/70

tshogs pa 'dra mi 'dra'i srid don chagasayod pa ma red/ tshogs pa 'dra mi 'dra'i srid don nang la chos byed dge 'dun tsho zhugs dgos don med/ 'brel ba gang yang yod pa ma red/bod mi rigs kyi bden don rtsod len byed pa'iganas tshul 'di dang srid don tshogs pa'i gnas tshul tha dad yin pas de gnyis dbye 'byed gtong dgos/ bod spyi pa'i don dag rang dbang rtsod len byed stangs dang / ma 'ongs pa la bod lam lugs gang 'dra zhig gi sgang la 'gro rgyu yin pa de tsho'i skor la bar lam yig cha de 'dra bzosayod pa red/ de tsho'i gras la tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ do snang byed rgyu nyung ba'i skyon med dam bsam gyi 'dug lhag par bod la gnyen 'phrad du par 'gro mkhan tshos rgya gar nang gi gnas tshul bshad thub pa byed dgos/ dper na rig gnas gsar brje de tsho'i skabs la bod nang dngangs skrag chen po yod dus bod nang gi mi tshos rgya gar rang dbang lung pa'i nang nas gtam bzang 'dra 'khyer med dam bsam nas rlung sman 'dra mi 'dug gam/ a gar so lnga mi 'dug gam zhes dris kyi lho pa red/ khyed rang sto gnyen 'phrad la 'gro mkhan tshos nga mon rtso ṭar bsdad kyi yod/ tsha ba'i dkyil mgo 'joms nas bsdad yod/ gang yang shes kyi med ces lab na ngo tsha ba 'dug yorgyal ba rin po che 'go 'khrid pa'i btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'og la bsdad yod pas gang la gang 'tshams shig bshad rgyu med na zhabs 'dren red/ rgya gar nang la mi mang gi spyi 'thus kyi sgrig 'dzugs gang 'dra zhig yod pa dang / bka' shag gi sgrig 'dzugs gang 'dra zhig yod pa/ sa khungs gang 'dra yod pa rnams dris dus/ 'di yang shes 71

kyi med/ 'di yang shes kyi med byas na ngo tsha po red/ nam rgyun nas bod spyi don la do snang byas nas shes pa byed dgos/ so sos shes kyi yod na phar gnyen 'phrad la phar phyin pa yin na'ang red/ bod nas tshur yong mkhan zhig yin na'ang red bshad thub kyi red/ rgya gar nang 7rgyal ba rin po ches 'go 'khrid pa'i btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs gang 'dra yod pa dang / nga tshos las ka gang byas pa de dag spobs pa'i thog nas bshad rgyu yod pa red/ de tsho bshad na pha rol po'i sems la phan gyi red/ sems skyo bsdad pa la dngos gnas rlung sman byung ba red/ yag po bshad pa yin na nga'i spun de rgya gar la thar ba thar go chod 'dug kho mgo 'tshos po 'dug kho la spyi sems 'dug bsam nas dga' po yong gi red/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu mang po sprod rgyu ma byung kyang / par phyogs kyi sems nang la shes 'dod yod pa dang / don du gnyer ba'i don dag rnams yag po zhig ngo sprod thub na phar phyogs yid tshims kyi red/ des na tshang mas dus rgyun ldan nas spyi don la do snang byas nas shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug lhod yangs byas na mi 'grigs/ gzhan dag dmigs bsal bshad rgyu mi 'dugabakra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che zhes bka' stsal// / / 72

༄༅// phyi lo 1993 zla 4 tshes 10 nyin/ rdor gling rang 'tsho bzo grwar bde don gyi las sdom 7snyan zhu gsan rjes bka' slob stsal ba/de ring 'dir rdor gling khul la yod pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba sto dang /de bzhin bod mi dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi gang 'tshams kyi thog bod nas gsar 'byor bayang kha shas yod 'dug pa nga tsho 'dir 'dzoms nas thug 'phrad go skabs byung bar shin tu dga' po byung / tshang mar 'tshams 'dri yod/ de bzhin sngon ma nas ngo shes pa'i bod pa dang / lda je gling khul gyi yul mi grogs spi rnying pa tsho yang thug rgyu'i go skabs byung bar dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas nga snung bod pa btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so bzhi lhag tsam 'gro gi yod/ 'di ni mi rigs shig gi lo rgyus ngos nas bshad na dus tshod thung thung yin rung / mi sger gyi ngos nas bshad na dus tshod ring po yin/ nga sto rgya gar nang btsan byol du 'byor rjes skyes pa'i phru gu cho'i dong sang phru gu'i pha ma chags pa dang / de skabs kyi rgan pa mang spi zhig med par gyur nas mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod/ de'i ring nga tshor dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad yod kyang / rdo don lo sum cu so bzhi song ba'i rjes la ngag thog nas 'grel bshad byed ma dgos par mig mthong lag zin gyi thog nas nga tsho'i gnas stangs ni/ 'dzam gling nang bod pa zhes brjod dus chos dang rig gzhung dmigs bsal gting zab yod pa zhig dang / btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i gong bu'i rnam pa gsal po yod pa/ tshang mas cha 'jog yod pa/ rgya gar gyi sa khul 'dra min nang yod pa'i bod mi tshor yul 73

pa tshos dga' po byed pa dang / sa gnas so lo'i rgya gar gyi las byed tshos yul mi tshor skul lcag gtong skabs bod pa mig dpe blta sa zhig la brtsi ba bcas kyi gnas stangs shig chags sku(da/gtso che ba bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang thog rgya mis 'jam rtsub gnon shugs kyi thabs shes rim pa sprad pa rnams pham nyes phyin nas da cha dngos gnas bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang smos ci/ mdor na rgya mi'i las khungs nang yod pa'i las byed pa bcas brgya cha go dgu brgal bas rgya mir rtsa ba nas blo mi blta ba/ so so ༄1da pa'i la rgya dang / bden don gyi thog sems shugs bsgril nas bsdad yod pa red/ rgya mi dmar pos bod la btsan 'dzul byas nas lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam dang / lnga bcu nga dgu lo bod gzhung med pa bzos nas rgya mi tshor 'dod pa gang yod byed rgyu'i dus tshod byung nas da bar lo sum cu lhag tsam 'gro gi yod/ de'i ring bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di sbug bsub btang ste 'ja' yal ba bzhin med pa 'gro rgyu'i tshab la deng sang rgya mi'i phyi 'brel las don thog bod don 'dis khong tsho ngo tsha kha skyengs ngang sdod dgos pa zhig chags yod pa dang / bod kyi gnad don thog rgya nag gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs kyi las byed pa dang / phyi rgyal khag nang gzhung tshab tu sdod mkhan mang po zhig gi bsam khro'i nang dka' ngal 'phrad de gnas yod pa red/ bod kyi gnad don 'di lo re bzhin shugs che ru phyin pa dang chabs cig 'dzam gling thog nas do snang byed mkhan yang lo re bzhin shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/ lhag par phyi lo 1987 lo nas bzung lha sa gtso bor gyur pa'i bod sa khul yas mas nas rgya 74

mir mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur shugs che zhig bstan nas gnas tshul gsal po chagasapar brten bod pa'i thog do snang byed mkhan yang shugs che ru phyin te 'das pa'i lo kha shas nang 'dzam gling thog bod don la bden rgyab byed mkhan de bas shugs che ru phyin pa bcas da lta nga tsho'i gnas stangs ni re ba chen po zhig gi thog slebs sku(da/gnyis nas nga tsho bod pas nus pa bton nas phan nus thon mi thub pa'i 'dzam gling khyon yongs kyi gnas stangs 'gyur ba ha cang chen po phyin yod/'das pa'i lo gnyis gsum nang de snga nga sto rgya nag tu 'gro dus rgya mi gung khran gyi kha'i rtse mor 'khyer nas ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling la dbang sgyur byed kyi red mdog mdog rtsa cher brtsi ba'i gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyal khab chen po su'u lan zer ba de da cha phyogs gcig nas dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal shin tu chen po zhig nang tshud yod pa dang / phyogs gnyis nas mang gtso rang dbang can gyi lung par gyur yod pa red/ de 'brel 'dzam gling thog shar yo rob dang /apha ri ka khul sogs la yod pa'i gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyal khab de tsho tshang ma mjug bsgril tshar ba red/ de ni nga tsho bod pas nus pa bton te 'gyur ba 'gro thub pa zhig min rung / nga tsho'i bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'gyur ba zhig phyin yod/ gzhan yang cadags mang po zhig la nga tshos nus pa thon sa zhig yin phyin nus pa bton yod/ nga tsho bod pa'i nus pa dang re ba'i tshad las brgal ba'i mthun phyogs kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig shugs je cher 'gro ba dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams nyam nyes 'gro ba'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas da cha 75

nga rang tsho re ba chen po yod pa'i dus tshod cig la slebs yod/nga rang tsho'i phyogs la re ba ji tsam chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul de tsam gyis rgya mi'i 'go khrid tsho'i bsam blo'i nang dngangs skrag slebs rgyu ni chos nyid yin/ bod de shor rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug bsam pa'i dngangs skrag slebs par brten rgya mis tshudags gcig nas bod nang rgya mi phon che gtong ba dang / bar lam rdzong rim pa dang / spyi khyab sa khul/ grong khyer/ rang skyong ljongs bcas kyi las khungs rim pa'i 'go khrid nang las 'gan bod mis 'khyer gyi yod pa'i rnam pa ston ched bod rigs gang 'tshams shig bzhag yod pa de dag la dbang cha gang yang med kyang / na ning nas bzung de yang 'gyur ba gtong gi 'dug gang ltar bod par zhen khog dang / sha tsha sku(da mkhan gyi mi de dag rim pas mtha' la phud de dbang cha gang yang med pa'i go gnas shig sprad nas rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa khul tshang ma'i 'go khrid rgya mi rang 'dzugs rgyu'i 'gyur ba phyin 'dug de ring kha sa bod pa las byed pa'i nang do dam du gtong gi yod pa red/de bzhin rgya gar dang / rgya nag gi 'brel ba'i don dam gnas tshul gang yin mi shes kyang / spyir btang gnas tshul bzang du 'gro gi yod pa red/gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og drin tu dmag khul khang gi las khungs dum bu gcig lha sar sgo rgyu gtan 'bebs byas 'dug de ltar bod kyi sa khul khag nang rgya mi'i dmag shugs che ru gtong rgyu dang / dmag gi rten gzhi khag brtan du gtong ba'i las ka mu mthud shugs bskyed byed kyi 'dug rgya dkar nag gnyis dbar gnas tshul zhi 'jam du song nas dmag mi dgos mkho chung du 'gro gi yod pa'i 76

gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og bod nang rgya dmag sgrig 'dzugs kyi gra sgrig shugs che ru gtong gi yod pa 'di ni bod pa tsho'i thog ched du dmigs pa zhig yin pa sus bltas kyang shes kyi red/ gang ltar bod kyi gnas tshul thog rgya mi tsho dngangs skrag skyes kyi yod par brten bod nang dza drag tu gtong gi 'dugad bar nga chos lo bco lngar nye ba'i ring rgya mir mes 'tshig mer gtugs kyi thabs shes byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni bod nang dza drag gi gnas tshul yod pa de dag da lta tshudags gang sa nas thabs shes byas te bskyabs thub pa zhig ma byung na bden mtha' rim pas gsal rgyu yin yang / bden mtha' ma gsal gong la bod yul yongs rdzogs rgya yul la bsgyur rgyu'i nyen kha nyin re bzhin che ru 'gro ba mthong gsal yin/ der brten da lta dza drag gi gnas tshul las skyob thabs shig byed dgos/ phyogs gcig nas 'dzam gling thog nga tshos 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang gi mtshon pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig 'bod skul dang skad brgyab nas thabs shes byas par brten 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag gi srid gzhung de 'dra nas bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gtso bor gyur pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la sems khur yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po shod mkhan byung yod/de dang chabs cig nga tshos rgya mi rang la gtugs te skad cha shod rgyu'i thabs shes kyis bod dza drag gi gnas las skyodab thabs ma byas na de'i 'gan ljid po nga tshor yod par brten thabs shes byas pa red/ da lta bka' blon bkra shis dbang 'dus nas 'grel bshad brgyab pa bzhin/ rgya mi tsho spyang thag chod nas phyi tshul la tu la'i bla ma dang gros mol byed kyi yin zhes yang yang bshad kyang /77

lag len ngo ma'i thog don dag rdog rdog gi lan zhig lo bco lnga'i ring nga tshor sprad med/ yin na'ang da dung ma lan ma 'gyod pa byed rgyu las/ rgya mi dang 'brel ba mtshams 'jog byed rgyu'i dgos pa mthong gi mi 'dug nga tsho'i ngos nas sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gang yang med par ga dus yin yang skad cha shod rgyu'i 'char gzhi dang 'dun pa 'di rang thog gnas yod/ tshod dpag byas na rgya mi'i ngos nas da mus bzhin phyi la 'dra chags po byas te nang don brtsis med rdog rol gtong rkyang byas na 'grigs kyi red bsam pa'i re ba rgyag gi yod kyang /de dag lam la 'gro gi ma red bsam gyi 'dug la/ lam la mi 'gro ba zhig gzhis byes 11da mi tshang mas sems khur blangs nas rig pa bsgrim dgos pa zhig chags yod/ da lta'i bar gyi byed phyogs de 'dra zhig red/de nas the bon dang 'brel ba'i skor/ de snga lnga bcu nga dgu lor nga tsho rgya gar la slebs ma thag the bon la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i skor go bsdur mang po byas yod/ de nas da lta bar 'brel ba yag po zhig dang / bsam pa rnam dag gi 'brel ba zhig byung med/ de'i thog the wan gyi ngos nas bod rgya mi'i khongs gtogs yin zer ba'i lta tshul rgya mi gung khran dang gcig gyur 'dzin te kho rang tshos kyang bod pa bdag gir bzung 'dod byas par brten bod pa dang khrims mthun nam/ mtshan nyid tshang ba'i 'brel ba zhig bzo ma thub pa'i skabs la/bod pa'i nang gi mi 'dra min dngul dang dngos pos bslus nas mtha' ma nga tsho bod pa nang khul la dam sel mang po bzos nas dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i gnas tshul yong gi yod pa red/ de dag che sa nas bsam blo btang ste 'brel ba byas 78

nas sel thabs byas na ma gtogs rgyab bshad brgyab te bsdad na cho gang yang med/ ma gzhi de snga phan chad kyang bsam blo btang ste the wan gzhung la thad kur 'brel ba bya rgyu'i thabs shes byas kyang lam la phyin med/ da cha the bon nang meng gtso'i 'gyur ba zhig 'gro gi yod pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgya nag gcig dang / the bon gcig yang na rgya nag gnyis zhes pa'i sko ra deng sang skad cha mang po zhig yong bzhin pa ma zad/ rim pas the wan la rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang dgos pa'i skad cha yong gi yod pa bcas sngon ma'i lo bcu grangs gong gi gnas tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ba mang po zhig 'gro gi yod par brten/ nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang 'gyur ba gsar pa gzhir bzung thabs lam gsar pa zhig rnyed thabs kyi 'bad brtson byed dgos/ da lta bka' blon na sa 'grel bshad brgyab pa bzhin ma11gas myur sku tshab cesags pa zhig 'gro rgyu yin pa 'di'i thog gnas tshul lhug po kha gsal gting gsal yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ de nas mu mthud the wan gzhung dang 'brel ba yag tu 'gro rgyu'i re ba yod/ de ni bka' blon nas brjod pa bzhin nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i srid byus 'gyur ba phyin pa'i gnas tshul zhig ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i bden don gyi rang lugs bzung ba 'di la 'gyur ba rtsa ba nas phyin med/ 'on kyang byed thabs mi 'dra ba bzung ba'i dus la slebs yong gi yod/ da phan rgya gar nang yod pa'i bod mi yin na'ang 'dra/ bal yul nang yod pa'i bod mi yin na'ang 'dra/ de bzhi na sa khu la gang dang gang du yod pa'i bod mi tsho'i nang rgya dmar nag gnyis zhes so so'i rang lugs bzung nas rig pa bsgrims nas sdod mkhan mang po 79

du phyogs pa'i dus tshod 'di'i skabs la yin na yang rig gzhung 'di dag dgos mkho yod pa zhig yin pas/ rig gzhung 'di dag nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyi rgyun 'dzin thub pa zhig byung ba yin na phan thogs yod pa zhig tan tan red/ 'di lta bu'i phan jogs yod pa'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed 'os pa dang / byed pa de rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin dus 'di'i thog la tshang mas do snang dang thugs khur bskyed kyi yod pa ltar/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas do snang gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/gtso che shos mi mang mi re ngo re'i ngos nas so so'i rig gzhung de gang 'dra yin pa de ngos 'dzin thub pa zhig dang / 'di so so'i pha mes kyi rig gzhung yin bsam pa'i bdag gces byed dgos/ bdag gces byed rgyu'i sems khur bskyed dgos/ de yang mi mang tsho'i ngos nas byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de 'dra'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel lag len rim pa ji ltar bya rgyu'i skor la/ da ring 'dir khyed rang tsho mkhas dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i 'brel yod mi sna mang po zhig phebs yod pa red/ khyed rang tshos zhib cha'i go bsdur gnang dgos/ da lta phan chad la yang tshogs 'du snga rjes 'tshogs yod/ da dung yin na yang sa gnas 'di ga'i jog la skabs su babs pa'i byed sgo gang dang gang yod pa rnams khyed tshos go bsdur bgro gleng gi thog nas gsal po chags kyi red/ nga la dmigs bsal zhu rgyu mi 'dug da ring khyed rang tsho'i tshogs 'du 'dir don snying grub 'bras thon pa yong rgyur ngas re 80

mtshan nyid ldan pa'i 'brel ba yag po zhig baXge thub na the bon la'ang phan thogs yod pa'i 'brel ba zhig yong rgyu dang / nga tshor yang phan thogs yod pa'i 'brel ba zhig 'byung thub/ de ltar byung na go skabs btsal te phar phyogs der skad cha zhig bshad/ tshur phyogs 'dir skad cha zhig bshad nas khrog rkyen slong ba de tsho'i gras 'gro khungs med pa chags kyi red/ da lta gnas stangs gsar pa 'di 'dra zhig gi thog gnas yod/ rim pas the wan la 'brel ba bya rgyu'i gnas tshul phal cher tshod thig pa 'dra po dang / rang dbang che ru 'gro gi yod dus rang dbang yod na nga tsho bod par yang rgyu mtshan mtha' ma 'gag pa zhig bshad rgyu yod/ nga tshos rgya mi rigs la thod rgol byed kyi med/ nga tsho rgya mir dga' po yod/ rgya mi'i rig gzhung la dga' po yod/ bde skyid rgya mir dgo sa la/bod par yang bde skyid dgos/ nga cho bod pa dang rgya mi gnyis ka lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs gnyis yin pas gcig dbang che ba dang / gcig dbang chung ba byas te sdod dgos pa 'di 'grigs kyi mi 'dug nga rang tsho grogs po grogs mched byas te gcig gis gcig la mthun lam dang / gcig gis gcig la sha tsha byas bsdad pa yin na nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas kyang rgya mir sems gnag byed dgos don med/ nga tshos bsam pa rnam dag byas te rgya mis ngo bstan yang skad cha bshad rgyu gcig dang / rgyab bstan yang skad cha bshad rgyu gcig yin/gtam brjod rang dbang dang / mang gtso shugs che ru 'gro dus tan tan bod pa'i dngos yod kyi bden pa'i gnas tshul rnams rgya mi mang po zhig gi rna bar blug thub kyi red bsam pa 'di gnas tshul gcig yin/81

de nas bka' blon gyis las sdom gsung bshad nang spyi 'thus la bka' shag nas 7snyan seng zhus pa yin/ spyi 'thus nas bka' shag la dogs 'dri 'di 'dra gnang gi 'dug ces 'grel bshad mang po zhig brgyab song / de ni gnad 'gag ha cang chen po zhig chags yod/ nga tshos phyi lo 1959 lo dang 60 lo'i nang nga tsho mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro rgyu'i 'char gzhi bting nas thag bcad de las ma'i go rim rnams bsgrigs yod/ mdor na 1963lor ma 'ongs par bod mang gatsho'i ngo bor bsgyur rgyu'i rtsa khrims zin bris snying bsdus shig gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ de'i nang la dgag bya dgos pa'i dbang gis 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dbang bzhag dgos byung na sde srid lhan tshogs bsko rgyu dang / tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi sum gnyis mang mos kyi thog nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dbang bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu yod pa zhig bkod yod/ de ni mang gatsho'i ngo bo'i snying don yin/ de nas rim pas gzhung dang / gzhis chags khag bcas pa'i sa khul khag la mang gathe'i) lam srol lag len 'khel nges rnams lag len bstar yod/ bod mi tsho'i kha rgyun la'ang mang gtso 7rgyal ba rin po ches gsol ras gnang byung zhes rgyun du shod bzhin pa las/ bar lam lo shas nang 'dzam gling thog mang gtso dang rang dbang gi las 'gul shugs che ru phyin pa'i dbang gis nga tshos a sar byas te mang gtso zhes bshad pa min /mang gtso lag len bstar rgyu ni phyogs gcig nas spyi tshogs kyi mi mang che bas khur mnyam len byas nas nus pa thon pa bya rgyur mang gtso ni thabs shes yag shos chags yod/ 'dis 'go khrid byed mkhan mi re zung gis rang snang gang 82

dran kha kyog sna kyog la mi 'gro bar phan gyi yod/ de ni 'dzam gling phyi'i gnas tshul brjod ma dgos par nga rang chorwa kud pa'i lo rgyus la bsam blo btang ba yin na'ang rgyal thog re gnyis dang / sku drag dbang shugs che ba re zung gi lag par dbang cha yod dus skabs re las sla por kha kyog sna kyog 'gro gi yod pa red/ tshogs 'du'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gro stangs khrims kyi yig cha dang 'brel ba'i dam pos dam bcings kyi sgrig 'dzugs yag po zhig chags pa yin na mi re zung gis ral gri gnam g.yugs kyi dbang cha bed spyod bya rgyu 'gog thub pa yong gi red/ der brten nga tsho mang gtso'i thog 'gro rgyu gal chen po yin/gnyis nas rgya mis nga tshor bden pa bden thub kyi lan rgyag rgyu med dus bsnyon btsugs te lag pa phyis sa lta bur nga tshos rang dbang lung pa'i nang bod rang dbang gi don du 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di spyi tshogs rnying pa zhing bran lam lugs bskyar gso bya rgyu'i dmigs yul red ces tam pa shod kyi 'dug bden pas phongs te tshur tam pa bsnyon 'dzugs byed pa 'di la nga tshos tshig gis lan rgyag mi dgos par lag len ngo ma'i thog nas kha zhe gnyis med kyi mang gtso'i lag len da lta nas bstar ba tsam du ma zad/ ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang byung mtshams su 7rgyal ba rin po che nas srid gzhung nang dbang cha 'dzin gyi min zhes tshig thag bcad de brjod dus bod pa'i kha dpe ltar rgya mi sto kha la mdzub mo bcug ste sdod rgyu las bya thabs gzhan med/ rgya mis bshad pa de bden pa yin min nga tsho bod pa'i lag len gyi thog nas rang bzhin lan thebs kyi yod/ de ltar nga tsho mang gtso'i thog 'gro rgyu 'di rgyu mtshan mang po'i thog 83

nas gal chen po chags kyi yod/ ma 'ongs par yang mtha' gcig tu mang gtso'i lam la 'gro rgyu ma gtogs de las gzhan pa'i lam zhig med/ der brten nga tshos bar lam spyi 'bus kyi sgrig 'dzugs la bsgyur bcos btang yod/ de snga phan chad ma 'ongs pa'i rtsa khrims kyi zin bris sheg yod pa 'di gzhi bzung nas lag len bstar thub pa rnams lag len bstar yod kyang / da dung lag len bstar thub dang mi thub sna tshogs shig yong gi yod par brten da nas btsan byol la sdod ring mang gtso'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsa 'dzin yig cha gsal po yong ba'i ched du mang gtso'i bca' khrims shig bzo rgyur dgos pa mthong ste btsan byol la sdod ring gi sgrig 'dzugs 'gro stangs rnams mang gatsho'i rang bzhin sra brtan zhig skudang ba'i don la bca' khrims shig bzos pa yin/ mang gtso'i bca' khrims gzhir bzung lag len bstar dus/ dper na/ gzhan dag lta ci/ nga'i ngos nas kyang thad shar gang byung bka' gtong sa med/ mang gce'i bca' khrims bzos nas nga rang la bar lam nyams myong gsar pa gang byung zer na/ de snga yin na nga rang la bsam 'char gsar pa zhig byung na/ de 'phral bka' blon tsho dang / skabs re spyi 'thus tshogs gtso gnyis bcas bos te bsam 'char go bsdur byas te thag gcod thub kyi yod/ da cha thog mar bca' khrims dang mthun min bsam blo gtong dgos pa 'di yag po 'dug mi sgor re gnyis kyis dbang cha bzung ba zhig min par yig gzhi'i sgrig srol gyi thog nas khrims lugs kyis dbang cha 'dzin pa 'dir gnad 'gag chen po yod/bar lam nas nga tsho'i las ka mang po zhig spyi 'thus tshos go bsdur byas 84

nas thag gcod byed kyi yod cing / skabs re spyi 'thus kyis thag gcod byasaX pa de tan tan ma byung dogs kyi sems 'phral dang / yang nga chos bsam blo 'di 'dra zhig gtong gi yod kyang spyi 'thus tshos thag gcod gang 'dra byas yong bsam nas sems 'phral byed dgos pa yang yong gi 'dug rmang gzhi ni spas dag po dang / brtan po'i thog 'gro gi yod pa red/ dngos gnas nyams chang bsags te mi dul ma lta bu zhig chags yong gi yod/ der brten da lta bka' blon gyi skad cha'i zhor 'phros la spyi 'thus kyi stor yang yang thon pa de lag pa 'phyis pa ma yin par dngos yod gnas tshul chags kyi yod pa red/dper na/ 7rgyal ba sngon po ches kyang thad kur lam seng bka' ral gri gnam g.yug byed sa med pa zhig chags yod/ ma gzhi da lta'i spyi 'thus tshos dmigs bsal btang ste 7rgyal ba rin po ches bka' gang zhig gnang yang de'i thog 'gro gi yin zhes bshad yod kyang / nga'i ngos nas de dag rdog rol gtong shes kyi ma red/ 'di ni spyi'i skad cha dang / mkhas snyan gyi skad cha red/ma gzhi da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul la mi tshang mas nga la yid ches byed kyi yod kyang mkhas snyan lta bu chags na cho mi 'dug nga tsho'i 'gro stangs ni 'di 'dra zhig chags yod/ gzhi rkang nga tsho btsan byol ba'i gnas stangs dang / sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas stangs/ chos lugs phan tshun mthun sgril gyi gnas stangs/chol kha phan tshun gyi mthun sgril gyi gnas stangs sogs spyi yongs kyi cha nas yag thag chod yod/ bod mi btsan byol ba chig 'bum nyis khri nas gsum khri bar yod/ spyi yongs kyi gnas stangs lo sum cu so bzhi'i gong gi nga tsho'i bsam 85

blo'i tshod dpag las yongs su brgal ba'i ha cang yag po chags yod/ de ltar yong ba ni bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan tshang mas rang nyid bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam blo snying la bcangs nas lhag bsam rnam dag dang hur thag byas pa'i grub 'bras yin pas tshang mar thug sa rje che brjod rgyu yin /rdo rje gling khul du yod pa'i mi mang tsho gams tshul go rtogs che ba yod pa'i bzo 'dug gzhis chags khag nang sdod mkhan tsho dang / rdo rje gling lta bu'i grong khyer khag nang sdod mkhan tsho'i dbar mthong rgya'i thad khyad par yod/ji tsam mthong rgya thos rgya che ba yod pa de tsam gyis gnas lugs gting zab rtogs thub pa zhig dang / de dang bstun pa'i thabs shes kyi las 'gul kyang rnam grangs mang zhing gzab pa zhig byed thub pa yong gi red/ da phan rdor gling khul du gnyug mar gnas pa'i ྅(da mi lhungan ma nas skustod bzhin pa tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ de bzhin rgya gar khams pa yin na'ang 'dra/ btsan byol ba gsar pa yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang mas bod spyi pa'i la rgya bzung nas da bar grub 'bras nges can zhig thob mordzod pas tshang mar thugs rje che brjod rgyu yin /deng sang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs nasabod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung la do snang gsar pa byed kyi yod pa dang / de la brten nas nga tsho bod pa'i thog las 'gan gsar pa zhig slebs yod/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi rig gzhung zhes brjod kyang nga tsho bod pa'i rig gzhung 'di yin/ de snga yin na hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul nas chos dang rig gzhung slob sbyong byed par bod nang 'gro gi yod pa dang / deng sang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul nas la dwags pa dang /86

khu nu ba/ mon pa sogs mang po zhig gdan sa gsum dang / rgyud grwa smad stod/ sa skya'i chos sgar khag rnying ma'i chos sgar khag bka' brgyud kyi chos sgar khag mdor na bon dang bcas pa'i ris med chos sgar khag nang slob gnyer byed kyi yod/ khong tsho'i khyimatshang yang rang shugs kyis nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhungadang 'brel ba chags pa dang / de bzhin bod nas phebs pa'i ris med kyi bla ma dge bshes 'ga' zhig sa khul de tsho'i nang gdan 'dren zhus nas chos kyi gnas lugs rtogs rgyu bzang du phyin pa bcas kyis hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byed pa'i dus tshod gsar pa zhig shar yod/ de ni nga tsho'i stobs shugs yin/ gong du bka' blon nas brjod pa bzhin khul 'di'i yul mi spyi yongs dang / de'i nang tshan nas blo kri ya dang / rta mang sogs nang pa'i chos gcig gyur yin pa de tshor rang re phan tshun rogs ram gang zhig bya dgos pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' 455// // 87

ko༅༅// phyi lo 1993 zla 12 tshes 22 nyin don zur rab rgyas gling gzhis chags mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring nga tsho gzhis chags la tshogs 'du byed rgyu 'di gar gtan 'jags yod mkhan gzhis mi tshos shes gsal red/ 'dir tshar mang po slebs yod pa dang / skad cha mang po byung yod/ nga rang tsho so so'i lung pa nas kha bral te rgya gar rdzo phyogs khul gzhis chags pa dang / ched mngags bod mi stong phrag kha shas mnyam sdod gzhis chags byed dgos pa'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan tshang mas shes gsal red/ nga rang tsho bod mi btsan byol ba 'dus sdod kyi gzhis chags byas par brten nas rang bzhin gyis bod mi btsan byol ba'i rnam 'gyur thon pa dang / sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa la brten nas phan tshun gcig gis gcig la lta rtogs byed rgyu sogs la phan thogs byung yod pa red/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas gzhis chags khag nang da lta bar du nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel dang / mdor na/ nga tsho'i bu brgyud tshun chad bod rigs gtsang ma zhigayong thub par phan thogs byung yod/nga tshos thog mar 'char gzhi bting / de nas bar du sa gnas sa thog gi gnam gshis tsha ba'i dka' ngal dang / mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i gnas tshul de sto khyad du bsad de 'bad brtson byas pa'i grub 'bras thon yod/ grub 'bras yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo khyed rang tsho 'di ga sa gnas sa thog la dka' las rgyago mkhan tsho yin pas/ de ring yang bskyar khyed rang tsho la thugs rje che zer 'dad byung /88

da ring 'dir phyogs mtha'anas mi gang la gang mtshams slebs pa dang /lhag par du bod nas gnyen 'phrad la yong ba khyed rang tsho gang tsam 'dug dper na grwa sa khag la slob gnyer ched yong pa ha lam stong phrag sgor slebs yod pa 'dra/ khyed rang tshos gnas tshul snga phyi cha tshang shes kyi med par brten/ ngas gsal bshad phran bu byas3 bsam pa byung / da lta bka' blon nas gnas tshul dka' ngal yod sa de dag rdog sgrug rgyab te bshad pa ltar/ de tsho sba ge sbug gedang / spam po byas pas ladag gi ma red/ spyirkangs kyi cha nas las bsdoms nang la yod pa bzhin yar rgyas kyi grub 'bras thon yod/ phyags rgyang ring po'i cha nas sa rgya che ru gtong thub thabs med pa dang / mi grangs 'phel yong gi lho pas da lta'i gnas stangs 'di'i thog la chog shes byasanas 'thus shor med tsam byung na 'grigs kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po byas na rtsa ba nas 'grigs thabs med pa red/ nga tshos thabs lam gsar pa gang 'tshol dgos kyi 'dug gam/ga3 rwa1 'di ga saganas sa thog gi dngosalodeganas tshul nyams myongatsede mkhan dang / cha rgyus yod mkhan tshos bsam blo gtong dgos/ mthun rkyen sbyor rgyu de 'dra'i thog la nang srid las khungs dang / phan tshun thabs shes byed phyogs/mu mthud de 'bad brtson byed rgyu 'di dza drag chen po chags yod/ 'phrod bsten gyi sgor dong / slob sbyong gi sgor da lta bka' blon nas snying bsdus byas te lab pa rnamasayag po byung song /nga rang cho rwa1da pa'i gnas tshul da phan lo 34 lhag tsam phyin pa de'i ring la nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas bsdad mkhan tshos kyang dka' las mang 89

po zhig rgyab yod/ lhag par du bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi sems kyi gting la dngangs skrag dang / dus rtag tu chu tshod nyi shu mabazhi'i ring la bag zon kho na byas nas sdodadagos pas ma tshad/ rgya mis ched mngags sdug sbyong mnar gcod btang nas 'das grongs phyin pa dang / dngos su dmar bsad btang ba/ mu ges shi ba sogs ha cang mang po zhig byung yod pa dang /rgya che'i mi mang spyi byings smos ci/ mdor na rgya mi'i las khungs nang yod pa'i las ka byed mkhan phyi tshul la rgya mi'i phogs za mkhan/ tha na go ming gang tsam yod pa yin na yang tshang ma'i sems kyi gting la blo g.yeng chen po'i ngang sdod dgos kyi yod pa red/ da phan bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag dka' ngal dpag tu med pa myangs nas bsdad yod par brten/ ji srid bod nang gi sdug bsngal rnams sel thub pa dang / 'gyur ba kha yod lag yod cig bod rgya che'i mi mang don dam gyi 'dod pa tshims pa zhig ma byung bar du bod don yal rgyu dang / brlag thabs med pas nga tshos mu mthud nas 'thab rtsod byed dgos/nga tsho btsan byol ba tshos bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig 'khyer gyi yod dam zhe na/bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams dngos gnas don gyi bdag po yin par brten/ khong tsho'i bsam tshul dang re 'dun gang yod pa de nga tshos sgrub dgos kyi yod/ da lta phan chad gzhis byes mi mang yongs rdzogs sems shugs ma nyams pa dang / lhag bsam g.yo ba med pa/ snying stobs 'gyur ba med pa bcas kyi thog nas mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod kyang / so so'i mi rigs rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod byed stangs 'di sngar las shugs je cher phyinayod/ de 90

'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang nas bod pa'i gnas tshul la do snang byed mkhan mang du 'gro gi yod/ rgya nag gzhung gi thog nas kyang bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di snang med du 'jog thabs med pa zhig chags yong gi yod/ de ltar phyi nang gi rkyen mang po zhig tshogs pa'i 'og la/ bar lam lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam ring rgya nag dang nga tsho'i bar 'brel ba byung ba red/ bod yul rgya yul la 'gyur ba'i dza drag gi gnas tshul 'di las srung skyob byed rgyu'i thabs lam de rgya mi rang la 'brel ba byed rgyu ma gtogs med stabs/ nga tsho'i ngos nas gu bshangs kyi bsam blo gtong rgyusku1da tshad btang nas thabs shes gang yong byas kyang / rgya mi'i ngos nas der bsam blo btang te lhug po'i go bsdur byed rgyu'i go skabs da lta bar du ma byung ba red/ rgya nag gzhung gi da dung sngar bzhin gu yangs kyi bsam blo ma btang ba yin na/ da bar ngas thabs shes byas pa ha lam mtha' la slebs pa red/ gnas tshul de la gzhigs pa'i bsam blo gtong rgyu gang 'dug gam/ ngas snga phyi bar gsum du mtha' ma'i thag gcod bod mi mang gis byed dgos pa ma zad/ bod mi mang gis re 'dun gzhi bzhag bya dgos zhes bshad kyi yod/ yang nga rang tsho mang mos kyi bsam 'char bsdu len byed rgyu de 'dra yang chags ma srid pa ma red/ da lta bar du rgya nag zhung la 'brel ba byed stangs de 'dra zhig yin/de nas the bon la 'brel ba byed pa'i stor la/ bar lam the bon nas gnad yod kyi mi sna de 'dra tshur yong nas nga tshor 'brel ba byung / nga tshos kyang gzhung 'brelaspenangs grags kyi thog nas sku tshab tshogs pa gcig the bon la phyin 91

nas srid 'dzin dang / srid blon de tsho thug 'phrad byas nas skad cha 'go tshugs pa 'di gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'gyur ba phyin pa'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig chags pa red/ de rjes srid 'dzin gyis yongs grags thog gsar 'god par gsung stangs de tsho yag thag chod 'dug the bon dang nga tsho'i 'brel ba 'di lugs mthun nam/ gtsang ma zhig 'byung thub na/ the wan la yang phan thogs yong gi red/ nga tshor yang phan thogs yong gi red/ gtso bo bod kyi dngos yod kyi gnas tshul 'di rgya mis shes pa byed rgyu ha cang gi gal chen po red/ rgya mi gung khran gyis skad cha tshang ma 'khyog bshad kho na byed kyi yod/ the wan gyi nang la deng sang gtam brjod rang dbang yar rgyas gang la gang mtshams phyin yod pas/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas nga tsho bod pa'i bden don 'di rgya mi mang po zhig gi rna bar thos thub pa dang / bod pa'i bden don 'di gsal po rtogs pa bzo thub pa'i go skabs yod pa red/ go skabs 'di 'dra'i thog nas gcig la gnyis brgyud kyis bod pa'i bden don 'di rgya nag skam sa chen po'i nang la yang rim pas shes thub pa'i phan thogs yong gi red/ yin na yang 'gyur ba ji tsam 'gro min dang / kha zhe gnyis med kyi 'brel ba bzang po zhig yong thub min/ dusasbun ji tsam 'gor min da lta lam sang tshod dpag gsal po thub kyi mi 'dug 'on kyang mu mthud nas 'brel ba byed rgyu'i bsam tshul yod/ da cha bod gzhung gis the wan la 'brel ba byasapar brten/ de snga phan chad the wan la lkog tu dngul dngos kyi 'brel ba yod mkhan rigs shig gis nga tshos 'brel ba byas pa 'di yang dag pa yin zhes ngan byas ngo 'khyer gyis shod 92

mkhan yong srid kyang / de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ yang rigs gcig gis nga tsho'i gzhung gis lam ston ltar rgya dmar nag gnyis gral gcig la bzhag nas langs phyogs brtan po zin nas bsdad pa 'di nor ba min nam bsam mkhan yong srid kyi red/ de nor ba gang yang ma red/ da lta ngas bshad ma thag pa bzhin/ bod gzhung gis the wan la yongs grags byas nas 'brel ba byed pa 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang / yang dag pa zhig byung na bsam nas 'brel ba byed kyi yod par brten/ de snga phan chad lkog tu 'brel ba byas pa de dag da dung nor 'khrul rang la bsdad yod pa red/ gnad don 'di dag gsal po mkhyen dgos kyi 'dug gang ltar nga tshos the wan la 'brel ba byas pa 'di da lta 'go tshugs tsam red/ the wan nang la'ang mang gtso'i 'gyur ba zhig 'gro gi yod/ mang gtso'i 'gyur ba des the wan nang la yod pa'i yul mi cho'i bsam tshul yang 'dra mi 'dra thon yong gi yod pa red/ phyogs mang po zhig nas 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa'i dus tshod 'dir nga tsho'i srid jus 'dzin stangs kyang dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs nas go skabs yod pa de tsho ma brlag pa byed dgos kyi 'dugartsa ba'i 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi 'pho 'gyur 'gro stangs dang / rgya nag nang la yang shes yon can gtso bor gyur pa'i slob phrug tsho'i nang la mang gtso dang rang dbang la 'dod pa chen po dang / don gnyer chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya nag gi dpal 'byor lam lugs 'di skabs re g.yas la thal/ skabs re g.yon la thal ba lta bus da lta'ang babs lhing po zhig chags med/ 'go 'khrid 93

rgan rabs de tsho yang lo na mtho por slebs yod/ gtso che shos nga rang tsho bod mi'i lhag bsam snying stobs 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas tshul 'di la brten nas bod kyi bden don 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la je gsal je gsal du 'gro gi yod pa dang / nga tshor rgyab skyor byed mkhan yang je mang je mang du 'gro bzhin yod/de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas lo kha shas nang la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro rgyu'i re ba tan tan yod pa red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas dus da lta bar du sems shugs ma chag pa tshang mas rig pa bsgrims nas bsdad pa red/ da dung yang tshang mas sngar bzhin rig pa bsgrim rgyu gal chen po red/ lhag par bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos sngar bzhin sems shugs bskyed dgos pa dang / de'i nang nas rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed mkhan/ lus po rgya mi'i gla 11gas la brten nas 'tsho dgos kyi spongad na yang / nang bsam blo 11 se'i pha mes nas brgyud pa'i bod mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen khog los yong / da dung yang tshang mas lhag bsam dang snying stobs bcang rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/de nas gal che ba zhig la ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang son pa'i mtshams lam khyodags gang 'dra zhig la 'gro gi red dam zer na/ brgya cha ba rgya tham pa gzhung 'brel gyi yig thog nas thag gcod byas pa'i mang gtso gtsang ma zhig gi lam la 'gro gi red/ dper na/ gzhan dag phar bzhag nga'i ngos nas cha bzhag na yang nga tshor rang dbang son pa'i mtshams la ngas bod gzhung gi 'go 'khrid byed pa'i dus tshod yol ba red/ dngos yod gnas tshul 94

la'ang ngas bod gzhung gi 'go 'khrid byas pa las/ spyi tshogs kyi nang spyir btang gi mi zhig byas te bsdad na/ spyi tshogs nang dka' rnyog yong ba'i skabs su ngas kha phan tshig phan byas na phan thogs che ba yong gi red/ gtso che shos bod nang la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang dbang mang gtso yag po zhig yong ched ngasagazhung gi 'gan khur dang / ming gnas gangasang med pa byas te bsdad pa yin na phan thogs de che ba yong gi red/ mi'i sems nang la rang bzhin gyi sems khur che ba slebs kyi red/ de min ngas 'go 'khrid nas bsdad na/ 'phral sel mang che ba blo bde yong srid nayang phugs la drin chung 'gro rgyu'i nyen khayod/ gang ltar nga tsho mang gtso yang dag pa zhig la 'gro rgyur yig gzhi'i thog nas gtan 'bebs byasasku/da pa red/ de yang nga rang tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms kyi nyi ma shar ba'i mtshams 'dir/ sngon la tshogs 'du hrag bsdus shig gi thog nas srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyu dang / lo rgyus thog nas yod pa'i rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang tshang rnams srid gzhung de la rtsis sprod rgyu/ srid gzhung des lo gnyis nang tshud la deng dus 'tham gling spyi srol dang mthun pa'i mang gatsho'i rang dbang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'os bsdu byas te bod mi mang gi 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bsdu bslong byed rgyu/ 'thus mi'i tshogs chen de'i thog nas bod kyi rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs dang / de bzhir bzhag srid gzhung 'dzugs rgyu/ da phan rgya mi'i zhi drag las khungs nang las ka byed mkhan tshor nyams myong dang / rgyus mnga' gang la gang 'tshams yod stabs mu mthud nas lhag bsam gyis las ka byed thub na yag po 'dug ces yig cha'i thog nas yongs grags gtan 95

'bebs byas yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs de 'dra red/ rgya mis 'khyog bshad byas te twa la'i bla mas 'go 'khrid pa'i las 'gul spel mkhan tsho'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso byed rgyu de red ces bshad kyi yod kyang / des gnas tshul shes mkhan tshor mgo stor rtsa ba nyid nas gtong thub kyi ma red/ 'on kyang khyed rang tsho lung khug kha shas la gang 'dra yin nam bsam pa yong ma srid pa min gshis/ dngos yod gnas tshul ngo ma ji yin bod sa khul rgya khyab gang sar dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas shes rtogs thub pa bzo rgyu gal chen po red/deng sang bod nang la chos dad rang mos sngon dang mi 'dra ba'i phran bu gu yangs su phyin te lha khang dang dgon pa nyams gso byed mkhan yod pa red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas nang pa'i chos shes kyi med pa dang / mthar thug gi dmigs yul ni chos rtsa ba nas med pa bzo rgyuyin pa smos ma dgos pa red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas chos dad rang mos zer ba gang 'dra zhig la bsam blo gtong gi yod dam zer na/ ha lam ma ṇi lag sgor lag tu 'khyer chog pa dang / phreng ba 'khyer nas skor ba la phyin pa yin na chos dad rang mos cha tshang yod pa lta bu'i bsam blo 'khor gyi yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rgya chen po yin pas slob sbyong byed dgos/ 'chad nyan dang / thos bsam sgom gsum lo nas lo bstud byas te bsam blor stong bdar byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / gling skor la 'gro chog pa tsam gyis 'grig gi yod pa ma red/ des na dgon pa khag gi gra pa tshos slob gnyer byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de 96

snga slob gnyer yod min la ma ltos par da lta'i dus tshod gsar pa 'di'i nang dpe cha lta rgyu dang / lha rab mtshan nyid kyi gzhung bltas nas rtsod pa'i thog nas bdar sha bcad de gtan la 'bebs thub pa/ de min na yang gzhung don bshad nyan gyi thog nas gang ltar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs shes pa byed rgyu de ha cang gal chen po red/ dgon pa lha khang nyams gso byas pa tsam gyis bstan pa nyams gso byas pa yin bsam mi rung / da lta lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa rnams 'grems ston khang lta bur ma bzhag par/ de'i nang la bslab pa slob gnyer yod pa dang / 'chad nyan yod pa zhig byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ deng sang chos dad kyi go skabs phran bu che ru phyin pa dang / dgon pa nyams gso byed rgyu'i go skabs mang du phyin pa dang chabs cig chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer byed rgyu'i gnas tshul yong srid pa red/ ma gzhi 'dzam gling chos lugs phan tshun gyi nang 'gal zla dang rnyog khra'i gnas tshul la ltos na/ nga rang tsho bod pa drags pa 'dug yin na yang chos lugs phan tshun gyi 'then 'khyer dang / phyogs lhung thog nas 'gal zla'i gnas tshul byung na dngos gnas blo pham po red/ chos brgyud so sos rang rang gi rten gzhi dgon gnas 'dzugs bskrun byas pa de dag nga tsho dang khyed tsho zhes chags sdang byed sa'i gzhi rtsa lta bur ma song ba'i gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug lo mang ring chos byed rgyu'i go skabs med pa'i gnas tshul 'og bar lam chos sgo phye bar brten mi mang nas phru gu mang po grwa pa bzo rgyur dga' po byed mkhan shugs chen po byung yod bzo 'dug de tshor bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos pa zhig red/ grwa pa mang nyung 97

de gnad 'gag chen po ma red/ yod pa rnams spas dag po dgos rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ ngas go thos la bod kyi sa khuzlo kha shas la grwa btsun mang po chags pa de tsho'i gras chos kyi slob gnyer byed rgyu gang yang med par brten grong chog 'dra rgyugs/ ga le ga ler sgrig khrims kyang med pa chags/ de 'dras rkyen pas snga mo chos dad shugs chen po yod pa'i khyim tshang de tsho'i gras kyi dad pa dang snang la'ang 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa 'dra po go yong gi 'dug dgon pa bzhengs pa de tsho'i nang dge 'dun yod pa rnams spus tshad yag po ma byung ba yin na khyon nas mi 'grigs/ gra btsun kha grangs mang gnas med pas/ yod pa de tshos spas dag po zhig yong ba byed rgyur do snang chen po byed dgos/ yang ngas gnas༄ tshul go thos gzhan zhig la/ bod nang dgon pa de 'dra bzhengs pa'i 'khris su bla brang yin zer ba de tshor yul pa do snang yod mkhan tshos blo pham byed mkhanasang yod tshod 'dug de tsho'i gras la tan tan bsam blo gtong dgos/ dngos gnas bstan pa rang la bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/chos ming la 'khyer nas sgor pa'i mi tshang zhig gi 'tsho gos la dmigs pa lta bu byas na dpe mi srid pa'i nor 'khrul red/de gong ri dwags gsod pa dang / nya zin rgyu sogs rgya mis kyang skul 'ded byed kyi yod pa red/ za 'bru dkon po yod pa'i skabs su srog 'tsho ba'i don du de 'dra ma byed rang byed red/ deng sang za bca'i gnas stangs phran bu drag tu phyin pa'i skabs la ri dwags gsod mkhan de tsho ha cang thabs skyo po red/ dngos gnas byas na rgya mi zhig gis ri dwags gsod par yong ba yin 98

na nga tshos bkag 'gog byed dgos pa red/ tha na rgya mi bkag ma thub kyang bod pa'i ngos nas bdag tu ma bzung ba'i bya ri dwags la gnod 'tshe nam yang byed mi rung / 'dzam gling 'di'i thog khor yug srung skyob kyi las gzhi'i nang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i bya ri dwags de tsho srog skyob byed rgyu gal chen por brtsi gi 'dugade snga bod la ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i mig dpe bzang po zhig yod pa red/rigs kha shas kyis dpal 'byor thog nas byed stangs de tsho skug pa red bsam gyiyod 'gro stedangos yod gnas tshul la 'dzam gling thog bya ri dwags gang byung gsod mkhan la dga' po byed kyi mi 'dug deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la bod nang de sngon bya ri dgas khyu khyu yod sa de tsho'i gras la deng sang nyung shas ma gtogs ha lam shul med rtsa stong 'gro ba'i gnas tshul bshad mkhan 'dugader brten rjon pa rgyag rgyu de tsho yag po gtan nas ma red/da dung sdug shos shig la rtsa chu'i don la bod pa nang khul 'khrug rtsod kyis mi gsod res byed pa'i gnas tshul go rgyu 'dug dpe srid kyi ma red/ rgya mis nga tshor sdug po 'di tsam gtong gi yod bzhin du nga rang tsho nang khul gnas tshul chung tsag la 'khrug pa byed pa de ni shin tu nas thabs skyo po red/ spyir btang bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams bod spyi pa'i don dag la tshang mas bsam blo 'khor gyi yod pa de ni yag po red/ da dung yang tshang mas bsam blo rgya che sa nas btang ste rnam dpyod dang ldan pa byed rgyu shin tu gnad gal chen po red/ lhag par du las byed pa tshos rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed skabs khral mngon sla bcos byas na yag po ma red/ so so las rigs gang 99

dang gang gi nang la lasag byed kyi yodanasang las rigs de'i thog nyams myong gsog pa dang / slob sbyong byas nas phyin chad las rigs de'i nang so so rang nyid kyis 'gan cha tshang 'khyer thub pa byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ nyin gcig so sos 'gan 'khyer dgos byung ba'i skabs su rgya mi gcig mi gla sgrig dgos byung na ngo tsha po red/ da lta bod pa'i las ka rgya mis 'phrog gi 'dug zer bzhin du/ so sos las ka de byed ma thub pa byung na de bas spam shor dgos pa dang / ngo tsha po red/ da lta nas nyams myong gsog dgos sar nyams myong bsags/ slob sbyong byas te mig dpe lta dgos sar mig dpe ltas nas gang ltar so sos 'gan theg pa zhig byed kyi yin bsam pa byed rgyu gal chen po red/bar lam nas gnas tshul legs pa zhig la/ phyi la yod mkhan bod pa khyim tshang sgor pa de 'dra nas/ bod nang la slob gra 'dzugs rgyu'i las ka byed kyiyod pa dang / khams khul ha lam bod pa'i phru gu stong phrag skor la sbyin bdag btsal rgyu sogs dbyin lan la yod pa'i bla ma gcig gis do khur chen po sanang 'dug de bzhin lha sa'i yas mas sa khul re gnyis la yang bod pa sgor pa de 'dras slob gra btsugs yod pa de tsho yag po red/ nga rang tsho phyi phyogs yod mkhan bod pa tshos sems khur blangs te bod nang la yod pa'i bod pa tshor phan thogs byed rgyu 'di nga tsho'i las 'gan red/ gal che shos shes yon gyi thog la cha rkyen bskrun rgyu 'di shin tu kha tsha dgos gtugs dang / phyags rgyang ring po'i gal gnad chen po red/ bya spyod de tsho'i gras la rjes su yi rangs yod/spyir btang thog nga tshos rgya mi rigs la ngo skol byed kyi med/ rgya mi'i 100

nang nas gnas tshul bden pa de tsho cha tshang shes pa yin na bod pa'i bden don la rgyab skyor byed mkhan tan tan yong gi red/ phyi la yod pa'i rgya mi'i nang nas nga la kha sang nas 'di 'dra bshad byung / nga tsho rgya nag nang la yod dus bod ces pa rjes lus dang / gdug rtsub/ kla klo'i rang bzhin red bsam gyi yod/ dper na skyes ma chog pa'i phru gu zer ba lta bu rdzun bzo byas pa'i glog brnyan de tsho'i thog nas bod ni gdug rtsub can zhig mthong gi yod/ de rjes/ phyi rgyal la slebs nas bod pa'i gnas tshul ngo ma shes pa'i tshe/ bod de 'dra red mi 'dug nga tsho rgya mi rigs kyi thog nas bod par dngos gnas brdab gsigs dang / gtor bzhig chen po byas 'dug gang ltar bod la gyo gun chen po phog 'dug nga rang rgya mi rigs yin pa'i cha nas dgongs nga0 nu gi yin zer mkhan de 'dra nga la thug myong / de ltar bod pa'i gnas tshub 5den don ji tsam gsal po shes pa'i tshod kyi bod par sha tsha dang / bod pa'i gnas tshul gyi thog la bsam 16) nang nas sems khur len mkhan yong rgyur brten/bod nang la rgya mi rigs dang bod pa sgor sgyu ngos nas 'brel ba bzang po byed dgos pa dang / grogs po bzo thub pa byung na bzo dgos/ kho tsho'i srid gzhung gi srid byus kha nas 'dra chags po brgya stong gang bshad rung ma bsod rung dngos po'i gnas tshul la bod pa la blos ma 'khel sa zhig dang / dbang yod bshang sa zhig la brtsi gi yod/ bod lung pa nas thon pa'i gter kha de dag nanu drung par gang la gang 'tshams phan pa zhig byed dgos kyang / gang yang byed rti dro ri nga/ gter kha thog mar 'don pa'i skabs la sa gnas kyi bod pa/ 'gakha 0 rngo ma/nyam 101

du 'gro gi yod kyang / gter kha 'bor chen po dang / spas dag po yod pa yin na/ sa cha de sto gsang rgya byed sa'i sa khul zhig la ngos rādzin byas te sa gnas kyi bod rigs las byed pa dang / dpon rigs de tsho'i gras kyis gnas tshul ma shes pa byed kyi 'dug de tsho'i gras dpe mi srid pa'i ham pa tsha po red/ rgya nag srid gzhung gis nga tsho rwa1da pa'i thog la phyogs gcig nas lo rgyus kyi bden don rnams brtsi med rdog rol btang ba red/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul thog bod par don dam pa'i sha tsha ba'i rogs ram byas yod na 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i ring la byed long byung yod/ da cha grub 'bras thon dgos tshod yin na yang / rgya mis bodabatsan bzung byas pa nas da lta bar bod pa mang che ba rgya mi la zhen pa log rgyu zhig ma gtogs byung med/ 'das pa'i lo bcu bzhi tsam gyi nang bod nas tshur gnyen 'phrad du yong mkhan dang / gros byol yong mkhan mi khri kha shas byung ba'i nang phal cher ngu mkhan dang / sdug skad rgyag mkhan sha stag ma gtogs mi 'dug bod mi mtho rim mi sna nas bzung / tha na sprang po yan chad khyim tshang mi re ngo re'i nang rgya mi'i btsan 'og la rdung brdeg ma phog pa ha lam med pa red/ khyim tshang kha shas ni pha ma bu phrug dang bcas pa btson khang nang shi song / rgya mis dmar bsad btang song / pha ma spun mched 'thab 'dzing 'og la grongs song / mu gos shi song zer ba sogs ha lam shod rgyu med pa su yang mi 'dug rgya mi'i srid gzhung gis nga tsho bod pa'i thog la rgyu mtshan yod min la ma tos par bod rgya khongs zer ba dang / bcing bkrol zer ba'i ming thog nas bod par phugs la drin 'jags pa zhig byas yod na gnas tshul 102

tha dad red/ de ltar nam yang ma byas pa'i thog la/ bod mir btsan dbang sdug sbyong de lta bu byas par brten/ srid byus de la nga chos da lta bar du ngo sgol byas pa red/ da dung yin na yang nga tshos ngo rgol byed kyi red/ dngos 'brel bod pa'i 'dod pa khengs pa zhig ma byung bar du ngo rgol byed dgos pa 'di las rgyu 'bras kyi thog nas bshad kyang rung / mi rigs kyi thob thang thog nas bshad kyang rung / 'dzam gling spyi khrims kyi thog nas bshad kyang rung / de ni yang dag pa red/ de yang nga tshos rgya mi'i srid byus la ngo rgol byed pa las/ rgya mi rigs la ngo rgol byas pa min/ de snubarno gras la nga tshos bsam blo zhib tshags po gtong dgos/ 'das pa'i dus yun ring bod nang rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs me ltar 'bar nas so so'i srog la ma ltos par bod spyi pa'i don dag la yi ge sbyar rgyu/ skad 'bod byed rgyu/ shes yon can tshos rtsom bris byed rgyus mtshon pa'i bod kyi rig gzhung dang skad yig de 'dra'i thog la zhabs 'degs nges can sgrub par rjes su yi rangs yod/ ha cang yag po red/bod nas gsar 'byor rgya gar khul slob gra'i nang 'gro mkhan da lta bar stong phrag re zung slebs yod pa dang / sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas par slob gnyer byed mkhan stong phrag drug yas mas slebs yod/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bshad na tshur yong rgyu nyen ka dang / dka' ngal ha cang chen po yod na yang / tshang ma blos btang nas slob sbyong ched yong ba red la/ yong don gzhir bzung 'dir slob gnyer byed stangs kyang dka' spyad rnying rus ha las pa 'dugade ni ha cang yag po red/ yang khag gcig ni/ ma gzhi rgya mi'i 'og la rtag 103

par khong khro slong mkhan gyi dkyil du lo nas lo bstud nas 'tshar longs byas pa'i shugs rkyen lta bus rnam 'gyur dang byed stangs ha cang spro thung thung / 'khon thogs phran bu byung ba yin na/ lam sang rgyag res rgyag rgyu dang / rdo gzhu ba/sdug sa la gri rgyag mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dug de tsho ni ha cang thabs sdug red/ de snga slob gra khag la cha bzhag na dang po slob gra zhig 'dzugs e thub kyi 'bad brtson byas/ rim pa gnyis pa slob gra tshugs zin pa de dag spus dag po cig yong rgyu'i thog la shugs snon byas yod/ de bzhin chos sgar khag kyang dang po tshugasa.e thub bltas nas gra pa bgres song nyung shas las med pa de 'dra'i thog nas sngon la rkang grangs sgrig rgyu gal chen po chags pa red/ da cha rgya gar nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i phru gu gang la gang 'tshams yod pa dang / nye ba'i char bod nas tshur gsar 'byor gra btsun mang po zhig yong ba bcas/ grangs sha'i cha nas dka' ngal sel zin pas spus dag po yong rgyu'i thog la shugs bsgril dgos kyi 'dug btsan byol du ji+o5ོda pa'i gdan sa che khag 'di dag ni mtho rim gyi gtsug lag slob gra rang red ma gtogs/ mi tshe bskyel sa'i don du min/ sal te mi tshe 'di'i nang bskyal ba yin na bshad sgrub gnyis kyi thog nas bstar pa'i bya ba sgrub dgos pa las/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyi thog la byas rjes gang ji gang med par so so 'tsho thabs tsam gyi don du mi tshe bskyal sa zhig ma red/ nga rang tsho'i gra sa tshugs stangs kyang sngar rgya gar gyi nā lan ḍa dang /bri ka ma /kru shi la so/bas pa 'di tsho'i goms srol rnams brgyud 'dzin byas pa lta bu gtsug sas rdzo ba gro'i ngo bo ldan pa zhig yin pas de'i rnam 'gyur dang / ngo 104

bo gsal po mtshon thub pa byed rgyu gal chen po yin/ gdan sa gsum dang /mdor na sa skya bka' rnying ris su ma phye ba'i bshad gra yod pa tshang ma spus dag po dang / gnad tshad longs pa bzo rgyu gal chen po 'dug bar lam slob 'khrid byed phyogs kyi skor dang / sgrig lam kun spyod kyi skor la nga tsho snga rjes su skad cha byung yod kyang / da dung ltod g.yeng rtsa ba nas ma byas par de'i thog do nan mu mthud byed dgos kyi 'dug da gin nang srid bka' blon gyis bshad pa bzhin/dge 'dun pa'i nang nas ma shes pa'am/ bod nang dka' ngal chen po 'phrad rjes 'di phyogs gu yangs thob pa lta bu'i thog nas byung ba gang ltar yang snying gyon pa gyon stangs/ sgrig lam kun spyod 'khyer stangs/ mdor na 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi rnam 'gyur gang ci dam chos 'dul ba'i lugs dang mi mthun pa/ phyi nang gi mi su 'dra zhig gi mig snang la ma mdzes pa thon dang thon bzhin pa 'di tsho'i gras la do snang dang yid zab nges par byed dgos/ de yang bstan pa'i don dag red ma gtogs/ mi sger gyi gnad don ma red/ 'di ga dun zur gzhis chags dang / de min dgon pa gzhan dag yod sa'i sa cha gang dang gang yin na yang phal ces che gzhis chags shig gi sgrig 'dzugs 'og gnas sku(da par brten/ gzhis chags skusgo so'i gzhis 'beta bde don mi mang bcas pas khur mnyam len byed dgos/ dper na/ gra btsun 'ga' zhig gis bstan pa'i mtshan shas yong gzhi'i bya spyod gnas tshul mthong thos dogs gsum byung na/ thad kur dgon pa'i las sne tsho la brda sbyor byed dgos pa dang / las sne tshos kyang spyi zom la ma bzhag par rgyu ma phu 'ded kyi brda 'ded gtong dgos/105
