gnas tshul thengs gcig lab/ gnyis lab/ lan grangs 'ga' shas lab kyang mi nyan mkhan de gras la nyes brdung gtong mi dgos/ da 'dir ma bzhugs par phebs rogs gnang zhes zhus na de ni spyi'i 'gro stangs shig red/ ston pa bka' drin can gyis bcas mtshams dgongs don yang 'dus sde'i dbye mtshams phye thabs shig red/ gra pa'i sgrig lam zhes pa 'di lcags ri phyi nang gi dbye mtshams phye rgyu'i gnas tshul min pas/ sgrig lam kun spyod dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul byung na do bdag gis kyang 'gro shag shag dang / las kyi sne mor gtogs pa de tshos kyang sgrig khongs nas phud rgyu ma gtogs/ rang bzhin zom 'jog byed rgyu zhig gtan nas min/ yang na slob sbyong la lta rgyu yod pa zhig dang / yang na spyod lam gyi thog nas zhi zhing dul ba/ dngos 'brel drang tshugs zin mkhan byung ba yin na lta rgyu gcig red/ de 'dra gang yang med pa'i rigs 'di tsho'i gras gcig yin rung mang drags pa red/ ga le ga ler gtsang sel gtong dgos pa las/ snang med du bzhag na mi 'grigs/ der tshang mas do snang shugs che tsam dang / nan tsam byed dgos kyi 'dug lhag par 'khrug rtsod kyi gnas tshul byung ba yin na/ bden dang ma bden gyi skad cha bshad yul med/ 'khrug slong gis lag pa bteg res kyi gnas tshul byung phyin 'gro rgyu rang red ma gtogs/ de bzhag thabs rtsa ba nyid nas yod pa ma red/ zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan mi re zung gis zhus/ mtshan shas de bstan pa spyi la phog yong dus khe gun gsab thabs gtan nas med pa red/ de cho'i gras la tshang mas gzab gzab kyis nan tsam byas na ga le ga ler gtsang ma chags yong gi red/106

sa gnas rgya gar gyiyul mi tsho la 'brel ba byed stangs skor thog mar gzhis chags tshugs pa'i skabs nas bzung gal chen por brtsis te rtag par bshad mus red/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bod pa yod sa'i sa gnas phal cher la 'brel ba yag po yod kyang / deng sang bod mi'i byed phyogs ma bzo ba'i rkyen gyis gnas tshul mang du 'gro gi med dam bsam pa 'dug de tsho'i gras la gtso bo 'gan khur byed mkhan tshos do snang byas te tshang mar slob gso gtong rgyu gal chen po 'dug dgon pa'i nang la ran la ma ran ngang sdod mkhan 'di tsho'i gras kho rang tsho la'ang slob sbyong gi thog nas 'gro sa'i mdun lam zhig tan tan yong gi red/ gang ltar phyi'i rtags dang cha lugs brjes pa ma gtogs nang gi bsam blo brje po ma thebs mkhan gyi mi de tsho'i gras khyim pa rang byas/khyim so bzung ste phyin pa yin na bod spyi pa'i don la'ang phan thogs che ba yong gi red/ gra pa 'jon la ma 'jon gcig gi dgon pa'i nang bsdad pa yin na/des bstan par phan thogs med la/ bod spyi par phan thogs med pa'i khar gnod kyi yod/ de las khyim sa bzungaste bsdad pa yin na/ kho rang khyim tshang gcig gi thog nas bu phrug 'dra byas/ bod pa'i spyi tshogs la phan gyi red/ so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul khams dang mos pa/ gshis ka la gzhigs nas so so skya bo byas nas bod spyi pa la phan thogs che ba 'dug na/ skya bo byas te phyin na yag shos red/ dngos gnas rtags cha lugs brjes pa tsam du ma zad/ rang gi bsam blo'i thog nas bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs shig sgrub thub bsam pa'i 'dod pa yod pa dang / sgrub thub mkhan zhig yin 107

na dgon par bsdad/ slob gnyer byas/ gos ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhabs 'degs rlabs chen sgrub thub kyi red/ gang ltar skya min ser min phan tshun su la'ang phan ma thogs pa tsam du ma zad/ zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan 'dra po byas pa yin nasag po gang yang med/de rnams da ring dran thog la zhus pa yin /da res 'dir nyi ma bco lnga tsam bsdad pa'i dus stod tshang ma chos 'brel byed rgyur rdzogs te slob gra khag la 'gro thub ma song / 'on kyang kha sang dbus bod slob tshogs pa'i drung che dang / shes rig lhan khang gi drung che nga mnyam du thug ste skad cha rob tsam byung / spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul thog tshang mas sems khur blangs te rtsa ba'i slob gra'i mthun rkyen drag tu phyin pa dang / slob sbyong gi gnas stangs drag tu phyin pa'i gnas tshul skad cha byung /gzhis mi tsho'i thog la byin rten yod/ 'di ga'i gzhis chags kyi mi tshor yin/ gzhis mi dang gzhis 'go tshang mas bgo sha mos stoms po rgyag dgos/ kha sa kha nyin chos 'brel skabs nyin ltar re bzhin rgas gcong de 'dra rtag par thug gi 'dug nga'i sems la gang drag bsam pa byung / da gin las bsdoms nang la bshad don ltar mthun rkyen sgo gang sa nas sgrub lta sgrub kyi yod pa red/ 'dir stong min zhal 'debs sgor nyis 'bum lnga khri yod pa 'di dag khyed tsho spyi pa'i khongs nyar nas nad pa nyams thag de tshor phan thogs byas na bsam byung / byed stangs gang dga' ba 'dug smin po zhig yong ba byed dgos/zhes bka' 355// // 108

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 2 tshes 25 nyin gsung chos ra bar ser skya mang tshogs la skyes rabs gsung chos skabs bka' slob stsal ba/da lta 'dir skabs su babs pa bod gangs can ljongs la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo zhes pa'i dus chen 'di gsar 'dzugs gnang ba nas bzung 'char can zla ba dang po'i nang lha sar jo bo chen po'i rten gyi drung la dge 'dun mang po 'dus nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong dang 'brel ba'i mchod 'bul rgya che gnang ba'i lugs srol zhig dar te ha lam lo drug brgya skor song ba de'i ring mdzad srol bzang po 'di la brten nas skye 'gro dpag tu med pa zhig gis bsod nams bsags te mdor na rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa mang po zhig byung ba brgya cha brgya thag chod pa red/bar lam nga rang tsho spyi mthun gyi bsod nams dman pa dang / phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mang po 'dzoms pa'i 'og nas nga rang tsho'i pha yul gzhan gyi lag tu shor ba de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas bstan pa la nyams nyes shin tu chen po byung yod/ 'dir btsan byol du yod pa'i bod mi'i nang de snga'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi srol bzang po de dag rgyun 'dzin byed thub na yag po 'dug ces bar lam nas dzña ram sa lar bstar chags su smon lam tshogs bzhin yod la/sa gnas gzhan du'ang de de bzhin tshogs kyi yod/ de ring 'dir nga rang tsho ser skya mang po zhig 'du 'dzoms byung ba 'di skal ba bzang po yin/ de bzhin 'dir phyi rgyal gyi mi sna ston pa bka' drin can gyi rjes su 'brangs shing / yang sgos bod gangs can ljongs la yod pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa 109

cha tshang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la yid 'phrog ste shes nas dad pa thob pa'i do snang can gang 'tshams shig slebs yod pa sogs mdor na 'dir mi rigs sna tshogs pa zhig dang / ser skya pha mo mang po zhig 'dzoms yod pa red/da ring nga tsho 'dir 'dzoms nas las 'gan gang zhig bsgrub rgyu yin nam zhe na/ tshang mas sems bzang po skye thabs shig dang / mi tshe bzang po'i ngang nas bzang mtha' 'khyol ba zhig bya rgyu 'di nga rang tsho tshang ma'i bsgrub bya yin/ sems bzang po dang / mi tshe bzang po zhig yong bar byed pa la byed stangs shes dgos/ de la sngon gyi ston pa bka' drin can gang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa shes pa byas na de'i thog nas nga rang tsho'i mi tshe skyel stangs la nyams myong bslab bya len rgyu mang po yod/ des na sngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len la 'khyer shes pa'i thog nas sems kyi sbyong brdar byed dgos pa gsungs yod/ sngon gyi phyag srol la de ring gi dus stod 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi skyes rabs mdzad pa rnam thar gyi lo rgyus slob dpon chen po dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa 'di'i gzhung nas 'chad nyan gnang ba'i phyag srol yod pa ltar de ring yang skyes rabs kyi bshad pa mdor bsdus shig zhu rgyu dang / bod nas gsar 'byor ba mang po zhig slebs yod pa'i khongs nas gang 'tshams shig sang gnangs bod du thon 'gro gi yod dus bod kyi gnas tshul yang phran bu 'grel bshad brgyab na snyam pa dran byung /da lta bshad ma thag pa bzhin mi tshe bzang po zhig yong ba la sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed dgos/ sems ji tsam dul ba de tsam gyi mi tshe 'di skyid 110

pa yong gi yod/ mi tshe 'di bzang po zhig tu skyel thub pa byung na tshe rabs rjes ma tshor yang phan gyi red/ skye ba snga phyi khas mi len mkhan zhig yin na de ni tha dad red/ skye ba snga phyi yod med kyi thad la skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i phyogs la sgrub byed mang po yod/ skye ba snga phyi mi 'dod na dogs pa mang po zhig mu mthud gnas rgyu red/ skye ba snga phyi yod par 'dod na dogs pa mang po zhig la lan 'debs thub/ skye ba snga phyi yod na de la 'gal 'du'i skyon med cing / skye ba snga phyi med na 'gal 'du'i skyon mang po zhig mthong yang de la lan rgyag rgyu med par gang shes zhes brjod na ma gtogs rgyu mtshan bgrang rgyu med/yang na 'jig rten bkod pa po yod par 'dod mkhan zhig yin na rtsa ba 'jig rten bkod pa po yod par 'dod pa'i grub mtha' 'dzam gling thog mang po yod/ de dag gis sngar dus rabs brgya phrag mang po'i ring mi sa ya mang por phan thogs byung yod la/ da lta yang phan thogs yong dang yong bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs par yang phan thogs yong rgyu red/ mi la phan na dgos rgyu de yin/ des dgos don tshang gi yod pa red/ grub mtha' mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa de dag la nga rang tshos dngos gnas dag snang sbyang nas brtsi bkur dang / rjes su yi rangs byas te mngon par bstod dgos pa red/ de lta na yang / nga rang tsho'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag gsungs pa de'i thog nas brtags na 'jig rten bkod pa po 'dod na 'gal 'du mang po zhig yong rgyu red/ yang rgyu med rkyen med cig 'dod pa yin na'ang rigs pa'i gnod pa mang po zhig yong gi yod/ nga rang tsho'i sems 111

la thog mtha' med pas srid pa 'khor ba la thog ma med pa'i steng nas skye ba snga phyi bshad pa de'i thad nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ dri ba tshang mar lan thebs kyi yod min mi shes kyang / phal che bar lan 'debs thub/ rtsa ba spyir btang bshad pa yin na nga tsho'i sems nang gti mug bden 'dzin gyis mtshon pa'i rmongs pa mang po zhig yod/ skabs re nga tsho'i sems nang nga rgyal skyes te/ dper na 'di 'dra dpe mi srid ces pa dang / nga yid ches kyi mi 'dug zer ba dang /rgyu mtshan bgrang dgos brjod skabs gang shes zer ba dang / gang yin yang nga ni yid ches thub kyi mi 'dug ces brjod dus de'i sems gting la nga rgyal mo da/ skad cha de dag nga rgyal gyi thog nas thon pa ma gtogs de min yid ma ches pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa brjod dgos na brjod rgyu mang po med/ mthar gtugs dus gang yin na yang nga ni yid ches med brjod rgyu de red/ dper na khang pa'i steng gi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin shes pa la khang pa'i steng du ma slebs na 'og nas steng gi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin bshad mi thub/ rgyang thag spyi le kha shas brgal ba'i lung pa zhig gi gnas tshul shes pa la yang na rgyang shel bed spyod pa'am/ yang na lung pa der dngos su bskyod de gnas tshul cha tshang shes pa byed dbesas pa ma gtogs mi gzhan gyis ngo sprod byas pa tsam gyis gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin shes mi thub la/ skabs re gzhan gyis bshad pa la'ang yid mi ches pa 〈snang srid/der brten skye ba snga phyi dang / khams gsum zhes pa/ sa lam gyi rnam gzhag sa lam bgrod nas skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyi sangs rgyas kyi 112

go 'phang thob pa de rigs lam seng blo la shong bde min tan tan yong gi red/de tsho'i gras mang po zhig dpe cha'i gzhung nas/ bdagad pa'i gnas tshul rnams dang /nyin re nyin re so so'i sems nang chags sdang gang 'dra yong gi yod pa de gnyis ra sprod gtong shin gtong gin byas na/ gang 'tshams nas/ a'u 'di ya mtshan zhig 'dug bsam pa zhig blo la 'char rgyu dang / nyams myong skye rgyu zhig yod/skye ba snga phyi yod pa mi 'dod na mun nag chag sa nas 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa khas blangs na 'di'i steng nas stong gsum gyi stong chen wa'i 'jig rten khams kyis mtshon pa'i mdor na zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten khams zhes pa 'di'i stod bcud chags 'jig gi rnam gzhag dang / rdul phra rab la brten nas 'byung stangs/ 'byung bzhi g.yo ba'i rgyu dang / sems can gyi las kyi rkyen/ de 'dra'i rgyu dang rkyen tshogs pa'i steng nas nga rang tshos srid pa 'khor ba zhes brjod kyang rung / gang ltar mtha' yas shing mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med yod pa 'di'i gnas stangs 'grel bshad rgyag thub pa dang /'di 'dra zhig yin 'dug bsam pa'i tshod dpag gang 'tshams byed thub pa zhig yod/ mi tshe 'di bzang po'i thog nas bzang mtha' 'khyol ba zhig byung na tshe 'di skyid pa tsam du ma zad/ tshe rabs gtan gyi mdun ma sgrub thub pa zhig yong gi yod pas tshang mas sems rgyud 'dul thabs dang / mi bzang po zhig e yong blta dgos/ lhag don 'dir dus dus la ma gtogs slebs mi thub 113

pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa yod kyang chos kyi gnas lugs de tsam go myong thos myong med pa khag cig slebs yod pa khyed rang tshos gal che shos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying don sems pa bzang po bya rgyu dang / spyod pa bzang po bya rgyu 'di yin pa shes dgos/ de yang ngas rnam kun 'grel shad rgyab pa bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying po bsdus na/ lta ba dang spyod pa gnyis kyi sgo nas 'chad dgos shing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa gang yin zhe na 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa de yin/ 'tshe ba ste gzhan la gnod pa byas na/ des pha rol po la sdug bsngal bskyed pa dang / ma skyid pa yong gi red bsam pa'i gnas tshul 'di shes dgos/ rang la mi gzhan gyis gnod bskyal na rang nyid ma skyid pa yong ba 'di'i nyams myong la dpag nas gzhan la tshig rtsub brjod pa dang / rgyu dngos 'phrog pa/ nyes rdung gtong ba/ 'khrug rtsod byed pa sogs byas na gzhan de yang ma skyid pa yong gi red bsam pa'i bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin gyi thog nas gzhan la 'tshe ba byed pa'i go skabs shar yang 'tshe ba mi byed pa 'di la 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa zhes brjod pa ma gtogs/ phar phyogs rdo la thug pa lta bu tshor ba gang yang med pa zhig la 'tshe ba med pa zhes zer ba min/ 'tshe ba byed pa'i go skabs dang / cha rkyen yod bzhin du gnod pa bskyal na 'grigs kyi ma red bsam pa'i bsam cho'i thog nas 'tshe ba mi byed pa de la 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa zhes brjod kyi yod/ shes song ngam/'tshe ba mi byed pa'i spyod pa byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/lta ba rten 'byung zhes pa 'di la thug yod/ nga rang tshor sdug bsngal med cing 114

skyid pa zhig dgos kyi yod/ sdug bsngal med pa'i skyid pa 'di gzhan la gnod pa mi skyel bar phan btags na phugs la rang nyid skyid pa yong rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul 'di shes pa byed dgos/ de shes na gzhan la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba mi byed pa 'di rang don la thug par brten rang don rang gces sus kyang byed kyi red/ mi la mgo bskor gtong ba dang / 'khrug pa brgyab pa sogs byas na so so'i grogs po dang / dga' po nye po brlag 'gro ba dang / rang la'ang mi sdug chag dang / rlung langs po/ rku ma/ rdzun ma bcas kyi ming chad yong gi red/ mi tshang ma'i mig zur nas rang la lta stangs mi 'dra ba zhig blta dus so so yang skyid po med/ mi tshang mas mi de drang po dang / rdzun mi shod mkhan/blo mthun red ces brjod pa zhig byung na ming de 'khyer nas rgyus mnga' yod pa'i mi tshang gang 'dra zhig la phyin kyang tshang mas yar shog ces brjod pa dang /dngos gnas snying nye po mi gcig snying gcig gi grogs po grogs mched dang /don dam pa'i mdza' bshes chags te so so'i dka' ngal gang la'ang mis rogs ram byed mkhan yong gi red/ gal te rogs dngos su byed ma thub kyang so so'i dka' ngal gang yang shod sa zhig byung na deyang skyo rogs rang yin/ dper na/ de ring rang nyid la gnas tshul sdug pa zhig byung na so so blos 'khel sa zhig gi sar phyin nas gnas tshul thabs sdug 'di 'dra byung song zhes sems nang gi ma skyid pa de shod sa zhig byung na phran bu phan thogs yod/ sems ma skyid pa de sdug bsgom brgyab ste bsdad na gang 'tshams nas srog rlung 'phar rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ snying nye ba'i grogs po zhig yod na skad cha bshad sa zhig 115

yong gi red/ nga rang tsho mi'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhig red/ der brten mi ya rabs shig byas na so sor phan thogs yod pa dang / ma rabs byas na so sor gyong rag rgyu yin/ ma rabs byas na chos dang 'gal bas 'grigs kyi ma red brjod kyi med la/ yang ya rabs byas na sangs rgyas dgyes po yong gi red ces kyang brjod kyi med/ ya rabs byas na so so rang nyid spyi tshogs nang mis cha bzhag sa dang / dga' po byed sa zhig chags nas rang gi mi tshe 'di skyid pa zhig yong gi red ces brjod kyi yod/ nga rang tsho ma rabs mi byed cing /ya rabs byed dgos pa'i rtsa ba rang gi bde sdu ga rnams gzhan dang 'brel ba yod pa der thug yod/ rang gi bde sdug gi rgyu rkyen gzhan la ltos ma dgos par rang dbang gi sgo nas rang btsan pa zhig yod na gzhan la bsam blo gtong dgos don med la/ gzhan zhes pa 'di la mig lta ci/ ltag khung yang ma bltas par g.yug bzhag na so so gcig pu'i don bsgrub na 'grigs pa yong srid/ 'on kyang nga rang tsho'i mi tshe'i 'gro stangs 'di mi'i spyi tshogs nang skyel dgos pa ma gtogs de min gzhan zhig tu skyel sa med/ mi gzhan la khong khro byed pa dang /blo mi 'khel ba byas nas bsdad na mi'i spyi tshogs phar bzhag dud 'gro'i khyur yang 'dres mi thub/ gal srid rang shi brgyab na de ni sdug gyong red/ gang ltar ma shi bar sdug skad rgyag shin rgyag shin du mi'i dkyil du sdod rgyu ma gtogs/'di las lhag pa'i pho rgod po byas te zla ba'i khang bzang la 'gro mi thub/ phyin kyang mu ge dang rlung mi mthun pa'i dbang gis 'chi rgyu las gzhan gang yang med/gal srid shubs 'dra gyon te phyin tshe chu tshod gcig gnyis sdod thub kyang de ni 116

rdog khres rang las snying po gang yang med/ de las srid pa chags te mi'i 'gro ba gnas sa'i 'dzam bu gling 'di'i steng du bsdad na skyid cing 'di las lhag pa'i 'gro sa gang yang med/ nga rang tsho lha gsol klu gsol byas kyang lha yul la 'khrid mkhan med la/ klu yul la 'khrid mkhan yang med/ nga rang tsho'i mi tshe 'di 'dzam gling 'di'i steng bsdad rgyu ma gtogs med/ mi'i nang sdod dgos pa da nga / mi dang 'brel ba byed dgos pa gang zhig la 'brel ba byed sa'i mi gzhan rnams la rgyag res brgyab/ mgo skor btang / ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa sha stag bshad de bsdad na byab chung dang / lkug pa red/ mnyam du sdod dgos dus 'cham po byas te gcig gis gcig la blo bkal chog pa'i mi bzang spro zhig dang / ya rabs shig byas te bsdad na de las skyid pa med/ der brten ya rabs dang bzang po byed dgos pa 'di rang gi bde sdug rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yin pas na rang nyid kyi bde sdug gang la brten sa'i yul de dag la 'brel ba yag po byed dgos pa dang / 'brel ba yag po yong ba la 'tshe ba mi byed cing / bzang po byed dgos/chos kyi snying po mdor bsdus na spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa dang / lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba 'di yin/ de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snying po yin/spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa zhes pa ni gzhan sdug bsngal gyis mnar bar mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa de dag ngos 'dzin byas te gzhan la phan bde sgrub thub na rab dang / gal srid phan bde sgrub ma thub kyang gzhan la gnod 'tshe byas na mi 'grigs/ gzhan de yang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa rang dang mtshungs 117

pa red bsam pa'i rang gi nyams myong la dpag nas gzhan la 'tshe ba'i las las dog pa 'di 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i rim pa gnyis pa yin/de ring cho 'phrul dus chen dang 'brel nas nga rang sto 'dir 'dzoms pa red/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches gang gsung gi 'dug ces brjod na/ 7rgyal dbang rin po ches nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zhes pa 'di lta spyod gnyis kyi thog nas bshad dgos/ lta ba rten 'byung gi lta ba dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i spyod pa yin/ lta spyod gnyis po 'di su zhig gis nyams len byas na de ni nang pa yin la/ lta spyod gnyis po 'di nyams len mi byed mkhan ni nang pa min zhes gsung gi 'dug bsam nas tshang ma'i sems la nges pa byed dgos/de nas bod la log 'gro mkhan dang / gnas skor la 'gro mkhan/ de bzhin la dwags dang / 'brug nas yong mkhan 'ga' shasalend pa bcas khyed rang tsho so so'i lung par log 'gro skabs 7rgyal ba rin po ches 'di 'dra gsung gi 'dug bsam te sems la nges pa byas/ de'i thog nas nyin re nyin re'i lag len gzungs sngags zab mo bgrang rgyu dang / lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal skor sbyong byed rgyu 'di rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin/ bsam blo gtong stangs yag po zhig gi sgo nas dge ba bsgrub thub pa ma byung na/ ngag gis sngags bgrang pa dang / lus kyis phyag 'tshal skor sbyong byas pa de tsam gyis dge ba la 'gro mi 'gro the tshom yin/ chos byed pa'i kun slong yag po zhig byung na chos la 'gro rgyur the tshom mi dgos/ sems nang phan sems shig skyes na de ni chos yin la/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang yin/ de'i 'gal 118

zla mi gzhan la gnod sems 'chang ba dang / 'khon 'dzin byed pa ni ma rung ba yin bsam nas ched du gnyer nas nyung du gtong rgyu 'di yang chos yin/ de 'dra zhig sems nang ga dus skyes kyang dngos gnas chos la 'gro ba yin/ de min sdug sa nas bshad na sems nang chags sdang gi blo skye bzhin pa'i mur ngag nas sngags bgrang kyang de chos rnam dag la 'gro thabs med/ da dung 'dra chags pos mi la mgo bsgor gtong rgyu'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te ngag nas chos bshad pa dang / lus la chos pa'i gos gyon pa de ni dge ba gsog rgyu phar bzhag sdig pa gsog gi yod pas de 'dra byed rgyu med/ lus ngag gi dge ba ni phal pa dang / sems kyi dge ba ni gtso bo yin pa 'di tshang ma'i sems la nges pa byas nas hur thag byed dgos/ shes song ngam/ngas khyed rang tshor hur thag byed dgos brjod pa 'di/ nga rang sgrig khrims 'khyer mi dgos par bsdadanas khyed rang tshor sgrig khrims 'khyer dgos zhes brjod kyi med/ nga rang la cha bzhag na ston pa bka' drin can gyi rjes 'brangs kyi dge slong phal pa zhig yin bsam pa'i bsam blo rmi lam tshun chad la btang nas sdod kyi yod/ bcom ldan 'das thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i bka' drin can de'i 7zhabs kyi rjes su 'brangs/ de'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong thebs chag cig yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos la ngas lam seng de de bzhin no zhes yid ches kyang byed kyi med/ skabs re dogs pa yong gi 'dug dogs pa de'i thog brtag dpyad byed kyi yod/ dper na/ 'dir ri mo bris pa'i rgyan 119

drug mchog gnyis mgon po klu sgrub dang / ār+ya de ba/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang / chos grags de tsho'i gras mi'i nang gi klad pa phul du byung ba sha stag yin/ khong tshos brtag dpyad mang po gnang / nyams myong bsags/ mthar bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' 'di bsregs btubs 'pher ba zhig yod pa'i yid ches nges pa rnyed/ gdeng 'khel te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chags pa red ma gtogs rmongs dad kyi thog nas g.yam rgyugs byas te phyin pa ma red/ de ltar min pa khong rnam pa'i brtsams chos legs bshad la bltas na shes thub/ khong tsho'i gzhung gi nang du yang brtag dpyad mang po byed dgos zhes gsungs yod pa ma gtogs/ brtag dpyad mi dgos par rmongs dad kyis lam seng yid ches byed dgos zhes gsungs med/ de bzhin du nga rang gi ngos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bka' la/ brtag dpyad byas/ brtag dpyad kyi thog nas rigs kha shas la the tshom za yang de dag mthar gtugs dus nga la yid ches rnyed ma song brjod rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ de las lhag pa'i sgrub byed ma rnyed pa'i dus la rang shed ma byas par/de min pa'i rgyu mtshan khungs skyel byed rgyu mi 'dug na de la cha bzhag na legs par bltas te rigs gcig 'di 'dra byas te 'gro gi yod/ rigs gcig ni rgyu mtshan rang la bsam blo gtong dus nges pa rnyed rgyu yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas bcom ldan 'das kyi lam ston gnang yod pa de la so sos yid ches dang bro ba rnyed nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' bzhin sgrub kyi yod/ mdor na/ da lta ngas bzang po byed dgos pa dang / gnod sems byed rgyu med brjod pa 'di 120

nga rang gi snying khong rus pa'i gting nas brgya cha brgya yid ches rnyed de nyams myong gdeng 'khel ba'i thog nas ngas nang pa tsho la 'di rang bshad kyi yod la/phyi pa chor yang 'di rang bshad kyi yod/ chos med mkhan tshor yang 'di rang bshad kyi yod/ rgya mi gung khran la'ang 'dzems bag med pa'i thog nas 'di rang bshad de sgrub byed bkod nas rgyu mtshan bstan thub kyi red/ der brten khyed rang tsho tshang mas sems rgyud bzang po dang / ya rabs bya rgyu 'di chos kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / 7rgyal ba rin po ches rang gi phyag len du bkal te nyams myong gi 〉stog nas phan thogs spongad pa zhig yin par yid ches brgya cha brgya thob ste gsungs pa zhig red bsam pa'i ngos 'dzin byas nas nyams len hur thag bya rgyu gal chen po yin/lhag par da lta'i dus 'dir nga rang tsho bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha dngo sa gnas yod/ rgya mi'i gdug rtsub mnar gcod byed stangs 'di mu mthud nas lo mang po zhig gtan nas gnas mi thub/ rgya nag rang gi nang du'ang gdug rtsub kyi byed stangs 'di rgya mi tshor yang 'tshams kyi med pas/ bod pa la de bas 'tshams po gang nas yong / der brten rim pas bsgyur bco 'gro rgyu yin pa nga tshos brgya cha brgya tshod dpag byed thub/ de lta na'ang jo lta'i gnas stangs 'di bod yul rgya yul ngo mar sgyur ba'i dza drag gi gnas skabs la slebs yod pas/ nga rang tsho rwa1da rigs yirno no cog tshang mas so so'i mjing par rdog khres re 'khyer te lhag bsam rgyun bcang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ bod rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod 'di sangs rgyas 121

kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin zhes ngas rgyun du brjod kyi yod/ ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod rang dbang lag tu son pa'i mtshams nga tsho'i bsgrub bya ni srid don rkyang pa'i rang dbang ma yin par/ dngos gnas zhi bde'i bsti gnas mi smon rang skyid/mdor na bcom ldan 'das kyi 'tshe ba med pa'i rten 'byung chos lugs kyi snying don dang mtshungs pa'i rang dbang gi lung pa zhig bskrun rgyu de yin/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngazung du 'brel ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin par brten/bod rang dbang gi don du so so'i lus srog la nyams nyes byung ba de dag gis dka' ngal khyad bsad byas pa byas go chod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i rang dbang rtsod len byed pa 'di dngos gnas so so'i 'di phyi'i bsod nams gsog pa'i yul yin pa tshang mas shes pa byed dgos/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i rang dbangabasgrub rgyu 'di gzhan phan rgya chen sngoge dang 'brel ba yod pa'i las bzang po zhig yin pas/phyogs gcig nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa 'di ngo shes dgos pa dang /phyogs gnyis nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub stangs yag po shes dgos/de yang ming rgyab 'khur khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste dge tshul slong gi sdom pa blangs pa'i grwa pa dang / btsun ma de dag ni bstan pa'i khur len mkhan yin/ dper na/ dmag la masnuran na dacadas su dmag rgyag mkhan gyi dmag mi lta bu yin/ yid thar par phyogs nas nyon mongs la kha gtad bcags te nyon mongs rgya'/ du 'jug gi min zhes pa 'di rtsa ba'i dam bca' yin/ khyim 122

nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhing / lus la chos gos rnam gsum gyon mkhan tsho la lhag par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i 'gan dmigs bsal can zhig 'khri yod pa tshang mas shes dgos/ rtags cha lugs brjes pa tsam la grwa pa zhes brjod pa min la/ 'gyed phogs len shes tsam la grwa pa brjod pa'ang min/ grwa pa rnams nas dngos gnas bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len byed mkhan grwa pa spus dag po byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/ de skor ngas rgyun du skad rgyag gi yod/ grwa btsun la cha bzhag na rgya gar nang bod pa btsan byol 'bum gcig tsam yod pa'i nang grwa btsun phal cher chig khri yas mas shig yod pa des mi 'bor khyon yongs kyi bcu zur tsam zin pa mang drags pa'i skyon ma gtogs nyung drags pa'i skyon med/ de dag spus dag po ma byung bar zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan snon ma lta bu zhig chags na shin tu thabs sdug yin/ der brten ngas rgyun du grwa sa grwa tshang gi dgon sde tshang mar 'bod skul byed kyi yod/sgrig khrims srung sdom bya rgyu'i thad la phyogs gcig nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtsa chen yin pa dang / so so'i 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba yin pa shes pa'i jog nas ma skul dang len gyis sgrig khrims de so so'i khur du mi brtsi bar rgyan du brtsis nas rang khrims rang gis srung dgos/ phyogs gnyis nas mkhan po dang / slob dpon/ dge bskos sogs chos khrims pa tshos 'gan khyer te skul lcag lta rtog bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de tsam du ma zad deng sang gi dus stod la spyi tshogs khyon yongs nas kyang do snang bya rgyu gal chen po yin/dper na/ dzña ram sa lar cha bzhag na meg lor lhan ci dang / dha sa steng 123

shod la sdod mkhan bod mi spyi byings tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ lus la grwa chas gyon te spyod pa ma rabs byed mkhan 'dug na khyed rang tshos spyi tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs so sor skabs 'phral lan sprod dgos/ lus la grwa chas gyon na yang don snying grwa pa ni ma red/ grwa pa'i rtags tsam 'dzin nas bstan pa bshig mkhan yod tshe skabs 'phral sgrig 'dzugs yas mas la lan sprad de tshang mas khur mnyam len bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ dgon pa grwa tshang nang sdod ring khungs so sor sgrig khrims gnon sdom byed kyi yod kyang / dgon pa dang bar thag 'dom kha shas chod mtshams lam seng zhabs 'dren mang po zhus na yag po min/ spyir btang spyi tshogs nang grwa pa thebs chag khyad mtshar po/ phu thung gyon mkhan de 'dra mang po zhig 'dug ces skad brgyab pa ma gtogs/ lam seng rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyi bkag 'gog byed ma thub pa 'di mur rdzod yengs shor na mi 'grigs/ khyed rang tsho stong khang nang gi tshong pa yin na'ang 'dra/ de min g.yas g.yon la sdod mkhan mi mang bcas pa tshang mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod rang dbang gi don dag sgrub kyi yod na/ spyi tshogs steng btsun ma yin na'ang 'dra/ dge tshul slong yin na'ang 'dra/ lus la sangs rgyas kyi na bza' gyon te spyode pa ngan pa byed mkhan 'dug na tshang mas khur mnyam len byas nas skabs 'phral 'brel yod la brda sbyor bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ da lta bar du ngas 'bod skul mang po byas yod kyang de dag kha shas kyis ma go ba dang / ma thos pa yin srid/ da dung yang khyad mtshar de 'dra re zung yod pa'i gnas tshul thos kyi /snadug tshang mas khur mnyam len byas na ma gtogs nga 124

mi gcig gis skad brgyab ste nus pa thon gyi mi 'dug grwa sa grwa tshang gi las kyi sne mo ba dang / de min gzhis chags khag sogs bod mi'i spyi tshogs gang du yin yang sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag dang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi bcas la sha tsha chen 11sa 'gan khur blangs te las ngan pa byed mkhan de dag skabs 'phral brda sbyor gyis rang dgar mi 'jog pa'i khur mnyam len byed rgyu gal chen po yin/de nas bod nang du'ang deng sang chos sgo phran bu phye ste grwa btsun gsar pa chos zhugs byed pa de dag kyang mang gnad med/ zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan gcig byung yang mang drags pa dang / spus dag po brgya stong byung yang dgos rgyu yin rung de ltar yong rgyu khag po dang / zhabs 'dren zhu rgyu ni shin tu las sla po yin/ dgon pa bskyar gso byed skabs dang po nas ltod g.yeng ma shor ba byas te thog mar grwa pa bzhi grwa dang / brgyad grwa tsam las ma byung yang de dag spus dag po yong ba byed dgo sa/ rmang gzhi de'i thog kha ston re gnyis brgyab ste rim pas nyi shu sum cu bar 'phar yang spus dag po yong gi red/ dang po brtag dpyad gang yang med par glo bur du grwa chas gyon mkhan gang 'tshams shig rub rub bzos/ mjug tu de'i nang nas zhab sa 'dren zhu mkhan thon te nad 'bu lta bu mched na tshang ma phyir 'bud byas kyang mi 'grigs/ skad cha bshad kyang nyan 'dod la ma 'dod cig chags yong dus yag po rtsa ba nas med/ dang po nas spas dag po yong ba bya rgyu 'di bstan pa chags 'jig gi gnad ngo mar thug yorno/ shes song ngam/ gzab gzab byed dgos/ ngas go thos la deng 125

sang lha sa'i nang zhogs pa grwa chas gyon nas 'don pa bton te zhabs brtan byed kyi yod pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan/ phyi dro ra bzi ste sdod mkhan de 'dra 'dug ces brjod kyi 'dug de ni dpe mi srid pa'i blo pham gyi gnas tshul yin/ mi de rigs rgya mi las sdug gi red/ rgya mi gung khran la chos zhes pa 'di dug la blta ba'i lta ba zhig yod cing / lta ba de'i 'og nas chos la snang chung khyad gsod byed kyi yod/ de ni kho rang tsho'i grub mtha' rang nas byung ba yin/ lus la grwa chas gyon te bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs yin khul byas nas lag len jog bstan pa bshig mkhan zhig byung na de ni gung khran las kyang sdug pas shin tu thabs sdug yin/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul thos dus gang drag bsam te sems nang ma skyid pa yong gi 'dug tshang mas bsam blo gzab gzab btang ste dang po nas spus dag po yong ba bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/spus dag po zhes pa 'di phu thung ma gyon pa tsam la spus dag po brjod mi thub/ spus dag po zhes pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di sems kyi steng nas byed dgos pa da lta gong du brjod pa yin/ sems kyi steng nas byed dgos na sems nang nas byed stangs cha tshang shes dgos/ de shes par byed pa la/ ྅ges bsam 〈(ma gsum ya ma bral ba byas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos/ der brten dgon pa bzhengs pa tsam la cha ma bzhag par dgon pa'i nang bslab pa slob gnyer yod pa zhig dgos/mdor na ngas rgyun du 'grel bshad brgyab pa'i lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang / lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len zhes pa 'di snyan ngag gi tshig 126

brjod pa lta bu ma yin pa tshang mas gang thub lag len du bkal nas dpe khrid dang / slob sbyong byed rgyu yod pa zhig dgos/deng sang bod nang dgon pa gsar pa tshugs pa kha shas la sngar med pa'i sman pa'i slob ga'am/ sman pa grwa tshang tshugs yod pa de rigs shin tu yag po red/ nga tsho'i rig gnas ni nang don rig pa tsam du ma zad/ da dung bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ de min sum rtags dag gsum sogs rnam grangs mang po zhig yod/ de mtshungs deng dus kyi shesaspedan de tsho la'ang dgon pa so sos do khur byas te spyi tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs bsgrub thub pa dgos/ phyogs gcig nas dgon pa'i nang grwa pa spas dag po yod pa zhig dang / phyogs gnyis nas dgon pas sne 'khrid byas dho spyi chogs kyi shes yonasar rgyas dang / 'phrod bstenasar rgyas 'gro thabs la shugs ston byed thub na ha cang yag poyong gi red/ dpe cha blta thub mkhan tsos dpe cha bltas/ dpe cha blta mi thub mkhan tshos rig gnas gzhan dag sbyangs te spyi tshogs la phan thogs yod pa byed dgos/ mdor na/ sangs rgyas kyi na bza' gyon pa gyon go chod pa zhig dang / mi go chod pa zhig bya rgyu gal chen poyin/ de min dgon pa'i nang sgrig zhugs thub tsam zhig dang / grong chog la 'gro thub tsam zhig las/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa'i lta ba dang / spyod pa'i lam gyi 'gro stangs gang yang mi shes shing / bshad rgyu yang med par mgo ma 'tshos kyi ngang nas 'don pa tshig skam po zhig bton nas bsdad na de ni bshu gzhog gi 'tsho bayin/ bshu gzhog ces pa'i tshig 'di rgya 127

mi gung khran gyis gsar pa bzos pa zhig ma red/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon ma nas log 'tsho nos thag bcad de gsungs yod/ bshu gzhog dang log 'tsho gnyis 'dra po yod/ log pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho mi bya/ zhes snga mo nas thag bcad gnangayod/ rab tu byung ba'i gos gyon nas nyams len 'di yin med cing /chos kyi gnas tshulayang mi shes par grong chog kho na bton nas bsdad na de ni log 'tsho yin pas yag po med/ tshe 'dir yang so sor nyams dang rtogs pa mi skye la/ tshe phyi ma rnams su'ang lan chags kyi bu yon du gyur te mtha' ma so so'i lus steng nas 'jal dgos pa'i nyen kha yod/ grong chog la 'don rgyu'i sto ga tsam shes pa las/ bslab pa slob gnyer byed rgyu'i thad 'thus shor phyin pa yin na rtsa ba nas yag po med/ tshang mas 'di gal chen por brtsis nas dgongs pa bzhes dgos/de bzhin du nga rang cho rwa1da pa'i spyi tshogs nang bla ma dang / sprul sku zhes pa zhig yong gi yod la/ deng sang rgya gar dang / bod nang bcas par sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed mkhan mang po yod pa rtsa ba yag po red/ dgon pa so sor sngar dgon pa phyag 'debs mkhan gyi bla ma yin na'ang 'dra/ bar du dgon par bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad de mdzad rjes chen poyod mkhan gyi bla ma yin na'ang 'dra/ bla sprul yod dgos/ 'on kyang ha cang mang drags na de yang bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig yin/ ngas gnas tshul go thos ltar na bla ma sprul sku'i ming yod pa de tsho'i gras la mi mang tshos dad pa byas te 'bul ba phul/ de 'dra'i thog nas bla brang lta bu zur du khang pa mtho po rdzig po de 'dra rgyag gi yod 128

pa 'dis lung gi bstan pa la phan gyi med la/ sgrub pa'i bstan pa la yang phan gyi med/ bla brang deyang ha lam khyim tshang zhig 'dzugs skrun byas pa lta bu chags na yag po rtsa ba nas med/ rim pas spyi tshogs nang mi mang gi shes tshad mtho ru song nas gnas tshul la brtag dpyad byed pa'i khra'i nus pa che ru 'gro skabs skyon brjod chen po byed yul zhig chags rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ rtsa ba nas yag po med/ 'di la yid gzab bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dugade nas mi mang spyi byings ya rabs spyod bzang dang / gzhan phan byams brtse zhes pa 'di gal chen po yin/ de snga bod la ri rgya klung rgya bsdams te skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags kun la gcad pa mi byed pa'i khrims srol bzang po zhig yod/ de ni ha cang yag po yin/ bar lam bod nang mu ge byung skabs so so'i srog 'tsho ba'i don la ri dwags rgyag mkhan phran bu byung yod pa de dag srog 'tsho'i ched du yin na thabs shes bral ba'i gnas tshul yin/ deng sang dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs phran bu bzang du phyin te de 'dra'i dza drag med kyang dngul la rngams te gla rtsi la chags nas gla ba gsod pa dang / khrag rwa la chags nas sha ba gsod pa/ gzhan yang lpags pa dang / spu la chags nas gcan gzan ri dgas gsod pa de tsho'i gras ha cang thabs sdug red/ ngas khor yug srung skyob kyi skor la do snang byas te 'dzam gling jog skad mang po rgyag gi yod/de 'dra'i dus skabs la nga rang tsho so so'i lung pa'i nang bod pa zhig gis rgya mis bslab pa'i srol ngan de spyad de ri dwags gsod pa de tsho'i gras shin tu blo pham gyi gnas tshul yin/ khyed rang tsho'i nang ri dgas rgyag mkhan yod med mi 129

shes/ gal srid yod na sngar 'gyod phyis sdom gyi jog nas phyin chad de ltar byed rgyu med/ gzhan yang khyed rang tshos ngo shes pa gcig la gnyis brgyud kyi thog nas ri dgas rgyag rgyu mi 'dug 7rgyal ba rin po che thugs pham chen po gnang gi 'dug ces shod dgos/ de bzhin rgya gar nang du'ang de 'dra re zung yong srid/ rgya gar gyi tshags par nang thon gsal byas na bod pa re zung gis khrims 'gal gyi thog nas stag gi rus pa nyo tshong byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul thos kyi 'dug nga'i ngo shes grogs po rgya gar ba kha shas kyis de stor 'gan chen po byas te nga la brjod kyi 'dug ngas kyang khong tshor gsal po brjod pa yin/las ka de rigs la bod pa mang che ba the gtogs dang 'brel ba gang yangayod pa ma red/ re zung nas de 'dra byas yod srid/ de tsho'i gras la skabs 'phral yul khrims gzhir bzhag khrims thog nas rnag jog gtsags 'khel gyi nyes pa gang zhig 'gol dgos kyang lag bstar byed dgos/ nga chos bshad par mang che bas nyan gyi yod kyang re zung nas nyan gyi med/ de dag la bya thabs gzhan med/ 'bod skul byas kyang phan gyi mi 'dug khrims lugs gzhir bzung gi nyes chad yan por ma song ba bcad na yag po red ces brjod pa yin/ nga tsho bod mir gzhung bzang gi tshad 'dzin sa la brtsiba'i ming mthong bzang poyod pa 'di mi ngan re zung gi byed stangs kyis rkyen pas brlag rgyu'i nyen kha 'dugadangos gnas bod mi sa ya drug da lta chags 'jig gi mtshams la slebs pa'i skabs 'dir mi rigs kyi mtshan shas bzos na thabs sdug ma yin nam/ nga chos bod spyi don la 'a 'ub ma 'dus bzhin du dka' ngal 'di 'dra zhig brgyab 130

ste phyogs gang sar 'gyel sa nas langs thub pa'i thabs shes byed kyi yod/ thod nang nas mi mang pos srog 'ben la btsugs te lus srog blos btang gis spyi don la dka' las brgyab nas mi mang po shi rmas yong dang yong bzhin pa yin/'di 'dra'i dus skabs la mi re zung rgyu la brngams nas gang byung gis las ka byas na shin tu thabs sdug yin pas de 'dra byed rgyu med/ las rgyu 'bras la'ang 'gro gi ma red/ nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang de 'dra byed mkhan dngos su ra sprod gsal po yod na de rigs ther 'don byed dgos/ thabs shes gzhan med kyang spyi tshogs nang 'phya smod kyis gdong pa bstan ma nus pa bzo rgyu gal chen po yin/de bzhin sku tshong rgyag mkhan de tsho yang thabs sdug yin/ bal yul nang sku tshong rgyag mkhan de 'dra yod pa thos kyi 'dug rgya gar nang de 'dra yod med mi shes/ lhag don deng sang bod nang sku tshong rgyag mkhan yod par ma zad/ dgon sde rnying khungs kyi sku rten rnying pa rku ma rku bar gtong mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs kyang yod pa'i skad cha 'dug de ni bod pa'i bsod nams zad kyi yod pa'i rtags yin/ ha cang thabs sdug gi las ka 'di 'dra byas na yag po rtsa ba nas med/ ngas byas yud bshad pa gang yang min kyang / phal cher bod mi sa ya drug yongs rdzogs zhes brjod chog pa tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don la rig pa bsgrims te shugs rgyag pa'i skabs la bsam blo ma 'khor ba re zung gis bod pa'i la rgya rtsa ba nas blos btang gis mtshan shas bzo ba 'di shin tu thabs sdug yin/ nga tshos rnam kun bdud ces brjod pa ltar mi de rigs phal cher dngos 131

gnas bdud chags kyi yod/ 'on kyang nga tshos de dag snying rjes btang ste yal bar dor na ga la 'grigs/ khong tsho yang rang nyid skyid pa zhig 'dod kyi yod/'on kyang tshe 'di la lta rgyu med la/ tshe phyi mar yang lta rgyu med pa'i las ngan gsog gi yod pa de ni snying rje'i yul yin/ de tsho'i gras la gzab gzab byas na ma gtogs deng sang skad cha ngan pa de rigs phran bu mang du 'gro gi 'dugatshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos/bod nang dgon pa khag gis khur blangs nas dgon pa'i nye 'dabs sam /yang na grong khul la slob grwa dang / sman khang 'dzugs thub na dngos gnas phan thogs chen po yod/ dper na/ nyi hong gi dgon pa mang pos khur blangs nas dgon pa dang 'brel nas slob grwa dang / sman khang btsugs pa mang po 'dugalhag par ye shu'i chos lugs la cha bzhag na ye shu'i chos pa tshos spyi tshogs kyi 'phrod bsten dang / slob sbyong thad las ka rlabs chen byed kyi 'dug de la nga tshos mig dpe blta dgos/ de snga ngas lo sum cu'i gong nas 'bod skul byas yod la tshang mas de'i thog do snang byed dgos/bod nang sgor pa re zung gis slob grwa dang / sman khang btsugs pa'i gnas tshul 'dug de la rjes su yi rangs dang bsngags brjod yod/ de bzhin phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod pa'i khyim tshang gnas stangs cung bzang ba de 'dras dang du blangs nas bod nang slob grwa dang / sman khang 'dzugs rgyu'i thabs shes byed kyi 'dug la/ kha shas kyis lha sa'i nye sgor dang / smad phyogs kyi sa cha kha shas la dngos su btsugs 'dug de tshor gong bzhin rjes su yi rangs dang bsngags 132

brjod yod/ da dung btsan byol la yod pa'i bod pa tsho'i thog nas bod rang gi shes yon slob sbyong dang / 'phrod bsten gyi thog la phan thogs byed thub na dngos gnas bod spyi pa'i don la kha yod lag yod dang / nad thog sman 'khel gyi phan thogs chen 11 yong rgyu yin pas tshang mas mu mthud khur mnyam len bya rgyu gal chen po yin/bod nas yong mkhan kha shas kyis rgya gar la 7rgyal ba rin po che ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi 'dug ces brjod kyi yod/ mthong tshul de ni gcig nas gnas tshul cha tshang ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis byung ba zhig dang / gnyis nas nyen kha'i gnas tshul zhig kyang yin/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas 'dir btsan byol gyi srid gzhung zhig tshugs yod/ srid gzhung 'dis 'go khrid pa'i 'og nas 'das pa'i lo sum cu so bzhi lhag tsam ring las ka mang po zhig byas yod/ thog mar nga tshor kha phor tsam yang 'khyer rgyu med pa'i mi mang po zhig mi sa ma ri dang / sbag sa la btsan byol du 'byor ba'i dus de nas bzung da lta bar las ka mang po zhig byas yod/ gtso che shos rgya gar gzhung gi rogs ram dang / de bzhin rgyal spyi'i tshogs pa 'dra min gyis rogs ram byas yod/'on kyang sgrig 'dzugs shig gi 'go khrid nas las ka hur thag byed mkhan zhig ma byung na dngul byung ba tsam gyis nus pa thon thub kyi med/ dper na/ 'dzam gling thog byung ba'i btsan byol ba mang po zhig chu bye ma'i nang thim pa ltar mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa chags yod/ nga rang tshor mtshon na de snga bod par rogs ram byed mkhan gyi tshogs pa khag gi mi bod pa rgyus mnga' yod pa de tsho'i gras 133

deng sang lo na rgas te rgas yol du phyin pa de tsho nga tsho dang thug skabs bod pa ra bstod bsngags chen po gtong gi 'dug khong tshos bod pa btsan byol bar rogs ram byas pa de dag bar ma dor chud zos su ma song bar bstan rgyu yod pa zhig 'dug ces dang / 'dzam gling thog btsan byol ba sa ya mang po yod pa'i nang nas bod pa btsan byol ba las lhag pa mi 'dug ces bstod bsngags gtong gi 'dug rgya gar gzhung dang rogs ram tshogs pa khag gis thad kur bod pa mi re ngo re'i lag par sgor brgya stong khri phrag sprad kyang gzhis chags tshugs thub pa zhig min/ nga tshos 'dir gzhis chags nas btsan byol bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig btsugs pa 'dis 'char gzhi bkod de gzhis chags byed thub pa byung ba ma zad/ stob grwa khag dang / de bzhin bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i las rigs mang po zhig bsgrub yod/ de bzhin 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab mang po zhig nang bod pa'i gnas tshul dril bsgrags dang 'bod skul byas pa dang / 'dzam gling mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs la bod don zhu gtugs byed rgyus mtshon pa'i las ka mang spro zhig bsgrubs yod/gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs la sman pa'i mkhrims kyi 'char zin 'god rgyus mtshon pa'i las khungs khag ma nga po zhig btsugs yod pa dang / mang gacha'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi ngo rwasga mtshan nyidayongs su tshang ba yong ched las ka mang po zhig byas dang byed bzhin yod pa bcas de dag tshang ma gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs/ nga mi gcig gis mi brgya nyis brgya la dngul sprad na sa khyed rang 'di gyis/ khyed rang der rgyugs zhes bkod 134

pa btang nas byung ba min la/ yong yang mi thub/ da lta bar du lo sum cu so lngar nye ba'i ring 'dir bod mi btsan byol ba rnams gong bu gcig sgril du gnas yod/ de la brten nas dper na/ bod pa'i khyim tshang sud si dang /a ri/ khe ṇa ḍa sogs 'dzam gling gi sa cha gang zhig tu gnas yod kyang dus dus la gung seng yong sa zhig dang / phyag mchod 'bul byed sa zhig phru gu slob grwar gtong sa zhig bcas byung ba dang / ma zad rang gzhung zhes kha nas brjod rgyu yod pa chags pa 'di rgya gar nang btsan byol srid gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'di yod pa la brten nas byung ba yin/ don ngo ma'i thog btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'dis phan thogs chen po byung yod/ khyed rang tsho bsam blo zhig thongs dang / phar phyogs rgya mis 7rgyal ba rin po che dang 'brel ba byed kyi yin/ btsan byol gzhung ngos len med ces zer ba de rgya mis gnad 'gag cig brtsis nas bshad pa ma yin nam/ rgya mis gnad 'gag brtsi sa de la nga rang tsho'i kha nas 7rgyal ba rin po che ma gtogs bod gzhung la lta khungs mi 'dug ces brjod na rgya mir dgos rgyu de byung ba yin pas skad cha 'di 'dra bshad mkhan de lkug pa re da/ deng sang rgya gar gyi grogs po mang pos btsan byol gzhung ngos len spud dgos zhes shod kyi yod/ mi gzhan chos btsan byol gzhung ngos len byed dgos zhes shod pa'i skabs la nga rang tsho bod pa zhig gis btsan byol gzhung la lta khungs mi 'dug brjod na de ni so so'i mgo la so sos rdo gzhus pa ltar lkug rtags kyi las ka yin/ mi re zung gis rnam dpyod yin khul byas te de 'dra brjod kyi yod kyang rdo don nga rgyal dang 135

phrag dog yang na srog rlung 'phar ba'i dbang du song ba yin pas skad cha ya mtshan 'di 'dra brjod na rtsa ba nas yag po mi 'dug dper na/ nga rang tshos rang dbang rtsod kyi yod/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab rgya mis btsan zos byas byung zhes brjod kyi yod/ rgya mis btsan zos byas pa'i 'og nas rang dbang len dgos dus 'di gar yod pa'i btsan byol bod gzhung 'di shin tu gal chen po chags yod/ bod la rgya mis bkod sgrig byas pa'i rang skyong ljongs zer ba des bod gzhung gi tshab nam yang byed mi thub/ bod gzhung ngo ma ni btsan byol gzhung 'di yin/ 1959 lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang zer bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung med pa bzos pa yin zhes gros chod bzhag ste bka' rgya bkrams yod kyang / bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang ni 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos btsugs pa zhig yin pa las rgya nag gzhung gis btsugs pa zhig min/ rgya nag gzhung gis btsugs pa zhig min dus rgya nag gzhung la de dag med pa bzo ba'i dbang cha rtsa ba nas med/ dbang cha med bzhin du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang zer bas gros chod bzhag ste thag gcod gang zhig byas kyang de la nus pa med/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches 'go 'khrid pa'i bod gzhung ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la tshugs te da bar lo sum cu so bzhi lhag tsam song zhing / de'i ring gi las don la grub 'bras ji byung tshang ma'i mig gis mthong rgyu yod/ de ltar yod bzhin pa'i skabs la 7rgyal ba rin po che ma gtogs gzhan mdzub mo 'dzugs sa dang / re ba rgyag sa gang yang mi 'dug ces brjod na de ni phyogs gcig nas mgo ma 'tshos pa'i skad cha red la/ phyogs gnyis nas skyon chen po yod pa'i skad cha 136

zhig red/ tshang mas bsam blo gzab gzab gtong dgos/nga tsho'i gzhung gi las byed par cha bzhag na mang che ba dngos gnas hur thag byed mkhan yin/ 'on kyang re zung gis sgrig 'dzugs 'di stong ra lta bur yos te khyug tsam rjod ring slob sbyong dang las ga'i nyams myong bsags/ 'phur sa zhig byung na 'phur chog chog byas te sdod mkhan yod/ de ni nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo red/ las byed pa ni mi mang la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan zhig yin/ nga tshos mi mang la zhabs 'degs zhu gi yod ces pa 'di rgya mi gung khran gyis bshad pa dang mi 'dra/ nga tsho'i skad cha 'di kha zhe gnyis med yin/ btsan bka' btang ste skul 'ded byed mkhan med/ mang gtso dang / rang dbang la yid ches brgya cha brgya byas te las ka byed kyi yod/ lta ba 'di khyer nas las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa las/ rgya mi gung khran gyi gcig sdud lam lugs lta bu rtsa ba nas min/ der brten nga tsho'i las byed pa'i ngos nas zhabs 'degs zhu yul gyi mi mang de dag gtsug tu bkur dgos pa ma gtogs/ las byed pa yin zhes gong du bsdad nas 'gyings nyams bstan pa dang / krog krog byed pa ni nor 'khrul yin/ lhag don rgyu brngan sprod len byed mkhan re zung yod srid kyang / sgor mo stong phrag yas mas tsam las thal cha chen po sprod len byed mkhan phal cher med/ ngos nas mi mang tsho ra bod gzhung la brtsi bkur byed dgos/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gal chen po red brjod pa dang chabs cig las byed pa tshor brjod rgyur nga tshos btsan po'i thog nas bod gzhung la brtsi dgos zhes brjod mi thub cing / mi'i mdun la rin thang mthong rgyu yod pa zhig 137

nga rang tshos bzo dgos/ da lta brjod pa bzhin grub 'bras gang 'tshams thon yod/ de dag rmang gzhir bzhag nas da dung nga rang tshos 'dzam gling gi mi gral la tshud pa'i yar rgyas gtong rgyur 'bad brtson mu mthud bya rgyu 'di tshang mas ltod g.yeng du ma song ba bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ da lta phan yang rgyu mtshan mthong nas 'on de dag ring btsan byol gzhung gis dngos gnas las ka byas 'dug ces phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig gis brjod kyi 'dug khong tsho dha ram sa lar yong nas 'di gar yod pa'i las khungs khag dang / spyi 'thus/ lhan khang sogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs rnams mig gis mthong nas gnas tshul cha tshang thos skabs tshang mas kha gcig grags kyis 11da pas las ka shin tu chen 11 byas 'dug ces brjod kyi 'dug nga rang tshor byas rjes med pa min/ byas rjes tan tan yod/ 'on kyang byas rjes yod ces lhod g.yeng spyid lug gi lam la phyin pa yin na nyen kha shin tu chen po yin/ nga rang tsho btsan byol bod gzhung gi las kyi sne mo ba tshang ma'i ngos nas mang gtso rang dbang dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod rang dbang sgrub rgyu 'di 'tshe med zhi ba'i bsti gnas rang dbang ldan pa'i lung pa mi smon rang skyid/ 'di phyi gnyis yod cig yong ba'i dmigs yul dang / lta ba 'di 'khyer nas tshang mas gzab gzab dang / hur thag byed dgos/ mi mang gi khrod nas kyang 7rgyal ba rin po che ma gtogs gzhan gang la'ang blta bzo mi 'dug brjod pa 'di mi dgos pa zhig dang / byab chung gi skad cha rang gis rang la byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'i dpe ltar yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod rang 138

dbang sgrub phyogs skor da lta bshad pa 'di dag tshang mas lag len jog bkal nas bya ba phyogs gang sar thi gu sne shor du ma song ba'i hur thag byed dgos pa las/ so so'i ngos nas 'gan khur gang yang len mi dgos par bod rang dbang gi bde skyid kyi nyi ma 'char gyi red ces sgug bsdad na mi 'grigs pas tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ de nas sngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar/ /rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin de ring skyes rabs kyi gsung chos 'phro skyong gnang rgyu yi na zhe sa jigs bshad gnang mjugade ring 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung zhig bton na snyam byung / gang yin zhe na/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid sku bltams zin pa nges can yin/ 'on kyang da lta yang srid ngos 'dzin yongs bsgrags byed thub pa byung med/ bar lam bkra shis lhun po'i bya bral rin 11 ches rgya nag gzhung brgyud de nga la tshur yi ge zhig 'byor byung / de 'phral rgya nag gi gzhung tshab brgyud paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid skor go bsdur gnang bar bya bral rin po che dang 'brel yod mi sna bcas 'di khyodags khyugatsam phebs thub na yag thoge 'dug ces snga lo zla ba brgyad pa dgu pa tsam zhig la yig lan btang ba yin/da lta tshur yig lan gang yang 'byor ma byung / da gang 'dra zhig byed grabs yod dam/ nga'i re ba byas pa yin na/ paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid 'di gal chen po yin/ rgya mis de srid don rkyang pa la mthong gi mongad kyang / nga tsho'i ngos nas de ltar min/ de ni bstan pa spyi dang / yang sgos bod kha ba gangs 139

can jongs kyi bstan pa la gnad 'gag cig chags yod/ dper na/ nga'i ngos nas bshad na/ da cha lo drug cu'i nang slebs 'gro gi yod/ ma gzhi da dung lo sum cu bzhi bcu zhig sdod rgyu'i sems shugs bskyed de smon lam rgyag gi yod/ ngos rang da dung lo sum cu bzhi bcu zhig bsdad pa yin na lo dgu bcu nas brgya yas mas kyi mtshams la slebs kyi sku(da/ de nas 'chi rgyu las sdod thub thabs med/ lo brgyad cu dgu bcu zhig bsdad pa yin na shin tu yag po yin/ tshe tshad byas na lo brgya dang bcu gsum tsam med dam snyam pa cadan ma rmi lam nang mtshan ma byung yang rmi lam la cha bzhag de tsam med/ gang ltar lo brgya skor zhig bsdad kyang nam zhig 'chi rgyu yin/ da lta paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid phebs yong mkhan 'di nga lo brgyad cu dgu bcu'i nang slebs dus 'di dgung lo sum cu bzhi bcu'i nang phebs kyi yod pas gnad 'gag shin tu chen po chags kyi 'dug ma gzhi ngas 7rgyal ba rin po che zhes 7rgyal ba'i mtshan mthong dang 'brel ba'i 'gro stangs 'di gal chen por brtsi gi med/ de gnas kyi yod na'ang 'dra/ gnas kyi med na'ang 'dra de ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ de sngon dus skabs gcig la 7rgyal ba rin po che'i bla brang dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa 'di byung ba red/ nam zhig de dgos mkho med pa'i mtshams la 'jig rgyu yin pa 'di ni chos nyid yin/ gang gal chen po yin zhe na/ bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i rang dbang 'di gal chen po yin/ de ni ji srid bod mi rigs gnas kyi bar de srid du gnas dgos la/gnas kyang thub pa zhig yin/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i bla brang dga' ldan pho brang 140

zhes pa 'di bar skabs shig nas byung ste mi lo sum brgya lhag tsam ring gnas yod/ ma 'ongs par de gnas dang mi gnas bod mi mang gi thag gcod bya rgyu las ngas de la 'gan brtsi dgos don med/ spyir btang 'gro stangasanas byas na da lta'i paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid phebs mkhan 'di dus tshod gal chen po zhig gi thog slebs kyi skusted/ phru gu gang byung zhig bdag po rgyag rgyu las sla po yin kyang / de 'dra ma yin pa dngos gnas ma nor ba zhig 'tshol dbotos/de yang sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa yong srid/ skabs re sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa zhes pa 'di lag pa 'phyis sa lta bu chags grabs byed kyi 'dug sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa yong srid/ de'i nang nas dngos gnas 7rgyal ba rin po che rgos dus rogs lta bu byed mkhan yag po+o zhig dgos pa yin/ nga rang sgor gyi la rgyus thag nas bshad na sku mdun sku gang ma sku myang ngan las 'das nasayang srid rtsad gcod byed skabs gtso bo lha mo'i bla mtsho dang / de 'dra'i thog nas mdo smad byang shar khul la yang srid rtsad gcod byed par 'gro mkhan ke'u tshang rin po ches gasdongs pa'i ga zhung zhabs kha shas gtan 'khel te khong tshos paṇa chen sku gong ma'i bokheng ma thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mjal ba'i skabs la paṇa chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas thugs khur ha cang chen po bzhes nas sku 'bum gyi nye 'khris stag 'tsher la yod pa'i phru gu de la phal cher dwogs pa byed dgos med/ 'os shos yin zhes bka' gnang yod/ gang ltar ngas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i khri 'di'i steng la bsdad nas 'jon yod rung med rung / nga khri 'di'i steng slebs pa 'di paṇa chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang 'brel ba zhig chags skusgod/ yang sgos 141

lhag par can du paṇa chen zhing gshegs chos kyi rgyal mtshan khong ni dngos gnas bod mi rigs kyi dpa' bo zhig yin/ paṇa chen rin po che zhal bzhugs skabs bod rang btsan gyi skor la rgya mi'i spu phyogs ded nas bka' mol ma gsung rang gsung byung ba de'i rkyen gyis mi kha shas kyis paṇa chen rin po cher tshong pa rgyag pa zhes zhu mkhan byung yod/ paṇa chen rin po che bzhugs dus ngas phyi log nas skad brgyab/ paṇa chen rin po ches bod nang nas snying stobs chen pos skad bskyon gyi yod/ paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs pa des deng sang tshang mar lag /gas rgyag gi 'dug dper na/ bod kyi skad yig gi don du thugs khur shin tu chen po bzhes yod pa dang / de bzhin yar 'brog g.yu mtshor glog khang bskrun rgyu de khor yug la nyen kha yod pa mi mang po zhig gis brjod kyi yod/paṇa chen rin po che zhal bzhug skabs khong dang nga phod khong tshos 'gog thabs gnang yod/ paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs rjes de la gdong len byed mkhan byung med/ de dang 'dra ba mdo stod smad kyi sa khul mang por bstan dgon nyams gso byed rgyu dang / mi rigs kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang / lag len byed rgyus mtshon pa'i gnad don gal che mang po zhig la thugs khur bzhes te skabs gcig ring yag po byung yod/ gang ltar paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid de 'khrul pa med pa/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / yang sgos bod khe ba gangs can gyi rgyal bstan la dus dang 'tshams pa'i bstan pa'i khur bzhes thub pa zhig dgos pas de dag bar chad kyi rkyen dbang du mi 'gro ba dang / bstan par phan thogs nges shig yong bar tshang mas thugs smon yag po gnang dgos/142

ngosanas kyang de ring paṇa chen rin po che'iyang srid kyi don la dmigs te 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung 'don gyi yin zhes gsung nas ljags lung bka' drin stsal/ mjug tu paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid bar chad kyi dbang du ma song bar 'khrul bral nges rnyed yong ched mtshan brjod kyi lung phul zin pa yin na tshang mas smon lam yag po rgyag dgos la/ rnam kun 'char can byas nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod phran bu gsog thub na yag po yod ces dang /de ring nas log 'gro mkhan kha shas yod cing / nyin shas sdod mkhan tshor gsum bcu'i dus dran skabs gzhung 'brel gsung bshad thog nas 'grel bshad bya rgyu yong gi red/ de ring log 'gro mkhan tshor ngos nas gsal bshad phran bu byas na snyam byung / bar lam nga tsho dang rgya nag gzhung dbar thad kur 'brel ba byung nas lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam song / de'i ring nga tsho'i ngos nas thabs shes byed stangs 'di la dbu ma'i lam zhes brjod kyi yod/ rtsa ba bod rgya gnyis tha dad red/ de yang de snga bod kyi chos rgyal tsho'i skabs smos ci/ de rjes 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dus sog po dang 'brel ba byung ba yang mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yin pa shin tu gsal po yod/ man ju'i skabs kyang mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yin pa gsal thag chod yod/ bod 'di rang btsan gtsang ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan nga tshos ham bshad dang / bsam btang dran skyes kyi skad cha ma yin par dngos gnas drang po drang bzhag gi thog nas bshad rgyu yod/ rgya mis bcings bkrol zhes pa'i ming gi 'og nas bod btsan zos byas 143

te lam bzo dang / 'dzugs skrun phran bu byas lho pa de dag bod la gtor bshig btang ba dang / nga tshos sdug bsngal myangs pa de gnyis yang lci bsdur ba yin na do thabs med pa zhig yin pa paṇa chen rin po ches dgongs pa rdzogs khar gsal po gsungs yod/ nga rang tshor lo rgyus thos nas rang btsan gtsang ma'i thob thang yod/ de ni dngos yod gnas tshul brjod rgyu yod pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang da lta'i gnas stangs ni bod mi rigs chags 'jig gi mtshams la slebs pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig yin dus/ sngon la rgya mi rang la mes 'tshig mer gtugs kyis thod skyome thabs bya rgyu 'di dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig tu mthong ste da lta bar du thabs shes byas pa yin/ rgya mi rang la mes 'tshig mer gtugs kyi bod skyob thabs byed dgos na nga tshos rgya mi'i khe phan la'ang gu bshangs byed dgos pa dang / rgya mi'i ngos nas kyang nga tsho rwa1da pa'i khe phan la bsam blo gtong dgos/ phan tshun gnyis phyogs nas khe phan la bsam blo btang ste gnyis mos yod pa zhig gi thog nas gros mol dang / gros mthun yag po yong ba'i don du ngos nas dbu ma'i lam zhes mtha' gnyis su ma lhung pa'i thabs shes 'di byas pa yin/ rgya mi'i khe phan la nga tsho'i ngos nas gu bshangs byed rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad byas pa yin/ gu bshangs byas pa'i rtsa don kha shas kyi thog la nga tsho bod pa'i nang nas der blo pham dang / de dag thal drags 'dug ces brjod mkhan mang po byung / yin na yang sngon la dza drag gi gnas stangs 'di nas skyob thabs bya rgyu gal chen po yin dus gong du brjod pa ltar thabs shes gang yong byas pa yin/ ngos kyi thabs shes dang langs phyogs 'di la 'dzam 144

gling thog nas de ni dngos yod gnas tshul dang 'tshams shing / bsam blo gu yangs btang 'dug ces bsngags brjod dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang po byung /'on kyang thabs skyo ba zhig la/ nga tsho'i ngos nas gu bshangs kyi bsam blo ji tsam btang yang des rgya nag gzhung blo ma tshim par chog shes med pa'i thog nas da dung mu mthud tam bshad byed pa dang / gal che shos bod nang gi dza drag gnas tshul rnams je sdug tu 'gro ba las 'gyur ba bzang po gangayang byung med/ mdor na/ bod nang khor yug nyams nyes dang / chos dang rig gzhung nyams nyes gtong ba/ grong dang grong khyer che sa rgya mi sdod thub pa'i cha rkyen ldan zhing sa bab legs pa'i sa cha gang sar rgya mis khengs te 11da kyi sa khul mang po zhig rgya grong chags nas bod yul rgya yul la sgyur ba'i nyen kha bdun phrag re re bzhin tshabs che ru 'gro bzhin pa'i gnas tshul mu mthud de gnas yod pa 'di ni dza drag can zhig yin/bar lam 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul la 'gyur ba mang po phyin yod kyang /da phan lo bcu bzhi'i ring ngos nas langs phyogs de 'dra zhig bzung ste rgya mi rang la gtugs kyang don phan ldan pa'i go bsdur zhig byed thub med la/ bod nang gnas tshul bzang du 'gro rgyur yang phan thogs byung med pa bcas don snying grub 'bras gang yang thon med/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling spyi yongs nas nga tsho bod par sha tsha dang / rgyab skyor yod bzhin pa'i thog gros tshogs khag mang po zhig dang / lhag par gzhung mang po zhig gis kyang da lta'i ngos kyi langs phyogs 'di'i thog la rgyab skyor byed bde po chags te rgyab skyor gang mtshams thobayod/ 'dzam 145

gling thog nga tsho ༷da pa'i ngos nas thabs shes ma lan ma 'khyod pa sgo gang sa nas byas pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal po thon yod/ 'on kyang des da lta rgya nag gzhung la g.yo 'gul thebs med par brten/ nga rang tsho'i spyi 'thus gros tshogs nas rgya mis tshur 'brel ba byas na ma gtogs phar 'brel ba byed rgyu med pa'i gros chod bzhag yod/ da cha gnas tshul de dag la gzhigs pa'i bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong dgos pa chags kyi 'dug bar skabs bod pa'i thog rgyal spyi'i tshogs pa khag dang / srid gzhung / de bzhin mi sger bcas do snang byed mkhan mang du phyin yod/ de dag gis rgya nag gzhung la 'bod skul dang / gnon shugs sprad pa'i 'og nas go skabs gsar pa zhig 'char na bsam blo gtong rgyu yod/ de 'dra yong min gnas tshul gsal po zhig da lta ngas brjod mi thub kyang da dung go skabs shig yod/ de min mtha' ma'i thabs shes byed phyogs ni 'das pa'i lo sum cu so grangs ring ngos nas yang yang brjod zin pa ltar mtha' ma'i thag gcod gang 'dra zhig byed min bod mi mang gi lag tu yod pas mi mang la thag gcod byed du 'jug rgyu 'di yin/ mdor na/ ngos nas phyi lo 1988lor yo rob gros tshogs la bton pa'i gros 'char nang du'ang gnad don de gsal thag chod bkod yod/ da cha gang 'dra byed dgos min bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam 'char bsdu dgos pa'i dus la slebs pa lta bu mthong gi 'dugabatsan byol ba chig 'bum gsum khri lhag tsam yod pa dang / bod nang yongs grags byas te bsam 'char bsdu thabs med kyang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi ngo bo mtshon thub pa'i mi sna khag gcig gi bsam 'char bsdu thub/ gal te 146

bsam 'char bsdu len byed dgos pa'i dus la slebs na mi mang tsho'i ngos nas nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i thob thang dang gcig da lta'i dngos yod kyi dza drag gnas tshul dang gnyis/ 'dzam gling gi 'gyur 'gros dang gsum/ rgya nag nang gi 'gyur ba dang bzhi bcas tshang mar brtag zhib gzab nan byas te nga tsho'i byed phyogs dang / langs phyogs ji 'gab bsam blo gtong dgos/ dus tshod zla ba gcig gnyis nang brel 'tshab byed dgos don me da/ dus yun zla ba kha shas ring tshang mas spyi pa'i don dag la byed phyogs gang dga' ci legs kyi bsam blo btang nas bsam 'char 'don rgyu gal chen po chags yod/ ma gzhi 'di skor gzhung 'grel gyi yongs bsgrags gsum bcu'i dus dran skabs brjod rgyu yin/ da lta dus mtshams 'di 'dra zhig la slebs yod/ da lta bshad ma thag pa bzhin rgya mis nga tshor thub tshod dang / dbang shed 'di lta bu byed stangs la bltas na da lta re ba de tsam med pa lta bu yang / rtsa ba nga tsho bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di re ba med pa zhig gtan nas min/ gong du brjod pa bzhin rgya nag gi da lta'i gcig sdud dbang shed kyi lam lugs 'di la rgya mi rigs rang khongs nas 'dod mos byed kyi med pa'i gnas tshul gsal po yod/ der brten lo kha shas nang rgya nag la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu yin pa'i mthong tshul bod nas skurdzong mkhan mang po zhig gis brjod kyi 'dug de bzhi na phyi rgyal la yod pa'i rgya mi'i nang du'ang thong tshul 'di yod pa mang po 'dug lhag par rgya nag gi gnas tshul nyams zhib byed mkhan mkhas pa phal mo che'i ngos 'dzin gong gsal dang lta tshul gcig gyur 'dug nga'i ngos nas bltas na'ang lo kha shas nang 'gyur 147

ba zhig phyin mi yong ngam snyam par brten nga rang tsho sems shugs chag dgos pa dang / re thag chad dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig rtsa ba nas med/ 'on kyang da bar nga tsho lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam ring thabs shes byas pa 'di la da lta'i rgya nag srid gzhung gi ngos nas grub 'bras son dang ma son byas na phal cher grub 'bras mi son rgyu thag nye ba lta bu yin/ da phan lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam ring nga tshos sgug pa ltar/ da dung sgug nas bsdad na dgos pa che ba med pa dang / bod nang du'ang mi re zung phran bu'i sems shugs chag pa'i rkyen chags kyi med dam bsam pa'i mthong tshul yong gi 'dug der brten da cha nga tsho byed phyogs gsar pa gang 'dra zhig byed 'gab mang tshogs rang gi bsam 'char bsdus nas thag gcod byas na bsam pa yod/ de ring sang nyin log 'gro mkhan yod na khyed rang tshos ngas bshad pa rnams sems la nges pa byed dgos/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ nyin shas sdod mkhan tshor sang nyin nas bdun phrag gnyis tsam ring chos 'brel yod pas skad cha zhib phra yong gi red/ khyed rang tsho log 'gro mkhan tshor ngas gong du chos phyogs dang / bod mi rigs spyi'i rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod byed phyogs sogs rtsa don 'ga' zhig bshad pa rnams tshang mas sems la bcangs nas ma brjed pa byas te khur bskyed hur thag byed dgos/nga tsho ༄1da pa'i grogs po phyi rgyal gyi mi gang 'tshams da nyin 'dir slebs pa rnamasanas da lta ngas gong du 'grel bshad rgyab pa de dag thos yod cing / khyed rang tsho'i nang rigs gcig gis bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang dang /gnyis nas thod pas rang dbang rtsod len byedapa 'di dngos gnas bden pa lko 14 8

pa zhig dang / rgya mis ham pa bshad de bod par thub tshod btang ba 'di gsal po mthong nas mi dang mi'i brtse ba'i thog nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang po yod la/ yang rigs gcig ni bod pas rang dbang rtsod len byed pa 'di 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam gyi thog 'gro gi yod dus de la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byas nas rgyab/ skyor byed mkhan de 'dra yang yod/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas da bar bod par rgyab skyor byas pa des rgya mi'i mdun la bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi do snang chen po yod pa zhig chags pa dang / de bzhin 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i thog rgya nag gis 'dra chags po byed pa'i skabs la bod pa'i gnas tshul gleng slong gis bsun po bzos te khong tshos dogs zon byed dgos pa zhig chags te dngos gnas phan thogs chen po byung / da dung yang sngar bzhin sha tsho'i rgyab skyor dang / phyogs gang sa nas rogs ram bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ tshang mar thugs rje che dang / bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bka' 4skor/// // 149

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1994 lo'i zla ba 3 tshes 14 nyin theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du sgrol dkar tshe dbang bka' drin che skabs bka' slob stsal ba/da ring lo 'di'i 'char can smon lam gyi dus chen dang 'brel nas dpyid chos legs par zin pa red/ da lam 'go 'dzugs rgyu'i dngos gzhi'i gzhung 'jam dpal zhal lung de 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa yin/ tshes bcu'i nyin mo thun drug kun btus de yang 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dag snang red/ da ring mjug tu dge ba sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbar phul rgyu 'di yang 7gong sa lnga pa chen wa'i dag snang gi chos skor yin/ dus phyis bod gangs can ljongs kyi dbus gtsang khul gyi bla ma snyan grags yod mkhan gtso che ba'i bla ma rnam pa gnyis dang /lhag par 7gong sa lnga pa chen po/ nga rang cho rwabad gangs can par dmigs bsal gyi bka' drin chen po yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang ngos nas cha bzhag na'ang skal pa bzang po byung / chos nyan mkhan khyed rang tsho yin na'ang de de bzhin mang che ba dga' po yong gi red/ da ring 'dir gdul bya'i gtso bo 'am/dmigs bya'i gtso bo de khyed rang tsho bod nas gnyen 'phrad du 'byor bsdad pa rnams yin/ gang yin zer na/ nga rang tsho rgya gar la yod mkhan tsho yang nas yang du thug 'phrad kyi dus chod yong gi yod/ khyed rang tsho bod nas tshur dka' las rgyab nas yong mkhan tsho yang yang thug 'phrad bya rgyu'i dus tshod yong gi med/twe/ da rnams thug 'phrad kyi go skabs nyung nyung yin/ da lam khyed rang tsho rgya gar du 'byor ba'i skabs 'dir/ nyin shas ring chos nyan rgyu dang / mchod mjal 150

byed rgyu byung pas khyed rang tsho dga' po yong gi red la/ nga rang gi ngos nas kyang gtso bo khyed rang tsho la dmigs pa yin/ da res ha lam bdun phrag gnyis tsam ring la nga rang tsho nyin ltar thug skad cha 'dra bshad byas pa 'dis khyed rang tshos chos kyi gnas tshul phran bu phran bu shes te phan thogs 'dra byung yod 'gro/ ma gzhi nga rang gis kyang ji bzhin shes kyi mi 'dug ma shes pa gcig gis bshad pa 'dis rgya chen po ma phan yang phran bu phran bu phan gyi spongad shas che/de dang chabs cig nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag gi gnas tshul gang 'dra yin pa dang / bsam blo gang 'dra btang dgos kyi yod pa/ nga rang tshos gang byed dgos kyi yod pa/ de tsho'i gras kyang zhar dang zhor la skad cha byung yod/ da cha khyed rang tsho phar rang yul la log 'gro mkhan yin dus khyed rang tsho tshang ma blo bde po dang / sems skyid po byed dgos/ tshang mas sems khur chen po zhig blangs nas bsdad yod pa ltar da dung yin na yang lhag par du sems khur yag po zhig 'khyer nas hur thag byed dgos/ nga rang tshorwa 1da rang dbang gi bden mtha' gsal ba'i don dag la gzhis byes bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs su rdzogs par las 'gan gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ mdor na nga rang tsho'i bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing nang la yod pa'i lha tshogs de rnams la yang bod rang dbang gi don du las 'gan yod red bsam gyi 'dug gang yin zer na/ bod kyi rang dbang de sangs rgyas bstan pa dang 'brel ba zhig yin pa ma gtogs rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam lho'i thog nas bod rang dbang bi/ skad cha bshad pa ma red/ 'gro ba spyi la phan pa zhig dang / nga rang tsho bod 151

gangs can gyi ljongs kyi gdul bya gatho ༄nar gyur pa'i 'gro ba tshang mar phan pa'i ched bsam blo gtong gi yod/ mdor na rgya mi la yang phan pa zhig yong ba'i don la bsam blo gtong gisku1da ma gtogs/ rgya mi la sdug pa cig byung na bsam pa dang bkra ma shis pa zhig byung na bsam pa'i bsam blo gtong gi med/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho bod rang dbang zer ba 'di mdor na 'gro ba kun la bde skyid yong ba'i don dag cig dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa yong ba'i don dag la dmigs nas sgrub kyi yod pa yin dus tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs tsho la yang las 'gan yod/ thugs khur bzhes kyi red/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs gnang gi red/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs 'jug zer ba de yang gtso bo nga rang chorware las dang bsod nams kyi mthu la rag las pa yin pas/ nga rang tshos hur thag byed dgos pa yin/ nam rgyun ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ bod pa'i gshis ka 'di dza drag byung na dngos 'brel mkhregs po dang snying stobs ldan pa byed thub kyi yod pa dang / yang dka' ngal de tsam med pa'i skabs la ltod yangs dang 'thus shor 'gro gi yod/ de snga yin na yang tod yangs phyin yod/'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu zhe grangs nang la cha bzhag na yang nga rang tshos rdzod yangs dang 'thus shor yong gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug nga rang tsho btsan byol ba la cha bzhag na yang so so'i ngo gdong la dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig ma byung na rdzod yangs thog nas nyi ma gang 'khyol byed pa'i nyen kha yod pa'i bzo 'dra po 'dug bod nang la yang dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig yod na tshang ma dog la 'gril po dang sems shugs chen po yod pa dang phran bu'i lhug tu phyin na kha 152

g.yeng mig g.yeng gis sdod pa nga tsho bod par de 'dra'i gshis ka zhig yod pa lta bu (1dug nga tshos gzab gzab byed dgos/ nad lta bur mtshon na nga tsho nad chen gyis zin nas bsdad yod/ nad chen gyis zin pa 'di la nga tshos tod yangs skad cig tsam gtong mi rung / tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ gtso bo nga rang tsho tshang ma dam tshig mthun po byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/chos lugs 'then 'khyer dang / lung tshan gyi 'then 'khyer gtan nas byed mi rung / mi 'dra mi 'dra'i nang sdug pa re zung yong gi red/ chos lugs ming la 3khyer nas rdo don rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam blo gtong mkhan re zung yong gi red/ de rnams chos ming du 'khyer nas yong ba ma gtogs/ chos chos dang mthun pa byed kyi yod pa ma red/ de bzhin du chol kha'i 'then khyer byas nas kha nas spyi sems yin pa'i khul la/ don yang snying so so'i chags sdang phyogs ris byed mkhan de 'dra yong gi yod/ nga tshos de 'dra nam yang med pa zhig byed dgos pa ha cang gal chen po 'dug nga rang tsho tshang ma nang khul mthun po byed dgos/bod nang la cha bzhag na sngon ma nas yar thon dang hur brtson byed mkhan byung yod/ de rnams snying rje/ mang che bar khag yod ma red/ phyogs gcig nas rang gis gnas tshul ma shes/ shes rmongs de tsho'i mdum la rgya mis lab pa rnams la yid ches dang 'jigs snang gi 'og nas hur brtson mi byeng ka med chags pa mang che ba red/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul 'gyur ba phyin/ngangangs skrag chung du phyin pa'i skabs la mi'i gshis ka 'am spyod pa brgya cha brgya 153

tham pa 'gyur bsdad spro/ mthong gsal yin/ 'dis ga ze'i rtags bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ hur brtson dang yar thon can de tsho 'jigs snang dang /yang na ma shes pa'i dbang gis g.yam rgyug gi thog nas byung ba gsal po red /de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho nang khul gcig gis gcig la 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam blo gtong mi rung / sngon ma mi 'di dang 'di zhes bya bas nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi mi la sdug po btang song / nga'i pha ma/la sdug po btang song bsam pa'i 'khon 'dzin byed mi rung / de thams cad kyi rtsa ba lan rtsa de rgya mi gung /bran gyis nga rang tsho'i lung pa dbang du bsdus pa 'dis lan pa red/ nga rang tsho nang tshag gcig gis gcig la 'khon 'dzin byas nas dam tshig ma gtsang ba byas na yag po yod ma red/ nga rang tsho'i ma 'ongs pa'i chab srid lam ston nang la gsal po bkod yod/ da lta rgya mis bkod sgrig byas pa'i las khungs nang la las ka byas nas sdod mkhan rnams rtsa ba grod khog rgya mis gsos nas bsdad yod/ming la cha bzhag rung rgya mi'i las khungs kyi ming btags yod/ re zung re zung gi gnas tshul tha dad reng ma gtogs/ gzhan tshang ma bod bsam mkhan dang / bod gangs can pa zer ba'i bsam blo med pa yod ma red/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho tshang ma mthun po byed dgos pa dang / tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs kyi thog nas nga rang tsho ༄/da spyi pa'i don dag sgru ba dgos/ de so so'i thob thang yin pa tsam du ma zad sems can thams cad smu phan bde sgrub pa'i dmigs yul bza nga ngo 'di bsgrub rgyu'i thog la tshang mas khur 'khyer rgyu 'aci/ gal chen po yin/ 154

de ga nang bzhin bod lung spra 'ode sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'brel ba zhig dang / de dar srol chen po yod pa'i dbang gis yul lha gzhi bdag bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mtshon pas gang ltar bod rang gi rje yi mgur lha zer ba sogs mang po yod pa red/ bong kyi dngos yod gnas tshul las lha 'dre mang po zhig nga rang tsho lung pa'i nang mi'i spyi tsho gas dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/ ma gzhi 'dzam bu gling ga sa ga la yul lha gzhi bdag gi mtshon pas skyes lha yul lha sogs yod pa red/ yin na yang lung pa'i yul mi tshos chos dang grub mtha'i dbang gis de 'drar do snang med pa yin dus phal cher lto tshang lta bu tha dad byas nas sdod kyi yod pa red/ dper na.a mi ri ga'i lung pa lta bur mtshon na yul lha gzhi bdag yod thag chod red/ 'on kyang de la mis do snang byed mkhan med/mis do snang byed mkhan med pa yin dus mi'i spyi tshogs nang la khong tshos tshang ka rgyab nas byus gtogs byed kyi med pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la rigs drug la sogs pa skye gnas 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig khas blangs kyi yod la/ yod thag chod red/ yod pa de nga rang tshos ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa yin dus de tsho'i gras kyis dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas skabs re phan thogs yod pa 'dra po/ skabs re gnod skyel gyi yod pa 'a dra wa de 'dra yong gi yod/ nga rang tsho bod gangs can pa'i spyi tshogs nang lha mi tshang ma zung 'brel gyi thog nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la shugs rgyag dgos pa gal chen po chags yod/ mi dam tshig gtsang ma dgos kyi yod pa nang bzhin/ lha yang dam tshig gtsang ma dgos pa gal chen po 'dug bar lam ngas sru nga sdu/ bsten phyogs 155

skor de 'dra bshad yod/ de rnams ngas hol rgyugs dang ri bong cal 'grogs byas pa gtan nas min/ ngas bshad pa 'di skor lo nas lo bstud nas brtag dpyad mang po byas nas nges pa rnyed thub pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags bsdad yod/rgya gar nang dang / bod nang la ngas 'grel bshad brgyab nas gnas tshul gsal bshad byas pa de tsho'i thog la yid ches blos 'gol thog nas de don lag len 'gol mkhan mang po zhig byung 'dug pa la dga' po byung / ngas phan pa zhig byung na bsam nas bshad pa red/ phan pa byung na bsam te bshad pa der phan pa zhig bshad kyi yod pa la ngos 'dzin byas nas lag len bkal yong dus rjes su yi rangs yod/ nga rang gi ngos nas brtag dpyad mang po byas/ phyags rgyang ring wa'i thog la phan pa zhig byung na bsam nas bshad pa red la bshad pa gzhi bzung mi tshos kyang do snang byas te lag len bkal yong dus da dung yin na'ang ngas bshad bsam pa dran gyi yod/ da dung yin na'ang dngos 'brel gzhan la phan bde bsgrub rgyu zhig dang / mi la gang phan ci phan zhig byas bsam pa dran yong gi 'dug gal te ngas bshad pa 'di'i nang la khungs dag min pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal po ston rgyu yod na gnas tshul tha dad red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la yang dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed kyi thog nas dgongs pa gzhan du bkral rgyu yod pa red/ nga tha mal pa ma shes mkhan gcig gis bshad pa la los yin/ nga tsho gtam brjod rang dbang dang mang gtso rang dbang gi lam la 'gro gi yod pas bsam 'char nges par du bshad dgos kyang drang bden dang / khyangs lung gi rgyu mtshan gang yang med par rmongs 156

shed thog nas rtsi med rdog rol byas pa yin na dgos pa mi 'dug ngas bshad pa de chud zos phyin pa red/ bshad nas nyan mkhan med na bshad dgos don med/ gang ltar nga rang tsho lha mi tshang ma dam tshig mthun po zhig dang / da lta skabs su bab pa bod rang dbang gi don la dam tshig mthun po byed dgos/de'i rgyu mtshan gcig la 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i lam ston yod pa 'di'i thog la nga tsho 'gro rgyu 'di gal chen po 'dug nga rang la cha bzhag na skyabs mgon sku gong ma tsho dang las 'brel yod pa zhig yin pa red/ de'i nang tshan nas gong sa lnga pa chen po dang phal cher las 'brel phran bu shugs che ba med dam bsam pa dran gyi yod/ de 'dra yin dus 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang 'go btsugs nas dus da lta bar du bod gzhung zer ba zhig chags bsdad yod/ ma gzhi nga tsho rgya gar la slebs tshar ba'i rjes la bod gzhung mang gtso'i rang bzhin can la bsgyur nas 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod/ yin na yang nga sa ji srid 'gan 'khyer na las don byed pa'i ring 'dir 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i skabs nas btsugs pa'i gzhung 'di'i rgyun mu mthud nas bsdad pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga'i ngos nas 7gong sa lnga pa chen wa'i lam ston yod pa 'di la yid ches byas te khong bi/ rjes la 'gro gi yod/ dper na/ chos lugs kyi nyams len byed stangs ngos nas bshad pa yin na yang / ngas 7gong sa lnga pa chen po la mig dpe gtso bor lta gi yod/7rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bla ma tshe gcig la zung 'jug gi go 'phangs rnyed pa zhes lab na yang ha lam lab chog pa lta bu zhig 157

red/ yin na yang 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos btsugs pa'i dga' ldan pho brang gi khri 'di'i sgang la bzhugs mkhan gyi mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs tshang med pa zhig la ngas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 7rgyal mchog skal bzang gis gong sa lnga pa chen po'i lam ston yod pa 'di'i mjug skyong cha thams cad nas sra thag thag cig gnang yod na/ deng sang rgya mis lag pa 'phyis sa'i bod rgya khongs yin zer ba'i skad cha 'di tsho bshad sa bsdad yod ma red/ gang ltar 7gong sa lnga pa chen po khong rang gis 'char gzhi bting nas lam bstan pa 'di'i thog 'gro ma thub pa'i rkyen byas nas/ bod gzhung nyag phra po chags/ de'i nyer len gyis nang khul nas dbang yod bshad mkhan dang / nang khul nas rnyog khra yong ba'i skabs la rgya nag gong ma la ma re rang re chags/ bod pas byas na mcho da yon sbyin bdag gi la rgya dang 'brel ba'i thog nas rgya nag gong mas rgyab ston byas par ngos 'dzin byed kyang / rgya mi'i ngos nas dpon 'bangs kyi 'brel ba'i ngo rwa1 la bed spyod log pa byas nas 'khyog bshad byas yong gi yod/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen po rang gi lam ston thog la 'gro thub pa byung ba yin na phal cher gnas tshul 'di yong gi ma red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug nga'i lta stangs 'di yin/ chos brgyud kyi nyams len byed stangs ngos nas bshad pa yin na yang /7gong sa lnga pa chen wa'i gnang stangs de la ngas kha mig yar blta byed kyi yod/nga rang tsho mi yin yang rung / lha yin yang rung / su yin rung 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i skabs la 'brel ba yag po yod pa zhig yin na/ 'di bstan pa'i 158
