sung ma yin pa red/ bod dga' ldan pho brang la 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pa red/ bod spyi la phan thogs yod pa red/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen po dang ma 'brel ba zhig dang / lnga pa chen po dang ma 'grigs pa'i gnas tshul yod pa zhig yin na/ lung pa khug skyog cig gi nang la bla ma gzhan gcig gis gang bshad kyi yod rung brtsi dgos don med/ bod spyi pa'i don dag la bsam blo btang ba yin na/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i lam ston yod pa 'di'i sgang la nga rang sto tshang mas 'gro rgyu 'di gal chen po 'dug nga'i ngos nas de 'dra byed kyi yod/ khyed rang cho'i ngos nas kyang de 'dra byas pa yin na yag po red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug gang yin zer na/ da lta nga rang tsho nang khul tsag tsig gi don dag la skad cha bshad res gtong ba'i dus tshod ga la yin/ nga tsho bod mi rigs kho rang rtsa brlag tu 'gro ba'i nyen ga'i mtshams la slebs bsdad yod/ nga tsho 'dir nyin ma gang 'khyol dang / so so'i 'khrul snang nying 'khrul lta bur snang ba dag nas sdod kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ ngo thog bsam blo btang na 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi mi rigs/ rig gzhung gting zab yod mkhan zhig rtsa med shul med 'gro ba'i mtshams la slebs yod pas/ nga tsho nyin ma gang 'khyol gyi lhod ltod cig dang / stod yangs su sdod pa'i dus tshod cig gtan nas min/khyed rang tshos rgyal ba rin po ches shes kyi red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che mkhyen zer nas bsdad/ nga mi gcig gis gang byed thub kyi red/ ngas sems khur len gyi yod pa 'dir nga rang tsho tshang ma'i nus pa spungs nas shugs rgyag dgos/spyi'i don dag la tshang mas bsam blo btang / khur blangs nas byed dgos pa 159

ma gtogs/ nga mi gcig gi sgang la khyed rang tshos lag pa 'phyis pa lta bu 7rgyal ba rin po che yod/ rgyal ba rin po ches gnang gi red zer nas bsdad na mi 'grigs/ sngon ma kha shas kyis nga la de 'dra zer mkhan byung / bod rang btsan yong dang ma yong ni bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs kho rang la rag las pa red/bod rang btsan zer ba de rgyal ba rin po ches thugs bskyed gnang na lam sang yong gi red zer gyi 'dug skad cha 'di tsho'i gras mgo skor gyi skad cha red/gcig byas na bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skad cha yin 'gro ste/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi dad pa dag snang sbyangs rgyu'i bsam cho de dang / dngos yod kyi lag len bkal rgyu gnyis khag khag so 11 byas nas 'gro rgyu red ma garke(gas/mnyam bsres bya thabs yod ma red/ nga rang gi ngos nas cha bzhag na ngas stag brag rin po che dang / rwa sgreng rin po che gnyis /ra rdo je 'chang gi 'du shes bzhag nas dad pa byed kyi yod la/ dad pa skye gi 'dug 'on kyang rang ngos nas rdo rje 'chang du mthong ba de rgyu mtshan du byas nas khong rnam pa tshos gang mdzad pa tshang ma yang dag par ngos 'dzin byed kyi med/ spyir btang lo rgyus kyi nang la kun dang mthun pa'i gnas tshul yag po byung ba rnams yag po red zer rgyu dang / phran bu mtshan shas lta bu yod pa de nor 'khrul yin par ngos 'dzin byed rgyu red ma gtogs/ 'di nga'i bla ma yin/ ci mdzad legs par blta dgos zer gyi med/ zer nas 'grigs thabs kyang yod ma red/ nga rang tshos phyogs tshang mar bsam blo gtong dgos/ spyir btang bod pa gyong po red/bla ma'i yang srid cig phebs yong dus bla ma de dang 'di'i yang srid red ces 160

dad pa byed kyi yod red de/ 'di sku gong ma'i yang srid red slob sbyong bya dgos kyi ma red/ skuyon tshang ma tshang bsdad yod ces su gcig gis zer gyi med/bla ma sku gong ma zhig gi yang srid yin pa la ngos 'dzin nas dad pa byed kyi yod nayang / phru gu de la slob sbyong gcig dang gnyis kyi sprad pa ma gtogs phru gu de la sku tshe sngon ma nas dbang lung man ngag tshang ma thob tshar ba red zer gyi med/ 'di nga tsho bod pas kha yod lag yod sgang la 'gro gi yod pa'i rtags red/ lag len gang gi thog la yin rung kha yod lag yod sgang la 'gro rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ spyir btang khyed rang tshos dad pa yin pa'i bzo 'dra po/ dag snang yin pa'i bzo 'dra po/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches 'gul skyod brgyab na 'di gcig pus 'grigs nas gzhan dag gis khur blang dgos kyi med pa lta bu'i ngos 'dzin byas pa yin na nor 'khrul chen po red/ nga mi gcig rang red/ sprul pa skye rgyu med la/ dmigs bsal gyi nus pa ston rgyu gang yang med/ nga rang tsho tshang ma rdog la bsgril nas 'go 'khrid mkhan gyis 'go 'khrid/ tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs byas nas nga tsho tshang ma chig sgril gyi jog nas nus pa 'don rgyu 'di gal chen po yin/ tshang mas de don sems la bcangs nas hur thag byed dgos/ khyed rang tsho da ring sang nyin log 'gro mkhan yin dus khyed rang tsho tshang ma la bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ khyed rang tsho tshang ma sems skyid po dang bag phebs po byas nas phebs rogs gnang / bod pa zhig yin dus nga rang tsho'i lus 'di pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' dang / ma srin mo brag srin ma nas brgyud pa'i sha khrag gi rgyun gcig gyurayin pas zhabs 'dren 161

zhu rgyu yod ma red/ bod pa'i ming gi thog nas zhabs 'dren zhus pa yin na (5ga po khyon nas yod ma red/ nga yin na yang bod pa zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan mthong yong dus chags sgo thabs sdug smu bsam pa dang / sems skyo yong gi 'dug de 'dra byed rgyu yod ma red/ khyed rang tsho sa cha gang du bsdad yod kyang gang ltar bod spyi pa'i don dag sems la bzhag ste mi ya rabs mi bzang po/ mi spas tshad yod pa zhig byed dgos pa ma gtogs zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan gyi mi gzug byed rgyu yod ma red/ shes song ngam/da gin 'dir gnyid nyal mkhan zhig 'dug 'di chung tsag red de/ de 'dra byed rgyu yod ma red/ de yang nga tsho bod pa'i zhabs 'dren red/ 'dir chos byed rgyu'i ched dang / 'don pa bton zhabs brtan byed du yong ba las/'dir gnyid nyal du yong ba min/ mi des kha yang phran bu gdangs nas bsdad 'dug gcig byas na 'khris la sdod mkhan tshos har har zer ba go med dam bsam pa byung / bya spyod 'di tsho yag po mi 'dug 'dra chags po yang mi 'dugang rang 66) kha nas bla ma dkon mchog zer gyi yod/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa zer gyi yod/ kha nas de 'dra zer bzhin du lag len ngo ma'i thog la snang med dang / rtsod yangs/ bag med byas nas bsdad pa yin na yag po mi 'dugaces bka' 355// //162

rī༄yo+o// phyi lo 1994 zla 6 tshes 10 nyin sud sir bod mi rnams la stsal ba'i bka' slob/thog ma ra 'di lo'i gsum bcu'i dus dran gyi bka' slob gzhir bzung ma 3ོngas bod kyi gnad don thag gcod mdzad phyogs skor mi mang la bka' 'dri bskyangs rgyu'i dgongs gzhi yod lugs zhib phra bka' slob stsal rjes bar skabs then pa'i gnas tshul gnyis kyi skor la gsal bshad bka' slob gnang don/sanas tshul chung tsag gcig la/ bar lam rda ram sa la'i bzhugs skar la rgya gar yul mi dang / bod mi'i dbar rnyog dra phran bu zhig byung / yul mi dang ma mthun pa byung na yag po ma red/ rda ram sa la grong sde chung chung gi nang bod mi stong phrag 'ga' shas yod/ de mngon gsal dod po chags dus/de sel ba'i thabs shes ni bod pa nyung du gtong rgyu 'di ma gtogs gzhan med/bod khyim gyis mtshon pa'i slob grwa tsho sa khul gzhan la spo dgos byung na dka' nga'/ yod/ de snga lo rabs bdun cu pa'i nang btsan byol gzhung gi las khungs khu shas ldi lir lpo rgyu'i skad cha zhig yod pa ltar nang srid lhan khang dang / shes rig lhan khang / dril bsgrags lhan khang 'di rigs ldi lir spo rgyu'i skad cha ji ming yang yong gi yod/ da cha gnas tshul dang bstun nas ldi lir spo thabs dang / rim pas nga rang sdod sa yang rgya gar gyi grong khyer phran bu che sa zhig gi nye skor du spos na/ grong khyer che khag gi nang bod pa stong phrag 'ga' shas bsdad kyang mngon gsal gang yang yong gi ma red snyam pa'i bsam tshul byung /dzña sar slebs nas mi kha shas thug ste gnas tshul de 'grel bshad byas pa yin/163

yul pa tsho dang nga tsho 'das pa'i lo sum cu so bzhi lhag tsam ring mnyam du gshibs nas sdod skabs tshang ma yag thag chod yod/ da cha bod pa'i dpe la/dga' dbye 'dzum bral zhes brjod pa bzhin nga tsho phan tshun tshang ma'i bsam khra'i nang thabs sdug gi gnas tshul chen po ma byung gong rim pas bzang gyes byas na yag po min nam zhes brjod pa yin/ de 'dra'i bsam tshul yul pa tshos rim pas shes dus yul mi'i sde tshogs 'dra min tshang ma'i 'thus mi nga'i sar yong nas dngos gnas kha zhe gnyis med kyi bod par dga' po'i thog nas bod pa rda ram sa lar bsdad na ha cang yag po 'dug 'di nas lpo rgyu'i bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma gtong rogs/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu so bzhi'i ring bod pa rda ram sa lar slebs nas lung pa yar rgyas 'gro rgyus mtshon pa'i gang ci shin tu yag po byung / phyin chad 7rgyal ba rin po che rda ram sa la nas lha sar thad rkar phebs rgyu ma gtogs/ rgya gar nang khul gyi sa cha gzhan la spo rgyu'i dgongs pa ma bzhes rogs zhes nan po byas te brjod kyi 'dug kha shas mig chu chir chir ngang lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas 'di 'dra'i bsam blo gtan nas ma gtong rogs/ da res rda ram sa lar gnas tshul byung ba 'di dngosaskudad gnas tshul la mi nyung shas kyi gnas tshul red ma gtogs mi mang mang che ba'i bsam blor de 'dra rtsa ba nas med/ rnyog dra bzo mkhan ni brgya cha gcig gnyis kyang lon gyi ma red ces gsal po brjod kyi 'dug la/ de ltar yin bzo 'dug sa gnas hi ma cal mnga' sde'i gzhung dang / de bzhin rgya gar dbus gzhung nas kyang ched mngags mi sna btang ste phyi srid las khungs nas 'gan khur chen po 164

len gyi 'dug gtso che shos yul pa tshos bsam pa rnam dag gi thog nas rda ram sa lar da lta bar du mnyam du gshibs ste yag thag chod yod/ ma 'ongs par yang bod rang dbang ma thob bar rda ram sa lar sdod rogs ces brjod kyi 'dug par brten/ ngas khor tshor gnad 'gag med/ da lta thag bcad med/ bsam blo 'di 'dra 'khor byung zhes bshad pa dang chabs cig gsal bshad byas don/nga cho thog mar rda ram sa lar yong ba 'di nga chos rda ram sa la'i sa cha 'di bdams te yong ba min/ nga tsho ma su rir lo gcig sdod skabs rgya gar phyi srid las khungs nas ma su ri 'di 'phral sel bzhugs sa yin/ rgyun ring gi bzhugs sgar chagasayul sa cha gzhan zhigaspend/ rda ram sa la'i sa cha 'di sa khadayangs po/ dang / gangs ri sogs khor yug gi gnas stangs yag po yod ces rgya gar gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa zhig red ma galtasgogs nga tshos sa cha 'di bdams pa gang yang min/ gnyis nas thog mar rda ram sa lar slebs skabs 'grims 'grul dang / kha par sogs kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med pas dka' ngal 'phrad stabs phyi lo drug cu re lnga re drug nang bzhugs sgar rda ram sa la nas sgos na yag po 'dug ces na ni ta khul dang / ma su ri/ ra je spur sogs nga chos sa khul mang po zhig la sa cha bltas pa yin/ de skabs rda sa'i yul mi'i 'thus mi nga'i sar yong ste 'di nas spo rgyu'i dgongs pa ma bzhes rogs zhes nan po byas te brjo da byung / yang de mjug phyi lo brgyad cu gya grangs nang sa 'gul shugs chen snyeg brgyab pa des rkyen byas te bzhugs sgar spo dgos 'dug ces bod rigs nang khul nas bsam tshul byung yod kyang / mtha' ma 'di ga 165

rang du sdod rgyu'i gzhis chags gtan 'khel ba red/ snga phyi'i yong rkyen 'di ltar yin zhes khong tshor 'grel bshad brgyab pa yin/ dang po nga tshos sa cha 'di 'dems sgrug byas pa gang yang min pa'i khar/ mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis nga tsho 'di nas sgo rgyu'i bsam tshul snga rjes byung zhing / da cha lo mang po zhig song nas mi rgyus yod dang / sa rgyus yod chags yod na yang /bar lam rkyen ngan byung bar brten da cha rgyang ring tsam bsdad rgyu'i bsam tshul byung yang / da cha khyed rang tsho'i bsam blo'i nang nas grogs po rnying pa'i zhen ma bor ba'i thog nas bsam tshul shugs chen po zhig shod kyi yod dus dka' ngal yong gi ma red ces brjod rgyu byung / rkyen ngan byung ba 'di rkyen ngan grogs la 'char ba lta bu yul pa tshos kyang bod par rin thang che ru phyin/ yul pa tsho'i snang ngor bod pa'i rin thang la dpyad sgom zhig byung nas do snang gsar pa zhig slebs pa dang / de bzhin bod pa tsho'i ngos la yang so so lung pa bral ba'i mi zhig yin pa dang / yul pa tsho gnad 'gag chen po yin pa'i nyams myong gsar pa zhig thob pa bcas yag po byung song / thog mar blo g.yeng phran bu byung yang mjug tu bzo ltasag po zhig chags pa'i gnas chul 'di rnams brjod na snyam pa byung /de nas don tshan gcig la/ zhib cha mjug tu bkra shis dbang 'dus kyis 'grel bshad rgyag gi red/ de ni don dag rtsa ba nas med pa'i rnyog dra tsha po zhig chags yod/ de gang yin zer na da res nga tshur yong khar chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'go khrid mi gsum nga'i sar yong nas nye char ldi lir chu bzhi snang drug 166

gi tshogs 'du zhig tshogs pa de'i gros chod yin zhes nga la bstan khul gyis sprad byung / de'i mjug tu gzim chung nang mi gzhan su yod med phar lta tshur lta gang 'tshams shig byasate gzhinas mi gcig gisam phrag nas nga la yig 〈(gas shig sprad nas/ 'di go min tang srid gzhung dang yig cha bzhag pa zhig yin zhes bshad byung / ngas yi ge de rob tsam klog pa yin/ de'i nang don tshan gsum 'dug 'di gsang ba chen po zhig yin zer gyi 'dug ngas 'di gsang ba byas te nga la lab na phan 1gegs med/ 'di gnad 'gag chen po chags yod pas bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso gnyis la bshad na ma gtogs yong gi ma red/ lar nas 'di 'dra'i gsang ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin na dang po yi ge ma bzhag gong la nga tshor skad cha bshad na yag po yod/ da lta khyed rang tshos skad cha byas/ yig cha tshun chad bzhag tshar ba red/ 'di bzhag tshar rjes gzhi nas nga'i sar bshad par yong ba 'di dngo sa gnas byas na ga phyi log pa red/ 'di ma bzhag gong nga tshor skad cha dang go bsdur ma byas par las ka tshang ma tshar te gzhi nas brjod pa 'di snga rting log pa red/ de nga'i snang bar 'gro po zhig ma byung / ngas khyed rang tsho chu bzhi sgang drug la da lta bar du dngos gnas ha cang yag po byas yod/ bsam pa rnam dag gis sgo gang sa nas mthun 'gyur byas yod/ yin na yang ngas khyed rang tshor 'di byed 'di ma byed ces bslab bya brgyab na khyed rang tshos nyan gyi ma red/ de snga phan chad ngas mang po zhig bshad pa nyan 'jog ma byung bar blo pham yod/ da cha yin na yang ngas 'dir 'grel bshad brgyab ste khyed rang tshos nyan gyi red bsam pa mi 'dug nyan 167

rogs byed ces brjod rgyu gang yang med/ da rgyugs shig brjod pa yin/ de'i sang nyin tshogs gtso dang / bka' shag nga'i sar yong nas nga tsho mnyam du go bsdur byung / sngon la ngas bsam 'char ma bshad gong tshogs gtso bgres gshon gnyis dang / bka' blon sto bcas la bsam 'char gang yod ces skad cha dris pa yin/ khong tsho tshang mas 'di don dag gal 'gangaso chen po zhig dang / skyon gnad yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po yin par bsam tshul gcig gyur red 'dug ngas kyang da cha ji legs bsam blo gtong dgos pa 'dug mdo stod chu sgang la cha bzhag na dngos gnas rang byas pa can gyi tshogs pa zhig chags yod/ lar nas bod kyi lo rgyus nang cha bzhag na bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi thog nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan gyi skyes bu dam pa mang spro zhig mdo stod kyi phyogs nas byung yod/ da lta'i skabs la yang / dper na/ rgya gar nang sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa de dag gi mkhan po las zung mang che ba mdo stod smad nas yong ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtso ༷ ra gyur pa'i bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi thog ha cang byas rjes yod pa zhig chags yod/ chab srid thog la'ang de snga bar skabs shig nas 'bri chus sa mtshams bcad nas 'bri chu shar rgyud dang / 'bri chu nub rgyud byas nas rgya sde dang bod sde zer ba'i skad cha zhig lhags yod/ des rkyen pas 'bri chu nub rgyud la skusad pa'i khams pa'i nang nas de snga mi rabs nas mi rabs pha tshe bu rabs nas dga' ldan pho brang gi 'og la gnas pa'i mi mang tshos dga' ldan pho brang la blta stangs de dang / yang 'bri chu shar rgyud bar lam 168

rgya sde'i khongs la bsdad pa'i mi tshos dga' ldan pho brang la lta stangs gnyis phran bu khyad par yong srid pa de ni dngos yod lo rgyus thog nas chags pa'i gnas tshul zhig red ma gtogs lhag bsam ma dag pa dang / bsam blo gtong stangs nor ba ma red/ de gnas tshul tha dad red ces de snga phan chad 'das pa'i lo sum cu so lnga lhag tsam ring ngas bsam tshul 'di rang bcangs te bsdad yod la/ go skabs mang po zhig la ngas 'grel bshad brgyab yod pa dang / phal cher yongs bsgrags byas nas kyang thengs kha shas bshad yod/ mdor na/ mdo stod kyi mi mang dang / mdo stod kyi sa khul 'di ha cang gal chen po yin pa dang / de'i ming gi thog nas chags pa'i chu bzhi sgang drug la cha bzhag na yang dad pa yod mkhan gyi tshogs pa zhig chags yod/ de ltar gal chen po yin pa'i tshogs pa 'di'i 'go khrid mkhan do do tan tan yag po zhig ma byung ba'i skabs la ming chen po zhig 'khyer/ las ka lag len thog la skabs re ran po med pa 'di 'dra chags na nyen kha chen po 'dug der gzab gzab byed dgos/phyin chad de 'dra mi yong ba'i thabs shes yag po zhig byed dgos zhes brjod pa yin/ de nas bka' shag dang tshogs gtso khong tsho go bsdur byas/ de bzhin nga la snyan zhu sprod mkhan gyi chu bzhi sgang drug gi mi sna gsum po de yang bka' shag dang / spyi 'thus mnyam du khong tshos yar 'grel bshad dang / mar gsal bshad byed ched thengs kha shas thug 'phrad byas yod/ mtha' ma bka' shag dang tshogs gtso'i thog nas gnad don 'di mi mang rang la skad cha dri dgos kyi 'dug khong tshos de ltar thag gcod byas pa 'di thag gcod byed pa'i dbang 169

tshad yod pa zhig red dam/ med pa zhig red/ khong tsho'i thag gcod der mi mang gi bsam tshul gang 'dra yod ces mdo stod mi mang rang la skad cha dris na yag po med dam zhes bsam 'char bton par de yag po 'dug ces skad cha byung /ngas da lta khyed rang tshor gong du brjod pa bzhin nga tshos jog mar rgya gar la slebs nyin nas bzung chol kha gsum zhes pa 'di shinatu gal chen por brtsis te bsdad yod/ lo sum cu so lnga lhag tsam ring ga dusayin yang dbus gtsang dang / mdo stod smad/ mdor na/ bod rigs rtsam zan ma ṇi bgrang mkhan yin phyin chad bod zer ba'i ming tshig gcig bu 'di'i 'og la nga tsho tshang ma sgril gyi yod/ bod nang nas kyang 'di gal chen po zhig tu brtsis te deng sang bod chol gsum yongs la khyab pa'i ming zhig la 'bad brtson byas nas bod nang khul gyi yig cha mang wa'i nang gangs ljongs dang gangs ljongs zhes bris kyi 'dugabod ces pa'i tshig 'di bod dang bod chen po zhes pa'i dbye ba zhig sngar yig cha'i nang yod par brten/ bod kyi sa khul yongs la khyab ched du gangs jongs dang / gangs can pa zhes pa 'di bod nang nas kyang gnad 'gag chen po brtsi gi yod/ nga rang tsho 'dir btsan byol la yod pa tsho yin na'ang 'das pa'i lo sum cu so lnga tsam ring ga dus yin yang chol kha gsum zhes pa 'di ha cang gal chen por brtsis yod/ bden tshig smon lam nang du'ang / yongs rdzogs bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ zhes bris pa 'di bsam blo 'di'i thog nas bris pa red/ dus da lta bar du nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul bod chol 170

kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba 'di yin zhes dus rtag tu rtsa don 'di dam por bzung ste sdod kyi yod/ yin na yang 'go khrid mkhan re zung gis mi mang kha la 'khyer nas las ka byed thal shor ba min nam/ gal te las ka 'dir mi mang gi rgyab skyor yod pa zhig yin na/ gnas tshul chen po zhig chags yong gi yod/ nga'i bsam blo'i nang gtso che shos bod nang yod pa'i khams pa mi mang de dag dngos gnas srog 'ben la btsugs nas bsdad yod/ sdug pa re zung ni chol kha gsum ga'i nang yong srid pa yin/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams ma bgros bsam pa gcig mthun gyi thoge nas so so'i langs phyogs brtan po 'dzin te shes yon che chung sogs la ma ltos par rtsa ba so so bod mi rigs yin bsam pa'i thog nas lhag bsam rnam dag ngang 'das pa'i lo sum cu so lnga'i ring dang / yang na de las kyang thag ring du btang na lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum lhag tsam ring bod mi rigasayongs rdzogs kyis so so'i rang tshugs brtan po bzung nas bsdad yod/ da cha nga rang tsho dngos gnas bden mtha' gsal rgyu'i re ba je cher 'gro ba'i skabs la/ mi re zung gis bsam blo tan tan ma btang bar zhabs 'dren zhus pa yin na ha cang phangs po yin pas 'di mi mang tshos gsal po shes pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ da res bka' shag dang tshogs gtso'i thog nas thag gcod byas te tshang mar bsam tshul dri rgyu yin pas phyin chad de ltar mi yong ba'i thog bsam blo gtong dgos/ de'i thad gzab gzab ma byas na 'di la gnad 'gag chen po 'dug ces bka' stsal// //171

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 7 tshes 7 nyin ldi li'i mgron khang du mjal khar bcar ba'i bod mi mang tshogs kyi 'thus mi khag gcig la bka' slob tso /ba/ rwa staralang tho rig ri zug r+sāpha tho zurartsa ba nga cha bad dan bdan mtha' gsal la nya ba zhag dang / bad gzhas byes yongs kyis rtsa ba'i bod don dza drag gi gnas tshul yod pa 'di'i sgang la tshang mas shugs bsgril te nus pa 'don rgyu med na ma gtogs yod tshad 'don rgyu'i skabs 'dir/ bar skabs gnas tshul gsar pa zhig thon pa des nga tsho nang khul la dka' ngal zhig byung yod/ chos zab sar bdud zab brjod pa ltar gyi gnas tshul zhig chags grabs byed kyi 'dug /ngas sngon ma bden tshig smon lam 'bri skabs/ /ring nas snying du brnag pa'i 'dod pa'i don/ /yongs rdzogs bod jongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ /lhun grub chos srid zung 'brel dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang myung ba nyid du tso+o/ zhes de dus nas bris yod pa ltar rdo don yang snying nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung chol kha gsum gong bu gcig gyur gyi thog legs nyes gang zhig byung yang skyid mnyam sdug mnyam zhig bya rgyu 'di nga tshos rtsa don la bzung yod/nga tsho chol kha gsum gyi nang nas gal chen po'i chol kha 'di'i mi nyung shas kyi byed stangs kyi rkyen pas chol kha'i bar mi mthun pa lta bu'i gnas tshul zhig chags yong dus/ 'di gnas tshul ha cang dza drag po zhig dang / gal chen po zhig chags kyiyod/ da res kyi gnas tshul 'di gcig pu ma red/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu lhag tsam ring chu bzhi skang drug gi las ka byed mkhan re zung 172

gi byed stangs kyis rkyen pas gang ltar spyi pa'i las ma'i thog khur mnyam len gyi nus pa 'do na rgyu med pa dang / don rtsa chung chung zhig gi 'og nas mda' dkrug phu dkrug byed rgyu'i thog ched du mngags pa lta bu'i gnas tshul zhig yong gi 'dug dngos gnas bod nang cha bzhag na/ da lta'i gnas skabs la khams phyogs kyi mi mang ser skya yongs kyis rgya mir gdong len byas te lhag bsam ri btsugs pa lta bu zhig yod pa red/ 'dir mi nyung shas shig gis mdo stod yongs kyi ming khyer nas phar phyogs dka' las rgyag mkhan de dag gi snga phyi bar gsum gyi byas rjes rnams nag bsub gtong ba lta bu chags yong ba 'di yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug da res kyi gnas tshul 'di dza drag gi go skabs shig slebs yong gi yod dus/ phyin chad gnas tshul gang byung mang byung 'di rigs mi yong ba'i ched du da res gtsang ma zhig byed thub na yag po yong ba 'dug ces bka' shag dang tshogs gtso bgres gzhon gnyis bcas mnyam du yod sar brjod rgyu byung /de'i mjug tu mdo stod mi mang tshor bsam tshul gang yod pa rnams bsdu rgyu'i yig cha bkrams pa red/ da lta sa khul mang che ba tshang ma gnas tshul 'di'i thog bsam tshul gcig gyur zhig yong dgos kyi red la/ yag thag chod yod pa'i bzo 'dug yang sa khul kha shas la gnas tshul gsal po ma rtogs pa de 'dra yang yong srid/ yang spam 'dod dang 'brel ba de 'dra yang yong srid/ da lta de 'dra'i gnas tshul zhig chags bsdad yod/ rdo don gang gal chen po yin zhe na/ nga tsho chol kha gsum gcig bsgril zhes pa 'di nga tsho'i srog rtsa chags yod/ rgya mi gung khran yin na yang de snga nga tsho dang ting zha'o ying thog mar thug 173

skabs teng zha'o thing gis rang btsan gyi skad cha ma shod/ de min ga re'i skor la yang go bsdur byas chog gi red ces 1979 lor bshad yod/ de nas dus da lta bar ngas bod rgya zhi 'grigs yong ba'i thabs shes bsten phyogs dang /gros 'char bton pa rnams teng zha'o phing gi brjod pa 'di gzhi la bzhag nas de'i rgya las ma 'das pa'i thog nas ngas da lta'i bsam tshul 'di bshad kyi yod/ngas chol kha gsum chig bsgril zhes pa 'di si tras si sbag gi gsung bshad de snur tshang ma'i nang rtag par bshad par brten bar lam nas rgya mis chol kha gsum chig bsgril zhes pa 'di rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red ces de'i thad ha cang nan po bshad kyi 'dug rgya mis kyang 'di gal chen po zhig dang / gnad 'gag chen spro zhig mthong gi yod la/ nga tsho'i rtsa don yang 'di chags yod/ ngas bod chol kha gsum gcig bsgril zhes brjod pa 'di srid don gyi rang dbang gcig pu'i skad cha ma yin par/ bod da lta'i gnas stangs 'di 'dra ma yin pa zhig gi rang skyong ngam/ gang ltar phyi srid dang rgyal srung ma gtogs pa'i las don tshang ma bod pa rang nyid kyis 'gan gtsang ma 'khyer te byed rgyu yod pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces brjod pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa 'di srung skyob byed rgyu nga tsho'i las 'gan gathorwa 1 chags yod/ 'di ni rgyu mtshan yang dag pa zhig tu mthong gi 'dugabod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yag po zhig byung ba yin na nga tsho bod mi sa ya drug la phan pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya gar gyi sa mtshams khul gyi hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs bod kyi chos dang rig 174

gzhung dang gcig gyur chags yod/chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yag po zhig yong ba'i dmigs yul bsgrub thabs la bod chol kha gsum gcig gyur byung na bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gathorwa 1ra gyur pa'i chos dang rig gzhung 'dzin rgyur de tsam gyis nus pa che ba thon thub kyi red/ gal te chol kha de tsho dum bur phyin te khams phyogs kyi dum bu gcig yun nan gyi khongs su bsdad/dum bu gcig zi khron gyi khongs su bsdad/ mdo smad kyang mtsho sngon zhes sa khul gcig dang / kun su'u bcas gang ltar rgya mi'i zhing chen 'ga' zhig gi khongs gtogs byas te bsdad pa yin na/ gang nas bltas kyang ha cang gsal po mthong ba ni/ rim pas rim pas rgya mi'i zhing chen gyi khongs la yod pa'i bod rigs nyung shas yod pa rnams ming med shul med la 'gro rgyu yin pa gsal po red/da cha phyin chad dka' ngal de 'dra mi yong ba'i ched du bod chol kha gsum gcig bsgril gyi don dag la dka' las rgyag mkhan da lta bod gzhung gi 'go khrid pa'i 'og la/ chol kha so so'i tshogs pa skyid sdug yod pa tshang mas nga rang tsho nang khul ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i dge skyon bsam 'char gang 'don rgyu yod kyang nga tsho da lta mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi yod pas nges par du bsam 'char 'don dgos/ yin na'ang bsam 'char bton pa'i thog la khur mnyam len gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ tshogs pa skyid sdug yod pa 'di dag bod gzhung la skyon brjod byed mkhan gyi tshog sa pa'i bzo lta 175

bu las/ khur mnyam len gyi nus pa de yang ma thon/ ma 'grigs pa ma 'thus pa bshad mkhan zhig dang / nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang phu dkrug mda' dkrug byed mkhan lta bu chags pa yin na/ tshogs pa btsugs pa'i dgos don ma tshang ba red/ gang ltar da lta chu bzhi sgang drug gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di mdo stod mi mang skungangs rdzogs mang mos drang bden gyi 'og nas thag gcod byas te btsugs pa'i tshogs pa'am/ las ka byed mkhan zhig chags kyi yod pa ma red/da res gnas tshul gyi rkyen zhig langs nas yod thog 'dir mdo stod khongs kyi mi mang tshang mas so sor bsam tshul gang yod pa rnams 'don thub pa zhig dang / de'i thog nas mang mos kyi mang gtso ming don mtshungs pa zhig gi 'og nas 'os 'dems byas te chu bzhi sgang drug sgrig 'dzugs kyi ming 'khyer mkhan dang las ka byed mkhan de dag drag 'dems yag po zhig byed thub pa byung na/da res dka' ngal gyi gnas tshul 'phrad pa 'di'i 'og nas phyin chad nga tshor dka' ngal 'di 'dra mi yong ba'i gnas tshul bzang po zhig la 'gyur thub pa'i rkyen ngan grogs la 'char ba'i gnas tshul yong rgyu'i re ba yod na/ gzab gzab byas nas bsam blo yag po zhig gtong dgos/ nga tsho ngar ngar rbad rbad byas nas 'khrug pa rgyag pa lta bu byas na de ni zhabs 'dren gyi bya ba red/ nga tsho spyi yongs nas bod rang dbang bsgrub rgyu 'di yang 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam bsten nas 'gro gi yod/ der brten nang khul gnas tshul phran bu ma 'grigs pa byung skabs lam seng mgo la rdo gzhu res byed pa sogs byas na dpe mi srid pa'i zhabs 'dren yin/ rgya mi'i mdun la ngo tsha ba 'dug176

da res rkyen langs thog 'dir nad la 'phral sel sman bcos rma kha gso thub tsam byas pa lta bus mi 'grigs par/ phyin chad na tsha 'di mi langs pa'i da res las ka shugs che tsam dang / 'gul bskyod shugs che tsam byed dgos pa chags yod/ da res gnas tshul gyi rkyen langs thog 'di la bsgyur bcos che tsam btang ste sman bcos gshag bcos lta bu che tsam zhig byed dgos pa phal cher chags yod/ de ltar byas te phyin chad gtsang ma yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ 'di gnad 'gag chen po min nam snyam pa dran gyi 'dug da res rkyen zhig 'phrad thog 'dir phyin chad gang byung mi yong ba'i gtsang ma zhig yong bar bod gzhung gi ngos nas yin na yang da res kyi las ka 'di mtha' bkar nas mjug skyel gyi yin la/ khyed rang tsho mi mang gi ngos nas yin na yang de lugs kyi bsam blo btang nas gang ltar gtsang ma zhig dang / phyin chad de 'dra gang byung mang byung mi yong ba tshang mas bsam blo gtong dgos/ shes song ngam/ 'di khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed dgos/ zhes bka' stsal// //177

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 7 tshes 19 nyin ga sha khul rig gzhung nyams gso'i chogs 'du'i sar stsal ba'i bka' slob/da lam 'dir tshogs 'du'i don dag la ched mngags phebs pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pa tsho dang / phyag las gnang mkhan tsho/ de min gyi ser skya mi mang lhan rgyas la zhu rgyu/ da ring 'dir khyed rang tshos gtso che ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i don dag la do khur chen po byas nas tshogs 'du gnang ba 'dir ha cang dga' po byung / tshogs 'du gra 'grigs po dang / yag po yong ba'i don du ngas bkra shis bde legs kyi smon tshig zhu rgyu yin/ de nas nga bod pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas dmigs bsal gyi dga' po yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yod zer na/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul 'di dag gi chos dang rig gzhung phal mo che bod gangs can gyi ljongs nas tshur yong ba zhig yin pa red/ de sngon bod gangs can gyi jongs su rang dbang yod pa'i skabs la sa khul 'di dag nas don gnyer chen po yod mkhan de 'dra bod la phyin/ lo mang po'i dus tshod btang nas bslab pa slob gnyer byas/ dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun bzang po zhus/ de nas rang gi lung pa la chos dang rig gzhung spel te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don byed kyi yod pa red/ bod rang dbang brlag pa'i rjes la sa khul 'di nas sngar bzhin bod la 'brel ba byed sa med par brten/ bod mi btsan byol ba nyung shas shig yod pa rnams la 'brel ba byas nas bsdad pa red/ gang ltar bod gangs can gyi ljongs la chos dang rig gzhung gtor bshig nyams nyes shin tu chen po byung 178

ba'i skabs 'dir hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs la gzhi nas rang nyid kyi ྾ dang rig gzhung thog la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so lnga lhag tsam de'i ring la mngon gsal dod d+ku do snang byung ba ni hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul khag nas sngar bod dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba yod pa 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs la gang dga' ci legs kyi thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byed kyi yod pa zhig mthong song / de la dmigs bsal gyi dga' po yod/ tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi rtsa ba'i 'byungakhungs ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas byung ba yin/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi gatho rwab nang pa'i chos dang 'brel bkod pa dang / nang pa'i chos 'di rgya gar gyi chos shig red/ rgya gar nas nang pa'i chos gatho rwanar gyur pa'i gso ba rig pa dang / bzo rig pa/ sgra dang / mngon brjod/ zlos gar/ sdeb sbyor / rtsis la sogs pa rig gnas che chung bcu grangs shig bod la rim bzhin dar yod pa red/ bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po dang / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhan skyes bu dam pa mang po zhig gis bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong byas pa dang / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas dar ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rig gnas 'di dag lag tu blang bde ba dang / rdog la 'gril po bzos pa'i rig gzhung zhig chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra'i rig gzhung 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rig gzhung rnying khungs shig yin pa tsam du ma zad/ da lta dus rabs nyer gcig par mngon 179

du phyogs pa'i dus tshod 'di'i skabs la yin na yang rig gzhung 'di dag dgos mkho yod pa zhig yin pas/ rig gzhung 'di dag nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyi rgyun 'dzin thub pa zhig byung ba yin na phan thogs yod pa zhig tan tan red/ 'di lta bu'i phan sgogs yod pa'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed 'os pa dang / byed pa de rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin dus 'di'i thog la tshang mas do snang dang thugs khur bskyed kyi yod pa ltar/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas do snang gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/gtso che shos mi mang mi re ngo re'i ngos nas so so'i rig gzhung de gang 'dra yin pa de ngos 'dzin thub pa zhig dang / 'di so so'i pha mes kyi rig gzhung yin bsam pa'i bdag gces byed dgos/ bdag gces byed rgyu'i sems khur bskyed dgos/ de yang mi mang tsho'i ngos nas byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de 'dra'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel lag len rim pa ji ltar bya rgyu'i skor la/ da ring 'dir khyed rang tsho mkhas dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i 'brel yod mi sna mang po zhig phebs yod pa red/ khyed rang tshos zhib cha'i go bsdur gnang dgos/ da lta phan chad la yang tshogs 'du snga rjes 'tshogs yod/ da dung yin na yang sa gnas 'di ga'i jog la skabs su babs pa'i byed sgo gang dang gang yod pa rnams khyed tshos go bsdur bgro gleng gi thog nas gsal po chags kyi red/ nga la dmigs bsal zhu rgyu mi 'dug da ring khyed rang tsho'i tshogs 'du 'dir don snying grub 'bras thon pa yong rgyur ngas re 180

ba zhu gi yod/ ngas da lta zhu rgyu zhig la/ tshogs 'du 'di'i thog la ngas dus chod ring tsam bsdad nas mkhas dbang rnam pa tsho'i gsung bshad nyan 'dod yod kyang da lta sa chog gi cho ga 'don rgyu gang 'tshams shig lhag bsdad yod pas/ ngas dgongs pa zhus/ khyed rang tsho mu mthud nas tshogs 'du gnang rogs gnang zhu gi yin zhes 455// //181

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 7 tshes 20 nyin/ ga sha khul ser skya mang tshogs la 455 ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul phal mo che nas 'dzoms yod pa red/ 'dzoms pa de khral bskul ba dang / rngan pa sprad nas 'dus pa lta bu min par/ bsam pa rnam dag dang / dga' zhen gyi thog nas 'dzoms pa red/ 'dzoms don ni nga rang tsho tshang ma chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di'i thog nas 'dzoms pa red/ mi kha shas kyi bsam blo'i nang yar rgyas ma phyin pa'i lung pa'i nang la rmongs dad byed kyi yod pa lta bu mthong srid mdog kha po red/ yin na yang / deng sang bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung zer ba 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rig gzhung rnying shos kyi gras shig yin pa dang / rgya che zhing gting zab po yod pa/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir phan thogs dang dgos kho chen po yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed stangs lo re nas lo rer je gsal du 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga tshor de lta bu'i rig gzhung zhig gna' rabs nas yod pa 'dir so so spobs pa skyes 'os pa zhig dang / nga rang tshos 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la ngoms chog pa lta bu zhig yod/ nga tsho bod mi tsho'i ngos nas bod rang dbang rtsod len byed kyi yod/ bod rang dbang rtsod len byed pa de srid don gyi rang dbang gcig pu min par/ da lta bshad ma thag pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gting zab yod pa 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dus yun ring po zhig gnas thub pa'i don du nga mos rang dbang rtsod len byed kyi yod/ de ni bod rang nyid kyi khe phan tsam du ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig 182

gzhung nyams len byed mkhan spyi dang / ma 'ongs par rgya nag rang dbang byung ba'i skabs su rgya mi sa ya mang po la phan thogs yong rgyu yin pa gsal po red/gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas hi ma la ya'i sa khul mang po zhig la bod nas dar ba'i sgo so rang nyid kyi rig gzhung 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs phyogs gang sa nas khyed rang tshos 'bad rtsol byed pa de dngos gnas rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa btsan byol ba kha stabs zhan po byas nas bsdad yod kyang / nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas khyed rang sbo la phan thogs gang byed thub pa de nga tsho'i las 'gan du brtsis nas gang yong ci yong byed kyi yod la/ da dung yin na yang byed rgyu yin/ ma 'ongs par bod rang dbang thob pa'i mtshams la sngar bzhin du nga rang pho ra pa gcig la kha rgyab ste bsdad thub kyi red/ rang nyid kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs kyi bya ba 'di dag lhag bsam dang /rnam dpyod kyi shes bya yon tan thog nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ dga' mos dang dad pa gcig pu'i thog nas zin thub rgyu khag po red/ de ltar na hi ma la ya'i ri khul gyi ser skya mang tshogs tshang mas phyogs gcig nas so so'i chos dang rig gzhung khag slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa dang / gnyis nas 'dzam bu gling spyi'i shes yon gyi rjes zin thub pa byas te mdor na phyi nang gnyis lnga'i shes yon ldan pa byed rgyu gal chen po red/ shes yon gyi nus pas ma ldang na/ rang gi rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed bsam pa'i sems shugs dang / 'dod pa yod na yang / lag rdum 183

chags te nus pa thon thub kyi ma red/gnas tshul de dang 'brel nas do tshan chung chung zhig zhu 'dod byung / de gang yin zer na/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul mang po zhig nas bod mi btsan byol ba'i chos sgar khag tsho'i nang la slob gnyer byed mkhan mang po phyin/yod/ khong tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi sa khul grang mo zhig nas rgya gar lto phyogs tsha ba'i dkyil la sdod dgos byung lho kyang / khong tshos dka' ngal dang du blangs nas bslab pa slob gnyer hur thag byas te deng sang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas yong ba'i gra pa tsho'i nang nas dge bshes ming rtags thon mkhan rim pasayong gi yod pa red/ ha cang yag po red/ dngos gnas drang gnas rjes su yi rangs yod/ khong tshos pho mang po gdan sa'i nang bsdad nas slob gnyer byas pa'i lag rjes kyi shes yon de dag so so'i yul nang chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu'i cha rkyen thog la bed spyod byed thub pa'i go skabs sprod rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/phyags rgyang ring po'i ngos nas bshad pa yin na/ bod nang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung thun mong mayin pa yod pa rnams nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs bya rgyu gnad chen po yin/ de ni bod kyi rang dbang dang 'brel ba chen po yod/ bod rang dbang ma byung na bod nang chos dang rig gzhung gnas thub rgyu khag wa 3da/ ngas khyed rang tshor mthong chung byas pa min te/ bod yul rgya yul la 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dmigs med phyin pa yin na/ hi ma la ya'i ri brgyud la zin thub rgyu khag po 184

red bsam gyi 'dug khye da rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi mi mang tshos bod rang dbang gi don dag la sems khur blangs/ sha tsha byas/ skabs babs rgya gar mi mang gi khrod la bod kyi gnas tshul 'di gsal bshad dang ngo sprod byed rgyu sogs gang thub ci thub byas pa la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas rjes su yi rangs yod/ bod rang dbang gi las 'gan yod pa'i mi gcig yin pa'i cha nas ngas khyed rang tsho tshang ma la thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ da dung yin na yang khyed rang tshos snga ra bzhin du nus pa che bskyed byas nas bod rang dbang gi don dag la gang yong ci yong byed rogs zhes 'bod bskul byed rgyu yin/ phyi rgyal chos tshogs kyi mi kha shas kyis bod kyi chos la dga' mos dang /nyams len byas/ bod rang dbang gi gnas tshul de srid don red/ nga tsho srid don byed kyi min zer mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dug ngas khong tshor rtsed mo dang sbrags bshad kyi yod/ khyed rang tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa shog ces smon lam rgyag gi yod pa 'dra/ smon lam rgyag gi yod na bod kyi rang dbang 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i don dag dang 'brel ba yod/ bod la rang dbang ma byung na/ phyi rgyal la nang pa'i chos byed mkhan 'bum kha shas yod pa tshos mi thog 'di dang / ma 'ongs pa'i mi thog gcig gnyis tsam las bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la 'dzin skyong sung skyob cha tshang byed thub kyi red bsam pa ngas dran gyi mi 'dug ma 'ongs pa la gcig byas na yong srid mdog kha po red/ da lta'i gnas skabs la bod rang dbang ma byung bar du bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa dang 185

'brel ba'i rig gzhung bod mis zin pa nang bzhin su gcig gis zin thub mi yong / de ltar bod kyi rang dbang 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba chen po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas hi ma la ya'i ri brgyud dang / de tsam du ma zad rgya gar rgyal yongs nang la 'phags bod mdza' 'brel tshogs pa che chung sna tshogs tshugs yod pa red/ lhag par nye ba'i dus chod kyi nang la tshang mas bod don la do snang chen po byed kyi 'dug 'phags bod mdza' 'brel tshogs pa'i las ka byed mkhan sa cha gar yod tshang mar ngas de ring go skabs 'di brgyud nas thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ da lam sa gnas 'di ga'i rdzong dpon dang /'brel yod las ka byed mkhan tshang mas hur thag byas pa dang / sa cha 'di ga'i yul mi tsho'i ngos nas kyang mthun 'gyur yag po byur bar thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / sa gnas hi ma cal mnga' sde'i gzhung nas mthun 'gyur gang gzab gnang bar da ring go skabs 'di dang bstun nas thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ zhes bka' 455// //186

༄༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 7 tshes 23 nyin/ ga zhar gsung chos grub rjes mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/dus 'khor dbang chen de grub pa red/ 'di ga'i sa gnas su sems shugs dang / dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i sgo nas gra sgrig byed mkhan tshang mas hur thag byas pa'i mthu la brten nas/ nga rang tsho tshang ma gra 'grigs po ha cang yag po byung / phal cher 'di khul yul lha gzhi bdag tshos kyang dga' ba'i mtshan ma'i bzo 'dra po 'dug dga' po byung / 'di khul mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dka' ngal chen po yod na yang / phyogs mtha' mang po zhig nas khyed rang tshos don gnyer chen po byas sems shug bsgril te yong pa la rjes su yi rangs kyi gan sa red/ tshang mas don gnyer chen po byas nas nyan pa der thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ so so'i ngos nas dad pa dang / dmigs pa de tsho yag po byung yod na/ gang ltar bag chags khyad par can zhig bzhag rgyu yin pa la the ma yod pa ma red/ byin rlabs che chung sems rgyud la thob yod med gang ltar gdong la ni byin rlabs chen po thob 'dug nyi mas 'tshig nas nag po chags pa dang / rlung gis pags pa gas te mi tshang ma spu mdog log 'dugang rang tshor dbang thob pa tsam gyis mi chog par/ gtso che shos dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams shes pa byas nas che sa nas srung sdom byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ phra zhing phra ba mtha' dag lam seng srung thub pa khag po red de/ dus rgyun ldan nas so so'i bsam blo'i nang ngas theg pa chen po'i chos la so sos mos pas kun nas blangs/ so so dang bstod byas nas theg 187

pa chen po'i chos nyan pa yin/ da cha so so'i nyin re nyin re'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa de theg chen gyi chos dang ma 'gal ba zhig ma byas na ha cang thabs sdug red bsam pa zhig dus rgyun ldan nas sems la dran pa byas te che sa'i nyes pas ma gos pa byed dgos/ zug pa chen po'i chos kyi bslab bya gtso bo dang / snying po de sems bzang po byed dgos/ su la yang gnod pa ma skyel zer ba de yin pas/ dus nam gyi tshe na yang mi lta ci smos/ srog chags gang 'dra zhig la yang gnod pa byed mi rung / lhag par mi nang tshags gcig gis gcig la mgo bsgor mi gtong ba dang / thub tshod ma byas par/ gcig gis gcig la phan groges yag po byed dgos/ gcig gis gcig la bsam pa bzang po'i thog nas mnyam du 'tsho gi yin na/ 'phral du khyim tshang nang la skyid pa/spyi tshogs nang la yang skyid pa/ tshang ma bag phebs pa yong gi red/ de 'dra'i las bzang po bsags na des tshe phyi ma la yang shugs kyis phan gyi red/theg pa chen po'i chos dang ma 'gal ba zhig byed kyi yin/ byed dgos kyi yod bsam pa dran pa'i thog nas bsam pa bzang po la lag len bkal rgyu de gtso bo red/ da lam skabs su babs pa'i chos 'brel tshang ma legs par zin pa yin/ phyi dro brtan bzhugs tshar ba'i rjes la dkyil 'khor mjal kha gtong gi red/ 'tshang ka ma brgyab par/ ltod rdzod byas nas mjal/ dbang thob pa'i rjes 'brel gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i skabs la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba ma skyes pa skyes pa dang / gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i smon lam yag po rgyab/ bod bstan srid kyi ched du dmigs nas — 188

smon lam rgyab na yang yag po yong gi red/ de nas mi tshang ma phyogs dang mtshams la phar gyes nas kha 'thor 'gro gi yod pa red/ gang ltar 'dus pa'i mtha' bral ba de chos nyid yin pa red/ ga le ga ler gson pa'i mtha' mar 'chi ba zer ba kho yong gi red/ kha seng sngon 'gro la lam rim gyi 'khrid mdor bsdus shig bshad pa bzhin/ dus rgyun ldan nas so sdus 11 so'i sems la bya ra yag po byas/ lag len so bdun ma'i mjug tu/ rang gi 'khrul pa rang gis ma brtag na/ chos pa'i gzugs kyis choges min byed srid pas/ gsungs pa de gal chen 11 'dug nga nang pa yin/ nga gra pa yin/ nga snungs pa yin bsam gyi yod pa red de/ zhogs pa yar langs pa nas dgong mo ma nyal bar du dngos gnas so so'i bsam blo 'khyer so dang / byed stangs de bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa zhig dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang ma 'gal ba zhig ngo thog byed kyi 'dug gam mi 'dug bsam blo btang ba yin na/ dngos gnas so so'i rang mtshang de gzhi nas rig thub rgyu red/ rang gis rang la brtag dpyad byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug gang ltar nga rang tsho chos pa'i gral la bsdad mkhan zhig yin na/ ྅gen pa bka' drin can gyis gsungs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul 'di dag nyin ma re re la tshig re re las ma byung rung shes thabs byed rgyu dang / shes pa'i don dag de lag tu bkal nas lo zla sbrel te so so'i gshis rgyud de ga le ga ler dul du 'gro thub pa dang / bzang du 'gro thub thabs la tshang mas 'bad rtsol byed dgos/ chos zhus pa'i dgos don mi'i gshis ka bzang du 'gro thub pa dang / so so'i sems rgyud 'jam du 'gro ba zhig byung 189

ba yin na chos zhus pa'i lag rjes de red/ de byung na 'dir nyin ma bstud de bla ma'i ngos nas dka' las rgyab/ khyed rang tsho slob ma'i ngos nas kyang dka' las rgyab pa'i dgos don tshang ba red/ sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed rgyur do snang dang / dang bstod ma byas par sems rgya yan la da lta bar du btang ba red/da dung de mur phyin pa yin na ha cang phangs po red/ chud zos red/'dir bod nas yong ba kha shas yod sa red/ khyed rang tsho kha shas ni dus 'khor dbang chen zhus nas bod la log 'gro mkhan yod mdog kha po red/khyed rang tsho blo bde po byed dgos/ dus kyi 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red/ nga rang tsho'i bden mtha' gsal ba la mngon du phyogs pa 'dra po red/tshang mas sngar bzhin lhag bsam bcang nas hur thag byed rogs byed/'dir phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig slebs yod/ ngas ngo shes pa yang mang po 'dug khyed rang tshos bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la do snang dang /nyams len byas pa ha cang yag po red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ ma 'ongs pa la yang chos pa kha yod lag yod byed thub na yag po red/ khyed rang tshos bod kyi nang pa'i chos la do snang byas pa dang chabs cig bod kyi rang dbang gi don dag la'ang sems khur dang do snang byas te 'dzam gling gang sar bod don la bden rgyab las 'gul spel dang spel bzhin pa la ngas bod mi mang gi tshab byas nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ da lta bar du tshang mas hur thag byas pa ltar/da dung yin na'ang hur thag byed rogs zer rgyu yin/ nga bo da mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa 'jig la nye ba'i dus mtshams la slebs pa'i skabs 190

'dir 'dzam bu gling spyi'i bden pa'i bden skyabs 'tshol rgyu la do gal chen po byed kyi yod la/ khyed rang tshos bden pa bden sar 'khyol ba'i rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byed rgyu gal chen po red/ thugs rje che/'dir nyin shas ring dus 'khor dbang chen sbyor dngos rdzis gsum gyi cho ga bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas ga tshod thub thub byas pa red/ khyed rang tsho slob ma'i ngos nas kyang ga tshod thub thub kyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i thog nas nyan/ smon lam tshig skam po gcig las ma byung rung tshang mas hur thag byas yod pa red/ de lugs kyi nga rang tsho tshang ma'i rgyud la dge rtsa gang la gang 'tshams bsags yod pa red/ bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams phyogs gcig nas bla med rdzogs byang gi rgyu la bsngo rgyu gal chen po yin pa red/ gnyis nas de ltar bsngo yul bla med rdzogs byang dang / bsngo rgyu'i dge ba/ bsngo mkhan rang nyid thams cad ming gi dbang gis yod tsam zhig ma gtogs/ ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa zhig med pa red/ de ltar ming tsam brda tsam/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos tshul gyi gnas lugs shes pa'i thog nas bsngo ba byed kyi yin na/ dmigs med kyis rgyas btab pa yin dus zab khyad sposad pa red/nga rang tsho 'dir chos bshad mkhan bla mar cha bzhag na/ nga skyes sa bod la skyes pa'i bod pa gcig red/ bod pa yin pa tsam du ma zad bod bstan srid kyi 'gan khur yod pa red/ da lta lo drug cu tham par slebs yod/ de'i ring la bod bstan srid kyi don dag la gang yong ci yong byas pa yin/ da dung yin na yang tshe lhag gang yod bod bstan srid don dag la so so las dang smon 191

lam gyi 'brel ba yod pa'i cha nas hur thag ma byas par thabs yod pa ma red/khyed rang tsho chos nyan mkhan la cha bzhag na bod rigs tsho lta lta ci smos/ bod pa ma yin pa'i hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi mi mang rnams kyang nga sto chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ bod la bde skyid byung na khyed rang tsho la'ang bde skyid yong gi red/ bod la bde skyid ma byung na khyed rang tsho la bde skyid yong rgyu khag po red/ nga tsho bde sdug gi mjing pa 'brel nas bsdad yod pa red/ de bzhin phyi rgyal mi sna gang 'tshams yod pa tsho skyes sa 'tshar sa lung pa gzhan dgayin nayang / bsam khra'i thog nas bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la yid 'phrog mos pa skyes/ sha zhen slebs te bod pa dang gcig gyur 'dra po chags bsdad yod/ da lam nga rang tshor dge ba'i rtsa ba thob pa 'di dag la brten nas bod gangs can gyi ljongs kyi chos rgyal tsho'i skabs thugs stobs mkhyen rlabs dang / byams pa dang brtse ba/ lhag pa'i bsam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thog nas sangs rgya sa kyi bstan pa gsar du gtod/ gsar du gtod pa de rim pas mi thog nas mi thog sbrel te yar rgyas gong 'phel btang nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zhes lab na/ bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos las lhag pa med mkhan 'di lta bu zhig dus da lta bar du gnas thub pa byung ba red/ 'di ni dngos gnas 'dzam bu gling gi spyi nor zhes lab thub pa lta bu chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra'i chos 'di deng sang rgya mi'i btsan dbang gi 'og la ha las pa'i nyams nyes phyin pa'i dus tshod la slebs yod/ 'di'i rtsa ba so so'i tshe sngon mar bsod nams ma yin pa'i las 192

bsags pa'i 'bras bu red/ las ngan pa yin na yang 'dzad rgyu yod pa dang /'gyur ba 'gro rgyu yod pa/ de dang chabs cig tshur phyogs 'dir bod rgya che'i mi mang gi lhag bsam dang / dad pa dang dam tshig g.yo ba med par lo nas lo sbrel gyis dge ba stobs chen po bsags yod/ de la yang nus pa shugs chen po zhig yod pa thag chod pa red/ nga rang tshos da phan bsod nams chen po bsags pa 'di dag gi mthu la brten nas ring por mi thogs par bod gangs can gyi jongs la rang dbang rang lag tu son pa zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sngar bzhin du rgyas thub pa/ de la brten nas bod mi sa ya drug la phan pa tsam du ma zad/ lham la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul yongs rdzogs la phan thub pa/ nga tshor sdug po gtong mkhan gyi rgya mi dung phyur mang po chos med kla klo'i mun nag gi 'og la dka' ngal de lta bu myangs/ myangs pa tsam du ma zad dngos gnas mi lus kyi byed ka lta bu'i gnas stangs thog bsdad mkhan sa ya mang pos dam pa'i chos kyi slob gnyer byed thub pa/ de la brten nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas zhi dul lhag bsam can gyi mi la 'gyur thub pa bcas kyi don du tshang mas bsngo ba dang / smon lam yag po zhig byed thub na yag po red/ tshang mas smon lam skyonashog a/ mdor na mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar gangs can zhing / /yongs bzung rgya chen smon lam gang mdzad pa'i/ /'bras bzang deng 'dir myur du 'char bar gsol/ zhes sogs dbu bskul thugs smon rgyas par bka' drin bskyangs// //193

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1994 zla 12 tshes 14 nyin se ra chos skar du ser skya mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/ dzod ring 'dir don tshan sa bcad lta bu phye nas zhus na phran bu nges bde ba mi yong ngam/ tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ nga rang tsho bod gangs can pa rnams 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan legs shos de yin pa gsal po red/ lo rgyus kyi nang la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod la dar te khyab gdal chen po byung ba'i rjes la bod mi'i goms gshis kho rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'brel ba'i goms gshis chags yod pa red/ don tshan dang po de chos phyogs nas zhus pa yin na/ da lta phan chad nga tsho btsan byol bod pa tshos lo sum cu so lnga lhag tsam gyi ring la chos phyogs nas bstan pa'i me ro gso ched tshang mas thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byas pa'i 'bras bu la gang la gang 'tshams kyi byas 'bras sgon yod/ rgya gar dang / bal yul/ de min phyi rgyal yul khag nang sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa'i rten gzhi tshugs nas bsdad yod pa de tsho byas rjes chen po red/ yag po red/ skabs su babs pa gzhis chags 'di ga'i nang la mtshon na yang /se ra theg chen gling gi chos sde dbus gtsang khul gyi dgon pa che shos kyi gras shig 'dir tshugs yod pa dang / pad nor rin po che yi rnam grol gling dgon pa la cha bzhag pa yin na/ rin po ches sku las skyon nas da cha snga 'gyur rnying ma'i dgon pa bshad gra yod pa yag shos/ 'dus tshogs che shos/ 'dul khrims gtsang ma yag shos shig chags bsdad yod pa red/ de dang 'brel ba'i dgon 194

pa chung khag de 'dra yang kha shas yod pa red/ spyi yongs kyi thog nas tshang mas hur thag gnang ba'i 'bras bu mig mthong lag zin yod pa ha cang yag po red/da dung yin na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di shes bya yon tan gyi skad cha gcig pu ma yin par/ lag len gyi thog nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub dgos par brten/ dgon sde yas mas tshang mas 'dul khrims dang kun spyod/ dwang ba 'dren pa gnang rgyu de ha cang gal chen po 'dug de tsho'i gras yag po ma byung na/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan gang 'dra yod med shes thub pa khag po red/phyi'i kun spyod rnam 'gyur gyi thog nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red/ bstan pa'i mtshan shas bzo mkhan de gra gzugs re zung gis bzos/mtshan shas de dge 'dun spyi la yong gi yod pas/ dge 'dun gyi sgrig lam kun spyod de dag dam pos dam bcing byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug dgon pa'i mkhan po dang / las kyi sne mor gtogs pa khag mdor na dpe 'khrid dge rgan dang / chos grogs tshun chad tsha nga mas khur mnyam len gyis gcig gis gcig la zhen bskul byas te dge 'dun spus dag po yong thabs la tshang mas do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug ci ste nges med tshang mas bslab bya ga stod byas kyang bzo bcos thebs rgyu med mkhan de tsho'i gras sgrig khongs nas dbyungs dgos pa las/ o stod byas nas bzhag na rtsa ba nas ma 'grigs pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi thog la dgon pa'i las sne tsam du ma zad/ lo gcig hun sur la'ang skad cha byung ba bzhin gzhis sgar rang gi 'go 'khrid dang / las byed pa tshos kyang khur mnyam len byed dgos/ dper na/ gra chas gyon mkhan 195

gcig gis mi mang khrod gang byung ma byung byed pa'i gnas tshul mthong ba yin na de tsho'i gras khungs gang yin brtsad gcod byas te khungs so sor rtsis sprod byas/ bslab bya byed dgos/ de 'dra'i khungs 'ded sa med mkhan gra gzugs sprang 'khyams byed mkhan de ri'adra yin na/ de la de 'tshams kyi bslab bya dang lam ston lta rtog do snang byed dgos/so thar gyi mdo las/ dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste/ /mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde/ zhes gsungs pa ltar chos sgar phan tshun gyi dge 'dun tshang ma thugs mthun po gnang dgos/ de snga bod la yin na/ skabs re grub mtha'i phyogs lhung 'then 'khyer byed mkhan phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ bar skabs nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas de 'dra'i gleng gzhi mi 'byung ched/ spyi yongs nas do snang byas te rim pas sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa tshang ma dag snang phyogs lhung med pa zhig dang / dam tshig gtsang du 'gro ba zhig byung yod/'di dngos gnas nga tsho'i byas rjes red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas dus tshod khag wa'i nang nga tsho sa gnas gcig la mnyam du bsdad/ phan tshun nang tshags dang skyo grogs lta bu chags/ phan tshun gyi gnas tshul shes rtogs 'og nas sems thag nye po byas te bsdad thub pa 'di gnas tshul khag po 'di'i 'og nas nga tshor slob sbyong dang / nyams myong gsar pa zhig byung ba red/ de ha cang yag po red/ nga tsho tshang ma ston pa gcig gi rje 'brangs/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la cadags ris then 'khyer byas na yag po sturton nas min pas/ gtso chen mkhan po rnam pa tsho dang / bla ma rnam pa tsho nas thugs khur chen po bzhes 196

dgos/ tshang ma thugs mthun po dgos pa gal chen po red/de nas slob sbyong gi thog la/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bod mi btsan byol ba'i phru gu rnams deng dus slob sbyong gi shes tshad de bod nang la yod pa'i bod phrug tsho las legs pa yod/ de nga tsho spobs pa skyes 'os pa zhig red/ yin na yang da dung phru gu'i shes yon gyi thog la tshang mas do khur byed dgos/ phru gu ke+o bdag so so'i ngos nas slob sbyong gi thog la do snang byed dgos pa rmos med thog ming rgyab 'khur gyi dge rgan tsho dang / de tsam du ma zad pha ma dang / khyim tshang gi nang mi tsho'i thog nas kyang phru gu'i shes yon gyi thog la rgyun du do khur byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ dper na/ pha ma bod nang gi 'grog pa dang /zhing pa'i sa khul nas yong ste ha lam bod yig 'bri klog ma shes mkhan yin na yang / so so'i phru gu slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa 'di chud zos ma btang bar phru gur shes yon 'jags thabs la do khur nges par du byed dgos/pha ma shes yon gyi thog la de tsam gyi cha rgyus med pa dang / do snang med mkhan tshos phru gus yi ge bris klog shes tsam byung ba dang khos yi ge shes kyi yod ces de tsam gyi chog shes byas te slob sbyong bar mtshams 'jog pa de 'dra byas na mi 'grigs/ phru gu so so'i ngos nas slob sbyong byed ma thub pa yin na ni gnas tshul khag khag red ma gtogs/ de min slob sbyong snyugs bsring nas byas te slob sbyong mdzug skyong thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po red/ slob sbyong mjug skyong ma zin gong nas bu bu mo gnyen sgrig byed pa dang / nang las bskul ba/ sud krar stong las bskul rgyu'i don du phru gu slob gra nas 'then pa sogs byas na yag 197

po khyon nas ma red/ phyogs gcig nas slob sbyong la do snang byed pa dang / gnyis nas slob sbyong mtha' 'khyongs pa byed rgyu de ha cang gal chen po red/nga tshos bod rang dbang bsgrub kyi yin zer gyi yod/ nga tshor bod rang dbang bsgrub rgyu'i las 'gan yod/ bod rang dbang bsgrub stangs de 'dzings res btang nas bsgrub rgyu ma yin par bden pa'i stobs shugs 'khyeranas bden pa'i brdar sha bcad pa'i thog nas nga chos rang dbang bsgrub thabs byed kyi yod/de la yang shes yon dgos gal shin tu chen po yod/ ma 'ongs pa la bod gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung nas skal bzang gi nyi ma shar ba'i skabs la rang nyid kyi shes bya yon tan gyi thog nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i zhabs 'degs bsgrub thub pa zhig dang / so so'i yul lung nang la 'dzugs bskrun dang / 'dzin skyong gi zhabs 'degs bsgrub thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ de ltar spyi sger gang gi cha nas kyang shes byaspenan tan deta cang dgos gal chen po yin pas khyed rang tshang mas do snang chen po byed dgos/ phru gu rang gi ngos nas slob sbyong byed thub mkhan zhig la nang khyim gyi dka' ngal la brten nas 〈ba sbyong mtshams 'jog byed dgos byung ba yin na/ thub ma thub gnas tshul khag khag red ma gtogs/ gzhis 'go bde don tsho la yang 'bod bskul 'dra byas/ de min shes rig las khungs dang / bod phrug khyim sde yas mas de tsho la'ang 'bod bskul 'dra byas te thabs shes byed kyi yin na thabs shes byed thub kyi red/ de tsam du ma zad/ gzhis sgar so so'i nang spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs mnyam las zer mkhan de 'dra yod pa de tsho'i thog nas kyang blta rtogs rogs ram byed thub pa 198

yin na de tsho'i gras babs 'os red/ gzhis chags nang la yod pa'i khyim tshang 'byor ldan tsho'i nang nas kyang rogs ram byed dgos/ deng sang bal yul nang nas bod pa 'byor ldan kha shas kyis bod pa'i phru gu brgya phrag skor la slob sbyong gi mthun rkyen sbyar gyi yod pa red/ de tsho ha cang yag po red/ de tsho'i gras kha sang phru gu sto zur du thug pa'i skabs la skad cha byung / 'dzam bu gling gi sa phyogs gang du bltas pa yin kyang nga chos shes gsal red/ mi la shes yon yag po yod pa yin na yang / lhag bsam yag po ma byung na shes yon yod pa des phan rgyu'i tshab la gnod pa'i rang bzhin can chags rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa red/ de nas phru gur shes yon yod pa dang chabs cig lhag bsam rnam dag gi mi bzang po zhig yong thabs 'bad rtsol nges par du byed dgos/ deng sang phyi rgyal lung pa yar rgyas phyin pa de tsho'i nang dka' ngal mang po 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa de tsho'i gras slob sbyong ma ldang pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad pa phal cher ma red/ spyi tshogs nang la mi gsod res byed pa dang /khram pa khram nag gi byed spyod thabs sdug mang po yong gi yod pa 'ga' zhig dpal 'byor sogs kyi dka' ngal thog nas yong gi yod kyang / gtso che shos ya rabs spyod bzang gi bslab byas ma ldang pa'i skyon yong gi yod/ lung pa yar rgyas phyin pa tsho'i nang la thog mar ya rabs spyod bzang dgos pa'i bslab bya dgon pa tshos byed pa dang / shes bya yon tan sprod rgyu de slob gra khag tshos 'gan 'khyer ba yin pa red/ de nas bslab gra yar rgyas mtha' med pa phyin/ spyi tshogs nang la chos dad chung du phyin/ ya rabs spyod bzang thog la blta rtogs 199

byed mkhan dang / khur len mkhan med pa lta bur gyur te spyi tshogs nang la dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad yong gi yod pa red/ nyams myong de tshor bltas te bod pa'i spyi tshog sa nang shes bya yon tan yod pa dang chabs cig ya rabs spyod bzang mnyam du 'gro thub pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ nga rang tsho bod pa rang la gna' rabs nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung bzang po yod pa 'di'i thog nasaya rabs spyod bzang nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu red ma gtogs/ phyi rgyal la dpe blta sa rtsa ba nyid nas yod pa ma red/ deng dus kyi shes yon yar rgyas gtong stangs skor nga tshos phyi rgyal la dpe blta gi yod pa ltar/ da dung yang blta dgos/ ya rabs spyod bzang slor phyi rgyal tshos nga rang tsho bod pa la tshur mig dpe lta gi yod pa ma gtogs nga tshos phar mig dpe blta sa yod pa ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / lhag par theg pa chen po'i chos kyi nang la bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i gnas tshul 'di dpe ma srid pa'i rtsa ba chen po yin/ phan pa'i bsam pa de lhag bsam gyi rtsa ba/ phan sems med na lhag bsam ha cang khag po red/ de lta bu'i phan pa'i bsam pa zhes pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi bslab bya gtso bo de nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la goms gshis su 'jags thub pa zhig nges par du byed dgos kyi 'dug pha ma tsho dang / bslab gra'i dge rgan tsho/ spyi tshogs spyi yongs kyi nang la ya rabs spyod bzang gi goms gshis dang / tshor snang mngon gsal dod po zhig yod na/ spyi tshogs de'i nang la skyes/ de'i nang la 'tshar longs byed mkhan gyi 200

phru gu de dag la rang shugs kyi goms gshis de 'jags thub kyi red/ dper na/ bod pa'i phru gu zhig gis chos shes kyi med na yang / chung chung skang nas 'bu srin lta bu bsad nas tsi sdig pa yod pa red zer mkhan zhig yong gi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la ya rabs spyod bzang gi goms gshis 'jags dgos pa de gal chen po yin pa la ngos 'dzin byas te dus rgyun du do khur byed dgos kyi 'dug dpal 'byor yar rgyas phran bu phyin pa'i skabs la dwangs bstod byed pa dang / gcig gis gcig la mig 'gran rgyu ngoms byas nas spyi tshogs nang la mig ltos shas gzhi de 'dra yong ma srid pa ma red/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigasaya rabs shig gi 'tsho dang ma 'tsho'i gnas tshul la 'brel ba yod pa yin dus gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug do snang yag po byed dgos kyi 'dugamang tshogs kyi nang la shes yon yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / nang pa'i chos kyi snying bsdus shes thabs bya rgyu'i ched du/ ma gzhi de sngon nas shes yon tshogs chung de 'dra btsugs yod pa red/ dper na/ 'dir bud med tshogs pa dang / gzhon nu tshogs pa/ de min tshogs pa khag cho'i thog nas mang tshogs la deng dus kyi shes yon dang / chos dang 'brel ba'i ya rabs spyod bzang gi bslab bya'i skor bla ma zhig gi bka' chos skabs ma gtogs go rgyu med pa de 'dra min par/ dus rgyun ldan nas tshes bzang dus bzang 'dra dang / las seng rigs la mang tshogs dang / lhag don gzhon nu pho mo tsho 'dzoms nas bgro nga gi tshogs 'du 'dra po tshogs/ yang rgan gras khag nas snga rgyus da rgyus 201

kyi gtam rgyus 'dra bshad/ de 'dra'i thog nas bod mi'iya rabs spyod bzang de tsho'i gras tshang mas thos rgags thub pa dang / so so'i goms gshis la 'jags thub pa byed rgyu'i thog la nges par du bsam slo gtong dgos kyi 'dugagasum pa dpal 'byor gyi sgor la/ chos kyi jog nas bshad pa yin na yang chos nor 'dod dang thar pa/ zhes nor de 'phral gyi phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i yo byad cig yin pa red/5 spyir btang spyi tshogs nang dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed dgos pa dang /ba nga tsho 'dir btsan byol ba rnams so so'i lus po so so rang nyid kyi rkang pa'i steng langs thub pa byed dgos pa so so'i rang 'gan yin/ da cha las bsdoms nang la bshad pa bzhin/ mi 'bor mang du 'gro gi yod pa dang / mthun rkyen sa cha rgya che ru 'gro thabs med par brten sa cha 'di ga'i thog nas thon 'bab che ru 'gro ba'i thabs shes shig ma byas na 'grigs kyi med/ ga le ga ler rgas po rgan mo mang du phyin/ gzhon skyes tshor yang phru gu mang du phyin/ rgan byis gso skyong byed rgyu'i 'gro song gtong sa mang du 'gro rgyurayong khungs da phan gyi byed stangs sus ṭar gyi tshong las gcig pu min pa'i thabs shes gzhan dag bsam blo ma btang bar bsdad pa yin na nyen kha red/da lta bzang po'i las bsdoms nang la bshad pa ltar gsar gtod byed rgyu'i 'bad rtsol dang tshad tshad bsdur bsdur mang po byed kyiyod pa de rjes suyi rangs kyi gnas red/ ha cang yag po 'dug nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos/de dang chabs cig deng sang so nam gyi las ma'i thog la rim pas 'thus shor 'gro ba'i bzo blta zhig thon gyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug nga tshor sa cha chung 202

chung zhig ma gtogs med na yang / zhing las 'phrul chas can la bsgyur dgos kyi 'dug ces sngon ma nas bshad yod/ der nges par du shugs brgyab nas zhing lasa'athus ma shor ba zhig mu mthud nas byed dgos/ ji tsam 'phrul las kyi thog nas byas pa de tsam mi'i lus po'i dka' ngal chung ba'i khe phan yong gi red/ de snga bod kyi 'grog sa nas yong pa de tsho'i gras zhing las ma shes par dka' las khag po byung yod kyang / dka' ngal dang len byas yod/ mi thog gzhon pa tshos skadayig phran bu shes/ 'gro stangs phran bu shesayong dus 'jor dang sbyag mar lag pa 'chang na de dman pa lta bu byed pa de yag po ma red/ de tsho'i gras yar rgyas kyi rnam pa gang yang min/ a mi ri ka lta bu phyi rgyal lung pa tsho'i nang la zhing las byed pa dang / dper na za khang gi g.yog rgyug pa/ ka yol dang sder ma 'khru mkhan/ slob gra'i gad phyis byed pa sogs las rigs gang yin kyang thon skyed yod pa dang / yong 'bab yod pa'i las ka zhig yin phyin chad la de la dga' po byed pa ma gtogs/ las ka yag nyes kyis mi la mthong che chung brtsi gi mi 'dug so so'i shes yon dang / las ka mang nyung dpag pa'i gla phogs che chung ni yod pa red ma gtogs/ gzhan las rigs gang yin kyang de la spam shor mkhan su yang med/ nga tsho 'di gar slob sbyong phran bu yod pa zhig yin na/ so nam zhing las byed rgyu ma 'os pa lta bur lta ba 'di nor 'khrul red/ de 'dra byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ so nam gyi las ga'i thog 'thus ma shor ba nges par du byed dgos/ yang so nam byed stangs snga mo nang bzhin skug pa tshugs min par/ las sla ba dang / phrod che ba'i so nam 203

'phrul las can la bsgyur dgos/ de min gyi shing tog sna tshogs kyi thon skyed sogs las rigs sna tshogs kyi thabs shes byed rgyu yod 'gro/ ngas gcig dang gnyis kyis bshad thub kyi mi 'dug la/ shes kyi yang med/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul shes mkhan tsho la slob ston 'dra zhus/ don snying thon skyed gang mang yong thabs la do snang byed dgos/ bar skabs hun sur la sa zhing gi thon skyed de tsam med stabs 'o ma'i thon skyed byas nas phan thogs byung song / gzhis sgar 'di'i nang la yang bar skabs phyugs las kyi thon skyed thabs shes byas yod pa 'di tsho'i gras 'thus ma shor ba byed dgos/ de snga phan chad lo mang po'i nyams myong byung ba de dag gzhi la bzhag nas da dung yar rgyas gang 'dra gtong dgos kyi 'dug bsam blo gtong dgos/ yar rgyas mthong rgyu yod pa zhig dang / yar rgyas bstan rgyu yod pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ de snga a'u tsam yod de deng sang sdug tu phyin 'dug zer na skad cha de mi snyan pa red/ tshang mas do snang yag po byed dgos/ de nas da gin skad cha byung ba bzhin gsar gtod kyi rigs gang dang gang byed rgyu yod dam/ gzhis chags nang la khyim tshang sgor so so 'byor pa'i gnas stangs drag tu phyin/ nga tsho'i mnyam las khag spyi rta sgal ral du lus te 'thus shor yong gi 'dug mi tshang phran bu'i skyid sdug drag pa tsho'i jodzig la mnyam las kyis phan thogs de tsam med na yang / gzhis chags 'di'i nang gi mi skyo ba 'di dag dang / spyi pa 'di dag la mnyam las kyi thog nas da lta phan chad la phan thogs byung yod pa ltar/ ma 'ongs pa yin kyang nges par du phan thogs yong rgyur mnyam las kyi thog la nges par du do snang yag po byed 204

dgos/ mnyam las tshags ma tshud pa yod na tshags tshud pa bzo rgyu dang / da dung yar rgyas 'gro thabs la nges par du las 'gan 'khri ba tshos bsam slo btang / 'char gzhi bkod de sems khur bskyed dgos/ 'char can gyi las ka de byas te 'char can gyi phogs de zas/ so so 'khyur ba'i skabs la mi gsar pa der rtsis sprod thub tsam zhig byas pas la dag gi yod pa ma red/ de dag wo re nas lo re yar rgyas kyi rnam pa gsal po thon pa zhig nges par du dgos kyi 'dugade nas don tshan gcig sgrig 'dzugs skor la/ sgrig 'dzugs skor che mu nas nga tsho btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ de bzhin btsan byol gros chogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs 'di dag bod rang dbang rtsod len byed rgyu'i chab srid jog la gnad 'gag yod pa tsam du ma zad/ btsan byol ba'i spyi tshogs 'di'i nang la shes yon dang / 'phrod bsten/ dpal 'byor sogs gang ci'i thog la gnad 'gag chen po dang / 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ dper na/ gzhis chags 'di'i nang la cha bzhag na/ 'dir sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa'i skabs la yas 'grig gi mi 'dug mas 'grig gi mi 'dug ces kha gtong sa dang / skyon brjod byed sa'i bzo 'dra zhig ma gtogasacasang gi yod pa ma red de/ gal srid gzhis chags 'di'i nang la spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di med pa'i dbang du btang ba yin na/ khyed rang tsho spyi byings rnams mgo 'don lta rtogs sus byed kyi red/ dpal 'byor phran bu yod mkhan tsho so so mgo thon 'gro gi red de/ spyi byings 'di dag 205

la mgo 'don mkhan med na ha cang dka' las khag po red/ 'phrod bsten gyi skor dang / slob sbyong skor/ dpal 'byor gyi skor/ 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs sogs gang ci'i skor la so sor dka' ngal zhig 'phrad song na spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'dir sngon la re ba rgyag sa zhig ngang / skad rgyag sa zhig yong gi yod/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gang yang med na gang 'dra zhigayong ba 'dugade la bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs khag gi rtsa ba de dha ram sa lar yod pa'i btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs de red/ btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs de yod pa'i nyer len gyis 'dzam bu gling phyi rgyal khag gang sa la 'brel ba zhig yong gi yod pa dang / sgrig 'dzugs des nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags khag yongs rdzogs la khyab yong gi yod pa red/ de nas chab srid kyi gnas tshul la mtshon na/ nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba rnams chab srid kyi gnas tshul 'og nas nga tsho mi'i lung par gyar ba ma gtogs/ bod la chu log 'dra po 'byung ba'i gnod 'tshe byung ste nga sto btsan byol la gyar ba min/ rgya mis bod nang btsan 'dzul thog bod mir tshad las brgal ba'i sdug sbyong dang /bsam ngan gyi 'char gzhi bting pa de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa red/ da cha nga tsho 'gyel sa nas langs thub pa'i bsam blo btang nas bsdad yod/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos nga tsho btsan byol la yod pa'i bod pa tshor re ba rgyag gi yod pa dang / nga tshos kyang bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag gi sems shugs la brten nas bsdad yod/dper na rgya mi'i gzhung nas gang 'dra byed kyi 'dug gam/ bod pa sgor so so 20 6

bod la 'gro mkhan tsho rgya mi'i gzhung tshab sar phyin pa'i skabs la mkhas thag chod byas te gtong gi yod/ bod btsan byol gzhung gi ming thog nas 'brel ba byas na ha cang mkhregs po byed kyi yod/ dper na/ bar skabs 'das pa'i lo bco lnga lhag tsam gyi ring la pe cing dang nga tsho skad cha bshad rgyu'i 'bad rtsol rim pa byas pa red/ de tsho'i skabs la tā la'i bla ma sger gyi mi yong pa yin na dga' bsu yod/ tā la'i bla ma'i spun yong pa yin na dga' bsu yod/ bod btsan byol gzhung zer ba'i gzhung zhabs de 'dra yong pa yin na ngos len med ces rgya mis dbye 'byed gtong gi 'dug rgya mis dbye 'byed btang dgos pa de chab srid kyi gnad don gal chen po zhig la thug nas btang ba red/ de ltar nga tsho'i btsan byol gzhung 'di gal gnad chen po chags kyi yod pa de shes dgos/nga tsho'i spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di spyi pa'i gzhung yin par ngos 'dzin gyi thog nas 'di la tshang mas rgyab skyor dang / sha zhen nges par du byed dgos/ kha gtong sa zhig yod na yod pa de yag gi red/ tā la'i bla ma gcig pu ma gtogs de las lhag pa'i bya spu gnon gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig med na ha cang khag po red/ ngas 'go 'khrid pa'i bod btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa yin dus/dper na/ nga'i sa la mi gcig gis nga'i phru gu slob grar tshud ma song nga'i phru gu/ nad pa yin zhes zer na/ ngas 'phrod bsten las khungs sam/ yang na shes rig yang na chos don dang / nang srid sogs 'brel yod las khungs ga cig la lab sa zhig yod pa red/ bya spu gnon gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig med na/ gal srid mi 'ga' zhig gis nga'i phru gu slob grar tshud ma song nga'i phru 207

gu gcig nad pa yin zhes lab na nga mi gcig gis gang yang byed mi thub/ nga sbyor btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di gal chen po red/dngos yod gnas tshul la'ang btsan byol gyi sgrig 'dzugs 'dis ya gi'i.a ru na cal nas/ la dgas bar gyi gzhis chags tshang mar lta rtog byed kyi yod pa dang / che sa nas bshad pa yin na 'dzam bu gling rgyal khab sum cu so grangs shig gi nang la bod pa kha gram te bsdad pa tshang mar sgrig 'dzugs 'dis 'brel ba byas nas phan thogs yong gi yod/ bod nang la cha bzhag na'ang phyi rgyal la bo da pa 'bum gcig tsam las med na yang btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa de'i cha nas bod nang la yod pa'i mi mang gi bsam cho'i nang re ba rgyag sa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs gal chen po yin par brten nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi las dge 'dun bzhi gra yan gyis byed dgos pa'i sgrig 'dzugs/ bzos gnang yod/ nga tshor sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di yang mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro gi yod/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu so lnga tsam de'i ring la nga tshos mang gatsho'i ngo bor bsgyur rgyu'i 'bad rtsol rim pa byas yod/ de snga dga' ldan pho brang zer ba'i ngo bo de da cha mang gatsho'i rang bzhin can la 'gyur bsdad yod/ da dung yin na'ang nga tshos mang gtso'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa zhig yong thabs la 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod/ da lta byas pa tsam du ma zad ma 'ongs pa la bod gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i mtshams la yang nga tsho'i gzhung 'di brgya cha brgya tham pa mang gtso'i gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyu de dag yig gzhi dang 'brel ba'i thog nas thag 208

gcod gtan 'bebs byas zin pa red/ de ltar cha/nga gtso'i rang bzhi na can gyi gzhung rnam par dag pa zhig yong ba la mi mang mi re ngo res sems khur blang dgos/ 'gan 'khyer dgos/ de snga bod pa'i kha rgyun la sde pa gzhung gi byus gtogs sde srid mgo leb pas byed kyi red zer ba de tsho spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skad cha red/ mi mang gis spyi pa'i 'gan khur blang dgos zer ba de las khungs mi re ngo re'i nang la so sos phyin te byus gtogs byed rgyu'i skad cha ma red/ las khungs de dag yongs rdzogs la blta rtogs byed mkhan dang 'gan 'khyer mkhan mi de mang mos kyis bskos pa'i mi des 'gan khur len dgos pa red/ deng sang gzhis sgar so lo'i nang la yang da lta las ka byed mkhan rigs gcig 'os bsdu'i thog nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ dper na/ gzhis 'gor cha bzhag kyang sa khul 'di ga'i mi mang gi 'os bsdu byas te bskos na 'grigs pa nga tshos gtan 'bebs byas yod/ phyogs gcig nas spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gal chen po yin pa dang / gnyis nas nga tsho mang gatho'i sgang la 'gro gi yod stabs mi mang mi re ngo res 'di'i jog la sems khur blangs/ do khur byed dgos/ rgyun du do snang byas nas gnas tshul gang ci mgo 'tshos pa byed dgos/ se ra byes kyi sgo gra'i nang la bod btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gro stangs gang 'dra gang 'dra yin pa ris mo bris 'dug las khungs go rim gang 'dra gang 'dra yod pa ris mo bris pa de snying rje po 'dug de 'dra byas nas tshang mas shes pa byed dgos/ 7rgyal ba rin po che dha ram sa lar bzhugs yod pa dang /btsan byol gzhung dha ram sa lar yod pas la dag gi yod pa ma red/ spyi 'thus 209

gros tshogs kyi 'gro stangs gang 'dra zhig yod pa dang / 'dzin skyong bka' shag gi 'gro stangs gang 'dra yod pa/ las khungs khag gang 'dra gang 'a dra yod pa de dag shes pa byed dgos/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs la tshang mas do snang dang /sems khur nges par len dgos/ sa gnas so so'i sgrig 'dzugs la yang khyed rang tshos brtsi bkur yag po byed dgos/ ngas sgrig 'dzugs la brtsi bkur byed dgos zer ba 'di sgrig 'dzugs kyi btsan dbang bshad kyang de 'khyer dgos/ma drang ma 'os pa byas kyang de 'khyer dgos zer ba min/ nga tsho mang gtso yin dus mang gtso'i sgrig 'dzugs der brtsi bkur byed dgos/ sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang la las ka byed mkhan mi zhig gis gal srid rgyu rngan rjes 'brang ngam/ nye dga' phyogs lhung ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i las ka nor 'khrul byed kyi 'dug na de la skyon brjod byed chog mi 'dis ma 'os ma drang ba 'di 'dra byas song zhes gong rim la dag 'bud byas na 'grigs/ bden pa mtha' bskyel gyis thog nas kha mchu rgyag sa sku(da/ gros tshogs la zhu sa yod/ bka' shag la zhu sa yod pa red/ ma 'ongs par mang gtso yag po zhig yong rgyu'i don dag la khrims khang dang / gros tshogs/ 'dzin skyong bka' shag bcas gsum po de dbang cha bgo gsha' byas nas las don sgrub kyi yod/ da lta'i char nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas rgya gar nang bsdad yod pas spyir btang khrims kyi 'gro stangs rgya gar gyi khrims la bstun rgyu ma gtogs med kyang / ma 'ongs pa la nga rang tshor khrims khang rang btsan pa zhig dgos kyi yod par brten de'i sa bon lta bu sa bcad ma stong tsam gyi khrims khang zhig nga tshos btsugs yod pa 'di'i 210

nang bod mi nang khul gyi gyod zhib las don byed bzhin pa red/ dper na/ gzhis 'go gcig gis ma 'grigs pa 'am/ yang na/ bka' blon gcig gis ma 'grigs pa byas song na/ ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i rgyu mtshan khungs skyel 'pher ba zhig yod payin na khrims khang mtho shos der gtugs bsher byas na 'grigs/dper na/ khrims kyi mdun sa la 'go 7rgyal ba rin po che dang / gzhis chags shig gi nang lasku/da pa'i mi nyam thag gcig 'dra mnyam red ma gtogs/ 7rgyal ba rin po cher thob thang che ba dang / mi mang nyam thag cig la thob thang chung ba rtsab nyid nas71da pa ma red/ de ltar ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i gnas tshul rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yod na nges par du bshad dgos/ bshad sa sgo ma 'gag pa/ sgo phye nas bzhagayod pa red/ rgyu mtshan khungs lung gang yang med pa'i sgrig khrims ma 'khyer na mi 'grigs/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi nus pa nyams chags phyin pa yin na mthar thug gyong mang tshogs la phog gi yod pa red/ so sgoyod sa'i spyi tshogs de tshags tshud pa dang / gra 'grigs po yag po zhig byung ba yin na des mang tshogs la phan gyi red/ yang tshuraphyogs 'dir spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs nang la las ka byed mkhan tshos kyang rang nyid la 'gan chen po zhig yod bsam pa'i thog nas phogs len thub tsam dang / ming 'khyer nas /ba stegs sgang la bsdad thub tsam ma yin par/ so so'i ming rgyab 'khur gyi las 'gan de cha tshang sgrub thub pa'i sems khur len dgos/ so so las ka byed sa'i sde tshan gang yin kyang de'i nang la grub 'bras thon pa zhig dang / byas rjes thon pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/211

de bzhin du gzhon nu dang / bud med tshogs pa sogs spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i 'og nas so so so so'i sde tshan sde tshan yod pa tshang mas sems khur blangs te de snga phan chad la hur thag byed kyi yod pa red/ da dung yin na'ang tshang mas khur blangs nas hur bskyed byed dgos/ spyi tshogs nang la phan thogs chen po yod pa red/de nas gnas tshul gcig la/ yul pa tsho la mthun po byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug bar lam dha ram sa lar gnas tshul zhig byung ba red/ de'i rtsa ba rgya gar ba srid don las ka byed mkhan mi re zung gi byed las nas byung ba zhig red/ spyi yongs la gzhigs na bod pa sto dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs yar rgyas phran bu phyin/ spyod lam bzo min gyi thog nas skabs re rgya gar ba yul pa tshor mthong tshul mi bde ba phran bu yong gi med dam snyam/ gang ltar gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul zhes lo rgyus kyi thog nas gus bkur byed sa zhig yin pa ltar/ nga rang tsho'i bsam cho'i nang la spyir btang rgya gar ba tshor brtsi bkur yod na yang / rgya gar ba kha shas gyon gos skyo po dang / 'ga' shas rnam 'gyur bstan stangs yag po rang med pa'i rkyen byas/ bod mi bsam med blo chung 'ga' zhig gis khong tshor mthong chung byed mkhan yong gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug de 'dra nam yang byed mi rung /nga rang tsho bod pa tshor de 'dra'i dngul mang po med kyang / sbag sbag de 'dra nyos/ tshig khebs 'dra gyon/ gyon chas skrag chen po de 'dra gyon pa des rgya gar ba'i mig snang la mthong tshul mi bde ba yong gi yod chod 'dug yo gcig 212
