hun sur khul du rgya gar ba bod pa la sha tsha yod mkhan zhig gis de 'dra'i bslab bya byas pa zhig ngas go thos byung / krog krog de 'dra ma byed/ sbag sbag cig nyos te bzhon pa yin kyang gong chung tsam byas na yag po red/ dper na rgya gar yul pa zhing pa tsho'i nang la sgor 'bum phrag bton rgyu yod mkhan yod kyang gyon gos skyo ra zhig gyon te bsdad pa ma gtogs/ khyed rang tsho bod pa nang bzhin byed kyi yodapa ma red ces bslab bya byas lugs ngas go byung / de dngos gnas 4sha tsho'i skad cha red/ bod pas krog krog byas pa de rgya gar ba'i mig snang la zan po chags kyi yod sa red/ de yag po mi 'dug gzab gzab byed dgos/rgya gar ba'i yul pa tsho la mthun po byed dgos/ spyi sgos gang gi thog nas bshad pa yin na'ang / spyir rgya gar gzhung drin chen po red/ yang sgos sa gnas so so'i yul pa tsho drin chen po red/ spyi yongs nas bshad na/ ngas rgya gar nang khul sa gnas gang sar bskyod skabs sa gnas so so'i rdzong dpon gyis mtshon pas rgya gar las byed pa tsho la skad cha dris pa'i skabs su bod pa yod sa tshang mar bod par bsngags brjod byed mkhan sha stag ma gtogs bod par skyon brjod byed mkhan ha lam go ma myong / de ga nang bzhin yul pa tsho'i nang nas kyang spyi yongs kyi thog nas bod par dga' po byed mkhan ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ yin na'ang nye ba'i char sa cha gang sar gleng ka phran bu yong gi yod pa dang / bar skabs rgya gar gyi gsar gyur tshags dpar de 'dra'i nang la yang phran bu thon song / 'ga' shas bod pa'i skyon gyi phyogs 'tshol sgrub byed mkhan 'dra yang med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa 'dug gcig byas na rgya mis kyang de 213

'drar 'brel ba yong mi srid pa ma red/ gang ltar nga rang chos dmigs bsal gyi gzab gzab dang do snang ma byas na yag po mi 'dugade dang chabs cig khor yug gtsang ma dang / khor yug srung skyob thog la nga tshos dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos/ ngas dzña ram sa lar rtag par bshad kyi yod/ nga la phyi rgyal gyi mi ngo shes pa de 'dra dang / ngo ma shes pa kha shas kyis yi ge btang 'byor byung / 7rgyal ba rin po ches khor yug skor bshad kyi yod kyang / 7rgyal ba rin po che yod sa dzña ram sa lar btsog pa 'dus / ces bshad mkhan byung / nga snubagra gzhis chags khag la yin na'ang khor yug gi thog la gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten/ shing sna 'debs 'dzugs byed rgyu sogs la do snang byed dgos/ ma gzhi sngon ma nas bshad yod pa red/ thog mar gzhis chags btsugs pa'i skabs la shing cha gcod thal shor ba'i gang ltar khor yug srung skyob dang / gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten thog la khyed rang tsho 'dir ming rgyab 'khur gyi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di'i thog nas 'bod bskul byas/ mi mang la slob gso btang / dus dus la de 'dra'i thog la tshogs 'du 'tshogs/go bsdur 'dra byas te sems khur len rgyu gal chen po 'dugade nas rtsa ba rgya bod gnyis kyi skor la deng sang gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig yod dam zer na/ da phan 'das pa'i lo bco lnga lhag tsam gyi ring la rgya nag gzhung dang nga tsho thad kur 'brel ba zhig byung / de nas bzung ngas nam rgyun dbu ma'i lam zer ba bzhin/ gang ltar rgya mi'i ngos la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa dang / bod pa'i ngos la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa de 'dra zhig gi thog 214

nas thabs lam zhig rnyed thub na bsam te 'bad rtsod byas pa red/ yin na'ang lo de dag gi ring la rgya bod gnyis skad cha bshad rgyu dang / bod nang gnas tshul phran bu drag tu 'gro rgyu de gnyis ga'i thog la grub 'bras gang yang ma thon pa red/ na ning zla ba brgyad pa nas ldi lir yod pa'i rgya mi'i gzhung tshab dang 'brel ba byed mtshams chad pa red/ deng sang bod nang la rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus mkhregs su 'gro gi yod pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur thon yong gi 'dug da lta de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul thog la bsdad yod/ yin na yang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod par rgyab skyor dang / do snang byed mkhan je mang je mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ rgya bod gnyis skad cha bshad pa'i thog nas dka' ngal sel thabs la rogs ram byed mkhanaskrug mi ri mas macesan pas rgyal khab 'ga' shas yod pa red/ de dag gis dngos dang shugs nas rgya nag gi jog la 'brel ba byas dang byed bzhin pa red/ da lta gang 'dra zhig chags grab yod med tshod thig gi mi 'dug ting zha'o phing bgres gog chags te kho rang gis thag bcad thub pa'i nus pa med pa chags/ da11na rigs gzhan dag de dag tshod ma thig rgi dus skabs yin dus thag gcod chen po byed pa'i spobs pa su la yang med pa'i gnas tshul thog bsdad yod pa red/ yin na'ang 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs kyi 'gyur ba dang / rgya nag rang gi nang la yang mang gca'i las 'gul byed mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ gtso che shos bod mi mang gi lhag bsam dang snying stobs zhum pa med par bsdad yod pa yin dus/ lo gnyis gsum nang la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i re ba chen po yod pa red/ da lta phan chad 'das pa'i lo bco lnga 215

lhag tsam ring la mes 'tshigs mer gtugs kyi thog nas thabs shes byas pa la grub 'bras thon ma song zhes nga tsho sgyid lug pa dang / zhum dgos pa rtsa ba nyid nas yod pa ma red/ deng sang rgya mi'i nang nas bod pa'i gnas tshul de bden don yin pa dang / bod pa la khag med pa/ bod pa la dngos gnas sha tsha dang / bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor byed dgos pa zhig mthong nas bod par do snang byed mkhan dang / rgyab skyor byed mang du mang du 'gro gi yod pa 'di ha cang rtsa ba chen po red/ da lta phan la nga'i bsam tshul der rgya nag gzhung nas brda lan dang / do khur gang yang byed kyi med na yang nga tsho'i ngos nas rgya bod gnyis mos kyi thabs lam 'tshol rgyu'i srid byus de da lta'ang 'gyur ba med/yin na yang kha seng gsum bcu'i dus chen skabs yongs khyab gsal bsgrags byas pa'i nang la bshad yod/ da phan lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam gyi ring la rgya bod gnyis mos kyi thabs lam zhig rnyed thabs byas pa da lta bar du ma 'grub pa red/da dung yun ring 'di mur lus na ngas ri bong rdo brdzus su bsdad pas 'grigs min stabs mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdu gi yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas pa yin/bsam tshul bsdu rgyu gtan 'khel song na/ mi mang gis dbu ma'i lam brgyud rgya bod gnyis mos kyi thabs shes byed pa'i srid byus de'i thog mu mthud nas 'gro dang mi 'gro bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / yang ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi thabs lam yongs grags byed pa'i skabs la skyon brjod byed mkhan bod pa'i nang dang / phyi rgyal gyi grogs po tsho'i nang dang / rgya gar gyi grogs po tsho'i nang la'ang yong gi 'dug de rnams kyi skyon brjod la nga'i langs phyogs de nus 216

pa chung drags pa red/ rang btsan gtsang ma'i thog la rtsod dgos/ rang btsan gtsang ma'i langs phyogs brtan po zin dgos zhes bshad kyi yod/ bsam tshul de'i thog tu yang go bsdur byas chog gi red/ de min gyi thabs shes gzhan dag gang yod bcas mi mang la gsal po byas te ngo sprod byas/ gnas tshul de dag gi thos la khyed rang tshos nyams zhib byas/ bsam blo btang / go bsdur byas/mtha' ma'i thag gcod mi mang gi 'os bsdu'i thog nas byas na snyam pa nga'i bsam tshul 'di yin/ de yang nga tsho btsan byol ba mi chig 'bum gsum khri tsam yod pa de dag gis thag gcod bya thabs med pas/ bod nang la yod pa'i gzhis lus mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdu dgos/ gzhis lus mi mang gi bsam tshul zhings grags byas nas bsdu thabs med na yang / phar tshur 'grul mi brgyud nas bsam tshul ga le ga ler bsdu thub kyi red/ a mi ri ku'i bod skad rgyang bsrings kyi thog nas kyang bod nang gnas tshul de thos thub kyi red/ de 'dra'i thog nas/ bsam tshul bsdu thub kyi red/ mi mi re ngo re'i thog nas bsam tshul bsdu ma thub kyang / bod chol kha gsum gyi sa khul yongs su rdzogs pa nas gnad yod mi tsho'i bsam 'char bsdu thub kyi red/ de la yang lo gcig gnyis shig 'asor srid pas nga tshos go sgrig byed kyi yod/ 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag 'ga' shas nas rgya bod gnyis skad cha bshad na yag po red ces rgya nag la bsam 'char bshad/ re 'dun byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya nag nang khul la'ang da lta 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa'i du sa tshod red/ des na zla ba kha shas sam/gcig byas na lo gcig tsam nga tshos blta zhib byed rgyu med dam snyam/ da lta'i 217

gnas stangs de 'dra zhig red/ de nas gal che shos ma 'ongs pa'i bod de brgya cha brgya tham pa mang gasgur rang dbang can de 'dra zhig la 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel zin pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag snga rjes skad cha byungayod pa ltar tshang mas shes gsal red/ gnad don 'di tshang ma'i bsam blo'i nang la nges dgos pa dang / lhag don bod la phar gnyen 'phrad la 'gro mkhan dang / bod nas tshur gnyen 'phrad lo yong mkhan tshos gsal sngob rgags thub pa'i gsal bshad byed rgyu de gal chen pa 'dugade nas bar skabs 'dir chu bzhi sgang drug gi thog nas gnas tshul lhags pa'i skor da gin bka' blon gyis gsal bshad byung song / chu bzhi sgang drug sgrig 'dzugs de nga tsho bod la yod pa'i skabs nas yod pa zhig red/ de dusakus 'brug mgon pa bkra shis sogs khong ce'i) gras kyis bstan par bsam nas rang srog blos btang gi thog nas sgrig 'dzugs de btsugs/ dka' las mang po rgyab yod pa red/ de nas rim pas lnga bcu nga brgyad nga dgu'i dus skabs la chu bzhi sgang drug gi sgrig 'dzugs de dbus gtsang / mdo stod smad chol kha gsum ga'i mi yod pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig chags pa red/ dang po sgrig 'dzugs de tshugs dus yang dag pa zhig tshugs pa red la/ sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i khungs nas mi mang po zhig lus srog blos btang gis 'das grongs phyin/ spyi don thog dka' las mang po rgyab yod/ lar nas mdo ྅rngod chol kha gal chen po yin pa smos mi dgos pa red/ nga rang tsho bod chol kha gsum zer ba 'di da lta'i gnas skabs tsam du ma zad ma 'ongs pa la yang skyid sdug legs nyes 218

gang sprudra zhig byung ba yin na'ang / chol kha gsum wa de skyid sdug gcig gyur byed rgyu nga tsho dang po btsan byol la slebs pa nas bzungs nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i srid byus de zin yod pa red/ dper na tshang mas rgyun du bton rgyu'i bden tshig smon lam nang la/ ring nas snying du brnags pa'i 'dod nga/'i don/ /yongs rdzogs bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ zhes pa'i yongs rdzogs zer ba'i tshig 'dis bod chol kha gsum yongs su rdzogs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i don bshad yod/ nga tshos smon lam de ltar 'debs kyi yod pa red la/ nga kle+o rtsa ba'i srid byus kyang de red/ bod kyi rig gzhung 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu'i thog la mdo stod chol kha'i khungs nas mi thog mang pos byas rjes chen po bzhag yod/ bar skabs kyi gnas stangs la mtshon na yang/ sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa 'di dag gi mkhan po slob dpon mang che ba mdo stod sma da kyi mi slebs yod pa dang / lhag don mdo stod kyi mi chags bsdad yod ri/ red/ bar skabs shig nas sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i nang gi las ka bye da mkhan 'ga' shas lhag bsam ma dag pa red ces lab mi thub/ nga'i ngos nas lhag bsam ma dag pa red bsam gyi med/ nga rang tsho3ོ bod pa su 'dra zhig yin na yang / bod pa'i sha zhen brlag ste rgya mir dga' sngod ged mkhan zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gus zhabs brlag mkhan de 'dra ha lam mi srid pa lta bu red/ yang lhag bsam ma dag pa ma red brjod pa de gcig pus kyang la dag gi med pa red/ bar skabs shig nas mdo stod sgrig 'dzugs kyi ming thog nas las ka byed stangs mang po zhig gi thog nas dka' ngal 'phrad yong gi yod/219

dper na/ lo gcig rdo je gdan la mdo stod kyi brtan bzhugs shig phul ba red/ de dus ngas lab rgyu byung / mdo stod kyi khams pa tshos khams rigs kyi zhen gog los byed/ de rgyu mtshan ldan pa red/ dgos kyi red/ yin na'ang zhen gog de rnam dpyod ldan pa zhig dgos kyi red/ de min bu glen pas pha yi klad pa bcom zer ba'i gtam dpe zhig yod pa de 'drar ma song ba dgos kyi red ces ngas lab myong / kha seng dha ram sa lara.a dar dang / bra'u dpon/sras don yod khong gsum chu bzhi skang drug gi nye char ldi lir tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i las bsdoms 7snyan seng zhu rgyuyod ces nga thug par slebs byung /las bsdoms sprad pa'i rjes la gsang ba'i 7snyan seng zhig zhu rgyu yod ces a dar gyi am phag nas yig skogs shig sprad byung / yi ge de klog par tha'i wan bod sogs las khungs kyi mi sna mnyam du yi ge zhig bzhag pa de red/ rnyogs khra tsha po zhig 'dug ngas khong tshor las ka de rnyogs khra chen po dang / 'gangs chen po zhig red/ nga la nang ma'i 7snyan seng yin/ zhes lab pas la dag gi ma red/ de tshogs gtso dang / bka' shag tshang mas shes pa byas na ma gtogs 'grig gi ma red/ gzhi nas khyed rang tshos chu bzhi sgang drug gi ming 'khyer nas las ka byed stangs mang po zhig la nga blo pham dgos pa'i gnas tshul mang po byung / da cha ngas khyed rang tsho la ma byed ma dag brjod de bslab bya byed rgyu'i 'dod pa yang med la/ ngas bslab bya byas na khyed rang tshos nyan gyi red bsam pa yang med/ khyed rang tsho rgyugs shigs lab pa yin/ yi ge de'i ngo bshus bzos te bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso la sprad/ de'i mjug la khong tsho gsum 220

po de yang bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso'i sar phyin te go bsdur bshad res mang po byung yod pa red/ gang ltar de'i sang nyin bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso gnyis yar phebs shog byas te sngon la nga'i bsam tshul gang yang ma bshad par/ yi ge de gang 'dra zhig 'dug gam zhes dris par/ tshang mas mthong tshul gcig gyur la de ha cang rtsa 'gangs chen po red ces gsung gi 'dug nga'i bsam tshul la'ang gnas tshul 'di ha cang khyad mtshar po zhig 'dug lar nas chu bzhi sgang drug gi ming 'khyer mkhan da lta las ka byed mkhan de dag sgor sde so so'i ngos nas bshad pa yin na nga'i ngo shes pa dang / grogs/ po sha stag yi/ na/ yin na'ang bar skabs kyi las ka byed stangs khyad mtshar zhig thodad gzhung dang dam tshig 'o chu gcig 'dres shig mo nga ba las ma sku nga ba dga' ba byed kyi yod pa'i baXge 'dra po/ bod gzhung gis chol kha gsum gcig bsgril gyi bsam blo btang gi yod pa ma red zer ba de 'dra'i skad cha bshad 'dug blo pham can tu chen po byung / nga bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig red/ ngas rdzun rang lta bshad shes kyi ma red/ don dag chung chung zhig yin kyang ngas bsam pa rnam dag byed kyi sku(da ma gtogs rdzun bshad kyi med/ ngas mi la rdzun bshad bsam pa dang / mgo bskor btang bsam pa ha lam med/chol kha 'di gal chen po'i chogeg la ngas mgo skor gang 'dra byas nas btang gi red/ mi mang la mgo skor gang 'dra byas nas bshad kyi red/ bshad shes kyi ma red/ nga'i bsam blo la yongs rdzogs bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal zer ba de la 'gyur ba sang yang med/ ngas 'go 'khrid pa'i btsan byol 221

gzhung gis nga'i bsam cho de gzhi la bzhag nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ ngas 'go 'khrid pa'i btsan byol gzhung la yid ches med par/ ngas kha nas bshad pa ma gtogs/ lag len ngo ma'i thog la chol kha gsum chig bsgril gyi bsam blo btang gi med pa 'dra zer ba'i skad cha de lta bu shod phod pa der ngas ya mtshan zhig mthong song / khyad mtshar po zhig nga la yid ches brlag pa red/ mang gtso'i 'gro stangs la cha bzhag pa yin na/ mi mang gi yid ches brlag gong na las ka de nyin nas bzhag rgyu ma gtogs las ka byed thub thabs sku(da pa ma red/ yin kyang chu bzhi sgang drug gi ming 'khyer bsdad mkhan mi re zung gi yid ches brlag pa ma gtogs/ rgya che'i mi mang gi yid ches brlag yod pa ma red bsam gyi yod/ gnyis nas khams pa'i nang khul la mtshon na bod nang gi khams pa phar bzhag rgya gar nang la yod pa'i khams pa phal cher stong phrag kha shas yod pa de dag gis kyang yid ches brlag yod pa red bsam gyi med /gang ltar khams pa mi mang spyi byings de dag gi bsam tshul gang yod med de gcig bsdur na yag po 'dug gal te khams pa mi mang spyi byings de dag gi bsam blo'i nang la'ang da lta chu bzhi sgang drug gi ming 'khyer mkhan mi de m+mu thag gcod byas pa la brgya cha brgya tham pa snangs mthun yin na/ nyin ma de nas bzungs bod chol kha gsum chig sgril zer ba'i skad cha de ngas tshig gi zur nas bton mi yong zhes bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso yod sar bshad rgyu byung /mjug la mang mos kyi bsam tshul gang yod med bsdu rgyu gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ rgya che'i khams pa mang che ba ha lam brgya cha dgu bcu go dgus de la 222

mos mthun med ces bsam tshul bton pa red/ yin dgos kyi yang red/ bar lam gyi yong stangs de 'dra red/ tshogs pa de deb skyel byas pa zhig yin dus bod gzhung gi bsgyur bcos gtong thabs med na yang / nga tsho bod gzhung gi ngos len ma byas pa red/ de'i mjug la dzña ram sa lar khams pa mang tshogs kyi tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs pa der mi grangs sum brgya sum cu so grangs shig slobs 'dug yul khag sum cu so grangs shig gi mi sna 'dzoms pa red/ kho rang chos go bsdur byas te mtha' ma yig cha zhig bzhag pa de dag yag thag chod byung 'dug de nas gtsang ma chags pa red/ de rjes chu bzhi sgang drug gi sgrig 'dzugs gsar pa zhig chags pa red/ de phal cher yag po zhig yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug gal che'i chol kha 'di'i ming 'khyer ba'i sgrig 'dzugs 'dis bod spyi pa'i don dag gi las ka byed mkhan btsan byol gzhung dang / phar tshur dam tshig 'o chu gcig 'dres gcig yid gcig la ches pa zhig byung bayin na nga rang tsho tshang ma blo bde po/ sems skyid po/ las ka nus pa jon thub pa yag po yong gi red/ rtsa ba'i mi mang gi bsam blor skyon med kyang / sgrig 'dzugs nang gi mi re zung gi byed stangs kyis rkyen pas don dag med pa'i dwogs pa dang / don dag med pa'i rnam rtog de 'dra spyi tshogs nang la slebs/ 'ga' zhig gis lam seng der sgro btags byed pa de tsho'i gras khyon nas mi dgos pa zhig red/ ngas da gin lab pa bzhin bod pa zhig yin phyin chad la gung khran tang yon yin yang rung / rgya mi'i phogs zan yin yang rung / bod pa'i zhen khog med pa yong mi srid pa red/ bod nang la cha bzhag pa yin na'ang phyi rtag 223

tu gung khran tang yon/ rgya mi'i las khungs nang la ming gnas mtho po yod pa'i bod pa zhig yin kyang nang rtag tu bod pa yin bsam pa'i bsam cho de ma shi bar du brjed thabs med pa zhig tshang mar yod pa red/ de snga nga bod la yod dus ngo shes pa'i bod pa gung khran tang yon mang po yod/ khong tsho'i bsam blo'i sbag rtsa der bod mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen khog khyon nas zub rgyu med pa zhig yorno pa red/ deng sang gi gnas stangs la mtshon na/ bod mi re zung re zung lta yong srid kyi red ma gtogs/ gzhan bod pa zhig yin phyin chad la bod pa'i la rgya de btsongs te rgya mi'i zhen khog byed mkhan mi srid pa red/ nga rang tsho btsan byol bar cha bzhag na de bas kyang smos mi dgos pa red/ nga rang tsho dngos gnas che sa nas bsam blo gtong dgos/ chung tsag gi thog la dogs pa rnam rtog mang po byed mi rung / so sor mthong tshul phran bu ma bde ba de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la lam seng zha mo chen po zhig g.yogs te kho gung khran gyi mi red/kho yas red mas red ces bshad rgyu de dang / yang skabs re khyim tshang phan tshun lta bur sger gyi na tsha yod pa de spyi tshogs kyi nang la zhwa mo g.yogs res byed pa de tsho'i gras yag po khyon nas mi 'dug de 'dra khyon nas byed rgyu mi 'dugargyu mtshan ldan pa'i gnas tshulayod pa yin na de dkar sa nag 'ded kyis brdar sha gcod dgos/ shod sa zhig la bshad dgos/ de min rgyu mtshan khungs skyel gang ya nga med par 'di yang min nam/ 'di yang min nam bsam nas gang sa ga la dogs pa byas/ srang lam gyi skad cha 'dra mi 'dra bshad de gzhis sgar gcig gi nang la yin na'ang gcig gis gcig la mthong phyogs chags/224

shog 'then byas pa yin na yag po khyon nas ma red/ ma 'ongs pa la gtso chen chu bzhi sgang drug gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'dis bod spyi pa'i don dag la tshang mas rgyag gcig mchong gcig phyar gru mnyam 'degs shig yong thub na bsam pa'i nga'i re ba dang bsam tshul de 'dra yin/ phal cher yag po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho mang tshogs kyi thog nas dkrog gtam gang byung la mgo ma 'khor ba byed dgos/ bar lam chu bzhi sgang drug gi gnas tshul de 'dra zhig red/da lta tha'i wan gyi gnas tshul skor la da gin bka' blon gyis gsungs pa de lhag nga la dmigs bsal bshad rgyu gang yang mi 'dug the wan gyi srid 'dzin gyi thog nas nga tsho bod pa mnyam du 'brel ba yag po zhig yong thub pa'i dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug tha'i bon lung pa'i nang la nang pa yang mang rngo/ yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas 'brel ba yag po zhig byung thub na bsam gyi yod/ bar lam lo mang po zhig gi nang la bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la dngul gyi shugs rkyen slebs pa'i rkyen gyis mthong phyogs dang /skad cha mang po lhags yod pa de dag gtsang ma zhig ma byung na 'brel ba byed rgyu khag po 'dug nga rang tsho rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi jog nas rgya dmar nag gnyis gral gcig la bzhag ste tshang mas langs phyogs brtan po zin nas bsdad pa 'di yag po red/ tha'i wan dang 'brel ba skog lkog sud sud min pa'i 'brel lam bzang po zhig gtod thub na bsam pa'i re ba yod na yang / da lta yag po zhig chags thub kyi mi 'dug de 'dra zhig gi sgang la bsdad yod pa red/225

gzhan dag zhu yag mi 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/da res gzhis sgar khul gang sar par tshur blta skor la 'gro rgyu byung ma song ste/ yin na'ang 'dir bdun phrag gsum tsam bsdad pa'i ring khyed rang tsho mi mang mang tshogs gang la gang 'tshams yong ste ngo shes pa mang po thug ste dga' po byung / spyir 'di ga'i gzhis chags kyi mi mang yongs rdzogs dang /yang sgos lhag par can du snga mo 'dir thog mar gzhis chags tshugs te shing rtsa bkog pa dang / shing rtsa bkog tshar ba'i rjes la tsha ba de'i dkyil du shing rtsa mer bsregs btang ste sdod mkhan/ de dus dka' las rgyag mkhan khyed rang tsho spo bo lags 'o lags kha shas da lta bsdad yod pa khyed rang tshor dmigs bsal gyi 'tshams 'dri yod/ khyed rang tshor dmigs bsal gyi bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ de dus ngas khyed rang tshor dka' las rgyag dgos/mjug la yag po chags thub kyi red ces togs la dang re ba bskul/ khyed rang tshos kyang 7rgyal ba rin po ches bshad pa la rmongs dad dang / 'dra ma 'dres se'i 11ga nas hur thag byas nas da cha gzhis chags da3rngos gnas yag thag chod 'di tshugs pa red/ gzhis chags yag po chags yod dus se ra chos sgar yang 'dir spos nas gra 'grigs po byung ba red/ 'di kho rang tsho'i 'dod mos byas pa ma red/ skabs der sbag sa chos sgar la ris med dge 'dun chig stong gsum brgya tsam yod/ sa gnas der tsha ba che ba'i khar/ mkha' rlung yang yag po med pa de 'dra'i gnas stangs 'og khong tshor lto chas 'bras dang 'bru rigs rnying pa 'khel te ha lam nad pa brgya phrag mang po byung ste dza drag dang /226

thabs skyo dze'i gnas tshul zhis/ chags pa de 'dra'i thog nas se ra chos sgar gzhis sgar 3di'i nang la tshur spos pa red/ spo dus mkhan po rnam pa tshos kyang gzhis chags nang dgon pa tshugs dgos byung na yag polge sku(nga zhes thugs khral chen po gnang song / 'on kyang nga tshos go sgrig de ltar byas par brten/ ngo ma chog lta bur 'dir spos pa red/ da cha tshang ma ltings 'jags te yag thag chod byung yong/ gang ltar gzhis chags 'di rnying shos dang / gzhi rgya yang che shos yin/da cha spyir btang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs kyang phal cher drag shos chags bsdad yod pa 'dra/ yang dpal 'byor gyi yar rgyas phyin pa'i skabs la rang mgo gang thon gyi bsam blo gtong ba dang gcig rgyu 'bras la ma bsam par sgom chung la thub tshod mgo bskor gtong ba dang gnyis/ de 'dra byas pa yin na jismug po yod pa ma red/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas nges par du 'gro dgos/'on kyang spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i nang la bsdad nas so so'i dpal 'byor nges/ spyi la yang phan thogs yod pa'i ngang nas sdod thub pa byung na yag po red/rang nyid dpal 'byor yar rgyas phyin pa'i skabs gzhan la stabs bstun dgos pa rnge/da bsam ste las 'bras khyad gsod byas na yag po khyon nas yod pa ma red/ya rabs byas/ lhag par dpal 'byor gyi nus pa skusad mkhan tshos mi mang nyams chung tshor rogs ram dang / blta rtogs byed thub na gal chen po red/ ma gzhi/ 'dir dmigs bsal gyi mi skyo po tsho'i thog la lta rtogs byed mkhan tshogs pa zhig btsugs na yag po 'dug ces sngon ma nas 'bod bskul byas pa ltar de 'dra yod pa red/ mi skyo po de tsho'i gras la dmigs bsal do snang dang blta 227

rtogs byed rgyu gzhis 'kho la yang mngags rgyu byung / skyo po dka' ngal yod pa de tsho'i gras lab sa ma rnyed par lhags yod na khyed rang tshos gzhis 'go don gcod la lab shog a/ snying rje/ skyo po nyam thag so sor bde sdug shod rgyu yod kyang shod sa der ma slebs par lhags pa de 'dra yod pa yin na/ khyed rang tsho grong pa/ bcu dpon brgya dpon tshos par tshur nang tshags rgyus yod byas te dngos gnas dka' ngal yod pa de tsho'i gras bdag med du ma lus pa'i don du tshang mas khur blangs nas blta rtogs byed dgos/ so sor bsod nams gsog gi red/ phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ de tsho gal chen po red/ spyi yongs kyi gzhis sgar yar rgyas 'gro gi yod na yang / khug kyog la skyo po nyam thag de 'dra lhags bsdad dus gang drag bsam pa dang / ya nga po de 'dra yong gi 'dug pas/ de 'dra ma lhag par tshang mas khur mnyam len byas nas sems khur len dgos/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ yang mjug la thug yong / 'di ga'i gzhis sgar gyi mi mang spyi byings tshor bdud rtsi chos sman dang /ma ṇi ril bu ras khug bzhi yod/ mi tshang tshang mar khyab pa zhig byed shog a zhes bka' 455// //228

༄tsho// phyi lo 1995 zla 1 tshes 18 mon go 'dod rgu gling gzhis sgar mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring las bsdoms skabs 'dir mi mang tshor zhu rgyu la/ nga rang tsho bod pa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la chos dang rig gzhung rnying shos kyi gras yod mkhan zhig red/ mi grangs nyung nyung yin na yang / chos dang rig gzhung gting zabayod pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i thog nas da lta dngosayod gnas tshul la/ gzhan dag la bsdur na bod mi'i bsam blo khog yangs pa dang / sems ltod pa yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa nang khul nas shes kyi yod pa ma red de/ bod pa la 'brel bayod mkhan phyi rgyal gyi mi mang po zhig gis mngon gsal dod po mthong gi yod pa red/ mdor na rgya mi'i nang nas kyang blo gzu bor gnas pa mang po zhig gis bod pa la lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin bzang poyod pa gcig dang / gshis ka yag po yod pa zhig mthong gi 'dug sems bag phebs po dang / ltod po sto pa 'di nyin re nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang la phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ de yong ba'i rtsab ni byams brtse la thug yod pas/ kha sang nas nga chor )na ma mang po skad cha bshad pa de tsho dang 'brel ba yod pa red/ chos kyi skad cha gcig pu ma yin par mi'i spyi tshogs nang la ya rabs spyod bzang zer ba 'di bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yin/ nga rang tsho la pha mes nas mig ltos rgyun 'jags yod pa'i bzang yi yon tan de dag gal chen por brtsis/ 'di so so'i gces nor yin pa ngo shes pa'i thog nas bdag po rgyag rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ nga'i ngos nas bod rang dbang rtsod len byed pa 'di chab srid kyi rang btsan gcig pu la blta 229

gi med/ nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung gal chen por brtsi gi yod/ des na chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur yin pa'i chol kha gsum gyi sa khul 'di dag tshang mar do khur byed dgos pa'i gnad 'gag gcig slebs yong gi yod pa red/ nga rang tshor ya rabs spyod bzang dang / zhi dul gyi mig ltos bzang po zhig yod pa 'di ma 'ongs par 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la spel thub pa'i nus pa dang cha rkyen lho pa 'di bsam blo 'khor thub pa zhig dang / ngos 'dzin thub pa zhig byung na/ des so so'i sems nang la spobs pa dang yid ches bskyed thub/ bya ba gang dang gang yin na yang bsgrub thub bsam pa'i sgobs pa dang yid ches de gal chen po yin/bsgrub thuba.e yong bsam pa'i the tshom dang / sems la zhum pa skyes na phyir bshig rgyag rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red/ nga rang tsho ser skya tshang ma'i bsam khra'i nang la so so nad rigs yin pa 'di spobs pa byed 'os pa zhig yin bsam pa dang / bya ba 'di nga'i las 'gan yin/ bsgrub thub kyi red bsam pa bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug da ring 'dir gzhis chags kyi las bsdoms nang la bshad pa 'di dag yar rgyas yag po byung ba lta bu 'dug hur thag 'bad thag byas 'dug yang las bsdoms nang la 'dra chags po zhig bkod/ rgyab logs la de min pa de 'dra yod na ni ma 'grigs pa red/ sa gnas sa thog la grub 'bras thon pa la zla ba dang lo sbrel nas 'go 'khri mkhan gyi 'go 'khrid/ dka' las rgyag mkhan gyis dka' las rgyab/ tshang mas snyugs bsring nas hur thag byas pa'i grub 'bras yin dus gzhis chags kyi 'go khrid mkhan tsho dang / las ka byed mkhan/ mi mang tshang ma la thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags khag 'di 230

dag phyogs gcig nas thod pa'i bzang wa'i goms gshis bzung sa'i bsti gnas lta bu yin pa dang / gnyis nas spyir btang byas na/ nga tsho btsan byol ba'i nang gi mi phran bu'i skyo ba rnams bsdad kyiyod pa red/ mi phran bu'i phyug pa dang / thabs shes thub mkhan tsho rim pas rim pas so so sger gyi lam kha btsal nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas gzhis chags nang la las ka byed mkhan tsho gzhan dag la 'gro ma thub mkhan dang / yang na bod gzhung gi lam ston byas pa 'di'i skang la brgya cha brgya tham pa blos bkal nas sdod mkhan tsho yin pa red/ gzhis chags 'di dag bod kyi rig gzhung dang / mig ltos bzang wa'i goms gshis bzung sa'i bsti gnas gal chen poyin/ 'dir las ka byed mkhan tsho bsod nams gsog rgyu'i las ka rlabs chen po zhig yin/ las ka 'di rlabs chung chung zhig min/ mi tshang gcig gnyis shig 'gro stangs bzos pa'i gnas tshul ma yin par mi rigs shig gi 'phral phugs kyi khe phan dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags bsdadayod/ lhag par du mi phran bu'i 'khyer 'khos zhan pa tsho dang 'drel ba yod pa yin dus/ dman pa la brtse ba'i bsam pa sbyang sa/ bsam pa sbyangs pa de'i sbyor ba lag len la 'gel yul yin pas chos phyogs nas bshad na ha cang gi go skabs bzang po red/ da lta phan chad la gur thag byas pa yag po red/ da dung yang tshang mas gur thag 'bad thag byed rogs zer rgyu yin/ de nas gzhis chags nang la yod bsdad pa'i mi mang dang / ris med chos sde khag sogs tshang mas gzhis chags spyi'i las 'gan gyi thog la'ang tshang mas khur mnyam len byas pa dang / bye brag tu so so so so'i 231

skabs babs kyi las 'gan re re bsgrub dgos kyi yod pa tshang ma gang lcogs ci phyogs tshang mas hur thag byas pa yag po byung 'dugade nas spyisku/ngas kyi thog nas bshad payin na/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so drug la nye ba phyin pa de'i ring la btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam gyi gra 'grigs po dang / tshags tshud po zhig chags bsdad yod/gzhis chags khag 'di dag nang nga tsho mi rabs nas mi rabs sdod dgos pa byung na yang bod mi rigs kyi bzang wa'i goms gshis dang / bod pa'i rnam pa rgyun 'dzin thub pa'i dmigs yul bzung pa ltar/ grub 'bras gang la gang 'tshams thon yong gi yod pa red/ mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod na yang / bod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang dri ma ma brlag par bsdad thub yod/ dper na/ khyed rang tsho bod nas da lta gsar pa yong mkhan tshos shes kyi red/ rgya gar gyi grong gseb sa cha 'di'i sgang la slebs dus bod pa'i grong gseb cig la slebs pa lta bu'i bod pa'i grong sde dang / dgon khag dar lcog sogs yod pa zhig mthong rgyu yod pa red/ka sbug dang / sho je gling de tsho'i nang la phyin pa yin na/ bod pa mthong rgyu yod pa tsam las/ bod pa'i rnam pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ gzhis chags khag la bod pa'i grong gseb kyi rnam pa gsal po yod pa 'di'i nang la skyes nas 'tshar longs byed mkhan tsho yang rang bzhin gyi bsam lha'i nang la bod pa'i bag chags shugs che ba yod pa'i dge mtshan byung yod/de nas gzhis chags khag phal che ba'i nang la dgon pa chos sde yod pa red/ gang ltar mon go ḍa 'dod rgu gling nang la bod nang skad grags yod pa'i 232

bshad gra gal chen po gnyis tshugs yod/ 'di dag ni nga tsho btsan byol ba'i nang lnga sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'i rmang gzhi dang rtsa ba tshugs bsdad pa zhig red/ deng sang bod nang mdo smad sa khul kha shas tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan spyi byings kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na/ bslab pa slob gnyer byed sa thod las rgya gar nang legs pa chags bsdadayod pa 'di grub 'bras chen po yin/ gnyis nas rgya gar nang la chos sde khag tshugs pa 'di dag gzhi rtsadang / ma gdan 'dra po byas nas 'dzam gling sa khul mang por deng sang bod kyi nang pa'i chos la do snang byed mkhan mang po yong gi yod yod pa red/ da lta chos don bka' chon gyis bshad pa ltar ha lam chos tshogs che chung nyis stong lhag tsam zhig yod pa rnams nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs gang la gang 'tshams sgrub kyi yod pa red/ de nas shes yon gyi skor la/ thog mar ne+e ru bzhugs pa'i skabs su nga tsho btsan byol ba'i phru gu 'di dag bod pa rang nyid kyi rnam 'gyur thon pa'i shes yon dgos kyi yod lugs zhus te/ bod pa'i bslab gra zur du btsugs/ gtso bo'i 'gro song rgya gar gzhung nas btang ste bod pa'i slob phrug khri gnyis gsum/ yas mas slob gra thon nas deng sang 'dzam gling gang sar ches mtho'i slob gra 'grims mkhan brgya phrag kha shas yod pa red/ slob gra thon nas nga choXrno las byed khongs su yang gang la gang 'tshams slebs bsdad yod/ gang ltar bod nang gi shes yon dang / rgya gar nang nga tsho btsan byol ba'i bod phrug gi shes yon gyi chu tshad bsdur na rgya gar nang drag pa ma gtogs/ skyo ba med pa lta bu de 'dra zhig 233

red/ da dung yang nga rang tshos mi rigs shig 'dzugs bskrun byed pa dang / mi rigs shig gi rang dbang sgrub pa/ mi rigs shig gi chos dang rig gzhung khyad chos ldan pa 'di dag mu mthud nas 'dzin skyong byed pa la shes bya yon tan shin tu gal chen po yin/ deng dus kyi shes sku1na yod pa'i thog nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di dag shes pa byas te 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa'i rig gzhung de zin thub pa zhig byed dgos/ nga rang tsho'i gna' rabs kyi shes yon yod pa'i thog la deng dus shes yon gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms pa de gnyis zung du sbrel ba'i thog nas so so'i spyi tshogs yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / 'dzam gling spyi la phan thogs sgrub thub pa byed dgos/ nga tshos rang dbang bsgrub pa'i skabs la yang shes yon gyi nus pa 'don dgos la/ rang dbang lag tu son pa'i rjes la yang shes sku(na gyi thog nas nus pa 'thosan rgyu gal chen po yin/bod nas tshur gnyen 'phrad la yong mkhan de tshor rtag par bshad kyi yod/da ring 'dir yang bod nas yong bsdad pa gang 'tshams yod pa red/ bod nang la yang de de bzhin slob sbyong thog la tshang mas do snang chen po byed dgos/ 'ga' shas sar rgya skad ma gtogs slob kyi med na yang gnas skabs thabs shes yod pa ma red/ gang ltar shes yon yod na yod pa rang drin che ba red/ phan thogs yong gi red/ bod phrug slob lo son pa tsho slob grwa la gtong rgyur 'bad rtsol nges par du byed dgos/ de gal cher brtsi dgos/ gzhon skyes pho mo tshor rtsa ba'i lcag bsam dang / so so'i mi rigs kyi sha zhen ha las pa yod na yang / skabs re chang 'thung ba dang / rtsed mor mgo yengs te nyin ma bskyal mkhan kha shas 234

yong gi yod tshod de sto ha cang phangs po red/ lo na gzhon pa'i skabs slob sbyong thog la do snang byed dgos/ slob grwa la 'gro gi yod min la ma ltos par rgyun du shes yon la dwang bstod dang / do snang byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dugade bzhin gyi las rigs khag nangaskudad mkhan tshos kyang so so las rigs gang 'dra zhig nang yod pa yin na yang / las rigs de'i 'gan cha tshang 'khyer thub pa'i bsam blo btang nas nyams myong gsog rgyu dang / slob sbyong byed rgyu gal chen po red/ kha nas rgya mi nga tsho'i lung par bsdad na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug bshad bsdad kyi yod pa red/ tho ga nyin ma gcig rgya mi log rgyu'i dus stod byung ba yin na/ las rigs 'ga' shas nang rgya mi'i lag rtsal ba med pas khungs ma 'khyol bar las rigs 'ga' zhig sgo rgyag dgos pa de 'dra byung ba yin na shin tu ngo tsha po red/ rgya mis bod pa tshos 'byon gyi mi 'dug ces khag 'dogs byed kyi lho/ bod pas ma 'byon pa de bod par slob sbyong dang / go skabs ma sprad pa'i thog nas ma 'byon pa chags pa ma gtogs/bod par go skabs sprad na 'tham gling rgyal khab sum cu so grangs shig gi nang la bod pa kha grams nas bsdadayod pa cho la slob grwa 'grims pa'i shesaspenan med na'ang las ga'i nyams myong bsags nas bod pas gyong thag chod dang / 'byon thag chod byas nas bsdad yod/ spyi yongs nas bshad na bod par go skabs byung na/ rgya mi las lhag pa ma gtogs/rgya mi'i mjug la rtsa ba nas sdod kyi ma red/ bod mis 'byon gyi mi 'dug zer mi dgos pa zhig lo gzhon pa tshos slob sbyong gi thog la shugs rgyab/ de min gyi las rigs nang la yod mkhan tshos gang cir do snang byas te rang mgo thon pa 235

byed dgos/ nga tshos bden pa'i ngos nas 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di lhag bsam gcig pusa.u btsugs byas pas mi 'grigs par/ shes byayon tan dang / 'acan thang nus pa ldan pa'i thog nas 'gro dgos/ dper na/ maha rdarma lhan dir cha bzhag na/ dngos gnas rang 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la brten nas rgya gar gyi rang dbang rtsod len byas pa red/ de yang lhag bsam gcig pu dang / rgya gar gyi shes yon yod pa gcig pu ma yin par/ deng dus kyi shes yon yod pa'i sgo nas rang dbang rtsod 'e na byas pa red/ yang deng dus shesayon shes pa dang chabs cig rgya gar gyi dri ma brlag pa yang ma red/ deng dus kyi shes yon yod pa/ rgya gar gyi rig gzhung rmang gzhi la bzhag ste so so'i gyon chas dang / nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba spyod lam cha tshang lag len bstar yod/ nga rang tsho yang shes yon gyi 11ga nas nus pa bton thub pa zhig ma byung na 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam bden pa bden sa la 'khyol ba byed rgyu 'di dpung dang / nus pa'i thog nas 'gro rgyu'i skad cha zhig ma red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas shes yon gyi thog la do snang chen po byas yod/ bdun cu don dgu'i lo ting zha'o phing dang thog mar nga tsho'i mi sna thug 'phrad skabs ting gis khyed rang tshos slob sbyong thog la do snang byas pa yag po red ces bsngags brjod byas 'dug gang ltar nga tshos da lta bar du shes yon gyi thog la do khur byas par grub 'bras thon yod pa ltar/ da dung yin na yang nga tshos shes yon gyi thog la nges par du shugs rgyag dgos/ kha sang slob phrug tshor yang lab rgyu byung / shes yon gyi thog la shugs rgyag dgos pa dang / shes yon de yang gzhan phan lhag bsam dang zung du sbrel ba zhig ma byung na shes yon 236

rkyang pas phan thogs de tsam med pa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la deng sang yongs grogs red/ gsal po red/ a mi ri ka zer ba sogs lung pa skad grags chen po de tsho'i nang la ya rabs spyod bzang gis phongs pa'i dka' ngal chen po yod pa red/ bod pa la nga tsho'i pha mes nas de lta bu'i mig ltos bzang po yod bsdad pa 'di dang zung du sbrel ba'i shes yon yar rgyas 'gro rgyur 'bad brtson byed dgos kyi 'dugade nas gzhis chags khag 'di dag nang la so nam gcig pu'i thog nas nus pa ldang thub kyi med stabs thabs shes gang byed rgyu 'dug gsar gtod byed rgyu gal chen po rdod/ nga tsho'i dngosayode gnas tshul la ran pa'i shing 'bras 'debs 'dzugs dang / 'o ma thon skyed 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa 'di tsho ha cang yag po 'dug da lta khang bajo'i rgyu cha sogs las 'gul byed mus 'di tsho'i gras 'char gzhi ldan pa yag po bzos na nus pa thon thub pa'i lam 'grosku1nga thub rgyu'i re ba yod pa red/ rgya garayul pa tsho la'ang zhabs 'degs sgrub thub kyi red/'dis mtshon pas gang ltar nga tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs yar rgyasayong ba'i thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byed dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so lnga lhag 'gro gi yod pa red de gong bu'i nus pa bsdad pa 'di btsan byol gzhung zer ba spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di'i thog nas byung ba red/ las don thog nor 'khrul yong gi red/ 'on kyang che sa nas bshad pa yin na/ nga tsho spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'dis phan thogs chen po byung yod/spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i thog nas rgya gar la yod pa'i bod pa tsam du ma zad/237

'dzam gling sa cha gang sarayod pa'i bod pa tshorayan lag dang nying lag gi 'brel ba yod pa 'di'i thog nas khyad par chen po byung yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas yin na yang btsan byol gzhung zer ba 'dir mi dga' ba dang / 'dir dogs zon byed kyi 'dug nga tsho btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di gal chen po chags yod/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i 'go stod nas mang gtso'i lam la bsgyur rgyu'i 'bad rtsol lag len rim pa bkal/ nyams myongagasog gin gsog gin 'gyur ba gtong gin gtong gin byas/ bar skabs nas nga tshos bca' khrims bzos te dngos gnas yar rgyas gang legs btang yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi lung pa gzhan dag gi gnas tshul dang / gzhan dag gi btsan byol ba'i gnas stangs dang bsdur ba yin na/ nga tsho mang gtso can du bsgyur ba'i thog grub 'bras gang la gang 'tshams kyi chen po thon yod/da lta 'dir gsar 'byor ba khyed rang tsho'i bsam blo'i nang la las bsdoms nang nga tsho'i rnyog dra'i rigs bshad pa der bod pa'i nang bkra mi shis pa'i skyon 'dug bsam pa kha shas dran mdog kha po red/ de la ha las rgyu gang yang med/ de ni mi'i spyi tshogs gang sar yod pa zhig red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so lnga lhag tsam gyi ring la rnyog gleng lhags pa byung yod/rnyog gleng lhag gin lhag gin phar yal gyinasal gyin byas nas phyin pa red/ de tshor gnad 'gagagang yang mi 'dug gnas tshul phran bu'i gleng gzhi che ba de gang yin zer na/ phyi'i rgyal khab dang 'brel ba slebs pa dang / dngul dang dngos pos bslu rgyu'i nyen ka zhig slebs kyi yod pa red/ gang ltarayang 'khrun 238

gcod tshar ba zhig red/ mi mang po 'di'i nang la yod pasang ma red/ mi nyung shas shig red/ yin na yang gnas tshul chags stangs phyi rgyal gyi dngul dang / dngos po'i 'brel ba'i thog nas chags pa dang / de yang shes bzhin khyad gsod byas pa lta buyin dus/ tshang mas ma shes ma go ba min par do snang dang yid gzab byed dgos/ spyisongs kyi cha nas spyi tshogs nang gnas tshul de 'drayong gi red/ gnyis nas nga tsho mang gtso'i lung pa'i nang la bsdadayod/gtam brjod rang dbang red/ 'dra mi 'dra bshad mkhanayong gi red/ de bzhin sasar shog khag nang la 'dra mi 'dra bshad kyi red/ de tshoyag po red/ rtsab brtan poyod pa'i rtags red/ phar tsam der rgya mi gung khran gyis mtshon pa'i gcig sdud lam lugs de tsho'i nang la skad cha mang poyod kyang gdong len byed ma thub par bkab nas bsdad kyi yod pa red/ mang gatsho'i yul nang skad cha 'dra min yod pa rnams gsal po bzos te gdong len byed kyi yod pa red/ de nus pa che ba yin/ rtsa ba brtan po yod pa'i rtags red/ dper na/ rgya gar nang la cha bzhag na/rnyog khra mang poyod na yang mi gsod khrag sbyor de tsam yong giyod pa ma red/ gang yin zer na/ mang gtso yod pa dang / rang dbang rang btsan gyi khrims khang yod pa red/ rnyog glengayod pa rnams bkab nas dri ngan sa g.yog ma byas par kha gsal gting gsal byed pa 'di dngos gnas mang gtso dang / rang dbang lung pa'i khyad chos shig red la/ de yon tan red/de nas ngas nam rgyun rtag par 'bod bskul byed kyi yod pa ltar) bod kyi chab srid gnad don la tshang mas do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug lhag don gdan 239

sa khag tshosado snang byed dgos/ nam rgyun kha rgyun la sde pa gzhung gi byus rtogs sde srid mgo leb pas byed kyi red zer ba de 'dra byasan mi 'grigs/ nga tshodangos gnas drang gnas mang gtso'i sgang la 'gro gi yod/ mang gtso'i sgang la 'gro dus mang tshogs kyi 'gan mang ba 'khyer dgos/ 'gan 'khyeradagos par brten gnas tshul tshang ma rtogs thub pa byed dgos/ gnas tshul ma rtogs par bsdad payin na gtam 'chal zhigasku1nga ba'i skabs la gang 'drayin nam bsam pa de 'drayong gi yod pa red/ dus rgyun gtan nas so sos rtsa ba'i bod gzhung gi srid byus dang / chab srid kyi las ka byed stangs thog la do snangayod pa zhig yinan/ dkrog gtam gtam 'chalasposang ba'i skabs la brtag dpyad byed rgyu'i nus pa zhig yong gi red/ brtag dpyad byed rgyu'i cha rkyen yod pa red/ nam rgyun nas do snang ma byas na gtam 'chal zhig slebs dus de 'dra min nam bsam nas bsdad rgyu las/ so sos dpyad pa byed rgyu'i cha rkyen yod pa ma red/ gdan sa'i mkhan po dang / las sne tsho nas nam rgyun nas 'dir do snang byed dgos/ nga rang tsho tshang ma bod rang dbang 'dod mkhan sha stag red/ mdor na rgya mi'i las khyangs nang la yod mkhan gyi bod rigs tang yon tsho la yang sems kyi gting der nga bod pa yin bsam pa zhig zub tu med par yod pa red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir bod pa'i chab srid kyi gnas stas gnyan 'phrang zhig gi dus skabs la slebs yod dus der tshang mas do snang byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nam rgyun nas do snang yod pa yin na dkrog gtam gyi rjes 'brangs mi byed pa'i khyad par yong gi red/bod nang la gnyen 'phrad du 'gro ba dang / bod nang nas tshur gnyen 'phrad la yong 240

mkhan tsho la dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul 'di dag sgro btags ma yin pa/gtam 'chal gyi gnas tshulade 'dra mayin pa/ dngos dngos brjen brjen 'grel bshad byed thub payong gi red/ de 'dra byung na bod nas yong mkhan tsho yin na yang dga' poyong gi red/ nga tshor mi la ma dga' tshig za byas nas skad cha bshad kyi yod pa ma red/ nga tshos bden pa bden gtugs kyi skad cha bshad kyi yod pa red/ nga tshos rgya mi la sdug pa zhig yong ba shog zer gyi med/ 'bad rtsol byed kyi med/ bde skyid rgya mi la yang dgos pa red/ bde skyid rgya mi la dgos pa nang bzhin nga phyo la yang dgos kyi yod pa red/ de snga spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs la zhing bran lam lugs sdug thag chodayod na yang / bcings bkrol btang tshar ba'i rjes la bod mi yongs rdzogs rgya mi'i tshe g.yog chags pa ni de las kyang shin tu sdug pa red/ des 'grigs kyi mi 'dug rgya mi'i ngos nas nga tshor drang po drang bzhag gi 'dra mnyam dang / bsam pa rnam dag gi thog nas gnyis phan gyi bsam blo btang ba yin na/ nga tsho'i ngosanas bsam blo los gtong /nga tsho nang pa red/ sems can thams cad zer gyi yod/ nga tsho 'dir mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gispend pa las/ spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag rgyu rmi lam la yang btang gi med/ rgya mis bod nang la nga tsho phyi rgyal layod pa tshos spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi yod pa dang / zhing bran lam lugs bskyar gso byed kyi yod pa red ces hang song de lta bu bshad kyi 'dug 'di nas bod la gnyen 'phrad la 'gro mkhan tshos nam rgyun nas nga tsho'i bsam tshul gang yod pa dang / chab srid kyi lta ba gang 'dra yod pa rnams yag po shes kyi yod na 241

bshad thub kyi red/de nas rgya dang bod kyi 'brel ba'i skor dang / the wan gyi gnas tshul sgor khong gnyis kyi thog nas 'grel bshad zhib phra byung song bas de lhag dmigs bsal shod rgyu med/ bar skabs rgya nag gzhung gi bsam blo ha cang sbag srub dog po dang / mkhregs po zhig gtong gi 'dug yin na yang de mur zlo ba nas bsdad thub kyi ma red bsam gyi 'dug 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la 'gyur ba shin tu chen po 'gro gi yod pa dang / rgya nag rang gi nang la'ang 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pas nga phyo zhum dgos don med/ rgya mi kho rang tsho'i khe phan la bltas nas bsam blo mkhregs wa de mur sdod thabs med/ rgya mi'i ngos nas phran bu'i bsam blo gu yangs su phyin pa yin na nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang de lugs gu bshangs dang 'brel ba'i thog nas gnyis phan gyi lam zhig btsal rgyu red/ da lta bar du nga tshos dbu ma'i lam la phyin pa ltar da dungayin na yang lam phyogs 'di'i steng nas gnyis phan gyi don 'bras shig smin pa'i yid ches yod/de nas go ming tang gi gnas tshul de rnyog khra tsha po red/ nga rang tsho bod mi btsan byol ba mang tshogs rnams ha las pa'i langs phyogs brtan po yag po red/ 'on kyang rgyu dngos por dga' po yod pa'i mi de tsho'i gras kyis rang tshugs zin ma thub pa'i gnas tshul byung ba red/ yin na yang ga le ga ler skyon de sel yong bsam pa dran gyi 'dug rtsa ba ni the wan la 'brel ba byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug rgya mi gnyen du bkuganas nga tshos thabs lam btsal dgos pa ma gtogos/rgya mi dgra bzos te gdong ma bstan par bsdad nas phan thogs mi 'dug nga 242

tshor lag cha bden pa yod pa red/ bden pa'i nus pa 'don pa la gdong dang gdong bstan nas rgyu mtshan bgrangs te bden pa bden jog tu 'khyol thabs byed dgos/ rgya dmar nag su la yin na yang gdong dang gdong bstan/ bden pa ra sgrod byas/ mi dang mi'i 'brel ba'i thog nas dka' ngal sel thabs dang /nga tsho'i nus pa thon thabs byed dgos/ nga tshos gzhi rtsa'i bsam blo gtong phyogs de 'dra zhig red/de nas rgya gar yul pa tsho dang bod pa 'brel ba yag thag chod yod/ da dung yang yul pa tsho dang mthun dzeX byed rgyu'i thog dmigs bsal gyi gzab gzab dang / do snang byed dgos/de nas nga tsho'i chos snar khag la da lta bar du bslab pa slob gnyer yag thag chod yod/ bslab pa slob gnyer bzang po yod pa de'i tshod kyi rgyud dul ba zhig dgos pa de shin tu gal chen po red/ gra pa gshis rgyud ma dul ba de 'dra byung na thabs skyo bo red/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren red/ da ring snga dro bka' chos skabs mtha' mtshams der gra pa zhig 'dug stod thung ser po gcig gyon/par chas shig 'khyer nas phar tshur 'gro gi 'dug gdan sa'i gra pa yin bzo mi 'dug kho bal yul khul nas yong pa gcig min nam/ dad pa yod pa'i tshor bani khyon nasayod bzo mi 'dug mi de tsho'i gras yag po min/ bod la'ang lus la gra chas gyon te nyal tha tshong gi 'dug zer ba dang / lus la gra chas gyon nas dgon pa khag nas rten sku gsung thugs rkun ma rgyag gi 'dug zer ba de tsho'i gras dpe ma srid pa'i thabs sdug red/ de tsho kha shas lta gra brdzus yin gyi red/243

spyi tshogs nang mgo skor gtong rgyu'i don dag la gra chas gyon nas yong ba de 'dra yin srid kyi red/ gang ltarayang rab tu byung ba rnams nas spyod lam tshul thun byed dgos pa shin tu gal chen po yin/kha sang nas skad cha lhang tsam byung ba bzhin/ nga rang tshor spyir btang bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la nam rgyun nas sha spangs mkhan ha cang nyung nyung red/da gin las bsdoms nang la khyed rang tshos nya stong brgyad gsum la dmar zas slong gi yin zer ba zhig 'dug pa de la rjes su yi rangs yod/ shin tu yag po red/ da dung yang de'i thog la dmigs bsal do snang dang shugs bskyed byed dgos/ lhag don dge 'dun mang po yod sa tsho'i nang la sha nyung nyung zhig nyos pa yin na yang phon chen po 'gro rgyur/ de snu'i gras la gzab gzab byed dgomu kyi 'dug grong khyer chen po'i nang dang mi 'dra bar grong gseb chung chung nang la gzab gzab ma byas na dmigs sha chags rgyu'i nyen ka chen po yod/ dzña ram sa lar yang nam rgyun bshad kyi yod/ rgya gar yul pa cho'i nang dang / deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dmar zas spong rgyu dar so che ru che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ sha med pa'i dkar zas kyi nang la gzugs po'i stobs bcud lu/phan pa'i sngo tshal rigs dang / lto chas bzo stangs kyi gnad 'gag mang po bshad rgyu 'dug de tshor nga rang tshos do snang dang / nyams zhib byas na 'gro gong che ru btang mi dgos par lto chas zas bcud yod pa 'dra bzo thabs bsam blo gtong rgyu yod kyi red bsam gyi 'dug sngon ma lo gcig nga tshos de 'dra'i tshod lta slob sbyong tshugs tsam byas pa red/ mjug la rgya bskyed rgyun skyong ma byung ba 244

red/ da dus tshod ring po 'gor song / tshang ma thang chad med dam/ thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs zhes dang /khyed rang snur ngad nas yong mkhan tsho la dmigs bsal gyi 'tshams 'dri yod/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams bod kyi don gyi bdag smo yin zhes ngas rgyun du bshad kyi yod/ nga rang ni bod rgya che'i mi mang gi gtam brjod pa gcig yin pas/ bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul gang yod pa de dag ngas bshad dgos kyi yod pa red/ phyi rgyal gyi mi bod nang blta skor la 'gro rgyu'i dus tshod ma shar bar du nga tshos bshad pa der 'dzam bu gling gi mi mang po zhig gis yid ches byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang mi mang po zhig gis 'di tsho spyir btang btsan byol ba tshang mas rgyun du shod srol chos nyid lta bu red ces zer gyi yod/phyi rgyal gyi mi bod nang blta skor la 'gro rgyu'i dus tshod cig shar te blta skor la 'gro mkhan tshos bod nang gi dngos yod gnas tshul mthong ba'i rjes la tā la'i bla mas mtshon pas btsan byol gzhung gi de sngon bshad pa'i gnas tshul de dag bden pa red ces nga tshos bshad pa'i bden pa'i bden rgyab je cher phyinayod/ de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gi snying stobs dang / lhag bsam zhum pa med par bsdad pa'i 'bras bu red/ ma gzhi bod rgya che'i mi mang lhag bsam dang snying stobs 'gyur ba med par gnas pa 'di rgya mi'i bka' drin red/ rgya mis dus rtag tu bod mir sdug sbyong btang ste bzo lta kho rang bzos par brten sems shugs ma bsdad rang bsdad red/ rgya mis ha cang byams po byas na sems shugs gang 'dra yod dam mi shes/ sngon ma rgya mi thog mar bod 245

la yong pa'i skabs su rgya gung khran drin can pha ma red/ dngul nā yang char pa babs babs red ces de 'dra bshad mkhan byung yod/ gang ltar rgya mi'i ngos nas 'dra mi 'dra'i thabs shes kyi thog nas bod pa la mthong chung byed sa dang / khyad gsod byed sa gcigatu bltas/ thod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsabarlag tu 'gro rgyu'i go rim zhig sgrig gi yod pa'i bzo lta zhig 'dug de 'dra'i 'og la bod mi su yin na yang nad theg thabs med pa gsal po red/ gang ltarayang snying khyed rang tshos dngos gnas drang gnas lhag bsam dang / sems shugs ri btsugs pa nang bzhin brtan po dang / 'gyur ba med par bsdad pa la rjes su yi rangs yod/ nga tshos bod kyi bden pa'i 'thab rtsod byed rgyu'i gzhi rtsa'i ma gdan 'dra 1— de bod rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi snying stobs red/ khyed rang tsho'i srog la nyen kha yod na yang / so so'i lus srog 'ben la btsugs/ snying stobs zhum med bsdad pa de dngos gnas bka' drin chen po yin/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas sngar bzhin gzab gzab byas/hur thag byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nga tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan tsho yin na yang da lta bar du gang yong ci yong byas pa red/ da dung yang tshang mas hur thag byed kyi red/ rdo don yang snying gzhis byes bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i las 'gan de bod rang dbang bsgrub rgyu 'di yin pas tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag byed rogs/ thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes 355// // 246

༄tsho// phyi lo 1995 zla 2 tshes 17 nyin rgya gar nas bod kyi rgyal pu lha ldan bar zhi ba'i gom bgrod du bskyod mi grangs brgya dang brgyad cu skor lu stsal ba'i bka' 11ba/da ring 'dir lhag bsam rnam dag dang zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis nga rang tsho'i bod kyi rgyal sa lha ldan la kha phyogs te zhi ba'i gom bgrod byed kyi yin zer mkhan lhag bsam snying stobs can khyed rang tsho khyug tsam thug nas skad cha zhig shod dgos bsam pa dran byung / gcig byas na khyed rang sto blo pham 'dra zhing srid mdog kha po red/ yin na yang da ring ngas thag bcad de zer rgyu gang yang med/ khyed rang tshor nga'i bsam tshul zhig bshad na bsam pa yin/ da lta nyi ma kha shas yod pas khyed rang chos bsam blo tan tan zhig thongs/ gang 'dra byas na dga' ba 'dug gam/ ga le ga ler gtan 'khel chog gi red/ de ring ngas zer rgyu'i don tshan dang por/ na ning 'go stod khyed rang tsho dbus gtsang chol kha'i gros chod nang la 'di 'dra zhig bkod yod pa red/ skabs der nga'i bsam tshul la ha cang yag po red/ dus tshod ran pa zhig byung ba yin na tan tan yag po yong gi red bsam pa zhig dang / dngos gnas rang lhag bsam 'di lta bu 'khyer ba ha cang yag po red bsam pa ma gtogs/ mgyogs myur lag len bkal gyi red bsam pa'i bsam tshul gang yang ma byung / da cha khyed rang chos dngos su lag len bstar rgyu'i sems thag gtsang ma bcad pa red/ dus tshod de ran po zhig 'khel gyi yod dang med der nga blo g.yeng phran bu 'dug khyed rang sto bod spyi pa'i don la phyogs gcig nas 247

bshad pa yin na 'u thug pa'i thog nas bsam 'char 'di yong gi yod red/thabs shes 'di 'dra zhig bya rgyu'i bsam tshul byung ba red/ dngos gnas khag mi 'dug 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ngos nas da lta phan chad lo bco lnga'i ring la rgya bod skad cha bshad de phan tshun gcig gis gcig la yid ches dang / bsam blo gu yangs sa nas btang ste gnyis mos kyi thabs lam zhig rnyed thub na bsam pa'i re ba rgyab nas lo nas lo bstud 'bad brtson byas pa red de/ grub 'bras thon med/ rgya bod gnyis don dag yod pa'i go bsdur byed rgyu'i 'go 'dzugs thub med/ bod nang la gnas tshul phran bu'i drag tu 'gro rgyu la'ang phan thogs byung ma song / da dung gnas tshul je sdug je sdug tu 'gro giyod pa yin dus mi mang gi ngos nas skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan sgrub ste/ mdor na srog blos btang gi bod spyi pa'i don la phan pa zhig byung na bsam pa'i khyed rang tshos sems shugs bskyed de mngo dun 7rgyal ba rin po ches thabs shes byas pa de'i thog la khyed rang tshos dngos gnas so so'i srog zhal 'debs lta bu rgyag gi yin bsam pa'i sems shugs slebs kyi yod red/ ha las pa red/ khyed rang tsho dngos gnas rmad du byung ba'i lhag bsam dang / ngo mtshar skye dgos pa/ zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs la rjes su yi rangs yod/ khyed rang tshor thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ khyed rang tsho'i snying stobs dang / lhag bsam gyi gnas lugs gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gis bod ngas yong dus dngos gnas sems kyigating la dga' snang dang / snying stobs skye yag la tan tan phan gyi red/ 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs kyi thog nas kyang do snang yong ba zhig chags kyi yod red/ ha 248

cang yag po red/yin na yang don tshan gcig la/ nga chos 'di nas mtha' gcig tu 'tshe med zhi ba'i thabs lam la bsten nas bod kyi bden mtha' sel ba'i thabs shes byed kyi yod pa dang / khyed rang tshos kyang bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo nas mtshon med zhi bde'i gom bgrod kyi thabs lam bsten rtsis byed kyi yod na yang / phar phyogs gdong bstan sa des rgyu mtshan la bsam blo gtong gi medapa dang / zhi bde zer ba de la rin thang khyon nas brtsi gi med/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la rin thang khyon nas brtsi gi med par brten/ mtha' ma'i dus la gang 'dra zhig chags yong ngam/ nga tshos mtha' gcig tu 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la yid ches dang 'brel ba'i thog nas lag len bstar te 'gro gi yod na yang / phar phyogs nas de la dog rol gtong rkyang dang / me mda' rgyag rgyur tsham tshom med par ang bsar byas te bsdad yod par brten mtha' ma'i dus la 'tshe ba'i ngo bo'i thog la slebs rgyu zhig chags spongang gi 'dugaganyis nas/ 'di nas lha sa bar du 'gro dgos byung na rgya gar ldi li nas/ lha sar bar sa thag ring po gang 'tshams yod/ sngon la phyogs gcig nas rgya gar gyi sa cha gang 'tshams shig bgrod dgos/ de nas bal yul gyi sa gang 'tshams shig bgrod dgos pas/ rgya gar dang / bal wa'i gzhung gi thog nas mdzad dka' chen po zhig yong rgyu yin pa gzhi grub pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la nga tshos bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos kyi 'dug rgya gar gzhung dang / bal po'i gzhung gsar pa'i ngos nas rtsa ba bod pa'i thog la sha tsha med 249

pa dang / bod pa'i 'thab rtsod de bden pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i ngos 'dzin med pa ma red/ bod par sha tsha dang / rgyab skyor tan tan yod pa nged/ lhag par du rgya gar gzhung la cha bzhag na/ lo sum cu so drug la nye ba'i dus yun de'i ring la rgya gar gzhung gis bod pa'i thog la rtsa ba'i srid byus 'dzin stangs de ngas bltas na yag po red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug rigs kha shas dper na/ bod rgya nag khongs kyi rang skyong khul zhig red ces ngos 'dzin byed pa lta bu nga rang cho ༷sa pham dgos pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod na yang / phyogs yongs rdzogs kyi thog nas rgya gar gzhung gis bod pa'i thog la blta stangs de yag po red/ ma 'ongs par yin na yang bod pa'i thog la dus tshod smin pa dang / rgya gar gzhung gis byed thub pa'i dus stod slebs pa'i skabs la rgya gar gzhung gis tan tan bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor dang / sha tsha yod yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la gzhig nas rgya gar bzhung mdzad dka' mi yong ba byed rgyu de gal chen po chags kyi skurdzod/gsum nas/ 'di nas lha sa bar rkang bgrod kyis 'gro rgyu'i lam rgyang thag ring po yin pas lam thog rang la nad na tshas mtshon pas dka' ngal sna mang 'phrad rgyu'i nyen kha tan tan yod pa dang / bod kyi sa zin pa'i mtshams la rgya mis lam seng bsad bzung byed rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ gal srid de 'dra ma byas pa yin na'ang bod kyi sa mtshams zin pa nas lha sa bar da dung zla lam bshar nas 'gro dgos/ rgya gar nas sems thag bcad de lhag bsam rnam dag gi yong mkhan de rnams rang gi sa cha zin pa'i skabs la bod nang sdod 250

mkhun tshos rang gi sems kyi gting du yod pa'i na tsha de bton mdog kha po red/de bton pa yin na rgya mis drag gnon shugs chen po byed rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ yang na bod nang gi mi tshos rgya mis drag gnon bya rgyu'i nyen kha de'i 'og tu sems kyi nang la yod pa'i na tsha de ma bton par 'khyams nas bsdad pa yin na/ khyed rang tshos zla lam bshar nas 'gro skabs lha sar ma slebs gong la ga le'i ga ler mug shi thebs rgyu'i nyen kha yang yod pa'i bzo 'dra po 'dug khyed rang chos dngos gnas drang gnas rang srog blos btang gis de lta bu'i snying stobs bskyed pa de ni shin tu gzi brjid chen po yin na yang / spyod 'jug las/ chung ngu'i ched du che mi gtong / gsungs pa ltar tshur tsam 'dir dril bsgrags chen po yong rgyu de dang / phar tsam der bod pa mang po zhig gi lus srog la nyams nyes chud thos 'gro rgyu'i khe nyen gnyis po de yang lci bteg te bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos kyi 'dug da lta'i char dus tshod smin po dang / ran po zhigaye yod bsam nga the tshom 'dug ces brjod dgos don ni/ rgya mi'i ngos nas nye ba'i char mtha' gcig tu sdig pa mig btsums kyis drag gnon byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad de bsdad yod pa'i dus stod cig 'khel yod/ dus tshod de'i sgang la dus skabs ran po med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug gal srid bod mi mang spro zhig 'phro brlag 'gro ba'i gnas tshul byung ba yin na/ ngas dha ram sa lar tshor ba gang yang med pa lta bur sdod thabs med/ nyan dang ma nyan khyed rang tsho'i bsam sdu red/ nyen kha yod pa'i gnas tshul rnams ngas ma lab na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug bsam dran gyi 'dug dper na/ lo kha shas gong du ldi lir zas 251

bcad ngo rgol byed mkhan mi bcu skor zhig byung yod/ de rnams nas ma shi bar du ngo rgol byed rgyur sems thag bcad nas bsdad pa red/ skabs der sems thag bcad pa dngos gnas drang gnas ngo mtshar skye dgos pa dang / ha las pa red de/ nga'i ngos nas bzod mi thub pa lta bu zhig byung / nyan dang ma nyan do bdag 11 16) bsam tshul red/ nga'i ngos nas ma lab na 'grigs kyi ma red bsam ste mtha' ma ngas lab pa red/ rjes su khong tshos mtshams bzhag pa red/ phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na nga byab chung 'dra po zhig chags pa red/ phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na ngas mi bcu skor zhig tshe thar btang ba yin bsam gyi 'dug de nas da dung yar ded phyin pa yin na/ phyi lo 1959 phyi zla 3 tshes 10 nyin lha sar gsum bcu'i dus chen gyi ngo sgol gyen langs byas/ tshes 17 phyi dro lha sa'i chu tshod 4 pa'i thog la nor bu gling byang sgo'i 'gram du me sgrogs kyi mdel gnyis babs pa 'di 'dra'i dza drag gi thog nas mtha' ma'i thag gcod byas te de'i dgong mo nga nor bu gling kha nas bros yong ba red/ de'i thag gcod byas pa dang chabs cig skabs der mgron gnyer che mo da nga / dga' brang khong gnyis la ngas bsam tshul zhig la/ nga tsho phyin tshar ba'i rjes la/ yang na da ring dgong dro nas 'go btsugs/gal srid do nub 'go 'dzugs ma thub na yang sang dgong nas 'go btsugs te nor gling phyi nang du mi mang po gsog bsdad pa de rnams gtsang po brgal nas gtsang po'i lho brgyud me skyogs ri ngos la ga tshod thub thub 'then thub na yag po red ces de dus lab rgyu byung / mgron che nas de ga de ga gsungs pa ma 252

gtogs lag len bkal mkhan gang yang byung med/ deng sang nga'i sems nang la 'gyod pa skyes yong gi 'dug de'i dgong dro nas 'go btsugs te 'then thub yod na bod mi stong phrag kha shas kyi srog phal cher tshe thar 'gro gi yod red/de rnams nor bu gling kha'i nang la lhags bsdad dus nyi ma gnyis gsum zhig girje me/skyid ri rbesgod 2te )sdod rwa'i( ༷sbo 16stolhan sa su gas rgyab sta ga nga nang ga pa ba 'dra ga chags pa red/ skyid chu'i gtsang po wargal te me sgrogs ri ngos su gang la gang 'tshams zhig 'then thub yod na gang ltar mi gang la gang 'tshams shig gi srog tshe thar thub pa byung yod red bsam pa da lta yin na yang dran gyi 'dug de dus ma byung ba red/ de bzhin du da res kyi las 'gul 'di yang khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas lhag bsam dang / snying stobs dngos gnas drang gnas ha las pa yin na yang ga le'i ga ler dngos su lag len bkal te phyin pa'i skabs la phyogs mang po zhig gi thog nas mtha' ma'i dus 'dir/ lhag bsam dang / snying stobs zhum pa med pa'i mi brgya phrag kha shas shig mug zas chud zos phyin pa yin na ha cang thangs po red/ ma gzhi bar der go thos su/ bod pa gzhon skyes nang nas da res thon dang po phyin pa'i rjes su thon gnyis pa dang / gsum pa byas te mu mthud nas 'gro gi yin zer mkhan yod pa go thos yong gi 'dug lhag bsam rnam dag red de/ rgya mis nga bo da pa'i mgo la gnam gyis sa brdung ba nang bzhin byung bsdad pa de dngos yod gnas tshul red/ thabs mkhas po zhig dang / dus tshod ran po zhig gi 'og nas nga tshos don dag sgrub rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/ lam seng lam seng nga chos ngar po dang 'pher po byas te don 253

dag son thub pa khag po red/ ma gzhi nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so drug phyinayod/ dus yun gang la gang 'tshams phyin pa de'i ring nga chos sgug pa red/ lo gnyis gsum zhig ring bzod bsran dang sdug rus rgyab ste sdod kyi yin na tan tan 'gyur ba chen po yong gi red bsam pa'i re ba chen po yod/ yid ches kyang byed kyi yod/ khyed rang tsho gra 'grigs po dang / yag po zhig byung ba yin na ngas bzang kha blangs/ yag po zhig ma byung na shi na yang shi ru chug bsam nas nga sdod thub thabs khyon nas yod ma red/ nga sa 'gan mi bzod pa lta bu 'dug nga'i sems kyi nang la dngangs skrag yod pa de khyed rang tshor lab na bsam pa dran song / thag gang bcad ma bcad khyed rang tsho'i lag pa red/ mi mang gi las 'gul red/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas las 'gul 'di brtsams pa red/ lag len bkal gyi yin zer nas sems shugs kyi me 'bar nas bsdad yod pa shin tu yag po red/ yin na yang gang 'dra zhig dga' ba 'dug gam/ khyed rang tsho bsam blo tan tan zhig btang na bsam pa nga'i bsam tshul yin/ gang ltar bod spyi pa'i don dag red ma gtogs/ mi re zung re zung gi khe phan don dag ma red/ nga tsho tshang ma spyi pa'i don dag red/ khyed rang tsho mi mang gis las 'gul brtsams pa la nga rang tsho tshang ma rgyag gcig mchongs gcig tu 'gro rgyu ma gtogs gnyis pa zhig yong thabs med/ ma 'ongs par dus tshod ran po zhig byung ba yin na zhi bde'i gom bgrod la nga rang yang mnyam por 'gro bsam pa yin/ dngos gnas rang nga rang tsho tshang ma shi gson gangayong gi yod rung mnyam por shi bayin na 'phyo 254

pa khyon nas mi 'dug de min lhag bsam can gyi mi mang po zhig chud zos phyin/nga tsho 'dir gang 'tshams shig gis bltas nas bsdad pa yin na de la dga' rgyu khyon nas med pa red/ sngon ma nas dran gyi yod/ zas bcad ngo rgol byed rgyu yang dus mod ran pa dang / don tshan bye brag pa zhig gi sgang la tag tag byung ba yin na nga rang yang zas bcad ngo rgol zhig byed bsam pa snga mo nas dran myong / da res zhi ba'i gom bgrod la cha bzhag na'ang dus tshod ran po zhig gi sgang la tshod thig po byung na nga rang tsho tshang ma mnyam por zhi ba'i gom bgrod byed kyi yin na bsam ste nga ang bsar yin/ da lta'i gnas stangs 'di'i 'og la bsam blo tan tan zhig btang na ma gtogs/ khyed rang tsho lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas byas rjes chen po bzhag pa red de/ yin na yang byas rjes 'di tsam bzhag pa der grub 'bras ngo tho na pa zhig ma byung bar mi mngapo chud zos phyin na shin tu phangs po red/ khyed rang tsho bsam blo tan tan zhig btang na bsam pa nga'i bsam tshul yin/ ngas khyed rang tshos 'di byas na 'grigs kyi ma red/ 'di ltar byed dgos kyi red ces thag bcad de shod kyi med/ nga'i bsam tshul yod pa rnams khyed rang tshor bshad pa yin/ nyi ma gcig gnyis khyed rang tsho bsam blo thongs/ go bsdur gyis/ 'brel yod tshogs gtso dang /bka' shag gi bka' blon tsho dang / khyed rang tsho go bsdur byas na snyam/ de min pa'i thabs shes bya rgyu gang 'dug gam/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir mug zos thebs rgyu'i nyen kha med pa zhig dang / gtso che rgya gar gzhung dang / 'brel yod bal po'i gzhung de tshor yang mdzad dka' med pa/ nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i 255

don dag skor 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dran gso thebs thub pa'i byed phyogs gang byed rgyu 'dug gam/ gang ltar khyed rang tshos snying stobs lhag bsam brtan po'i thog nas sems thag bcad pa'i bya ba de da res ma 'grub kyang / ma 'ongs par bsgrub rgyu'i dus tshod yong gi red/ khyed rang tshos da res 'grub ma song /ma 'ongs par byed thub yag byung ma song bsam pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos kyi ma red/ da dung 'di gras dus sang / sang phod lo gsar te gnas tshul gang yong gi 'dug gam/ yang de'i gnangs phod la gang 'dra zhig chags kyi 'dug gam/ byed rgyu'i dus tshod da dung bsdad yod/ da res byed thal la phyin te phyi bshig rgyab ma thub pa chags na yag po yod pa ma red/ byed rgyu bsdad na ga le'i ga ler byas chog gi red/ byedathal shor te rjes su phangs po spud dgos pa byung na tshang ma 'gyod pa skye ba'i rgyu red/ gnas tshul 'di khyed rang tshor lab na bsam pa byung / khyed rang tsho tshang mas shes song ngam/ rdo don snying po khyed rang tsho'i lhag bsam dang / snying stobs la dngos gnas ngo mtshar skye yag red/ rmad du byung ba red/ rjes su yi rangs yod/ yin nayang thabs la mkhas pa zhig dang / dus la babs pa zhig dgos kyi red/ dus shes dgos/da lta'i dus tshod 'dir nga rang yang gang drag bsam pa zhig dang sems nang dngangs skrag dang / mi bde ba zhig mi yong ngam snyam pa dran yong gi 'dug da res lan gcig rang 'di 'dra zhig gi bsam blo gtong rgyu med dam snyam pa de khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed dgos/ gzhan dag shod yag mi 'dugakhyed rang tsho kha shas kyis 7rgyal ba rin po che nas byab skyel gyi 'dug bsam 256

pa gcig byas na dran mdog kha po red/ nga rang gi bsam blo'i ngos nas 'gan ma bzod pa chags kyi yod pa yin dus 'phral phyags kyi khe nyen gang yod pa de rnams khyed rang tshor lab na/ lab tshar ba'i rjes la khyed rang tshos gang thag bcad kyangadangos gnas 'gyod pa gang yang mi 'dug da res thug ste lab na bsam pa de ltar yin/ gang ltar khyed rang tsho nas dngos gnas drang gnas lhag bsam dang / snying stobs zhum pa med pa bskyed pa der shin tu dga' po byung / nga rang tsho'i bod mi pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' dang / ma srin mo brag srin ma'i rgyud nas mched pa'i mi de dag dus da lta bar du 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nyams dma' mi dgos pa zhig byung yod/ da dung khyed rang tsho yin na yang nga rang tsho pha mes nas bod gangs can pa/ kha ba can pa dngos gnas rang sreg btub 'pher ba yod bsdad pa de shugs bsgril gyi yin zer gyi yod red/ dpe yag po red/ rjes su yi rang yod/ brel ba med pas khyed rang tsho go bsdur yag po gyis/ shes song ngam/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' 455// //257

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1995 zla 3 tshes 2 nyin/ dha sar bod mi ser skya mang tshogs la lo gsar bkra shis bde legs kyi 'tshams 'dri bka' slob stsal ba/de ring lo gsar la bod mi tshang mar bkra shis bde legs dang 'tshams 'dri bya rgyu yin/ rang re'i mi rigs kyi goms gshis ltar tshang mas gzab mchor spras te kha zas kyang zhim po bzas nas dga' dga' spro spro byed kyi yod pa ltar de ring gnam gshis kyang yag po 'dug pas khyed rang tsho tshang mar lo gsar skyid po gtong rgyu'i re ba yod/ sems pa skyid po byas te sdod dgos/rnam kun ngos nas chang 'thung mkhan la ngo rgol byed kyi yod kyang / da res lo gsar skabs khyim tshang so sor chang grwa sgrig byas yod pa bzhin mi so sos 'thung skabs tshod 'dzin byas nas ra bzi skyur 'gong shod mi rung /nga rang tsho phyogs gcig nas bsam sbre+o btang na lo gsar pa zhig 'char ba dang / phyogs gnyis nas bsam blo btang na nyi ma re re 'gro skabs mi tshe thung du 'gro gi yod/ nyi ma re re de dag don dang ldan pa zhig bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de ltar byung na lo ji tsam song ba de dag don dang ldan pa zhig yong gi red/ don dang ldan pa zhes pa ni/ so so mi sgor zhig 'phral gang sems pa skyid po yong ba'i don gcig bu min par/ gtso che shos mi gzhan la phan thogs byed pa dang / ma mthar yang gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i thog nas sems ltod dal byed rgyu byung na yag po red/ de min sems pa rang shed che ba'i thogaskyur phran bu 'thung nas rogs pa gzhan tsho bzod ma bde chags na mi tshe'i dgos 258

don ma byung ba red/ nyin re bzhin du nyi ma gsar pa zhig 'char yong gi yod pa ltar de bzhin so so'i sems la lcag bskul gyis nyin re don dang ldan pa bya rgyu gal chen 11 yin/de ltar dge ba'i bsam pa dang / lhag bsam ldan pa zhig byung na bod spyi don gyi bsam pa zhig rang shugs su yong gi red/ gang yin zhe na/ nga rang tsho bod kyi spyi don 'di rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi gnad don zhig min par/ kun la phan pa'i ched du dmigs pa'i bya ba dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags yod/phan pa'i bsam blo sku(da na rang shugs kyis sems can mang po zhig la da1dus dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan thogs yod pa'i bya ba 'di nges par du bsgrub thub pa yin/ der brten don dang ldan pa'i thog nas nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag thog bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen po yin/ bod spyi don 'di mi re gnyis kyis sgrub thub pa zhig min pas/ nga rang tsho tshang ma thun mong gis bsgrub dgos pa zhig yin/ thun mong gi nus pa 'don pa la nga rang tsho tshang ma mthun po dgos/dam tshig mthun po zhes pa 'di chos kyi thog nas kyang rtsa bar bshad yod la/'jig rten tshul lugs nas bshad kyang gong bu gcig gyur gyi nus pa yod na bya ba gang jigang bsgrub thub/ chos dang 'jig rten gang la'ang mthun po zhes pa 'di gal chen po yin/ bod spyi pa'i don dag sems la bcang pa'i thog nas che sar bsam blo gtong dgos/ chung sa'i tho ga nas sems pa ma skyid pa byed dgos don med/ gal che chung dang gtso che chung zhes pa 'di dngos po'i chos nyid yin/ phyogs gcig nas bsam blo gtong skabs nga rang tsho rang yul bral 259

te mi yul la gyar ba dang / so so'i lung pa'i gnas stangs ha cang thabs skyo po zhig la gyar yod pas/ de rtsis tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/'di lo'i lo gsar skabs bod nas gnyen 'phrad du 'byor ba yang mang po yod/ khyed rang cho swā/ bur gyi mgron lta bu chags te so so'i khyim la sdod skabs ltar gyi gro so phye mar sogs gang yang yod kyi ma red/ dha ram sa lar phyi'i mthun rkyen 'alhurams po med na yang / nang sems la dga' spro'i snang bas nyi ma gcig yin kyang lhod rdzod bag phebs ngang sdod rgyu yod/ lo gsar tshar rjes da res dha ram sa lar mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med kyang sems skyid po byung zhes brjod rgyu yod pa byung na yag po red/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ sems pa lhod lhod byas nas sdod/nga rang snur bod pa zhes pa 'di la rang bzhin gyis sems bag phebs po dang / gshis ka 'jam po'i goms gshis shig yod pa 'di rtsa ba chen po yin/phyi'i mthun rkyen ha cang 'dzoms po yod kyang nang gi sems la dngangs skrag byas te gcig gis gcig la dwogs pa rnam rtog dang / re dwogs lu gu brgyud de sdod dgos byung na skyid po gang yang med pa tshang mas mthong gsal red/ nga rang tsho bod pa rnams la phyi'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po sku(da min la ma ltos par nang bsam blo'i thad snang ba skyid po dang / bag phebs po zhig yod pa 'di dag nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang cha tshang spyod thub na/ ji tsam snang ba skyid po dang / bag phebs yod pa de tsam gyis dge sbyor zhig byas pa yin na'ang cha rkyen legs pa yod/ sems nang rnam rtog gi mun pa 'thibs te bsdad yod na/ dge sbyor 260

zhig byas kyang de dge sbyor la 'gro rgyu khag po red/ gang zag dge sbyor la goms 'dris chen po yod mkhan zhig yin na de ni gnas tshul tha dad yin zhing / nga rang tsho las dang po pa rnams sems ltod zhi bde yod med kyis kha ton dge sbyor gnad smin po zhig yong dang mi yong la khyad par chen po yong gi yod/ der brten nga rang tsho'i rang bzhin gyi gshis ka dal po dang / 'jam po/ bzod bsran thub pa bcas 'di dag shin tu rtsa ba chen po yin/nga tsho'i lo gsar zhes pa 'di bod kyi dus chen 'di 'dra dang / 'brel ba yod par brten phyi'i rnam 'gyur cha lugs so so rang nyid kyi mi rigs kyi goms gshis thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa 'di dran gso gtong ba dang chabs cig gtso che shos goms gshis bzang po 'di da lta gsar skyes 'tshar longs yong bzhin pa'i mi rabs gsar pa rnams la 'jags pa byed dgos/ khyim tshang nang bod pa'i bzang po'i goms gshis rnams nga tshos dran gso btang ste rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa goms gshis bzang wa de dang mthun pa zhig byed thub na so so'i 'khris la yod pa'i phru gu tsho dang / de min gzhan tshang mar ngag thog nas 'brel bshad rgyag mi dgos par/ don dngos sgo gsum gyi spyod pa'i thog nas ngo sprod byed dus pha rol po'i sems la 'jags po zhig yong gi red/ nga rang tshos dus chen 'di 'dra'i skabs su gtso chen so so'i mi rigs kyi goms gshis bzang po rnams dran gso dang / rgyud 'dzin byed rgyu gal chen po red snyam gyi 'dug ngas rtag tu brjod bzhin pa ltar nga rang tsho bod pa'i goms gshis bzang po 'di nga tsho bod pa gcig pu'i khe phan gyi don tsam min par mi'i rigs 261

spyi la khe phan dang / phan thogs yod pa zhig chags yod/ mi tsamadu ma zad/phan pa'i bsam pa zhes pa 'di srog chags tshang mar yang phan thogs yod pa zhig yin/ der brten nga rang tsho bod pa'i goms gshis bzang po 'di ngosa'adzin pa'i thog nas rgyun 'dzin dang / nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba byed dgos/ 'di ni nga rang tsho mi gcig pu dang / yang na bod pagacig pu'i don ma yin par/ che sa nas bshad na lha dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don chags yod/ thag nye sa nas bshad na nga rang tsho'i mthong chos la so so gang du gnas sa de'i nye skor du yod pa'i mi dang / dud 'gro tshun chad la phan thogs yod pa zhig rang bzhin chags kyi yod pas 'di gal chen poyin /phan pa'i rang bzhin can 'di yod na sems bag phebs po dang / yag po yong gi red/ gnod pa'i rang bzhin can zhig yod na de ni thabs sdug dor 'os pa red/ yag nyes bzang ngan zhes pa 'di phan pa'i rang bzhin can yin min la brten nas de'i chos nyid dang / ngo bo thag gcod kyi yod pa red/ zhes bka' 455// / /262

༄༅// phyi lo 1995 zla 3 tshes 16 nyin dha sar mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir nub phyogs kyi lung pa nas yong ba'i mi gang la gang 3tshams slebs yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho nang pa'i chos la do snang byed kyi ji+o 5ོda pa (5ga po red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra yod pa snadi dag lta ba dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba chen po yod na yang / spyir btang mi tshe gcig gi nang la phan pa bsgrub rgyu'i thog la chos lugs tshang ma phan thogs skyesad pa sha stag yin pas/ chos lugs tshang ma mthun po byed rgyu gal chen po red/ chos mi mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas te 'khrug pa byed pa 'di tsho'i gras dpe ma srid pa'i blo pham po dang / thabs skyo po red/ mi'i spyi tshogs nang la rtsod pa rgyag sa dang / 'khrug pa rgyag sa'i gzhi lto gos gtam gsum la sogs pa gnas tshul mang po zhig yod pa red/ chos zer ba 'di mi mthun pa mthun pa dang / ma skyid pa skyid pa bzo rgyu'i thabs shes shig yin pa 'dis mi mthun pa dang / ma skyid pa bzo rgyu'i 'khrug rtsod kyi rgyur gang la phyin pa yin na shin tu thabs skyo po dang / ga phyi log pa zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ chos brgyud tshang ma mthun po byed dgos/ mthun po yong thabs byed lugs de yang sems can rang rang so so'i khams dang mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i thog nas 'gro dgos pa 'dir gnad 'gag chags kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho gtam brjod rang dbang / 'gro lugs rang dbang / bsam blo gtong stangs rang dbang / chos dad rang dbang bcas yin pas/ so so'i khams dang mos pa dang 'tshams pa 263

byas nas 'gro dgos pa 'di gal chen po yin/ spyir btang nga'i bsam tshul 'di rtag par bshad kyi yod/ nub phyogs lung pa'i ye shu'i chos pa dang / rji'u yi chos pa/ kha che'i chos pa sogs so so pha mes kyi chos brgyud gang yin pa de'i thog la phyin pa yin na rnyog khra gsar pa dang / dka' ngal med par babs snying ba yong gi red/ so sos brtag dpyad yag po ma byas par chos lugs brjes pa yin na gang 'tshams song nas so sor dka' ngal 'phrad/ sems 'khrug rkyen byed mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dug chos lugs brjes rgyu de las sla po rtsa ba nas min/ so sor sngar gyi goms gshis dang / pha mes kyi chos brgyud gang yod pa de ga'i thog nas phyin pa yin na yag gi red/ yin na yang /so so sgor gyi ngos nas dus yun ring po'i ring la bsam blo nan tan btang nas gang ltar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs 'di rgyu mtshan mang ba dang /phan thogs che ba mthong ba yin na/ so so rang dbang red/ nang pa'i chos nyams len byas chog gi red/ yin na yang so so nang pa'i chos la zhugs pa'i rjes la rang nyid kyi chos gsar pa de yang dag pa dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa/ so so'i chos brgyud rnying pa de la gcig ma ldang pa dang / ma 'grigs pa lta bu'i skyon gyi cha nas brjod pa 'di rigs nam yang byed mi rung / so so rang nyid la nang pa'i chos des so so'i pha mes kyi chos las phan thogs dang / nus pa che ba yod pa yin na yang / so so'i lung pa'i nang gi mi mang che bar gnas tshul de chags kyi yod pa ma red/ de ltar na/ khams dang mos pa sna tshogs lu brten nas byung ba'i chos brgyud sna tshogs pa de dag tshang mar mos gus byed 264

rgyu de gal chen po 'dug ngas rtag par 'di bshad kyi yod/ da ring yang yang skyar bshad pa yin/ so sos nang pa'i chos la nyams zhib ltod rdzod byas nas de rang nyid la ran po yod pa yin na nang pa'i chos byed chog pa so so sger gyi thob thang red/ khyed rang tsho nub phyogs pa la dngos po yar rgyas phyin te deng sang rang 'gul gyi 'phrul chas sna mang yod pa ltar/ sems kyi nyams len de yang sud ji gcig mnan ma thag lam seng sems la bzo bcos thebs kyi yod pa lta bu'i re ba de 'dra byed mi rung / lo nas lo bstud 'bad brtson byed dgos/ dper na nga rang gi nyams myong thog nas bshad pa yin na/ nga lo bco lnga bcu drug gi mtshams nas nang pa'i chos la slob sbyong dang nyams len 'bad rtsol byas pa red/ da lta lo drug cu'i nang la slebs yod/ da dung rim pas nyams myong gsog gi yod pa ma gtogs/ dus yun thung ngu'i nang nyams rtogs skyes thub pa yong thabs mi 'dug khyed rang tsho yang de de bzhin yin pas/ 'go btsugs ma thag lam seng sems la 'gyur ba yong gi red bsam pa dran rgyu yod pa ma red/ gung thang tshang gi gsung gi nang / nyin re zas kyang mi dran brtson 'grus rtsom/ /zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'dod/ /zhag gsum lon nas rjes med g.yeng bas 'khyer/ /de 'dra de la ci yang mi 'ong bas//brtson 'grus chu wa'i rgyun bzhin sten zhiga.ang / zhes gsungs pa ltar snyugs bsring nas sgom rgyu de gal chen po red/de nas da ring 'dir rgya mi'i grogs po mang po zhig slebs yod pa red/khyed rang tsho spe wan la sogs pa rang dbang gi lung pa'i nang nas yong pa red/265
