khyed rang tsho 'ga' shas mi 'dra ba yod shas che/ mang che ba pha mes nas nang pa'i khyim tshang nas yong ba phal cher yin gyi red/ rgya mi rigs la mtshon na pha mes nas nang pa'i chos dar rgyas chen po yod pa'i lung pa zhig red/ khyed rang tsho don gnyer chen po byas nas yong / nyin ma kha shas ring chos 'chad nyan byed rgyu'i go skabs byung ba la dga' po byung / bshes gnyen bstan 'dzin byams chen nas hur thag byed kyi yod pa la rjes su yi rangs yod/ da dung yang bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs yag po zhig sgrub dgos/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub zer ba de sems can la phan pa sgrub rgyu yin pas/ mi gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can la phan bde sgru ba rgyu'i don dag la khyed rang tsho tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ mi la phan pa sgrub stangs de mi'i sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed rgyu de yin pa red/ mi'i sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed pa la sngon la so so'i sems rgyud 'dul dgos/ so so'i sems rgyud ma dul na mi'i sems rgyud 'dul thub rgyu khag po red/ dper na/ dge rgan gcig gis dge phrug la rig gnas 'dra po sde tshan gcig gi 'grel bshad byed pa la sngon la so sos shes dbe|sa/ 11 so ma shes na mi la bshad mi thub/ gang gi sgo nas gzhan la phan pa sgrub rgyu'i don de rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa zhig dang / de la cha rgyus yod pa zhig dgos pa red/ sngon la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi lam yongs rdzogs la go ba chags pa zhig dgos gal chen po yod/ nyams rtogs skyes rgyu ga le ga ler rim pas rim pas yong gi red/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad de dang po mi dge bcu 266

slong gi tshul khrims nyams su len stangs nas bzungs te ya gi'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum gyi go 'phang sgrub rgyu'i bar gyi lam cha tshang ba zhig go rim bsgrigs nas bshad yong ba 'di la gnad 'gag chen po yod pa red/ lam yongs rdzogs lu go ba ma chags par gzhung tshan 'ga' re dpyis phyin pa shes na yang / de ga'i gnas tshul tsam ma gtogs/ lam yongs rdzogs la blo bskyed thon pa khag po red/ khyed chos da bar hur thag byas pa ltar/ da dung yang hur thag byed rogs/ rgya nag gi rgyal khab chen snub der mi dung phyur bcu gnyis yod pa'i lung pa zhig yin pa red/ lung pa de'i nang la bde skyid phran bu zhig byung ba yin na yang mi dung phyur bcu gnyis la phan gyi yod pa dang / sdug bsngal chung ngu zhig byung bayin na yang mi dung phyur bcu gnyis la gnod pa babs yong gi yod pa red/ bde sdug gang byung na yang mi mang po de tsam la phan gnod 'brel mthan zhig yin dus rgya nag lung pa'i nang la bde skyid dang / sems la zhi bde yong thub pa zhig byung na de yag po red/ nga tshos gung khran ring lugs btsan dbang bshad mkhan de sdug po yin pa mthong gi yod na yang / de mgo rding slog ste rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam blo gtong gi med/ mi'i rang gshis la ha cang sbag srub dog po dang / btsan dbang zer ba de la su yang dga' gi ma red/brgya nag rang nyid kyi mi mang gis kyang 'dod kyi med pa yin dus/mi la rang dbang dgos kyi 'dug zer gyi yod/ bod rang dbang sgrub stangs de yang rgya mi la'ang bde skyid yod pa/ bod mi la yang bde skyid yod pa gcig 267

rtsod len byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ bod rgyal rgya pham zer ba'i skad cha bshad kyi med/ nga rang tsho tshang ma mi yin pa gcig gyur red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lo rgyus thog khyim mtshes byas nas bsdad mkhan yin pas gnyis kur bde skyid yod pa zhig dang / phan tshun lhag bsam rnam dag gis gcig yid gcig la ches pa/ gcig gis gcig la brtse ba dang gus pa yod pa/ gcig gis gcig gi khe phan shes pa'i thog nas rogs res dang 'cham 〈sna byed thub na de yag po red bsam nas/ ngas da lta bar du 'bad rtsol de byed kyi yod/gang ltar yang snying rgya dang bod kyi dka' ngal de rgya bod gnyis kyis sel dgos/rang dbang lung pa'i nang la bsdad pa'i rgya mi tshos rang dbang med pa'i rgya mi grogs po tsho la khyed rang tshos yin lugs min lugs kyi gnas tshul gsal bshad byed rgyu dang / rgyus yod byed thub na yag sngage red/ chos kyi ngos nas bshad pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i 'tshe ba spangs/byams brtse'i rang bzhin can gyi bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis rgya mi rigs la phan rgyu ma gtogs/ gnod pa gang yang med/ de lta bu'i 'tshe ba med pa'i lta ba dang / spyod pa de mi dung phyur bcu gnyis yod sa'i lung pa'i nang la khyab spel thub pa yin na mi mang sngoge la phan gyi red/ mi mang po tsam du ma zad/ rgya yul nang yod pa'i srog chags 'bu srin mang po la'ang phan gyi red/ sha spangs pa'i rgya mi mang sngoge skusgod/ khong tshos sha med pa'i lto zas zhim 〈sna bzo gi yod pa de tsho yar rgyas yag po btang / rgya nag nang la skusgod pa'i ngang pa de tsho mang tsam tshe thar btang thub na yag 1rdzo red/ deng sang gsar shog nang la rgya nag la 268

bya de dang / phag pa mnyam du bzhag nas sha mi 'dra ba bzo gi yod pa de tsho'i gras mi dgos pa red/ de tshor nad 'bu gsar pa de 'dra yong gi yod lugs gsar shog nang thon 'dug mis sha la brngams/ rgyu la brngams/ lto la brngams pa'i thog bya de dang / phag pa gso tshags byed pa 'di tsho'i gras shin tu thabs sdug red/ nub phyogs rgyal khab nang la yang bya de dang / phag pa/ba glang sogs rgyag pa yong ba'i thabs shes 'dra min mang po byas/ sha de tsho zas ji/'i rjes la sngon med pa'i nad rigs 'dra min byung nas dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'a dug lhag bsam gyis zin pa zhig ma byung na/ mi las bya rgyu mang rgadang /mi las bsam rgyu mang ba/ mi las sdug pa ha lam med pa lta bu red/ gang ltar rgya nag da lta'i gnas stangs de 'dra gcig gi thog la phyin pa yin na mi ma skyid pa'i zhor la stod bcud yong rdzogs la god chag yong rgyu ha cang gsal po red/ des na khyed rang tsho rgya mi'i grogs po tshos so so rang nyid chos rnam dag byed pa dang chabs cig yul khams chen ngo de'i nang mi mang po zhig gi bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel thabs la khyed rang tshos gang la gang 'tshams kyi zhabs 'degs sgrub thub kyi red bsam pa'i re ba yod/ de khyed rang tsho'i dgongs par bcangs/ gzhan dag phyi rgyal gyi mi yin yang rung / phyi rgyal la yod pa'i rgya mi tsho yin yang rung / khyed rang tsho da ring 'dir yong ste bod pa la dga' po byas/ bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byas/ sha tsha byed kyi yod pa red/ nga bod pa gcig yin pa'i cha nas khyed rang tsho tshang ma la bka' drin che zhu gi yin/269

nga chos ngad pa deng sang gnas stangs ha cang thabs lharwa 1 gcig gi gnas tshul 'og la bsdad yod/ bod nas rgya gar la yong mkhan mi de tsho ga dus thug na yang ngu mkhan sha stag red/ khong tsho skyid drag nas ngus pa ma red/ nga tsho bod pa de 'dra gcig gi gnas tshul 'og la bsdad yod/ bod pa tshos nga la blos 'gol gyi yod pa ltar/ ngas ga tshod thub thub byed kyi yod na yang / nga mi gcig red/ deng sang nga tsho ༄bad pa skyabs med mgon med/ bod lung pa nyam thag po/ tshothabs skyo po gcig gi 'og la bsdad nas bsam pa rnam dag gis nga tsho'i bden don sgrub rgyu 'di'i thog la khyed rang tshos sha tsha dang / rgyab skyor byed rgyu gal chen po red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir khyed rang tshos bod pa'i don dag la ga tshad thub thub kyi phan thogs byed thub pa byung na dga' bsuyod/ rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam pa med par spyi sger tshang mar phan bde yong ba'i kun slong dang 'brel ba'i thog nas bod pa'i thog la ga tshad thub thub kyi rgyab skyor byed thub na so so bsod nams gsog thub rgyu red/ bod nang la yod bsdad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang dngangs skrag dza drag chen po/ khog nang nas me 'bar rung kha nas du ba thon mi nus par sdod mkhan 66) tshab byas nas ngas khyed rang tsho la thugs rje che zer gyi yod/ khyed rang zo brgyud nas da dung bod pa'i grogs po 'dzam bu gling lto byang shar nub gang sar yod pa rnam la yang ngas da ring go skabs 'di zin nas thugs rje che zhes zhu 'dod byung —/nga rang bo da pa'i ngos nas tshang mas da lta bar du hur thag 'bad thag byas pa red/ da dung yin na yang hur thag byed dgos/ khyed rang tsho bod 270

nas yong mkhan tsho gnangs gzhes tsam la phar log 'gro rgyu red/ tswa bde po byed dgos/ 'das pa'i lo sum cu so drug tsam phyin pa'i ring la nga tshor dka' ngal mang po 'phrad yod kyang / bod nang gi mi mang tsho'i sems shugs chag yod pa ma red/ nga tsho phyi la sdod mkhan tsho'i sems shugs kyang chag yod pa ma red/ nga tsho bod pa nyung nyungagacig ma gtogs med na yang / nga tshor bden pa sto pa dang / lhag bsam ri btsugs pa bzhin brtan po yod pa/ 'dzam gling nang do snang byed mkhan mang poyod pa bcas rkyen mang po tshogs pa la brten nas bod don gyi gnas tshul 'de rgya nag rgyal khab chen po de'i phyi 'brel srid byus nang dka' ngal che shos shig chags bsdad yod/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus 'di gdug rtsub kho nas mnan thub rgyu'i re ba rgyag gi yod pa red de de lam la 'gro thub kyi ma red/ de lam la ma 'gro ba zhig nga rang chos byed dgos/ lam seng gdong nag po bstan nas rgyag res rgyab zer ba min/mchon cha bed spyod byed zer ba min/ nga rang tsho so so'i bden don rang lugs de yag po zin/ so so'i rang tshugs brtan po zin thub pa byed dgos/ rtsa ba'i don dag che sa nas rig pa bsgrims rgyu gal chen po red/ rigs mang po zhig gi nang la rtsa ba'i lhag bsam yod na yang byed stangs kyi thog nas ma 'grigs pa de 'dra yong gi yod/ 'di tsho'i gras so so rang sa nas ma 'chug pa byed dgos/nga rang tshor rab tu byung ba mang po yod/ tshang mas gzab gzab ma byas na gra pa dang btsun mas zhabs 'dren zhu ba de 'dra byas na yag po khyon nas 271

ma red/ gzab gzab byed dgos/ lus la gra chas gyon/ sems de khyim pa'i bsam blo ji bzhin bsdad pa yin na gra chas gyon dang ma gyonayod pa ma red/dper na/ nyin shas 'di'i ring la phyogs mtha' nas mi mang po yong ste dge 'dun pa tsho la 'gyed 'bul gyi lho pa red/ spyir btang lto gos kyi gnas stangs gra pa sto las khyim pa pho mo tsho dka' rnyog che ba yod/ khong tsho phru gu gso dgos/phru gu'i slob sbyong gi don dag la bsam blo gtong dgos/ khyim tshang gi gnas tshul sogs mang po zhig la bsam blo gtong dgos/ gra pa tsho 'gro bde sdod bde red/ dngos gnas dgos mkho'i cha nas rtsis pa yin na dngul de khong tshor sprod 'os pa ma gtogs/ gra par dgos mkho bde tsam med/ yin na yang dge 'dun bsod nams kyi zhing du bltas nas bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi goms gshis nang dge 'dun pa tsho la 'gyed dang / gsol ja sogs bsnyen bkur mang po zhig zhu gi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho 'gyed len mkhan tsho'i bsam blo'i nang spyi tshogs nang dka' ngal yod pa 'dra 'dra red/ lhag don khyim pa pho mo phru gu mang po gso dgos pa/ dka' tshegs chen pos bsags pa'i dngul nga tshor sprod pa 'di dag nga tshos gyon chas 'di 'dra zhig gyon gyi yod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs kyi ming zhig thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas sprad pa red bsam nas rang rang so sos phran bu'i dran shes bag yod bsten/ ngo tsha khrel gzhung yod pa zhig ma byas na shin tu thabs khyod nga red/ rgya mis nga tshor bshu gzhog gtong mkhan zhes lab pa de dngos gnas chags pa red/ rab tu byung ba tsho'i bsam cho de khyim pa phal pa'i bsam blo rang la bsdad/ rtags 272

cha lugs mi 'dra ba zhig gyon nas 'gyed dang / thob thang rtsod pa yin na de ni bshu gzhog rang red ma gtogs/ yag po gtan nas min pas gzab gzab byed dgos/ rab tu byung ba tshos gal che shos slob sbyong byed dgos pa dang /slob sbyong byas pa lag len la bkal nas spus dag tu 'gro thabs la 'bad brtson byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tshos dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa 'di dag gis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa/ yang sgos 'gro ba bde ba/ lhag par bod gangs can gyi jongs kyi bden mtha' myur du gsal nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal thub pa/ des rkyen pas bod gangs can ljongs kyi khyim mtshes nye skor tshang ma la phan thogs yong thub pa/ de brgyud nas 'dzam bu gling spyi la yang gang la gang 'tshams kyi phan thogs yong thub pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gnang dgos/sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa'i dgon khag rnams dang / gzhis chags khag kha 'thor gnas sdod ser skya mi mang bcas khyed rang tshang ma la thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ bal yul nang la bod pa khri re gnyis yod pa dang /sa gnas lung khug 'ga' shas la dka' ngal can de 'drayang yod pa red/ 'on kyang spyi yongs bod mi tsho'i gnas stangs yag thag chod red/ dpal 'byor gyi thog nas bal yul rgyal khab la phyi rgyal dngul rtsis kyi 'bab yong thog bod pas zhabs 'degs gang la gang 'tshams bsgrubs sku(da pa red/ sdudags gcig nas so so'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs tshags tshud po byas/ de dang chabs cig mi rigs kyi la rgya ma brjed pa'i thog nas so so'i chos dang rig gzhung 273

nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs la rang rang so d+ku rten gzhi bzungs ste tshang mas hur thag gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ nga rang cho ༄bad spyi pa'i don dag yin na yang bden mtha' gsal la nye ba lta bu red/byams brtse rtsa bar gyur pa'i bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi thog la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ byams brtse zer ba 'di phyi pa dang / nang pa/ chos yod pa dang med pa tshang mar phan thogs yod pa dang / dgos mkho yod pa zhig yin dus des 'gro ba mi spyi la phan thogs yod pas ma tshad/ srog chags grog sbur tshun la yang phan thogs yod pa/ khor yug srung skyob la yang phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ de 'dra'i thog nas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i mi tshos do snang byed pa'i skabs 'dir nga tshos lhag par du yang gzab gzab gnang rgyu gal chen po 'dug mis do snang med pa'i skabs la/nga rang tsho tod yangs phyin na thal cha de tsamakhabad kyang / misado snang byed pa'i gnas skabs la nga rang tshos spus dag po byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po 'dugamador na nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi chogs gang du yin na yang so sku'i pha mes nas yod pa'i ya rabs bzang spyod kyi goms gshis 'di nga tsho'i khyad nor yin/'jig rten gyi dpe la yod pa bzhin/ nor bu rang la yod dus nor bu'i nor nyams ma chod/ nor bu gzhan la shor dus sems pa gting nas skyo byung / zer ba bzhin nga rang chorwa 1da gangs can gyi snod bcud gnyis /ra nyams nyes ha las pa byung yod na yang / bod pa'i byams brtse dang 'brel ba'i ya rabs bzang po'i goms gshis 'di da lta nga tshos zin thub kyi yod pa red/ so sor bzang 274

i khyad chos yod pa 'di snang med du lus/ lhod yangs su shor/ phyi logs kyi khra khra zing zing la dwang bstod byas/ de la mngon par bstod na nor 'khrul red/ 'dzam bu gling gi yar rgyas la ltos na/ nga tsho ༄1da pa rjes lus red/ rjes lus de dag nga tshos nges par du gso dgos kyang de dang chabs cig so so rang nyid la yod pa'i bzang po'i goms gshis rnams rtsa brlag tu phyin na/ nam zhig nga rang tsho 'gyod pa'i nang la slebs rgyu'i nyen ka tan tan yod/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu de yang gabo rang gi sems rgyud kyi steng 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu red ma gtogs/ phyi logs kyi dgon pa khra khra zing zing dang / mchod rdzas yag po bshams/ sku gsung thugs rten rin thang chen po bsgrigs pa de tsam la chog shes byas nas bsdad na mi 'grigs/ dgon pa dang lha khang 'du 'god byas pa yin na yang de 'grems ston khang shi bzo 'dra zhig chags na yag po min/ rten sku gsung thugs rten rtsab chen po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mi'i klad pa'i nang la cha tshang yod dgos/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa de dag mi'i gshis rgyud dang 'dres pa'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ lha khang stong pa zhig yod pa la ha las rgyu gang yang med/ lha khang stong pa bod nang rgya mis kyang bzo gi 'dug rgyal khab kyi gna' bo'i dngos rdzas red ces dgon pa rnying pa tsho nyams gso byas te 'grems ston khang bzo gi 'dug de tsam gyis bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mi thub/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum zer ba de/ nga rang tsho'i gshis rgyud la tshang ba dang /275

rgyud thog nas bstan rgyu yod pa zhig dgos pa red/ nga rang tsho mi'i rgyud thog la med na phyi'i khang pa 'dra chags po yod pa tsam gyi 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red /tshang mas da lta phan chad hur bskyed gnang ba red/ da dung yang hur thag gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/ spyir btang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi yul khag dang / nga rang tsho'i khyim mtshes yas mas tsho dang bsdur ba yin na nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs 'di dam tshig mthun po dang / rdog la 'gril po yag thag chod red/ gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang dang / byes 'khod mi mang chos brgyud dang lung tshan 'dra mi 'dra spyi yongs kyi cha nas nga rang tsho tshang ma gangs can pa gcig gyur gyi bsam blo shugs chen po red/ dam tshig gong bu gcig gyur gyi nus pa tan tan yod pa red/ 'dis bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i thog nas 'dzam bu gling spyi la phan thogs byed rgyu/ mdor na rang gzhan tshang mar 'di phyi gnyis yod/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don 'grub rgyu tshang mar phan thogs yod pa red/spyir btang srid phyogs nas mthun sgril zer ba dang / chos phyogs nas dam tshig mthun po byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho'i don dag 'grub dang ma 'grub de yang thun mong gi nus pa yag po zhig 'donathub ma thub la rag lus kyi yod pa red/ da ring 'dir brtan bzhugs 'bul gyi yod pa red/ 'di yang bla ma dang slob ma'i dam tshig dang 'brel ba chen po yod pa red/ nga rang la cha bzhag pa yin na/ skye 'chi la rang dbang yod pa lta rtsa ba nas min na yang sems bde po'i ngang nas smon lam 'dra brgyab/ 'phen pa 'dra btang na khyad 276

par yong gi red/ nga rang tsho mthun po byed rgyu 'di chos dang 'jig rten gang gi thog nas bshad payin na yang gal chen sngo rdod/ tshang mas hur bskyed gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ da ring skabs su babs pa bal yul nang bsdad pa'i bod mi ser skya mchog dman tshang mar dmigs bsal thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa bka' drin can gyi yon tan la dman la lhag par brtse ba'i khyad chos yod pa red/ nga rang tsho ston pa bka' drin can de'i rjes 'brangs shig yin dus nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang mi skyo ba 'di tsho la phran bu'i skyid sdug 'khos ka drag pa tshos blta rtogs rogs ram byed rgyu gal chen po red/ bsod nams gsog stangs ma nor ba byed stangs shes na yag po red/de nas bar skabs bod nang la srid byus 'gyur ba phran bu phyin yod/ wad nang dpal 'byor 'dzugs bskrun dang / slob gra 'dzugs rgyu/ 'phrod bsten la sogs pa de 'dra'i jog la bod kyi phyi logs nas rogs ram byed rgyu'i go skabs gsar pa zhig yod pa red/ da lta phan chad la phyi la sdod mkhan bod rigs nang nas bod nang slob gra dang / sman khang chung chung de 'dra 'dzugs rgyu sogs las ka phran bu phran bu byed kyi yod pa red/ de tsho'i gras yag po 'dugagatso che shos bod nang la yod pa'i gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang rnams bod kyi rtsa ba'i stobs shugs zer yang rung / bod don bden pa yin pa'i ngo sprod zer yang rung / gcas nga gzhis lus mi mang rnams yin/ khong tsho'i gnas stangs ha cang skyo dze dang / dka' ngal chen po'i 'og la yod pa dang / khong tsho'i bsam 277

blo'i nang la rang dbang 'dod pa'i bsam tshul de yod pa yin dus/ nga tshos 'dir skad 'bod byed pa 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / bden pa chags pa red/nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la dka' ngal med pa min na yang / ltos sa ltos 'jog gi phran bu'i drag par brten gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi don dag la nga tsho btsan byol ba tshos bod nang mang tshogs spyi 'phrod bsten dang / lhag par du slob sbyong thog la nga tshos zhabs 'degs phran bu bsgrub thub pa byung na de gal chen po dang / gnad 'gag chen po 'dug de bzhin phyi rgyal rogs ram tshogs pa de 'dra nas bod nang 'dzugs bskrun thog la do snang dang / rogs ram byed kyi yod pa red/ ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ rogs tshogs khag nas bod nang 'dzugs bskrun rogs ram byed thub pa byung na dga' bsu yod/ 'on kyang bod nang rogs ram byas pa de dag bod mi rang la gtor ma dmigs sa la 'khyol ba zhig dgos kyi 'dug de min ming la bod pa'i rogs ram yin zer btags/ ngo thog de phyogs gzhan dag la phyin pa yin na 'grig gi mi 'dug ces dang / rogs ram byed sa de yang grong khyer dza() nang la ga tshad min zer yang mthun rkyen drag pa yod/ gang yin zer na/— grong khyer nang rgya mi phon chen po yod pa yin dus slob gra'i mthun rkyen dang / sman bcos mthun rkyen sogs drag pa yod pa red/ dper na/lha sa grong khyer gcig gi nang la yang rgya mi yod sa'i sa khul la slog skud sgom pa dang / grog shugs che ba bed spyod byed thub kyi yod pa red/ bod pa yod sa de tsho'i gras glog skud phra ba yod/ grong khyer gcig gi nang la yang de 'dra'i 278

dbye 'byed btang gi yod pa red/ lhag par rgya mi med pa'i grong gseb lung khug sa khul khag la gang ci'i thog nas mthun rkyen skyo ba yod pas/ de tsho'i thog la rogs ram mang tsam byed thub na bod pa rang la sha khu sha thim phan thogs che ba yong ba 'dug ces ngas phyi rgyal de tshor 'bod bskul byed kyi yod/ gcig byas na da ring 'dir yod pa'i grogs po tsho'i nang la bod nang 'dzugs bskrun gyi las kur 'brel ba yod pa kha shas yod shas che/ da ring go skabs 'di bzung nas khyed tsho tshang ma la thugs rje che zer gyi yin/de nas bal yul nang yod pa'i bod mi khyim tshang dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs legs tsam yod pa kha shas nas/ btsan byol bod pa'i slob phrug tshor mthun rkyen sbyar te rogs byed mkhan kha shas yod pa red/ da ring go skabs 'di bzung nas ngas khyed rang tsho'i bya ba 'di bsngags par 'os pa/ bstod pa'i me tog 'thor 'os pa yin pas thugs rje che zer gyi yin/da res 'dir bal yul nang la yod pa'i dgon sde ris su ma chad pa'i bla sprul khag mang po zhig phebs yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas bstan pa'i don dag la thugs khur bskyed nas da lta bar du hur thag gnang gi yod pa red/ da dung yang hur bskyed gnang nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub pa dang chabs cig rang gis rang la zhu dag gnang rgyu de gal chen po 'dugang rang cha bzhag na/ rgyal ba rin po che'i ming yod pa red de/ rang nyid ston pa bcom ldan 'das bka' drin can de'i rjes 'brangs dge slong thebs chags shig yin bsam pa'i 'du shes de rtag par sems nang la bcangs te rang gis 279

rang la zhib 'jug byed kyi yod/ khyod rgyal ba rin po che'i khri 'di'i sgang la bsdad de nga rgyal byed kyi mi 'dug gam/ khyod ham pa byed kyi mi 'dug gam/ khyod rgyu mtshan med pa'i khengs dregs byed kyi mi 'dug gam zhes rang gis rang la zhib 'jug rtag par byed kyi yod/ bla ma rnam pa chos kyang de de bzhin byas nas/ nga rang tsho bla ma'i ming yod pa zhig yin dus de lugs kyi rang gis rang la zhu dag btang / rang gis rang la lcag bskul/ rang gis rang la gcun 'doms byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug de ngas zhor 'phros yin/bco brgyad rin po che dgung lo bgres po red/ bstan pa'i don dag la thugs khur bskyed nas nga rang la lam 'bras 〈bo bshad kyi 'khrid gnang nas slob bshad pa'i gral la slebs thub pa 'di rin po che'i bka' drin la brten nas byung ba red/ da res rin po che 'dir nyi ma mang po lhod mjal thub par ha cang dga' po byung / rin po che dgung lo yar gtugs yong gi yod pa red de/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dag la thugs khur bskyed nasasbun ring bzhugs pa'i 'phen pa yag po gtong rogs gnang / rin po che'ileṭag tshoms de yang sngon ma'i rtsis nas ring du phebs 'dug pas/ da dungashenag tshoms ring po sa la thug thug bar du rin po bzhugs dgos/ bka' drin che/da ring chu sgang khongs gtogs gzhis byes ser skya thun mong nas kyang dad pa dang dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas brtan bzhugs phul ba red/khyed rang tshang mas smon lam rgyag gi red la/ nga'i ngos nas kyang smon lam 'debs kyi yin/ bar skabs nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang skad cha phran bu lhags 280

pa red/ de'i skabs la mdo stod khongs gtogs mi mang spyi byings rnams nas ༷lhag bsam brtan po dang / so sos rang tshugs zin po byas pa red/ byes 'khod mi mang tsam du ma zad gzhis lus bod nang la gtam 'chal dkrog gtam slebs pa'i skabs la mi mang spyi byings kyi langs khyedags ha cang brtan po byung 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa spyi'i thog nas bshad pa yin na/ dam tshig mthun bsgril gong bu gcig gyur shugs chen po yod pa ha cang gsal po red/da ring go skabs 'di zin te mdo stod khongs gtogs gzhis byes skya ser mi mang spyi byings kyi thog nas lhag bsam ri btsugs pa nang bzhin brtan 11 yod pa la ha cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ nga tsho bod gangs can pa zhes chol kha gsum ris su ma chad pa rnams sngar chos rgyal snubarno skabs nas bod gong bu gcig gyur du bsdad pa red/ bar skabs srid don gyi 'pho 'gyur mang po byung ba dang / gtso bo lha sar yod pa'i bod srid gzhung gis mig rgyang ring po'i blta rtogs yag po byed ma thub par mdo smad dang / mdo stod kyi sa khul mang po zhig skyabs med mgon med lta bur lus te 'thus shor chen po phyin pa ha cang gsal po red/ yin na yang nga rang tsho tshang ma mi rigs dang /skad yig gcig gyur thog lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug zer ba'i lta spyod gcig gyur la brten nas tshang ma'i bsam blo'i nang la nga mo tshang ma gangs/ can pa yin bsam pa zhig dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar gyur pa zhig yin bsam pa chol kha gsum gyi sa khul ngesangs rdzogs la yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas bar skabs 281

chab srid 'dzin skyong gi gnas tshul 'thus shor phyin yod na yang / gang ltar nga rang tsho mi rigs gcig gyur gyi la rgya mu mthud nas bsdad thub pa byung yod pa red/ dper na bar skabs bod nang rgya mi gung khran gyis dbang bsgyur dza drag byu nga ba'i skabs la chol kha gsum gyi mi mang yongs su rdzogs pa rnams gangs can pa gcig gyur yin pa'i 'du shes dang ngos 'dzin lhag par du shugs che ru phyin yod pa red/ nga rang tsho chol kha gsum gcig bsgril bya rgyu ha cang gi gal chen po yin par brten/ sngon ma bden tshig smon lam gyi nang la yang /yongs rdzogs bod jongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ zhes bris dgos pa'i gnas tshul der thug pa red/ don dngos po'i gnas chod la yin na yang nga rang sgor gyi ngos nas bod kyi rtsa don 'thab rtsod kyi dgos pa'i gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi rig gzhung 'di'i don dag gtso bor 'dzin gyi yod/ chab srid kyi gnas stangs gtso bor rtsis kyi med/ gang yin zer na/ srid don gyi rang dbang gtsang ma zhig yod na yang spyi tshogs de'i nang la zhi bde bag phebs yag po zhig med na snying po gang yang med/ deng sang 'tham bu gling 'di'i sgang la lung pa mang po'i nang la chab srid kyi rang dbang thob pa'i mtshams la nang 'khrug lung pa gang rgyab/ athe ri ma'i yul khag dang /apha gha ne+e si than/ /ma tho ḍi ya sdusags kyi gnas tshul la bltas na shes gsal red/ gang ltar nga rang tshor rang dbang thob nas mi smon rang skyid yag spro zhig yong thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ de yong ba la spyi tshogs nang ya rabs drang bden gyi spyod bzang gnas thub pa byung ba yin na spyi tshogs bde skyid ldan 282

pa yong gi red/ der brten sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos sam/ bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung ya/ rabs spyod bzang de gal chen por brtsi gi yod/ lo rgyus kyi nang la mtshon na/ mdo stod smad kyi mi mang po zhig gis bod gangs can pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i rig gzhung 'di dag bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin skyong spel gsum thog byas rjes chen po bzhag yod/ sngon gyi gsung 'bum mang po yod pa tshor bltas pa yin na/ gsung 'bum brtsams mkhan gyi mkhas dbang mang spro zhiga.a mdo'i khul dang / mdo stod kyi sa khul nas yin pa gsal po yod/dgon pa khag la cha bzhag pa yin na yang / mdo smad khul dang / mdo stod khul la sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa'i dgon sde ha cang mang po yod pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs la yang chol kha gsum gcig gyur dgos pa de gal chen po chags yod/ des na bod nang dang / nga tsho btsan byol ba'i nang la chol gsum gong bu gcig gyur gyi bsam cho de tshang ma'i sems la ngos 'dzin gsal po yod pa ltar/ da dung yang tshang mas de la do snang yag po byed dgos/ gnas tshul chung tsag gis rkyen pas chol kha'i 'then 'khyer byas na thabs skyo po red/ khungs med pa red/ bar lam mi re zung gi byed las kyis rkyen pas skad cha mang po lhags pa de tsho'i gras rkyen ngan g.yang la khug pa lta bu chags te nga rang tsho tshang mar do snang gsar pa slebs thub pa byung ba red/tshang ma blo bde po byas/ hur thag 'bad thag gnang dgos/ ma 'ongs pa la 283

yin na yang / mi'i spyi tshogs nang la re zung re zung gra ma 'grigs thon mkhan yong srid pa red/ der ha las rgyu gang yang med/ de 'dra yong ba'i skabs la rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi thog nas da lta nang bzhin rang tshugs brtan po zin nas sdod rgyu gal chen po 'dug lung tshan dang / yul tsho/ lha sde mi sde gang du yin na yang phran bu phran bu bshad mkhan yong ba 'di chos nyid red/ 'on kyang rgya che'i mang tshogs nas che sa'i gnad don ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te ri btsugs pa bzhin brtan po byas nas sdod dgos/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bka' 455// // 284

༄tsho// phyi lo 1995 zla 4 tshes 19 nyin/ bod gzhung dang / bod ljongs lha sde mi sdesongs nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul zhus pa de'i thog stsal ba'i bka' slob/sngon ma ngos kyi lo skeg skabs khyed rnams tshang ma 'dzoms nas brtan bzhugs gnang ba de skabs skal ba bzang po byung / de ring yang lo drug cu re gcig la slebs pa'i skabs 'dir bod gangs can ljongs kyi chos rgyud tshang ma'i dbu khrid rnam pa tsho so sor mdzad brel dang sku ngalayod bzhin du dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas de ring 'dir phebs te tshang mos dad pa dang dam tshig 'dun pa gcig gyur gyi thog nas ngos kyi tshe bgegs bar chad zhi ste/ tshe mthar phyin pa'i thog nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la lo na gang mtho mtho sdod pa'i thugs smon gnang yod pa 'dis tan tan phan thogs yong gi red snyam byung /tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/de ring bod ljongs lha sde mi sde yongasanas brtan bzhugs phul ba bzhin bod 'bangs skye bo mchog dman phal mo che tshang ma dad 'dun gcig sgril gyi sgo nas smon lam rgyag gi yod pa 'di la bden mthu zhig tan tan yod pa ltar ha cang yag po byung bas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ da lta bzlas pa gsog skabs nga rang tshe dang bsodanams 'phel nas ring du gnas te bstan pa spyi dang / lhag par bod gangs can jongs kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mthar son pa dang /mtha' 'khyol ba yong ba'i smon lam rgyab pa dang chabs cig bod gangs can ljongs kyi lhag bsam can gyi skye bosku'ongs rdzogs kyi tshe bgegs bar chad zhinas/285

rang rang nus pas cogs tshod kyi bod bstan pa chab srid la zhabs 'degs mthar phyin pa sgrub thub pa'i smon lam rgyab yod/ de ring brtan bzhugs dang smon lam 'debs pa 'di nga gcig pu'i don min/ ngos rang yang bod gangs can ljongs kyi lhag bsam can zhig yin par cha bzhag nas/ nga rang the ba'i mdor na bod gzhis byes gang dang gang du gnas pa'i lhag bsam can de dag tshe ring por sdod thub pa dang / rang so sos 'dun pa bskyed de bstan pa chab srid kyi don bsgrub rgyu'i 'gan khur dang nus pa ji ltar yod pa rnams bgegs med mthar son pa yong ba'i ngos nas smon lam rgyab pa yin la/ khyed rang tshos kyang de ltar smon lam rgyab na yag po yong gi red/ lhag par bod nang dngangs skrag gi 'og tu gnas pa des rkyen pas lus khams mi bde bar dka' ngal nang lhung pa de dag ni nga tsho'i gtso bo'i dmigs bya zhig yin pas khong 'i ched du tshang mas thugs smon gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ tshe ring du gnas thabs yongs grags mthong chos la 'phrod bsten yag po bya rgyu 'di rigs yin la/gting zab sa nas bsod nams 'phel ba zhig dgos/ de la nga rang tsho tshang ma lhag bsam 'chug pa med pa zhig dgos rgyu rtsa ba yin/ ji tsam lhag bsam bzang po yod pa de'i tshod kyis rang bzhin bsod nams 'phel ba chos nyid yin/bod gzhis byes ser skya tshang ma lhag bsam bzang po dgos rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ gzhi rkang tshang ma lhag bsam rma med pa'i brtan po zhig yod/ yin na'ang chos zab sar bdud zab brjod pa bzhin/ nga rang sto lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas bslangs te tshang ma chig bsgril yod pa 'di'i thog 'gal/ rkyen 286

gyi gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba'i bag zon bya rgyu'i thad tod g.yeng mi 'gro ba byed dgos/ chos brgyud khag la mtshon na sa dge bka' rnying bzhi ni ston pa gcig gi rjes 'brangs yin pa dang / g.yung drung bon la cha bzhag na'ang bod gangs can ljongs kyi pha mes dus kyi chos brgyud cig yin/ bar skabs shig nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas gsungs pa mang po zhig bon gyi chos brgyud nang blangs te nyams len byed kyi yod/ rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas tshul ji ltar yin min la ma ltos par da lta'i gnas tshul la/ nga rang tsho tshang ma thun mong la bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gyis mtshon pa'i mthosar na zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi nyams len gcig gyur du yod pa zhig chags yod/ de ltar rang re dam tshig gcig tu bsgril rgyu'i cha rkyen yod pa 'di gzhir bzung tshang mas dad pa dag snang phyogs ris med pa'i thog nas gcig gyur la shugs snon bskyon rgyu gal chen yin/ da bar yag thag chod yod kyang / da dung tshang mas ltod g.yeng ma song ba'i dgongs bzhes gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ de ring bstan 'dzin skyes chen mang po zhig dang / mkhan rin po che kun dga' dbangaphyug kyang phebs yod/ rnam pa tshos mtshon pa'i ris med 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub mkhan bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu tshang ma sku tshe brtan pa dang / rnam kun rang rang so so'i ngos nas 'phrod bsten dang sman bcos/ tshe sgrub gnang rgyu sogs zhe ltod du ma song ba gnang rogs zhu snye/ yin/deng sang 'dzam gling thog spyir nang pa'i chos dang / yang sgos bod gang 287

can ljongs la yod pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la do snang byed mkhan mang du 'gro gi yod/ 'di 'dra'i dus skabs la nga rang tsho phyogs dang ris su med pa'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang mkhan tshang mas/ gtso che shos sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma mchis pa tshang ma dad pa dag snang 'o chu gcig 'dres sngar lhag yong thabs gnang dgos pa dang / de nas rje rin po ches gsungs pa bzhin/ rang ma dul bar gzhan 'dul ba'i gnas med gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar rang gi sems dul ba zhig ma byung na/ gzhan gyi sems rgyud 'dul gyiyin zhes bshad pas 'grigs thabs med/ tshang mas ji tsam gzhan la phan bde sgrub pa de tsam gyi so so rang nyid kyis lag tu blangs nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de ring chos brgyud khag gi dbu khrid tsho 'dir phebs yod dus/ rang rang so sor dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i rtsa ba dang / yan lag nying lag bcas pa tshang mar 'bod skul gnang rgyu gal chen 11 yin/'das pa'i lo sum cu so drug ring btsan byol gzhung gi srid byus rtsa ba gang yin zhe na/ bod chol kha gsum skyid na gcig dang sdug na gcig bya rgyu'i bsam blo gtong ba 'di yin/ sngar chos rgyal yab mes tsho'i dus skabs su bod chol kha gsum po chos rgyal gcig gi dbu khrid 'og tu gnas yod/ bar skabs bod sil bu chags rjes gcig bsgril gyi nus pa yag po ma byung bar/ rtsa ba dngayan lag dum bu byas nas mgo lag kha bral te gnas pa'i dus shig byung 288

yod/ de la lta skabs nga rang tsho tshang mar gyong rag pa dang / bod sil bur song ba des rkyen pas nga cho'i spyi sgos kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig 'thus shor phyin pa mthong gsal yin/ de ltar mthong dus ma 'ongs par bod chol kha gsum po 'di skyid sdug gang byung rung gcig gyur bya rgyu 'di sngon gyi nyams myong nas bslab bya blangs te dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan mthong nas bshad pa zhig yin pa las/ dgos pa rgyu mtshan med bzhin du kha nas 'dra chags po bshad pa zhig min/ der brten bod chol kha gsum dam tshig la rgya gcig tu bsgril rgyu'i rtsa ba'i gzhi rtsa yod la/ yod pa gzhir bzung tshang mas hur thag byed kyi yod/da dung yang skabs re rgyu mtshan med pa'i dkrog rkyenasku/nga ba'i skabs la nga tshor gzhi rtsa zhig med na dkrog rkyen de la gsal bshad bya rgyu med par zab zob tu bzhag rgyu las med/ 'on kyang nga tshos yongs rdzogs bod jongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ zhes brjod pa 'di rtsa ba'i dam bca' la brtsi gi yod dus/dkrog rkyen lhags pa 'di la nga tshos gsal bshad dang / dag 'bud bya rgyu yod pa zhig yin pa las zab zob tu 'jog dgos don med/ rgyu ma phu 'ded kyis gcig nas gnyis su bgrangs te/ gnas tshul 'di yong ba'i rgyu rkyen gang chags 'dug rtsad gcod byas nas dag sel byed thub pa yin/ chol kha'i 'then 'khyer gyi dogs pa rnam rtog lhags pa'i skabs la nga rang tsho tshang ma 'dzoms te sems nang gi dogs pa rnams mdun la spungs nas skad cha bshad na bshad rgyu yod pa zhig yin/ rtsa ba'i srid byus gong du brjod pa 'di yin dus mgo 'tshos la ma 'chos kyi dkrog gtam yong ba de dag dngos gnas byas na gzhi rtsa rtsa 289

ba nas med/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i gtam 'chal zhig lhags skabs ji tsam/ gsal po bzos pa de'i tshod kyis bden pa'i gnas tshul gsal du 'gro gi yod/ der brten nga tshos spyi ma sgom du 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med/ bzhag na dogos pa'ang med pas de dag tshang ma'i sems la bcangs nas hur thag byed dgas/yang don dag med pa zhig la rgya gar nang sngon la slebs pa dang /gsar du 'byor ba gnyis la skabs re rnying 'byor dang / gsar 'byor zer ba'i skad cha zhig lhags kyi 'dug rtsa ba'i rnam rtog la zad mtha' med pa yin dus gnas tshul phran bu skurdzong gi red kyang / mi 'dra ba phran bu rgyu rma tshan du byas te che sa'i lngardzog 'thus ma shor ba bya rgyu gal cher brtsis nas gzab gzab byed dgos/ gnad 'gag de tsam med pa'i rkyen chung chung zhig la rnam rtog gi sgro btags pa 'di mi dgos pa'i bya ba yin/ des spyi pa'i don la gnod par ma zad/ 'dra chags po yang med/ 'dzam gling gi mthong snang la'ang yag po med/ de ltar spyi bye brag gi gnas tshul tshang ma'i thog tshang mas dam tshig gong bu gcig gyur yong thabs byed dgos/ gzhi rtsa yag po yod pa 'das pa'i lo rgyus nang gsal po yod/ de ltar yod bzhin du skabs re skabs babs kyi thabs shes 'phral 'phral tshags tshud lag len rjes lus ma thebs pa bya rgyu'i thad lhod g.yeng ma shor ba tshang mas do khur bskyed de hur thag gnang rogs/ngos nas sgrung thung thung zhig zhus na/ nga rang chung chung skabs lha sar 290

'gro gi yin/ zhes yang yang bshad yod/ ngos kyi dran par nga tsho'i nang gi sgo khyang gi khra ma'i phyi la sgrom skyor zhig yod pa de la ngos nas yang yang bzhon te l+ya sar 'gro gi yin zhes bshad kyi yod/ byis pa lo gnyis gsum bsam blo gang yang ma 'khor ba'i dus nas rang bzhin bag chags lta bus lha sar 'gro gi yin/ lha sar sdod sa yod ces bshad yod dus/ da cha lo na son nas rnam dpyod kyis rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i skabs la de bas kyang bod dang lha sar 'gro bsam pa zhig los yong / spyir nyam thag pa'i sems can su la'ang phan thogs bya rgyu rang nyid theg chen gyi chos la mos pa yod pa'i mi yin dus de ltar byed dgos pa yin/ yang sgos rang la yid ches dang re ba/ dga' mos bcas byas nas ngos kyi gdong la re ba'i mig 'bur bltas te sdod mkhan de dag gi re ba bskang rgyu ngos rang gi las 'gan yin pas/ bod spyi pa'i don dag rtsa ba nas brjed thabs med/ ma gzhi khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i rjes la nga'i lung pa dang / nga'i pha yul yin zhes zhen chags byed dgos don med na yang / dka' ngal yod sa dang / phan thogs byed dgos sa zhig gang du yod kyang de la sdod dgos pa yin/ gzhan la phan thogs bya yul med par 'di nga'i lung pa dang / skye yul yin zhes bshad na de ni zhen chags kyi bsam blo las/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig min/ yin na'ang dngos yod gnas tshul la/ bod gangs can ljongs kyi mi mang de dag gis ngos la re ba dang yid ches byed kyi yod dus/ thog mar skyes yul 'di la skyes pa red la/ gson pa'i ring la'ang bod gangs can ljongs kyi chos srid gnyis kyi don la dka' las rgyab 291

pa yin/ mi tshe'i mjug 'di bod gangs can jongs la 'khod de gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms kyi thog nas da bar dka' las gang la gang 'tshams rgyab pa 'di'i 'bras bu la longs spyod thub pa zhig ma byung na/ rgyu ngas bsags/ 'bras bu gzhan gyis longs spyad na ga la 'grigs/ rang gis bsags pa'i rgyu 'di'i 'bras bu cung zad longs spyad ma thub tshe las rgyu 'bras 'chol 'gro ba yin/ tan tan nga cho'i bden mtha' gsal te gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms kyi bkra shis kyi nyi ma zhig 'char rgyur ngas yid ches brtan po byed kyi yod/ tshang ma hur thag gnang rogs zhes bka' stsal// // 292

༄tsho// phyi lo 1995 zla 7 tshes 12 nyin dha sa bzhugs sgar du sku'i 'khrungs skar nyin bka' slob 455 ba/da ring 'dir grogs po lhan rgyas tshang ma la zhu rgyur/ nga'i skyes skar gyi shen 'brel sa la khyed rang tsho tshang ma dga' bzhin spro bzhin du phebs 'dzoms byung ba la ha cang dga' po byung / khyed rang tsho tshang mar thugs rje che zhu gi yin/'dir nga tsho'i gros tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa dang / bka' thon khri pa gnyis kyi gsung bshad nang ngas da lta bar du hur thag byas pa la ngos 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i thog nas smon lam dang / 'tshams 'dri bzang po gnang ba der thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ sngon ma nas ngo shes yin pa'i sku zhabs shar ma nas 'phags bod gnyis/ chos phyogs nas 'brel ba bzang po yod pa'i lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i thog nas bsngags brjod gnang ba la yang thugs rje che zhu gi yin/khyed rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal red/ nam rgyun nga'i skyes skar gyi nyin mo 'dir rang ngos nas gal chen po zhig la brtsi gi med/ tshogs 'du'i sa la yang slebs kyi yod pa ma red/ nang pa'i dge slong zhig dang / nyams len gang thub byed mkhan zhig gi ngos nas skyes skar dus tshes dang / lo gsar 'di tsho'i gras la do snang gang yang med/ ngas nam rgyun grogs po tsho la'ang bshad kyi yod/ so so zhogs pa snga po langs te kha 'don 'dra byed skabs nyin re bzhin du nyin ma gsar pa re dang / mi tshe gsar pa re shar yong ba lta bu 'duganyin re don dang ldan pa zhig byed rgyu de gal chen po mthong gi 'dug de gal chen po zhig la brtsis kyi yod/ de min skyes skar la tshogs 'dzoms byed 293

rgyur nam rgyun do snang gang yang byed kyi med/ da lo'i dus tshod 'dir kha sang sud dza lan ṭi la bod mi stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dzoms nas skyes skar dus chen gcig byas pa red/ da res sdi lir yang rgya gar ba'i grogs po chos rkang khyar blangs te skyes skar dus chen gcig byas pa red/ da ring 'dir skyes skar dus chen 'di gsum pa chags pa red/ dzña ram sa lar nga rang tsho bod pa'i gnas skabs kyi bsti gnas gtso bo yin pa dang / 'dir ser skya mi mang rgan gzhon mang po zhig 'dzoms nas yod pa 'dir snang chung min par da res dmigs bsal byas na bsam ste/ da ring nga 'dzam gling spyi bsangs kyi dus chen dang bstun te mdzad sgo 'dir slebs pa red/ gang ltar da ring 'dir nga rang m+mu mi mang po zhig dga' tshor ldan pa'i ngang nas 'dzoms pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ da ring dus tshod 'dir ngas dmigs bsal zhu rgyu gzhan dag gang yang mi 'dug nga rang da cha lo drug cu re gcig la slebs pa'i dus yun de'i ri nga la mi tshe gang 'dra byas nas bskyal bar bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na/ ha lam 'gyod pa med pa 'dra zhig chags bsdad yod/ rang nyid 'dzam gling mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dus stod snyigs ma la skyes pa'i mi zhig yin pa red/ ngas mi su dang su yin na'ang rigs dang rus pa/ lam dang lugs srol/ choges dang mi rigs/ bo sa mtho dman sogs kyi dbye ba med par/ mi kun la phan pa'i bsam pa'i sgo nas phan bde sgrub gang thub 'gyod pa med pa byas yod/ de dang 'brel nas srog chags grog sbur tshun chad la yang gnod 'tshe min par phan sems byed kyi yod/ da ring 'dir phug ron kha shas zhi bde'i 294

mtshon rtags la glod gtong byed rtsis de tshor gzab gzab byas na ma gtogs 'phur thub la ma thub byas nas bsdad pa'i skabs la ping kyur ma dang / bya rog be+e/sa gnod pa bskyel rgyu'i nyen ka yod pa red/ yag po byas nas bltas na ma gtogs/ phug ron la gnod pa 'khyol na 'grigs kyi ma red/ngas nam rgyun ming rtags de 'dra bkod pa'i skabs la shwakya'i dge slong shākye'i dge slong zhes rtag par bris kyi yod/ nga rang gi bsam khra'i nang la sems thab snye shos de dge slong yin bsam pa de byed kyi yod/ rmi lam tshun chad la yang nga dge slong yin bsam pa de yong gi yod/ nga'i rmi lam nang la 7rgyal ba rin po che yin bsam pa ha lam yong ma myong / gang ltar ston pa bka' drin can gyi rjes 'brangs shwakya'i dge slong yin pa de nga rang gi ngos nas skal ba bzang po yin bsam pa'i spobs pa skyes kyi 'dug rang ngos nas ston pa bka' drin can de'i bka' drin gsab thub pa zhig lta khag po yin na yang / ston pa bka' drin can de la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i thog nas ston pa'i bstan pa bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gang thub 'bad brtson byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang 7rgyal ba ri na po che'i ming gi cha nas mi khom pa dgu pa zhig gis zin sku(da pa de da1dus yod gnas tshul red/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la spyir btang ris su ma chad pa'i chos brgyud 'dra min ha cang mang po yod/ de dag tshang mas mi la phan thogs yod pa sha stag yin/ 'on kyang choges brgyud mi 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas te phan tshun mi mthun pa dang / skabs re 'khrug pa rgyag res byed pa 'di dag blo tham gyi rang bzhin yin pas/ phyin chad 'di rigs mi yong ba'i thabs shes 295

byed dgos par brten/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig yin pa'i cha nas chos brgyud phan tshun dam tshig gtsang ma yong ba dang /chos brgyud phan tshun gcig gis gcig la ngos 'dzin dang / brtsi bkur yod pa'i 11ga nas thun mong gi nus shugs bton nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad/ spyir btang chos lugs khag tsho'i thog nas bshad pa yin na ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan thogs bsgrub thub pa zhig yong thabs la 'bad rtsol gang la gang 'tshams byed kyi yod/ grub 'bras kyang phran bu phran bu thon gyi 'dugadaper na ngos rang sa khul 'dra mi 'drar slebs dus sa khul de dang de'i nang yod pa'i ye shu'i chos lugs gcig gyurayin na yang / nang gses grub mtha' phran bu mi 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas te rnam kun 'brel ba gang yang med pa de 'dra la nga slebs pa rgyu mtshan du byas te khong tsho nang khul mnyam du thug 'phrad thub pa'i go skabs gsar pa de 'dra things kha shas byung song / rang nyid nang pa'i dge slong zhig dang / twa la'i bla ma'i ming gi jog nas chos brgyud phan tshun mdza' mthun yong ba dang / phan tshun nyams len gyi nyams myong spel res byed rgyu'i thog la zhabs 'degs phran bu sgrub yod/ nga'i grags po mang po zhig gis kyang 7rgyal ba rin po ches ris su ma chad pa'i chos pa tshang ma la lhag bsam rnam dag gis brtsi bkur byed stangs 'dis nga tshor phan sgogs chen po 'dug ces nga la bsngags brjod dam/ spobs pa sprad mkhan de 'dra gang la gang 'tshams yong gi 'dug de dag ni mi rigs gzhan la phan bde sgrub pa'i 296

bya ba'i rigs gcig red/ de nas nang gses rang nyid ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing / bod kha ba gangs can gyi jongs la skyes pa'i mi zhig yin pa red/ de la brten nas so 16) mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen khog gcig rang bzhin gyis yong gi yod pa red/ la rgya zhen khog byed pa de rmongs zhen dang / chags sdang dbang gis byas pa yin na nor 'khrul red/ de 'dra rang min bsam gyi 'dug spyispenangs kyi cha nas mi la dbye ba 'byed kyi med/ mi su dang su zhig thug pa yin na'ang tshang ma bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig gyur red bsam pa'i 'du shes dran gyi yod/ bod pa'i ngos nas nga la yid ches dang re ba byed kyiyod pa dang / lo rgyus kyi thog nas dmigs bsal gyi las 'gan 'ig 'khri yod pas/ bod pa'i thog la sems khur len dgos pa zhig las kyis bsgos yod pa red/ gang ltar bod bstan srid nyag phra 'di 'dra zhig skabs la las dang smon lam dbang gis bod pa'i skye ba zhig blangs pa'i blangs go chod pa byed dgos pa ltar/ phal cher lo bcu drug sgor nas bod bstan srid kyi khur blangs te da cha lo drug cu brgal nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ de'i bar du so sor 'byon thang dang / nus pa med na yang lhag bsam brtan yi thog nas 'bad brtson byas pa red/ bod bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde skyid dang bcas pa'i bde don thog rlabs chen po zhig gi grub 'bras da lta son med na yang / bod kha ba gangs can pa rnams 'gyel sa nas yar langs thub pa'i thog la gang la gang 'tshams kyi zhabs 'degs bsgrubs yod bsam gyi 'dug 'gro ba mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas dang / de'i nang tshan nas chos pa zhig 297

yin pa/ de'i nang tshan nas shwakya'i dge slong zhig yin pa/ tu la'i bla ma'i ming 'dzin gyi cha nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ nga'i mi tshe stong zad rang phyin mi 'dug bsam pa zhig dran gyi 'dug da dung yang nga rang tsho'i spyir btang gi mi ce re thog nas bshad pa yin na da cha lo drug cu tsam slebs dus rgas pa'i 'go tshugs yong gi yod pa red/ kha sang rgya gar ba ngo shes pa zhig gis rgya gar ba rnams lo drug cu'i skyes skar de gal chen po brtsis kyi red/ gang yin zer na/ lo drug cu nas mi cherware mdun lam gsar pa zhig 'go tshugs kyi yod pa red/ lo drug cu bar du tshe 'di'i don dag gtso bor byed pa dang / drug cu brgal nas chos phyogs kyi nyams len gtso bor byed pa'i mig ltos shig ngesad pa red ces bshad byung / spyir btang mi'i 'gro stangs byas pa yin na lo drug cu zer dus rgas gso khang dang / rgas yol la 'gro rgyu'i tshod yin pa red/ 'on kyang nga tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag gnyan 'phrang gi gnas stangs 'di'i thog nas bsam chotshe btang dus da lta las ka byas pa las byed rgyu mang ba bsdad yod par brten/ nga rang gi gzugs lo'i gnas stangs dang / bsam blo gtong phyogs gang gi cha nas kyang rig pa bsgrim nas mu mthud 'bad rtsol dang snying stobs bskyed de hur thag byas bsam nas bsdad yod/ khyed rang cho ༷/da mi spyi bo gnam bstan mchog dman yongs su rdzogs pas kyang de lugs da lta nga tsho las don bsgrubs pa las bsgrub rgyu mang ba bsdad yod bsam pa'i sems khur dang snying stobs rmi lam tshun chad la ma brjed par snying du bcang nas hur thag 'bad brtson byed dgos/ nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu 'di mi sgor pa 298

gcig gi bsod nams kyi thog nas bsgrub mi thub pas mang tshogs thun mong gi bsod nams thog nas sgrub dgos/ nga rang tsho tshang mas thun mo nga gi sems khur bskyed nas 'bad rtsol byed rgyu de ha cang gi gal chen po red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che mi gcig la 'khri ba lta bu dang / de la rogs pa byed pa'i rnam pa tsam las/ so so'i mjing pa'i sgang la rdog khres 'khyer mi dgos pa lta bu'i bsam tshul de 'dra gal srid yod pa yin na/ nga tsho'i las ka 'thus shor gyi red/ las don sgrub thub kyi ma red/ nga rang tsho tshang ma thun mong gis 'bad rtsol byed dgos/ bsod nams gsog thabs lha bla khag tsho'i lung bstan gyi nang la yod pa ltar/ slob dpon thugs rje can gyi mtshan sngags dang / ma ṇi yig drug 'gro gang che gsog rgyu/ dus rgyun gtan nas rang nyid nang pa yin na ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de tsho'i gras nyams len yag po byed thub na dus yun thung thung stan thog gcig la bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsag thub pa yong gi yod pa red/ mchog dman tshang mas bsod nams gsog rgyur 'bad rtsol lhod pa med pa'i thog nas/ bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu la tshang mas zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i lhag bsam brtan po mu mthud nas bskyed de 'bad rtsol byed rgyu gal chen po red/ tshang mas hur thag gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' sung5// //299

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1995 zla 8 tshes 25 nyin/ dha sar hi ma la ya'i nang pa'i tshogs pa dang / bal yul gyi nang pa rnams nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bcar skabs stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring khyed rang tsho 'dir ched mngags yong nas brtan bzhugs bton pa red/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi nang pa'i chos tshogs dang / bal yul gyi chos tshogs khyed tshos lhag bsam rnam dag chos phyogs nas bshad na dad pa dam tshig g.yo lhad med par khyed rang tsho ched mngags yong ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ nga tsho bod lung pa'i rang dbang shor nas nyams chag shin tu chen po byung ba red/ 'on kyang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul rnams dang / de bzhin bal yul/ 'brug yul bcas la rang dbang yod pa red/ rang dbang yod pa'i dus tshod de'i thog nas khyed rang tshos nang pa'i chos la do snang byed rgyu dang /nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i so so'i rig gzhung de nyams pa sor chud dang /mi nyams gong 'phel bya rgyu gal chen po yod pa'i ngos 'dzin shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa lta bu 'dug de ha cang yag po dang rtsa ba chen po red/ rang dbang yod na yang so so'i rig gzhung la lhod g.yengs snang med du phyin pa yin na phangs po red/ bar skabs nga'i mthong tshul ltar na/ khyed rang tsho'i sa khul rnams la gzhi nas so so'i chos dang rig gzhung thog la do snang gsar pa shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa'i bzo 'dug de'i don dag la bar skabs tshogs 'du mang po zhig 'tshogs pa red/ de yag po red/ dngos gnas rtags mtshan bzang po red/ khyed rang tsho'i sa khul khag nas so so'i chos dang rig gzhung thog la 300

do snang byas te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dngarig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams dgong 'phel yong thabs 'bad bco+on byed pa der ngas bsngags brjod zhu gi yod/ rjes su yi rangs yod/bar skabs nga tsho bod pa'i bden don 'thab rtsod byed rgyu'i thog la khyed rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul mang po zhig nas phyogs gcig nas nga tsho chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur gyi la rgya dang / gnyis nas da lta dang ma 'ongs par bod la rang dbang dang / bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams med bsdad thub pa yin na hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs la phan thogs yod pa dang /bod nang la yod pa'i nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung rtsa brlag thog rim pas bod yul de rgya yul ngo ma zhig la 'gyur ba yin na/ hi ma la ya'i sa khul yong sa rdzogs la dka' ngal gsar pa 'phrad rgyu'i gnas tshul thog nas khyed rang tshos bod don thog la bden rgyab las 'gul mang po zhig byas pa la yang thugs rje che zhu gi yin/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung gi cha nas bshad pa yin na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos spyi dang / yang sgos theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi thog nas rang bzhin gyis kha nas ma gyur sems can thams cad dang /'gro ba rigs drug sems can thams cad ces shod kyi yod/ de 'dra'i bsam tshul de byams pa dang snying rje'i thog nas yong gi yod pa red/ chos lugs gzhan dag tshos mi la phan thogs yod pa ha cang yag po red de sems can thams cad zer gyi med/ ma gzhi chos lugs gzhan dag nang la srog chags 301

gzhan dag la brtseb byed mkhana'ade pa red/ dperan chos lugs r+sān gcer bu ba lta bu ha lam nang pa las lhag pa 'dra poyod/ yin nayang lta ba dang / grub mtha' gting ring po zhig gi thog nas gzhan phan sgrub pa'i lhag bsam bskyed lugs kyi bslab bya de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos da nga / lhag par theg pa chen po'i chos las lhag pa med pa gsal po red/ de 'dra'i lta ba dang 'brel ba'i 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa de nang pa tsam ma zad/ 'dzam gling nyiyongs la phan thogs yod pa zhig red la/ deng sang 'dzam gling nang nang pa'i chos la do snang gsar du byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ bar skabs tshan rig pa de 'dra dang mnyam du ngas babo( glong tshogs 'du snga rjes mang spro byas pa yin/ sems kyi rnam gzhag sgor dang / de bzhin sems dang klad pa'i 'brel ba'i skor sogs la go bsdur mang po byung / tshan rig pa nang pa'i chos la do snangayod mkhan tshos ma 'ongs pa'i dus rabs la tshan rig yar rgyas mu mthud 'gro gi red/ tshan rig yar rgyas phyin pa'i skabs la mnyam du 'gro thub mkhan de nang pa'i chos khon red ces mang pos shod kyi 'dug dus rabs nyi shu rtsagacig pa'i nang la dadapa gcig pur bsten mkhan de nyung du 'gro rgyu dang / nang pa'i chos la dga' zhen byed mkhan phal cher shugs che ru 'gro rgyu'i gnas tshul chags srid pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho'i sa khul la nang pa'i chos pha mes nas yod pa zhig red/ bod layod pa'i nang pa'i chos theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang yod pa des 'dzam gling spyi la phan thogasayod pa'i cha nas nga tshos nang pa'i chos nyams pa sor chud dang /mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu gal chen po chags kyi 'dug302

de dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung ngos nas bshad pa yin na/ nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung de mi rigs kyi mtshon byed lta bu chags kyiyod red/ hi ma la'i ri rgyud sa khul du yod pa'i nang pa'i rig gzhung dang 'brel nas yod pa 'di dag ma gzhi rgya gar rgyal khab chen po 'di'i khongs yin na yang /sgo i rig gzhung de hin du'i rig gzhung dang mi 'dra ba zhig chags yod/ de la 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi cha nas dmigs bsal do snang zhig yong gi yod pa red/ de so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa mtshon byed cig yin pa red/ de bzhin bal yul nang la cha bzhag na yang lhan du mang po yod na yang / grangs ka mang nyung la ma ltos par nang chos yod sa'i sa khul la nang chos dang 'brel ba'i goms gshis dang / rig gzhung zhig yod pa'i cha nas so so'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba mtshon byed cig chags yod pa red/ chos dad yod min la ma ltos par sgo so'i mi rigs shig gi ngos nas bshad yong dus so so'i rig gzhung de rtsa 'gangs chen po zhig la slebs yong gi yod/ nga nye 'char sog yul la phyin pa yin/ sngon ma yang tshar kha shas slebs pa red/ ngas sog po tshor shod rgyu byung / bod pa dang sog po la nga tsho'i pha mes dus nas nang pa'i chos de 'jags pa zhig red/ so so'i mi rigs kyi goms gshis la nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i mi tshe bskyel stangs shig chags yod dus so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa mtshon byed du nang pa'i chos de rtsa 'gangs chen po red ces skad cha byung / so so sgor gyi ngos nas gal srid chos dad med na yang so so'i mi rigs gcig gi skad cha bshad yong dus 303

nang pa'i chos de gnad 'gag chen po zhig red/ de bzhin du hi ma laya'i ri rgyud dang / bal yul/ 'brug yul sogs la nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung de ga'agangs chen po red/ nang chos la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba'i thog nas ji tsam gyi nang chos kyi lta ba dang / grub mtha' shes mkhan mang ba dang / nang chos nyams len bya mkhan spus dag pa yod payin na/ de dang 'brel ba'inang chos kyi rigagazhung mi nyamasasbun gnas yong gi red/ nang chos kyi slob sbyong 'thus shor phyin te spyir btang mi'i goms srol lta bu chags pa yin na de tsam gyis 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu med pa chags kyi red/ rtsa ba nang chos dang / rig gzhung gnyis tha dad yin/ dper na/ de snga lha sar sdod mkhan ka shi smir nasaspenang ba'i kha che de tsho'i gras chos lugs kha che red/'on kyang bsam blo gtong stangs dang / goms gshis de bod kyi rig gzhung dang 'brel bsdadayod par ngas do snang byung / sgor so so'i ngos nas nang pa'i chos ma byas na yang nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung de'i nang la yong srid pa red/ nyiyongs cha nas nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung srung skyob byed pa la nang chos nges par du rtsa ba brtan po zhig chags dgos kyi 'dug nga rang tsho'i sa khul 'di dag nang chos la bsgyur ba'i skad cha ma red/ skadayig gsar par bsgyur dgos pa yang med/ so so'i skadayig gi thog la pha mes dus nas yod pa'i nang pa'i chosayodayod pa 'di nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed dgos/ de ltar byed payang rtsa ba slob sbyong la thugayod/ dgon pa dang /lha khang rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red de/ nang pa'i chos de phyi rol khang pa'i nang 304

la yod pa zhig min stabs rtsa ba klad pa'i nang la yod dgos pas/ slob sbyong byed rgyu de gal chen por slebs kyi 'dug nang chos slob sbyong byed yul de phyogs gcig nas ming rgyab 'khur btsun pa'i dgon pa khag dang / btsun ma'i dgon khag de bzhin sngags 'chang gos dkar can gyi dgon sde khag la nang chos kyi slob sbyong bya rgyur do snang byed dgos/ dus dus la bla ma tshad ldan de 'dra gdan zhus kyis gsung chos zhu rgyu dang / rgyun du 'dzin grwa btsugs nas nang ྾ kyi shes tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byed rgyu gnad 'gag chen po 'dug phyogs gzhan nas lung pa spyi yongs nang nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed dgos pa dang / de'i rtsa ba mang tshogs kyi thod ngags la rag lus pas mang tshogs kyi nang du nang chos kyi gnas tshul shes tshad ji tsam rgya cher phyin pa de tsam gyis lung pa de'i nang du rig gzhung srung skyob thub kyi red/ gal srid yul spyi'i nang la nang chos kyi go rtogs skyo ru skyo ru phyin nas brlag pa yin na/ tshur tsam der dgon pa nyung shas gcig gi nang la bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gang la gang 'tshams yod nayang khag wa red bsam gyi 'dug sngar yul khag gi nang yod pa'i chos lugs 'dra min gyi dgon pa de tsho shes yon 'dzin mkhan lta bu chags yod/ deng sang shes yon 'dzin mkhan slob gra khag chags yod pas/ skya ser pho mo tshang ma slob gra de dag 'grims nas 'gro gi yod pa dang / dgon pa'i nang la yul mi nyung shas shig ma gtogs 'gro gi med/ dgon khag gi nang la nang chos kyi shes tshad mtho ra gtong ba dang chabs cig spyi tshogs nang la shes tshad mtho ra ra ri ri ri ri305

gtong rgyu der nga tshos nges par du 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de gal chen po 'dug thub kyi yod med gang shes ma gtogs kha sang ngas sog yul sgo ras thu dang / khar mug pa de tshor nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung srung skyob byed rgyu de rtsa ba shes yon la brten nas yong dgos pa dang / mang tshogs kyi shes yon ga tshod kyi mtho ru phyin pa'i tshod kyis lung pa de'i nang so so'i rig gzhung 'dzin thub rgyu ma gtogs mang tshogs kyi shes tshad gong mthor spel thub pa ma byung na dgon pa lha khang 'ga' shas shig yod pas 'dzin thub rgyu khag po red ces shod rgyu byung /slob gra'i nang nang chos dang 'brel ba'i slob tshan de 'dra go sgrig byed kyi 'dug ti ma la ya'i ri rgyud du yod pa'i sa khul de tshor ga le ga ler thabs shes thub pa yin na/ slob gra'i nang la chos kyi ming btags mi bde ba yod na rig gzhung gi ming btags te ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs dang / lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug 'dra po chos kyi snying po de tsho'i gras slob tshan nang la slebs thub pa yin na phan thogs yong gi red/ gang ltar yul de'i nang gi mang tshogs kyi khrod la go lha gas che ru gtong thub pa ma byung na rim pas rim pas bstan pa brlag 'gro ba'i nyen kha yong gi red/ ngas zhor 'phros su zhu rgyur/ nga rang tsho'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ rgya gar nang 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa dus gcig tu nyams len byed pa'i srol rgyun zhig bod lung par dar yod/ de 'dra'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba yod pa'i chos 'di dang / 306

chos 'di dang 'brel ba'i spyi tshogs nang rig gzhung gi goms gshis yod pa bod mi sa ya drug tsam dang / de nas nang sog sa jig gsum tsam/ phyi sog rang btsan yin pa der sa ya gnyis tsam/ u ru su'i khongs yod pa'i khar mug dang / thu wa/ sgo rad thu/ de min sa khul re zung bsdoms pas khyon sa ya gcig lhag tsam/ de nas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud du sa ya gcig lhag tsam med dam/ khyon sa ya bcu gsum bcu bzhi tsam zhig yod pa'i bzo 'dug sa khul de rnams kyi nang la mi grangs sa ya bcu gsum bcu bzhi de ha cang nyung nyung red/dper na/ hin du lta bu dang / yi shu/ mu si lim sogs yod pa red/ yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa spyi nas bshad pa yin na/ lhar ma dang / thā lan/ shri lung ka sogs mang po yod kyang / theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa bshad yong dus sa ya bcu gsum bcu bzhi tsam las med/ rtsa ba'i 'dzam gling 'di'i snang la mi grangs dung phyur lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa 'di'i nang la theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa yod mkhan sa ya bcu gsum bcu bzhi tsam las med pa de gnas stangs skyo po zhig gi sgang la bsdad 'dug sa khul de dug gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs skyo po dang / mi rnams kyang kha 'jor bsdad mkhan zhig chags yod/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og la dper na/ sog po lta bur cha bzhag na deng sang ye shu'i chos mang po spel yong gi 'dug sngon ma lo 'ga' shas gong sog yul du 'gro skabs ye shu'i chos bya mkhan brgya phrag 'ga' shas shig yod pa red zer gyi 'dug deng sang stong phrag gsum tsam yod lugs shod kyi 'dug rigs gcig gis dngul gyi don du khyug tsam ye shu byas/ dngul 307

de blangs nas ga le ga ler nang pa bya mkhan de 'dra yang yod sa red/ ngas sog po tshor lab rgyu byung / ye shu'i lung pa'i nang la so so'i pha mes kyi chos ye shu byas nayag gi red/ ye shu'i lung pa gcig gi nang nang pa'i chos byed rgyu der bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos/ lung pa spyi byings ye shu'i goms srol cha tshang pha mes nas yod mkhan gcig gi nang la khyim tshang gcig nang pa'i gomasagashis bya dgos byung na dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red ces lab rgyu byung / yang nga rang tsho pha mes nas nang pa red/ nang pa'i goms srol yod pa'i lung pa'i nang la khyim tshang gcig gis ye shu'i chos byas pa yin na rtog khra byed kyi red/sog po'i nang la 'ga' shas pha ma nang pa byas/ phru gu bu bu mo dbyin ji'i slob grar bskyode deya gsar byas nas ye shu byas/ pha ma 'das grongs phyin pa'i skabs la nang pa'i lugs kyi dge sgrub ma byas par ye shu'i lugs kyi 'das mchod de 'dra byas/ de pha ma'i gnyen 'brel de tsho'i snang bar ma 'gro ba'i thog nas dka' ngal zhigayong gi yod pa'i tshod 'dug gang ltar rang rang so so'i pha mes kyi chos brgyud de ga'i thog nas phyin pa yin na yag gi red/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la mtshon na rtsab chos dad rang mos red/ chos byas pa yin na'ang chos gang byed dang mi byed rang mos red/ 'on kyang rang gi pha mes nas nang pa yin pa'i sa khul la nang pa rang gi thog la phyin pa yin na legs pa red/ yang mi sgor pa so sos sgo gang sa nas bsam blo btang / dpyad pa byas/ dper na/ nang pa'i chos dang / kha che'i chos/ lhan du'i chos/ ye shu'i chos bcas la dpyad bsdur byas nas mtha' ma so so'i sems nang chos gang la mos pa dang / gang 308

'phrod che bayod pa de byas pa yin na khyad par mi 'dug so sos nang chos ma shes pa byas/ chos lugs gsar pa zhig la a gsar byas te bsgyur bcos byas pa yin na rjes su dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red/ rang gi pha mes nas yod pa'i nang chos de khyim tshang so so'i nang slob sbyong bya rgyu der gnad 'gag cig 'dug bar skabs nga rang nas mthong ba dang / nyams myong byung ba'i gnas tshul de dag khyed rang tshor lab na bsam pa byung /so so 'dzam gling 'di'i nang yod pa'i cha nas 'dzam gling spyi'i thog la yin yang rung / bye brag tu mi so so'i khe phan thog la yin yang rung / nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel bya rgyu de nga tsho'i las 'gan chen po zhig red/ lung pa so so'i nang la dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / deng dus kyi shes yon slob sbyongasprod rgyu'i thog la gzhung sgo sos 'gan blangs kyi yod pa dang / mi mang chos kyang do snang nges par du byed kyi red/ de rnams la do snang byed pa dang chabs cig nga rang tsho'i pha mes nas yod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung de tshor yang dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos/ phyi'i 'dzugs bskrun dang / dngos po/ rlung 'phrin/ gzugs mthong rlung 'phrin zer ba de tsho ga ler ga ler yar rgyas phyin/ mi rnams brel ba tsha ru tsha ru dang / dngul la dga' ru dga' ru phyin/ nub phyogs pa'i gzhas gtong rgyu dang / yang na lhan du'i gzhas gtong rgyu la dga' ru dga' ru phyin/tshur phyogs der nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung skor la dmigs bsal gyi ngo sprod dang / slob gso sogs ma ldang bar mang tshogs rnams do snang med 309

par lus pa yin na/ dper na/ spi ti khul la bud med tsho'i nang la chos lu do snang byed mkhan jo mo de 'dra mang po yod pa lta bu mthong tshul byung / skyes pa mang che ba rgya gar gyi slob gra 'grims/ de nas las shar tshud nas chos la do snang de tsam med pa lta bu 'dug de 'dra de 'dra'i ngang la mi thog gcig gnyis phyin/ gang mtshams song nas mang tshogs nang chos la do snang med pa chags pa yin na ha cang phangs po red/ spyir btang spyi tshogs yar rgyas dang / dngos po yar rgyas dang 'brel ba'i deng dus kyi shes yon nges par dgos pa red/ de tsho yar rgyas 'gro ba'i skabs la tshur tsam der mang tshogs nang chos dang rig gzhung gi shes yon thog do snangasag po byed ma thub par 'thus shor phyin pa yin na tan tan nyen kha red/ sngon ma nga 'bras ljongs la 'gro skabs shod rgyu byung /'bras jongs kyi khyim tshang rer thad 'phyar gnam gru re re yod pa'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshad mthon por slebs pa yin na yang / sems skyid pa dang / zhi bde yong bar phan gyi ma red/ sems nang bag ma phebs pa dang / sdug bsngal byung ba yin na yang de tsam gyi sems nang dngangs skrag mi yong ba de nang pa'i chos kyi thog nas yong dgos pa las/ dngul gyi thog nas yong thub thabs med/nam zhig khyim tshang mi re ngo rer thad 'phur gnam gru re re yod pa'i dus tshod la slebs pa yin rung nang chos rtsa brlag phyin pa yin na de dus gzhi nas 'gyod pa skye rgyu red/ nga tsho'i slo two dus la dngos po yar rgyas med na yang mi tshang ma sems skyid po byas bajed kyi yod pared/ da nga tsho gang byas pa red zer rgyu zhig chags kyi red ces ngas shod rgyu byung la/ ngas de 'dra dran gyi 'dug310

dper na deng sang nub phyogs lung pa'i nang la khyim tshang gi gnas stangs dang /slob sbyong gi gnas stangs sogs mthun rkyen yag po 'dzoms yod na yang /sems ma skyid pa chags nas tha mag 'then/ ṭag 'then/ khab rgyab gang byung mang byung rgyab byed mkhan khyim tshang drag pa'i phru gu mang po yong gi 'dug pa khyed rang chos mkhyen gsal red/ de tshos shar phyogs lung pa'i nang sems la zhi bde yong thabs gang byed rgyu yod dam bsam nas/ bla ma 'dra mi 'dra de 'dra thug hin du'i bla ma 'dra mi 'dra dang / nga tsho bod pa'i bla ma 'dra mi 'dra yong srid kyi red/ de 'dra'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'dug gang ltar so so'i lung pa'i nang la lto gos kyi sems khral dang / gtam gyi sems khral rgyag mi dgos par gra 'grigs po yod mkhan de gras 'di khul sprang 'khyams rgyab nas yong mkhan de tshos dngos po yar rgyas gcig wa'i thog nas sems la bde skyid yong gi med pa'i rtags gsal po bstan gyi yod/ da lta nga rang tsho'i shar phyogs lung pa'i nang la dngos po yar rgyas ma phyin pa'i skabs su nga rang tsho'i busam cho'i nang dngos po yar rgyas phyin nas khra khra zing zing zhig byung na mi'i dka' ngal sel thub kyi red bsam gyi yod na yang / dngos su yar rgyas phyin tshar ba'i lung pa de tsho'i nang la dpal 'byor yod pas ma 'grigs par/ sems nang chog shes dang / byams pa dang / snying rje bzod bsran zer ba sogs med dus sems nang skyid pa khyon nas med pa shin tu gsal po mthong chos su yod pa red/ sems nang ya rabs spyod bzang / byams pa dang / rnying rje rtsa bar gyur pa'i spyod bzang med mi rung ba yin/ rgya gar la cha bzhag na snga mo lhan 311

rdi sogs rgya gar rang dbang rang btsan sgrub pa'i skabs kyi mi de tsho phyogs gcig nas lung pa'i srid don mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul yin 'gro/ phyogs gcig nas rgya gar gyi gna' rabs lo stong phrag gi rig gzhung gting zab yod pa dang / der yid ches yod pa'i thog nas shugs rkyen nus pa zhig yod pa red/ dper na/rgya gar rang dbang byung ba'i skabs la so sos rang khrims rang srung byas te kog rngan za len zer ba de tsho'i gras go rgyu med pa red/ deng sang rgya gar ba tshor nub phyogs pa'i shes yon gang la gang 'tshams yod pa chags/ so so'i pha mes dus kyi hin du'i lta ba de d+ku gras la do snang chung du phyin te rang khrims rang srung byed rgyu de tsho'i gras rgya gar nang gi snga mo'i mi de tsho dang / mi 'dra ba'i deng sang ha cang ྅ rwa/ chagasayod/ bsam khra'i ya rabs spyod bzang de tsho nyams chag 'gro dus lung pa'i nang la dka' ngal mang po 'phrad kyi 'dug gal srid nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang rig gzhung de nyams chag phyin payin na/ dngos posar rgyas ga tshod phyin rung des dka' ngal rigs gcig sel ba red de/ rigs gcig sdug tu 'gro rgyu gsal po red/ des na dngos po yar rgyas shugs chen po 'gro ba'i skabs der dmigs bsal gyis so so'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byed ma thub na gang 'tshams song nas dka' ngal 'phrad rgyu red/nga sngon ma zangs dkar la 'gro ba'i skabs dkar dkyil la kha che'i bla ma yag po zhig yod/ bla ma des nga ja 'thung bar bos pa ltar phyin pa yin/ kha che'i bla ma des mo ṭa'i lam de yag po khyon nas mi 'dug mo ṭa'i lam de bzos rjes yul pa tsho dngul la mgo 'khor nas lha khang nang du phyag 'tshal rgyag par 312

zhing mkhan nyung du 'gro gi 'dug ces bshad byung / phyogs gcig nas bden pa re da/ ngo sprod mkhan gyis ngo sprad/ ngo 'phrod mkhan gyis ngo 'phrod de so so'i chos gting ring po shes pa yin na pad shag yar rgyas phyin pa dang chabs cig so so'i chos dang rig gzhung de med na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug bsam pa zhig bsam blo'i nang slebs thub kyi red/ nga rang tsho'i mang tshogs nang la nang pa'i chos slob sbyong sprod rgyu dang / nang pa'i chos la go ba slebs thabs byed phyogs gang legs khyed rang tshos bsam blo gtong dgos/ de skor nga rang tshor las 'gan chen po zhig yod/ nga'i ngos nas 'bod skul byed rgyu tsam las rgya chen po byed thub sdig yod pa ma red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming yod pa'i cha nas sa khul tshor dus dus la slebs kyi yod pa dang / ma 'ongs par yang dus dus la slebs thub kyi red/ nga'i ngos nas gang byed rgyu yod pa rnams zhabs 'degs zhu dang zhu/ de dang chabs cig bod pa btsan byol ba'i thog nas ga tshad thub thub byed rgyu de yang 'os 'gan red/ 'on kyang gtso bo sa gnas so so'i yul mi rang nas shugs rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red/ sa gnas kha shas la tshogs 'du 'dra 'tshogs yod/ 'ga' shas la nga yang slebs yod/ nga'i mthong tshul la sems shugs yod pa dang / 'dod pa yod pa gang zhig kha/ nus pa thon mi thub pa lta bu 'dug sa khul yongs rdzogs re 'dod sarig gyur yin dus nub la dwags nas/ shara.a ru na cal bar tshang ma rdog la bsgril te nus shugs gcig tu spungs nas ga ler ga ler thabs shes bya gi yin na nus pa thon che ba yong gi red/ 'dod pa dang gnas stangs gcig gyur yin na yang sa khul 313

so so nas sgul tsam sgul tsam byas pa ma gtogs yongs rdzogs gcig gyur 'brel ba dam zab nus pa chig bsgril ma byung ba'i thog nas nus pa ma thon pa min nam bsam pa dran gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho sa khul yongs rdzogs phar tshur 'brel ba byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug khyed rang tsho 'brel ba lhug po'i thog nas yig 'brel byas/ phan tshun nyams myong spel res dang / phan tshun gnas tshul shes rtogs yong ba byas nas thun mong gi nus pa 'don rgyu de gal chen po red/ thun mong gi nus pa 'don pa'i mtshams la slebs skabs tshang ma mi rang yin dus skabs re phran bu 'grigs ma 'grigs yong srid kyi red/ dper na /bod la cha bzhag na yang sa dge bka' rnying zer ba dang / yang sa dge bka' rnying gcig gyur yin na'ang nga'i dgon pa dang / kho'i dgon pa zer ba lta bu chung tsag la mgo 'khor nas che sa'i thog la rdzod g.yengs dang / 'thus shor 'gro ba yong gi yod/ khyed rang tsho yang nas yang du thug nas phan tshun ngo shes pa byas na gcig gis gcig la dogs pa dang rnam rtog gis rkyen pas phan tshun mnyam nub kyi nus pa ma thon pa de tshor phan thogs yong gi red/ dus dus la phan tshun thug 'phrad byas/ phan tshun skad cha gsang po dang / 'khrol po byung na don dag med pa'i dogs pa rnam rtog gi dka' ngal 'phrad pa de tsho sel thub kyi red/ bden pa'i don dag cig yin phyin ji tsam ngo shes 'dris gshibs byung ba de tsam nang gtsang du 'gro thub pa zhig red/ mthun po byed dgos zhes lab pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs/ mthun po mayong ba'i rkyen rtsa 'brel ba nyung drags pa'i dbang gis gcig gis gcig la gsal po med par lus/ phyogs gzhan 314

dag nas yas red mas red zer dus de yang min nam/ de yang min nam bas ma nas phan tshun dbar dogs pa rnam rtog sel ma thub pa'i skyon cha lhag gi yod/ bar skabs bod pa'i nang la nyams myong byung / dper na/ chol kha dang / tshogs pa de tsho'i dbar sngon ma nas mthong tshul byung yod/ khyod rang tsho tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i skabs la chol kha gzhan dag gi mi skad btang nas mnyam du 'tshogs/ tshang mas gsal po shes pa byung na rgyab tu don med kyi dkrog gtam dkrug shing de yong gi ma red/ tshogs 'du'i nang rang nyid dngos su yod pa dang / dngos su mthong ba/ gang bshad pa thag gcod gang byas pa tshang ma so sos mthong ba yin dus dkrog gtam dkrug shing gis gnod thub kyi ma red ces bshad pa yin/ sngon ma dha sar chos tshogs dang po tshogs pa'i skabs la yin pa yod/ bdud 'joms rin po che chos tshogs grol nas ka sbug tu phebs skabs rin po che'i thugs ngo mkhyen pa 'ga' shas kyis dha sar chos tshogs 'tshogs nas chos lugs yongs rdzogs dge lugs par bsgyur rgyu gtan 'khel ba red zer gyi 'dug de 'dra yin nam zhes rin po cher zhus byung gsung gi 'dug rin po che dzña sar chos tshogs kyi 'tshogs mi'i gras la dngos su phebs yod dus chos lugs tshang ma dge lugs par bsgyur gyi yod med rin po ches mkhyen gsal red/ ngas chos lugs tshang ma yar rgyas gtong dgos zhes shod kyi yod/ rin po ches de 'dra ma red/ nga dha sa nas yong ba yin/ chos tshogs kyi chogs 'dur nga yod/ tshogs 'dur thag gcod byas pa 'di dang 'di red ces bka' slob gnang ba yin gsung gi 'dug des na sa gnas yas mas 315

kyi mi tsho dus dus la 'tshogs/ sa khul gcig la tshogs 'du 'tshogs kyi yod na sa khul gzhan dag nas 'thus mi skad btang ste mnyam du 'tshogs pa yin na don med kyi skad cha 'dra mi 'dra de 'dra mi yong bar phan gyi 'dug gang ltar nga tshor las 'gan chen potsede/ las 'gan de bsgrub rgyur nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud ma song ba'i gzab gzab byed ma thub na/nyin gcig da phyis drags pa red zer ba zhig yong rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ de 'dra yin dus dza drag gi jog nas nus pa thon pa zhig byed dgos/ 'dod pa yod pa dang / bsam tshul gcig pa yin rung lag len gyi jog nas nus pa ma thon pa zhig yong gi yod dus thun mong gi nus pa 'don rgyu de gal chen po red/ thun mong gi nus pa 'don pa la tshang ma gcig yid gcig la ches pa byas nas tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs bya mkhan yin bsam pa'i bsam blo zhig skyes dgos pa ma gtogs gcig gis gcig la dogs pa rnam rtog gi thog nas rgyang so rgyab bsdad pa'i bzo lta bu byas pa yin nayong thabs med/nga tsho dad pa'i nang la yang lung tshan mi 'dra ba la brten nas 'then 'khyer byed pa lta bu/ yang na gsar 'byor dang / rnying 'byor zer ba lta bu cho khyon nas med pa de 'dra bshad kyi yod/ khyed rang tsho'i nang la yang de 'dra yod 'gro/ bal yul nang la yang yod srid/ mi'i rnam rtog la zad mtha' med stabs ming re re btags sa ga dus yin na yang yong gi red/ don dag chung sa gcig la 'gan chen po rtsis/ don dag che sa'i thog la 'thus shor phyin pa yin na shin tu phangs po red/ tshang mas nus pa bton nas shugs rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red/ de zhu 'dod byung / bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' stsal// //316

༄tsho// phyi lo 1995 zla 10 tshes na nyin/ dzña ram sa lar bal yul nas 'byor pa dang / dzña sa'i mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/khyed rang tsho ched mngags 'dir brtan bzhugs la gal chen po rtsis te yong ba red/ mjal kha'i dus chod mi 'dug kyang / khyug tsam thug nas skad cha bshad na/ khyed rang tsho yang dga' po yong gi red la/ nga rang yang thug 'dod byung / khyed rang tsho bal yul nas do gal chen po byas te ched mngags yong ba la dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ de bzhin 'di ga dha ram sa la'i bod mi tsho'i thog nas kyang dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas brtan zhugs la dmigs bsal 'bad brtson byas pa la dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/nga tsho bod pa'i gnas stangs tshang mas shes gsal red/ nga tsho dka' ngal chen po zhig gi 'og la bsdad yod/ yin na yang rtsa don bod kyi bden mtha' gsal la nye ba zhig chags bsdad yod/ gang yin zhe na/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa'i jog la do snang byed mkhan je mang je mang 'gro gi yod pa dang / gal sto shos rgya mi'i nang na sa kyang bod pa'i thog la do snang byed mkhan mang du mang du 'gro gi yod/ bod pa'i gnas tshul la do snang byed pa'i skabs su rang bzhin gyis bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di bden pa'i gnas tshul yin pa dang / nga tsho bod pa'i ngos nas rgya mi rigs la 'khon 'dzin byed kyi med pa/ rgya nag rgyal khab la ngo rgol byed kyi med pa/ de las lhag pa ngas bod don 'thab rtsod byed stangs de/ rgya bod tha dad so so yin kyang / 'dzam bu 317

gling 'gyur ba chen po 'gro bzhinayod pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul 'og nas rgya bod gnyis mos zhig gi thabs lam 'chol rgyur 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa de rnams mthong yong dus/ 'dzam gling phyi mi tsam du ma zad/ rgya nag rang gi nang la yod mkhan gyi rgya mi'i nang nas kyang / bod don gyi thog la do snang sha tsha dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang du mang du 'gro gi yod pa de gsal po 'dugader brten bzang phyogs nas 'gyur ba tan tan yong gi red/ da lta 'phral sel bod nang la las ka byed mkhan chos srid byus mkhregs po zhig dang / rtsub po byed kyi yod kyang / 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam zhig gi ring la nyams myong byung bar gzhigs na/ rgya mis bod pa'i thog la gdug rtsub dang / mnar gcod ji tsam btang ba de tsam du bod pa'i bsam blo'i nang la mkhregs su 'gro rgyu zhig ma gtogs/ des dka' ngal sel rgyur phan thogasaspenang rgyu ha cang khag po red/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi las ka byed mkhan tshos bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di slod bzhag na'ang 'gan mi bzod pa zhig chags te/ mtha' cig tu mnan rgyu ma gtogs/ thabs lam gzhan dag med pa lta bur mthong ste srid byus de 'dra zhig zin gyi yod pa red/ srid byus de ni 'phral sel 'u thug gi srid byus shig red ma gtogs/ des bod don gyi rnyog khra rtsa ba'i thag gcod byed thabs kyi srid byus shig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ dza drag gi gnas tshul de phran bu grang sang 'dra thebs payin na/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod pa'i dka' rnyog 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas sel rgyu'i bsam blo zhig mi gtong bar thabs khyon nas yod pa ma red/ gnyis nas rgya nag 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rgyal khab gal 318

che shos kyi gras shig red/ 'dzam gling nang gal gnad chen wa'i rgyal khab gcig gis de la dpag pa'i srid byus rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang / mi tshos bltas na yang red bsam pa'i srid byus shig 'dzin dgos pa ma gtogs/ srid byus spyon pa 'khrab pa lta bus 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la khungs 'khyol rgyu khag po red/ der brten rgya nag rang nyid kyi mthong dang / rgya nag rang nyid kyi khe phan dang / phyags rgyang ring po'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas bod don gyi gnas tshul thog la rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i srid byus shig dus tshod snga phyi tsam ma gtogs tan tan yong gi red bsam pa'i nga la yid ches yod/ rtsa ba'i bod don bden mtha' gsal la nye ba zhig gi mtshams la slebs yod/ da lta phan chad la tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par bsdad pa ltar/ las sla po yin pas sems shugs ma chag zer gyi med/ gnas tshul dngos gnas ha cang mgo na po dang / dza drag cig yin na yang nga tshos re ba rgyag rgyu'i rgyu mtshan dang / gzhi rtsa yod pa zhig yin dus sems shugs ma chag par rigaya sgrimadagos zer gyisku1da/ dka' las ga stod rgyab rung don 'bras son rgyu med pa zhig yin na/ gnas tshul tha dad red/ tshang mas sems shugs bskyed dgos zer rgyu don tshan gcig yin/da lta bar nga tshos dka' las rgyag bzhin pa'i bden don de gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig yin pa dang / nga tsho'i bden don de rtsa ba chen po dang / gal chen po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang 'dra zhig la brten nas yong gi yod dam zer na/ de rtogs dgos rgyu gal chen po red/ ngas ngos 'dzin 'di 'dra zhig byed kyi yod/ nga tshor mi rigs rang btsan dgos kyi yod ces zer ba de gcig 319
