pu'i skad cha ma red/ dper na/ a phe ri kha'i nang la rgyal khab mang po yod/'dzam bu gling gi sa phyogs gang sar lung pa re res so so'i thob thang re rtsod kyi yod/ nga tsho rwa1da pa'i gnas tshul de gcig pu ma red bsam gyi 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di bod kyi sa cha'i gnas babs/ de bzhin bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi gnas stangs/ bod kyi khor yug gi gnas stangs 'di dag gi 'og nas/ bod kyi gnas stangs yag po zhig tu gnas pa yin na/ khyim mtshes lung pa mang por phan thogs yod pa red/ dper na/ pa ki se than dang / rgya gar/ sbang la sde she/ we ṭi nam/ de nas rgya nag dang bcas pa'i sa khul de dag gi gtsang po gal che ba phal mo che bod nas yong ba sha stag yin pa red/ tshan rig mkhas pa rigs gcig rkang 'dzin byed mkhan de tshos nam rgyun bshad don la/ bod kyi sa mtho'i sgang la gal srid gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ba shugs chen po byung ba yin na/ des bod kyi nye skor du yod pa'i sa khul de dag gi gnam gshis la 'gyur dog yong gi yod pa dang / bod kyi sa mtho'i sgang la shing nags gcod 'dreg tshad las brgal ba de tshos rkyen pas char pa dus thog ma babs pa'am/ yang na chu log yong rgyu la sogs pa bod gcig pu'i gnas tshul ma yin par/ e sha ya'i shar gling gi sa khul mang po zhig la 'brel ba yod lugs bshad kyi yod pa red/ 'di gnas tshul gcig red/de nas bo da kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi gnas stangs la mtshon na/ da nang snga dro skad cha byung ba bzhin/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis mi'i spyi tshogs nang la bde skyid bskrun thub pa zhig dang / mi'i sems zhi 'jam ltod 320

lhod bzo rgyu'i nus pa yod pa red/ mi spyi la phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ dper na/ rgya gar nang nub la dbas nas/ shara.a ru na cal bar gyi sa khul dang /'brug yul bcas par sngar lo brgya phrag mang po'i gong nas bod kyi chos dang rig ga/zhung gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ de nas bod byang phyogs la rtsis pa yin na/ sog po phyi nang gnyis dang / de bzhin shin cang nang la'ang sgor rgod zer mkhan de tsho'i gras rigs kha shas bod kyi nang pa red/ de nas u ru su'i khungs kyi bho rad thu dang / khar mug la sogs pa de tsho'i sa khul de dag kyang lo brgya phrag mang po zhig gi ring la bod kyi chos rgyud gcig gyur yin pa red/ sa khul de dag gi mi grangs rob rtsis byas pa yin na/ phal cher sa ya bcu bzhi tsam yod 'dug sa khul de dag la dus da lta'ang so so so so'i yul skad mi 'dra ba yin na yang / bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur dang / bod kyi sa dge bka' rnying gi chos rgyud so so so so'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum detsho'i gras yongs rdzogs bod yig thog yod pa da lta'ang bed spyod byed bzhin pa red/ de snga lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring la bod kyi nang pa'i shugs rkyen rgya nag gi nang la slebs yod pa red/ rgya nag gi rgyal rabs lo rgyus kyi nang la bod la nang chos ma dar gong phal cher lo gsum brgya bzhi brgya tsam gyi sngon nas rgya nag la nang chos dar ba red/ de 'dra'i thog nas rgya nag gi nang la snga dus nas nang pa'i chos dar myong ba'i lung pa zhig yin pa dang / phyis su bod nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba de yang rgya nag nang la dar rgyas gang la gang 'tshams byung ba zhig red/ der 321

brten sa khul de dag la bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig lo rgyus kyi thog nas gsal po mthong thub kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang deng sang rgya nag gi byed stangs la cha bzhag na/ chos dad ris su ma chad pa tshang mar mgo gnon byed pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas nang chos kyi thog la mgo gnon byed kyi yod/ de dang chabs cig chos rmongs dad red/ rmongs /da de med pa bzo dgos zer gyi yod/ khong tshos rmongs dad la brtsis pa'i chos des 'grub tshod kyi bde skyid cig kho rang chos phyogs gzhan dag cig nas sgrub thub yod na gnas tshul khag khag red/ de ni byung med/ rgya nag nang gi chos dang rig gzhung sngar nas yod pa de dag med pa bzos nas/ gung khran ring lugs kyi lta ba dang spyod pa'i thog nas dka' las chen po rgyab pa red/ phyi byug nang blug byas te slob gso de lta bu sprad kyang sprad pa'i 'bras bu la rgya nag nang la mi'i spyi tshogs don snying ldan pa'i spyi chogs shig dang / bde skyid ldan pa'i spyi tshogs shig chags thub med pa mthong gsal red/ gang ltar rgya nag nang la gung khran ring lugs pham nyes phyin tshar ba red/ gung khran ring lugs la yid ches byed mkhan yod pa ma red/ 'go khrid tsho'i bsam blo'i nang la'ang yid ches yod med the tshom red/ gung khran ring lugs la mtha' gcig tu yid ches yod na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la mtha' gcig tu shugs rgyab ste 'gro dgos stod yin kyang / don ngo ma'i lag len thog ma rtsa'i ring lugs la 'gro ba ma gtogs/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la 'gro gi med/ da res nye char tang gi tshogs 'du'i sar rgya nag nang gi gzhung 'dzin bzo gra 'bum phrag brgal 322

ba de tsho'i gras/ sger gnyer gyi bzo grar bsgyur rgyu'i thag gcod byas yod/ ngas da res nye char go 'phral yin/ rgya na ga gi mi mang tsho'i nang la bzhad bgad slong ba'i skad cha zhig bshad kyi yod tshod 'dug gang bshad kyi yod zer na/a mi ri kha'i srid 'dzin khe lin kron dang / u ru su'i srid 'dzin ya sing dang /rgya nag gi srid 'dzin cang rtse ming bcas kho tsho gsum po de so so'i mo kror nang yong gi yod pa red/ lam gyi mtha' der gcig la spyi tshogs ring lugs zer ba'i lam gcig dang / gcig la ma rtsa'i ring lugs zer ba'i lam gcig bcas lam khag gnyis yod pa red/ srid 'dzin gsum gyi mo ṭa gsum yong ste khe lin gron mo ṭa de thad gar ma rtsa'i ring lugs zer ba'i lam de'i sgang la shar bskyod phyin/ de'i mjug der ya sin gyi mo ṭa de yang ma rtsa'i ring lugs zer ba'i lam de'i sgang la phyin pa red zer/ de'i mjug tu can tse min gyi mo ṭa lam gnyis mdo kha der slebs pa dang lam gnyis gang du 'gro dgos tshod ma thig par mo ṭa bkag ste bsdad pa'i skabs der rgyab de nas ting zha'o thing gis bka' zhig btang ste/ mo ṭa'i mdun gyi bzhu mar gnyis po de spyi tshogs ring lugs ngos phyogs der sgor/ mo ṭa rang ma rtsa'i ring lugs la rgyugs zhes bshad pa red ces rgya nag mi mang nang la de 'dra'i sgrung zhig bzos yod pa red zer gyi 'dug de ngo ma chags bsdad 'dug kha nas bshad dus/ rgya nag gi gnas stangs dang mthun pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dang gung khran ring lugs zhes bshad kyi yod kyang / don dag ngo ma de ma rtsa'i ring lugs la 'gro gi yod/ dngos gnas don dam gyi gung khran ring lugs kyi lta ba la yid ches 323

yod pa dang / yid ches de dang 'brel ba'i thog nas gzhung gis srid byus zin/lam ston byed kyi yod na dka' ngal yod kyang mu mthud spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta spyod 'dor thabs med kyang / the tshom med par 'gyur ba gtong gi 'dugades gung khran ring lugs pham nyes phyin pa'i rtags ha cang gsal po red/de bzhin bod kyi nang nas bla ma mkhan 1— de 'dra rgya nag la gdan 'dren zhus nas 'gro mkhan 'ga' shas yod pa'i bzo 'dug sa cha kha shas la rgya mi'i na gzhon shes bya yon tan yag po yod mkhan/ spyir nang pa'i chos la do snang yod mkhan/ yang sgos lhag par can du bod kyi nang chos la do snang byas te/bo da kyi mkhas pa de gras kyi zhabs la gtugs mkhan mang po yod pa dang / gya mi'i dge slong yang ha lam drug brgya bdun brgya zhig yod pa'i skad cha 'dugades na gung khran ring lugs kyis 'grub ma thub pa/ gung khran ring lugs pham nyes phyin pa'i lung pa'i nang 'a/ nang pa'i chos kyis phan thogs byed thub pa zhig tan tan yod pa red/ gang ltar ngas da lta bshad pa 'di tshe phyi ma'i skad cha ma red/ tshe 'di ga'i mi'i spyi tshogs nang la mi gsod pa dang / ma byin len/log g.yem/ rdzun dang phra ma la sogs pa 'di tsho chos med mkhan gyi lung pa zhig yin na yang de chorware gras khrims kyi thog nas dam bsgrags byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de tsho'i gras mi yong bar mi rang rang so so'i ngos nas de dag skyon yin pa zhig bsam blo 'khor na/ phyi nas pu li si lta bus lta mkhan yod min la ma ltos par sgrig rang 'khur byed kyi red/ ma rabs tha shal de rigs la sems kyi nang nas nyes dmigs su blta ba zhig med na/ phyi nas pu li sis 324

me mda' 'khyer te bsrung na yang ha cang khag po red/ bar skabs u ru su'i nang la gnas tshul gang byung ba ltar/ gung khran ring lugs kyi slo ba gso lo nas lo bstud btang ste mi'i sems bsgyur bcos btang ma thub pa de ha cang gsal po red/ nga tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs spyir btang bshad pa yin na/ dper na/ de snga bod la mi gcig bsad 'dug zer na/ ha las pa dang / don 'thor 'thor de 'dra byed kyi yod/ gzhan dag 'bu srin gcig bsad pa yin na'ang sdig pa yod red ces/ bod pa'i kha rgyun la rang shugs kyis 'jags ba sdad yod/ las rgyu 'bras kyi bsam blo med mkhan tshos sems can gzhan dag srog gcod byed pa la the tshom ci yang med/ che chung la ma tos pas srog chags gang 'dra zhig yin rung de la srog yod pa red/ de snying rje/de la sdug bsngal yong gi red bsam pa'i khro de med na/ ga le ga ler mi nang tshag gsod rgyu la yang ya nga bag tsha med pa rang shugs kyis yong gi yod/ ngas sgrung zhig bshad na/ lnga bcu nga drug gi lo la lha sar bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan khang btsugs pa red/ der las khungs khag kha shas shig yod pa red/skabs der nga'i spun mched blo bzang bsam gtan spyi khyab mkhan po red/ rang skyong ljongs bde 'jags las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin rgya mi zhig yod pa de'i rogs pa de blo bzang bsam btan la 'khel 'dug tshogs 'dur nyin ma rtag par 'gro dgos/ nyin zhig blo bzang bsam gtan hon 'thor 'thor 'dra byed kyi 'dug gang 'dug ces dris pa yin/ bde 'jags las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin rgya mi zhig yod pa de spyir btang mi yag po zhig yod pa red/ ngos kyang rjes 325

la ngo shes byung bas mi yag po zhig 'dug kho rang tsho shen 'brel mdzad sgo zhig tshogs pa'i skabs blo bzang bsam gtan la kho gsod zer na bod skad la gang 'dra zer dgos zhes skad cha dri gi 'dug zer byung / nga rang tsho ༄nad pa'i sems nang gal te gsod 'dod yod kyang nyi ma dang po'i mdzad sgo'i sar skad cha de 'dra dris shes stangs med/ de dpe ston lta bu zhig red/ de ni bsam blo'i 'gro stangs sam/ bag chags kyi khyad par zhig red/ mi la brtse ba med na spyi tshogs ring lugs dang gung khran ring lugs 'grub thabs med/ spyi chogs ring lugs ming don mtshungs pa zhig yong dgos na/ gzhan phan gyi bsam blo yod pa/ snying rje'i bsam blo yod pa/ rang las gzhan gtso che ba byed ma thub kyang / gzhan la rang dang 'dra bar blta ba'i bsam blo zhig nges par du yod dgos/ de 'dra med na spyi chogs ring lugs zer ba de ha cang khag po red/ gung khran ring lugs nas bshad pa'i tshang mar lto gos dang / shes yon gang ci'i cha nas 'khos snyoms po/ thob thang 'dra mnyam ngo ma zhig yong dgos na/ nang pa'i chos spyi dang / lhag par theg pa chen po'i chos dang zung du 'brel nas 'bad brtson byed kyi yin na/ theg pa chen 16) chos kyis rogs byed thub kyi red ces ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ gral rim 'thab rtsod byed pa dang / ma dga' zhe 'dzin byed rgyu zhig rtsa ba la bzhag nas/ gung khran ring lugs gang 'dra byas nas 'dzugs bskrun byed thub kyi red dam/ lkog za rul sung gi gnas tshul rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig yong rgyu red/ deng sang rgya nag nang la lkog za rul sung byed mkhan la khrims gcod byas te/ lo ltar mi stong phrag 326

stong phrag bsad kyi yod na yang / des phan gyi yod pa ma red/ nang sems nas g.yo 'gul thebs thub pa zhig dang / sems la bsgyur bcos thebs thub pa zhig ma byung na/ phyi nas mnan zer rgyu de ha cang khag po red/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gis bslab bya gang byed kyi yod dam zer na/ bzang po byed dgos/ gzhan phan sgrub dgos zhes bshad kyi yod/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i kha rgyun la ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces dus rtag tu bshad kyi yod/ smon lam ga dus rgyab kyang tshig de thon gyi yod/de 'dra'i lta ba des mi'i spyi tshogs nang la tan tan phan thogs yod pa zhig red/lhag par rgya nag sogs sa khul mang por sngar nas nang pa dar myong ba yin dus ma 'ongs par bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gis 'gro ba mang po zhig la phan thogs byed thub rgyu zhig tan tan yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug deng sang nub phyogs kyi lung pa de snga nang pa'i chos rtsa ba nas dar ma myong ba/ skad yig khag khagagoms gshis khag khag 'tsho ba skyel stangs khag khag de 'dra'i lung pa'i nang nas skad kyi dka' ngal dang / goms gshis kyi dka' ngal/ rig gzhung mi 'dra ba'i dka' ngal yod na yang / bod kyi nang chos la do snang chen po byed rngu 'i skabs la/ rgya nag gis mtshon pas sa khul de dag la nang cesas kyi phan thogs byed thub rgyu yin pa ngas rtag par dran gyi 'dug der brten bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel gces 'dzin byed pa 'di bod mi gcig pu'i khe phan ma yin par/ rgya nag gtso bor gyur pa'i sa khul de'i rgyud kyi mi sa ya mang po zhig gi bde sdug dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig 327

chags bsdad yod/ da lta'i char rgya nag gi 'go khrid tshos ma shes pa'i dbang gis bod kyi chos de rmongs dad red ces bshad kyi yod kyang / lo nas lo bstud dus tshod gang 'tshams phyin pa dang / gtam brjod rang dbang gi thob thang mang du phyin pa yin na/ bod kyi chos de rgya mi rang gis srung skyob byed dgos pa zhig dang / rgya mi rang gis bod kyi chos la do snang byed pa zhig yong srid/ da lta sgor pa'i thog nas kha shas kha shas yong gi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs par mi'i spyi tshogs kyi bde sdug skor la nyams zhib byed pa dang / bsam blo gtong mkhan tshos bod kyi chos des spyi tshogs yar rgyas 'gro rgyu dang / spyi tshogs zhi bde yong rgyur 'brel ba 'dug phan thogs 'dug zer ba zhig tan tan yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug ngas da lta rgyu mtshan gtso bo 'di'i thog la bsam blo gtong gi yod/bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di bod mi gcig pu'i khe phan min par/ 'askro ba mi spyi dang / yang sgos lhag par can du e sha ya'i sa khul/ de'i nang tshan nas rgya nag gi khe phan la thug gi po(da/ yang cadags gcig nas bshad pa yin na/ rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab kyi lung pa'i nang la brtse bayod pa dang / bzong pa'i nyams len yod pa/ ya rabs kyi nyams len yod pa'i stobs chen rgyal khab cig chags pa yin na/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab tshang mar nyen kha chung du 'gro gi red/ deng sang nub phyogs rgyal khab nang la deb de 'dra thon pa'i nang /deng sang rgya nag gi nang khul du gung khran ring lugs kyi lta ba pham nyes phyin pa'i tshab la/ mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba khyab spel shugs bskyed byed kyi yod pa dang / rgya mi sger pa de gras kyis kyang deb bris rtsom byed mkhan yong gi yod 328

pa red/ deng sang rgya nag nang la dpal 'byor yar rgyas shugs che 'gro gi yod pa dang / de dang chabs cig mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs par rgya nag gi dpal 'byor yar rgyas dang /go mtshon yar rgyas phyin pa yin na/ mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba'i shugs rkyen gyis 'dzam bu gling nub phyogs dang dmag 'khrug yong rgyu'i nyen kha yod lugs bshad kyi yod pa red/ rgya nag dpal 'byor dang / dmag shugs yar rgyas phyin na/ mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba'i thog nas khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag la nyen kha tan tan yod/ der brten 'dzam bu gling spyi'i thog nas bshad pa yin na yang / rgya nang gi mi'i sems la ji tsam gyi zhi bde bag phebs dang /bzod bsran/ byams snying rje'i lta ba de 'dra slebs thub pa byung na/ 'dzam bu gling spyi la yang phan thogs yong gi red/nga tsho'i bod kyi bden don gtso wa de bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gces 'dzin byed thub pa zhig dang /bod kyi lung par khor yug nyams nyes chen po mi 'gro bar zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig bzo thub na/ bod mi'i khe phan tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam bu gling spyi la phan thogs yong gi red bsam pa nga la yid ches sku da la/ yid ches yod pa bzhin mi la yang 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod/ chab srid kyi thog nas bod rang btsan gtsang ma zhig byung na yang nga tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi thog nas bsam blo zhig btang ba yin na/ bod kyi lung pa lung khug red/ mi nyung nyung red/ dngos po yar rgyas kyi thog nas nga sto bod pa ha cang rjes lus red/ rjes lus yin pa'i lung 329

pa'i nang la yar rgyas gtong dgos na rogs byed mkhan zhig la brten dgos/de rgya mi la brten pa yin na/ kho rang tshor dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i nus pa yod la/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi nyams myong yang yod/ des nga tsho la yang phan rgyu dang / rgya nag la yang phan gyi red/ tshur phyogs 'dir chos dang rig gzhung / de dang 'brel ba'i shes yon gyi gnas tshul bod pas legs pa shes kyi red/ rgya mis shes kyi ma red/ de bdag po rgyag stangs bod pas shes kyi red/ bod pa la rgyus mnga' dang / nyams myong mang ba yod/ ngas mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi med/ gang gal che gi red zer na/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed dgos pa de bod pa'i khe phan red la/ rgya mi'i khe phan yang red/ 'dzam bu gling spyi'i khe phan dang yang 'brel ba yod/ dmigs yul 'di 'grub thub pa zhig byed dgos/ dngos yode gnas tshul la bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi las don wade pas byed dgos pa de 'os babs red/ chos dang rig gzhung gtso bor gyur pa'i bod pa rang nyid kyis byed thub pa'i las rigs rnams bod pas 'gan gtsang ma zhig 'khyer/tshan rig dang 'phrul chas sogs dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i las rigs mang po zhig la rgya mis nga tshor slob sbyongs sprad med la/ nyams myong gsog rgyu'i go skabs kyang sprad med pas nga tsho res lus thebs nas bsdad yod/ de dag gi nang la rgya mis lag len byas/ phyi 'brel gyi las ka dang / rgyal srung gi las ka rnams rgya nag gis 'gan 'khyer/ nga tshos rang btsan rtsod pa'i skad cha de rgya mi'i rna bar shinatu gnod po zhig yong giyod pas nga tshos bshad kyi min/330

rang btsanayang bde skyid kyi rtsa ba red/ rang skyongasang bde skyid kyi rtsa ba red/gtso che shos bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ngoms chog pa/ rgya nag the bas mi mang po zhig gi khe phan la thug gi sku(da pa 'di dag nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel 'dzin skyong yag po byed thub pa byung na/ gzhan dag chab srid kyi gnas stangs nga tshor de tsam gyi gnad 'gag mi 'dug 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs gcig gis gcig la ltos dgos pa dang /gcig gis gcig la brten dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dzam bu gling gang sa gang du yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ bar skabs ngas si pan la phyin pa yin/ sbag se zer ba'i sa khul de la slebs song / de'i dpon rigs de 'dra dang nga cho ngo shes nang tshag chags song / ngas nyin gcig khong tshor khyed rang cho rang btsan 'dod kyi 'dug gam zhes dris pa yin/ khong tshos de'i lan du/rang btsan 'dod kyi yod med kyi dri ba 'di lo brgya tham pa'i gong la dris pa yin na/ the tshom med par rang btsan 'dod kyi 'dug zer gyi red/ da cha si pan gyi nang la sbag me rang skyong 'di si pan gyi lung pa spyi byings kyi dpal 'byor gnas stangs dang bsdur ba yin na/ sbag me'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs legs pa yod/ sngag si'i skad yig dang / rig gzhung thun mong ma yin pa yod pa 'di dag nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel cha tshang byed thub kyi yod/sngag si rang skyong gi sa khul 'di rang btsan byas te zur du thon na nga tshor khe phan dmigs bsal gang yang yong rgyu med ces zer byung / de bzhinas ṭa li'i byang rgyud la 'jar man gyi skad yig spyod mkhan gyi rang skyong zhig 'dug331

de'i nang la yang khong tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs delo si spyo ri ya dang /e ṭa li spyi byings las legs pa yod zer/ khong tsho'i rang skyong tshad mthon po zhig yin pa dang / 'char gzhi bkod stangs dang / 'dzin skyong byed stangs de dag gi thog nas/ e ṭa li rgyal yongs nang las ka med pa'i mi 'bor shin tu chen po yod kyang / khong tsho'i rang skyong gi nang la las med mi grangs nyung nyung las med/ der brten khong tshor rang skyong gi gnas stangs 'di'i thog nas khe phan che ba yod lugs zer gyi 'dug dpe de bzhin du/ nga tsho bod pa la cha bzhag na'ang / rgya nag rgyal khab chen 1— de'i khungs la bsdad/ nga tshor dgos rgyu'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel bya rgyu de/ bod pa rang nyid kyi 'gan cha tshang 'khyer rgyu'i gnas tshul gtsang ma byung ba yin na/ lung pa yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i jog la rgya mis nga tsho las lhag pa byed thub kyi red/ de kho rang tshos byas na 'grigs/ ngas da lta bsam blo 'di gtong gi yod/ de 'grub dang ma 'grub zer ba de rgya mi la rag lus yod/ nga tshos rang btsan rtsod kyi med/ nga sbyor ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong ngo ma zhig dang / de yang bod chol kha gsum yongs su rdzogs pa de rnams lus gcig gi mgo dang yan lag nying lag lta bu yin pas de dag kha bral na 'grig gi mi 'dug ces ngas 'di bshad kyi yod/ dper na/ da lta nga tsho bod pa btsan byol ba'i nang cha mamon na/ mkhan po dge bshes dpe cha legs pa mang che ba de dag mdo stod smad khul nas red/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris khul nas shin tu nyung nyung red/ nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas lo sum cu so brgyad lhag 'gro 332

gi yī pa dang / de'i ring la mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod kyang / da dung yang skyes sa'i skye khungs zhib 'jug byas na mang che ba khams pa red/ khams pa'i nang nas kyang 'bri chu shar rgyud kyi khams pa red/ de snga bod la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar/ chos rgyal bka' drin can chos bod rgyal khab yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gyur du bskyangs/ skad kyi sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba yod kyang /rtsa ba'i yi ge de nga tsho bod rigs yongs rdzogs gcig gyur byas te phyin pa red/dus da lta yin na yang / bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dzin skyong spel gsum/chol kha gsum thun mong gis byas nas bsdad yod/ ma 'ongs pa la yang bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel/ chol kha gsum gcig tu sgril te byed rgyu ma gtogs/ dum bur phyin pa'i chol kha gcig gis byed rgyu ha cang khag po red/ der brten chol kha gsum gcig gyur byed rgyu de rtsa don zhig red/ dper na/ rgya nag gzhung rang ngos nas cha bzhag na yang / bod rigs yod sa'i sa khul yongs rdzogs la rang skyong khul dang /rang skyong rdzong gi ming btags pa mtsho sngon dang / gan su/ zi khron gang sar yod mus red/ rgya nag gzhung 'grog mgo byed dgos don mi 'dug nga tshos 'dir chol kha gsum gcig tu sgril zer ba 'dir rang btsan kha bral byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi 'dug bsam te rgya mi zhed snang byed kyi 'dug kyang / zhe snang byed mi dgos/ bod pa rgya mi mnyam du mthun po dang yag po byas te sdod rgyu yong ba la rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa blo bzhag sa zhig bzos dang / nga tshos bsam blo gtong gi red/ bod pa lkug pa ma red/ bod pa la rgyug brdungs 333

kho na byas te kha bral phyin chog gi ma red ces brjod na/ dud 'gro yin na yang rgyug brdungs byed sar sdod kyi ma red/ rang yang skyid pa/ gzhan yang bde ba zhig byung na dgos rgyu de red/ de 'dems kyi red/ bod don 'thab rtsod byed pa 'dir bod pa brgya cha brgya tham pa'i rgyal kha thob rgyu zhig dang / rgya mi brgya cha brgya tham pa pham rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi med/ nga tshos smon lam btab dus sems can tham cad zer ba ma gtogs/ nga skyid pa shog gzhan pham pa shog zer gyi med/ nga tshos chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod byed dus kyang / rgya mi la yang bde skyid yod pa/ bod pa la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa dang bde skyid yod pa/ de 'dra zhig nga tshos dmigs yul bzung gi yod/ de 'dra yin tsang ma 'grub pa yong gi ma red/ rim bzhin yong thub kyi red/ chol kha gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i rang skyong zhig byung ba yin na/ nga bo da pa la yang blo bzhag sa zhig yong gi red/ rgya nag gzhung la yang bod kha bral 'gro gi ma red/ rgyal srung dang / phyi 'khrel rgya nag gis 'gan 'khyer bar brten rgya nag gzhung gi 'dod pa gcig gyur gyi dmigs yul de 'grub kyi yod pa red/ gcig gyur gyi dmigs yul 'grub pa tsam du ma zad/ rtag tu dmag mis gcig sgril srung skyob byed mi dgos pa zhig yong gi red/ gang ltar ngas rgya nag thog la lta stangs de rgya mi la dgra kha gtad byas pa ma yin par/ dngos gnas rang grogs po dang grogs po'i 'du shes kyi thog nas/ rgya la yang khe phan yod pa dang / nga tsho la yang don dag son thub pa de 'dra'i gnyis mos kyi lam zhig rnyed na bsam ste ngas da lta bar du 'bad brtson byas payin/ bar skabs rigs 334

kha shas kyis ngas dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'dis mi 'grigs/ lo rgyus jodzig la bod rang btsan gtsang ma yin pas/ nga tshos rang btsan gtsang ma rtsod dgos zer ba'i bsam 'char zhig yong gi 'dug da lta bar du nga'i lam phyogs 'dir phyogs gcig nas/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan ha cang mang po byung yod/ phyogs gzhan gcig nas nga sa gu bshangs gang yong ci yong byas pa 'di la rgya mi'i ngos nas mu mthud 'gro tshod lta bu rtsis te brda lan ma byas pas rgya mi mnyam du skad cha bshad rgyur grub 'bras byung med/ der brten ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i ched du mi mang nas bsam tshul bsdu len byas na legs zhes lo gcig gnyis de'i nang la mi mang nang nas bsam tshul gang la gang 'tshams bsdus yod/ bod nang la dngos su yongs bsgrags byas nas bsam 'char bsdu thabs med kyang / bod sa khul gang sa gang nas phar tshur gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong byed mkhan de tsho brgyud nas nga tshos gnas tshul gang la gang 'tshams nyams zhib byed thub yod/ bsam 'char khag phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i snying por/ nga tsho btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi mang ba de dag gi bsam 'char la/ da lta nga'i srid byus 'di ga'i thog nas 'bad rtsol bya rgyu dang / mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdu len byed mi dgos pa byas na legs zhes mang che bas bsam tshul de bshad 'dug de bzhin bod nang nas lo gcig gnyis de'i nang la bsam 'char byung ba khag phyogs bsdoms skabs/ bsam tshul mang che bas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbu ma'i lam zer ba de kha yod lag yod lag len bkal thub pa zhig dang / 'grub thub pa zhig red/ dza drag gi gnas tshul 335

skyob rgyu'i thabs shes yag shos red ces mdo stod smad dang / dbus gtsang sa khul mang po zhig nas bsam tshul 'di yong gi 'dug nye char nga tsho'i gros tshogs thog nas de'i skor la thag gcod gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa bzhes 'dug par/ ngas lam seng thag gcod ma byas par zla ba kha shas shig sgug na da dung /bod nang nas gnas tshul 'dra phran bu yong mdog kha po red/ lo jes ma'i gsum bcu'i dus dran skabs la thag gcod gsal bsgrags byas na zhes zhu rgyu byung /gang ltar rgya bod gnyis kyi gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi sgang la bsdad snyo/ de'i rgyu mtshan dang / 'gro stangs/ nga tshos bsam blo gtong stangs dang / byed stangs de ltar yin/ shes song ngam/ bar skabs khyed rang tsho bal yul la yang de'i skor tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa red/ mi mang gis do snang gang 'dra byed kyi 'dug gam/de nas gnas tshul gcig zhus na bsam pa dran song / ngas nam rgyun bod pa su thug na yang rna ba tsha tsha rtag par bshad mus bzhin/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi rtsa don snying po mi'i bde skyid dang 'brel ba yod pa/ mi sger gyi bde skyid dang 'brel ba yod pa/ spyi chogs kyi bde skyid dang 'brel ba yod pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang zer ba'i bsgrub bya de sgrub pa'i gnas skabs la/ nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung 'di ngo shes pa byas te bdag po rgyag rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug ces ngas nam rgyun rtag par bshad kyi yod/ bar lam zhig nas bod pa tsho la mthong tshul gang yong gi yod dam zer na/ nga tsho'i slob grwa'i nang dang / spyir btang spyi tshogs kyi nang la bod mi'i ya rabs spyod bzang gi 336

tshad de ga le ga ler dma' ru 'gro gi yod pa dang / dngul ma gtogs bsam rgyu med mkhan 'dra po/ khram pa'i byed stangs mang ba/ gang ltar bod mi'i spus ka zhan du 'gro ba zhig bshad kyi 'dug 'di la nga tsho tshang mas gal che don cher brtsis te do snang chen po byed dgos kyi 'dug ya rabs spyod bzang zer ba de 'dzin grwa tshogs te bslab rgyu gcig pu ma red/ de khyim tshang so so'i nang gi bza' tshang dang / pha ma bu phrug tsho'i dbar la 'brel ba byed phyogs/khyim tshang de'i nang gi rgyun ldan gyi spyod lam ya rabs gus zhabs ldan pa/ skad cha bshad stangs/ rnam 'gyur bstan stangs sogs bzang po'i mig tos rnams phru gur 'jags thabs la khyim tshang so so'i nang nas do snang byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ ya rabs spyod bzang 'di dag srog rtsa lta bu yin bsam pa byed dgos/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod mi bsngags brjod byed yul du bsdad yod/ de yong ba bod pa phyug po red ces bsngags brjod thob pa min/ bod pa shes yon can red ces bsngags brjod thob pa min/ bod pa ya rabs red/bod pa'i gdong la 'dzum mdangs 'dug bod mir dka' ngal 'phrad kyang sems la zhi bde 'dug ces bsngags brjod de tsho'i thog nas thob yong gi yod pas/ de dag nga tsho'i nor bu lta bu chags bsdad yod/ nor bu lag par yod dus bdag po rgyag shes pa byed rgyu gal chen po yin/ de cho'i gras mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas ga be+e ga ler 'thus shor phyin/ gang 'tshams mngon gsal dod po chags tshar dus phyis drags te bzo bcos rgyag rgyu khag po byed rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ de la nga rang tsho tshang mas do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug chos dang 337

rig gzhung nyams pa gsor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu de/ dgon pa grwa tshang gcig pu min par/ nga rang tsho mang tshogs tshang mas do snang byed dgos pa zhig red/ lhag don khyim tshang nang la do snang byed rgyu gnad 'gag chen po 'dugachos dad skor la yang de bzhin yin/ ngas nam rgyun rtag par bshad mus ltar/ bla ma dang po de pa pha dang / a mas byed dgos kyi 'dug khyim tshang nang la so so'i phru gu chung chung skabs su nga nang pa red/ skyabs 'gro byed dgos brjod pa tsam min par sangs rgyas zer na gang 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod pa/ chos dang / dge 'dun zer na gang 'dra zhig yin pa/ de'i nang tshan nas gtso bo gtso bo chos yin pas/ chos zer na gang 'dra yin pa/ dpe cha pu ti brtsigs pa de dag rjod byed kyi tshig red/ lung gi chosayin pa red /gca rwa1 gtso bo brjod bya'i don rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin/ mthar gtugs na 'gog pa'i bden pa dang / lam gyi bden pa zhes pa 'di yin pas chos ngo shes dgos/ 'gog pa'i bden pa dang lam gyi bden pa'i steng nas chos ngo shes pa zhig byung na/ chos zer ba de la bsam blo gtong rgyu zhig 'dug de la dngos gnas drang gnas mi'i sems la bzo bcos bya rgyu'i nus pa zhig 'dug snyam pa'i bsam blo 'khor thub pa yong gi red/ de min chos zer dus grong chog rgyug rgyu dang / yang min na sku gsung thugs rten sgrig rgyu lta bur ngos 'dzin byas na yag po mi 'dug khyim tshang nang phru gu chung chung la chos dang po ngo spyod byed mkhan dang / chos slob mkhan de pha ma so sos byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam 338

pa dran gyi 'dug pha mas so so'i phru gu la skyo ma ster gyin ster gyin/ 'o ma ster gyin ster gyin la ma ṇi bgrang na phan yog yod pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ tshe snga phyi sogs bslab dgos/ phru gu chung chung yin na yang chags sdang drag po'i gzhan dbang du phyin na phru gu skyid po yod pa ma red/ gang ltar nyon mongs zer ba 'di sems kyi skyon yin pa ngo sprod byed dgos/ sems kyi skyon med pa bzo thabs la nang pa'i chos bshad pa ma gtogs/ skyabs su mchi zer rgyu gcig pu'i don la bshad pa ma red/ de ltar pha ma chos phru gu la chos kyi ngo sprod byed dgos pa dang / de byed pa la pha ma so so'i chos kyi shes tshad yar rgyas gtong rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ de snga bod la chos slob rgyu de grwa pa'i las 'gan dang / de'i nang tshan nas mtshan nyid pa dang / bshad gra de tsho'i gras kyis las 'gan yin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig ma gtogs/ spyir btang mang tshogs kyis chos bslab dgos kyi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin ha lam med pa lta bu zhig red/ de thabs skyo po dang nor 'khrul red/ 'di la nga tsho tshang mas do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug de sngon gzhis chags khag nang shes yon tshogs chung zer ba zhig btsugs te las 'gul zhig byas pa red/ mjug la khungs 'khyol po byung yod med mi shes kyangaka gzhon nu dang / bud med tshogs pas shes yon yar rgyas dang 'phrod bsten skor slob sbyong 'bod skul byed mus red/ bla mas chos khri'i sgang la bsdad de chos bshad pa lta bu byed ma dgos/ khyed rang tsho tshogs pa skyid sdug khag nas dus dus la gling ga 'dra btang ba'i skabs la/ nang pa'i bden pa bzhi zer ba'i don dag gang dang gang yin pa'i skor la bgro gleng 'dra 339

byas/ go bsdur 'dra byas na/ shes pa phyed ka dang / ma shes pa phyed ka yong mdog kha po red/ thal cha gang yang mi 'dug gang ltar de tsho'i skor la shod res gtong rgyu dang / do snang 'dra yar bslangs pa yin na/ 'di la slob sbyong byed 'dod slebs yong gi red/ ha cang gal chen po min nam bsam gyi 'dugakhyed rang tsho cha rkyen 'dra 'dzoms/ mos pa 'dra byung ba yin na/ dus chen dang / gung seng de 'dra'i skabs la mnyam du 'dzoms te nang pa'i chos dang /phyi pa'i chos la khyad par gang yod pa/ nang pa'i chos la theg pa chen po dang /theg pa chung ngu la khyad par gang yod pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i skabs la bden pa bzhi gsungs pa de dag gi don gang yin pa sogs sbyangs bshad slob sbyong bya rgyu de gal chen po 'dug sngags bgrang rgyu dang / cho ga 'don rgyu de tsho yag po yin kyang / de tsam gyis ha las rgyu gang yang med/ de tsam gyis chos ngo ma byed kyi yod med the tshom red/ de gnad 'gag chen po red bsam gyi 'dug de skor zhen bskul zhu 'dod byung /de khyed rang tshos sems la bcangs/ de nas bla ma tshad ldan dang / dge bshes tshad ldan de gras kyis dus dus la chos kyi ngo sprod byas na yag po red/ tshe dbang byabs khrus zer ba de tsho'i gras gnad 'gag che ba min/ chos ngo sprod byed rgyu de gnad gal chen po red/ shes song ngam/dper na/ nga shi song na 'phral sel gzhis byes gnyis ga'i nang la sems mi skyid pa yong rgyu dang / las gar gnas skabs 'gal rkyen chen po chags kyi red/ 'on kyang bod don 'di mi rigs shig gi 'thab rtsod yin dus mu mthud 340

de byed rgyu ma gtogs/ mtshams rtsa ba nyid nas bzhag gi ma red/ ji srid bod mi rigs gnas phyin chad la de srid du bod rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod mu mthud bsdad kyi red/ nga tsho mi thog nas mi thog sbrel te las ka mu mthud byed dgosri pa dang / mi thog rjes ma rnams shes yon yod pa zhig dgos pa yin stabs/ rgya gar la slebs nas rim pa dang po de nga tshos slob grwa btsugs pa red/ skabs der stabs legs pa zhig la/ rgya gar gyi srid blon 'jo ha la zhe ru nas thugs khur chen po bzhes te bod don mu mthud sgrub rgyu dang / ma brlag pa'i rtsa ba'i 'gag rtsa bod mi'i shes yon la rag lus yod pas/ bod phrug na gzhon mi rabs gsar pa de dag la shes yon sprod dgos zhes ne+e ru rang gis nga la bka' slob gnang byung / 1959 lo nang ma su ri la bod mi na gzhon lnga bcu skor yod pa'i slob grwa zhig btsugs pa red/ de nas bzung dus da lta'i bar du ha lam bod phrug khri lnga drug tsam slob grwa 'grims nas bon bsdad yod pa 'di dag nga tsho mi rigs shig gi rtsa don gyi ched du yin pa ma gtogs/ mi gcig bsdad pa'i ring la bod don 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa dang / nga mi gcig 'chi ba'i nyin mob de nas bod don yal rgyu rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ ngas yang srid skor bshad pa der blo g.yeng byed dgos don med/ yang bar skabs paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid skor gnas tshul yong stangs la mtshon na ma 'ongs par tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed rgyu'i gnas tshul byung ba yin na/rgya mis yang srid ngos 'dzin byas te/ tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen bla ma gnyis ka rgya mi kho rang tshos bskos pa zhig bzos te/ de'i thog nas bod la dbang 341

bsgyur bya rgyu'i bsam blo gtong giyod tshul bshad mkhan 'dug gal srid de 'dra yin na/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas te bsdad pa'i ring la nga 'das grongs phyin pa'i dbang du btang ba yin na/ yang srid gal srid dgos na/ brgya cha brgya tham pa rgya mi'i lag 'og tu yong gi ma red ces bshad kyi yod/ gang yin zer na/ de la rgyu mtshanayod/ yang srid yong ba'i dgos don nam/ dmigs yul ni snga ma des las ka mgo btsugs nas 'phro can la bsdad pa de mjug skyong byed pa'i don duyong dgos/ dper na nga lha mo ༄dun grub kyis las ka mgo btsugs te da lta ma 'grub par bsdad pa zhig nga'i yang srid yin zer mkhan phru gu gcig gis lha snu ngadon grub kyis mgo btsugs pa'i lasaka de gtor bshigs gtong mkhan zhig byung song na/ de yang srid min pa'i rtags red ma gtogs/yang srid yin na deyong shes kyi ma red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas te sdod pa'i ring la nga med pa chags pa dang / de'i yang srid cig rgya che'i mi mang gis gal srid 'dod pa yod na/ nga'i yang srid de rang dbang lung pa'i nang la yong gi red/ de dngos yod gnas tshul red/ de'i rgyu mtshan la bsam 13 1ngas dang //des kyang tshad kyi ma red/ phyi rgyal mi de tsho 'dra mi 'dra'i skad cha dri rgyu la dga' po yod/ tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bud med yong gi red dam/ de snga bod kyi bla ma'i nang la bud med yod dam med ces dri mkhan yang yang yong gi 'dugangs nam rgyun 'char can 'di bshad kyiyod/ bla ma'i nang la bud medayod /dper na/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mo lta bu yod/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mor cha bzhag na/ bla ma chen po red/rten bud med red ces bshad kyiyod/ 7rgyal 342

ba rin po che da phan sku phreng bcu bzhi'i bar du bud med byung med/ ma 'ongs par de'i tshe de'i dus la rten bud med cig gis bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs che ba yong rgyu'i gnas tshul zhig chags song na/ bud med rten can gyi 7rgyal ba rin po che yong gi red/ yong ba tsam du ma zad/ rnam pa yag po zhig yong gi red ces brjod kyiyod/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong ba la/ gzugs bzang ba la sogs pa dgos kyi yod/ tā la'i bla ma bud med cig byung ba yin na phal cher rten rab byung ma zhig yong gi red/rab byung yin na rang bzhin gyi rnam pa yag po zhig yod na ma gtogs/ gdong par chos byug ste mdzes po bzos chog gi ma red/ gang ltar yang srid skor lu ngas rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul zhig 'grel bshad byas pa ma garke(gas/ rig 'dzin bla ma thugs bsun nas/ mkha' spyod zhing du dgongs pa gtad/ ces pa de 'dra'i blo sna thung thung byas pa rtsab nyid nas ma red/ kha sngon dha ram sa lar brtan bzhugs skor las ka byed mkhan khong tsho la ngas 'grel bshad rgyab pa yin la/ de ring yang khyed rang tshor zhor la cig lab na bsam pa red/des na khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas nas sdod/ nga gzugs po ni bde thag chod yod/ lo lta drug cu re grangs la slebs pa red/ sku mdun sku gong ma las nga rgan pa chags tshar ba red/ sku phreng gong ma bcu gsum byung ba'i nang nas/ nga las dgung lo bgres pa 7gong sa lnga pa dang / de nas dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ de nas dge 'dun grub bcas gsum byung yod/ lo drug cu re bdun la slebs na/ 7rgyal ba lnga pa las brgal yong gi red/ de nas drug cu re 343

brgyad la slebs na dge 'dun rgya mtsho las brgal yong gi red/ dge 'dun grub pa dgung lo brgyad bcu gya bzhi bzhugs pa red/ rig pa bsgrims dgos kyi red/ dge 'dun grub pa bzhag tshar song na/ nga lo brgyad cu gya lnga gya drug la slebs 'gro gi red/ da lta'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs la bltas pa yin na tshe ring tsam bsdad yong bsam gyi 'dug yin na yang rkyen mang po zhig la ltos kyi yod pas/ khyed rang tshos kyang dad pa dam tshig mthun po yag po byed dgos/ da lta nang bzhin hur thag gyis/ nga rang gi ngos nas hur thag byed kyi yin la/ tshe sgrub 'dra yang byed kyi yod/ rgyun du bsam blo rdzod rtsod byas sdod kyi yod ma gtogs/ sems mi skyid pa gang yang med/ bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems khur blangs dgos kyang 'khor ba'i chos nyid de 'dra de 'dra red bsam gyi 'dug snying rje/ bod nang layod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams dngangs skrag chen po yod pa 'di gang drag bsam pa 'dra dran pa ma gtogs gzhan de 'dra de 'dra red/ gal che shos so so'i mi tshe 'di don dang ldan pa zhig dang /mi la phran bu'i sems skyid pa las ma byung na yang de tsam zhig gis blo bag spros rgyu'i phan thogs byung ba yin na mi tshe gcig gi dgos don 'grub kyi red/ de gal chen po red ma gtogs/ gzhan gnad 'gag de tsam mi 'dug der brten khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas te sdod/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ zhes stsal// // (skabs 'dir dol rgyal sgon bka' rābī stsal ba ga' slob 'di gras byings khongs su phyogs bsdebs zhus/)344

ra༅rgya// phyi lo 1996 zla 2 tshes 19 me bya'i gnam lo gsar tshes nyin gangs ljongs gzhis byes mi ma nga yongs la bkra shis bde legs kyi gsung bshad bka' drin stsal ba/da ring 'dir dha ram sa lar rgyun du gnyug mar gnas pa'i bod mi ser skya rgan gzhon dang / phyogs mtha' nas yong mkhan tsho/ lhag don bod nas gnyen 'phrad dang gnas mjal la yong ba cho/ de bzhin bod pa'i grogs po phyi rgyal gyi mi sna yang mang po zhig slebs 'dug 'dir dngos su yod pa'i khyed rang tsho brgyud nas bod gangs can jongs kyi bod mi ser skya tshang mar ngos nas lo gsar pa'i bkra shis bde legs zhu gi yod/nga rang tsho'i kha la rnam kun nas bkra shis bde legs zhes pa 'di 'jags yod/ bkra shis zhes pa 'di'i don 'phral sgang snang ba skyid po byed pa zhig ma yin par/ bde skyid kyi rtsa ba dge ba smren dus dge ba'i don la go ba yin/ rang res rnam kun 'don bzhin pa'i 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nang / bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar dge ba rim pa gnyis pas tshe phyi ma phan chad mngon mtho'i lus rten thob par byed pa'i rgyu rkyen byas te de lta bu'i sgo nas bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis par byed pa/ dge ba de las rim pa mtho ba bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gyi dge bas srid pa 'khor ba las thar ba'i thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu rkyen byas te thar pa'i bde skyid thob pa'i sgo nas bkra shis par byed pa/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba/ mdor 345

na pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su blangs te lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu rnam mkhyen 7rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i bde skyid mthar thug skrub par byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi thog nas gtan du skyid pa'i bkra shis par byed pa bcas kyi don yin/ der brten rnam kun nga rang tsho 〈snad pa'i kha nas bkra shis bde legs zhes brjod pa 'di'i don la bsam blo btang na rgya shin tu chen po yod/ rdo don snying lngardzo/ bkra shis par byed pa zhes pa 'di rgyud la dge ba zhig bsgrubs nas dge ba de'i mthus rang 'bras bde skyid thob pa'i sgo nas bkra shis par byed pa zhig yin pas/ nga rang tshos kha nas bkra shis bde legs zhes brjod pa dang chabs cig so so'i bsam blo'i nang dge ba'i blo zhig skye dgos/ dge ba'i slo med par bsam rgyu sdig pa dang / bya rgyu gnod pa'i rang bzhin can zhig gi thog phyin pa yin na/ bkra shis pa yong rgyu med/ngos nas rgyun du brjod pa bzhin/ nga rang snur bod kha ba gangs can ljongs kyi rig gzhung gi rtsa ba nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba yod/ bod kha ba gangs can ljongs kyi rig gzhung zhes pa 'di da lta da lta'i nga rang tsho'i rig gzhung 'di la bsam blo gtong dgos/ 'dzam gling thog nas bod pa'i rig gzhung zhes dmigs bsal do snang byed yul yang / bar skabs bod nang dar zhing rgyas pa'i rig gzhung 'di yin/ rig gzhung 'di'i jog nas nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi 'tsho ba skyel stangs dang / bsam blo gtong stangs sogs mang po zhig naji pa'i chos kyi bslab bya dang 'brel nas yong gi yod/ der 346

brten ngos nas bkra shis bde legs kyi go don 'brel bshad byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/ rdo don nga rang tsho tshang mas sems pa skyid po byed dgos pa las/ sems sbub dog po byed mi rung la/ sems shugs kyang chag mi rung / nga rang bod spyi pa'i don dag bsgrub rgyu dang / so so mi sge ra zhig 'tsho zhing gnas par byed pa'i mi tshe 'di dge ba bsgrub rgyu dang /phan pa bsgrub rgyu'i thog gtong dgos/ nyin re'i mi tshe 'di sdig pa gsog pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa byed pa'i thog tu btang ba yin na/ gson pa las ma gaskusten na legs/ phan pa'i rang bzhin can gyi mi tshe zhig skyel thub na/ gson nas nyi ma gcig gam/ zla ba gcig yo gcig sdod thub kyang khe bzang yin la/ da dung lo brgya dang / yang na lo stong phrag gcig sdod thub kyi yod pa yin na/ de ni dngos gnas rang gzhan gnyis phan yong rgyu dang / rang nyid skyid la gzhan la phan pa/ de yang 'gro ba mi tsam du ma zad/ srog chags grog sbar tshun la phan thogs byed thub pa yin/ de rtsis tshang mas sems pa bzajo po bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ nga rang tsho gcig gis gcig la phan pa'i bsam pa bzang po bcangs nas phan tshun mdza' gcugs kyi dam tshig la rgya 'o chu gcig 'dres kyi thog so so sgor gyi don nam/spyi pa'i don/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don/ mi rigs kyi don bcas bsgrub pa yin na 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub thub pa zhig yong rgyu yin/ zhes ngos nas de ring gi go skabs 'di brgyud ring min 'di nas thon mkhan tsho dang bcas pa tshang mar zhus na snyam pa dran byung / snga lo mjal kha byung med 347

la/ phal cher khyed rang tsho mang pos do snang byung yod/ bar lam zla ba bzhi lhag tsam zhig song ba de'i ring ngos rang slo brgyab nas mid pa ma bde ba byung / der brten mjal kha ma dgos par mang tshogs 'khyug tsam thug nas bkra shis bde legs zhus na des 'grig gi red snyam byung / bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che zhes bka' stsal// //348

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1996 zla 6 tshes 17 nyin khu nu re kong pi 'u la mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir sku mgron dge bshes rnam pa dang / sa gnas kyi phyag las 'gan bzhes mkhan/ mi mang bcas tshang mar zhu rgyur/ 'dir rin po ches thugs khur rkang bzhes kyis slob grwa chen po zhig gsar bskrun 'char gzhi dang / sngon 'alha'i rten 'brel skabs ngos rang bcar thub pa dga' po byung thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal red/ 'gro ba mi zer mkhan 'di sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa'i cha nas sems can gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med/ sems can tshang ma gcig pa red/ gzugs stobs che chung la mtshon na/ mi gzugs stobs che ba'i gras la tshud kyi med/yin na yang 'gro ba mi la rnam dpyod kyi nus pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shig yod/ rang bzhin gyi rnam dpyod yod pa tsam gyis mi chog par rnam dpyod kyi nus pa gong mthor spel thub pa byed dgos/ slob sbyong zer ba de ni/ mi'i rnam dpyod kyi nus pa gong nas gong du gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen gtso bor 'dzin gyi yod/ shes yon yag po yod na'ang / bed spyod yag po gtong ma thub na shes yon gyis phan pa'i rang bzhin la 'gro gi yod dam/ yang na gnod pa'i rkyen la 'gro gi yod dam/ de ni nges pa med pa red/ shes yon gyi rnam dpyod de phan pa'i don chen zhig la spyod pa'i ched lhag bsam bzang po dang zung du 'brel ba'i jog nas 'gro dgos/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'dir dper na nub phyogs rgyal khab de tsho'i gras phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas ha cang chen po phyin yod stabs/349

yar rgyas ma phyin pa'i lung pa tshos dpe lta sa chags bsdad yod/ yin na'ang phyi dngos po yar rgyas yod pa de'i nang gi mi'i sems kyi dka' ngal la bltas pa yin na/ nub phyogs rgyal khab dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa tsho'i nang la sems kyi dka' ngal dmigs bsal can rnam grangs mang po zhig yong gi 'dug shes ga re'i rtags bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ shes yon yod pa gcig pus mi 'grigs par shes yon dang lhag bsam zung du 'brel ba'i thog nas lhag bsam bzang po'i rgyab 'khyogs pa zhig dgos pa nga rang tshor ngo sprod yong gi yod/ ngas rnam kun rgya gar gyi grogs po mor rtag par shod kyi yod/ nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi tshan rig dang / 'phrul chas thog nas dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa mig dper bltas nas rang gi lung pa'i nang la 'dzugs bskrun nges par du byed dgos pa red/ de dang chabs cig rgya gar rang nyid la gna' rabs nas bsam blo'i gnas tshad mthon po'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / bslab bya bzang po lta ba'i rnam gzhag zab po yod pa de rnams nges par du zung sbrel thog nas 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa gnad chen po red ces bshad kyi yod/ snga dus lung pa mang po'i nang la rnam dpyod dang 'brel ba'i shes yon gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i rtsa ba'i 'gan 'khyer mkhan slob grwa khag dang / lhag bsam bzang wa'i yon tan yag po zhig yong thabs su chos rje tshos 'gan khur byed kyi yod/ deng sang chos rje tshor spyi tshogs nang la nus pa de tsam med mkhan zhig chags yong dus gang ltar mi'i lhag bsam bzang po'i yon tan rgyud steng du 'jags thub pa'i 'gan khur byed mkhan dmigs bsalamed pa lta bur gyur te 'thus shor chen po 'gro 350

gi ṣ+ka/ nga'i re ba la da lta 'dzugs bskrun 'go 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa'i slob gra 'di bzhin phyin chad rnam dpyod gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen tshang ba dang /chabs cig lhag bsam ldan pa'i mi bzang po zhig yong ba'i re ba byed kyi yod la/ khyed chos kyang dmigs yul de bsgrub thub pa'i tshang mas thugs khur bzhes rogs gnang zhu rgyuyin/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa sangs rgyas kyi mtshon pas chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig yod pa'i nang tshan nas gtso che ba'i chos lugs 'di dag gis sngar gyi dus dang / da lta/ ma 'ongs pa bcas par mi sa ya mang por phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho gna' rabs pha mes kyi dus nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su 'brangs mkhan sha stag yin/ ngos rang gi mi thog la cha bzhag na khu nu'i yul 'dir mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa khu nu ba rgan bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dang /rgan rig 'dzin bstan pa khong rnam gnyis nas ngas chos 'brel zhu myong ba ltar skyes bu dam pa/ nga tshore mi jog tu yang yod spos red/ nga rang tsho pha mes nas nang pa'i chos dar sa'i sa char skyes yod pa dang / ma zad chos rgyud phan tshun mthun po yong rgyu'i gzhi g.yang yod pa zhig red/ lta ba dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba yod na'ang bzang po'i bslab bya gcig gyur yin pa dang / gzhan phan gyi bsam blo'i thog nas chos rgyud phan tshun dam tshig mthun po yong thub pa'i cha rkyenayod pa red/ yin na'ang chos rgyud so so'i rjes 'brangs pa 'ga' zhig gis lhag bsam yin khyal gyis chos lugs spel res dang / phar sgyur tshur sgyur byed pa/ ha lam chab srid tshogs pa lta bur mi mang khrod du hab thob 351

rgyag gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra byed pa 'di ni chos rgyud phan tshun dam tshig ma mthun pa'i rkyen rtsa zhig red/ ngos nas rgyun du shod bzhin pa ltar nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi yul gru'i nang la pha mes nas ye shu'i chos lugs red/ rang rang so sku'i pha mes kyi chos lugs thog phyin pa yin na legs pa'i rang bzhin red/ rtsa ba'i chos byed mi byed dang / gang byed dang mi byed so so'i rang dbang yin yang /nga rang tsho pha mes nas nang pa yin dus nang pa rang gi thog la phyin na legs pa red/ de ni ngos rang gi nyams myong gi thog nas do snang byung / nga rang tsho pha mes nas nang pa'i chos la dad mos yod pa gcig pus ldang gi ma red/ dad pa byed sa'i chos de ji 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de'i 'gro stangs la do snang gis shes thabs byed rgyur tshang mas sems khur che bskyed bya dgos/da lta bshad pa'i gnad ke+on de ni/ nga rang tsho'i nang gi sems rgyud gtsang ma bzo rgyu'i bya thabs shig red/ rang sems gtsang ma bzo ba dang chabs cig rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de yang gtsang ma bzo rgyu gal chen po red/nga rang tsho'i spyod 'jug nang la/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam beḍar+ya'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig ces gsungs pa ltar nga rang tshos dngos su lam seng 'grub kyi med na yang / mos pa tshun chad kyis sa phyogs yid du 'ong ba/ bkod pa mdzes pa de 'dra bsgom dgos kyi yod pa ltar rang nyid yod sa'i sa cha dang /khor yug tshang ma gtsang ma byed kyi yin na bsgom pa gcig pu ma yin par dngos su lag len bstar thub pa'i ched du do snang nges par byed dgos/ rgya gar nang 352

bzo gra mang po dang / mi 'bor/ 'khor lo bcas mang po yod par brten nas kha rlung bsgurag pa chags pa'i rkyen gyis mig tsha ba sogs kyi mig nad dang /de bzhin blo bar yang skyon cha yong nyen yod pa red/ de dag 'gog thabs su 'gro song khyon che zhig thabs 'tshol byed dgos pa chags kyi 'dug 'di khul sa cha rang bzhin kha rlung gtsang ma yod pa sdug tu mi 'gro ba'i do snang nges par byed dgos/ sa cha 'di'i ri rtser gangs kyis brgyan cing / bar du rang byung mdzes sdug phun sum tshogasapa/ gsham du nags kyi bkod pa ldan pa'i sa gzhi gtsang ma smon pa'i rang bzhin lta buyod/ dper na/ ngos rang la cha bzhag na rgya thang nas 'dir slebs dus sa cha gtsang la bsil ngad ldan pa'i tshor ba yong gi 'dug 'di khul du gnas pa'i khyim tshang ngam/ mi re ngo re'i thoganas sa dngos gtsang yong ched shog snyigs dang / shel dam sogs gang byung mang byung ma g.yug par lam seng lam seng mer bsregs gtong dgos kyis yod/don du gang byed dgos kyi yod kyang med pa bzos te/ gang ltar sa cha gtsang ma bzo rgyu gal cher 'dzin dgos/ dang po nas 'thus shor ma song ba byed thub na rjes su 'gro song gi dka' ngal ma 'phrad pa yong gi red/ khor yug gi gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten thog la khyed rang tshos do snang byed kyi yod shag red/ yin na yang dmigs bsal do snang byed rogs zhes shod 'dod byung / bod pa tshor so so'i lung pa rgya che la mi nyung nyung yin dus khoraslig thog dmigs bsal do snang dang / goms gshis 'jags ma thub pa'i gnas tshul 'dir ngo sprod byed dgos pa'i gnad 'gag cig mthong ste lab na bsam pa dran byung /353

slob grwa'i slob phrug rnams lhag bsam dag la rnam dpyod ldan pa zhig dang / gnyis pa nga rang tsho'i pha mes nas yod pa'i chos rgyud zab mo yod pa 'di nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong thabs shes pa byed rgyu/ gsum pa khor yug gi gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten thog la do snang byed rgyu bcas gsum po 'di bshad 'dod byung / khyed rang tshos nga la dga' mos dang yid ches byed kyi yod pa red/ ngos nas khyed rang tshor byin rlabs shig sprad/ smon lam zhig bton pa gcig pus phan gyi ma red/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das sku ngo ma 'tsho bzhugs skabs la yang gsung gi 'phrin las thog nas gdul bya'i gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi 'dod don sgrub pa ma gtogs/ byin rlabs gcig pus gdul bya'i sdug bsngal sel ba gnang gi yod pa ma red/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs dge slong phal pa nga lta bu zhig la byin rlabs kyi nus pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ da phan pa gang bya rgyu yod dam zer na/ khyed rang chos nga la yid ches dang / re ba byas par brten ngas yin lugs min lugs blang dor gyi bslab bya rgyag rgyu nga'i las 'gan red/ 'di dag khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa gyis/ yang rjes su thug yong / bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' sdigapa// //354

si༅// phyi lo 1996 zla 7 tshes na nyin spi ti rta pho dgon par mang tshogs la tshe dbang gnang skabs bka' slob 455 ba/da ring 'dir mjug tu dge ba tshe dbang dang / de dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs byas te dus skabs 'di'i chos 'brel sbyor dngos rjes gsum cha tshang zin pa red/ de yang nga rang tsho tshang ma da res nyin shas shig 'dir 'dzoms pa'i ring la/ ma gzhi nga tshor nyon mongs lhan skyes su yod pa goms pa'i dbang gis chags sdang skyes kyi red de/ yin na yang nam rgyun dang mi 'dra bar dge ba'i blo gang la gang 'tshams gsar du skyes thub yod/ des sa bon lta bu byas te mu mthud nas dge ba'i blo je bzang du 'gro e thub blta dgos pa gal chen po red/ blo dge ba'i nang nas mchog twa gyur pa zab shos dang / nus pa che shos ni bden pa bzhi dang / bden pa gnyis spyi'i go ba gang la gang 'tshams yod pa'i sgo nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla med rdzogs byang gi go 'phang don gnyer gyi bsam pa 'dun pa gnyis ldan gyi byang chub kyi sems dang / de bzhin chos thams cad nga rang tshor phyi rol khuthul steng nas grub pa'i snang tshul zhig 'char yang / de thams cad kyi sdod lugs ngo ma rang bzhin gyis gdod ma nyid nas ma grub par rkyen gyi dbang gis yod pa tsam zhig yin pa'i blo dang bcas de lta bu'i thabs shes la bslab rgyu de chos kyi snying po gal che shos yin pa red/ gzhi rtsa de 'dra zhig yod pa'i thog la nga rang tsho'i yul 'dir sngar nas theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi goms gshis yod stabs spyir btang sa gnas kyi las byed pa tshos kyang rgya gting la mi tshogs chen po skusad sa'i sa 355

khul la ltos na sa khul 'di phyogs la khrims 'gal byed mkhan yang nyung nyung red ces shod kyi yod/ sngon ma nga thog mar 'di phyogs su yong ba'i skabs la sa gnas kyi rdzong dpon dang / skor srung 'go byed de tsho'i gras kyis brjod gsal/ 'di khul yul pa tsho rtsa ba gyong po yin na yang / ya rabs spyod bzang gi bag chags yag po 'dug ces nga la de 'dra bshad myong / bzang po'i goms gshis yod pa 'di tsho'i gras dngos gnas drang gnas kyi mi che'i nang gi rin thang red/ phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas nges par du 'gro dgos kyang / phyi'i dngos po kho nar zhen chags byas te nang gi ya rabs spyod bzang gi rin thang brlag na nam zhig skyid po gang yang yong gi ma red/ da lta 'dzam gling thog dngos/ po yar rgyas ha cang tshad mthon po yon pa'i nang la'ang rang shi rgyag mkhan dang /gnyid ma khug pa'i sems khral gyis gnyid sman rtag par zas nas sdod dgos pa de 'dra'i gnas tshul yong dang yong bzhin par brten/ phyi dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa dang chabs cig nang gi nga rang tsho'i goms gshis bzang poyod pa 'di dag mnyam por 'gro thub pa zhig nges par byed dgos/ de lta bu'i goms gshis bzang po 'di la rgyu mtshan shes pa dang rin thang mthong nas rgyun 'dzin byed dgos/ ya rabs spyod bzang gi goms gshis so so'i yul srol la yod pa 'di'i dge mtshan mthong ba'i sgo nas mu mthud rgyun zin thub pa byung na gang byung gi rkyen gyis 'gyur tu med pa'i cho'i 'gro stangs brtan spro zhig chags yong gi red/ de gal chen po red /de bzhin nga rang tsho'i nang chos kyi rig gzhung de spyi tshogs nang rgyun 'dzin 356

thub pa yong ba la/ nang chos kyi shes tshad de ha cang gal chen po yin stabs kha sang bshad pa bzhin spyi tshogs nang mang tshogs kyis nang chos kyi shes yon go rtogs mtho ru 'gro ba'i 'bad rtsol byed dgos pa dang / slob grwa khag gi nang la de lugs kyi do gal chen po byed dgos/ lhag par dgon sde khag chung chung zhig yin na'ang de'i nang gi dge 'dun tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa ngo shes pa byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ngo ma de 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub pa zhi ga dgos rgyur tshang mas do gal chen po gnang rgyu gal chen po red ces zhu snying 'dod kyi 'dug gzhan du nga rang tshos spyir btang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba ngo ma de lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can de la ngos 'dzin ma thub par/ lha khang dang gtsug lag khang lta bu phyi'i rtags thon tsam yod pa de gas chog shes pa'i bzo 'dra po bya sa na yag po yod pa ma red/de nas skam dang / gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags la 'tshe ba byed mi rung / nga rang tsho'i bod la de snga nas goms gshis bzang po ri rgya klung rgya bsdems rgyu'i mig tos yag po yod pa 'di dngos gnas rang chos dang mthun pa red la/ khor yug gi gnas stangs thog la yin na'ang gal chen po yin pa'i skor kha sang tshogs 'du'i sa la bka' mol byung / dus rgyun ldan nas khor yug gi thog la do snang byed dgos/ de dang 'brel nas skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags la 'tshe ba mi byed pa so sos nyams len byed pa dang chabs cigang rang tsho nang pa'i yul sde tsho'i nang la de sngon sa mtshams khag la dmar mchod 357

'bul srol yong gi 'dug pa de tsho deng skabs ha cang nyung du phyin par rjes su yi rangs yod/ da dung yang de 'dra gal srid yod pa yin na nga rang tsho nang pa'i yul sde'i nang la dmar mchod 'bul ba'i rigs 'di rtsa ba nas byed rgyu yod pa ma red/de dang mtshungs pa'i sa khul yas mas kyi yul lha gzhi bdag tsho la yin na'ang da res go skabs 'di'i jog nas ngas 'tshams 'dri dang / smon lam rgyag 'dod byung / yul lha gzhi bdag tshos sa gnas so so'i yul pa tsho la phan thogs byed thub pa gang yod byed kyi yin na dngos gnas yag po yong gi red/lha klu gzhi bdag tsho yang gang ltar las dang nyon mongs kyi gzhan dbang ca na nga rang tsho 'khor ba pa gcig pa yin pa dang / nga rang tsho tshang ma sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa'ang gcig mtshungs yin/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni rang rang gi sems rgyud dul ma dul gyi las dge sdig bsags pa'i jog nas yong gi yod par brten so so'i las kyi dbang gis gang ltar gzugs med kyi sprul pa bzung nas yod pa'i skabs 'dir ga tshad thub thub kyi phan sems bskyed pa'i thog nas yul tsho la phan thogs byed dgos/ de min mi mang la thub tshod byas pa yin na dam tshig dang 'gal 'gro gi red/ nga rang tsho lha mi kun spyod gcig yin pa ltar/ gzugs can mi la cha bzhag na'ang spyi sems kyi khur 'khyer te phan thogs byed mkhan gyi 'go khrid cig byung ba yin na de la mi tshang mas dga' po byed pa dang / mi la brdabs gsigs dang / sgog rngan bzas pa sogs byed mkhan byung pa yin na spyir btang mi'i nang la sdug 358

pa zhig la brtsi ba ltar/ khyed rang tsho lha klu gzhi bdag tshos kyang lkog rngan za rgyu'i don du yas yas byed dgos/ mas mas byed dgos zhes tam pa bshad nas zas pa yin na so sos las ngan bsags pa'i rnam smin ngan pa sku/nga rgyur de sprudra byed rgyu med/ khyed rang tshos dngos gnas spyi la phan pa'i sems bskyed yag po byas na da lta rten gzugs med yin kyang rim pas rim pas khyed tsho'i rgyud la khams bde gshegs snying po yod pas/ mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub kyi rgyu ma tshang ba min/ tshang mas yul sde so so'i nang la dge ba bsgrub mkhan zhig dang / dge ba skyong mkhan zhig byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ ces bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs pa dge slong theb chags gcig gis khyed rang tsho la re 'dun dang / 'bod bskul byed kyi yod pa 'di blo la bcangs nas hur thag gyis/ ngas smon lam rgyag gi yin/de dang phyogs mtshungs yul mi tsho'i ngos nas yin na yang yul lha gzhi bdag tshor skyabs su 'dzin chog gi ma red/ de yang / rang nyid 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi/ 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyabs par nus/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yul lha gzhi bdag 'di tsho'i gras da lta ngas bshad ma thag pa/ bzhin/ kho rang tsho nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba nga rang tsho dang gcig pa yin stab sa de la khyed rang tshos yul lha gzhi bdag gis 'phral sel phan gnod phran bu yong gi yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te skyabs su mchi nas de la glo snying brang gsum gtad na/ rang rgyud kyi skyabs 'gro stong nas nang pa min pa chags kyi red/ des na khyed rang tshos 'phral sel yul srol gyi dus mchod 359

skabs yul lha gsol mchod byed pa 'grigs pa red/ ma chog pa gang yang min/ de min gyi dus rgyun ldan nas yul lha de mkhyen zhes bsam blo btang ba yin na nang pa'i gral nas bud kyi red/ de byas mi chog pa red/ nga rang tsho nang pas ston pa mnyam med rnam 'dren shākya seng ge la glo snying brang gsu/ma gtad nas skyabs su mchi dgos pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i chos dkon mchos la 7skyabs su mchi dgos/ de dang 'brel ba'i dge 'dun dkon mchog sde 7skyabs su mchi dgos pa ma gtogs/ gzhan su gcig la 7skyabs 'gro byas na nor ba red/ nga rang tsho dngos gnas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brangs rnam par dag pa'i mi bzang po zhig byas na mi tshe ga tshod ring po bsdang pa de'i tshod kyis mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig yong nges yin/ mi tshe'i ring sdig pa bsags mkhan zhig byas pa yin na tshe thung ba yag gi red/ nga rang tsho mi tshe bzang po zhig bskyel rgyu de gzhi mar bzhag pa'i thog nas da ring tshe dbang zhu rgyu yin bsam pa dang / de yang mtha' yas pa'i nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ched du bla med rdzogs byang gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i ched du dbang dang byin rlabs zhu gi yin bsam dgos pa red/ ces bka' stsal rjes dngos gzhi tshe dbang gi rim pa rnams bka' drin bskyangs// //360

༄tsho// phyi lo 1996 zla 12 tshes 20 nyin/ sa lu sgar du ser skya mang cho gas la stsal ba'i bka' slob/nga 'dir slebs ma thag sa gnas 'dir 'gro song ga tshod phyin yod med skad cha dris te 'gro song 'di tsam btang ba rnams rjes su bed spyod yod pa zhig byung na sdig po red lab pa yin/ 'dir rjes su slob sbyong byed sa zhig bzo rtsis yod zer gyi 'dug de ni ha cang yag po red/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog slob sbyong mtha' med pa'i yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang dngos po yar rgyas gcig pus 'grigs kyi med pa deng sang 'dzam gling nang gsal po mthong gi 'dug bod dang 'brel ba yod pa'i hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i goms gshis kyi bsam sdu'i 'khyer so zhig yod pa red/ lung pa mang po'i gnas tshul mthong ba'i tshe nga rang tshor de snga nas goms gshis bzang po yod pa 'di dag rin thang chen po yin pa gzhi nas gsal po mthong yong gi 'dug 'dzam gling nang rigs gcig gis bod pa'i thog la do snang byas te bod pa tsho dka' ngal de 'dra zhig gi 'og la bsdad yod na'ang bsam blo'i nang zhi bde dang / bzod bsran chen po yod pa/ bsam slo nang dngangs skrag dang / rang dbang brlag pa lta bu min pa/ mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces mang pos shod kyi r+shadug dper na/ bar skabs tshan rig pa de 'dra dang mnyam du tshogs 'du mang po 'tshogs pa red de'i zhor 'phros la skad cha shod skabs/ dka' ngal mang po myangs pa'i mi spyir btang phal mo che bsam blor skyon shor gyi yod pa red/ bod pa'i shes yon can mang che ba 361

lnga bcu nga grangs nas bzung brdung brdegs phog nas btson nang lo mang po go myong ba dang / mang che ba btson nang 'das grongs phyin pa red/ lhag lus tshos dka' ngal mang po zhig myangs yod kyang / bsam blo'i nang re thag chod nas bsam blo rnal du mi gnas pa nyung shas yod na las/ mang che ba de 'dra mi 'dug spyir btang dka' ngal chen po myangs pa'i mi de gras bsam blo grung po dang / bsam blo nan po gtong thub mkhan dkon po red zer gyi 'dug nga rang tshor pha mes nas yod pa'i goms gshis bzang po 'di dag mi che'i nang la phan thogs yod pa dang / gnad 'gag yod pa zhig tan tan chags kyi 'dugang tsho bod pa rnams skyes pa'i skabs la klad pa dang / bsam blo mi 'dra ba gang yang med pa mi gzhan dag dang gcig gyur yin na yang / mi 'dra ba zhig yong ba de rig gzhung goms gshis kyi thog nas byung ba red/ 'dzam gling nang dngos po yar rgyas mu mthud 'gro gi red/ dngos po yar rgyas phyin pa dang chabs cig dka' ngal gsar pa thon yong ba der gdong len bya rgyu'i thabs shes gcig nga rang tshor de snga nas yod pa'i goms gshis bzang po 'di dag srung skyob bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug 'dis nga byed ngad pa tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling sgog lam ston byed thub pa'i dge mtshan rten tan yod) pa red/ bod la theg pa chen wa'i chos gzhan gces 'dzin gyi bslab bya bzang po yod pa 'di dag shin tu rtsa ba chen po yin/ bod dang 'brel ba yod pa'i hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur yin pa de rnams rgya gar rang dbang lung pa'i nang bsdad yod pa dang / de bzhin 'brug dang / bal yul nang la yang rang dbang byas 362

nas bsdadayod pa red/ de rnams nas rang gi pha mes dus nas yod pa'i goms gshis bzang po'i nor bu zhig so so'i lag par yod pa de ngos zin nas bdag po rgyag dgos/ gnad don de dag gi don du slob sbyong sprod rgyu gal chen po red/ dgon pa'i nang la chos kyi slob sbyong sprod rgyu gal chen po yin na yang /mang phyogs nang slob sbyong med pa yin na rim pas ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu lta bur rim pas rdzogs 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/ mi rabs gsar pa rnams chos la do snang yod mkhan zhig bzo dgos byung na/ khyim tshang re re'i nang la chos kyi tshor ba yod dgos/ de byung na khyim tshang de'i nang 'tshar longs bya mkhan phru gu tshor rang bzhin gyis nang chos kyi tshor ba slebs kyi red/ slob gra'i nang dang / mang tshogs nang tshang mar chos kyi gnas lugs shes pa bzo rgyu de gal chen po 'dug dus dus su bka' chos kyi skabs bshad pa de gcig pus 'grigs kyi ma red/ slob gra'i nang slob sbyong sprod rgyu de gal chen po 'duganang chos dang 'brel ba yod pa'i slob tshan 'khrid skabs bod yig gi gnad don rtogs thub pa dang / bed spyod byed thub pa dgos kyi 'dug skad kyi sgra gdangs 'dra min dang / bri stangs phran bu 'dra min yong gi yod kyang / nub la dgas nas shar dar rtse mdo bar yi ge gcig red/ de bzhin lha ma la'i ri rgyud la cha bzhag na shar4 ru na cal nas/ nub la dwags bar sa khul de tshor bod yig gcig gyur ma gtogs yi ge mi 'dra ba med/ yul skad so so'i nang nas chos cha tshang shes pa dang / rtogs thub pa zhig bya dgos byung na/ 'brug pa'i skad kyi nang bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur cha tshang gcig bzo dgos pa dang / mon 363

pa'i skad nang cha tshang bzo dgos pa/ de bzhin la dwags/ ga sha/ spi nyi/ 'bras ljongs sogs tshang mar bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur cha tshang re bzo dgos pa byung na lo brgya phrag 'gor bas ma zad/ khungs dag yong rgyu shin tu khag po yin/de ni las ka med pa'i las ka red/ sngar thon mi sam bho ṭas gtan la phab ste dus da lta bar bed spyod byed bzhin pa 'dir ming gang btags kyang khyad par mi 'dug gang ltar yi ge 'di slob sbyong byas nas shes thub pa zhig byung na brgya go gcig chod kyi khe phan chen po yod/ nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas lo so bdun lhag tsam phyin pa red/ de'i ring hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul de rnams nas nang chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung la do snang byed dgos pa dang / de'i rtsa ba bod yig shes dgos pa de mthong nas bar skabs sa khul mang po zhig nang slob gra yod dang yod bzhin pa'i nang bod yig slob rgyu'i 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa khul mang por nang chos slob rgyu'i 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa red/ de rnams bsngags par 'os pa dang / rjes su yi rangs yod/da cha sa gnas 'dir dus 'khor dbang chen la dmigs nas sa cha dang /khang pa gang tsam zhig la 'gro song btang ba 'di dag bed med la bsdad na chud zos red/ da lta sa bon gyi gzhi rtsa zhig yod pa 'di ga'i thog nas slob sbyong byed rgyu'i 'go btsugs/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i mtshams rim pas rgya bskyed thub pa byung na yag po yong gi red/ da lta khyod rang tshos bsam blo btang nas 'char gzhi bting ba de yag po byung 'dug rjes su yi rangs yod/ nga tsho btsan 364

byol ba byas nas bsdad yod na yang ma 'ongs par nga tshos rogs ram rgyab skyor gang byed thub pa rnams dga' zhing spro bzhin du zhu gi red/ ma 'ongs par gzhis byes gnyis mnyam 'dzoms skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i rjes la'ang sa gnas 'dir rna thos la nas ka sbug dang / 'bras ljongs sogs brgyud/ lha sa dang 'grims 'grul byed bde'i lam chen lta bu 'khel bar brten sa lu sgar sa cha 'di dbyar dus tsha ba che tsam yod kyang / ma 'ongs par 'dir slob sbyong gi bsti gnas yag po zhig bzo thub na phan thogs chen po yong rgyu dang / gcig byas na bod pa'i phru gu la yang 'dir slob sbyong sprod thub pa yong srid pa red/ 'di sa cha'i babs dang / grong tsho'i mthun rkyen cha nas phal cher yag po yong thub kyi red/da lta a gsar lta bu byas/ gang 'tshams nas yal 'gro ba de 'dra ma yin par 'brelayod tshang mas thugs khur bskyed dgos/ nyi chos bzang po'i nor bu'i 'od je chung du 'gro ba de 'dra min par khyed tshos las ka 'di mjug bskyel thub na yag po red/ thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' stsal// //(skabs 'dir dol rgyal sgor bka' slob stsal ba bka' slob 'di gras byings khongs su phyogs bsdebs zhus/)365

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1997 zla 2 tshes 19 nyin/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi zhi ba'i gom bgrod par stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring khyed rang tsho thug pa ha cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che/ tshang mas bod spyi pa'i don dag la bsam blo btang ste/ dka' las rgyab pa red/ zhi bde'i gom bgrod zer dus 'tshe ba med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang / bsgrub bya de yang snying rje rtsa ba la yod mkhan gyi chos dang / rig gzhung de 'dra zhig rtsa brlag tu 'gro ba'i dus tshod cig la slebs/ de 'dra'i rig gzhung ldan pa'i mi rigs shig srung skyob byed rgyu'i don dag dang / mi rigs de la rang dbang thob pa'i don dag la khyed rang tshos zhi ba'i gom bgrod kyis 'tshe med zhi ba'i thabs lam zhig bsten pa red/ mdor na bsgrub bya'i ngos nas bshad pa yin na'ang chos dang 'brel ba zhig chags bsdad yod/ sgrub byed thabs lam ngos nas bshad pa yin na yang chos dang 'brel ba zhig chags pa red/ khyed rang tshang mar thugs rje che zer gyi yin/nga nang pa'i chos pa zhig dang / ston pa bka' drin can gyi rjes 'brangs dge slong zhig gi ngos nas khyed rang tshos bya ba bzang po sgrub pa der rjes su yi rangs yod/ bsngo ba yod/ thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ de nas nga bod pa zhig yin pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi 'gan yod mkhan tā la'i bla maX/ ming zhig thogs yod/ de'i ngos nas bshad pa yin na/ bod pa rnams ni so so'i rang don rang gces kyi dka' las rgyab pa red/ yag po red/ de nga rang choge gad spyi bo gnam bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i las 'gan 366

red/ khyed rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas yong ba rnams khyab khongs rgya gar khongs gtogasayinanayang lo stong phrag ring la bod dang / chos dang rig gzhung thog nas 'brel ba chen po yod pa'i don dag cig dang / gnyis nas rgya gar gyi khe phan la cha bzhag rung sngar bod du rgya dmag ma slebs bar rgya gar byang rgyud hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud de rnams dngos gnas drang gnas kyi zhi bde'i sa mtshams red/ phar phyin rung rang dbang red/ tshur yong rung rang dbang red/ nyen kha gang yang med/ rgya gar ngos nas dwogs zon byed dgos pa gang yang med/ 'on kyang bod rgya nag gis dbang bsgyur/ bod kyi lung pa'i nang la rgya dmag 21na chen po zhig slebs tshar ba'i rjes su sa mtshams de rnams rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor dka' ngal la tos pa med par srung dgos pa zhig dang /de ga nang bzhin hi ma la ya'i sa mtho'i ri rgyud de rnams su rgya thang nas yong ba'i rgya gar gyi dmag mi sdod pa la dngos gnas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi rkyenaskudang rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa'i gnas stangs 'og nas dka' las rgyab ste sdod dgos pa chags pa red/ da dung hi ma la ya'i byang ngos su rdul phran gyi mtshon cha yod pa'i skad cha shod kyi yod/ sngar yin na bod yul dngos gnas drang gnas kyi zhi bde/ khor yug gtsang ma/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas 'bab pa'i chu zhig yin na yang chu bzang po yod/ chu mo gang ga'i chus sdig pa dang / sgrib pa sbyang thub kyi yod med mi shes te/ gang ltar dngos gnas drang gnas chu gtsang ma red/ ga le ga ler bod kyi sa cha la rdul phran gyi snyigs ro sbas pa lta bu dang /de ga nang bzhin bkod gra 'dra mi 'dra mang du phyin payin na mthar thug rim bzhin 367

hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas yong ba'i chu rgyun rnams btsog pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus khyed rang tsho hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul mi mang rnams nas phyogs gcig nas dngos gnas rang bod dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung thog nas 'brel ba yod pa'i lar rgya/ dam tshigade bzhin rgya gar gyi khe phan gnas stangs la mtshon na yang rgya gar gyi bde 'jags/ rgya gar gyi srung skyob don gnad dang 'brel ba yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas khyed rang tsho snga mo nas bod pa'i don la sems khur chen po blangs yod/ da lta'i gnas skabs yang khyed rang chos zla ba gnyis tsam ring gom bgrod byas/sems kyi nang la na tsha dang / sems khur blangs/ lhag bsam gyis phan pa'i ched du'abad brtson byas pa red/ shin tu dga' po byung / thugs rje che zer gyi yin/hi ma laya'i ri rgyud gang sar nga slebs myong / dngos gnas drang gnas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi mi mang de rnams dad pa dam tshig ha las pa red/ ha cang yag po red/ nga rang gi ngos nas cha bzhag na spyir nga rang nang pa'i chos byed mkhan zhig dang / yang sgos theg pa chen po'i chos nyams len byed mkhan zhig gis sems can thams cad bsam pa ma gtogs/ dbye ba phye thabs med/yang sgos lhag par can du hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi mi mang rnams nga rang gi ngos nas bod pa gcig gyur yin pa'i 'du shes bzhag gi yod/ nga tsho chos dang rig gzhung gcig pa red/ khyed rang tshor nga'i ngos nas phan thogs gang byed rgyu yod pa rnams nga ma shi bar du bsam pa rnam dag gis phan thogs sgrub bsam 368

pa zhig rtag tu sems la bcangs ste bsdad yod/nga rang tsho'i las 'gul 'di da lta zhus pa bzhin/ bsgrub bya snying rje rtsa bar gyur pa'i 'tshe ba med pa'i lta ba dang / spyod pa bzang po 'di 'dra zhig deng sang nyams dmas rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha slebs pa 'di nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i don dag la las ka byas pa red/ bod nang gi gnas tshul da lta 'gyur ba 'gro gi med na yang / 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i re ba chen po yod pa red/ rgya nag nang la 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red/ bod nang gi gnas tshul snga phyi zhig ma garke(gas/ gcig byas na lo gcig gnyis nang la 'gyur ba 'gro srid pa red/ gcig byas na lo kha shas 'gor srid pa red/ gang ltar da lta nga tsho dka' ngal sel med pa yin dus khyed rang tshos kyang las 'gul mu mthud de byed dgos pa chags bsdad yod/ khyed rang chos da lta nang bzhin sems shugs skyed rogs zer rgyu yin/ da res 'gro sa'i lam phyogs yag po byung ba red/ lo sngas mar skabs dang dus kyi gnam gshis dang bstun mu mthud de byed thub pa byung na yag po red/ gom bgrod byed pa'i skabs sus mi ri ku'i rlung 'phrin khag gnyis po'i jog nas khyed rang sto phar tshur dri ba dris lan byed kyi yod pa ngas rtag par go gi 'dug sa gnas mang po zhig 'grims te 'gro skabs rgya gar ba ha cang mang po zhig la rang shugs kyis 'brel ba dang / khyab bsgrags yong thub pa dang / rgya gar gyi mi mang mang po zhig gi bsam blo'i nang du bod don la do snang dang / bod par sha tsha slebs pa zhig byung ba de phan thogs chen po red/ rgya gar mi mang gis bod pa'i gnas tshul 369

mang tsam shes pa'i rkyen gyis lam seng 'gyur ba 'gro gi red zer ba min na yang rim pas rim pas shugs rkyen thebs thub pa zhig yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus gom bgrod kyi las 'gul 'di lta bu mu mthud de byed dgos pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ khyed rang tshos byed kyi red la/ khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed rogs zer rgyu yin/ shes song ngam/da ring 'dir nga sto thug pa'i zhor red/ bod pa'i gnas tshul da lta bshad ma thag pa bzhin bod nang gi gnas tshul drag tu gang yang 'gro gi med/ rgya mi'i ngos nas gdug rtsub che thag chod kyi mur bsdad yod/ yin na yang dper na/ bar skabs rgya mi'i dpon rigs shig gi gtam bshad skad cha'i zhor 'phros su/ deng sang bod kyi nang lha khang khag tu bod mi 'gro mkhan tshor bkag sdom byed pa de tsho phran bu thal drags pa red/ bod pa tsho la cha bzhag na krung go'i mi mang gcig gyur red/ dad pa yod mkhan tsho dgon pa'i nang la 'gro ba dang /smon lam rgyag rgyu de tsho'i gras thob thang yod dgos bshad 'dug de tsho'i gras kyis gang ltar rtags shig bstan gyi yod/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gis bod don thog la srid byus 'dzin stangs 'di bzhin thal drags pa'i dogs pa dang / bsam blo zhig 'khor gyi yod pa red/ gang ltar bod gcig bu'i gnas tshul ma yin par/ hong kong gi gnas tshul dang / the wan gyi gnas tshul tshang mar rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus mkhregs po 'dzin pa 'dir da lta'i rgya nag dpon rigs mtho rim tshang ma'i bsam pa gcig gyur dang / gcig mthun zhig phal cher med pa'i bzo 'dra po mthongagi 'dug dngos yod gnas tshul la da lta'i rgya mi'i byed 370

stangs 'di phugs rgyang ring po'i cha nas rtsis pa yin na rgya mi rang nyid la gnod pa'i las ka zhig red/ 'dzam bu gling phyi la cha bzhag na'ang rgya mi'i ming shas yong rgyu'i las ka zhig red/ sa khul de dang de'i sgang la rtsis pa yin na yang gang ltar bod pa yin yang rung / shing cang yin yang rung / bsam blo'i nang la na tsha che ru 'gro gzhi zhig chags kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ des rgya bod kyi mthun bsgril legs su 'gro rgyu dang / shing cang gi mi dang / rgya mi'i dbar mthun bsgril yag tu 'gro rgyur phan gyi yod pa ma red/ de ha cang gsal po red/ ji tsam gyi gdug rtsub srid byus 'dzin pa de'i tshod kyis gdug rtsub myong mkhan gyi mi rnams kyi sems nang la 'khon 'dzin dang / ma dga' ba che ru 'gro rgyu las/ phan thogs med pa ha cang gsal po yin/ bod nang la deng sang srid byus lag len bkal yod pa de dag de snga phan chad byed ma myong ba ma yin par/ thengs cha/nga po byed myong yod pa red/ yin na yang de rnams kyi lag rjes gang bzhag yod dam/ 'bras bu gang byung yod dam/ zer na/ de snga sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyis gral rim mtha' skyo tshor thob thang yod lugs zer skabs don ngo ma'i thog la phyags rgyang ring por gnas yod med mi shes kyang /'phral sel gyi 'gyur ba zhig yong dus dbul phongs 〉 ༄6) rigs kha shas bcos sgyur la dga' po byed mkhan byung yod na yang / da cha rgya mi rang nyid kyi srid byes gdug rtsub che drags te thog mar sems la gsar brje yag po red/ rgya mi gung khran tang yong ba yag po byung bsam mkhan nyung shas yod pa de tsho yang med pa chags/ rgya mi kho rang cho'i byed stangs thog nas rgya mir phran bu'i sha 371

tsha yod mkhan de tshos kyang sha tsha brlag 'gro ba zhig byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus da lta'i rgya mi'i srid byus 'di gnas skabs tsam las rtsa ba nas rgya mi rang nyid kyi khe phan thog la bsam blo btang ba yin na yang gnas thabs med pa ha cang gsal po red/ 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dugad lta ngas dbu ma'i lam zer ba de dag mu mthud nas de ga rang gi thog la u tshugs rgyab ste bsdad yod/ nga tsho'i srid byus 'dzin stangs kyi gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig yin/ 'di don tshan gcig byas/ngas dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'di che sa zhig nas bsam blo gtong dus 'dzam bu gling 'dir so so'i rgyal khab zer ba dang / so so'i mi rigs zer ba de deng sang de tsam gyi gal chen po chags kyi med/ gang gal chen po red zer na/ mi sde'i spyi tshogs de dang / de la khe phan mang shos thob dgos pa de rtsa ba yin/ dper na/ yu rob nang la cha bzhag na rgyal khab tha dad dang / skad yig tha dad/ lo rgyus mi 'dra ba yod pa/ de snga so so'i rang dbang dang / rang btsan/ so so'i rgyal khab rtsa cher 'dzin te dmag 'khrug mang po rgyag myong mkhan gyi rgyal khab de tsho'i gras kyang deng sang spyi pa'i khe phan don du bsam blo gtong dgos pa chags yod/ dper na/ pha ran si dang / 'jar man gnyis la cha bzhag na/ sngar dmag 'khrug mang po rgyag myong yod na yang / deng sang gi dngos yod gnas tshul la gang ltar yu rob yar rgyas gtong rgyur sems khur gcig pa yod pa'i bsam blo'i 'og nas 'gro ba ma gtogs/ pha ran si dang /'jar man gnyis snga mo nas dmag 'khrug mang po rgyag myong yod pa de dag dus 372

namasang ma brjed par/ pha ran si'i phyogs nas rang gi khe phan la brtsi srung dang / 'jar man gyi khe phan blos gtong rgyu/ 'jar man ngos nas rang nyid kyi khe phan ma gtogs/ pha ran si'i khe phan blos gtong rgyu'i bsam blo gtong giyod pa ma red/ 'jar man yar rgyas ma phyin na pha ran sir gnod pa dang /pha ran si yar rgyas ma phyin na 'jar man la gnod kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og nas lo rgyus so sor yod pa/ rang btsan rgyal khab tha dad yin na yang thun mong gi khe phan de dza drag dang / gal che ba chags yong dus mnyam sbrel byed kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin du nga rang tsho e sha ya'i lung pa'i nang la cha bzhag na bod bod red/ rgya rgya red/ rgya gar rgya gar red de/yin na yang thun mong gi khe phan de deng sang shin tu 'dres nas bsdad yod/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og nas bod lung par mtshon na rgya mtsho dang 'brel ba'i mtsho lam med mkhan/ sa cha khug kyog dngos po yar rgyas ma phyin pa/rang byung gi thon khungs chen po yod pa'i lung pa zhig yin dus gcig byas na nga tsho rgya mi dang mnyam du zla bsgril te bsdad pa yin na/ nga tshor khe phan che ba yong mi srid pa ma red/ ngas bsam blo 'di 'dra zhig btang ste gang ltar rgya dang / bod kyi rnyog dra de thun mong la khe phan yod pa zhig dang / thun stong gi mos mthun yod pa'i thog nas sel thub thabs kyi re ba de ltar byed kyi yod/nga rang tsho hi ma la ya'i grogs po tsho yin na yang / bod kyi bden pa'i bden rgyab gnang mkhan tsho'i ngos nas bod kyi lo rgyus rang btsan yin pa/ chos dang rig gzhung thog nas kyang rgya nag dang tha dad yin pa de dag gsal po bzo 373
