rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ nga'i ngos nas bod kyi lo rgyus thog nas rang btsan red/ yin na yang 'das pa 'das pa red/ ma 'ongs pa gal chen po yin dus rgya bod gnyis mos kyi thabs lam 'og nas nga tsho thabs shes shig byas na bsam nas ngas dbu ma'i lam de'i sgang la 'gro gi yod/ ngas bod rang btsan ma red zer gyi med/ bod rang btsan yin yin pa red/ lo rgyus thog la shin tu gsal po yod/ lo rgyus thog la rang btsan yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas te nges par du ma 'ongs par rang btsan dgos kyi yod ces u tshugs rgyag gi med/rgya'i ngos nas bsam blo lhug lhug cig btang ba yin na nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang bsam zhib lhug po gtong gi yin zer gyi yod/ nga tsho'i ngos nas rgya bod gnyis mos kyi skad cha byed kyi yin zer gyi yod stabs skad cha bya rgyu'i go skabs dang /thob thang zhig nga tshor tan tan yod/ rgya mi thog mar bod la yong ba'i skabs su/ lo rgyus thog nas bod rgya khongs red/ bod bshu gzhog gral rim rjes lus yin tsang bcings bkrol gtong bar yong ba yin zer bshad yod/ shing cang zer ba shar tur ki si than dang / sog po bcas/ gang ltar sa khul gang du yin na'ang bcings bkrol zer ba'i ming tshig de'i 'og nas rgya mi'i dmag mi rnams yong ba red/ bod la yin na yang bcings bkrol zer ba'i ming tshig de gcig gyur byas te yong ba red/ yin na yang bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i cha nas bod rgya'i dbar don tshan bcu bdun zer ba'i yig cha zhig bzhag dgos pa byung ba red/ rgya mi'i dmag shing cang nang bskyod pa'i skabs la gros mthun bzhag med/ rgya mi'i dmag mi nang 374

sog la phyin pa'i skabs la gros mthun bzhag med/ bod kyi sa khongs 'bri chu shar brgyud du rgya dmag yong skabs dang / a mdo sa khul du rgya dmag yong skabs gros mthun gyi skad cha byung med/ 'bri chu nub brgyud bod kyi sa khul du rgya dmag yong skabs gros mthun zer ba de bzhag dgos pa byung yod/ gang yin zer na/ 'bri chu nub brgyud kyi sa khul de rnams dga' ldan pho brang gi khyab khongs su yod pa tsam dum zad/ rgyal khab kyi ngo bo mtshon pa'i so so'i dngul ṭam dang / dngul lor sogs yod pa red/ gang ltar rgyal khab tha dad cig yin pa'i gnas tshul gsal po yod pa yin dus rgyu mtshan de'i 'og nas bcings bkrol dmag mi 1951 lor chab mdo bar slebs rjes/ mtha' ma lnga bcu nga gcig gi zla ba lnga pa'i nang gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zer ba de bzhag yod/ de gnyis mos thog nas bzhag pa ma yin par/ rgya mi'i btsan dbang 'og nas bzhag pa yin na yang / gang ltar gros mthun zer ba zhig bzhag ste/ de 'dra zhig gi 'og nas bod zhi ba'i bcings bkrol btang ba yin zer bshad pa red la/ shod rgyu yang 'khel ba red/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dngos yod gnas tshul thog nas rgya mis gros mthun 'di 'dra zhig ma bzhag rang bzhag chags te/ gros mthun bzhag nas bod zhi ba'i bcings bkrolabatang ba yin zer gyi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs pa la yang nga tsho sku/da zer ba las sla po zhig min pas/ gang ltar rgya dang bod gnyis phan tshun skad cha bshad de/ bod pa'i blo ngor gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'jog bzo yod pa'i gnas tshul 'og nas nga tsho'i dka' ngal sel dgos pa ma gtogs/ bod pa'i bsam tshul sdug grong 375

btang ste/ rgya mi'i 'dod dbang kho na'i thog nas thag gcod thub thabs med pa zhig lo rgyus dang / dngos yod gnas tshul steng nas gsal po chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra yin dus nga tsho'i grogs po khyed rang tshos bod kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i bden pa'i gnas tshul skor/ dper na rgya gar gyi nang srid blon chen sa rdar spa ṭal gyis bod la rgya mi thog mar yong skabs khong gi bsam tshul gang 'dra byung yod pa dang / rgyal rabs lo rgyus thoganas 'dod tshul dang bsam tshul gang 'dra yod pa/ ngos 'dzin ga 'dra byed kyi yod pa de tsho'i gras rgya gar nang la gsal po bzo rgyu dang gcig gnyis nas bod pa'i gnas tshul 'grel bshad rgyag skabs de bas kyang gsal po bzo rgyu gal chen po 'dug yu rob nang dang / a mi ri ma'i nang la bod par rgyab skyor byed mkhan tshor shod kyi yod/ nga'i ngos nas dbu ma'i lam la 'gro gi yod/ yin na yang nga tshor rgyab skyor byed mkhan tshos bod kyi lo rgyus thog la gnas stangs gang 'dra yin min gsal po bzo rgyu gal chen po 'dug ji tsam gyi gas la po byung ba'i tshod kyi ngas rgya bod mnyam du gnyis mos kyi skad cha shod rgyu 'di dag nus shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/ bod rgya nag gis gang du bzhag bzhag cig yin na/ skad cha shod shugs med pa chags kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus hi ma la ya'i grogs po tshos mu mthud de bod kyi lo rgyus thog gnas stangs ji yin gsal po bzo dgos kyi 'dugadon tshan gnyis pa/ rang thag rang gcod zer ba de/ lo rgyus thog nas bod rang dbang bod rang btsan red/ deng sang 'dzam gling yongs grags 376

kyi sa khul gang du yin na'ang rang thag rang gcod kyi skad cha shod kyi yod/ bod kyi thog la chos dang / rig gzhung gi ngo rwa1 'am/ rnam pa rang bzhin gyi zur gsal mi 'dra ba zhig yo/ pa dang / de yang chos dang rig gzhung mi 'dra ba yod mkhan gyi mi rigs 'dus sdod yod sa'i sa cha zhig la rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang yod pa dang / thob thang de yang tan tan dgos kyi yod pa zhig deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bshad dang shod bzhin pa red/ 'dzam gling gi khrims don mkhas pa mang po zhig gis gcig gyur thog nas bod la rang thag rang gcad kyi thob thang nges par du yod dgos kyi 'dug ces shod kyi yod/ skad cha de yang gleng slong byed dgos pa zhig red/ lo rgyus thog nas gcig bshad/de ga nang bzhin rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lung pa gang du yin na yang yong gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang skor shod dgos pa byung na ka shi smir la rnyog dra phran bu yod pas/khyed rang tsho sbi gsang byed dgos/ spyi yongs thog nas rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang rtsod dgos pa yin/ de la yang gnad 'gag cig 'dug gang ltar deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang du kun la grags bzhinapa'i rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang zer ba 'di'i thog la phyin pa yin na bod rigs sa ya drug yongs su rdzogs par khyab thub kyi yod pa red/ dngos yod gnas tshul la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lo rgyus zer ba gcig byas na gal chen po dang /gcig byas na de tsam gal chen po ma red/ gang gal chen po red zer na/ da lta dngos yod gnas tshul la mi'i 'dod pa dang / mi'i re 'dun gal che shos 377

red/ de'i thog nas bshad yong dus rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang shugs chen po zhig slebs yong gi 'dug nga tsho bod la spyi yongs cha nas lo rgyus kyi rgyu mtshan bgrangs rgyu yod cing / lhag par du deng sang 'tham bu gling 'di'i sgang la gal chen por brtsi zhing / 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa'i rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang de gnyis thog nas bod pa'i gnas tshul rtsod len bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de tsho grogs po tsho'i sems la bcangs dgos/zhi ba'i gom bgrod byed dus kha seng 'go stod kha shas la ngas lab rgyu byung / zhi ba'i gom bgrod byed mkhan tshos bod rang dbang zer ba gcig pu bshad pa min par/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa de dag mahā rda ma lhan rdi'i bzhed dgongs yin pa dang / de ni 'dzam bu gling spyi la yang dgos mkho yod pa/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa mahā rda ma lhan rdis rgya gar nang nyams pa sor chud gnang yod pa ltar nga tshos shugs bskyed de lta bu'i 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa gong mthor spel rgyu nga tsho'i dmigs yul gtso bo yin cing / 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i gnad don dang 'brel ba'i thog nas bod kyi rang dbang 'thab rtsod grub 'bras thon pa dgos kyi 'dug de la rgyab skyorayang byed dgos kyi 'dug ces lab pa yin na yag po 'dug bod rang btsan zer ba'i skad cha gcig bu'i thog la phyin pa yin na gnas tshul 'di chung chung chags kyi 'dug 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa 'dzam bu gling yongs dang /mi thams cad la dgos pa zhig red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rang dbang 378

'thab rtsod byed mkhan lung pa dang / sa khul ha lam brgya phrag yod mdog kha po red/ de ltar yod pa'i nang la mtha' gcig tu 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam du 'gro mkhan bod pa ma gtogs med pa 'di rtsa ba'i lta spyod bzang po khyab spel gtong rgyu dang / de yang gsal po bzo rgyu/ dran gso gtong rgyu'i ched du yin lab pa yin na yag po mi 'dug gam/ ma 'ongs par khyed rang tsho bsam blo gtong dgos kyi med dam dran song / rgya gar mi mang la phran bu'i shugs nus che ba yong gi med dam snyam/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud kyi bod pa'i grogs po tshos 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta ba dang / spyod pa gong mthor spel rgyu'i dpe mtshon zhig gi skang nas bod pa'i don du rgyab skyor byas pa yin na 'tshe med zhi ba'i lta spyod gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i las ka chags kyi yod/ de lta'i gnad 'gag ma gzhi khyed rang tshos shes gsal red/zhor 'phros shig la/ de snga nga tsho rgya gar du slebs pa nas bzungs rgya dmar nag gnyis gral gcig la bzhag gnyis kur gdong len byas te bsdad yod/ bar skabs rgya nag wa'i lung pa'i nang la phyogs gcig nas mang gtso'i rang dbang che ba yong gi yod pa dang / da lta'i srid 'dzin lis tang hu'i khong rangaye shu'i chos pa zhig yin 'dug mang gtso'i lta ba dang / 'di 'dra'i thog la lhag bsam rnam dag yin pa'i cha nas da lta the'i bon nang la mang gtso'i 'gyur ba shugs chen po 'gro bzhin yod/ gtam brjod brgyud lam rang dbang yod pa zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ da lta bar du the'i bon gzhung gis rgya nag dmar po'i srid byus ltar bod rgya khongs yin zhes gcig gyur gyi srid byus zin 379

pa dang / bye brag tu the'i wan bod sog las khungs gatho rwa1ra gyur pa'i las khungs kha shas nas bod par 'brel ba byed 'dod yod kyang / nga tsho btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs tshad dang / mtshan nyid ldan pa 'di la thad thar 'brel ba byed ma thub pa dang / nga tshos kyang nga tsho'i gnad don zhig la brten nas 'brel ba byed kyi med/ phyi lo 1959 zla 4 pa'i nang nga 'bum sde lar slebs skabs cang ke shis nga la tar zhig btang 'byor byung / de'i nang go ming tang dang / bod pa mnyam nub jog nas gung khran la ngo sgol byed dgos zhes dang /bod la rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang yod pa ltar/ go ming tang rgya nag skam sa chen por slebs rjes thob thang de sprod kyi yin zhes bshad yod/ de dus nas nga tsho 'brel ba byung ba red/ skabs der nga tshos dmar po'i lta bar ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byed kyi med/ bod lung pa'i nang la rgya mi dmar pos tshad las brgal ba'i sdug sbyong dang / srid byus gdug rtsub byas pa der ngo skol byas pa red/ ngo rgol byed cha/khan nang la bod pa gung khran yang mang po yod/ go ming tang rgya mi gcig pa red/ skad yig rig gzhung gcig gyur yin na yang / khong tshos dmar po'i lta bar ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa'i cha nas khong tsho dgra zla chags pa red/ nga tsho bod pas gung khran la kha gtad gcog rgyu 'di bod pa'i thog la gung khran srid gzhung gi srid byus 'dzin stangs de dag rgyu mtshan med pa zhig dang / gdug rtsub che ba/ kho rang tsho dmar po'i lta ba dang yang 'gal zla yod pa'i srid byus 'dzin gyi yod pa de la nga tshos ngo skol byed kyi yod red/ bod mi gung khran mang po zhig gis kyang rgya nag gung khran srid gzhung gis srid 380

byus 'dzin stangs de maka se/ le nin ring lugs dang / lhag don le nin gyi mi rigs ring lugs dang ma mthun pa dang / de dang 'gal zla yang yong gi 'dug ces ngo rgol byed kyi yod/ nga tsho bod pa dang rgya mi gnyis mi rigs tha dad/ chos/ rig gzhung / skad yig goms gshis bcas tha dad red/the'iwan dang / rgya mi gnyis la mtshon na/ spyir btang so so'i yul skad phran bu mi 'dra ba yong gi red ma gtogs/ spyi yongs thog nas skad yig gcig gyur/ rgya mi'i rig gzhung gcig gyur/ mi rigs gcig gyur red/ nga tshos rgya mi gung khran la kha gtad gcog rgyu de dang / the'i wan nas rgya mi gung khran sde kha gtad gcog rgyu gnyis ngo bo mi 'dra ba red 'dug gam/ lnga bcu nga dgu'i lor go ming tang gis nga tshor tshur lag pa brkyangs yong dus nga tshos rang nyid kyi lta ba zhig 'dzin te bsdad pa red/ go ming tang gis bod pa'i nang la gang byung mang byung byed mkhan de tsho'i gras la lag pa brkyangs te/ dngul mang po gtong gi yod pa red/ dper na gzhan dag phar bzhag ka shi smir la yod pa'i lha sa'i kha che tsho'i nang la'ang go ming tang gis dngul gtong gi yod pa'i sgor deng sang go thos yong gi 'dug sa gnas gang sar go skabs 'tshol gyi 'dug de rnams rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / cha 'jog 'pher ba'i bya ba gang yang min/ da ngul gang byung mang byung du sprad de/ gang ltar so pa'i las ma'i bzo 'dra po/ dkrug shing rgyag rgyu'i bsam blo yod rung med rung / lag len gyi 'bras bu dkrug shing gi las ka chags kyi yod red/ bod pa go ming tang gi dngul za mkhan zhig yin na/ kho la bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang phran bu dogs pa 381

byed dgos pa 'dra po/ go ming tang gi phogs za mkhan red zer ba de rnams kyi khang pa yang legs pa yod pa 'dra po 'di 'dra yong gi 'dug bod mi 'ga' zhig gis dngul byung na de'i 'byung khungs la bsam blo ma btang ba desasgang khul la 'gal rkyen mang po yong gi 'dug da lta bar du go ming tang gi gnas stangs thog la bod gzhung gis 'dzin nas bsdad pa'i srid byus thog bod chol kha gsum gyi ser skya yongs su rdzogs pas de bzhin rig pa bsgrims te bsdad payin na da tshod gnas tshul mi 'dra ba zhig yong gi red de/ de ltar byung med/ mang po lta ma red/ nyung nyung red de/ ser mo ba'i nang nas bla ma sprul sku 'ga' zhig dang / skya bo'i nang nas kyang de de bzhin 'brel ba byed mkhan mu mthud de byung yod/ bar skabs phal cher lo bcu/ bco lnga tsam gyi sngon du nga chos the'i wan la 'brel ba byed stangs 'dis nus pa thon pa dang / ran pa zhin yong gi mi 'dug pas da cha nga tshos bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces skad cha byung / 'on kyang phar phyogs nas cha rkyen yag po zhig ma 'dzoms pas de mur bsdad pa red/ nye dus kyi 'gyur ba gatho rwag ze'i wan nang la mang gtso yag po zhig chags/ gtam brjod kyi rang dbang zhig slebs/ yis tang hu'i khong rang sgor gyi ngos nas bsam blo gtong stangs gu yangs po zhig chags yong dus nga tshos de gong nas bsam blo btang ba de dag sgrub rgyu'i thabs shes byed sayod pa'i bzo 'dra po chags yong gi 'dug lis tang hu'i srid 'dzin byas zin pa'i rjes la lis tangatwa'i la 'brel ba'i 'go btsugs te/ yig 'brel yang byung / 'brel ba byung ba'i nyer len gyis lis tang hu'i khong rang gis tā 382

la'i bla mas zhi bde'i don tshan lnga bar pa de rgyu mtshan ldan pa yang dag pa red/de la rgyab skyor gtsang ma yod ces khong gis 'dzam glingayongs grags thog gtam bshad byas yod/ bod rgya khongs yin zer mkhan gcig gyur gyi khongs nas tā la'i bla ma'i dbu ma'i lam la yongs grags rgyab skyor byas pa de la gnad 'gag cig 'dug de ltar 'gyur ba zhig phyin pa red/ de nas go ming tang srid gzhung rang gi ngos nas nga tsho bod gzhung dang 'brel ba g.yo sa la ngo kog med par tshad longs pa'i 'brel ba byed 'dod yod pa dang / the'i wan bod sog las khungs rang gi las ka byed mkhan tshos kyang re 'dun de bzhin yod pa'i bzo lta 'dug dper na/ kho rang tshos kha sangs te bshad don la/ the'i ldan bod sog las khungs nas nam rgyun bod pa the'i wan du yong mkhan tshang ma bod sog las khungs la yong gi yod pa dang / bod sog las khungs nas khong tshor rogs ram rgyab skyor byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang yong mkhan bla ma sprul sku de tsho'i gras 'ga' shas kyis the'i wan du slebs rjes dngul la do snang byed pa dang / spyod pa yang gang byung mang byung byed mkhan yong gi 'dug da cha the'i ldan la phebs mkhan gyi bla ma de tsho'i sgor bod btsan byol gzhung gi chos don las khungs nas bla ma tshad ldan de 'dra the'i wan du gtong thub pa byung na yag poyong ba 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug de bzhin bod sog las khungs nas rga pa'i slob phrug thog la dngul gyi rogs ram byed kyiyod kyang / rgya gar dang /sprulayul nas the'iwan du slob phrug yong mkhan rigs gcig slob sbyong mi byed mkhan/ spyod pa yang sdug chag de 'dra 'dug rogs ram bya rgyu'i dngul gyi 383

dmigs sgoyod pa de dag gtong yul bod pa'i slob phrug slob sbyong dngos gnas drang gnas hur thag byed mkhan dang / ma 'ongs par slob sbyong gi thog nas phan thogs yong thub mkhan gyi slob phrug byung ba yin na yag po yong ba 'dugadeyang bod btsan byol gzhung gi shes rig las khungs nas slob phrug bdams rgyusku1da pa zhig byung bayin na yag po yong ba 'dug ces bod sog las khungs nas shod kyi 'dug yo gnyis gsum gong nas 'gyur ba de 'dra byung bar brten/nga tha'i wan du 'gro 'char gyi skad cha zhig byung / mtha' ma the'i bon srid gzhung nas yongs grags byas te gtan 'bebs gtsang ma byas don du/ 7rgyal ba rin po che the'i wan du phebs pa yin na bod sog las khungs dang 'brel ba rtsa banas med par the'i ldan du yod pa'inang pa'i chos tshogs tsho'i thog nas 7rgyal ba rin po che gdan 'dren zhu rgyu dang / 7rgyal ba rin po che 7zhabs sor 'khod thub pa'i 'gan khur chos tshogs rang nas zhu rgyu yin zhes bshad pa red/ 'di nas mi btang ste zhib brtsad byed dus khong rang tsho'i kha nas bshad pa bzhin don dag ngo ma'i thog bod sog las khungs nas 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med par chos tshogs rang gi thog nas gdan zhu bya rgyu dang / 7zhabs sor 'khod pa'i skabs la bde 'jags kyis mtshon gang ci'i zhu sgo nang don srid gzhung rang nas 'gan khur gtsang ma len rgyu/ ma 'ongs par 'brel ba yag po yong thub pa'i re 'dun dang bsam tshul shugs chen po zhig the'i wan gyi srid gzhung rang gi nang la yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po 'dug da cha dus tshod smin pa min nam bsam gyi 'dug pas ngos rang the'i bon du 'gro rgyu'i rtsis gzhi byed kyi yod/ 'di skor 384

khyed rang tshor lab na bsam byung / da lta bar du bod gzhung gis rgya dmar nag gnyis la blta stangs gcig gyur yin yang / da cha 7rgyal ba rin po che the'i bon du phebs kyi yod pa gang 'dra yin nam dran srid kyi red/ khyed rang tsho nga tsho'i grogs po red/ nga tshor rgyab skyor byed kyi yod par brten grogs po rnam par gnas tshul ngo ma gsal po zhus na bsam pa dran song / gcig byas na phyi zla 3 pa'i zla mjug la the 'i wan du 'gro rtsis byed kyi yod/ dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i nga tsho the'i wan srid gzhung ngo ma dang 'brel ba yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ the'i wan gzhung gis bod pa'i slob phrug gi slob sbyong thog la rogs ram byed 'dod yod pa rnams lkog sgog sud sud ma yin par kun gyi yongs grags byas te rogs ram byas pa yin na/ nga tshos kyang len bde po yong rgyu dang / bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang lasang go ming tang gi phogs zan red/ yas red/ mas red shod ma dgos payong rgyu/ de ga nang bzhin bla ma chos pa 'gro mkhan tsho yin na yang tshad long pa yag po de 'dra dgos kyi 'dug bod gzhung gi bka' la brtsi mkhan dang / sgrig khrims 'khyer mkhan gyi mi de tsho'i gras 'gro thub pa dang / chab srid kyi lta ba dang / chos phyogs kyiyon tan thog nas phran bu legs pa'i gras 'gro thub na dge mtshanayod/ rin thang med mkhan rang dgar 'khyams 'gro mkhan 'dra po byung na/ phyi'i mthong tshul la yang yag po mi 'dug ma 'ongs par nga tsho btsan byol bod gzhung dang /tha'i bon 'brel ba gtsang ma yag po zhig chags song na the'i bon la slebs mkhan de rnams bod pa'i spus tshad yod mkhan gyi gras slebs thub kyi red/ slob 385

phrug 'gro thub kyi red/ nga tsho'i gzhon nu dang / bud med tshogs pa 'di m+mu gras kyi mi legs sbyar shod par 'gro rgyu dang / de bzhin slob phrug brje res byed rgyu la sogs pa gang cir lta ba yod pa/ rang lugasayod pa de tsho'i gras slebs thub rgyu dang / chos phyogs nas kyang de de bzhin byung ba yin na rim bzhin rim bzhin gang byung mang byung byed mkhan de rnams ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar 'gyur 'gro gi red/ bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la the'i wan gyi phogs zan yag po red zer mkhan su yang med/ de dag brgyud nas the'i wan gyis go pa'i nang la dkrug shing dang / gtor bshig gtong gi 'dug ces shod kyi yod pa des the'i bon gzhung dang / the'i bon mi mang la ming shas bzo gi yod pa ma gtogs phan thogs gang yang med/ nga tsho do bdag gdong thug skad cha bshad/ nang tshags chags payin na gtsang ma bzo thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dugaganas tshul de dag shes na khyed rang tsho blo bde poyong gi red bsam ste bshad pa yin/ zhu yag gzhan dag mi 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che/ rjes su thug yong / zhes bka' stsal// //386

༄7// phyi lo 1997 zla 7 tshes 29 nyin bzhugs sgar mi mang brtan bzhugs gra sgrig tshogs chung gi 'thus mi rnams la stsal ba'i bka' slob/nye dus brtan bzhugs shig phul chog pa zer ba dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni nye chara.a mi ri kur 7rgyal ba rin po che'i yang srid phebs phyogs sgor bshad pa des khyed rang tsho blo g.yeng byung yod bzo 'dug de skor dngos yod gnas tshul gang yin pa de gsal bshad byas na bsam byung / khyed rang tsho des g.yeng dgos don gtananas med/ de ni nga sems shugs chag pa gangayang min/ khyed rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal red/ che sa nas bshad na bod spyi pa'i don dag la 'gal rkyen ha cang chen poyod nayang / nga tsho bden pa la brten nas 'gro gi yod/ nga tsho bden pa dang 'brel ba'i thog nas 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la 'gro gi yod pa yin dus 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la dpung stobs che chung gi skad cha gang yang yong pa ma red/ 'tshe ba'i lam la brten nas 'khrug pa brgyab ste rgyal kha lon thabs byed rgyu zhig yin na dpung stobs che chung la rag lasaspend /nga rang tsho dang po nyid nas mtha' gcig tu bden pa la yid ches byas nas bden pa bden sar 'khyol ba'i dmigs yul bzungs/ de dang mthun pa'i thabs lam lag len bkal nas dus da lta bar du phyin pa red/ bod pas rgya mi'i dpung ya yon thabs med nayang / nga tshor bden pa yod pa dang bden pa'i lam la brten pa'i skabs su rgya nag gzhung stobs chen rgyal khab de bod pa'i gnas tshul gyi jog nas ha cang gi bsun po dang / kha skyengs po zhig chags yong giyod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so brgyad lhag 387

tsam 'gro gi yod/ da lta bar du nga tsho tshang mas bden pa la yid ches byas/sems shugs ma chag par bsdad pa'i nyer len gyis bod pa'i bden don tshad gzhi mtho rwa1ra slebs yod/ gang ltar re ba yod pa zhig red ma gtogs/ re ba med pa rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ nam rgyun ngas rtag par bshad pa ltar bden mtha' gsal la nye ba zhig yin pa'i yid ches la 'gyur ba gang yang med/ rgya nag gis byed stangs la 'gyur ba rtsab nas ma phyin par bod kyi bden mtha' gsal rgyu khag po red/ rgya nag gi 'gyur bar tos nas bod kyi bden don lu 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu de dngosayod gnas tshul red/ rgya nag la cha bzhag na/ rtsab gung khran tang gis 'go 'khrid pa'i srid gzhung gi phyi sgrom la 'gyur ba phyin med na yang gung khran tang gi 'go 'khrid pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i 'og nas nang rtag tu dpal 'byor la 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod/ 'dzam gling phyi 'brel byed stangs la 'gyur ba chen po phyinaspend/ phyi nang gi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i cha rkyen mang du phyin pa'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas rgya nag gi phyi sgrom sngon yod rang 'jagasayin nasang / nangadon 'gyur ba chen po phyin pa tshang mas mthong gsal red/ da lta'i rgya nag dang / lo nyi shu'i gong gi rgya nag gnyis dbar 'gyur ba ha cang chen po phyinaspend/ rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab de lo re nas 'o rer 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red ma gtogs/ 'gyur ba ma phyin par bsdad thabs yod pa ma red/ dper na/ lnga bcu nga grangs dang / drug cu re grangs kyi nang layin na ma kha se le ning ring lugs zer ba'i gcig sdud kyi lam phyogs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs brgyud gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyal khab chen por 388

'gyur rgyu'i dmigs yul de 'dra zhig 'dzin gyi yod pa dang / gang ltar ma 'ongs par 'gro sa'i mdun lam cha tshang gi rnam pa zhig blo la shar/ de dang 'brel ba'i lam lugs kyi lta ba gcig la yid ches byas nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ da cha gnas tshul de 'gyur tshar ba red/ da cha rgya nag mi mang nang gung khran ring lugs la yid ches ngos 'dzin byed mkhan shin tu nyung nyung chags pa'am/ ha lam med pa lta bur gyur yod/ mang che bas gung khran ring lugs zer ba lag len 'khel thabs med pa'i lta grub lta bur ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ lta ba dang /dmigs yul nges can zhig bzung / de la yid ches dang rgyab skyor nges can yod pa'i 'og nas gcig sdud lam lugs la 'gro rgyu'i phyi nang gi cha rkyen de dag med pa chags tshar dus gcig sdud lam lugs gnas rgyu ha cang khag po red/ da lta gang 'dra zhig gi thog yod dam zer na/ gcig sdud kyi lam lugs la 'gro rgyu'i rgyab rten brlag zin pa dang / des khungs 'khyol thabs med pa rgya mi'i 'go khrid tshos shes kyi yod nayang / lam seng 'gyur ba chen po zhig btang ba yin na de snga.u ru su'i nang la byung ba ltar sgrig 'dzugs rtsa ba nas gzhig rkyen dang / dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal/ lung pa'i nang la khrims 'gal byed mkhan mang du 'aX shen/ spyi tshogs yongs rdzogs bag ma phebs pa 'byung nyen sogs dka' ngal mang dag 'phrad rgyu gsal po red/ nga tshos bod don gyi dka' ngal sel ched dbu ma'i lam btsal ba bzhin/ rgya nag gis kyang nang don dbu ma'i lam zhig 'tshol gyi yod pa red/ de snga'i gcig sdud lam lugs la da lta bar du yid ches rtse gcig tu byas nas phyin na yang da cha des khungs 389

'khyol thabs med pa gsal po chags tshar bar brten ga ler ga ler 'gyur ba gtong rgyu'i 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa dang / thabs shes 'tshol gyi ā+o pa red/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi 'go khrid tshos de snga phan chad kyi srid byus nor 'khrul byung ba dang / pham nyes phyin lugs dngos su khas len byed mi dgos pa'i thog nas ga ler ga ler 'gyur ba gtong thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ de ni bod pa'i ngo la bltas nas 'gyur ba btang ba dang / 'dzam bu gling phyi logs kyi gnon shugs la brten nas 'gyur ba btang ba red ces brjod mi thub kyang 'dzam gling phyi phyogs nas rgya nag la dga' mos yod pa dang / yid ches yod pa/ snyan grags yod pa zhig 'dod kyi yod pa'i cha nas phyi rol gyi gnas tshul la bstun gyi yod/ gtso bo rgya nag rang nyid kyi khe phan la bltas nas 'gyur ba ma btang thabs med chags pa ha cang gsal po yin/ nga tshos da bar lo sum cu so brgyad lhag tsam gyi ring la tshang mas rig pa bsgrims pa'i nyer len la brten nas gzugs med sar gzugs gsar pa chags/ gzugs de rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod/ 'on kyang dka' ngal dang 'gal rkyen yang shin tu mang po yod/ nga tshos 'gal rkyen gcig pu la bltas pa yin na/dngos gnas gang 'dra yin nam bsam pa 'dra po yod na yang / 'gal rkyen gcig pu ma yin par mthun pa'i rgyu rkyen mang po zhig yod pa de dag kyang mthong ba byed dgos/ phyogs gnyis ma'i gnas tshul la brtag zhib dang / khong du chub pa'i thog nas phyogs bsdoms zhib 'jug byas pa yin na/ nga chor re ba yod pa ma gtogs re ba med pa rtsa ba nas ma red/ de ltar na nga sems shugs 390

chag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med/ nga sger gyi ngos nas cha mtshon na/ rgya mis tu la'i log spyod pa zhes mang po zhig zer ba der ha las dgos pa gang yang mi 'dug de ni rgya mi kho rang tshos khungs med rang 'dod kyis lab pa tsam zhig red/ tā la'i bla ma zhes ming sgos kyi thog nas 'phya smod shugs che tsam byas na bod pa'i bsam blo'i nang 'gyur ba 'gro gi red bsam gyi yod na yang / don la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i tshab tu tu la'i bla mar dga' zhen che ru 'gro ba dang / rgya mir ma dga' ba sdug tu 'gro gi yod pa gsal po red/ de snga spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya drug cu'i nang la rgya mis srid jus de lag len bstar myong yod/ sngon ma rgya mis twa la'i bla ma chos gos gyon pa'i spyang ki red zer ba dang / twa la'i bla mas mi bsad pa/ btsan g.yem byas lugs sogs 'dra mi 'dra bshad yod kyang / rang ngos la sems nang ma bde ba gang yang mi 'dug srid jus de pham nyes phyin tshar ba red/ da lta'i srid byus gsar pa 'di yang pham nyes su 'gro rgyu red/ rdo don yang snying rgya mis ngan smras gang 'dra zhig kyang de tshor gnad 'gag gang yang mthong gi mi 'dug deng sang bod nang chos sde khag tsho'i nang sgrig lam dam du gtong ba dang / dmigs bsal gyi lta ba bslab rgyu'i las 'gul spel gyi yod pa des bod mi'i sems la 'gyur ba 'gro mi srid/ gang ltar nga rang tsho'i phyogs yongs kyi gnas tshul la bltas pa yin na re ba'i sgang la bsdad yod pas nga sems shugs chag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mi 'dugang tsho rgya gar nang la cha bzhag na/ bsam 'char mi mthun pa phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ de ni deng sang gi gnas tshul gcig pu ma yin par/ sngon 391

ma cig stong da gu brgya drug cu'i nang nas phran bu yong gi yod/ de mi'i chos nyid red/ gang ltar nga rang tsho phyogs gcig nas mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi yod/ gtam brjod rang dbang yod/ nga tsho rgya gar rang dbang lung pa'i nang la bsdad yod/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas blo mthun ma mthun yod mi tshang mas gsal po byas nas 'don rgyu'i sgobs pa dang / bton chog pa'i go skabs yod pa red/ de tshor dga' bsu zhu rgyu red/ de la skyon gang yang mi 'dugabar skabs chos skyong bsten stangs skor gnas tshul mngapo byung yod/ rigs gcig gis nga'i ming smos te 'dra mi 'dra bshad kyi yod/ de la thal cha gang yang mi 'dug gtam brjod rang dbang red/ nga'i bsam tshul dang / lam ston byas par yid ches med pa'i mi tan tan yong gi red/ yid ches med mkhan gyi mi des so so'i sems nang yid ches med pa ltar kha nas yid ches med ces lab pa de yag po red/ kha nas 7rgyal ba rin po cher yid chesayod mdog mdog sems nang nasayid ches med pa yin na deyag po ma red/ chos kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na ngo sgog mi mtshungs pa chags pa red/ dam tshig ma gtsang ba yong rgyu'i nyen g.yod/ blo ma mthun pa tshos dngos su ngo sgol byas par dga' bsu zhu rgyu red/ gnad 'gag gangayod zer na/ mang tshogs rnams nas da bar rang tshugs zin nas bsdad pa red/ da dungayang mgo skor ma thebs pa byed dgos/ ngas lab pa 'di la rgyu mtshan gang 'dug phar phyogs nas bshad pa de la rgyu mtshan gang 'dug brtag zhib byas/ bsam blo yag spro zhig btang / ngas lab pa 'dir rgyu mtshan mang ba dang / yid ches 'dug na de'i 392

snang la so so langs phyogs brtan po zin nas da lta nang bzhin hur thag byas nas bsdad/ mgo 'tshos la ma 'tshos kyi yig cha mang po'i nang bston 'dzugs dang ham bshad gang byung bris pa de tshor mgo skor ma thebs pa'i gsal bshad byed rgyu las/ de min gnad 'gag gang yang mthong gi mi 'dug ngas nam rgyun nas bshad kyi yod pa ltar/ gang ltar ngas phyogs tshang ma'i gnas tshul bltas/ dge skyon zhig mthong / rang ngos nas nyams myong mang po zhig bsags/de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas gsal bshad byas pa red/ de gsal bshad ma byas na nga nor ba red/ gsal bshad byas nas nyan dang mi nyan de so so'i bsam blo red/ mang che bas ni nyan gyi yod pa red/ nyung shas shig gis nyan gyi med/ de gnas tshul khag khag red/ de 'dra yong gi red/ de snga sku gong ma'i skabs la yang sku gong ma la kha gtong mkhan byung yod/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i skabs la'ang de 'dra red/ da dung rgyang ring tsam bshad na ston pa bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs la'ang khong la skur ba 'debs mkhan byung yod/ gang ltar rang ngos nas drang pos gzhungs bsrangs nas phyin pa'i skabs blo ma rangs pa 'ga' shas nas sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs 'dra mi 'dra yong srid kyi red/ der ya mtshan rgyu gang yang med/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyis rkyen pas nga sems shugs chag dgos don rtsa ba nyid nas med/7rgyal ba rin po che'i yang srid skor la phal cher lo bco lnga lhag tsam dang / gcig byas na ha lam lo nyi shu tsam phyin med dam/ ngas 7rgyal ba rin po che sku phreng bcu bzhi pa 'di sku phreng mtha' ma de yin srid kyi red ces 393

bshad yod/ de bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ nga chos bod kyi rang dbang rtsod len byed pa'i las 'gul 'dir rgya mi'i phyogs nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i khe phan gyi don dag red zer ba dang / spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag ched red ces bshad kyi yod/ der lan rgyag rgyu'i snying po de gang yin zer na/ spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re gnyis la nga tshos ma 'ongs pa'i rtsa khrims kyi thog ma'i zin bras de bzos/ de nas spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re gsum lo rtsa khrims snying bsdus shig gsal bsgrags byas pa de'i nang la gal te dgag bya dang / dgos pa'i gnad 'gag byung ba yin na/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang cha dor rgyu zer ba zhig bkod yod/ skabs der khyed rang tsho rgan pa kha shas yod na dran gyi red/ mang tshogs nang nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dbang la bsgyur bcos btang na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug yorgyal ba rin po ches 'gan ma mkhyerata 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces bsam tshul mang po zhig byung myong ba red/ gang ltar nga rang tsho ma 'ongs par mang gtso'i lam la 'gro dgos/bod mi rigs dang rgyal khab kyi khe phan ched du 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang cha bzhag dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags song na gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi gsum gnyis kyi mang mos thog nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbang cha dor rgyu zhes rtsa khrims zin bris nang bkod yod/ de nas tshur drug cu re dgu'i gsum bcu'i gsung bshad nang dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa 'di bzhin bla brang gi 'gro stangs 'dra po yod pas ma 'ongs pa la gnas dang ma gnas bod rgya che'i mi mang gis thag gcod rgyu red ces bshad yod/ nga tshos bod kyi bden don 'thab rtsod 394

byed pa 'di bod mi mang gi don dag dang / bod mi rigs kyi don dag red ma gtogs spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs rgyag rgyu'i don dag ma red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i khe phan don dag de bas kyang ma red/ mdor na tā la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs lta bu yod pa 'di ma 'ongs pa la gnas dang ma gnas de bod mi mang gis thag gcod rgyu red/ bod mi mang gi lag par yod/ de gnas rgyur u tshugs rgyag dgos pa dang / de gnas pa'i thabs shes byed dgos pa gang yang med ces bshad yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi mang po zhig gis ha lam tā la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs med pa chags na sangs rgyas kyi bstan par 'gyur ba yong gi yod pa lta bu dang / bod mi rigs la 'gyur ba yong gi yod pa lta bur mthong nas dri ba byed mkhan yong gi 'dug de tshor ngas gsal po bshad kyi yod/ bsam blo thongs dang / bod mi rigs zer ba 'di bon po'i rig gzhung gi lo rgyus dang sbrags nas bshad payin na nyung shos la lo bzhi stong lnga stong phyin pa'i mi rigs shig red/ rgyal rabs lo rgyus nas bshad na gnya' khri btsan po nas lo nyis stong lhag tsam phyin pa'i mi rigs shig red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la cha bzhag na gang ltar lo nyis stong ma zin tsam zhig gi nang bod la thog mar bstan pa dar/ bar du yar rgyas phyin pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / tā la'i bla ma ni dge 'dun grub pa nas rtsis pa yin na lo drug brgya tsam zhig dang / bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa lnga pa'i skabs nas bzung na lo sum brgya lhag tsam zhig phyin yod/ gang ltar bod mi rigs ni lo bzhi stong lnga stong gi gong nas yod pa dang / bod la nang pa'i chos dar nas 395

lo stong phrag gnyis ma zin tsam phyin pa zhig red/ de ltar na tā la'i bla ma yod na bod mi rigs yod pa dang / bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod pa/ de med na bod mi rigs brlag 'gro gi yod pa dang / bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa brlag gi yod pa de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus de ltar red/ma 'ongs pa la yin na yang bod mi rigs bsdad rgyu red / bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung yang bsdad kyi red/ bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang bsdad kyi red/ tā la'i bla ma'i 'gro stangs 'di nam zhig dgos mkho med na yal 'gro gi red/ de mu mthud nas gnas dgos rgyur 'bad brtson byed dgos don med/ der sems khur len dgos don rtsa ba nas med ces ngas bshad kyi yo/da/gal te ma 'ongs pa la lo nyi shu sum cu phyin/ nga rang cho dngad gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung / de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas dngos gnas nga rang tsho tshang ma'i 'dod pa tshims pa zhig dang / bod kyi mi rigs dang bod kyi rig gzhung /bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa tshang ma dngos gnas sra thag thag chags pa'i skabs su gcig byas na nga rang tsho'i mi mang mang po zhig gi bsam khra'i nang la da cha tā la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs de mtha' gcig tu dgos gal mi 'dug bsam pa zhig yong masrid pa ma red/ de 'dra byung ba yin na rang bzhin gyis tā la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di 'gag pa red/ med pa chags 'gro gi red/ gal srid nga'i mi thog 'dir de 'dra chags pa yin na twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa 'di tu la'i bla ma mtha' ma de chags pa red/ tā la'i bla ma mtha' ma de chags pa yin na nga dga' bsu yod/ nga dga' po yod/ ngas rtsed mo dang sbrags da 396

lta bar du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi byung ba'i nang nas nga la cha bzhag na tā la'i bla ma yag shos dang / snyan grags che shos de min na yang / zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan zhig chags med ces bshad kyi yode/ tā la'i bla ma zhabs 'dren ma zhu mkhan gcig gis skabs su de'i sgrig 'dzugs mjug bsdogs pa yin na desag po red/ gzi brjid ngang nas mjug bsdogs pa red/ lo rgyus nang tā la'i bla mas zhabs 'dren lung pa gang zhus nas mjug bsdogs pa red ces lab na ngo tsha po dang / thabs skyo 1 red/ tu la'i bla ma gzi brjid dang rgyal kha'i ngang nas tu la'i bla ma'i bla brang gi mjug bsdogs na 'grig gi 'dug ces bshad kyi yod/yang phyogs gcig nas de tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid dang de'i sgrig 'dzugs mu mthud nas bsdad na dge mtshan yod pa yin na/ de yang de snga 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sgrig 'dzugs dang / sog po'i bar 'brel ba phran buyod pa dang /de bzhin ti ma la ya'i ri rgyud la 'drel ba phran bu las/ de min 'brel ba de tsam byung med/ bar skabs nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa nas bzung 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa'i chos la do snang byed mkhan mang du phyin pa'i 'gyur ba gsar pa zhig gi thog nas nang pa yongs rdzogs bshad thub min ji ltarayang /'dzam gling nang theg chen gyi chos brgyud tsho'i nang la twa la'i bla ma zhes yongs grags kyis ngos 'dzin dang cha 'jog yod pa'i nang pa'i 'go khrid gcig chags yod pa red/ der brten twa la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di bod gcig bu'i gnas tshul tsam min par 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi spyir nang pa/ de'i nang 397

tshan nas theg chen gyi nang pa yongs rdzogs kyi 'go khrid gcig tu yongs grags kyis cha 'jog byed kyi yod pa yin dus de 'dra'i cha nas sgrig 'dzugs kyi rnam pa gsar pa chags yod/ rgya gar ba ngo shes de 'dra kha shas kyis sngon ma nas bsam tshul dang / go bsdur de 'dra byung myong / dper na ye shu'i bla chen pob bzhugs sa.i ṭa li rom la yod na yang / de 'dzam bu gling yongs rdzogs nang gi ye shu khe ta lig tshogs mi spyi'i dbus kyi bsti gnas lta bu zhig chags bsdad yod pa ltar/ tu la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs de lha sar yod na yang / de'i ngo bo de 'tham bu gling 'di'i sgang la yod pa'i nang pa yongs rdzogs sam/ yang na theg chen pa yongs rdzogs kyi bsti gnas 'dra po chags kyi red ces bshad mkhan yong myong / gal srid twa la'i bla ma'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di mu mthud nas yod dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags payin na tā la'i bla ma'i mjug mthud mkhan de gang 'dra zhig byed rgyu yin nam/ de yang bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig red/dper na dga' ldan khri pa ji bzhin bslab pa bgres gzhon gyi thog nas tā la'i bla ma'i khri 'dzin mkhan zhig yong mi chog pa ma red/ de yang thabs shes shig red/ yang min na ye shu'i bla chen gshegs pa'i skabs su khe ta lig gi bla chen drag pa 'gan 'khyer mkhan gtso che ba de tsho'i nang nas 'os bsdu byas te bla chen bsto srol yod pa de 'dra'i gnas tshul yang yong ma srid pa min/ de yang yong chog pa zhig red/ yang nga rang tsho'i de snga'i lo rgyus nang la bla ma gong ma de ma 'das gong de'i yang srid 'di yin zhes ngos 'dzin byed srol yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ ti dzu la bla ma zhig byung ba des kho rang ma gshegs gong 398

kho rang gi spun mched yin nam phru gu zhig la 'di nga'i yang srid yin zhes thag bcad pa dang / rjes su phru gu de yang bla ma sa/shegs 'gro mkhan de yi kun spyod nang bzhin byed mkhan zhig chags bsdad 'dug nye ba'i lo rgyus nang la yang ma 'das sprul sku zer ba zhig yong gi yod pa dang / sngar nas kyang ma 'das sprul sku zer ba de byung myong ba red/ de yang yong chog pa red/ nga ma shi gong la nga'i ngos nas las dang smon lam/ bsod nams dang gang spyi'i cha nas cha rkyen 'dzoms mkhan re ba yod pa zhig la nga'i mjug gu bskyel mkhan 'di yin zhes lab rgyu de 'dra spri/nga yong chog gi red/ yang de snga nang bzhin byas nas gong ma de 'das tshar ba'i mjug tu yang srid 'tshol zhib byas nas yong ba de yang de snga phan gyi 'gro stangs thabs shes shig red/ gang ltar rtsa ba 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di mu mthud bsdad dam ma bsdad de mi mang gis thag gcod kyi red/ gal srid de mu mthud nas bsdad pa yin na tā la'i bla ma'i mjug mthud mkhan gyi yong stangs ji ltar byed dgos min thog bsam blo mang po gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces lo nyi shu'i gong nas de 'dra bshad kyi yod/bar lam phyi rgyal mi kha shas nas bud med kyi thob thang sgor la bshad mkhan mang po byung / bod kyi bla ma'i nang bud med mi 'dug ma 'ongs pa la tu la'i bla ma'i yang srid bud med yong gi red dam zhes dris mkhan byung / de snga bod kyi lo rgyus nang bud med kyi bla sprul med pa ma red/ dper na/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mo bod kyi bla chen gras red/ bsam sding rdo je phag mo mjal khar phebs dus bzhugs khri yod pa dang /theb rngo phag mo'i sku 'khor gsol gzim 399

mchod gsum zer ba cha tshang yod/ khong bla chen gyi gras su bzhugs kyi yod/nges mthong ma myong ste bsam sding rdo lja phag mo'i yang srid ngo ma yin na sgal gzhung du phag pa'i ze lta bu yod lugs zer srol 'dug lnga bcu nga gcig lo nga gro mor yod dus bsam sding rdo rje phag mo mjal myong / 1959 lo rdo rje phag mo kho rang thengs gcig rgya gar la phebs nas sgom mda' dang 'brel ba byung / de rjes khong rang bod la phar log phebs pa red/ gang ltar bod kyi bla chen nang la bud med med pa ma red/ des mtshon pas stod khul la'ang bud med kyi bla ma sku phreng de 'dra gsum bzhi zhig yod lugs go myong / de dag nga tshos zhib 'jug byed dgos pa zhig red/ rdo rje phag mo'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu srol yang phal cher rkarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / rang byung rdo rje'i yas mas suyin pas rnying shos kyi gras red ces ngas 'grel bshad byed kyi kho/ma 'ongs pa la tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid mu mthud nas phebs rgyu dang / mjug mthud mkhan de yang de snga phan chad kyi 'gro stangs nang bzhin byas nas yang srid ngos 'dzin gyi thog nas yong rgyu yin na/ ma 'ongs pa'i yang srid de yang de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs che ba yod pa yin na bud med kyi rten la tā la'i bla ma yong gi red/ yong chog gi red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gatho rwa1 gang yin zer na/ yang srid phebs pa'i dgos pa de sku gong mas 'go btsugs pa'i las mjug skyong mkhan zhig dang / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dag la phan thogs gang che ba zhig gi ched du yang srid phebs kyi red/ dper na ston pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal rigs las 'khrungs pa red/400

gang yin zer na de'i tshe de'i dus rgya gar gyi rigs brgyud nang la rgyal rigs gtso che bar 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ yang 'byung 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas byams pa de bram ze'i rigs la phebs kyi red ces bstan yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de'i tshe de'i dus bram ze'i rigs la mthong che ba yong gi yod pa red/ don snying spyi tshogs kyi nang la phan thogs gang che ba dang / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dag la nus pa gang che ba yong giyode pa de'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas skabs re rgyal rigs dang / skabs re bram ze'i rigs la phebs kyi yod pa red/ dpe de bzhin ma 'ongs pa la spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig yod pa de dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul dang bstun te yang srid phebs pa zhig yong gi red/dper na rgyal ba sku phreng nang la cha bzhag na/ de'i tshe de'i dus sog bod kyi 'brel ba gal chen po chags pa yin dus 7rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho sog wa'i dpon khag gcig la phebs yod/ de skabs khong sog po yin pas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid ma red ces bshad mkhan byung med/ 'gro stangs 'dra min sna tshogs chags kyiyod red/ ma 'ongs par gal srid bud med kyi rten zhig byung ba yin na des bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs che ba yod na bud med kyi rten layong gi red/ da dung ngas rtsed mo dang sbrags bud med kyi rten la phebs pa tsam du ma zad rnam pa yag po zhig la phebs kyi red ces bshad kyi yod/ de la rgyu mtshan yod/ mdog nyes po zhig byung na gzhan yid 'gugs mi thub/ dpe cha'i nang la rnam smin yon tan brgyad ldan zhes gzugs bzang ba/ dbang che ba tshig btsun pa sogs bshad pa de dag kho rang dbang thang che ba'i skad cha ma yin par/401

gzhan phan bsgrub pa'i don du gzhan gyi yid 'phrog pa zhig dgos kyi yod stabs gzugs bzang ba la sogs pa bshad pa red/ dper na mtshan dang dpe byad kyi yon tan bshad yong dus mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ blta bas chog mi shes pa zer ba de dag kyang dgos pa gzhan gyi don du thug yod/ nye sngon rang pha ran si la bud med gcig gis de'i skor skad cha mang po dris byung / ngas yang srid de bud med phebs rgyu'i dgos pa yod na bud med la phebs kyi red/yong chog gi red/ bud med de yang mdzes po zhig yong gi red/ mdzes po yong dgos pa la rgyu mtshan gnyis pa zhig kyang yod ces lab pa yin/ phal cher tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bud med la phebs pa yin na de btsun ma byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ spyir btang bud med khyim pa ni byed thub kyi ma red/ phyi rgyal gyi mi'i nang nas de 'dra'i skad cha dris mkhan 'das pa'i lo bco lnga nyi shu'i nang la yang yang yong gi 'dug par/ 'grel bshad de ltar rgyag gi yod red/bod pa'i nang la de skor dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba gangayang med stabs bshad dgos don mi 'dug gal srid 7rgyal ba rin po che'i yang srid btsan byol gyi gnas stangs 'og nas phebs pa'i gnas tshul byung bayin na de rgya mi'i dbang sgyur 'og skye gi ma red ces phal cher lo bcu grangs gong nas bshad yod/ deng sang phyi mi'i nang nas bod pa'i gnas tshul de mi gcig la rag las yod/ mi de ni rgas 'gro gi yod pas mgyogs po shi 'gro gi red/ de shi ba'i rjes su khyed rang cho cad pa'i gnas tshul re ba rgyag sa med pa red ces bshad kyi 'dug sngon ma pe cing du blta bskor la 'gro mkhan khong tshor yang rgya mi kha shas kyis de 'dra 402

bshad 'dug rjes su spyir btang skad cha bshad mkhan de 'dras kyang rgya mi'i nang la de 'dra shod mkhan kha shas 'dug zer gyi 'dug rgya mis de 'dra'i rtsis rgyag gi yod pa red/ paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed stangs de tsho'i gras kyang de dang 'brel ba yod tshul bshad kyi 'dug de bzhin rgya gar nang la deng sang yod pa'i bla chen nang tshags zhuyul kha shas kyis 'di 'dra gsung mkhan byung / 7rgyal ba rin po che sdug pa lta rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red/ gal srid sdug pa'i gnas tshul byung ba'i dbang du btang ba yin na/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'iyang srid phebs phyogs 'di 'dra yin gsungs pa'i phyag bris de 'dra bzhag gnang ba'am/ gang ltar nges brtan zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces gsung mkhan yong myong / de tsho yag po red/ sems khur blangs pa'i rtags red/ khong tshor ngas dngos yod gnas tshul 'di ltar bshad kyi yod ces zhu rgyu byung / gang ltar ngas kha chems 'dra wa'i yig cha bzhag dgos don mi 'dug ngas yongs grags byas nas gnas tshul bshad kyi yod/ gal te nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas bsdad pa'i ring la nga shi ba dang / bod mi mang la yang srid gcig mu mthud dgos kyi yod pa yin na yang srid de gang ltar skye ba sngon ma des las ka 'go brtsams nas 'phro bskyang rgyu bsdad pa de'i mjug skyel rgyu'i ched du yang srid de yong gi red ma gtogs/ de gtor bshig gtong mkhan la yang srid de yong shes kyi ma red/ rgyu mtshan de'i thog nas phyogs bsdoms byas na/ gal srid 7rgyal ba rin po che btsan byol la yod pa'i ring la 'das grongs phyin pa dang /mu mthud nas yang srid gcig dgos pa'i dbang du btang na/ yang srid yong 403

sa de rgya mi'i lag 'og tu yong gi ma red/ de rang dbang lung par yong gi red ces ngas tshig thag bcad nas bshad dgos pa'i gnas tshul der thug pa red/de spyi yongs kyi 'grel bshad cig dang / gnad 'gag cig chags kyi yod tsang ngas gsal bshad byas pa ma gtogs/ nga sems shugs chag nas da 7rgyal ba rin po che dag zhing la phebs kyi yin zer gyi med/ sngon ma bla ma gcig gis lab pa red zer gyi 'dug gam/ nam rgyun nas bla ma des khyed rang tsho sdug pa ma gtogs/ nga dag zhing la 'gro chog chog yin zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/rjes su bla rma phran bu na ba'i skabs su slob ma de tshos khyed rang lta dag zhing lu phebs chog chog red/ nga tsho la 7skyabs 'jug gnang rogs gnang zhus par/bla ma des nga ma shin na lta ma shi ba rang dga' ba 'dug ces lab pa'i skad cha 'dug bag gro po'i skabs su dag zhing 'gro chog chog yod zer ba dang / bla ma ngo jog na ba'i skabs ma shi bar bsdad rogs byas na bsam pa dran gyi yod pa red/ dngos gnas rang bod phyi nang gomi mang tsho'i sems shugs 'di lta bu yod pa dang / dam tshig la rgya gcig gyur gyi nus pa 'di lta bu yod pa red/da lta lam seng kha yod lag yod kyi grub 'bras shig ma son na yang bod rgya che'i mi mang gi blo bzhag sa zhig dang / bsam cho'i nang la sems gso gtong mkhan zhig las ma byung yang / nga 'tsho zhing bsdad pa'i ring la phan gyi yod pa red/de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og la da lta nad na tsha zhig gis gdungs nas zhi ba 'i nyenag byung na yang dbugs 'gro sa ma red ces bshad kyiyod/ nga sems shugs bskyed nas bsdad yod/ gzugs po ni bde thag chod yod/ bsam blo ni skyid 404

thag chod yod/ gnyid ni skyid thag chod 'dug sto chas kyi bro ba ni che thag chod 'dug khyed rang tshos brtan bzhugs 'bul dgos pa dang / de 'dra'i blo g.yeng byed dgos don rtsa ba nyid nas med/ bal yul nas bod rigs skyid sdug thun mong nas brtan bzhugs shig 'bul dgos yod ces bshad kyi 'dugade zla ba bcu pa'i nang red/ de dus mnyam du brtan bzhugs phul na 'grigs kyi red/ cho ga zhig dang sbrags smon lam brgyab/ rten 'brel sgrig rgyu yod pa de ga tsam byas na 'grigs/ khyed rang tsho dza drag dang / dngangs skrag byed mi dgos/ blo bde po byas nas sdod a/ma 'ongs pa la 7rgyal ba rin po che'i yang srid gnyis pa zhig yong rgyu bsdad yod pa red/ sngon ma nga lha sar yod dus snying rje lha klu'i.a ma lags kyis nor bu gling khar pho brang gsar pa rgyab tshar ba'i rjes la nyin ma gcig mjal khar slebs byung / snying rje/ a ma lags nas 7rgyal ba rin po che sku tshe brtan pa'i dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ sku tshe ma brtan pa yin na yang srid gcig ni ma phebs par thabs med/ yang srid phebs nas phyag dpe de lta bu bslab dgos/ sku las 'di ga tsam bskyon dgos/ da lta phyag dpe gzigs grub pa sku las tshang ma bskyon tshar ba gcig sku tshe ring po bzhugs na de yag gi red ma gtogs/ yang srid gnyis pa zhig phebs nas ka kha nas bzung ste gzhi nas slob sbyong gnang dgos byung na sku mnyel rogs red zer gyi 'dug a ma lags kyis de 'dra bshad myong / khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas sdod a/ shes song ngam/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' 455// //405

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1997 zla 10 tshes 8 nyin gsung chos ra bar brtan bzhugs 'bul bcar bal yul mi mang dang / bzhugs sgar mi mang bcas la lcang5 ba'i bka' slob/da res khyed rang cho ched mngags gal chen po byas te brtan bzhugs la yong ba red/ khyug tsam thug nas skad cha phran bu bshad na khyed rang tsho 'dod pa tshim nas dga' po yong gi red snyam byung / nga tsho gengad pa dang bal po gnyis sngar nas gzhung gnyis dbar 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin/ ngas 'dir gtso bo bod pa'i gnas tshul skor brjod rgyu yin pas de dag gcig dang gnyis skad bsgyur ma thub kyang snying bsdus shig bsgyur rgyu dang / de yang dus tshod dbang gis zhib phra rjes su bsgyur na 'grigs kyi red/jog mar khyed drong tsho bal yul nas do gal chen pos ched mngags yong bar ha cang dga' po byung / de bzhin dzña ram sa lar gtan sdod bod mi khyed rang tshos dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa'i thog nas brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyur dmigs bsal 'bad brtson byas par ha cang dga' po byung / bal yul mi mang sogs tshang mas de ltar byas par thugs rje che zhes brjod kyi yin/nga rang chorwa nad pa'i gnas stangs tshang mas shes gsal ltar dka' ngal chen po zhig gi 'og gnas yod/ yin na yang rtsa ba'i thog bod kyi bden mtha' gsal la nye ba zhig chags yod/ gang yin zhe na/ 'dzam gling 'di'i steng bod pa'i thog do snang byed mkhan je mang du 'gro ba dang / gal che shos rgya mi'i nang nas bod pa'i thog do snang byed mkhan mang du mang du 'gro gi yod/ bod 406

pa'i gnas tshul la do snang byed dus rang bzhin bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di bden pa yin pa mthong ba dang / nga cho rwa1da pa'i ngos nas rgya mi rigs la mthong chung dang / rgya nag rgyal khab la'ang ngo gol byed kyi med/ des ma tshad ngos nas ro don thag gcod byed phyogs 'di sngon chad bod rgya tha dad so so yin yang /deng sang 'dzam gling ha cang 'gyur ba 'gro ba'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bstun nas bod rgya gnyis mos yong ba'i thabs lam zhig 'tshol rgyur 'bad brtson byas pa 'di mthong yong dus/ rgya nag gi phyi la yod pa'i rgya mi tsam du ma zad/ rgya nag gi nang la yod pa'i rgya mi'i khrod bod don la do snang dang sha tsha'i rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang du 'gro gi yod/ da lta 'phral sgang bod nang las ka byed mkhan chos srid byus ha cang mkhregs po dang / rtsub po zhig 'dzin gyi yod kyang des khong tshor phan thogs yong rgyu khag po yin/ da lta'i char rgya nag gzhung gi las ka byed mkhan tshos bod kyi gnas tshul 'di blos 'gan mi bzod pa dang / gnas skabs thabs shes gzhan med pa'i 'og mtha' gcig tu gnon pa'i srid byus shig 'dzin gyi yod/ phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na de ni phal cher 'phral sel gyi srid byus shig las bod don gyi rtsa ba'i rnyog dra thag gcod byed pa'i srid byus shig rtsa ba nas ma red/ da lta khong tshos blo dogs chen po byed pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul 'di phran bu grang sangs thebs na tan tan rgya nag gzhung gis bod pa'i dka' rnyog 'di rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas sel rgyu'i bsam blo ma btang thabs med yin/ phyogs gnyis nas rgya nag ni rgyal khab ha cang chen po 'dzam gling thog gi rgyal khab gal che shos kyi gras chags yod/407

de ltar 'dzam gling thog gi gal gnad chen po'i rgyal khab gcig gis rang gi gnas stangs la dpag pa'i srid byus rgyu mtshan ldan pa/ gzhan tshos yid mos thob pa zhig 'dzin dgos pa las/ spyon pa'i byed stangs lta bu'i srid byus shig 'dzin na 'dzam gling 'di'i thog khungs 'khyol khag po red/ der brten rgya nag rang nyid kyi 'phral phyags khe phan la bsam blo btang nas bod don thog dus tshod snga phyi tsam ma gtogs rgya nag gzhung gis rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i srid byus shig 'dzin rgyu yin par yid ches byed kyi yod la de ltar 'gyur ba'ang yong gi red/rtsa ba bod don bden mtha' gsal la nye ba'i mtshams la slebs yod dus tshang mas da phan sems shugs ma chag par gnas pa ltar da dung yang sems shugs ma chag pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ sems shugs ma chag pa bya rgyu ni las sla po zhig min zhing / nga tshor dka' ngal gyi gnas tshul dngos gnas mgo na po dang / dza drag po zhig yod/ yin na'ang re ba rgyag sa'i gzhi rtsa zhig yod pa'i 'og nas ngas tshang mar sems shugs ma chag par rig pa bsgrim dgos zhes brjod kyi yod/ rig pa bsgrim nas dka' las ji tsam brgyab kyang don 'bras son rgyu med pa zhig yin na/ de ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ nga tsho'i gnas tshul ni de 'dra gtan nas min pas tshang mar sems shugs ma chag pa byed dgos zhes brjod rgyu 'di don tshan gcig yin/ bod don jog dka' las rgyag dgos don ni bden don 'di rtsa che dang /gal chen po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan nga tshos shes pa bya rgyu gal chen po chagasa'ade/de ni nga tsho'i mirigs rang btsan dang / mi rigs gcig gi don dag gcig 408

pya min par ngos nas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ dper na/ a phi ri rka'i nang rgyal khab mang po dang / 'dzam gling sa gnas gang sa'i lung pa tshos so so'i lo thang dang chab srid rang btsan rtsod kyi yod pa red/ nga tsho bod pa'i gnas tshul ni de 'dra gcig pu ma red snyam gyi yod/ nga'i ngos 'dzin la bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di bod kyi sa cha'i chags tshul/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi gnas stangs 'di gnyis kyi 'og nas bod 'di gnas stangs yag po zhig byung na yin na/ bod kyi khor yug gi gnas stangs kyi 'og nas rgya gar dang / paki si than/ lhang la sde shi/ wi ti nam/ gam pos ya/ la'o si/ lhag par rgya nag bcas pa'i sa khul de dag gi gtsang po gal che ba phal mo che'i chu 'go dngad la thug yod/ der brten tshan rig thog rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi mkhas pa de 'dra nas rnam kun bajode gsal la/ gal srid thode sa mtho'i thog gi gnam gshis la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung na/ de ni bod kyi nye stor la yod pa'i gong gsal sa khul de dag gi gnam gshis la phan gnod kyi 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i rkyen chen po zhig chagasayod pa dang / gnyis nas wade sa mtho'i gnam gshis 'gyur ba phyin nas char pa dus su ma babs pa dang / shing nags gcod 'breg tshad las brgal ba byed pa de dag gis rkyen byas te chu log gi mtshon pa'i rang byung gnod 'tshe yong rgyu ni bod gcig pu ma yin par e sha ya shar gling gi sa khul mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod pa gsal po chags yod/ 'di ni gnas tshul gcig yin/gnyis pa/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis mi'i spyi tshogs la bde 409

skyid bskrun rgyu dang / mi'i sems zhi rdzod bzo rgyur nus pa ldan pa bcas kyi spyi la phan thogs yod pa zhig yin/ bye braga.e sha ya'i sa khul 'dir bod kyi chos dang gcig gyur yin pa'i sa cha dper na/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud bal yul gyi byang phyogs dang / rgya gar gyi nub la dwags nas/ shara.a ru na cal bar dang / 'brug yul bcas kyi sa khul de dag lo brgya phrag mang po'i gong nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gcig gyur yin/ bod kyi byang rgyud nas brtsis na sog po phyi nang gnyis dang / de bzhin shar krar ki si tan khul du yod pa'i thor rnyod mi rigs/ u ru su'i khongs su yod pa'i sgo ras thu dang / khar mugathu wa bcas de dag tshang ma lo brgya phrag mang wa'i ring bod kyi nang chos kyi chos rgyud gci ga pa chags yod/ sa khul de dag gi nang chos dad can mi grangs rob rtsis byas na phal cher sa ya bcu bzhi nas bco lnga'i bar yod pa red/ sa khul de dag la so so'i yul skad mi 'dra ba yod kyang / bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur gyis mtshon pa'i bod kyi sa dge bka' rnying gi chos brgyud so so'i bla ma mkhas pa khag gi gsung 'bum bcas pa dus da lta'ang bod yig gi thog nas klog 'don nyams len byed kyi yod/ der brten bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung de dag dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa ha cang gsal po yin/ de tsam du ma zad rgya nag la cha bzhag na/ lo rgyus thog bod la nang chos ma dar ba'i gong gi phal cher lo sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam la rgya nag la nang chos dar yod pa dang /de rjes lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring bod kyi nang chos kyi shugs rkyen ha cang chen po zhig slebs yod/ de ltar rgya nag ni lo rgyus thog nas chos dar myong ba'i 410

lung pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di rgya nag nang gang 'tshams dar rgyas chen po byung yod pa ltar bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung dang 'brel ba chen po yod/ da lta'i rgya nag la cha bzhag na/ chos lugs tshang mar mgo gnon byed pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas nang chos thog mgo gnon chen po byas yod/ de yang chos rmongs dad la brtses nas med pa bzos pa red/slongs dad la brtsi ba'i chos 'dis mi'i spyi tshogs nang bsgrub mi thub pa'i bya ba zhig gam/ yang na 'dis bsgrub pa'i bya ba tsam zhig khong tshos phyogs gzhan zhig nas sgrub thub yod na de ni gnas tshul tha dad yin yang / de ltar byed thub med/ rgya nag gis sngar nas yod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung med par bzos te gung khran ring lugs kyi lta ba dang spyod par brten nas dka' las chen po rgyab par ma zad/ phyi byug nang blugs kyi slob gso yang ha cang mang po rgyab yod/ de ltar byas kyang rgya nag gi spyi tshogs de don snying ldan pa'i mi'i spyi tshogs shi/ga dang / bde skyid ldan pa'i spyi tshogs shig chags thub med pa ha cang gsal po red/ rgya nag nang gung khran ring lugs pham nyes su song zin pas/ gung khran ring lugs la yid ches byed mkhan med/ tha na 'go khrid tsho la yang yid chesayod med the tshom gyi rang bzhin red/ gung khran ring lugs la mtha' gcig tu yid ches yod na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la shugs rgyab ste mtha' 'khyongs byed dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang don dngos thog kha nas spyi tshogs ring lugs bshad de lag len ma rtsa'i ring lugs thog 'gro gi yod pa red/ da res nye 411

char rang gung khran tang gi tshogs chen thog nas thag gathode byas par rgyal gnyer gyi bzo grwa 'bum phrag mang po zhig sgor gnyer gyi bzo grwar sgyur rgyu'i thag bcad 'dug ngos nas nye char gnas tshul thos par/ rgya nag gi mi mang nang deng sang rgod ༷'i shod srol zhig yod 'dug a ri'i srid 'dzin khe yin khon dang /u ru su'i srin 'dzin ya sing / rgya nag gi srid 'dzin cang tse min bcas khong tsho so sos rlang 'khor chung chung re kha lo bsgyur te gzhung lam thog btang nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro ba'i lam nyis mdo zhig la slebs skabs/ khi lin khon gyis thad /ra ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam la shar bskyod byas pa dang / de'i rjes la ya sing gis kyang lam de'i thog shar rer phyin pa red/ cang tse min gyis lam nyis mdo do der rlang 'khor kha bkag nas gang du 'gro tshod ma thig par bsam blo gtong skabs/ rang gi rgyab nas teng zha'o thing gi rnam shes kyis rlangs 'khor gyi grog brda gaphro phyogs spyi tshogs ring lugs la 'gro rgyu spar nas/ rlangs 'khor g.yas phyogs ma rtsa'i ring lugs la thongs zhes bka' btang ba bzhin/ de ltar byas pa red ces shod kyi 'dug don ngo ma de rang chags yod pa red/ kha nas bshad dus rgya nag gi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs zhes sogs mang po zhig bshad/ don dngos thog ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro gi yod pa red/ don dam gung khran ring lugs dang / ma khe se'i/ le zhin ring lugs kyi lta bar yid ches yod na de dang 'brel ba'i gzhung gi srid byus shig 'dzin nas lam ston byed dgos pa zhig yin na yang / don du spyi tshogs ring lugs 412

lta spyod kyi ming mu mthud 'dzin pa'i 'og nas the tshom med par lag len 'gyur ba gtong gi yod/ de ni gung khran ring lugs pham nyes phyin pa'i rtags mtshan ha cang gsal po red/deng sang bod nang gi bla ma drag pa de tsho rgya nag nang gdan 'dren zhu mkhan kha shas yong gi yod 'dug sa cha kha shas la rgya mi na gzhon shes bya yon tan yag po yod pa'i spyir nang pa'i chos la do snang yod pa dang / yang sgos bod kyi nang chos la do snang yod pa de 'dra bod kyi mkhas pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas rgya mi'i dge slong phal cher drug brgya bdun brgya zhig yod pa'i skad cha 'dugade tsho'i gras kyis rtags mtshan gang bstan yod zer na/ gung khran ring lugs kyi lta bas gang yang sgrub mi thub par pham nyes song ba ngang / yul de'i nang la nang pa'i chos kyis phan thogs byed thub kyi yod pa gsal por bstan yod/de ni ngas tshe phyi ma'i skad cha shod kyi med/ tshe 'di rang la mi'i spyi tshogs nang mi gsod pa dang / rku ma ba/ ba/ btsan g.yems byed pa/ rdzun shod pa/khram pa byed pa de dag chos med pa'i lung pa'i nang du'ang ma 'grigs par brtses te khrims thog nas dam drag byed kyi yod pa red/ de dag mi yong ba'i thabs shes gtso bo ni mi so so'i bsam blo'i nang nas srog gcod dang / ma byin len/log g.yems/ rdzun dang phra ma/ tshig rtsub bcas skyon yin par ngos 'dzin nasa.a tsi ngas 'di 'dra byas na rung gi ma red bsam pa'i bsam blo zhig yod na/ de ni phyi la skor srung ba lta bu'i srung bya yod min la ma tos par/ nang nas sgrig rang 'khur byed pa yin/ bsam khra'i nang ma rabs tha shal gyi bya spyod 413

la nyes dmigs su blta ba'i bsam blo zhig med na/ phyi la skor srung bas me mda' 'khyer nas srung ste sdod skabs bya thabs med kyang / de dag med pa'i dus skabs su bya ngan byed kyi yod/ dper na/ bar skabasa.u ru su'i nang gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba de dag nas gsal po yod cing / gang ltar gung khran ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i slob gso rgyab ste lo nas lo bstud 'bad brtson byas kyang des mi'i sems la 'gyur ba gtong thub kyi med pa gsal po yin/tshur phyogs nang chos la bsten pa'i spyir btang bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul nas bshad na/ nga rang tsho de snga bod la yod pa'i skabs mi bsad 'dug zer na gsar 'gyur ha cang chen po zhig yin/ a tsi mi bsad 'dug ces ha las hon 'thor byed pa'i gnas tshul yod/ gzhan dag 'bu srin gcig bsad na'ang sdig pa yod pa red brjod pa 'di bod pa'i kha rgyun la rang bzhin du 'jags yod/ nang chos kyi bsam blo med mkhan zhig gis 'bu srin dang /sems can gzhan dag gi srog gcod pa la ya nga bag tsha byed kyi med/ 'gul bskyod byed mkhan gyi srog chag 'di bsad na sdig pa yod pas mi 'grigs bsam pa'i bsam blo zhig med dus srog chag de dag gis zhed snang dang dngangs skrag byed pa mthong bzhin du gsod rgyur ya nga bag tsha mi byed pa dang / rim pas khyi dang / zhi mi / ra lug lta bu gsod pa la'ang ya nga bag tsha med/ mi de rigs kyis rim pas so so nad na tsha sogs kyis gzhan la re dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig yod na ma gtogs de min mi gzhan bsad pa la snying rje snyam pa'i 414

bsam blo skyes kyi med/ rang bzhin bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs la srog chags gang la'ang 'di la srog yod pas snying rje bsam pa dang / 'di la sdug bsngal yong gi red snyam pa'i bsam cho de med na rim pas mi nang khul gsod rgyur ya nga bag tsha med pa zhig rang shugs su yong gi yod/ 'di skor ngas sgrung zhig bshad na 1956 lor lha sar bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrigaya yon lhan khang btsugs pa red/ las khungs khag kha shas yod pa'i nang rgya rigs dang bod rigs las ka byed mkhan yod/ ngos kyi spun mched spyi khyab mkhan po blo bzang bsam gtan bde 'jags lhan khang gi gtso 'dzin gzhon par bskos 'dug gtso 'dzin rgan pa rgya mi zhig yod/ rgya mi de spyir btang yag po yod cing / ngas kyang ngo shes kyi yod la/ kha ri kha thug yag po zhig yod/ yin na'ang khong tsho las khungs btsugs te thog ma'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo tshogs skabs blo bzang bsam gtan la rgya skad rgyab ste mi de gsod ces bod skad nang gang 'dra brjod dgos red dam zhes skad cha dris 'dugablo bzang bsam gtan hon 'thor te nga la nyi ma dang po de rang la khos skad cha 'di 'dra dris byung zhes brjod byung / nga tsho bod pa yin na sems kyi nang gsod rgyu'i bsam blo yod na'ang nyin dang po'i mdzad sgo'i nang kho gsod zer ba 'di 'dra'i tshig tsam yang kha nas brjod kyi ma red/ de ltar bsam blo gtong stangs dang chos kyi bag chags kyi thog nas khyad par zhig tan tan yong gi 'dugami la brtsoba'i bsam khro red na gung khran ring lugs kyi lta bas spyi tshogs ring lugs bskrun thub thabs med/ spyi tshogs ring lugs ming don mtshungs 415

pa zhig bskrun bsam na gzhan phan dang / snying rje'i bsam blo yod dgos/ bsam blo 'di yod na rang las gzhan gtso che bar 'dzin ma thub na'ang / mi gzhan dag rnams rang dang gcig gyur yin pa'i lta tshul gyi bsam blo zhigayong gi red/de 'dra med na spyi tshogs ring lugs zer ba bskrun rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ rnam kun ngos nas gung khran ring lugs kyis bshad pa ltar mi tshang ma lto gos kho snyom po dang / shes yon sogs gang ci khod snyom po'i thob thang 'dra mnyam ngo ma zhig yong ba byed dgos na/ nang pa'i chos spyi dang / lhag par theg pa chen po'i chos dang zung du 'brel nas 'gro gi yin na 'dis rogs ram byed thub rgyu red ces shod kyi yod/ gung khran ring lugs pas gral rim gyi 'thab rtsed byed pa dang / ma dga' zhe 'dzin byed pa 'di gtso bor bzung na gung khran ring lugs 'dzugs skrun ji ltar byed thub kyi red dam/ kog za rul sungs kyi gnas tshul rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig yong gi yod/ deng skabs rgya nag nang kog za rul sungs par khrims gcod byas te lo re mi stong phrag mang po gsod kyi yod kyang /da dung gnon ma thub par de rigs mu mthud nas yong gi yod/ rtsab nang sems la 'gul bskyod thebs thub pa zhig dang / bsam blor bsgyur bcos ma byung na/ phyi nas nag nyes 'gog thub rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gis bslab bya gang zhig rgyag gi yode dam zhe na/ bzang po ced dgos pa'i bslab bya rgyag gi yod/ nga rang chor ngad pa'i kha rgyun la ma rgan sems can thams cad ces pa dang / ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces 'jags yod pa ltar nga tshos ga dus smon lam brgyab kyang 416

tshig 'di brjod kyi yod/ lta ba 'di ni mi'i spyi tshogs la phan thogs yod pa zhig yin zhing / lhag par rgya nag gis mtshon pa'i sngar nang chos dar ba'i lung pa rnams kyi 'gro ba mang po zhig la ma 'ongs par bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis phan jogs byed thub pa yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug gang yin zhe na/ sngon chad nang pa'i chos rtsa ba nas dar ma myong ba'i nub phyogs kyi lung pa/ skad yig dang / goms gshis/ 'tsho ba skyel stangs bcas nga tsho dang tha dad yin pa de tsho'i nang nas skad yig goms gshis sogs kyi dka' ngal yod bzhin du deng skabs bod kyi nang chos la do snang chen po byed bzhin yod/rgya nag gis mtshon pa'i sa khul de dag la nang chos kyis tan tan phan thogs byed thub kyi red snyam pa rgyun du dran gyi 'dug der brten bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyi gces 'dzin bya rgyu 'di bod gcig pu'i khe phan ma yin par rgya nag gtso bor gyur pa'i sa khul de dag gi mi sa ya mang po'i bde sdug dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig chags yod/da lta rgya nag gi 'go khrid tshos bod kyi chos 'di rmongs dad la brtsis nas khong tshos 'di'i don shes kyi med kyang / rim pas lo nas lo bstud yul gyi nang gtam brjod rang dbang gi thob thang gang tsam byung ba'i mtshams la rgya nag gis bod kyi chos la do snang dang / srung skyob byed dgos pa zhig yong rgyu red/da lta nas rgya mi sger kha shas kyis de ltar byed kyi yod pa red/ bsam blo gtong mkhan tshos bod kyi chos 'di spyi tshogs yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / spyi tshogs zhi bde yong ba bya rgyu dang 'brel ba yod pa'i phan yod kyi chos gcig red ces 417

brjod pa'i dus shig yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug der brten ngos nas gtso bo rgyu mtshan de tsho'i thog bsam blo btang ste/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di nga tsho bod mi'i khe phan gcig pu ma yin par 'gro ba mi spyi dang / yang sgosaspe sha ya'i sa khul/ de'i nang nas kyang rgya nag gi khe phan la thug pa zhig yin bsam gyi yod/yang che sa nas bshad na/ btsan dbang ldan pa'i rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab de bzod pa'i nyams len dang / ya rabs kyi spyod pa ldan pa'i stobs chen rgyal khab gcig chags pa yin na de'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag la nyen kha chung du 'gro gi red/ de yang nub phyogs rgyal khab nas thon pa'i dpe deb kyi nang la deng skabs rgya nag nang mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba shugs che ru 'gro gi 'dug ces bris 'dug de yang gung khran ring lugs kyi lta ba pham nyes phyin pa'i tshab la mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta bas rgya mi tsho'i blo zin thabs dang /sems shugs ma chag pa'i thabs byed kyi yod pa dang / da lta dpal 'byor yar rgyas chen po 'gro ba dang chabs cig mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa dang / ma 'ongs par de mtshungs go mtshon yar rgyas phyin pa'i mtshams la 'dzam gling nub phyogs dang dmag 'khrug yong rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa red ces bris 'dug dngos po dang dpal 'byor yar rgyas phyin na/ dmag gi go mtshon shugs ma thub kyi yar rgyas 'gro gi red/ de dang chabs cig rtsa ba'i bsam blo'i khyer stangs mi rigs ring lugs kyi lta ba shugs chen spro zhig gi thog phyin pa yin na/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag la nyen kha tan tan yod/418

der brten 'dzam gling spyi'i thog nas bshadaka'ang rgya nag nang ji tsam mi'i sems zhi bde bag phebs dang / bzod bsran/ byams snying rje'i lta ba bcas slebs thub pa byung na de tsam gyis 'dzam gling spyi la phan jogs yong rgyu yin/nga tshos bod don la dka' las rgyab nas bod kyi bden don zhes brjod pa'i gtso bo ni bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyi gces 'dzin byed thub pa zhig dang / bod lung pa'i khor yug nyams nyes chen po mi 'gro ba/ bod 'di zhi ba'i bsti gnas shig la bsgyur rgyu bcas yin/ de ltar byung na nga tsho bod mi tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling spyi la phan thogs yong rgyu yin par ngos rang yid ches yod la/ de don 'grel bshad kyang byed kyi yod/ chab srid jog bod rang btsan gtsang ma zhig ma byung yang / nga rang tshos dpal 'byor gyi khe phan thog bsam blo btang na bod lung pa sa rgya chen spro yin yang / mi grangs nyung nyung yin/ phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas phyin med par nga tsho res lus thebs yod/ rjes lus kyi lung pa'i nang dngos po yar rgyas gtong bar gang ltar nga tshor rogs byed mkhan zhig dgos pa yin/ de rgya mi tsho byed du bcug na khong tshor dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i nus pa yod la/ nyams myong yang gang 'tshams yod/ khong tshos dpal 'byor yar rgya sa gtong rogs byas na des nga tshor phan thogs yong rgyu dang / rgya nag rgyal khab la'ang phan thogs yong rgyu yin pas 'grigs pa red/yang chos dang rig gzhung nang bsam blo yar rgyas dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi shes yon rig gzhung skor bod par rgyus mnga' yod cing de dag rgyun 'dzin 419

bdag skyong ji ltar byed de bod pas shes pa las rgya mi tshos shes kyi ma red/ngos nas mi rigs kyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi med/ gang zhig gal chen po yin zer na/bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyu 'di gal chen po yin/ de ni bod mi'i khe phan yin la/ rgya mi'i khe phan yang red/ 'dzam gling spyi'i khe phan dang yang 'brel ba yod pa yin/ dngos yod gnas tshul la bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di'i thad bod pa rang rgyus mnga' che ba yod/ der brten chos dang rig gzhung gtso bor gyur pa'i bod pa rang nyid kyis byed thub pa'i las rigs kyi 'gan bod pas gtsang ma blangs rgyu dang / bon skyed kyi 'phrul chas dang / dngos po yar rgyas gtong ba'i las rigs mang po zhig da phan rgya mis nga cos ngad par slob sbyong dang nyams myong gsog rgyu'i go skabs sprad med par brten da lta'ang nga tsho rjes lus thebs te bsdad yod pas de tsho'i rigs rgya mi rigs gcig mkhas pa tshos 'gan blangs nas rogs ram bya rgyu/ phyi 'brel dang rgyal srung gi las ka 'di kho rang tshos 'gan khyer na rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab red/ bod rang btsan zhes pa'i skad cha 'di rgya nag phyogs la ha cang gnod po zhig la brtsi gi 'dug pas ngos nas kyang de shod kyi med/ nga tshos rang btsan zhes brjod pa'ang bde skyid kyi rtsa ba red/rang srid rang skyong zhes brjod pa'ang bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yin/ gtso che shos bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung zhes 'dzam gling 'di'i thog ngoms su chog pa zhig yod pa 'di rgya nag the ba'i mi mang po'i khe phan la thug gi yod stabs 'di nyams shaṃ sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel rgyun 'khyongs yag po zhig byed thub pa 420

byung na/ de min chab srid kyi gnas stangs la gnad 'gag de tsam mi 'dugadeng sang 'tham gling gi lung pa yongs rdzogs phan tshun gcig la gcig brten gyi gnas stangs shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ bar lam ngos rang si pan gyi lung par bskyod pa yin/ de'i khongs su ba sa ka zhes pa'i rang skyong tshad mtho i lung pa zhig 'dug nga rang der slebs nas dpon rigs tsho dang phan tshun ngo shes kyi nye po chags song /nyi ma gcig ngos nas khong tshor khyed rang tsho rang btsan 'dod kyi 'dug gam/ gang zhig 'dod kyi 'dug ces skad cha dris pa yin/ khong tshos de'i lan du rang btsan 'dod kyi 'dug dang mi 'dug ces zhi dri ba 'di 'das pa'i lo brgya'i gong la byung na the tshom med par rang btsan dgos zhes brjod kyi red/ da cha nga tsho ba sa ka rang skyong gnas stangs 'og dpal 'byor si pan gyi lung pa spyi dang bsdur na nga tsho legs pa yod/ nga rang tshor rang gi skadayig dang / rig gzhung sogs dmigs bsal thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa de dag nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel cha tshang byed thub kyiyod/ der brten nga tsho rang btsan byas te zur du thon pa yin na'ang dmigs bsal gyi khe phan zhig yong rgyu med/ si pan khongs kyi rang skyong zhig byas te so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i skad dang rig gzhung cha tshang srung skyob bya rgyu dang / dpal 'byor gnas stangs thad khe phan che ba yod ces bshad byung / yang de bzhin kha sngonas ṭa li la slebs skabs de'i byang rgyud la 'jar man gyi skad yig spyod mkhan gyi rang skyong tshad mtho wa'i lung pa zhig 'dug khong tsho'i dpal 'byor gnas stangasalo si ṭi ri ya las legs pa yod pa dang / i 421

ṭa li spyi dang bsdur na'ang khong tsho legs pa 'dug khong chos rang skyong tshad mtho po zhig gi 'og rang nyid kyis 'char gzhi bkod de stangs 'dzin byas par brten las ka ma bob pa'i mi grangasa.i ṭa li rgyalacanangs las nyung ba 'dugader brten khong tshor rang skyong gi gnas stangs 'di'i thog nas khe phan che ba yod pa red/ dpe 'di bzhin nga chod ngad par cha bzhag na rgya nag rgyal khab chen po de'i khongs su bsdad de nga rang tshor dgos pa'i bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyu 'di'i 'gan cha tshang bod pa rang gis 'khyer thub pa zhig dang / cha tshang 'khyer chog pa'i gnas stangs gsal po zhig byung na/ lung pa yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thog rgya mi tshos nga tsho las lhag pa byed thub kyi yod pas de'i thad khong tshos byed rogs byas na yag po red snyam pa bcas ngos nas bsam blo 'di ltar gtong gi yod/ yin na'ang de ltar 'grub thub dang ma thub rgya nag phyogs la rag lus yod/ nga tshos rang btsan rtsod kyi med/ nga tshos rgya nag dang mnyam du skad cha bshad de nga tshor ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong zhig dgos pa dang / de yang bod chol kha gsum yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ mi zhig la mtshon na mgo lus cha lag yongs su tshang dgos pa ltar khams dang / a mdo/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa yang mi'i mgo lus dang / yan lag nying lag lta bu chags yod pas de dag kha bral na mi 'grigs zhes ngos nas shod kyi yod/ dper na/ deng skabs nga tsho btsan byol bar cha bzhag na/ mkhan po dge bshes dpe cha legs pa mang che ba khams pa dang / a mdo yin/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris khungs nas ha cang nyung nyung 422

red/ nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas lo sum cu so brgyad brgalayod pa red/ de'i ring mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod kyang / da dung mkhan po bgros pa tsho'i skye sa'i skyes yul zhib 'jug byas na mang che ba khams pa dang / de'i nang nas 'bri chu shar rgyud kyi khams pa chagasayod/ tre+e hor khams pa mang po yod/ de bzhin chos brgyud ris med nas bshad na/ nyag rong khul nas yong ba mang po yod pa gsal po red/ nga tsho de snga bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di chos rgyal bka' drin can tsho'i thugs rje la brten nas bod rgya khyab yongs su skad yig gcig gyur gyi thog nas dar spel gnang yod/ yul skad phran bu mi 'dra bayod pa ni skad gdangs mi 'dra ba tsam las yi ge'i thog bod rigs yongs rdzogs gcig gyur byas te 'gro giyod/ der brten bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang /bzo rig pa/ nang don rig pa sogs gang ci chol kha gsum ris su ma chad pas da bar bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas yod/ ma 'ongs parasang bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung mi nyams gong 'phel gyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum bya rgyur chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril nas 'gro dgos pa las/chol kha gcig dum bur phyin yang nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ der brten bod chol kha gsum gcig tu gnas rgyu 'di rtsa ba'i dmigs yul la brtsi gi yod/rgya nag gzhung gi ngos nas da lta bod rigs yod sa'i sa khul khag la rang skyong zer ba'i ming zhig btags te rang skyong jongs dang / rang skyong khul rang skyong rdzong zer ba sogs tshang mar ming re btagasayod/ dper na mtsho 423

sngon dang / kun su'u/ yun nan/ zi khron bcas pa'i bod rigs sa khul dang / gang ltar bod rigs yod sa'i sa khul khag rang skyong zer ba'i ming btags pa de dag rtsa khrims nang du bkod yod pa red/ der brten rgya nag gzhung 'drog 'go byed dgos don med/ nga tsho chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba zhes brjod pa 'di bod pas rang btsan dang kha bral byed kyi 'dug bsam pa'i rgya phyogs nas zhed snang byed kyi yod kyang / zhed snang byed dgos don med/dngos gnas bod pa rgya mi mnyam du 'cham mthun yag po byas nas sdod dgos na rgya mi'i ngos nas bod par blo bzhag sa zhig bzos dang / nga tsho bod pas bsam blo gtong gi red/ bod par rtag par rgyug brdung btang nas kha bral byed chog gi ma red ces brjod na/ duda'agro zhig yin na'ang rgyug brdung btang nas nyar thub thabs med pas/ 'gro ba mi ni de bas kyang los yin/ nga tshor rgyug brdung btang nas kha bral rgyu med ces brjod na sus nyan gyi red dam/byams po byas te nga tshor blo 'jog sa zhig sprad pa yin na nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang bsam blo gtong gi red/ nga tsho bod pa skug pa min pas rang nyid skyid pa zhig dang / gzhan dag bde ba zhig byung na nga tshos 'di 'dems kyi red/ nga tsho bod pas 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di bod par brgya cha brgya rgyal kha thob pa dang / pha rol rgya phyogs brgya cha brgya pham nyes yong ba'i bsam blo nga tshos gtong gi med/nga rang tsho rnam kun smon lam rgyag skabs 'gro ba sems can thams cad la bde ba yong ba shog ces brjod pa las/ nga skyid po yong ba dang / gzhan dag phung bar shog ces rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi smon lam rgyag gi med/ thams cad 424

la bde bayong ba dang / thams cad la skyid po yong bar shog ces smon lam rgyag gi yod/ de ltar smon lam rgyab pa bzhin nga tsho chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod byed dus kyang rgya mi tshor blo bzhag sa yod pa dang / bde skyid yod pa zhig yong ba'i dmigs yul bzung yod pa ltar de dag rim pas 'grub thub kyi red bsam gyi yod/ der brten chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i rang skyong zhig byung ba yin na dngos gnas nga tsho rwand pa tshorabasam blo gtong sa dang / blo bzhag pu zhig yong gi red/ rgya nag gzhung gi ngos la cha bzhag kyang bod kha bral la 'gro gi med/ rgyal srung dang phyi srid las don gnyis kyi 'gan rgya nag gzhung nas 'khyer rgyu dang / des rgya nag gzhung gi gcig gyur gyi dmigs yul 'grub yod/ gcig gyur gyi dmigs yul 'grub pa tsam du ma zad/ rgyun du dmag mis so blta byas te chig bsgril srung skyob byed dgos pa 'di mi dgos pa yong rgyu yin/ nga'i ngos nas rgya nag gi gnas stangs de'i 'og nas rtsa don bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dzam gling spyi la phan thogs byed thub pa'i nus pa yod pa 'di gnas thub pa zhig yong ba dang / de ltar yong ba la rgya mi dang mnyam du dgra kha gtad byas te skad cha bshad rgyu min par/ phan tshun grogs po'i 'du shes kyi thog nas rgya mi la yang khe phan dang don dag lag tu son rgyu yod pa'i gnyis mos kyi lam zhig rnyed na bsam ste da bar ngas 'bad brtson byed stangs 'di 'dra yin/ bar skabs ngos kyi dbu ma'i lam 'dir mi kha shas kyis byab chen po bskyal 'dug zer ba dang / thog ma nas har gong tshe tsam brgyab ste tshong sgrig pa ltar byed dgos zer ba/ bod 'di lo rgyus thog nas rang btsan 425
