gtsang ma yin pas rang btsan rtsod dgos pa las/ de nas babs na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces brjod mkhan byung yod/ ngas dbu ma'i lam 'di la phyogs gcig nas 'dzam gling thog nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang po byung ste rgyal kha thob yod/ yang phyogs gcig nas ngas gu bshangs gang yong ci yong byas pa 'di la rgya mi'i ngos nas mu mthud 'gro tshod rtsis te brda lan ma byas par brten ngos kyi dbu ma'i lam phyogs skor rgya mi dang mnyam du skad cha shod thub pa byung med/ sngon la ma lan ma 'gyod ched mi ma'i gi nang la bsam tshul ganga'ade de dag bsdu len byed thub na yag po 'dug ces nga tshos lo gcig gnyis nas mi mang gi bsam tshul gang 'tshams bsdus yod/ bod nang gi mi mang la dngos su yongs bsgrags byas te bsam tshul bsdu thabs med kyang / bod kyi sa khul gang sar gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ong byed mi tsho brgyud nga tshos gnas tshul gang tsam nyams zhib byed thub pa byung yod/ btsan byol la yod pa'i bod mi mang che ba'i bsam 'char phyogs bsdoms byed skabs/ da lta bar ngas thag gcod byas pa'i srid byus 'di rang byas na yag po 'dug pas/ 'phral du mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdu len byed ma dgos na yag po 'dug ces de ltar thon 'dug de bzhin bod nas lo gcig gnyis nang bsam 'char 'byor pa khag la phyogs bsdoms byed dus mang che bas da lta 7rgyal ba rin po che'i dbu ma'i lam zhes pa 'di dngos gnas kha yod lag yod kyi lag len bstar thub pa zhig dang / da lta'i dza drag gi gnas stangs skyob thub pa'i thabs shes yag shos shig 'dug ces khams dang / a mdo/ dbus gtsang bcas pa'i sa khul mang po'i bsam 'char 426

nang gcig gyur red 'dug nye char gros tshogs thog ngos nas da lta lam sang thag gca ma byas par da dung zla ba kha shas sgug na de'i bar bod nang nas gnas tshul phran bu 'byor rgyu dang / denas 'o da(sa ma'i gsum bcu'i dus dran skabs la nga'i ngos nas thag gather+shad kyi gsal bsgrags shig byas na zhes zhus pa yin/da lta bod rgya gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i gnas stangs dang / de dag gi rgyu mtshan nga 'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang byed stangs bcas 'di ltar yin pas khyed rang chos shes song ngam/ngos nas rnam kun bod pa su dang thug kyang skad cha rna ba tsha tsha shod mus ltar/ ya rabs spyod bzang byed dgos pa ltar bsgrub bya de sgrub pa'i gnas skabs la nga rang tsho so tsho/'i chos dang rig gzhung ngo shes pa byas te bdag po rgyag rgyu ha cang gal chen po red ces de ring tsam ma yin par rgyun du bshad kyi yod/deng sang bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi mthong tshul phyogs bsdoms nas bshad na/ slob grwa khag gi nang yin na'ang 'dra/ spyir btang spyi tshogs nang yin na'ang 'dra/ya rabs spyod bzang rim pas nyams zhan du 'gro gi yod pa'i mthong tshul zhig yong gi yod pa dang / dngul ma gtogs gzhan bsam rgyu med pa dang / rdzun shod pa sogs ma rabs kyi spyod pa phran bu mang du song nas mi'i spus ka zhan du 'gro gi 'dug ces brjod mkhan yod/ 'di'i thad nga tsho tshang mas gal che don chen la brtsis nas/ do snang byed dgos/ ya rabs spyod bzang zhes pa 'di ni 'dzin grwa'i nang slob tshan 'khrid pa lta bu byas nas bslab rgyu yod pa zhig min par/ de ni khyim tshang so so'i nang bza' tshang bar gyi 'brel ba dang / pha ma 427

bu phrug bar gyi 'brel ba byed stangs/ de bzhin khyim tshang gi rnam kun rgyun gyi gshis ka dang / spyod lam 'khyer stangs nas rgyun 'jags yong ba zhig yin pas skad cha shod stangs tshun ma rabs dang / ngo tsha khrel med 'di 'dra ma yin par/ ya rabs gus zhabs ldan pa'i mig tos bzang po zhig 'dzugs rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ de lugs khyim tshang so sos do snang byas te phru gu tshor lta rtog byed stangs dang / bskyed sring byed stangs/ spyir btang spyi tshogs nang rnam 'gyur ston stangs dang / skad cha shod stangs gang ci'i thog ya rabs bya rgyu bod pa'i srog rtsa yin bsam pa byed dgos/da bar 'dzam gling 'di'i thog bod pa zhes brjod dus bsngags brjod byed yul zhig la gnas yod/ de ni bod pa phyug po yin nas bsngags brjod job pa zhig min la/ yang bod pa shes yon chen po yod nas bsngags brjod thob pa yang min/ de ni bod par ya rabs kyi spyod pa zhig yod pa dang / bod pa'i gdong la rang bzhin 'dzum bag shig shigabyungad pa 'di la brten nas byung ba yin/ dka' ngal 'di tsam 'phrad kyang sems zhi bder gnas pa'i gshis ka 'dug ces mi mang pos bsngags brjod byed kyi yod pas 'di ni nga rang tsho'i nor bu lta bu yin/ nor bu rang gi lag par yod pa 'di bdag po yag po rgyag shes pa bya rgyu 'di ha cang gal che na po yin/ de'i thad mngon med 'thus shor gyis rim pas je sdug tu song ste mngon gsal dod po chags dus phyis drags pas 'phral du legs bcos byed mi thub pa'i nyen kha tan tan yod/ nga rang sbo tshang mas de la do snang byed dgos/428

nga tsho'i rtsa don bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung zhes pa 'di mi'i bde skyid dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pa dang / desang mi sgor gyi bde skyid dang 'brel bayod par ma zad/ spyi tshogs hril po'i bde skyid dang yang 'brel ba yod/ chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phelayong ba bya rgyu 'di dgon pa grwa tshang dang / rig gnas kyi sde gnas khag gcig pu'i las ka min pas nga rang tsho mang tshogs tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ lhag don khyim tshang so so'i nang nas do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen poyin/ de bzhin chos dad skor yang ngas rnam kun bshad mus ltar/ phru gu tsho'i bla ma dang po pha ma gnyis kyis byas nas phru gu chung chung skabs nas nga rang tsho nang pa yin pas skyabs 'gro byed dgos zhes bshad pa gcig pu mayin par/ sangs rgyas zhes pa dang / chos zhes pa/ dge 'dun zhes pa de dag gang 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas gtso bo chos yin pa/ chos de yang po ti brtsigs pa 'di dag rjod byed kyi tshig yin zhing / gtso bo lung gi chos sde stod gsum dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin/ de yang mthar gtugs na 'gog pa'i bden pa dang lam gyi bden pa 'di gnyis kyi steng nas chos ngo sprod byed dgos pa yin/ de gnyis kyi steng nas chos ngo 'phrod pa zhig byung na/ chos zhes pa 'di bsam blo gtong rgyuspend pa zhig dang / de dngos gnas kha yod lag yod mi'i sems la bzo bcos byed thub pa zhig yin pa shes thub/ chos zhes pa 'di grong chog rgyug pa lta bu dang / yang na sku gsung thugs rten sgrig gshom byed pa de 'dra la ngos 'dzin byas na yag po mi 'dug pha ma tshos phru gur chos ngo sprod byed skabs chos 429

khri'i steng sdod mi dgos la/ phru gu tshos kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul mi dgos par nu zho dang skyo ma ster ba'i dus nas 'go btsugs te maṇi bgrang pa'i phan yon dang /las rgyu 'bras/ tshe snga phyi/ 'gog bden dang / lam bden sogs chos kyi gnas lugs bshad de khong tsho chung dus nas chags sdang drag po'i gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba byed dgos/ phru gu yin kyang chags sdang drag po'i gzhan dbang du song na rang bzhin gyis ma skyid pa chags te ngus nas 'o ma 'thung 'phro yang bzhag gi yod pa ha cang gsal po yin/ chos zhes pa ni sems kyi skyon nyon mongs ngo sprad nas de med pa bzo ba'i thabs bstan pa zhig la brjod pa las skyabs su mchi brjod pa de tsam min/ der brten pha ma tshos rang ngos kyi chos kyi shes tshad yar rgyas gtong rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ de snga bod la chos dang dpe cha bslab rgyu 'di grwa pa'i las ka lta bu dang / de'i nang nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa tsho'i las 'gan yin pa lta bu las/ spyir btang gi mis chos slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin phal cher med/ 'di ni thabs skyo bo dang /nor 'khrul ha cang chen po yin pas de'i thad tshang mas do snang byed dgos /nga rang tshos de sngon shes yon tshogs chung zhes pa zhig btsugs yod pa 'dis gzhis chags khag nang las 'gul spel yod/ de khungs 'khyol yod med dang / nus pa thon yod med mi shes kyang / gzhon nu dang bud med kyi thog nas shes bya yar rgyas dang / 'phrod bsten skor slob sbyong sprod rgyu mjug bskyal nas byed kyi yod pa red/ de yang sngon ma'i lam bzhin bla mas chos khri'i steng nas chos bshad lta bu byed mi dgos par rnam kun gung seng dang /430

tshogs pa skyid sdug khag 'dzoms nas gling kha gtong ba sogs kyi skabs su chos kyi sgor shod res byas na rim pas do snang slebs rgyu dang / de yang nang pa'i chos dang phyi pa'i chos bar la khyad par gang yod pa dang / nang pa'i chos la'ang theg pa che chung gnyis kyi bar khyad par gang yod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos 'khor dang po bsgor ba'i skabs su bden pa bzhi gsungasayod pa de dag gang dang gang yin pa de tshor slob sbyong bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/gzungs sngags bgrangs pa dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / sbyor chos sogs chog 'don pa de tsho yag po yin yang de tsam gyis ha las rgyu med/ dngos gnas chos la 'gro minayang the stom gyi rang bzhin yin/ de ltar chos kyi gnad 'gag 'di shes dgos rgyu gal chen po yin pas de ring ngos nas gzhen skul zhus pa yin/ de lugs khyed rang tshos sems la bzhag nas go skabs yod dus bla ma dang / dge bshes tshad ldan de 'dra'i drung nas dus dus la chos kyi ngo sprod skor zhus na de ni tshe dbang dang byabs khrus zhus pa las lhag gi red/(mtshams 'dir lha srung bsten phyogs sgor bka' slob gnang ba rnams lha srung bsten phyogs kyi bka' slob byings khongs zla bsgril zhus/)bod don gyi 'thab rtsod 'di mi rabs nas mi rabs sbrel te las ka byed dgos pa zhig yin/ nga tsho rgya gar la slebs nas las ma'i rim pa dang por slob grwa btsugs pa yin/ skabs der dzña ram sa lar 'phral sel gsog sgar btsugs te bza' bca' dang sman bcos sogs 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dka' ngal yod na'ang phru gu tsho bdag po rgyab pa yin/ de ltar bdag po 431

rgyag dgos don nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod 'di mi rigs gcig gi don dgayin pas gal srid mi rabs nas mi rabs sbrel te 'thab rtsod byed dgos byung na/ mi rabs rjes ma rnams shes yonayod pa'i mi rabs shig bzo dgos stabs nga tshos las ga'i thog ma slob grwa btsugs pa yin/ skabs der stabs legs pa zhig la rgya gar gyi srid blon dam pa ne+e ha ru zhal bzhugs yod pas khong gis thugs khur chen po bzhes te nga la gsal po gsungs don/ bod don mu mthud ma brlag pa byed pa'i rtsaba'i 'gag mashes yon slob sbyong sprod rgyur thug yod pas bod phrug na gzhon mi rabs gsar pa de dag la shes yon slob sbyong sprod dgos/ 'dzam gling mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs la bod don skor thengs gcig snyan zhu phul ba des bod don ma brlag pa byed mi thub/ bod don ma brlag pa bya rgyu ni rtsa ba bod mi'i shes yon la rag lus yod/ der brten gzhon skyes tshor shes yon slob sbyong sprod rgyu gal chen po yin zhes bka' slob gnang byung /1959 lo'i zla bzhi pa'i nang nga tsho rgya gar la 'byor te ma su rir bsdad pa yin/ 'on sgros ma'i dpyid mtshams la nga tshos chu bzhi sgang drug gi tsho khag dang / las byed pa'i nang khul nas gzhon skyes lo nyi shu mgrangs sum cu zin ma zin gyi pho gsar lnga bcu tham pa bsdus nas ma su rir slob grwa thengs dang po btsugs pa yin/ de nas bzung da bar phal cher na gzhon khri lnga drug cig slob grwa 'grims nas thon yod cing / de tshor yag nyes la ma ltos par slob sbyong gi go skabs job yod/ nga tsho'i bod don 'di mi rigs gcig gi 'thab rtsod yin dus mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gnya' rus ma chag par 'thab rtsod 432

rgyun bsrings nas byed dgos pa las/ nga mi gcig bsdad pa'i ring bod don 'thab rtsod 'di gnas pa dang / nga mi gcig shi ba'i nyin mor bod don med pa chags rgyu 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas min/ngos nas yang srid sgor bshad pa 'diyang gcig nas ma 'ongs par tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid ngos 'dzin bya rgyu'i gnas tshul zhig byung ba yin na/ rgya phyogs nas yang srid ngos 'dzin byas te tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen bla ma gnyis ku'i yang srid kho rang tshos bsgos/ de brgyud nas bod dang bod mi mang dbang bsgyur byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red ces zer mkhan kha shas 'dug de 'dra'i bsam blo gtong gi yod pa yin na/ gal te nga tsho btsan byol la sdod ring nga 'das grongs phyin pa'i dbang du btang yang bod nang nga'i yang srid skye gi ma red ces ngas bshad yod/ yang srid de brgya cha brgya tham pa rgya mi'i 'og skye gi ma red ces ngas bshadayod/ 'di la rgyu mtshan yod/ yang srid yong ba'i dgos don dmigs yul ni tshe snga mas las ka 'go btsugs pa'i grub 'bras son rgyur bsdad pa de'i 'phro skyong byed par yong ba ma gtogs de gtor bshig gtong mkhan zhig yong shes kyi ma red/ dper na/ ngos lha mo don grub kyis las ka 'go btsug pa de 'phro can du lus na nga'i yang srid yin brjod mkhan gyi phru gu zhig gis nga lha mo༄ dun grub kyis 'go btsugs pa'i las ka 'di gtor bshig btang na de ni nga'i yang srid min pa'i rtags yin zhing /nga'iyang srid yin na de 'dra yong shes kyi ma red/ der brten gal te btsan byol la sdod skabs nga shi ba dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang la nga'iyang srid gcig 433

dgos 'dod yod na/ nga'i yang srid rang dbang lung pa'i nang skye gi red ces ngas bshad yod/ 'di ni dngos yod gnas tshul yin/ rgyu mtshan la bsam blo zhig thongs dang / nga tsho'i chos 'di yang rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i chos shig yin/yang srid phebs rgyu 'di yang rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / phan thogs yod pa zhig phebs dgos pa las/ thug pa bskol mkhan zhig gi yang srid cig yong shes kyi ma red ces ngas 'grel bshad byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang phyi rgyal khul nas skad cha 'dra min 'dra bshad mkhan yong gi 'dug khong tsho kha shas ni skad cha 'dri rgyur dga' po yod pa red/ tā la'i bla ma'iyang srid bud med kyi rten la phebs kyi red dam/ de snga bod kyi bla ma'i nang bud med yod med 'dri mkhan yong gi 'dug ngos nas dper na bsam sding do je phag mor cha bzhag na bla ma chen po red/ khong gi rten bud med red ces bshad kyi yod/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng gi nang la da bar bud med kyi rten la phebs pa byung med/ ma 'ongs pa de tshe de'i dus bud med kyi rten la phebs pa yin na bstan pa dang 'gro bar phan thogs che ba zhig yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags na/ bud med kyi 7rgyal ba rin po che zhig yong gi red ces bshad kyi yod/ de ltar yong ba tsam du ma zad rnam pa yang yag po zhig yong gi red ces bshad kyi yod/ skad cha 'di phyed ka rtsed mo lta bur go srid kyang de ltar min/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten sgo thams cad nas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong ba la rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa zhig dgos zhes gsungs yod pa ltar gzugs bzang ba la sogs pa de tsho gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha rkyen la dgos pa yin/ ta la'i bla ma 434

mdog nyes shig byung na skyabs su mchi/ zhal ras 'di de 'dra'i nyes pa las zer gyi red/ rnam pa yag po yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig ni de 'dra'i tā la'i bla ma de rten rab byung byed dgos pa las khyim pa'i rtenayong gi ma red/ rab byung byas na rang bzhin gyi rnam pa yag po med tshe gdong la tshos byug pa dang /mchu to dmar po bzo ba/ mig spa sdus ma bsgar ba de 'dra byed chog gi ma red/7rgyal ba rin po che'i rten btsun༄ mar yong na rang bzhin gyi rnam pa yag po zhig yong gi red ces bshad yod/ de ni rtsed mo dang ngo ma gnyis ka yin/ ngas yang srid skor brjod pa 'di rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul zhig 'grel bshad byas pa las/ rig 'dzin bla ma thugs bsun nas/ mkha' spyod zhing la dgongs pa gtad/ zhes brtan bzhugs nang yod pa ltar ngos rang mkha' spyod zhing la 'gro thub min mi shes kyang blo sna thu nga thung byas pa rtsa ba nas min/ de skor kha sngon skabs de rang la dzña ram sa lar brtan bzhugs skor las ka byed mkhan tshor 'grel bshad brgyab pa yin la/ de ring 'dir zhor la bshad na snyam pa byung /khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas te sdod rogs/ nga rang gzugs po bde thag chod yin/ lo drug cu re gsum la slebs nas sku mdun sku gong ma las nga rgan pa chags zin pa da nga / 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum byung ba'i nang nas nga las dgung lo bgres pa da dung 7gong sa lnga pa chen po dang / dge 'dun rgya mtsho/dge 'dun grub pa bcas gsum lhag yod/ lo drug cu re drug la slebs na 7rgyal dbang lnga pa'i dgung lo las brgal rgyu dang / de nas drug cu re brgyad la slebs na dge 'dun rgya mtsho las brgal rgyu/ de 'dun grub pa dgung lo brgyad 435

cu gya bzhi bzhugs yod pasalo brgyad cu gya lnga gya drug la slebs na de las brgal rgyu red/ da lta gzugs po'i gnas stangs nas bshad na tshe ring tsam sdod thub bsam gyi 'dug yin na'ang nga rang gi tshe 'di rkyen mang po zhig la tos dgos pa yin pas/ khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas dad pa dam tshig mthun po dang / da lta nang bzhin hur thag byed dgos pa dang / nga rang gi ngos nas kyang hur thag byed kyi yin/ tshe sgrub byed kyiyod la/ bsam blo ga dus yin kyang zhi rdzod du gnas pa las sems pa ma skyid pa gang yang med/ bod spyi pa'i don dag gi sems khur len gyiyod/ 'on kyang 'khor ba'i chos nyid red snyam pa rtag par dran gyi 'dug snying rje/ bod nang yod pa'i mi mang de dag dngangs skrag chen pospend pas gang drag bsam pa las/ gzhan gnas tshul de 'dra zhig red/ gal che shos so so'i mi tshe 'di don dang ldan pa zhig dang / mi gzhan sems pa skyid po yong ba dang / khong tshor blo bag spros rogs shig las byed ma thub kyang des rang gi mi tshe gcig gi dgos don 'grub pa yin pas gal chen po red/ gzhan dag gnad 'gag mi 'dug khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas te sdod/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che zhes bka' stsal// //436

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1997 zla 11 tshes 21 nyin don grub gling gzhis chags kyi ser skya mi mang dang / slob phrug bcas la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir zhu rgyu la/ 'dir las bsdoms rgyas pa zhig yig thog tu yod pa dang / da lta snying bsdus shig gsungs par gzhigs na/ da lta bar duyar rgyas kyi rnam pa gsal po mtshon thub pa byung ba desag po red/ sa gnas sa sgog tu las ka byed mkhan tshos lo nas lo bstud de dka' las rgyab pa'i grub 'bras red/ khyed rang tsho tshang mar thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ de nas khyed tsho slob phrug gzhas sna 'khrab mkhan dang / de bzhin na gzhon 'khrab ston mkhan tshang mas dang dang dod dod kyis hur thag byas pa la dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhu gi yin/nga tsho bod pa gzhis byes gang du yin na yang bod par dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos gang yod dam zer na/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang nas bod pa'i gnas tshul shes mkhan tshang mas ha lam gcig gyur gyi thog nas bod par dga' po byed sa'i gzhi gtso bo de bod pa tsho'i gshis rgyud 'jam po dang / ga dus yin na yang 'dzum shig shig yod mkhan mi gshis bzang spro zhig mthong gi yod pa red/ phyi sgrol ba thod la blta skor du 'gro mkhan tshos bod pa tsho btsan gnon myong mkhan dang / rgya mi btsan gnon gtong mkhan yin na yang bod nang la rgya mi de tsho ga dus yin na yang gdong nag po bstan mkhan/ bod pa btsan gnon myong mkhan de tsho ga dus yin na yang 'dzum shig shig 'dug khyad mtshar mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces zer mkhan mang po yong gi 'dug yang bod 437

la lta skor 'gro mkhan gcig bal yul brgyud dzña sar yong ste nga la khong rang gi mthong tshul byung ba de rnams bshad byung / mi de sems shugs chen po dang /bod par dga' zhen dang sha tsha chen po 'dug bod nang la gnas tshul ha cang thabs skyo po 'dug ste yin na yang bod pa la bden mtha' gsal thub pa'i re ba chen po 'dug zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan la bod nang bod pa thug 'phrad skabs gcig gis gcig la gdong bstan te mig thad /ra bltas nas 'dra mnyam dang /spobs pa ldan pa'i thog nas skad cha bshad kyi 'dug rgya mi thug skabs lam seng gdong pa phar g.yol te 'gro gi 'dug des mi'i rang bzhin gyi bsam blo'i gting gi spobs pa dang / snying stobs che chung de gsal po mngon gyi 'dug de ltar na bod par tan tan bden pa'i mtha' gsal gyi red/ de la nga yid ches gtsang masku/da ces bshad byung / gang ltarayang snying bod nang gnas tshul thabs skyo po dang / dza drag de 'dra gcig gi 'og la yin na yang rang bzhin gyi bod pa'i bzang wa'i rnam 'gyur de 'gog tu med pa zhig yod pa dang / bod pa btsan byol ba tsho yang de de bzhin du yod pa red/ nga tsho bod par 'brel ba yod pa/dper na/ phyi lo drug cu bdun cu'i nang bod par rogs ram byed mkhan tshogs pa de 'dra'i mi da cha rgan yol la phyin te spo bo lags dang rmo bo lags chags bsdad mkhan de tsho'i gras kyis bod par rogs byas pa der dngos gnas rang grub 'bras mthong rgyu yod pa ha cang yag po red/ bod par rogs byas pa de byed rin chog pa byung zhes dga' po byed mkhan mang po yod/ de bzhin du dzña ram sa la dang / nga tsho bod pa yod sa'i sa cha khag la phyi rgyal nas yul/ 438

skor spro 'cham pa mang po zhig gis bod pa'i dkyil la slebs dus skyid po dang dga' po byung zhes bshad kyi 'dug nga tsho bod pa la khyad chos gcig yod pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i gshis ka bzang po yod pa 'di red/ yang sdug chag 'dra mi 'dra byed mkhan re zung yod kyang / spyi yongs kyi cha nas bshad pa yin na tos sa ltos 'jog gi bod pa'i gshis ka de mi tshos rang bzhin gyis dga' po byed yul zhig yod pa de gsal po red/ de nga tsho'i khyad nor red/ ma gzhi nga tsho so so'i lung pa shor te yul gyar pa red/ gnas dus gsar pa zhig gi 'og la ngo shes mang po chags/ gang du phyin na yang grogs po grogs mched kyi 'du shes thog nas nga tshor skyo rogs lta bu byed mkhan mang po byung na so so rang nyid la phan gyi 'dug bzang po'i yon tan zer mkhan 'di shin tu rtsa ba chen po red/ nga rang chorwa nad pa'i goms gshis ma brlag pa byed dgos kyi 'dug zer ba'i dgos pa 'di red/ goms gshis 'ga' shas byab bskyal mkhan de 'dra yod pa de tsho'i gras gnas tshul tha dad red/ dper na gos gyon stangs/skra bzhag stangs/ so so'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so thun mong ma yin pa yod/ gal che shos rtsa ba'i mi'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so dang / gshis ka bzang po yod pa de nga tsho'i khyad nor yin pa 'di nga tshos ngos 'dzin gsal po byed dgos kyi 'dugad lta chos don bka' blon gyis gsungs pa bzhin ga le ga ler mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas shog bu snum zos lta bur rim pa rim pas bzang wa'i gshis ka de rnams nyung du phyin/ ma rabs khrel med kyi gshis ka rnams 'char can rgyun gshis lta bur 'jags pa yin na shin tu nyen kha chen po red/ nga tshos bod 439

kyi bden pa'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo de/ nga tsho'i lung pa rgya mis 'phrog song / nga tsho nad theg ge mi 'dug zer ba 'di gcig pu ma yin par/nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo de bod la thun mong ma yin pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / de dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung mi la kha yod lag yod kyi phan bogs yod pa/ mi la bde skyid yong ba'i nus pa dang / goms gshis bzang po zhig yod pa 'dis bod mi rigs rang nyid la phan pa tsam du ma zad/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs/ byang la phar rtsis pa yin na sog po phyi nang gi mtshon pas hor gyi yul khag yang sgos lhag par can du rgya mi'i nang la bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nas phan thogs byed thub pa'i nus pa dang cha rkyen tan tan yod/ bod mi sa ya drug the bas mi sa ya mang po zhig dang / lhag par du rgya mi sa ya mang po zhig la phan thogs byed thub pa'i nus pa yod pa'i bzang po'i gomasagashis dang / rgyun srol 'di dag rtsa med shul med 'gro ba 'di shin tu phangs po dang / mthar thug mi mang po zhig la gyong gun chen po phog rgyu'i gnas tshul 'di la brten nas rgya mi'i bya spyod 'di 'grig gi mi 'dug ces nga tshos rtsod pa rgyag gi yod/ srid don gcig pu'i rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam blo'i thog nas rtsod pa zhig dang / 'thab rtsod byed pa zhig rtsa ba nas min/ nga tshos 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dmigs yul de bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi ched yin dus/ bod mi rang nyid kyi nyin re nyin re'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so rnams nga tsho'i rtsa don dmigs yul de dang mthun pa'i ya rabs bzang po'i spyod pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ nga rang tshos nyin re nyin 440

re'i spyod lam dang / bsam blo'i 'khyer so ma rabs tha shal gyi byed stangs sgang la phyin pa yin na/ nga tshos rang dbang rtsod len byed pa'i dmigs yul dang 'gal ba red/ gal te nga rang tsho 'thab rtsod byed mkhan gyi ngos nas sgo gsum bzang po'i spyod pa la do snang gang yang ma byas par sprang lto khrel med ma rabs tha shal gyi byed stangs thog la sgod g.yengs phyin pa yin na/ dngos gnas rang nga tsho'i bsgrub bya'i dmigs yul dang ma mthun pa dang / phyin chad nga rang mo gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ste so so'i lung par slebs skabs lung pa de'i nang la ma rabs tha shal gyi spyod pa zhig mnyam du slebs pa yin na/ rang dbang son dang ma son la de tsam gyi khyad med pa 'dra po chags pa red/ des nas rabs spyod bzang zer mkhan 'di nga tsho'i khyad nor yin par ngos 'dzin byas te/ 'di la bdag po rgyag thub pa byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po red/'di la bdag po rgyag stangs de yang kha nas nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung bzang spro yin zhes lab pa tsam min par/ so so'i gshis ka la 'jags thub pa'i sgo nas bdag po rgyag dgos/ de yang gtso che shos khyim tshang so so'i nang la gshis kur 'jags thub pa dgos kyi 'dug bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dzin gyi yod ces dgon pa'i nang la dge 'dun pa gang tsam zhig gis 'don pa bton pa gcig pu ma red/ mang tshogs rang gi nang la bzang po'i ya rabs kyi spyod pa'i mig ltos spel thub pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug sgor so so'i ngos nas chos la dad pa yod rung med ru nga / sger so i ngos nas chos dad yod min dang /na nga pa yin min la ma tos par rang nyid gang du gtogs sa'i spyi tshogs de'i 441

nang ya rabs bzang spyod kyi goms gshis 'jags pa zhig dgos kyi 'dugabazang po'i goms gshis de'i rtsa ba thug sa nang pa'i chos dang 'brel ba yod pa gsal po red/ dper na/ ya rabs zer ba 'dis mi la brtsi bkur byed pas ma tshad/ srog chags grog sbur tshun chad la brtse ba byed kyi yod/ gzhan la brtse ba dang / gus pa'i bsam pa yod na de la gnod pa byed pa'i bsam blo dang spyod pa rang shugs kyi 'gag yong gi red/ de'i rtsab thug sa nang pa'i chos dang / de'i nang nas theg pa chen wa'i bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zer mkhan de la thug gi yod/ nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi ga nga la nang pa'i chos la dad pa med mkhan tsho gnas tshul tha dad red/ nang pa'i chos la do snang yod pa dang / dad pa yod mkhan tshos nang pa'i chos shes pa byed dgos/ chos slob sbyong byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po mthong gi 'dugad lta nga rang tshor pha mes nas mig ltos goms gshis su ya rabs spyod bzang 'jags pa tsam las dmigs bsal gyi dpyad pa byas te dge mtshan mthong ba'i thog nas so sos nyams len byas pa gang yang ma red/ mig tos goms gshis kyi thog 'jags pa de rim pas dus tshod bsrings yong dus 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu las sla po red/ gang ltar nga tshosaya rabs spyod bzang zer mkhan 'di la dgos pa rgyu mtshan gang yod pa dang / phan thogs gang yod pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsam blo btang nas rgyu mtshan mthong / yid ches rnyed pa'i thog nas de la dgos pa 'dug lag len byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa'i sems shugs shig slebs pa yin na/ de goms gshis thog nas 'jags pa tsam ma yin par/ rgyu mtshan 442

mthong ba'i thog nas gces spras bdag po rgyab pa zhigayin dus de 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu ha cang khag po red/ dper na / spyi lo drug cu'i nang la nga rang tsho bod pa gzhon skyes 'ga' shas kyis chos zer ba 'di de tsam gal chen po ma red bsam pa dang / kha shas kyi bsam tshul la/ nga tshos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la mgo 'khor/ des rkyen pas so so'i lung pa shor song zer mkhan byung yod/dper na/ phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya sum cu/ bzhi bcu'i yas mas la bod kyi chos la bla ma'i chos lugs zhes ming btags/ de la rtsed mo rtsed sa dang /ltad mo lta sa lta bur ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ phyi lo chis stong bdun cu dang /brgyad cu'i nang la bod kyi chos la rgyu mtshan gang 'dra yod med dang / bsam blo gtong sa gang 'dra yod pa rnams rim pas shes mkhan mang du phyin pa'i skabs la gzhi nas bod kyi chos 'di ltad mo lta yul dang / lag rtsed byed yul ma yin par/ 'di la rgyu mtshan yod pa dang / 'dis phan thogs yod pa'i ngos 'dzin gsar pa zhig 'dzam gling sa khul mang po nas byed kyi yod/ lhag par tshan rig pa'i nang nas spyir nang pa'i chos/ de'i nang nas bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di rmongs dad kyi skad cha min pa/ der bsam blo gtong sa yod pa dang / rgyu mtshan yod pa zhig tu gzhi nas mthong ba dang / do snang gsar du byed kyi 'dug de ltar na nga rang tsho bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang la bod kyi chos slob sbyong nges can zhig byed dgos pa ha cang gal chen po 'dug slob sbyong byas nas dge bshes byed rgyu'i don min la/ rgyugs sprod byed rgyu'i don yang min/ so so chos der dad pa ni yode/ dad pa byed sa'i chos de ji tsam mang 443

ba shes pa'i tshod kyis so so sems skyid pa dang / 'don pa zhig bton na yang de'i don bsam blo'i nang la 'khor thub pa'i khe phan chen po yod/ don dag ma shes na sgra 'dzin 'khor lo btang ba 'dra po zhig red/ don dag dang gnad 'gag shes pa yin na so so kha 'don dge sbyor zhig byas pa yin na yang spas dag po dang / don snying ldan pa/ so so'i blo yid tshim pa zhig yong rgyur ba|na nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la chos slob sbyong byed rgyu gal chen po yin/ ngas chos slob sbyong byed dgos zer ba 'di bla mas gsung chos mang po gnang dgos kyi 'dug zer gyi med/ nga rang tsho 'dzin gra tshogs pa'i lta bu byas/ slob gra ba tshor slob grwa'i nang gi chos dge tsho dang / dge rgan tshos phran bu slob kyi yod pa red/ de min gzhon nu pho mo tsho dang / spyir btang khyim tshang nang nas do snang yod mkhan tshos las ku'i dus tshod dang bstun/ 'dzin gra lta bu tshogs de'i nang la chos slor 'grel bshad rgyag mkhan zhig gi 'grel bshad rgyab /dper na da gin ngas 'grel bshad rgyab pa nang bzhin red/ byang chub kyi sems zer mkhan 'di'i byang zer ba'i don gang yin/ chub zer ba'i don gang yin/de bzhin du thar pa zer ba 'di gang 'dra yin pa/ 'khor ba zer ba 'di gang 'dra la zer gyi yod pa/ de bzhin bden pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas dkon mchogachos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog zer mkhan 'di dag gang 'dra yin pa/ 'di tsho'i gras dri ba dris lan byas/ 'grel bshad kyi thog nas shes pa bzo rgyu gal chen po 'dug de bzhin skye ba snga phyi dang / las rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di tsho da da mos kyi skad cha ma yin par rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas bshad kyi yod 444

pa 'di m+mu sgor brtsad dpyod byas te shes pa byed dgos/ khyed rang tsho don gling gzhis chags pa'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal la 'dir chos sgar 'ga' shas yod pa red/ chos sgar phan tshun gyi nang nas mkhan po rnam pa tshos yin yang rung / bla ma rnam pa tshos yin yang rung / 'grel bshad bskyon te nang chos kyi gnad don shes pa bzo dgos/ cho ga 'don rgyu'i skad cha ma red/ dbang bskur dang / tshe dbang / byab khrus byed dgos zer ba min/ nang chos kyi rmang gzhi yag po shes pa'i ched du dus dus la 'grel bshad rgyab/ khyed rang tshos de'i thog la go bsdur byas/ bgro gleng byas te khyim tshang so so'i nang gi pha ma tsho nang chos shes mkhan zhig chags pa yin na so 16) khyim tshang de'i nang gi phru gu tshor nang chos dang po ngo sprod byed mkhan pha ma tsho chags yong gi red/pha ma tshos bla ma dang po byed dgos zhes ngas zer gyi yod/ pha ma tsho nang chos shes mkhan zhig yin na phru gur bslab cha rgyab nas chos dkon mchog 'di 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog 'di 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod/nga i chos 'di ye shu'i chos dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di dang 'di yod/lhan rdu'i chos dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di yod/ kha che'i chos dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'diyod/ spyir btang kha che'i chos/ lhan rdu'i chos/ ye shu'i chos tshang ma yag po red/ mi mang po la phan gyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho nang pa red/ nang pa'i chos kyi khyad par 'di dang / 'di 'dra'i thog nas bshad kyi yod ces/ gang ltar khyim tshang tsho'i nang nas phru gu chung chung skabs bslab thub mkhan de 'dra zhig nga tshos nges par du bzo dgos kyi 'dug de khyed tsho'i dgongs yo5

par bcangs dgos/ ngas 'di skor 'bod bskul byed kyi yod/ gzhis chags 'di chung chung red/ khyed rang tsho kha shas kyis phal cher lag len bstar thub mi yong ngam/ kha sa bkra shis 'khyil dgon pa la'ang 'bod bskul byas pa yin /sngar kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku phreng dang po'i gsung gi nang la grub mtha'i dpe cha 'dus chen po yag po zhig yod/ ngas mang po lta myong /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i grub mtha' lta bu'i thog nas 'khrid kyi yin na yag po yong gi red/ sngar gna' rabs rgya gar nang mu stegs pa gang 'dra gang 'dra yod pa/ khong tsho'i bsam blo gtong stangs gang 'dra yin pa/ nang gses kyi khyad par gang 'dra yod pa/ de nas nang pa'i grub mtha'i nang la bye brag smra ba/mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa de tsho'i gras rim pa bzhin bshad yod/nang pa rang gi nang la yang grub mtha' gong 'og gi lta ba dang spyod pa la khyad par gang yod med 'di dag shes pa byung ba yin na/ so so ma ṇi zhig bton pa yin na yang gzhi nas bsam blo gting ring po 'khor ba'i thog nas ma ṇi 'don rgyu yod pa/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchicad zer dus sems kyi gting nas 'gul bskyod thebs rgyu yod pa zhig yong gi red/ 'di shin tu gal chen po mthong gi 'dug gal te nga rang tsho'i gzhon nu pho mo'i nang la dmigs bsal chos dad med mkhan yin na yang grub mtha' bslab dgos/ spyir btang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la ba /na' bo'i dus nas mi'i sems yar rgyas gang 'dra phyin pa dang /mi'i rnam dpyod yar rgyas phyin pa la brten nas lta ba dang / grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'dra min gang 'dra byung ba/ mi re ngo re'i bsam blo gtong stangs gang 446

'drayod pa 'di cho ses yon gyi 'du shes kyi thog nas rākha sbyong byas na phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ dper na/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang gi slob grwa che khag phal mo che'i nang la 'dzam gling gi chos lugs 'dra min 'di tsho'i gras slob sbyong byed pa 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang sar 'dug khong tshos chos nyams len byed pa'i ched du ma red/ dper na/ nang chos dang 'brel ba med mkhan ye shu'i chos pa 'am/ yang na hin rdu'i chos pa/ yang na kha che'i chos pa yin na yang /rang lugs dang nang pa'i chos la khyad par gang 'dra yod med shes pa yin na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag red ma gtogs/ gnod pa gang yang med/ phan thogs yong gi red/ slob sbyong byed stangs 'di 'dra'i thog nas nga tshos gsar gtod byas na bsam pa dran byung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzad pa'i grub mtha' de ha cang yag po yod/ sngon la grub mtha' bsdus bsdus shig gi thog nas go bde gcig sprad/ de nas rgyas su btang ba yin na 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ra nga gis mdzad pa'i grub mtha' chen mo dang / da dung zhib phra btsal 'tshol byed kyi yin na dpal ldan chos rjes mdzad pa'i grub mtha' ha cang yag po yod/de tsho'i thog nas slob sbyong rgya che chung gang yang byed rgyu yod/ de ga nang bzhin slong chen rab 'byams pa'i gsung gi nang la yang grub mtha' yod/ de dang de 'dra ba'i ri gas la slob sbyong byed rgyu byung na yag po 'dug nyams len byed mkhan zhig gi cadas nas bshad pa yin na ji tsam nang chos kyi rtsa ba dang / grub mtha'i 'gro stangs shes pa de'i tshod kyi sems la yid ches dang / shes nas dad pa thob rgyur khyad par chen po yod/ dmigs bsal chos dad med pa dang /447

nyams len byed rgyu'i 'du shes med na yang / 'di tsho shes bya'i rnam grangs su shes thub na yag po red/spyir 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa'i chos la do snangayod mkhan rigs gnyis 'dug rigs gcig ni bod pa dang / rgya mi/ ko ri ya/ rgya gar ba khag gcig bal yul lta bu pha mes nas nang pa yin bsam nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro mkhan rigs gcig 'dug yang rigs gzhan de chos lugs 'dra min mang po la zhib 'jug byas pa'i skabs su nang pas bshad lugs 'di tshan rig dang mthun pa/ rgyu mtshan bsam blo gtong sa yod pa/ dpyad pa byed sa yod pa/ dpyad pa byed stangs la rang dbang yod pa zhig dang / chos lugs gzhan dag phal mo che'i nang la so sos dad pa byed sa'i chos de la dogs pa byas te dri ba dris mi chog par de dkon mchog gi bka' red ces yid ches byas nas sdod dgos pa/ nang pa'i chos spyi dang / de'i nang nas theg chen gyi chos nang la rgyal ba'i bka' rang la dpyad pa byas chog pa dang / zhib 'jug byas chog gi yod pa sogs chos lugs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par de tsho la ngo mtshar skyes te gzhi nas nang pa'i chos byed mkhan yong gi 'dug de ha cang brtan po yod/ spyir nga rang tsho nang pa byed mkhan yod tshad rim pa de'i thog nas 'gro dgos zer ba min na yang / nang pa'i chos kyi khyad chos rtsa ba ngos 'dzin byed stangs rim pa de'i thog nas 'gro dgos kyi 'dug dper na nga rang tsho'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi nang la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brangs dang /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brangs zhes rigs gnyis bshad yod pa ltar/ rigs 448

gcig dad pa kho na'i thog nas 'gro mkhan yong gi red de/ spyir btang 'khrid stangs dang / go rim bstan stangs de chos kyi rjes 'brangs gzhir bzhag pa'i thog nas 'khrid dgos pa de gal chen po min nam bsam gyi 'dug de rin po che rnam pa tsho'i thugs la bcangs dgos/ kha sang bkra shis 'khyil la'ang bka' mol zhu rgyu byung /de nas phru gu'ishes yon slob sbyong gi thog la nga rang tsho bod pa'i gzhis chags che chung tshang mas gzhi nas do snang byas te shugs rgyag gi yod/ da lta sa cha 'dir cha bzhag na/ khyed tsho mthun rkyen 'dzoms min gyi dka' ngal mang po zhig yong gi yod na yang / tshang mas de gal chen por rtsis nas 'bad brtson mu mthud gnang gi yod pa dang / grub 'bras kyang gang la gang tsam thon par thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ phru gu tshos shes yon sbyangs pa dang chabs cig rtsa ba'i mi'i gshis ka bzang po dgos pa der khyed rang tshos nges par du do snang byed dgos/ de ma brjed pa byed dgos/ phru gu so so'i ngos nas gshis ka bzang po zer mkhan 'di gal chen po yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed rgyu gal chen po red/gshis ka bzang po yong ba'i 'gan khur gathorwa 1 pha ma dang / dge rgan tshos len dgos/ 'dzin gra'i nang la dge rgan tshos phru gur slob tshan 'khrid pa tsam ma yin par/ phru gu'i mi che'i mdun lam la yang sems khur mnyam du blangs nas phru gu tshor sha tsha dang sems khur yod pa'i thog nas slob 'khrid byed thub pa byung ba yin na/ phru gu'i ngos nas kyang dge rgan la gus brtse dang / dga' zhen/ snying nye po yong gi red/ khyim tshang nang la'ang pha ma tshos de de bzhin 449

byas nas phru gu tsho'i skad cha shod stangs tshun ya rabs dang / bzang po'i goms gshis 'jags thub thabs pha ma'i ngos nas rgyun du do snang dang / slob ston byed dgos/ 'dzin gra'i nang nas dge rgan tshos phru gur slob sbyong sprad pa dang chabs cig bzang po'i goms gshis dge rgan rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa'i thog nas phru gu la ngo sprod lta bu byas/ so so'i khyim tshang nang la pha mas zhar dang zhor la bzang po'i ya rabs kyi goms gshis ngo sprod dang / de tsho gal chen spro yin pa'i gzhen skul zung 'brel du byas te lo bcu grangs mu mthud pa yin na/ de 'dra zhig gi 'og nas thon pa'i phru gu de phyin chad 'tshar longs yong dus 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i ya rabs bzang po'i spyod pa yod pa zhig yong gi red/ de shin tu gal chen po red/ phru gu tshos shes dgos pa red/shes yon gcig pur ngo mtshar che rgyu de tsam mi 'dug deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang gi nub phyogs rgyal khab tsho dngos po yar rgyas shin tu chen po yod/shes yon ha las pa'i yag po yod na yang / shes yon gyis phyug pa'i spyi tshogs tsho'i nang la dka' ngal mang spro zhig yong gi 'dug shes yon dang / dngos po yar rgyas kyi cha nas phongs pa med pa zhig la da dung dka' ngal 'phrad pa de'i rgyu rkyen la nyams zhib byed mkhan mang po zhig gcig gyur gyi ngos 'dzin la/ spyi tshogs nang dang / lhag par khyim tshang gi nang la ya rabs dang / byams snying rje'i 'tsho bas ma ldang pa'i rkyen gyis spyi tshogasanang la dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'dug ces deng sang bshad kyi 'dug de 'dra yin dus 'dir shes yon gyi thog la 'brel ba yod pa dang / 'gan khur yod pa tshang mas gnad don 'di la ltod 450

g.yengs ma song ba dgongs pa bzhes rogs gnang zhes zhu rgyu yin/de nas bod spyi pa'i gnas tshul spyi yongs kyi thog nas khyed tsho tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ rgya bod gnyis kyi dka' ngal sel thabs la ngas dbu ma'i lam zhes zer gyi yod/ lo rgyus kyi thog nas nga rang tsho bod rang btsan rgyal khab tha dad pa cig red/ sngar chos rgyal tsho'i skabs nas rdo ring layi ge bkod de rgya rgya yul na skyid/ bod bod yul na skyid ces rgya dang bod tha dad so so/ yin pa'i gnas tshul gsal po yod/ sngar yul tshan lung tshan so so byas te phan tshun gcig gis gcig la ltos mi dgos pa dang / re mi dgos par gnas pa'i skabs la yin na rang dbang rang btsan zer ba 'di gnad chen po chags kyi yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pas rang dbang rang btsan zer ba der de tsam gyi gal chen po mthong gi mi 'dug de ring kha sa'i dus tshod la dper na rgya gar/ lhang la sde zhi/ bal yul/ 'brugargya mi/ de de bzhin lung pa tshang mar dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i gnas tshul mang po la brten nas rang bzhin gyis 'brel ba byed dgos pa dang / phan tshun ltos res yod mkhan zhig chags yod/ nga rang sto bod par cha bzhag na de bas kyang bod la rgya mtsho'i thog nas mtsho lam med/ 'grim 'grul khag po/mi tshogs nyung nyung / sa rgya chen po/ rang bzhin gyi thon khungs yag po yod mkhan/ dngos sngon n+dis lus yin mkhan de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul gyi 'og la/nga tsho'i lung pa mgyogs myur dngos po yar rgyas yong ba la nga tsho rwa/da pa gcig pus phal cher khag po red/ gang ltar dngos yod yar rgyas kyi nyams myong yod 451

mkhan zhig la ma brten par nga tsho gcig pus byed thub pa khag po red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la bsam blo btang na rgya mi dang mnyam du bsdad nas dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thog la rgya mi'i sa nas rogs lam len rgyu byas pa yin na/ des nga tsho la khe phan yong gi red bsam gyi 'dugabod kyi chos dang rig gzhung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba/ mi'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / sgo gsum gyi spyod pa spus dag cig yod pa 'dis rgya mi la tan tan phan thogs thub pa zhig yong gi red/ sngar lo rgyus kyi nang la cha bzhag na/ bod la nang pa ma dar gong rgya nag la nang pa dar nas ha lam lo gsum brgya bzhi brgya phyin tshar ba red/ sngar rgya nag nang nang pa'i chos dar rgyas byung yod/ yang sgos lhag par can du bod gangs can jongs kyi sangs kyi bstan pa de'ang rgya nag nang la dar khyab chen po byung yod pa gsal po yod/ dper na/ pe cing gis mtshon pa'i rgya nag gi sa khul mang wa zhig la bod pa'i lag shes pas bzos pa'i lha khang dang / sku 'dra sna tshogs mthong rgyu 'dug nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang /de dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung rtsa che bod la yod pa 'di dag nga tshos bdag po rgyab thub pa ma gtogs rgya mis bdag po rtsa ba nyid nas rgyag mi thub/ des na nga tshos byed thub sa 'di'i nang la nga tshos 'gan gtsang ma 'khyer dgos pa dang / nga tshos byed mi thub pa'i sa la rgya mis 'gan gtsang ma 'khyer dgos pa de 'dra zhig byed kyi yin na rgya gzhung la yang blo bzhag sa zhig yod pa/ nga tsho bod pa yin na yang blo bzhag sa yod pa zhig yong gi red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'dir bod chags 'jig gnas su slebs pa'i dza drag gi dka' ngal 'di sel 452

thabs ma byas par sgug bsdad pas mi 'grigs par brten/ ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi thabs shes 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa de yin/ bar skabs ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi bsam 'char bton pa 'dir 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang po zhig gis rgyab skyor byed kyi yod pa dang / rgya bod gnyis dbu ma'i lam gyi thog nas zhi 'grigs yong thabs 'bad brtson rgyal khab mang po zhig gis yongs grags byas nas byed kyi yod la/ yongs grags ma yin pa'i thog nas kyang thabs shes byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ nye ba'i char a ri'i srid gzhung nas rgya bod dbar 'brel ba byed mkhan dmigs bsal gyi 'gan khur yod pa'i las byed pa zhig kyang bskos yod/ phyogs gcig gi gnas stangs de 'dra red/ yang phyogs gcig nas ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi byed stangs 'dis 'grig gi mi 'dug ces skyon brjod byed mkhan nga tsho ༷ da pa'i nang nas kyangayong gi yod/ bod nang nas kyang blo pham byed mkhan rigs kha shas yong gi yod bzo 'dug nga tshor rgyab skyor byed mkhan kha shas la yang bsam tshul de yong gi 'dugagand don 'di gal chen po yin stabs sngon la mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdu len zhig byed thub na bsam ste lo kha shas gong la ma 'ongs pa'i byed phyogs skor la gang dga' ci legs mi mang gi bsam tshul bsdus pa'i mtha' bsdoms su/phyogs gcig nas gnad don 'di shin tu gal chen po yin pa dang / gnyis nas phyogs mang po zhig gi gnas tshul la bstun dgos kyiyode dus gnas skabs mang mos thag gcod mi dgos pa byas te ngas da lta bar du dngos yod gnas tshul gyi cho bzo la gzhigs pas thabs shes byed phyogs 'di ga'i thog nas mu 453

mthud bsam blo btang na legs gnas zhes mang mos byung ba red/ gang ltar rgya bod kyi dka' ngal sel phyogs skor la nga'i bsam tshul dang langs phyogs 'di ltar yin/de nas nga tsho nad pa'i spyi tshogs nang dang / lhag don gzhon skyes nang la deng sang tha mag nyal tha 'then mkhan kha shas yong gi yod pa go rgyu 'dugade ni dpe ma srid pa'i thabs sdug red/ de 'dra nam yang byed mi rung / de bzhin chang rag tshod med 'thung ba dang / rgyan btsugs nas rtsed mo rtsed pa de si gras yag po khyon nas mi 'dug gzab gzab byed dgos/da lta chos don bka' blon gyis gsungs pa de tsho ngas bskyar du lab dgos mi 'dug tshang ma mthun po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho gzhis chags nang la spyi yongs yag thag chod yod na yang re zung so so'i bsod nams kyi rgyab ma 'khyogs pa lta bus gnas stangs skyo dze'i ngang sdod mkhanalho/ dper na/ 'byor ldan tshos phyag mchod byas nas 'gro song gtong ba de tsho'i gras nas dmigs bsal skyo po de tshor lta rtog byed rgyu dang / sman bcos mthun rkyen la sogs pa de 'dra btang ba yin na yang dge rtsa gcig pa red/ so so nang khul la'ang bsam blo gtong dgos/ yang nang srid dang / 'phrod bsten de tsho la 'brel ba byas na thabs shes phran bu yong srid kyi red/ dmigs bsal khyong nga tshor lta rtog byed rgyu 'di 'thus ma shor ba dang / rdzod g.yeng ma song ba byed dgos/'di tshor nges par du dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ snying rje/ kha shas ha cang skyo po/ re sa tos sa med pa 'di tsho bdag po med par sdug bsngal gyis zin te 454

phar gzhi nas skad cha dris dus za rgyu med/ 'thung rgyu med/ bu lon yod ces gzhi nas lab mkhan 'di tshos tam pa byas te bshad ma nus par khug kyog la lus nas bsdad kyi 'dug 'di khul la yang de 'dra yong ma srid pa ma red/ de tshor dmigs bsal gyi dgongs pa bzhes dgos kyi 'dug de nas nga tshos rgyun du 'phrod bsten byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ bod pa'i gshis ka la rgyun du 'phrod bsten byed rgyu la do gal chen po ma byas par bzhag nad na tshas zin/nad kyis mnar te zug zer rgyag pa sogs mngon gsal dod po chags yong dus sman khang la phyin te sman bcos byed rgyu gzhi nas dran gyi yod/ de dus na tsha rnying pa chags te phyis drags pa red/ 'gro song chen po phyin/ na tsha'ang ma drag pa byed kyi 'dug rgyun gyi spyod lam la do snang byas te sngon 'gog byed dgos/ 'dir bod pa'i sman khang yod stabs so so'i gzugs po'i khams dang bstun nas rgyun bcos bod sman bsten na 'byung ba cha stoms bzos te nad mi yong bar phan thogs chen po yod/ lhag don bod sman gyis pho ba la dmigs bsal gyi phan nus chen po yod/ pho ba yag po byung na to zas bzhu smin bde ba dang / nad mi phog pa/ pho kran mi yong bar phan thogs yod/ sgod g.yeng shor na yag po med/ de min zhu rgyu med/ tshang mas hur thag gnang shog a/thugs rje che/ zhes bka' 455// //(skabs 'dir/dol rgyal sgor bka' slob gnang ba rnams bka' slob 'di gras byings khongs phyogs bsdebs zhus/)455

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1997 zla 12 tshes 9 nyin se ra chos sgar du ser skya mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir 'jam mgon 7rgya la ba'i rgyal tshab mtshungs med chos kyi rje dga' ldan khri rin po che blo bzang nyi ma lags dang / byang rtse chos rje/ de min mkhan po las zur/ dge bshes la sogs pa dge 'dun gyi sde gang la gang 'tshams 'dus pa rnam pa sto dang / de nas 'dir gzhis chags kyi las byed pa dang / mi mang spyi byings bcas rnam pa tsho lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ byes pa gra tshang bar skabs gra tshogs chen por gyur te chos ra dang stabs bstun 'du khang gsar pa rgyag dgos byung ba da ring sgo 'byed rten 'brel sar nga sto mnyam 'dzoms byed rgyu'i go skabs byung ba red/ khyed rang tshang ma don gnyer chen po byas te phebs pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin /sngon la da lta lag 'khyer thob mkhan dge bshes khyed rang tsho tshang ma la bkra shis bde legs yod/ khyed rang sto 'dir slob gnyer byas pa'i grub 'bras la da ring 'dir lag 'khyer thob pa red/ ngas nam rgyun rtag par zhu bzhin pa ltar/ nga chos dpe cha slob gnyer byed pa 'di thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub rgyu'i don du red ma gtogs/ dge bshes kyi ming skam po zhig yong ba'i don dag la slob gnyer byas pa ma red/ dge bshes kyi lag 'khyer thob tshar ba'i rjes la dpe cha dpe ras nang la bsgril te 'jog rgyu min pas/ dpe cha mu mthud nas gzigs rogs gnang zhes zhu rgyu yin/ dge bshes bzhag tshar nas dpe cha blta dus go ba yag tu 'gro tshul zer mkhan de 456

'dra kha shas yong gi 'dug dpe cha'i go ba zab tu 'gro rgyu yong srid pa ltar/ mu mthud nas phyag dpe gzigs rgyu dang / so sos shes pa rnams bsam pa rnam dgagi thoganas dge phrug tshor slob khrid bya rgyu/ so gos kyang gang shes pa rnams brgya cha brgya tham pa lag len bkal thub rgyu lam seng ma byung na yang / gang thub ci thub lag len bkal dgos pa de shin tu gal chen po 'dug ces zhu rgyu yin/dge phrug la dpe khrid byed pa'i skabs su yang / ngas rtag par zhu bzhin pa ltar/ thog mar kha dog dkar dmar 'khrid sa'i phru gu tsho nas bzung ste/gang ltar dmigs yul lam ston gsal po byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug 'phral sel rig pa'i rtsal 'don rgyu gcig pu ma yin par/ gathorwa nga sems rgyud 'dul rgyu'i don dag la slob sbyong byed kyi yod stabs/ dang po nas slob sbyong byed pa'i dmigs yul dgos pa dang / nying dgos zhes bshad pa bzhin thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu dang / de'i cha rkyen la smin thub pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ nga rgyal dang / phrag dog 'gran sems 'phel ba'i don dag la phyin na shin tu thabs skyo po red/ de ni lha bdud la babs zer ba lta bu yin/dpe cha bltas pa nyon mongs kyi gnyen por ma song bar nyon mongs kyi grogs la phyin na shin tu thabs skyo po red/ de tsho'i thog la khyed rang tsho tshang mas yag po zhig gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/da lta las bsdoms gnyis da ring dus tshod ma ldang bas klog long ma byung ba red/ da ring 'dir klog long byung min la ma ltos par spyir btang dus dus 457

la mi mang tshor nga tshos las ka gang 'dra byed kyi'ade pa de tsho'i gras gsal bshad byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug 'di ga'i sa gnas kyi mi mang tshos gnas tshul gang 'dra yin pa dang / gang 'dra byed kyi yod pa de tsho rtogs pa byed dgos/ lhag don dngul gyi rtsis khra'i skor de tsho'i gras nam rgyun nas gsal po zhig byung ba yin na/ 'dir las ka byed mkhan tshos hur thag byas pa de mi mang gis kyang shes pa zhig dang / mi mang gis kyang 'dir mos mthun dang / rgyab skyor yod pa byung na tshang ma blo bde po yong gi red/ mi mang gis gnas tshul tshang ma shes pa byed rgyu de gal chen po 'dug gang ltar 'dir gzhis chags nang lo nas lo bstud tshang mas hur thag byas/ dka' las rgyag gi yod pa red/ tshang ma la thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ gzhis chags 'di rnying shos chags bsdad yod /thog mar tsha ba de'i dkyil la shing nags gcod bregs dang / mer bsregs byed pa'i skabs la nga 'dir slebs yod/ da lta bar du gzhis chags 'dir tshar mang shos slebs yod pa red/ gang ltar gzhis chags 'di rnying khungs yin pa tsam du ma zad/ da cha gang ci'i thog nas gra 'grigs po yag thag chod chags yod/ 'dir mi mang dang / lhag don gzhon skyes tsho'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur dang / gdong gi tshos gzhi'i thog nas shes thub kyi 'dug 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs mi 'dug mi 'dug zer bzhin du lo re nas lo re mi sdod pa drag tu phyin yod/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i ring la 'dir so so'i pha gzhis chung chung zhig chags bsdad yod pa 'di'i thog la tshang mas sems khur blangs nas hur thag byas pa dngos gnas yag po red/ 'dzam gling nang btsan byol 458

ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nga tsho bod pa gra 'grigs shos shig dang / tshags tshud shos yin pa/ btsan byol ba'i thog la las ka byed myong mkhan dang / nyams myong yod mkhan tshang ma mthong tshul gcig gyur gyis bshad kyi 'dug gang ltar gra 'grigs po dang / tshags tshud po yong ba'i rkyen rtsa gtso bo sa gnas sa thog gi las ka byed mkhan tsho dang / rgya che'i mi mang tsha grang ngal dub la ltos pa med par bsdad mkhan tshos dka' las rgyab pa'i 'bras bu red/ lhag par du yang thog mar gzhis chags tshugs pa'i skabs kyi mi de dag gis dka' las chen po rgyab yod/ de'i skabs kyi las ka byed mkhan mkhan chung rgyal mtshan lags dang / pha lha'i rim bzhi khong gnyis yin pa yod/ skabs der gzhis chags la thog mar yong mkhan gyi mi mang po zhig da cha rgas shing 'khogs pa'i na tshod la slebs pa dang / mang po zhig ni 'jig rten pha rol la phyin zin pa red/ gang ltar byas rjes 'jog mkhan dang / dka' las mi thog rgan pa khong tshos rgyab/ de'i byas rjes kyi grub 'bras de mi thog gsar pa gcig gis longs spyod pa 'dra po chags bsdad yod/ khyed rang rgan pa tsho nas dka' las rgyab pa 'di dag nam yang yal thabs med pa zhig red/ phyed ka so so'i sgor gyi lto gos kyi don dag red de/ phyed ka nga tsho bod spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig dang / bod gzhung gis lam ston 'char 'god 'og nas gang yong ci yong byas pa de dngos dang brgyud pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod par brten dge ba'i las bsags yod pas/ khyed rang tshos rjes su yi rangs byed dgos/ ngas kyang khyed rang tsho rgas po rgan mo tsho thug dus sngon ma dka' 459

las rgyag mkhan gyi mi yin bsam nas sems nang dmigs bsal gyi tshor ba zhig yong gi 'dug ngas smon lam rgyab chog khyed rang tsho tshang ma sems skyid po dang bag phebs po byas nas sdod rogs byed/da cha mi thog brjes te gzhon skyes gsar pa rnams slebs yong gi yod pa red/ deng sang gzhis chags tshang mar gzhon skyes pho gsar mo gsar mang po zhig 'tshar longs yong gi yod/ nye char lam zhor du had rdar bha thar khyug tsam bsdad pa yin/ de khul bod pa sud ṭar tshong mkhan sum brgya skor zhig 'dug pa de tsho'i nang la yang gzhon skyes mang po slebs 'dug de dus ngas gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas slob gra 'grims myong ba ga tshod yod med dang / slob gra 'grims ma myong ba ga tshod yod med dris pa yin/ mang che ba slob gra 'grims myong ba chags 'dug nga tsho btsan byol bar gyar te thabs skyo po yin na yang /spyi yongs kyi shes yon gnas stangs la bltas pa yin na/ gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bu phrug tsho'i shes yon las/ nga tsho btsan byol ba'i bu phrug gi shes yon drag pa chags bsdad yod/ a ri dang / yo rob la sogs pa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang gi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gra khag gi nang la nga phyo btsan byol ba'i slob phrug brgya phrag kha shas yod pa dang /bod nas nyung shas ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ da cha shes yon gyi cha nas bod pa btsan byol ba'i spyi tshogs nang gzhon skyes rnams yig rmongs kyi gnas tshul ha lam sel te yi ge shes pa'i sgo nas gang ci'i mthong rgya thos rgya chen po zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ 'di nga tsho'i yar rgyas red/ ha cangasag po red/ yin na yang mthong rgya thos rgya'i 460

shes yon yod pa gcig pus mi 'grigs/ nga tsho'i mi thog rgan pa 'di dag la deng dus kyi shes yon dang / mthong rgya sgos rgya de tsam med na yang / de snga bod nang pha mes nas brgyud pa'i bzang po'i goms gshis 'bu zhig mthong ba yin na'ang snying rje zer ba dang / nyams thag pa'i srog chags gang 'dra zhig mthong na yang de la rogs byed rgyu dang / phan gdags rgyu'i bsam rmyo zhig rang bzhin gyis bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la yod pa red/ ma gzhi bod pa'i nang mi gsod mkhan sogs gang byung ma byung byed mkhan yong gi red de/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bod pa'i spyi tshogs 'di gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar byams snying ldan pa'i spyi tshogs shig yin/ 'di 'dra'i bzang wa'i yon tan 'di dag mi la dgos mkho yod pa dang / mi la phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la byams brno ldan pa'i spyi tshogs kyis phongs nas bsdad pa'i skabs 'dir/ nga rang tsho la de 'dra'i goms gshis bzang po zhig sngar med gsar 'dzugs kyi 'bad rtsol byed mi dgos par/ sngar pha mes kyi dus nas rang chas su yod pa 'di ngo shes pa byas nas bdag po rgyag rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ des na rgan pa tshos spyir btang phan sems byed stangs dang / ngo tsha khrel yod byed stangs/ rgan gzhon brtsi bkur byed stangs/ bag med kyi spyod ngan slong thabs de tsho'i gras rgan pa tsho rang nyid kyis mig dpe mtshon thub pa zhig byas pa'i jog nas gzhon skyes tshor lam ston dang ngo sprod byed dgos pa dang / gzhon pa tsho nas kyang nga tsho'i pha mes dus nas ya rabs spyod bzang gi lta spyod yod pa 'di dag khyad du 'phags pa'i khyad nor yin pa ngo shes pa dang /461

sems la nges pa byas te 'di tshor dang bstod byed dgos/ 'phral sel gyi khe phan phran bu'i don du ma rabs ham rdzun byas na yag po rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/dus rgyun du ya rabs dang / ngo tsha khrel yod/ drang po drang bzhag byed rgyu 'di dag rang gi srog nang bzhin gal chen po la brtsis te tshang mas do snang byed rogs byed/ ngas 'di rgyun du bshad kyi yod/ 'dzam gling phyi logs la yang 'di rang bshad kyi yod/ gang yin zer na/ deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la dngos po yar rgyas dang / shes yon yar rgyas chen po phyin pa'i lung pa'i nang la ya rabs bzang spyod kyis phongs pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa red/mis mi la bsam cho'i nang nas snying nye ba'i brtse ba dang / yid ches brlag ste gcig gis gcig la dogs pa byas nas bsdad dgos pa dang / rang bzhin gyi bsam blo'i nang la rang nyid grogs med gcig bu'i 'du shes lta bu slebs/de 'dra'i thog nas 'byor ldan phyug po tsho yang bsam blo bag mi phebs pa ma skyid pa/ dbugs ring btang nas sdod mkhan mang po zhig yong gi 'dug mi gzhan dag la de 'dra'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa nga tshos mthong skabs/ nga rang tsho la pha mes dus nas bzang po'i yon tan zhig yod pa 'di dag dngos gnas rin thang chen po yin par gzhi nas yid ches rnyed skyor byed pa zhig yong gi 'dug 'di ha cang rtsa ba chen po yin/ bod pa'i gshis ka bzang po dang /ya rabs yong ba'i rtsa ba nga rang tsho'i sha khrag gi nang la dmigs bsal gyi cha rkyen zhig yod pa'i thog nas byung ba min par/ so so'i goms gshis dang / rig gzhung gi thog nas byung ba gsal po yin/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas bod 462

gangs can gyi ljongs la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rim pas dar/ bod rang nyid kyi mkhas pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug mang po zhig gis brtag dpyad mang po byas/ nyams zhib mang po byas te nyams su blangs/ rgyud thog la sbyar/de 'dra'i sgog nas gtan la phab pa'i legs bshad/ theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i chos tshul 'di dag ha las pa'i rtsa ba chen po yin/dper na/ bod gangs can gyi ljangs kyi lung khug gi 'brog pa gang yang mi shes mkhan zhigayin na yang / de snuras spyod lam rgyag dus ma rgan sems can thams cad zer ba kha nas rang bzhin gyis thon yong gi yod/ de 'dras rkyen pas srog chags 'bu srin tshun chad la gnod 'tshe byed rgyur bsam blo'i nang mi bde ba zhig yong gi yod/ sems can la gnod 'tshe byed rgyur ya nga bag tsha med pa dang / de la ltad mo'i 'du shes byed mkhan rtsa ba nyid nas med/ dper na/lnga bcu nga dgu'i gong la rgya mi lha sar 'byor pa kha shas kyis lug dang / g.yag de 'dra gsod pa'i skabs sems can 'ga' shas kyis 'phag tshags rgyab byed dus gad mo bgad/ ltad mo bltas/ de 'dra byed kyi yod pa nga lha sar yod dus go myong / deng sang 'dzam gling sa gnas mang por srog chags sems can gzhan dag la brtse ba byed rgyu de nam yang shes kyi med pa lta bu zhig 'dug bde sdug gi tshor ba yod pa'i sems can gzhan dag la gnod 'tshe byed rgyur ya nga bag tsha med pa'i goms gshis 'jags pa'i mi de tshos ga le ga ler mi nang tshags la gnod 'tshe byed rgyu dang / mi nang tshags gsod res gtong rgyur the tshom med pa de shugs ma thub kyi chags yong gi red/ gzhan la lta stangs gcig 463

gyur chags pa red/ ji srid so so'i lus la sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba zhig ma byung bar du gzhan dag gi sdug bsngal la sems khur yong ba khag po red/de 'dra'i spyi tshogs nang la bde skyid gang 'dra byas nas yong gi red/ yong rgyu khag po red/ nga rang chog nad pa'i goms gshis gcig gis gcig la brtse ba byed pa 'di'i rtsa ba ni spyir nang pa'i chos dang / lhag par du theg pa chen yi chos kyi bslab bya'i thog nas byung ba ha cang gsal po yin/ de snga yin na nga rang tsho bod la so so she gtsang byas nas bsdad pa red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lta ba dang spyod pa 'dra mi 'dra mang i dkyil la nga rang tsho 'dres nas sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig chagasayod/ ma 'ongs pa la yin nayang /'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la deng sang brnyan 'phrin sogs 'phrul chas 'dra mi 'dra mang po zhig gi thog nas gnas tshul tshang ma lam seng shes thub pa'i phan tshun 'brel thag nye po chags pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og la nga tsho'i bzang po'i khyad chos 'di dag mthong ba brgyud pa'i goms gshis kho na'i thog nas 'jags pa lta bu byas pa yin na rgyun 'khyongs yong rgyu khag po red/ nga rang tsho'i goms gshis bzang po 'di dag bzang po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ngo 'tho/ dge mtshan mthong / dgos pa shes/ yon tan mthong thub pa zhig byung ba yin na/de la bdag po rgyag 'dod dang / gces spras byed 'dod kyi sems shu gas shig skyes yong gi red/ de ltar byung na phyi nang gi rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad na yang nga tsho'i goms gshis 'di kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs yod pa zhig yin bsam pa dran yong gi red/ dgos pa dge mtshan ma mthong bar goms gshis 46 4

'jags pa tsam du bsdad na/ nga tsho spyi tshogs gsar pa'i nang la 'tsho sdod byed dgos stabs/ goms gshis gsar pa'i shugs rkyen gyis nga tsho'i goms gshis rnying pa de rim pas yal 'gro gi red/ spyir btang sa phyogs gang sar yul dus kyi gnas tshul dang / spyi tshogs kyi goms gshis tshang ma rang bzhin gyis 'gyur 'gro gi yod/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i bod pa'i gyon chas la sogs pa yang 'gyur 'gro gi yod/ de tshor 'gal ba de tsam mi 'dug kyang / rtsa ba'i mi'i gshis ka bzang 1— de 'gyur ba yin na ha cang phangs po yin/ de gal chen po zhig la brtsis nas bdag po rgyag dgos/ nga tsho'i ya rabs bzang spyod kyi 'byung khungs rtsa ba gang 'dra yin pa de shes dgos/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la chos la dad pa ni bag re yod/ gzugs sngags 'dra bgrang / phyag 'tshal dkor sbyong 'dra byas pa de tsam gyi thog la bsdad na nor 'khrul red/ mang tshogs kyi thog nas nang pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba de shes pa byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/nang chos shes thabs byed stangs kyang skabs re nga sto thug 'phrad byas pa tsam dang / bla ma zhig gis khri'i sgang la bsdad nas chos bshad phran bu byas pa tsam gyis phan thogs chen po yong mi thub/ dus dus la 'dzin gra lta bu 'tshogs/ lhag don khyed rang tsho gzhon nu dang / bud med tshogs pa khyed rang tshos khyar blangs/las ku'i bar seng dus tshod dang bstun te gza' 'khor gcig nang thengs ma gcig tsam gnyis tsam 'tshogs/ de'i sar shes mkhan zhig gis 'grel bshad rgyab/ 'grel bshad byed rgyu'i rtsa don de yang bden pa bzhi dang / bden pa gnyis/ byams pa dang snying rje/ de'i snga na gang 'dra yin pa/ de tsho skyes stangs 465

gang 'dra yin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di chos lugs gzhan dag las khyad par 'phags chos gang dang gang yod pa de tsho'i gras 'grel bshad brgyab/ khyed rang tsho nang tshags bgro gleng byas/ go bsdur byas/ dmigs bsal gyi dogs gcod dang / dri ba dris lan 'dra byas te zla ba nas zla ba/ lo nas lo bsrings pa yin na tan tan grub 'bras nges can zhig thon gyi red/ bod yig gi slob deb dang / dbyin yig deb nang chos kyi gnad don go bde de 'dra yod pas/de tshor bltas te khyed rang tsho gzhon nu pho mo'i nang nas nang chos kyi 'gro stangs shes pa byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ nyams len byed dang mi byed so so'i lag pa red/ byung na nyams len byed dgos/ nang chos shes nas dad pa thob pa zhig byung na lag len ma byas par sdod thabs med pa rang shugs kyis yong gi red/ sngon la tshe phyi ma bsam blo ma 'khor na'ang tshe 'di ga rang la yang sems 'khrug pa'i skabs la phan thogs yod pa de tsho'i gras ngo cha yag po 'phrod pa yin na/ de la bdag po rgyag gi red/ don gnyer byed kyi red/ de tsho la tshang mas do snang zhig byas na yag po min nam dran song / khyed rang tsho'i ngos nas 'dun pa byung ba yin na sa gnas 'dir gdan sa chen po zhig yod stabs 'grel bshad rgyag mkhan lag thogs kyi ma red/ 'grel bshad rgyag mkhan tshos kyang lta ba dang grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'dra min khag ngo sprod byed rgyu dang / phyi nang gi khyad par/ mdo sngags kyi khyad par la sogs pa 'di tsho'i gras shes thabs dang / gtso che shos bden gnyis dang / bden pa bzhi la sogs pa'i thog nas 'grel bshad byed dgos/ de dang chabs cig nyams len gyi thog la tshur ldog 466

la bsgril ba'i skabs su blo sbyong gi rigs dang / lam rim lta bu/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / dwags po'i thar rgyan sogs bod gangs can jongs kyi sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma phye ba'i bla ma skyes bu dam pa mang pos mdzad pa'i sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung mang po yod pa de cho dang zung sbrel byas na yag po red/ de min dmyal ba'i lo rgyus lta bu zhig thad garabashad pa yin na phran bu ma bde ba lta bu red/ sngar khams la mi gcig gis dgon pa'i mkhan po zhig mjal du phyin par/ mkhan 1— de ma bzhugs pa'i skabs dang 'khel/ mi des mkhan po'i dge phrug la/ mkhan po gang du phebs skad cha dris par/ dge phrug gis mkhan po sgo bo rmyo bo tsho la zhed snang bskul bar phebs song lab pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/la de 'dra min par sdig slong dge sgrub byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang dang gang yin pa de tsho lha sprod byed dgos/ bshad stangs 'di rigs la gnad 'gag phran bu med dam dran song /de nas spyir btang nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang skya ser pho mo dang / slob gnyer yod min la ma ltos par ma ṇi dang / sgrol ma 'don mkhan mang po yod/ha cang yag po red/ sngar bod nang ma ṇi dang / sgrol ma bsags te nyams len gnang mkhan mkhas grub skyes bu dam pa mang po byung yod/ gzungs sngags yig drug sgrol bstod 'di tsho byin rlabs can yin pas/ tshig tsam bton pa tsam gyis byin rlabs dang phan yon chen po yod pa red/ gal che shos dper na/ sgrol ma lta bu bsags pa'i skabs su mdun la rje btsun sgrol ma skad cig gis gsal btab/ de sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 467

'phrin las kyi rang gzugs yin bsam pa dang / 7skyabs gnas kun 'dus la mos te tshe gegs bar chad zhi ba dang / rgyu nor longs spyod la sogs pa gang ltar so so'i 'phral dang yun gyi 'dod don la gsol ba btab na yag po yong gi red/ gtso che shos shig nga rang tshos 'don pa gang bton pa yin na'ang de 'don pa'i skabs la snying rje sgom dgos/ nang chos la go ba gang 'tshams yod na bden pa bzhi dang / de 'dra'i thog nas chos dkon mchog la dad pa sbyangs/de lta bu'i chos ston mkhan gyi sangs rgyas/ de 'dra'i chos tshul bzhin bsgrub mkhan gyi dge 'dun la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas kha tsam tshig tsam min pa'i dad pa skyes pa zhig byas/ de 'dra'i dad pas kun nas blangs pa'i sgo nas 7skyabs su 'gro ba dang / gzungs sngags bgrang / de'i thog la da dung nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang rang dang 'dra bar sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod mkhan yin pa bsam pa'i thog nas dge sbyor byed kyi yin na dngos gnas drang gnas chos rlabs chen po yong thub kyi red/de nas nga tsho'i gzhis chags nang thon skyed yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i skor la sngon ma nas rtag par bshad yod pa red/ bar skabs zhing las yar rgyas gtong thabs skor la nang srid las khungs nas sde tshan zur du phye ste blta rtogs byed dgos zhes da lta las 'gul byed dang byed bzhin pa red/ deng sang shugs gnon bsgril sa delo ri sa gzhis chags nang bsgril gyi yod pa red/ rim pas rim pas sa zhing yod pa 'di dag gi thog nas thon skyed gang 'dra byas nas 468

yag tu gtong dgos kyi 'dug bsam blo gtong dgos/ de dang chabs cig so sor sa cha yod pa de'i sgang la bzo las tsag tsig de 'dra 'dzugs thub pa'i thabs shes 'tshol dgos/ sngon ma nas lab lta lab zin pa red/ sngon ma tshar gcig 'bad rtsol byas nas ma 'grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas g.yugs ma bzhag par/da dung tshad tshad bsdur bsdur/ yang tshad tshad bsdur bsdur byed kyi yin na thabs shes rnyed srid kyi red/ deng sang sngon ma dang mi 'dra bar yo rob gros tshogs khongs dang / a mi ri ma'i gros tshogs khongs nas rogs ram 'dra yong gilode pa red/ nga tsho'i ngos nas 'char gzhiyag po byung ba yin na/ rogs ram 'bod bskul byed sa tshogs pa bye brag pa de 'dra min par deng sang gzhung de 'dra'i thog nas rogs ram dang do snang zhig yong gi yod/ nga tshor sngon ma las mthun rkyen dang go skabs yag tu 'gro gi yod/ de 'dra yin dus thon skyed yar rgyas gtong thabs la nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos/de nas da ring 'dir khri rin po che nas dngos gnas rang thugs khur bskyed de gsung bshad gnang ba la ha cang dga' po byung / thugs rje che/ nga rang tsho 'dir dge 'dun mang po zhig 'dus yod pa red/ ngas sngon ma nas yang nas yang du bshad pa ltar/ lo stong phrag gi ring la nga tshos bdag po rgyab pa'i khyad nor de nang pa'i chos 'di chags bsdad yod/ nang pa'i chos ngo thog bdag po rgyag mkhan gyi btags don btsal ba yin na/ nga tsho'i slob gnyer khang bshad gra khag 'di dag chags bsdad yod/ 'don kha khral tsam ma yin par dngos gnas rang tshig re re la 'grel bshad byas nas don dag gtan la 469

phab/ don dag khong du chud mkhan bslab pa slob gnyer yod pa'i gdan sa khag 'di dag gtso bo chags bsdad yod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo sum cu so brgyad lhag tsam phyin pa'i ring la sdug pa la dpag pa'i gang la gang 'tshams yar rgyas phyin yod/ deng sang dngos yod gnas tshul la bod nang la slob gnyer rgyag 'dod yod mkhan tsho ༄1da nang la slob sbyong byed sa dang /mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms par brten nga tsho btsan byol ba'i bod pa'i sgrig 'dzugs nang la tshur re ba rgyab nas yong dgos pa zhig chags yod/ bar skabs rgya gar nang gdan sa gsum gyi nang la bod nas gsar 'byor bslab pa slob gnyer byed mkhan deng sang stong phrag kha shas yod pa tshang mas slob gnyer hur thag byed kyi yod pa la thugad+dha/ rje che zer gyi yod/ de bzhin hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud sa khul mang po zhig nas kyang 'dir bslab pa slob gnyer byed par yong mkhan mang po yod pa ha cang yag po red/ da dung tshang mas rdzod yangs ma song ba thugs khur bskyed nas gzab gzab gnang rogs gnang zhes zhu 'dod byung /de nas nga tsho bod don gyi gnas tshul skor la/ da lta kha yod lag yod kyi 'gyur ba 'di 'dra byung zhes lab rgyu gang yang mi 'dug gnas stangs de 'dra zhig la bsdad yod/ nga tsho'i langs phyogs ni tshang mas shes gsal red/dbu ma'i lam zhes/ gang ltar rgya bod gnyis mos kyi thabs shes 'og nas dka' ngal sel thub pa'i dmigs yul de 'dra zhig bzungs yod/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa kha bral la 'gro gi 'dug ces dngangs skrag chen po byas/ 'di'i don dag la drag gnon byed dgos kyiye yod/ gang byed dgos kyi yod kyang the tshom 470

med pa byas nas bsdad yod pa red/ nga rang tshos bsam blo rgya che sa zhig nas btang ba yin na/ rgyal khab phan tshun gyi sa mtshams zer ba dang / rgyal khab phan tshun gyi gnas stangs zer mkhan de dus kyi 'gyur ba'i nang nas 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin du yod pa red/ mi rigs tha dad dang / lo rgyus tha dad yod pa gnyis thun mong gi khe phan gyi 'og nas gcig tu bsgril ba yong gi yod pa dang /yang mi rigs gcig gyur yin pa zhig thun mong gi khe phan med pa'i skabs la dum bur 'gro ba zhig yong gi yod pa red/ gang ltar yang snying deng sang 'dzam gling gi dngos yod gnas tshul la lung pa gcig gi dpal 'byor dang / 'dzugs bskrun gyi gnas stangs de dag lung pa gzhan dag rnams la phan tshun ltos tshabs ha cang chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas dper na/ bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i thog la bod sa rgya chen po red/ rang byung gi thon khungs yag po yod/ yang 'grim 'grul khag po dang / mi 'bor nyung nyung red/ dngos po yar rgyas thad rjes lus chen po thebs nas bsdad yod/gang ltar dngos po yar rgyas ni 'gro dgos/ dngos po yar rgyas yag po gtong ba la yar rgyas gtong shes mkhan gyi lag rtsal pa dang / ma rtsa dgos kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul thog nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ da lta nga 'i bsam blo'i nang la rgya dang bod rgyang thag ring po yod pa'i bsam tshul de ga le ga ler 'gyur ba zhig phyin/ rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa la cha bzhag yid ches byas/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul byung ba yin na/ bod kyi dngos po yar rgyas gtong rgyu de tsho'i thog la rgya mis 'gro song mang tsam btang / ma rtsa rgya mis 471

bton/ lag rtsal pa de tsho'i gras bod pa rang nyid kyis ga tshod thub pa de bod pa rang nyid kyis byas/ bod pa rang nyid nas ma thub pa de tsho'i gras rgya mi'i ngos nas rogs ram byas pa yin na/ nga tsho'i bod kyi dngos po yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i thog la khe phan yong ma srid pa ma red/ tshur phyogs nga tsho'i ngos nas gang gal chen po yin zer na/ bod mi rigs kyi chos dang rig gzhung bcas pa 'di dag nyams med nga tshos zin dgos pa zhig red/ 'di ni bod pa sa ya drug gi khe phan tsam du ma zad/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs/ chen po hor gyi yul khag sog po phyi nang gnyis/ u ru su'i khongs kyi bho rad thu/ kur mugathu ba sogs kyi sa khul khag la phan thogs yod pa smos mi dgos pa red/ de nas gal che shos shig rgya nag nang la mtshon na/ sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod la ma dar gong la rgya nag nang la dar myong ba zhig red/ gnyis nas bod gangs can jongs kyi ris su ma chad pa'i bla chen de 'dra sngar rgya nag la phebs te bod pa'i bla mas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa dang / lha khang de 'dra deng sang yang rgya nag nang khul la mthong rgyu yod pa red/ bar skabs rgya mi'i nang nas bod kyi nang chos la do snang byed mkhan je mang je mang 'gro gi yod pa gsal po 'dug deng sang rgya gzhung gi srid byus la zhed snang dang dngangs skrag byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas bod kyi nang chos la do snang byed mkhan rgya mi gang la gang 'tshams yong gi yod par gzhigs na/ ma 'ongs par rang dbang che ru phyin pa'i mtshams la nga tsho rwaped pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi thoganas rgya mi mang po zhig la phan thogs byed thub pa tan tanayong gi red bsam gyi 'dug472

gang ltar chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nga rang tsho bod mir rang dbang gtsang ma yod pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i slob sbyong sgrod rgyu/ gzhan yang bod pa rang nyid kyi thog nas so so'i lung pa'i rtsa chu/ gnam gshis/ nags tshal de tshor ma gnod pa'i thog nas dngos po yar rgyas 'gro thabs kyi 'char 'god lam ston ro gas ram byed rgyu dang / lag rtsal ba rnams rgya mi'i ngos nas mthun 'gyur byed rgyu/ de min bod kyi nang srid dang 'brel ba'i las ka tshang ma bod pa rang gis 'gan cha tshang 'khyer thub pa zhig byed dgos/ de yang chos dang rig gzhung gi skad cha bshad yong dus bod chol kha gsum/ gyi sa khul yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ skad kyi sgra gdangs phran bu phran bu mi 'dra ba ni bod nang gi lung tshan gzhan dag la yang yod pa red/ de min ka mig sum cu'i yi ge gcig gyur yin/ gang ltar skad dang yi gos shan phye ba'i bod mi rigs gcig gyur byas nas bsdad yod/ dper na/ 'jang mi rigs la cha bzhag na'ang bod kyi nang chos red 'dug khong tsho'i pha mes kyi dus nas bod kyi chos rgyal bka' drin can tsho'i khyab khongs la bsdad pa yin sa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gcig la/ bar skabs bod kyi khrims yig rnying pa de 'dra la zhib 'jug byed mkhan phyi rgyal gyi mi de 'dras zer na/ bod kyi khrims yig thog gi brda chad de tsho rwa1da chol kha gsum yongs rdzogs la gcig gyur red/sngar chos rgyal tshos bod kyi khrims lugs gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i skabs la bod kyi sa khul yongs rdzogs khrims lugs gcig gi 'og la gnas pa'i gnas tshul gsal po 'dug ces bshad kyi 'dug nga tsho chol kha gsumayongs su rdzogs 473

pa gcig tu bsgril ba de 'dra zhig byung ba yin na/ nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong rgyu'i las ka byed bde ba dang / 'grub che ba/ rlabs che ba yong gi red/ rgya nag gzhung nas bod kha bral phyin dogs sems khral chen po byed kyi yod kyang bod pa 'dod pa khengs na nga tsho kha bral byed dgos don med/ 'dod pa ma khengs na kha bral ma byed ces lab kyang nyan gyi ma red/ kha bral 'gro dang mi 'gro ༄ra ba de rgya mi rang gi lag par rag las yod/ nga tsho'i ngos nas rgya mi la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa zhig dang / bod pa la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa de 'dra zhig gi thog nas 'grigs thabs dang / nga tsho'i dka' ngal sel thabs 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa red/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la rang rgyal gzhan pham thog nas thag gcod yong rgyu khag po red/ gnyis phyogs nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi gu bshangs byas te gnyis mos kyi thabs lam zhig gi 'og nas dka' ngal sel thabs byed dgos/ dper na/ bar skabs ltos phe ri rka'i gnas tshul lo kha shas nang 'gyur ba byung ba de tsho'i gras gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas yong gi yod pa red/ snga mo yin na mi rigs dkar nag gnyis kyi dbar la 'gal ba shin tu chen po yod pa red de/ mi rigs dkar nag gnyis gcig pham/ gcig rgyal zer ba de yong thabs yod pa ma red/ gal srid 'khrug pa rgyab pa yin na gnyis ka pham rgyu red/ de bzhin du nga tsho bod pas rgya mi la 'dzings mi thub /'dzings pa'i dbang du btang na yang mthar thug tshang mar gyong phog rgyu red/ rgya mi ni stobs dang ldan pa zhig yin pa dang / mi grangs sa ya stong phrag lhag tsam 474

yod/ nga tsho bod mi sa ya drug tsam las med pas ha cang khag po yin/ rtsa ba 'tshe ba'i lam zer ba 'di nga tsho mi la ran pa'i bya ba nam yang min/ lhag par du yang dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang la gnas tshul shin tu gsal po bstan yod/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la 'tshe ba byas nas dka' ngal ga tshod sel thub 'dug thag chod ga tshod byung 'dug nga chos bltas na shes rgyu red/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po dang / dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs la mi de lta bu bsad pa red/ 'tshe ba'i lam la brten na mi la dka' sdug ston ma yong rgyu dang / 'gal zla che ru 'gro rgyu ma gtogs med pa ha cang bsal po red/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la sngar 'tshe ba la dwang bstod byed mkhan tshos kyang deng sang 'tshe ba spangs pa'i thabs shes 'tshol dgos lugs bshad kyi yod pa red/ gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi 'og la nga rang bo da pa de bas kyang mtha' gcig tu 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la brten nas 'tham bu gling 'di'i snang la mig dpe bstan thub pa zhig dang / lam srol gsar pa gtod thub pa zhig byed dgos/ nga chos da lta bar du 'bad rtsol byed stangs gnas tshul de 'dra red/ da lta rgya nag gzhung gis ngas rang btsan thabs shes byed kyi 'dug ces skyon brjod byed pa ma gtogs gnas tshul 'di dag cha tshang mthong gi yod pa ma red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la gzu bor gnas pa'i mi dang / mdor na rgya mi'i nang nas kyang blo gzu bor gnas pa phal mo ches ngas dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'dir mthong tshul gcig gyur gyi thog nas rgyab skyor byed kyi 'dug khong tshos kha zhe gnyis med kyi rgyab skyor byas pas ma tshad/ da dung 7rgyal ba rin po che nas dbu ma'i lam 475

zhes pa'i bod kyi dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs lam 'di rgya nag mi mang gis shes thub pa'i go skabs byung na rgya nag mi mang yongs rdzogs kyis rgyab skyor byed kyi red ces phyi grags byas nas bshad kyi 'dug da lta bar du nga tsho'i gnas stangs de 'dra red/ hob ste bltas pa yin na deng sang bod nang la rgya mi'i srid byus gdug rtsub che ru phyin pa lta bu dang / tā la'i bla ma'i par nyar chog gi ma red zer ba de tshor 'gal ba de tsam mthong gi mi 'dug byed stangs de tshos phugs rgyang ring wa'i cha nas bod pa'i bsam tsā'i nang la na tsha che ru 'gro rgyu ma gtogs chung du 'gro gi ma red/ da lta rgya nag gzhung gis bod nang la srid byus zin stangs de 'u thug thabs zad kyi srid byus shig red/ yong babs la bltas na/de yang bod sa gnas sa thog gi las ka byed mkhan rgya rigs las byed pa de tsho'i gras dang / rgya nag dbus gzhung gi bar la'ang bsam tshul mi mthun pa med dam bsam gyi 'dug dbus gzhung gi dpon rigs gung khran tang gi 'go 'khrid tsho'i nang la'ang mthong tshul gnyis sngon ma nas yod pa ltar/ deng sang yang phal cher yod sa red/ da lta rgya nag rang gi nang la'ang srid byus thag gcod byed rgyur dka' ngal mang po yod pa red/ 'di 'dra zhig yod pa'i skabs la bod kyi dka' ngal sel thabs yang dag pa zhig byas pa yin na/ bod pas rkyen byas nas shing cang / shing cang gis rkyen byas nas nang sog nang sog gis rkyen byas nas rgya nag nang la grangs nyung mi rigs lnga bcu skor yod pa tshang rma ra g.yo 'gul thebs kyi red ces sems khral byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul bshad kyi 'dug rgya nag nang la rang bzhin gyi mang gtso'i 'gyur ba 'gro dang 476

'gro bzhin pa red/ dper na/ deng sang rgya nag nang la rgya nag gzhung la ngo rgol byed mkhan dang / skyon brjod byed mkhan gyi mi de 'dra 'dzin bzung byas pa yin na lam seng 'dzam gling phyi logs nas shes thub kyi yod pa dang / des ma tshad 'dzin bzung byas pa de tsho'i nang mi tshos 'dzam bu gling gi phyi la 'brel ba byed thub kyi yod/ lo bco lnga / nyi shu'i gong la de 'dra byed thub thabs rtsa ba nas med pa red/ bar skabs pe cing la slob gra chen po zhig gi dge rgan zhig gis gung khran tang gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i skabs la re 'dun gsar pa kha shas bton song yang / dge rgan de da phan 'dzin bzung byas ma song /mngon gsal dod po min yang / rang bzhin gyis 'gyur ba ca 'gros kyi 'gro bzhin pa de gsal po red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas da lta rgya nag gzhung gis bod kyi jog la srid byus zin pa 'di mur bzhag thabs yod pa ma red/gnyis nas bod mi tsho'i rtsa ba'i lhag bsam g.yo ba med pa yod pa/ gsum nas tshong 'brel gyi khe phan ched rgya nag la 'brel ba byed rgyu gal chen po la brtse mkhan gzhung tshos kyang dbu ma'i lam 'di'i snang layongs grags byas nas mos mthun yod/ rgyab skyor yod/ rgya nag gzhung gis 'di'i jog la dgongs pa bzhes dgos kyi 'dug ces rgya nag gzhung la 'bod bskul byas dang byed bzhin pa red/a mi ri mas mtshon gzhung kha shas shig gis bod kyi rtsa don thog la sha tsha yod/rgyab skyor yod ces kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par tho dngag lag len ngo ma'i thog nas rgya bod gnyis gdong dang gdong bstan nas skad cha bshad thub payong thabs la dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas thabs shes byed dang byed mus red/ bar 477
