skabs a mi ri ga'i rgyal don khang nas bod pa'i don dag la dmigs bsal gyi las byed pa gcig kyang bslo gzhag byas/ las byed pa bskos pa de yang gnad yod kyi mi zhig btsugs pa de dag rtags mtshan gsal po red/ yo rob shar phyogs kyi lung pa'i nang layang / deng sang thod pa'i gnas tshul shes mkhan mang du phyin/ bod don la do snang byed mkhan dang / bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang je mang du 'gro gi 'dug de ltar phyogs mang wa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red/ khyed rang tsho mi mang tshang ma sngar bzhin du sems shugs ma chag par tshang mas rig pa bsgrims/ so sor skabs su babs pa'i khur 'khri'i las 'gan gang yod pa de dag rgyab mdun med par hur thag byed rgyu gal chen po red/bar skabs nga the wan la gcig phyin pa red/ 'di skor rob tsam ma zhus na/ bar lam mi kha shas kyis nga tsho sngon ma nas the wan la 'brel ba byas pa de dag yang dag pa chags pa red/ gang yin zer na 7rgyal ba rin po che yang lam kha de'i sgang la 'gro rgyu 'khel ba red zer mkhan de 'dra med dam bsam gyi 'dug spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga dgu zla ba bzhi pa'i nang la nga rgya gar shar phyogs sa khul la 'byor pa red/ de dus cang gis nga la tar zhig 'byor byung / de'i nang don tshan gcig la7rgyal ba rin po che bod kyi phyi logs la sleb sa pa red/ the bon dang bod pa gnyis gcig bsgril gyi thog nas gung rgol byed dgos zhes 'khod 'dug de'i skabs nga tsho'i bsam blo'i nang la nga tsho gung sgol min/ nga tshos rgya mi rigs la ngo sgol byed kyi med/ gung 478

khran ring lugs kyi gsar brje la ngo rgol byed kyi med/ nga tshos gang la ngo rgol byed kyi yod dam zer na/ rgya mi gung khran bod nang btsan 'dzul thog ma 'os ma drang pa'i gdug rtsub dbang yod bshad pa de la nga tshos ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa red/ gsar brje'i las ka byed mkhan nang bod pa'i gung khran tang mi mang po yod/ dper na/ ngas ngo shes pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs 'ba' pa gang 'tshams dang / de bzhinas mdo gang 'tshams shig yod/ de dag gung khran tang yon red/ chos la dad pa yod pa ma red/ yin na yang khong tshor mi rigs lta ba ha cang shugs chen po yod pa red/ de tsho'i gras mang po zhig chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga bdun/ nga brgyad kyi mtshams nas rgya mi'i zhi drag gi las byed pa'i nang nas phud/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal la cha bzhag na lo mang po zhig btson la bzhag pa red/ bod nang mtha' gcig tu gsar brje la yid ches byas/ gsar brje'i las 'gul nang dngos su zhugs te dka' las rgyag mkhan mang po zhig gis rgya mis bod pa'i thog la ma drang ma 'os pa'i btsan dbang bshad pa 'dir ngo rgol byed kyi yod stabs nga tshos tha'i wan dang gung rgol gcig gyur yin pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug the ldan gung khran la ngo skol red/ nga tsho gung khran la ngo rgol ma red/ the bon dang / rgya nag skam sa chen po gnyis kyi dbar la lta ba'i thog nas 'gal zla red ma gtogs/ skad yig rig gzhung gi 'gal zla yod pa ma red/ deng sang the bon rang la sa skyes rdo skyes kyi mi tsho'i thog nas nga tsho ye wan gyi mi yin/rgya mi min zhes dbye 'byed btang nas skad cha bshad kyi 'dug spyir btang byas 479

na the wan dang rgya nag skam sa chen po gnyis kyi 'gal zla dang / nga tsho dang rgya nag gi 'gal zla gnyis po de rtsa ba nas tha dad chags bsdad yod/ mthun pa'i cha yod na yang / rtsa ba mi 'dra ba yin/ the bon nas nga tsho bod pa'i nang la tshur 'brel ba byed stangs la mtshon na/ khag gcig bod sog las khungs brgyud nas 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa dang / khag gcig the wan gyi dmag don las khungs/ khag gcig the wan gsang ba'i las khungs nas 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa red/ the bon nas bod pa'i nang lag pa brkyong 'dod yod pa de tshul dang mthun pa zhig chags ma thub/ nga tsho'i ngos nas 'brel ba yag po zhig chags thub na bsam pa zhig yod kyang / nga tshos rang lugs dam bca' zhig zin pa de dang ma ran pa lta bu chags nas bsdad pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la the wan gyi dngul dang dngos pos bslu khrid kyi bya spyod de rgya gar nang dang / bal yul gang sar spel yod spu red/ de m+mu skor par tshur mi sna'i 'gro 'ong thog thabs shes 'phros mol byasayod kyang /r+pā dag thag chod pa zhig dang / byed bde po gtsang ma zhig chag sa ma thub par brten/ nga tshos the wan la 'brel ba byed rgyu mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa'i gsal bsgrags byas pa red/ bod gzhung gis thag gcod byas pa 'di'i thog la bod mi ser skya mi mang yongs rdzogs nas gcig gyur rang tshugs zin po byas yod na des nus pa zhig thon thub rgyu yang / de ni byung yod pa ma red/ the wan bod sog las khungs brgyud nas dngul gyis 'brel ba de mu mthud nas gang sa gang la yong gi yod/ 'di ga ma'i sor nang la yang yong gi yod pa dang /480

de min sa cha gzhan dag mang po zhig la yang yong gi yod pa red/ nga tsho dang the ldan bar gyi 'brel ba 'di gtsang ma yag po zhig ma byung na/ da lta'i byed stangs 'dis bod pa nang khul la dogs pa rnam rtog byed dgos pa 'dra po/ gang ltar mi dgos pa'i dka' ngal zhig 'phrad yong gi yod/ 'di sel thabs la nga tsho bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces yang yang skad cha dang bsam tshul zhig yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ ba ra lam the wan rang la mang gtso'i 'gyur ba shugs chen po zhig byung / mtha' ma 'os bsdu byas par mang mos kyi thog nas li tang hus khong rang srid 'dzin la slebs/ khong rang ma gzhi ye shu'i chos pa zhig kyang yin tshod 'dug khong rang sgor gyi bsam blo gu yangs po'i thog nas ngas zhi bde'i gros 'char don tshan lnga bshad pa 'di'i thog la kho rang gis yongs grags byas nas rgyab skyodar sku(da ces gsal bsgrags byas sku(da/ de nas nga tsho phar tshur yig 'grul byung / de 'dra'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas bar skabs the bon gyi chos tshogs 'ga' zhig dang / sgor pa de 'dra dang / tshogs pa de 'dra'i thog nas nga the bon la yong thub na zer mkhan mang po byung / kha shas kyis dus te nga tsho the wan la yod pa'i nang pa 'di dag 7rgyal ba rin po ches blos gtong gi yod dam zer mkhan yang byung / yin na yang nga the wan la 'gro rgyur rnyog khra mang po yod/ rnyog khra de dag gtsang sel ma thub bar du nga the wan la 'gro rgyu khag po red ces bshad kyi yod/de nas mtha' ma'i gnas tshul 'phel rim gyi babs la bstun nas sngon la gcig phyin te srid 'dzin rang dang thug chos tshogs khag gi mi sna tsho'i 'dod 481

pa de yang bsnang / the wan gyi mi mang tsho la nga rgya mi rigs la ngo rgol med/ rgya nag la ngo rgol min/ rang btsan rtsod kyi med/ rgya bod gnyis mos shig gi thabs lam btsal gyi yod ces gsal po byas nas bshad thub na/ rgya mi'i rna bar rgya mi gcig brgyud nas skad cha bshad pa yin na yid ches mang ba dang /shugs rkyen mang ba tan tan thebs thub kyi red/ deng sang the bon nas rgya nag skam sa chen po'i nang la dpal 'byor gyi 'dzugs bskrun thog mnyam 'brel rogs ram byed kyi yod pa dang / ma rtsa 'dzugs mkhan yang mang po yod pas the wan nas rgya nag skam sa chen wa'i nang la 'gro mkhan ha cang mang po yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi rgyu mtshan la brten nas mtha' ma the wan gzhung la gsal po byas nas lab rgyu byung / nga the bon la yong rgyu'i 'dod pa yod/ yin na yang bod sog las khungs dang dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas 'brel ba med pa gtsang ma zhig dgos pa yod ces bshad par the wan srid 'dzin las khungs nas kyang mos mthun gtsang ma byas te bod sog las khungs la bka' nan po btang 'dug de 'dra byas nas gnas tshul gsal po chags par brten/ phyi rgyar tshogs khag gis mgron 'bod byas pa ltar/ nga the bon du slebs rjes gtso che shos chos bshad phran bu byed rgyu byung / ngas gang yang shes kyi yod pa ma red de/ yin na yang bod gangs can gyi jongs la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ha cang dar rgyas chen poyod pa de'i cha shas tsam go myong thos myong yod pa la brte na nas /yul de'i nang pa tsho la theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa'i 'gro stangs skor 'grel bshad byas pa tshags par khag gi nang la yag po thon pa dang / nang pa 482

tshos kha zhe gnyis med kyi dga' po byed kyi 'dug de dgos pa chen spro zhig 'grub pu+ong bsam pa byung / the wan gyi nang pa tshos shes rab snying po dang / chos spyod de 'dra 'don pa'i skabs la dngos gnas nga rang sems skyo bo yong gi 'dug de gong nga sing ga spur la phyin pa'i skabs la nyams myong de thog ma byung / khong tshos rgya skad kyi nang la shes rab snying po bton pa'i skabs la sems 'byongs po zhig yong gi 'dug sngar 'don pa 'di bton mkhan gyi mi bye ba mang po yod pa'i lung pa zhig deng sang kha thabs skyo po 'di 'dra chags pa red bsam nas nga rang sems skyo dzede 'dra byung myong / gang ltar gtso che shos chos tshogs khag de dag dang / nang chos la dad pa yod mkhan de tsho'i gras la 'brel ba yag po byung / tshags par khag brgyud nas bod pa'i gnas tshul dang / nga'i langs phyogs rang bzhin gyis gsal po chags te yag po byung / srid 'dzin dang / srid 'dzin gzhon pa mjal 'phrad jog nga tsho'i dka' ngal de tsho'i gras bka' mol rob tsam rob tsam byung / chos dang rig gzhung gi las 'gan gathorwa 1 'khyer mkhan mi zhig thelon du gtan 'jags sdod rgyu byung ba yin na bod pa dang mnyam du phar tshur 'brel ba gsal po dang / gtsang ma yag po yong rgyur phan tshun gnyis mos byung ste tha'i wan du nga tsho'i rig gzhung gi las khungs shig 'dzugs rgyu gtan gtsang ma 'khel te bsdad yod/ rim pas the wan gzhung dang sger pa/ tshogs pa khag nas bod pa'i slob sbyong skor dang / 'phrod bsten/ chos sde khag sogs la rogs ram byed 'dod yod na/ ngo kog byed ma dgos par yongs bsgrags phyi gsal nang gsal byas nas btang na rogs ram tshogs pa 483

gzhan dag spyi mtshungs sprod bde len bde yong gi red/ de 'dra'i lam gsar pa zhig chags thub mi yong ngam bsam gyi 'dug the bon nang bod pa ha lam stong phrag gcig tsam yod pa red/ nga thug 'phrad du yong mkhan brgyad brgya skor 'dug de'i nang la sdom pa yod med ni mi shes/ gang ltar gra chas dmar po gyon mkhan ha lam bzhi brgya lnga brgya tsam yod sa red/ kho rang sto tshang mas bod pa'i la rgya gcig gyur zin te ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dug khong tsho mthun mong gi thog nas tshogs chung zhig bzos/ de'i nang sde dge ba rig 'dzin gyi 'thus mi lta bu byas te khong tshos yig cha don tshan gsum yod pa zhig bris 'dug—de'i nang da phan nga tsho wan la slebs pa rnams rang rang rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyi thog nas slebs pa las/ bod gzhung la rgyab ltos blo log sems log byas nas phyin pa min/ 'di khul slebs nas kyang so so'i mi rigs dang / so so'i rig gzhung de 'dra'i thog la rang lugs brtan spro zin te bsdad yod/ ma 'ongs pa lha yang 7rgya ba rin po che dang ṭ+wāṃ thod kyi spyi pa'i sgrog 'dzugs 'og bshar bskyod byed rgyu yin zhes bris 'dug nga tsho tshang ma sgor sgor yod sa der kho rang tshos yi ge klog de 'dra byas song / de dus lab rgyu byung / khyed rang tsho rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyi thog nas the wan la slebs yod pa red/ 'on kyang bod mi btsan byol ba spyi yongs kyi nang la mthong tshul yag po med pa shes gsal red/ yin na yang 'das pa 'das pa red/ da ring 'dir nga tsho dngos su thug pa'i skabs la khyed rang tshos don tshan gsum khas len byas te de snga yin kyang hur thag byas pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa la yang hur thag byed kyi yin zhes lab 484

pa yin dus da cha ma 'ongs pa gal che gi red/ ma 'ongs par de khyed rang tsho tshang mas dngos gnas da lta 'dir bshad pa bzhin/ bod spyi pa'i don dag ma brjed pa dang / so so'i mi rigs kyi rang tshugs brtan po zin nas bsdad pa yin na yag po red ces lab rgyu byung / gang ltar nga the bon la 'gro stangs de 'dra byas nas phyin pa red/ rgyu rkyen yong stangs de 'dra yin/ gnas tshul 'di rnams gsal bshad zhus na bsam byung / (mjug tu lha srung bsten phyogs sgor bka' 〉brestsal ba rnams lha srung brten phyogs bka' 〈be spyi byings khongs su zla bsgril phyogs bsdebs zhus/) 485

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1998 zla 6 tshes 13 nyin sud si bod mi sbyor tso ba'i bka' slob/da lta 'dir don gcod kyis lab pa bzhin da lam sud sir ched mngags yong ba yin/ ho lan dang / 'bel 'jam/ e kra li bcas la 'gro rgyu byas par nyin gcig gnyis bar seng zhig 'dug pa'i ring sud sir sngon ma bdun cu don gsum lo nas ngo shes pa'isem rje zhig yod pa khong sar skabs re brtag dpyad byed kyi yod pa ltar/ kha sang brtag dpyad khyug tsam byas pa yin/ da lta bkra shis dbang 'dus kyis 'grel bshad rgyag gi red/ de'i gong la bar lam gyi gnas tshul gcig gnyis ngas gsal bshad byas na/ da lam zhor yin stabs yag po mi yong ngam bsam byung /don tshan gcig la/ kha sang gsum bcu'i dus dran gyi gsung bshad nang la bkod pa ltar/ da phan lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam gyi ring la rgya nag gzhung dang thad shar 'brel ba byas te ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi thabs lam 'di 'dra zhig brgyud de rgya nag dang gros mol 'go 'dzugs thub pa dang / de brgyud nas rim bzhin dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs shes rim pa byas pa la rgyu nag gzhung dang gros mol 'go 'dzugs ma thub pas grub 'bras gang yang ma jon pa red/ ngas dbu ma'i lam gyi gros 'char bton pa'i dmigs yul gcig bod nang dza drag gi gnas tshul yod pa de rnams phran bu drag tu 'gro thub na bsam pa de la yang grub 'bras ma son pa red/ gal srid gnas tshul drag tu ma 'gro ba dang / rgya bod gnyis skad cha bshad rgyu'i bzo lta ma chags pa yin na/ mi mang la skad 486

cha dris rgyu yin zer ba'i bsam tshul de red/ las don gang zhig yin na yang dmigs yul rigs gcig la/ 'phral sel gyi gnas tshul la gtso bor ma dmigs par phyags rgyang ring wa zhig gi thob thang dang / de 'dra'i thog nas skad cha bshad phyogs lta buyong rgyu dang / yang thabs shes gcig shos ni dmigs yul gatho rwa1 sngon la 'phral du dza drag gi dka' ngal yod pa de sel rgyu'i thabs shes gcig bcas gnyis yong gi yod/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i nad la yang /'phral sel sman bcos byed stangs gcig dang / rim pas phyags rgyang ring po'i sman bcos byed stangs gcig bcas gnyis yong gi yod pa bzhin nga rang tsho'i las do na gang la yang de 'dra yong rgyu yin dus/ da phan 'das pa'i lo bcu bzhi'i ring la da lta dza drag gi gnas tshul yod pa de sel thabs gtso bor dmigs te thabs shes de dag byas pa red/ dmigs yul bzung sa gtso bo ni bod nang la dza drag gi gnas tshul rgya mi phon che yong gi yod pa nyung du 'gro thabs dang / khor yug gi gnas tshul nyam nyes 'gro ba 'di dag 'phral du mtshams 'jog yong ba'i re ba byas pa red/ de'ang grub 'bras ma thon pa red la/ rgya nag gzhung dang thad /ra gros mol 'go 'dzugs kyang ma thub pa red/yang tshur phyogs 'dir ngas dbu ma'i lam phyogs kyi gros 'char snga rjes bton pa de la phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgyal kha chen po thob yod/ ji ltar zhe na/ nga'i gros 'char gyi bsam khra'i 'khyer so'i thog la 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gzhung khag mang pos rgyab skyor byed bde byung nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang po yong gi yod/gang ltar 'dzam gling spyi yongs nas bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor dang sha tsha sems 487

khur slebs rgyu'i thog la phan sgogs chen po byung yod/'on kyang nga'i da lta'i gros 'char 'di thog bod phyi nang gnyis kus thog ma nas gros 'char 'di nus pa chung drags 'dug bod rang btsan gyi rgyal khab yin pas rang btsan rang gi langs phyogs bzung dgos pa ma gtogs rgya bod gnyis phan gyi zhi 'grigs yong rgyu'i bsam blo 'di khag po red ces bsam tshul shugs chen po zhig jog ma nas yong gi yod pa red/ 'go stod yin na nga'i langs phyogs 'di'i thog la nga rang gi bsam blo'i nang rgyu mtshan dang yid ches yod la/ mi la yin na yang rgyu mtshan 'grel bshad rgyag thub pa zhig yod/ da cha lo bcu bzhi lhag 'bad brtson byas kyang rgya bod gnyis skad cha byed rgyu 'go yang tshugs ma thub/ bod nang gi gnas tshul yang lo re nas dza drag cing je sdug je sdug tu 'gro dus ngas 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu'i rgyu mtshan gyis ma ldang pa lta bu chags yong gi 'dug gnyis nas bod nang gi gnas tshul dang / lhag don grong khyer che khag tsho'i nang la ha cang dza drag dang / 'u thug gi gnas tshul chags/ nga tsho phyi la yode pa 7rgyal ba rin po che nas 'go 'khrid pa'i lam phyogs de rgya mi la bstun mkhas shugs ches drags pa lta bur mthong ba'i gnas tshul gyi 'og nas mi re zung re zung phran bu sems shugs chag gi yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig na ning lo mjug der go thos byung / mi mang po yin bzo mi 'dug kyang sa khul re zung la de 'dra byung ba go dus ngas gnas tshul de dza drag cig tu mthong byung / de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga tshos 'phral phugs gang du yin na yang re ba rgyag sa dang / nga tsho'i bsgrub bya'i las don 'di bden pa yin bsam pa'i 488

yid ches dang / sems shugs slebs rgyu'i rtsa ba de bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gi 'gyur ba med pa'i sems shugs dang snying stobs de dag la thug yod/ de nga tsho'i tshong gi ma rtsa lta bu de yin/ da lta phan la bod nang la sems shugs ri btsugs pa nang bzhin yod pa de'i thog la gal te do phog 'gro ba'i gnas tshul zhig yong gi yod pa yin na ha cang 'gan ljid po chags yod/da phan lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam ring la nga'i ngos nas ma lan ma 'gyod pa byas pa yin/ de'i grub 'bras 'dzam gling phyi phyogs nas rgyab skyor mang po yong gi yod pa dang / lhag par du rgya mi'i nang nas nga'i langs phyogs 'di'i thog yongs grags rang byas te rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang je mang du 'gro gi yod/dper na/ nye ba'i char we'i cing hran zer mkhan deng sang rgyanag nang layongs grags kyi ngo rgol byed mkhan ming grags che shos don dgu lo nas bston 'jug byas pa des ting sha'o phing la yi ge zhig bris pa'i nang bod rang dbang gi lung pa yin pa dang / rgya gzhung gi srid byus nor 'khrul yong gi yod skor gsal po bkod 'dug yang da res nye char phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum nyin hrang has la yod pa'i rgya mi'i shes yon can dang / bzo pa bcas khyon rgya mi grangs lnga bcu nga bzhi tsam thun mong gi thog nas nas sa yig sbyar ma'i yi ge don tshan bcu dgu yod pa zhig rgya nag rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi tshogs gtso ja'o hri'i ming jog btang ba'i don tshan bco lnga'i nang la/rgya nag nang la yod pa'i mi rigs khag gi sa khul de dag la ming don mtshungs 489

pa'i rang skyong zhig dgos pa dang / lhag don bod thog la kha yod lag yod kyi rang skyong ming don mtshungs pa zhig dang / de'i skor la tā la'i bla mar thad gar rgya nag gzhung gis bka' mol gnang dgos kyi 'dug ces bkod 'dugarjes su yig cha bzo mi'i nang nas mi gtso bo gcig gnyis 'dzin bzung byas pa'i skad cha 'dug de bzhin 'dzam gling phyi logs nas rgya nag gi nang la mang gtso'i las 'gul byed mkhan rgya mi slob phrug dang / dge rgan/ shes yon can de tsho'isgang nas sems shugs che bskyed kyis 7rgyal ba rin po ce dang /bod par khag med lugs bshad de nga tshor rgyab skyor byed mkhan je mang je mang 'gro gi 'dug da lam nye ba'i char 'dzam gling phyi logs la yod pa'i rgya mi mang ga'i las 'gul byed mkhan gyi nang nas rgya nag skam sa chen po nas bros byol yong mkhan/ de bzhin hong kong dang / the bon gyi mi/ a ri'i mi ser yin pa'i rgya mi khrims don mkhas pa yin mkhan ming grags yod pa gang 'tshams shig gis snga rjes tshogs 'du 'tshogasate mthar ma 'ongs pa'i rgya nag rang dbang ldan pa zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i rtsa khrims gsar pa'i zin bris shig bzos pa de'i nang du bod kyi gnas tshul de yag po bkod yod tshod 'dug gang ltar da phan nga'i langs phyogs de'i thog la 'dzam gling phyi nang gang sa nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan yag thag chod byung ba red/ da dung rim bzhin bskyar du 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab khag dang / de bzhin sger pa'i mi sna khag tshogs pa khag bcas par 'bod bskul shugs ston rgyab te rgya nag gzhung la gnon shugs sprod rgyu dang gcig de bzhin 'dzam gling phyi la yod pa'i rgya nag mang gtso'i las 'gul 490

byed mkhan tsho'i thog la 'brel ba byas te de'i thog nas rgya nag gzhung la gnon shugs yong thabs byas te/ de 'dra'i 'og nas gcig byas na rgya nag gzhung nas bskyar du bsam blo gu yangs gtong rgyu'i re ba byed rgyu dang / ma gzhi re ba nyung nyung red/ yin na yang yong ma srid pa ma red bsam gyi 'dug snga lo spyi 'thus nas gros chod bzhag pa khyed rang tshos shes gsal red/ da dung nga'i langs phyogs kho rang gi thog dusasbun phran bu ngang sgug byas te ོ rgyu dang /lo gcig gnyis kyi mtshams nas gnas tshul gyi babs la bltas te da dung bzo lta gang yang ma thon na/ slar yang mi mang la skad cha 'dri rgyu yin/ mi mang la skad cha 'dri stangs rgya gar dang / phyi rgyal la yod pa'i bod pa tshor yongs grags byas nas bsam tshul bsdu thub kyi red/ bod nang du yongs grags byas te bsam tshul bsdu thub kyi ma red de/ da phan bod nang du mi sger pa de 'dra phar tshur 'gro 'ong bya mkhan yong gi yod pa de 'dra brgyud de thabs shes thub kyi red la/ de min4 ri'i rgyang bsring rlung 'phrin de 'dra'i thog nas thabs shes byed thub kyi red/ de ltar byas te gang ltar nga tsho'i bsam tshul gang yod gsal bshad dang 'brel ba'i thog nas bod sa khul yongs rdzogs nas bsam tshul bsdu ma thub na yang sa khul gnad che sa nas bsamaspend tsho'i bsam tshul bsdu thub kyi red/ de 'a dra byas te gzhis byes tshang ma'i bsam tshul zhig bsdus na bsam pa yin/ bsam tshul bsdu rgyu'i gzhi rtsa ni/ dang po/ da lta phan ngas dbu ma'i lam phyogs bzung ba 'di yin/ gang ltar sngar phan ni rtsod med kyis rgya dang bod zer tha dad so so red/ bod rang btsan gyi rgyal khab ma yin 491

yin khul gyi skad cha min par dngo sa yod lo rgyus dang / khrims/ rig gzhung /goms gshis/ za stangs 'thung stangs tshun nas rgya bod tha dad so so yin pa yongs grags red/ yin na yang ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling 'gyur ba gang yang yong rgyu yin stabs rgya mi'i ngos nas bod pa'i khe phan la bsam blo gtong rgyu yod pa zhig dang / bod pa'i ngos nas de lugs rgya mi'i khe phan gyi thog la bsam blo btang ste gnyis mos kyi sgog nas thabs lam zhig btsal na snyam pa'i dbu ma'i lam phyogs de la mu mthud 'gro dang mi 'gro dang / de'i thog phyin na dge skyon gang yod gsal bshad byed rgyu yod pa gcig dang / gnyis pa/ ngas gnyis phan dbu ma'i lam phyogs kyi gros 'char bton pa des 'grig gi mi 'dugabod rang dbang gtsang ma zhig dgos kyi red zer ba'i bsam tshul de gdam ga byed dang mi byed/ de 'dra zhig gi lam phyogs zin pa yin na dge skyon gang 'dugade dag kyang cha tshang gsal bshad bya rgyu yod pa gcig de nas da dung de gnyis ka ma yin pa'i thabs lam gsum pa bzhi pa de 'dra yong srid kyi red bsam gyi 'dug de'i stor la khyed rang tsho 'dir yod chab srid kyi thog la do snang dang /sems khur yod mkhan tshos bsam blo btang / go bsdur byas nas phyin chad rgya bod gnyis 'grigs pa'i thabs lam da lta 'dir bshad pa 'di gnyis ma yin pa'i deng sang 'tham gling gang sar 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod stabs de 'dra'i thog nas nga tshos dpe mtshon len rgyu yod mdog kha po red/ de 'dra'i thog nas bsam blo btang ste da ring sang nyin lta bu'i brel ba gang yang med/ rim pas zhar dang zhor la bsam blo btang / go bsdur byas nas blo gros gsar pa de 'dra 'don 492

rgyu yod pa yin na bka' shag la thad ka ra yi ge btang na yang 'grig gi red/sku yig tu nga'i ming thog la yi ge bris kyang 'grig gi red/ khyed rang tshos bsam tshul dang / go bsdur byas nas blo rogs gros rogs byed thub na ha cang yag po yong ba 'dug thabs lam gsum pa bzhi pa de 'dra tan tan yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug gang ltar rgya dang bod kyi bar gyi dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs lam da bar byed dang byed bzhin pa de 'am/ de min thabs lam gang dang gang yod pa de rnams gsal po byas te mi mang la khyab bsgrags byas/ de nas bod nang gi bsam tshul bsdu rgyur dus yun gang tsam 'gor gyi red/ nga tsho phyi la yod pa'i mi mang tshang mas gnas tshul cha tshang gi thog don sems la rtogs thub pa'i thog nas tshang ma go bsdur byas/ bsam blo btang / de 'dra byas te zla drug yin yang rung / lo gcig yin yang rung / de 'dra'i mtshams nas 'os 'phen byas te bsam 'char bsdus/ mang mos kyi bsam tshul gang yod gzhir bzhag gis nga tsho'i srid byus bsgyur bcos btang ste srid byus gsar pa zhig bzung na bsam pa ngas da lta go rim 'di 'dra zhig sgrig gi yod/ shes song ngam/ 'di da ring khyed rang tshor lab na bsam byung / de ni gal che ba'i don tshan gcig yin/de nas bar lam phyi rgyal la bod don rgyab skyor byed mkhan de 'dra thug skabs ngas 'grel bshad nan po rgyag gi yod/ nub phyogs pa'i mi kha shas kyi bsam khra'itang bod zer dus shar phyogs kyi lung pa nub phyogs nas ha cang thag ring po/ phyi dngos po'i thog nas yar rgyas gang yang med pa'i lung pa chung chung 493

zhig red/ bden don zhig red de yin na yang deng sang 'dzam gling gi dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ las ka 'di 'dra zhig byas te nga tshor khe phan gang yong rgyu 'dug gam/ zhes bsam blo gtong gi yod/ mi kha shas kyi bsam blo'i nang bod zer dus sa thag ring po dang / lung pa chung chung dngos po'i thog nas rjes lus thebs pa zhig yin pa dang rtsa ba'i bden pa yod kyang bden pa brdar sa rgya mi la thug gi yod pa dang / rgya nag ni stobs chen dang / gnad 'gag chen po yin pas bod pa'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas rgya mi'i thog la phog thug 'gro gzhi byung na phan thogs gang yang mi 'dug bsam pa dran gyi yod pa red/ bsam tshul de ni yong srid pa zhig red/ de 'dra'i thog la ngas 'grel bshad gang rgyag gi yod dam zer na/ nga bo da mi sa ya drug dang / de'i chos dang rig gzhung skyob thabs byed rgyu da lta dza drag gi gnas tshul la brten de'i thog rogs ram bya dgos zer ba 'di snying rje'i rtsa ba lta bu zhig ma red/ bod kyi sa cha'i babs nas ma 'ongs par spyir 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / yang sgos e sha ya'i sa khul gyi zhi bde la gnad 'gag shin tu chen po chags yod/ gnyis nas bod kyi rig gzhung 'di dag gis ma 'ongs par sa khul 'di'i nang la phan thogs byed thub pa'i cha rkyen yod/ rgyu mtshan de gnyis kyi thog nas da lta 'jig la nye ba'i dus tshod 'dir bod skyob rgyu de gal chen po red ces bshad kyi yod/rgyu mtshan dang po sa babs nas bod kyi gnas tshul gal chen po chags stangs gang yin zer na/ rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi bar la bod chags yod pa dang /'jig rten kha dper bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyang nas che zer ba bzhin/ rgya dkar 494

nag gnyis sa 'dres min par phran bu'i rgyang thag ring ba yod pa yin na yul gnyis po de phan tshun 'brel ba bzang po dang / don dam gyi grogs po yong srid pa red/ 'khrug pa rgyag rgyu'i nyen kha med/ bod yul nang la rgya mi'i dmag dpyang ma slebs bar rgya gar byang brgyud kyi sa cha 'di dag nyen kha rtsa ba nas med pa'i sa mtshams shig yin na yang / bod nang la rgya mis dbang bsgyur byas/bod nang rgya dmag slebs pa'i nyin smad do nas rgya gar byang rgyud kyi sa cha'i gnas stangs yongs su 'gyur ba red/ ma 'ongs pa na bod kyi chab srid rang skyong ngam/rang btsan gang yin rung sa khul 'di'i sgang la dmag mi med pa'i zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig bzo thub pa byung ba yin na/ e sha ya'i sa khul la bod pas dngos gnas phan thogs chen po byed thub pa tan tan yong gi red/ gnyis nas rgya nag gi khyim mtshes yin pa'i e sha ya'i rgyal khab mang po zhig gi lo rgyus thog sngar sa khul de tsho'i nang rgya nag gi mi rigs 'phel rgyas chen po phyin yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas sems kyi gnying nas ma bde ba zhig dang / dngangs skrag yod pa'i bzo 'a dug sngon ma ngas sha ya'i sa khul khag 'ga' zhig la slebs yod pas/ mi sna 'dra thug 'phrad yong skabs khong tsho'i bsam tshul gsal po mthong gi 'dug bod yul zhi bde'i bsti gnas shig la 'gyur thub pa dang /rgya dkar nag gnyis po de mdza' 'brel zhi mthun yag po zhig dang / gnyis rka'i stobs shugs cha snyoms dang / gnyis ka mthun po dang 'cham po de dang chabs cig nus pa de yang cha snyoms shig byung ba yin na sa khul 'di dag gi zhi bde la phan thogs tan tan yong gi red/ gsum nas rgya dkar nag gnyis 495

gar mi 'bor che bas dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal yod/ da lta'i bod kyi gnas tshul 'di la brten nas rgya dkar nag gnyis gas dmag mi mang po sa mtshams su bzhag ste 'gro song shin tu chen po gtong dgos stabs/ bod zhi bde'i bsti gnas bsgrub pa yin na rgya dkar nag gnyis ma'i dpal 'byor la khe phan yod pa dang / rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi 'brel ba bzang po byung na/ de la brten nas e sha ya'i sa khul la zhi bde yong thub pa dang / de la brten nas 'dzam gling spyi la phan thogs yong thub kyi red ces ngas 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod/'grel bshad de ltar byed dus mi mang po zhig la do snang gsar pa slebs yong gi 'dug de gnad 'gag gcig yin/de nas chos dang rig gzhung gi thog nas bod pas ma 'ongs par phan tho gas thub pa'i cha rkyen gang yod da ma zer na/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus nang rgya gar nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba 'di 'dra zhig bod la dar yod/ des rim bzhin bod kyi mtha' mtshams brgal te lto la cha bzhag na shar mon nas/ 'brug 'bras jongs/ ga sha/ khya nu/spi ti/ la dgas bar gyi sa khul de dag yongs rdzogs gang ltar lha ma la ya'i ri rgyud yongs rdzogs la khyab pa dang / byang ngos la cha bzhag na/ sog po phyi nang gnyis dang / shin cang gi nang la'ang nang pa gang la gang tsam yod/ de bzhin u ru su'i khongs gtogs mang gatsho'i yul sde gsum dang / de min rdzong khag gi rang skyong khag kha shas bcas khyona.u ru su'i nang la bod kyi nang pa'i chos kyi rjes su 11ba mkhan mi ha lam sa ya gnyis tsam yod pa'i gnas tshul 496

'dug de ltar bod mi sa ya drug dang / de nas hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud la sa ya gcig lhag tsam/ u ru su'i nang la sa ya gnyis/ sog po phyi nang gnyis bsdoms na phal cher sa ya lnga tsam bcas khyon mi grang sa ya bco lnga brgal bas theg pa che chu sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di nyams len byed kyi yod/ bod kyi rig gzhung spyi yongs kyi cha nas bshad pa yin na/ rang bzhin gyis mi'i spyi tshogs nang la zhi bde'i spyi tshogs zhig 'dzugs skrun byed rgyur phan thogs yod pa dang / bod pa'i rig gzhung gi thog nas sems can ci 'dra zhig yin kyang de la snying rje byed pa/ mdor na bshan pas so so'i 'tsho ba'i don la sems can gsod pa'i skabs su yang kha nas ma ṇi bgrangs bzhin sdig las yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ bod pa'i rig gzhung gi thog nas rang bzhin gyi mi phan tshun brtse ba dang / de bzhin mi dang srog chags gzhan bar gyi 'brel ba/ khor yug gi 'brel ba bcas gang cir mi'i bsam blo gu yangs dang / zhi bder phan gyi yod pa gsal po red/ mdor na bod kyi rig gzhung 'dis bod mi sa ya drug tsam ma zad/ lha ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas/u ru sa'i sa khongs nang yod pa'i nang pa bcas par phan thogs yod pa dang /deng sang 'dzam gling nub phyogs rgyal khab de snga nang chos la do snang med mkhan dang / ye shu'i chos pa'i nang nas kyang deng sang do snang byed mkhan gang tsam yong gi yod pas/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs la'ang gang la gang 'tshams kyi phan thogs byed thub pa yong gi red/ lhag par rgya nag gi nang la ma 'ongs par gtam brjod rang dbang dang / chos dad rang mos yag po zhig byung ba'i 497

mtshams su rgya mi na gcesan saya mang po zhig la sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi thog nas phan thogs byed thub pa tan tan mthong gi 'dug dper na/ deng sang pe cing la sngon ma paṇa chen rin po ches nang chos kyi slob gra btsugs gnang ba de'i gras dang / de min bod kyi nang chos phran bu'i cha rgyus yod mkhan de tsho'i nang nas gnas tshul phran bu go thos yong babs la gzhigs na/ rgya mi'i nang nas spyir nang pa/ de'i nang nas bod kyi chos la do snang bya mkhan mang po tan tan yod pa'i bzo 'dug lhag par shes yon can gyi nang du do snang byed mkhan yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po mthong gi 'dug ma 'ongs par rang dbang gi go skabs byung ba yin na/ bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rig gzhung gi thog nas rgya mi mang po zhig la phan thogs yong rgyu tshod thig nas bshad thub kyi 'dug da lta bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa 'jig la nye ba'i mtshams su slebs pa 'dir srung skyob thub pa byung ba yin na/ ma 'ongs par bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa 'disalge sha ya'i sa khul gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dzam gling 'di'i snang la phan thogs sgrub thub pa'i cha rkyen yod pa zhig red/ de yod pa 'di dag nga tshos 'dzam gling thog gsal po ston rgyu gal chen po 'dug nga tsho'i ngos nas bod don 'di bden pa'i gnas tshul yin/ nga tshor 'bu ches chung zos kyi thub tshod bshad byung / sku mkhyen gsung mkhyen zer ba gcig pu ma yin par/ nga tsho 'tsho thub na 'dzam gling nang phan thogs de 'dra byed thub kyi yod pa dang / 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la byas rjes bzhag thub pa'i nga tshor cha rkyen dang / gdengs tshod yod pas/ bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang 498

bcas pa skyob rgyu 'di 'dzam gling spyi'i khe phan la thug gi yod ces nga chos 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu gal chen po 'dug gnad 'gag de khyed tshor lab 'dod byung /de nas don tshan gcig la/ chung tsag red de bar lam dha ram sa la bzhugs sgar du rgya gar yul pa dang lab rtsod phran bu byung ba red/ nga a rir yod skabs gnas tshul go thos byung dus blo g.yeng phran bu byung / de nas dha sar slebs rjes nga'i bsam blor yul pa tsho dang phran bu'i bsam blo'i nang nas ma bde ba byung ba yin na de yag po ma red/ dzña ram sa la grong sde chung chung zhig nang bod pa stong phrag kha shas yod pa de mngon gsal dod po chags yod/de sel ba'i thabs shes la bod pa nyung du gtong rgyu ma gtogs gzhan thabs shes med/ nyung du gtong sar slebs dus bod khyim dang / slob gra 'di tsho'i gras lam sang dzña sa nas sa cha gzhan zhig la h+pho dgos byung na de'ang dka' las khag po red/ bar skabs shig nas btsan byol gzhung gi las khungs khag kha shas sdi lir h+pho dgos kyi 'dug ces sngon ma nas nga tsho skad cha yod mus red/ nang srid/ shes rig dril bsgrags lhan khang 'di tsho ldi lir sgos na yag po 'dug ces bdun cu brgyad cu'i nang nas rtag par skad cha yong mus red/ sngon ma nas bsam tshul de 'dra yod bzhin pa'i thog da cha las khungs khag gang tsam ldi lir spo rgyu dang / de nas ga le ga ler nga sdod sa yang rgya gar grong khyer che khag cig gi nye 'gram zhig la bsdad na/ grong khyer che khag cig gi 'khris la bod pa stong phrag kha shas yod na'ang mngon gsal gang yang yong gi ma red 499

bsam pa'i bsam tshul byung / dzña sar slebs skabs mi kha shas la ngas gnas tshul de 'grel bshad rgyab pa yin/ yul pa tsho dang nga tsho lo sum cu so bzhi ring gshibs nas bsdad pa red/ tshang ma yag thag chod yin/ da cha bod pa'i dpe la yod pa bzhin/ dga' dbye 'dzum bral bya rgyu gal chen po red/ nga tsho phan tshun tshang ma'i bsam cho'i nang la ha cang thabs sdug ma byung gong la ga le ga ler bzang gyes byas na yag po med dam zhes lab pa yin/ de rjes yul pa tshos bsam tshul de rim pas shes skabs sde tshogs 'dra min tshang ma'i nang nas yul pa'i mi 'thus 'ga' shas ngos kyi sar yong ste/ kha zhe gnyis med kyi bod par dga' po'i thog nas bod mi rnams sngar bzhin dha sar bsdad na ha cang yag po 'dug 'di nas gzhan la spo rgyu'i bsam blo rtsa ba nas ma btang rogs byed/ 'das pa'i lo so bzhi'i ring la dzña ram sa lar bod pa slebs nas yul lung yar rgyas 'gro rgyu sogs ha cang yag po byung / phyin chad 7rgyal ba rin po che dzña ram sa la nas thad gar lha sar phebs rgyu ma gtogs/ rgya gar nang khul gyi sa cha gzhan la sgo rgyu'i dgongs bzhes ma gnang rogs ces nga la nan po byas te zer gyi 'dug 'ga' shas mig la chu zhag 'khor te bsam pa rnam dag gi rnam 'gyur thon gyi 'dug da res dzña sar gnas tshul de 'dra byung ba ni dngos yod la mi nyung shas kyi gnas tshul red ma gtogs/ mi mang mang che ba'i bsam blor de 'dra rtsa ba nyid nas med/ de 'dra'i rnyog phra bzo mkhan de brgya cha gcig kyang long gi ma red zer gyi 'dug de dang chabs cig sa gnas hi ma cal mnga' sde'i gzhung dang / de bzhin rgya gar dbus gzhung nas ched 500

mngags mi sna btang byung / bod pa'i tshong khang 'ga' zhig la skyon shor byung ba'i gras la rgya gar phyi srid las khungs nas gun gsab sprad de gang ltar do khur chen po gnang gi 'dug gtso che shos yul pa de dag gis bsam pa rnam dag gi thog nas dzña sar de snga phan chad mnyam du gshibs te yag thag chod yin/ ma 'ongs pa la bod rang dbang ma thob bar dzña sa rang la bsdad rogs zhes kha zhe gnyis med thog nas bshad pa yin tsang / de 'dra yin na ngas da lta thag bcad pa med/ bsam tshul 'di 'dra yin zhes dang / nga tsho dang po dha sar sgo rgyu 'di nga rang tsho rang gis dha ram sa la'i sa cha 'di bdam ste yong ba min/ sngon ma nga tsho ma sur rir lo gcig bsdad pa red/ ma su rir yod dus rgya gar phyi srid las khungs nas ma su rir nga tsho sdod sa gra sgrig byed pa 'di 'phral sel gyi sdod sa yin/ yun ring gi bzhugs sgar chags sa sa cha gzhan zhig rgya gar gzhung gis 'tshol zhib byas yod/ dha ram sa la'i sa cha 'di sa khad yangs po dang / gangs ri nags tshal sogs yag po yod ces bshad de rgya gar gzhung gis gtan 'khel byas pa ma garke(gas/ nga cesas sa cha 'di 'dems sgrug byas pa min/ gnyis nas nga tsho thog mar dzña sar sgos tshar mtshams der 'grims 'grul dang / ldi lir 'brel ba byed khag po/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med stabs drug cu re lnga re drug nang nga tsho dzña sa nas sgo rgyu'i bsam blo btang ba yin/khyed tsho 'ga' zhig gis shes gsal red/ nga tshos na ni tal dang / de bzhin ma su ri rgyud dang / ra ci pu'u rgyud sogs sa khul mang po zhig la nga tshos blta skor byas pa yin/ de dus yang dzña ram sa la'i yul pa'i 'thus mi khag gcig 501

nga'i sar yong ste 'di nas spo rgyu'i bsam blo ma btang rogs zhes nan po lab ste 'di gar rang 'jags bsdad pa red/ yang de rjes brgyad cu gya grangs nang la sa 'gul shugs chen po byung / des rkyen pas bzhugs skar sgo dgos kyi 'dug ces bod rigs nang khul la bsam tshul shugs che byung yang / da cha 'di nas sgos kyang brdab gsig gi rgyu red bsam nas 'di ga rang la bsdad rgyu gtan 'khel ba red/ nga tshos sa cha sgrug ste yong ba min na yang mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis sgo rgyu'i bsam tshul snga rjes byung ba red de/ lo mang phyin tshar ba red/ mi rgyus yod dang / sa rgyus yod chags pa yin dus de mur bsdad pa red/ da res rkyen ngan byung bar brten rim pas rgyang ring tsam bsdad na snyam pa'i bsam tshul byung ba red/ snga phyi'i yong rkyen de 'dra red ces ngas khong tshor 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu byung / da cha khyed rang tsho'i bsam blo'i nang du mtha' gcig tu grogs po rnying pa'i la zhen ma bor ba'i thog nas nga sto 'di gar sdod dgos pa'i bsam tshul shugs chen bshad kyi yod na dka' ngalayong gi ma red ces lab rgyu byung / gang ltar da res rkyen ngan byung ba 'dis rkyen ngan grogs shar lta bu byung / yul pa tshos dpyad sgom byas par brten nas yul pa'i snang ngo la bod pa'i rin thang gzhi nas che ru phyin/ bod par do snang gsar pa zhig slebs/ de bzhin bod pa tsho'i ngos nas kyang rang nyid lung pa bral ba'i mi yin pa dang / yul pa tsho gnad 'gag chen po yin pa'i nyams myong gsar pa zhig byung ba bcas yag po byung song /denas done tshan gzhan zhig la/ zhib cha bkra shis dbang 'dus kyis 'grel 502

bshad rgyag gi red/ don dag gtan nas med pa'i rnyog khra zhig byung / nye char chu zhi sgang drug gi 'go 'khrid mi gsum nga'i sar yong ste/ sdi lir chu bzhi sgang drug gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i gros chod 'di yin zhes nga la bstan par slebs byung / grod chod de nga la sprad rjes gzim chung nang mi gzhan yod med phar lta tshur lta gang 'tshams byas te gzhi nas mi gcig gisam phag nang nas yig kog cig sprad byung / yi ge de go min tang dang mnyam du yig cha bzhag pa zhig yin/ shin tu gsang ba yin zer gyi 'dug yi ge de rob tsam bltas par don tshan gsum 'dug ngas 'di gsang ba byas nas nga la lab pas phan thogs med/'di gnad 'gag chen po chags yod/ bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso la lab na ma gtogs yong gi ma red/ lar nas dang po yi ge ma bzhag gong nas nga tshor skad cha bshad dgos pa yin na yang / khyed rang tshos yi ge bzhag tshar ba red/ bzhag tshar nas nga la lab par yong ba 'di dngos gnas byas na ga phyi log pa red/ ma bzhag gong la nga tsho ra skad cha bshad/ go bsdur byas na 'grigs pa red de/ las ka tshang ma tshar rjes gzhi nas nga tshor lab pa 'di snga rting log pa red/ nga'i snang ba la 'tho ༄/ ma byung / ngas khyed tsho chu bzhi'i snang drug la dus da lta bar du dngos gnas yag po byas yod/ bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo gang sa nas mthun 'gyur byas yod/ da cha ngas khyed tshor 'di byed 'di ma byed bslab bya rgyab par khyed tshos nyan gyi ma red/ de snga phan chad la ngas lab pa rnams ji bzhin ma byas pa de 'dra byung bar blo pham yod/ da cha ngas 'grel bshad rgyab par khyed tshos nyan gyi red bsam pa'ang mi 'dug la nyan 503

rogs byed zer rgyu gang yang med/ mar rgyugs shig lab pa yin/ de nas yi ge de'i ngo bshus bka' shag dang / tshogs gtso gnyis la sprad pa yin/ de'i sang nyin zhogs pa tshogs gtso dang / bka' shag nga'i sar yong ste nga cho go bsdur byung / de nas sngon la ngas skad cha ma bshad gong la chogs gtso rgan gzhon gnyis dang / bka' blon tsho la bsam tshul gang yod skad cha dris pa yin/khong tsho tshang mas gnad don de gal 'gangs chen po da nga / gang ltar skyon gnad yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po bsam tshul gcig gyur red 'dug de nas ngas da gang 'dra byas na legs/ bsam blo gtong dgos pa 'dug mdo stod chu bzhi sgang drug la cha bzhag na dngos gnas byas pa can gyi tshogs pa zhig red/lar nas 11da kyi / rgyus kyi —nang la cha bzhag na/ bod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi thog nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po zhig mdo stod kyi phyogs nas byung yod/ da lta rgya gar nang yod pa'i sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa'i mkhan po las zur de dag phal che ba mdo stod smad nas yong ba red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung jog la byas rjes bzhag yod/ khams rigs nang la bar skabs nas 'bri chu shar rgyud dang / 'bri chu nub rgyud zer ba'i skad cha zhig lhags pa red/ des rkyen pas 'bri chu nub rgyud la yod pa'i khams rigs de snga mi rabs nas mi rabs pha tshe bu rabs nas dga' ldan pho brang gi 'og la sdod mkhan gyi mi mang tshos dga' ldan pho brang la lta stangs de dang / yang bar lam rgya sde'i khongs la sdod mkhan gyi mi tshos dga' ldan pho 504

brang la lta stangs de la phran bu'i khyad par yong mdog kha po red/ 'di tsho dngos yod rgyu rkyen zhig gi thog nas byung ba ma gtogs lhag bsam ma dag pa'i cha nas byung ba min pas de dag gnas tshul khag khag red/ de snga phan chad lo sum cu so lnga'i ring la ngas bsam tshul 'di rang bcangs kyi yod la/ go skabs mang po zhig la 'grel bshad 'di rgyag gi yod/ yongs grags byas nas 'grel bshad 'di tshar kha shas rgyab yod/ mdo stod sa khul 'di dag ha cang gal chen yin pa dang / de'i ming gi thog nas byung ba'i chu bzhi sgang drug la cha bzhag na'ang byas rjes yod pa'i tshogs pa zhig red/ gal chen po yin pa'i tshogs pa 'di'i 'go 'khrid mkhan do brtan ma byung ba'i skabs la/ ming chen wa de 'khyer/ las ka lag len gyi thog la ran po med pa chags na nyen kha chen po 'dug gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug phyin chad de 'dra ma yong ba'i thabs shes byed dgos kyi 'dug ces nga tsho go bsdur byas/ de nas bka' shag dang phyogs gtso go bsdur byas te nga la snyan zhu sprad mkhan chu bzhi sgang drug gi mi sna gsum po de la bka' shag dang spyi 'thus thun mong nas 'grel bshad byed rgyur thengs kha shas thug 'phrad byas pa red/ mtha' ma'i dus su bka' shag dang tshogs gatsho'i thog nas/ gnad don de skor mi mang rang la skad cha dris na yag po yong gi yin pa 'dra/ khong tshos de ltar thag gcod byed pa'i dbang tshad yod pa zhig yin nam min/ thag gcod byas pa de la mi mang gi bsam tshul gang 'dra 'dug skad cha dris na yag po med dam zhes bsam 'char byung bar de ltar byas na 'grig gi 'dug ces thag gcod byas pa red/ 'go stod 505

nga sto rgya gar du slebs pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung ste chol kha gsum zer ba 'di ha cang gal chen por rtsis yod/ bod nang la'ang 'di gal chen por rtsis te deng sang bod chol gsum yongs rdzogs la khyab pa'i ming zhig 'bad rtsol byas nas dper na bod nang khul gyi yig cha mang po zhig gi nang la gangs ljongs zer mkhan dang / gangs can pa zer ba 'di bris te bod nang khul la yang gnad 'gag chen por brtsis kyi 'dug nga tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan chos yin na yang chol kha gsum gal chen por rtsis yod/ dper na bden tshig smon lam gyi nang la'ang / yongs rdzogs bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal/ zhes 'khod pa 'di yang bsam cho de 'dra btang nas bkod pa red/ dus da lta bar nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul yang bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba 'di nga tsho'i rtsa don zhig tu bzung nas bsdad yod/ 'on kyang 'go 'khrid mkhan re zung gis mi mang kha la 'khyer nas las ka byed thal shor ba dang / gal te 'di 'dra'i las ka byas pa la mi mang gi dngos gnas rgyab skyor yod pa zhigayin na gnas tshul de gzhi ljid po chags kyi yod red/ nga'i bsam blo'i nang la gtso 0 che shos bod nangayod pa'i khams rigs mi mang de dag srog 'ben btsugs kyis bsdad yo da/ sdug pa re zung ni nga tsho chol gsum sa cha gang du yang yong gi red de/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams dngos gnas ma bgros bsam pa gcig mthun gyi 'og nas so so'i langs phyogs brtan po zin te bsdad yod/ shes yon che chung gi gnas tshul khag khag red/ rtsa ba'i bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i thog nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis lo sum cu so lnga ring bsdad 506

pa dang / de nas yar thag ring du btang ba yin na lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum lhag tsam ring la bod mi rigs yongs rdzogs so so'i rang tshugs brtan po zin te bsdad pa red/ da cha nga tsho'i bden mtha' gsal ba'i re ba je che je cher phyin pa'i skabs la mi re zung gis bsam blo tan tan ma btang bar zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan lta bu chags pa yin na de shin tu phangs po red/ de mi mang tshos mgo 'tshos pa byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug bka' shag dang tshogs gso'i jog nas thag gcod byas te mi mang tshang mar bsam tshul 'dri rgyu gtan 'khel ba bzhin /mi mang tshos bsam blo tan tan btang nas phyin chad de 'dra mi yong ba'i bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug gzab gzab byas na ma gtogs de gnad 'gag chen po mthong gi 'dug bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' stsal// //507

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1998 zla 6 tshes 29 nyin la dwags zhi ba'i tshal du rgyal sras lag len so bdun ma'i bka' 'khrid skabs rigs rus kyi skor bka' slob stsal ba/sangs rgyas kyi chos bya mkhan rnams la rigs rus kyi dbye ba med pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nan po gnang yod/ 1954 lo nga rgya nag pe cing du zla ba bzhi tsam bsdad pa yin/ de'i ring ma'o tshe tung tshar mang po mjal byung / skabs gcig ma'o tshe tung gis rgya gar nang rigs rus kyi dbye 'byed chen po yod pa der ngo rgol byed ched bcom ldan 'das kyis nang pa'i chos de gsungs pa red/ bcom ldan 'das ni gsar brje ba chen po zhig red ces maca dmi tung gis lab myong / rgya gar du bram ze'i chos lugs kyi jog nas rigs rus kyi dbye ba mang po zhig phye/ rigs dman pa de dag gis sto chas sogs la lag pa 'chang na lto chas de mi za ba sogs spyi tshogs nang la drang bden min pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad par brten/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs rus kyi thog la dmigs bsal thugs snang gnang 'dug nga'i chos la rigs mi gtso/ rus mi gtso/ sgrub pa gtso rwa1 yin gsungs yod/ de'i dpe mtshon du/ rgya gar du skra dang / sen mo 'breg mkhan tsho rigs dman par brtsi ba yin na'ang /'breg mkhan gnas brtan nye ba 'khor gyi zhabs la rgyal pos mgo bo btud dgos zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs 'dug 'og ṭara.am be kur nas nang pa'i chos la rigs rus kyi dbye ba med pa 'di gzigs nas nang chos la thugs yid 'phrog pa byung ba red/ spyir btang mgar ba dang / bshan pa/ bsu 508

sna gtong mkhan tsho rigs dman par brtsimakhan yod 'dug khyed rang tsho sangs rgyas dang / chos la skyabs su mchi zer mkhan zhig yin na rigs rus kyi dbye ba gtan nas phye mi rung / gzab gzab byed dgos/ brda ma brdung mkhan dang / bsu sna gtong mkhan sogs rigs dma' bar rtsis nas gral mthar bzhag pa de med pa bzo dgos stabs ched du gnyer nas khong tsho gral gong la bzhag zas gos kyi phud de khong tshor sprad na yag po red/ rigs dman pa tshor mthong chung ma byed ces ngas sngon ma nas mang po lab pa yin/ rigs 'ga' shas la phan yod pa red/ rigs 'ga' shas la phan med pa zhig ngas go yong gi 'dug de bden pa yin min mi shes/ gal te bden pa yin na/da dung nan du gtong dgos stabs rigs dman pa tsho mgron gyi gatho rwa1ra brtsis nas gong du bzhag rnyed pa dang po de phul/ rigs dman la mthong chung byed srol med pa yong slad/ ched du gnye ra nas thabs shes byas na/ spyi tshogs nang phan che ba yong gi red/ ngas go bos byas na/ bram ze'i rigs kyis dbye 'byed byas pa ltar rigs dman pa de tsho zam pa'i sgang la 'gro chog gi med pa red zer ba go byung / bden payin min mi shes/ de bzhin thugs spro gtong skabs brda ma brdung mkhan tsho yong dgos kyi yod na yang / gral mthar phud nas 'jog gi yod pa go thos byung / de 'dra gtan nas bya rgyu yod pa ma red/dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa tshos kyang rigs bzang ba'i sar zhabs brtan la 'gro ba las rigs dman pa'i sar mi 'gro ba bya rgyuyod pa ma red/ dge 'dun pa tshos rigs bzang ngan dbye 'byed byas na rtsa ba nas nor ba red/ bcom 509

ldan 'das kyi rjes su 'brangs mkhan zhig gis rigs rus kyi dbye ba phye na bcom ldan 'das thugs pham gyi red/ rigs mi gtso/ rus mi gtso/ sgrub pa gtso gsungs pa de nga tshos shes pa byas/ 'breg mkhan nye ba 'khor gyi zhabs la rgyal pos kyang mgo bo btud dgos gsungs yod pas nga rang tshos khong tsho rigs dman pa la brtsi ba de nor 'khrul yin pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi thog bshad na'ang drang bden ma red/ deng sang pho mo 'dra mnyam med pa de tshor 'dra mnyam dgos pa'i rtsod pa byed pa dang / rigs rus kyi dbye ba yod pa de tshor rigs rus kyi thob thang rtsod kyi yod pa/ tshos gzhi dkar nag gi thog nas dbye ba yod pa de tsho thob thang rtsod nasa.a ri dang / a phe ri kha'i nang 'thab rtsod byas nas 'gyur ba mang po 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho sangs rgyas kyi chos bya mkhan gyi spyi tshogs shig nang rigs nus kyi dbye ba phye na ngo tsha dgos pa zhig dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi zhabs 'dren red/ de 'dra byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ces bka' 37pa// //510

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1998 zla 10 tshes 31 nyin 'jar man du bod rigs mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/lo bcu grangs gong gi rgya nag gzhung gis 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi skor la 98brel ba gnang stangs dang / deng sang 'brel ba gnang stangs gnyis 'gyur ba phyin tshar ba red/ stobs chen rgyal khab kyi mdun du dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya nag gzhung nas gdong len byed dgos pa zhig dang / dgongs pa bzhes dgos pa zhig chags kyi yod tsang / gzhi rtsa de'i thog nas rgya nag gzhung gis dgongs pa ma bzhes thabs med cig byung ba red/ gnyis nas rgya nag gi dpon rigs tsho mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod pa red/ mi thog gsar pa de rnams kyi thos rgya mthong rgya mi thog rnying pa tsho dang 'dra gi ma red/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyang 'gyur ba chen po 'gro bzhin pa red/ byas tsang rgya nag 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa red la/ da dung 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red/ yin na'ang bod la rgya mi khyon che yong ba de skor/ sangs rgyas ma byon sngon la bram ze rgas zer ba'i dpe ltar yong rgyu'i nyen kha yod pas de dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig chags yod /ngas rtag tu bden mtha' gsal la nye ba yin zhes shod kyi yod/ gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang da lta bar du sems shugs4nga ki dang po yod/ nga tsho btsan byol bar cha bzhag na'ang mtha' dbus gang la yod pa tshang mas hur skyed gnang gi yod pas thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ da dung gal che shos bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams la sems shugs dang / lhag bsam yod na yang / shes yon gyi thog nas lung khug de tsho'i gras snga mo'i 'gro stangs de tsam byung na 511

'grigs pa'i bsam tshul rgya chung chung chags kyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug dus kyi 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pa red/ rang bzhin gyi bod pa'i de snga'i 'gro stangs de tsam la chog shes byas nas bsdad na nga tsho ༄sa lus thebs kyi red/des phugs rgyang ring po'i thog la phan gyi ma red/ deng dus dang mthun pa'i yar rgyas yod pa dang chabs cig nga rang tshor gna' rabs nas yod pa'i bzang po'i lta spyod/ ya rabs kyi spyod bzang 'dzam gling nang mig dpe 'os pa zhig dang / gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i so so'i rig gzhung phyug potsede pa de dag mnyam du rgyun 'dzin byed thub pa zhig nga tshos shugs rgyag dgos/nga tsho bod rigs nang nas phyi la 'brel ba ma byung ba dang / so so khug skyog nang snga mo'i bag chags kho na bzung nas bsdad pa'i skabs su lag par phreng ba zhig 'khyer te ma ṇi bgrangs nas chos dad chen po yod pa lta bu yod na'ang / 'dzam gling phyi la 'brel ba byung ba'i skabs la ga le ga ler phreng ba dang / ma ni bgrangs rgyu de'ang bzhag de snga'i bod pa'i goms gshis bzang po de tsho rjes lus red mdog mdog byed mkhan de rigs mi yong ba'i nges pa med/ yang na yar rgyas med par ྅rwa nga byas nas bsdad/ yang na yar rgyas phyin pa dang cha bas cig bzang po'i goms gshis kyang phyi nang slog na cho gangayang med/ rgyal khab dang / dpal 'byor sogs kyi 'gro stangs deng dus dang mthun pa'i yar rgyas cha tshang yod pa'i thog la/ nga tsho'i khyad chos bzang po yod pa rnams la rgyu mtshan dang / dgos pa mthong ba'i jog nas 'dzin thub na yag po yod/ bod nang gzhis lus mi mang rnams lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba dang / sems shugs 'gyur ba 512

med pa yod/ da dung de'i thog la deng dus kyi shes yon sbyang rgyu dang / chos lu dad pa byed stangs kyang nga tsho'i pha mes kyis dad pa byed kyi yod pa red/ ngas kyang dad pa byas pa yin zhes bshad pas 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ chos zhes pa de'i don shes pa byed dgos/ bka' chos thog la skad cha byung ba ltar shes na bro ba zhig kha rgyu yod pa red/ ma shes na spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs red/ yi shu dang / kha che/ hin du sogs chos 'dra min mang po yod pa tshang ma ra lha khang yod pa dang / smon lam rgyag rgyu sogs byed stangs 'dra po yod/ ma gzhi sems can khams dang mos pa sna tshogs yod dus chos lugs 'dra min yod pa des da lta 'dzam gling nang phan thogs yod pa dang / ma 'ongs pa la'ang phan jogs tan tan yong gi red/ yin na yang nang pa'i chos kyi 'gro stangs gsal po shes na rgyu mtshan masgong ste nges pa rnyed rgyu zhig yod pa red/ tshang mas chos dang rig gzhung la do snang byas nas shes pa bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ lha khang bzhengs rgyu dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs rgyu de yag po yin kyang / de gcig pos phan gyi ma red/ nang gi lung rtogs kyi yon tan zhes pa de rang gi rgyud la yod dgos/ gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de ga 'dra yin pa slob sbyong yag po byas/ deng dus shes yon la do snang yag po byed dgos/ gzhon skyes tsho khag ni khag mi 'dug bsam cho'i nang ma skyid pa chags/ de 'dra'i 'og nas chang btung / sho sbag rtsed nas nyin ma gang 'khyol gyis sprang 'khyams rgyab/ 'chal spyod sna tshogs spyad nas sdod mkhan de sto dngos 'brel so so so sos drin chung gtong gi yod pa red/ gzab gzab 513

byed dgos/ rgyun du slob sbyong la do snang dang / so so'i las rigs gang yin pa de'i nang nyams myong yag po bsags nas 'gan cha tshang theg pa zhig byed dgos/ bod sa khul gyi khor yug tshang ma rang bzhin gyis gtsang ma zhig yod pa der do snang bya rgyu gal chen po red/ bar lam rgya nag la chu log chen po byung ba de rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba ltar rgya nag dbus gzhung gi 'brel yod tshos shing sna rgya che gcod breg byed pa de chu log yong ba'i rkyen rtsa gcig chags 'dug na shing gcod breg byed rgyu mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa dang / 'ga' shas nyung du gtong dgos zer ba'i skad cha bshad pa de yag po byung 'dug da cha skye shing gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / btsugs pa de dag 'tshar longs yag po yong rgyur bdag gces bya rgyu gal chen po red/ khor yug nyag phra po yod pa der bod pa tshos do snang bya rgyu de gal chen po dang gnad 'gag chen po chags kyi 'dug gzhis byes mnyam 'jums yong rgyu'i re ba chen po yod pa red/ byes 'khod mtha' dbus gang dang gang du bzhugs pa tshang mas sngar bzhin hur thag gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ nga rang gi ngos nas zhus na/ lo rgas yong gi yod na'ang lus po bde thag chod yod/ bod bstan srid kyi don nga rang gis ma shes pa dang / ma thub pa rnams de ga red ma gtogs/ gzhan hur thag zhu bsam pa yod/ yin na'ang nga mi gcig gis sgo 'pher thabs yod pa ma red/ tshang mas mnyam nub hur thag gnang gi yod pa red la gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/ gzhan dmigs bsal zhu rgyu med/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bka' sdig5/514

yang / rgya bod gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i skor tshags dpar rgyag mkhan tshos skad cha dris nas gnas tshul gsar pa de 'dra 'tshal gyiyod dus de 'dra'i gnas tshul thon pa ma gtogs/ da lta rtsa ba'i dmigs bsal 'gyur ba 'gro gi mi 'dug gzhung 'brel byed rgyu de dgu bcu go gsum lo nas mtshams chad pa red/ gzhung 'brel ma yin pa'i tshogs pa de 'dra dang / yang tshong pa de 'dra yod pa red/ yang byed gzhung 'brel gyi 'brel ba de 'dra 'ang yod pa red/ bar skabs zla shas nang gzhung 'brel ma yin pa'i 'brel ba byed pa'i ngo bo de phran bu zab tu 'gro gi yod pa lta bu 'dug gnas tshul de tsam zhig red/ gang ltar 'gyur ba ni 'gro gi 'dug yin na yang da lta gtan 'khel ba'i 'di 'dra zhig bya gi yin zer ba shod rgyu gang yang yod pa ma red/ bshad rgyu yod nas ma bshad pa ma red/ rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i lam phyogs ni tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ dbu ma'i 'a/ma zer ba de red/ ngas sngon ma nas bshad zin pa ltar mtha' ma'i thag gcod nga mi gcig gis byed thub pa khag wa rdod/ gtso che shos gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul gang 'dra yod med rab tsam mod thig pa'i thog nas thag gcod byed rgyu red ma gtogs ngas brgya kha gcig gcod byas nas thag gcod thub thabs yod pa ma red/ ngas gzhis byes gnyis ku'i mi mang gi tshab byed rgyu'i 'os 'gan yod stabs gros 'go bton pa red/ gros 'go bton pa de'i mtha' ma'i thag gcod gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul gang yod med kyi thog nas byed rgyu red/ da lta bar du bod nang yas mas mang po zhig gi gnas tshul sgrub bzhin pa red/515

rgya nag gzhung nas bod nang la gnas tshulasag po yod gsungs pa ltar yag po yod na bstan dgos/ bod nas mi mchog dman 'bring gsum mang po zhig yong gi yod pa tshang mas kha gcig bsgrags kyis dka' ngal chen po 'dug zer gyiyod pa red/ sngon ma ting sha'u thing gis dngos thog bden 'tshol byed dgos gsungs pa ltar/ nga tshos mtha' ma'i thagagacod ma byas gong gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul ga 'dra yod med shes thabs byed dgos /'os shog 'phen rgyu sogs khag po yin na yang nga tshos phar tshur 'brel ba byas te bod nang gi bsam tshul rob tsam shes pa'i thog de'ang gsang ba ma yin par/ rgya mi'i las byed pa dang / rgya mi'i dpon rigs dang mnyam du bsam tshul gang yod med zhib bsdur byas nas thag gcod byas na bsam pa de 'dra yin/ da lta lam seng thag gcod byed shes kyi ma red la/ thag gcod byas pas la dag gi ma red/ gzhan dag zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug ces bka' stsal// //516

de༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 1 tshes 8 nyin 'ja' ye pur du bod mi sud tshong bar stsal ba'i bka' slob/ khyed rang tsho tshang mar 'tshams 'dri yod/ 'dir ched mngags thug par yong ba red/ thugs rje che/ da lta 'dir khyed rang i las sdom nang gi don tshan gcig la/ khyed rang tsho sa gnas 'dir sud lngar tshong bar yong ste sdod yun ring 'dir sgrig 'dzugs shig bzos te de'i thog nas/ tshong la blta rtogs dang 'gan khur bya rgyu dang / dka' ngal 'dra byung na sel thabs bya rgyu/ 'di ga'i yul mi tsho dang mthun po yod pa/ 'brel yod rgya gar zhi drag las byed tsho la yang 'brel ba yag po yod lugs 'khod pa la ha cang dga' po byung / gtso che shos sa gnas 'brel yod kyi las byed pa tsho dang / de bzhin rgya gar mi mang phyo dang 'brel ba yag po dgos rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho rgya gar la btsan byol ba chags pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung yul chu 'thung nas yul khrims ces nga rang tsho'i kha rgyun la yod pa bzhin/ sa gnas de dang de'i yul khrims la brtsi bkur dang / yul mi dang mthun sgril byed rgyu 'di dag nga rang tshos gal chen po zhig la rtsis yod/ nga rang snub ngad pa gzhis chags yod sa'i sa cha tshang mar spyir btang byasan yul mi tsho dang 'brel bsngag poyod/ phyogs gcig nas yul mi tsho yang spyi yongs kyi cha nas nyam chung yag po red la/ nga rang cho nad pa'i ngos nas yin na yang nga tsho'i pha mes dus nas ya rabs spyod bzang gis goms gshis shig nga rang tshorayod pa la brten nas phan tshun 'brel ba yag po yod/ sud krar gyi tshong dang / de min gyi tsag tsig tshong 'khos kyi 517

las ka byed skabs khe phan phran bu zhig ni yong thabs mi byed dka' med red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo bzhi bcu tsam 'gro gi yod/ khyed rang tsho 'dir yod pa'i gzhon skyes mang po zhig nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i rjes la skyes pa'i mi rabs chagasayod/ rgya gar la skyes te 'tshar longs byas pa khyed rang tsho mang che bas so so'i lung pa de mthong myong med kyang tshang ma bod pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes dus rtag tu sems la bcangs te nga rang tsho ༷de pa'i bden r+pā gyi sems khur blangs rgyu dang / de bzhi na skabs su bab pa'i bod rang da bang gi don dag la las 'gul ci rigs lag len bkal rgyu/ gtso che shos bod pa'i rig gzhung dang / goms gshis kyi jog la spyir btang tshang mas do snang byed kyi yod pa yag po red/ spyigongs kyi thog nas bshad payin na 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lko pa'i btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nga chos ngad pa btsan byol ba rnams tshags tshud shos dang / gra 'grigs shos shig la 'dzam bu gling spyi yongs kyis thog nas rtsis kyi yod pa red/ de thams cad gtso che shos nga rang tsho'i ser skya mi mang yongs rdzogs kyis lhag bsam rnam dag dang / dad pa dang dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa byas pa'i 'bras bu red/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhes brjod kyi yin/ nga rang cho dngos gnas rang spobs pa skyes 'os pa zhig chags bsdad yod/da lta nga tsho bod kyi nang gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig yod dam zer na/bod nang rigs 'ga' zhig la dpal 'byor gyi 'du 'god byed rgyu'i go skabs sngon ma las yag tu phyin te khang pa gsar rgyag dang / rgyas spros byed pa gang la gang 'tshams mthong rgyu yod pa red/ yang phyogs gcig nas zhing 'grog 518

sa khul la khral lci po bkal te skyid sdug gnas stangs ha cang ྅rwa 1 chags bsdad yod/ grong khyer che khag tsho'i nang la rgya mi phon che slebs nas/ nga tsho bod mi rang nyid la ngan las rgyug rgyu'i go skabs kyang rag rgyu khag po chags yod/dpal 'byor gyi thog nas sems skyo ba zhig la/ bod kyi sa khul nas gser dngul lcags zangs dang / de min gyi dngos rdzas dkon po de gras kyi thon khungs gter kha rnyed/ gter kha de bzang poyod pa'i gnas tshul chags song na/ lam seng sa cha de srung skyob byed sa'i dmigs bsal gyi sa cha zhig chags/ sa cha de nas thon pa'i gter kha'i thog nasayul mi tshor phan thogasayong rgyu dang / bed smo byed rgyu phar bzhag yul pa bod mi tsho sa der 'gro yang chog gi med/ gter kha gang yod pa rnams bdag po cha tshang rgya nag gis rgyab/ rgya nag gzhung tsam du ma zad pa'i rgya mi sger pa de gras kyang yong gi yod sa red/ de'i thon 'bab gang yod pa de dag rgya nag la phan pa ma gtogs/ bod par phan gyi med/ de thabs skyo spro zhig red/ de 'dra'i gter kha bsngogs 'don byed pa'i skabs la dngul yong rgyu'i dngangs skrag ma gtogs/ gter kha bsngogs 'don byas pa des khorasbug gi jog la skyon gang 'dra yong gi yod med la do snang dang / sems khur med pa chags/ de 'dra'i thog nas khor yug la skyon gnod chen po yong gi yod pa red/ shing gcod byed stangs la mtshon na/ gro mo khul dang / de nas khams khul/ a ma17re khul kha shas la gna' dus kyi nags tshal ha cang gi stugs po yod pa mang po zhig deng sang ha lam mgo'i skra bzhar ba nang bzhin bzos 'dug ces mi mang pos bshad kyi 'dug snga lo dbyar thog char 'od 519

chen po byung ste rgya nag nang la chu log byung bar brten/ rgya nag nang khungs kyi sa cha 'ga' shas la shing nags ga3sgrod 'breg byed rgyu kha shas bkag 'gog byas yod sa red/ da res nye char rang bod nas yong mkhan gyi mi zhig thug byu nga ba des bod kyi sa khul la shing nags da dung mu mthud gcod kyi 'dug ces dang / gtsang po gzhung chu rgyug sa'i g.yas g.yon gyi shing nags da dung de ga rang gcod kyi 'dug ces brjod kyi 'dug gang ltar bod kyi khor yug gi thog la snang med gtong rkyang byed kyi yod pa red/ rdo don yang snying nga rang tsho bod kyi dpal 'byor gyi khe phan yongs rdzogs rgya mi'i lag par bzung nas bsdad yod pa red/ gzhan dag par bzhag da res nye char bod nas yong mkhan mi mgo 'chos po gcig nga la thug nas skad cha byung / deng sang lha sa khul la smad stong ma ha cang mang po 'dug bsdoms rtsis rgyab na khri gcig tsam 'dug zer/ de tshor nyams zhib byas pa yin na/ de tsho'i gras mang po zhig rgya nag nang spyir btang slob grwa'i slob sbyong gang la gang tsam yod mkhan de gras red ces dang / gnyis nas sa khul khag la dmag sgar yod pa de tsho dang / smad tshong ma de tsho 'brel ba chen po 'dug zer/ 'di dag bud med sgor pa so i 'phral sel dngul gyi don ma yin par/ gang ltar yang snying bod pa'i lag pa nas dngul 'phrog rgyu'i dmigs bsal gyi 'char gzhi ldan pa'i jog nas gzhang khang mang po ched mngags btsugs pa yin tshod 'dug ces nga la bshad byung /de tsho'i gras gang 'tshams kyi gting ring po'i thabs shes sgo mang po'i thog nas bod par dpal 'byor gyi jog nas shugs skyes mi thub pa'i thabs shes byed kyi 520

yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug dpal 'byor gyi thog la khyad par gtong stangs nas bshad pa yin na/ bod pa khe gtsang sdod sa'i khang pa de tsho'i nang la klog shugs chen po gtong mi thub pa'i mi krar chung ba'i gras btsugs/ slog skud mthud sbyor byed rgyu'i yo chas de tsho'i gras kyang chung ba byas/ khang pa'i nang la yang shel tog chung chung sha stag btsugs/ che gras btsugs mi chog pa'i stangs 'dzin byed kyi yod pa dang / rgya mi yod pa'i sa khul tshor slog shugs che ba'i slog skud mi 'dra ba bzos te he bag chen po btang gi yod pa red/ sdug shos shig la/ shes yon gyi thog bod yig la de tsam do snang mi byed par rgya yig rang gi thog la shugs rgyag gi yod/ nye ba'i cha la chos sde dgon khag dang /btsun dgon de tsho'i nang la las don ru khag ces pa btang nas chab srid kyi slob gso'i las 'gul shugs chen po byed kyi 'dug nye char rgya nag dbus gzhung nas dril bsgrags byas don la gzhigs na/ lo 'di'i nang chos la stangs 'dzin bya rgyu dang / chos la ngo rgol byed dgos lugs bshad yod/ bod gcig pu mayin par rgya nag nang du'ang chos phyogs kyi thog la dam drag shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i las 'gul spel gyi yod sa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas rang bzhin gyis bod pa'i bsam blo'i nang la nad ma theg pa yong dang yong / bod mi'i phyogs nas de 'dra'i rnam 'gyur phran bu thon pa yin na yang lam seng 'dzin bzung gis nyes chad gtong ba/ btson khang nang la yang sdug sbyong sna tshogs gtong gi yod pa red/ bod nas yong mkhan kha shas kyis gnas tshul kha shas de snga'i rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi byed stangs 'dra po yong gi 'dug ces 521

zer gyi 'dug yin na yang nga rang tsho bod pa'i sems shugs ha cang gi chen po 'dug dbus gtsang khul dang / khams khul/ mdo smad a mdo khul gang sar spyir btang thod mi rnams ha cang gis sems shugs chen po dang / dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa ha cang yag po yod 'dug rgya mi'i zhi drag las byed khongs la yod pa'i bod rigs rgya mi'i phogs zan/ rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed mkhan sto yang nang don bod mi rigs kyi sems shugs ha cang yag po yod 'dug dper na lo gnyis tsam gyi gong la lha sa'i rgya mi'i dpon po gcig gis kho rang tsho'i tang gi tshogs 'du zhig gi sar kha sangs te/ bod rigs tang yon dang / las byed pa khri kha shas yod pa'i nang thos 'khel ba'i mi gnyis ma gtogs mi 'dug ces bshad 'dug mi gnyis 1— de la cha bzhag na yang / gcig rgyal mtshan nor bu dang / gcig rag sdis zer mkhan de red/ rgyal mtshan nor bu las ka 'phos pa red/ rag sdis da lta'ang bsdad yod/ de tshos da lta rgya mi shugs chen po yod dus rgya mi'i bka' gsung ci sgrub byed kyiyod kyang / 'gyur ba byung na mi de tsho'i bsam khra'i nang la'ang bod rigs yin pa'i 'du shes shig phal cher yod/ gang ltar bod rigs shig yin phyin chad la so so'i sha khrag gi rus zhen rang bzhin gyis yong gi red/ rgya mi'i ngos nas slob gso gtong rgyur thabs shes 'jam rtsub sna tshogs byed kyi yod nayang /nang gi bsam blo 'gyur ba gtong thub rgyu khag po red/ nye char bod nas 'byor ma thag pa'i phyi rgyal gyi mi kha shas thug byung / nyin zhig khong tsho'i sar rgya mi'i bde 'jags kyi las ka byed mkhan bod pa kha shas yong nas nga tshos rgya mi'i gos 522

gyon pa dang / rgya mi'i phogs za gi yod kyang / nga tsho'i bsam sdug nad pa rang la bsdad yod/ gal srid khyed tsho 7rgyal ba rin po che thug byung na de 'dra lab rogs zhes mngags byung zer/ de bzhin yang rgya mi'i las byed bod pa gcig yong ste nga gung khran tang yon yin/ tang yon byas te lo mang po phyin song / mgo stod la gung khran tang la yid ches dang / ma khe si dang / le zhin ring lugs la so sos yid ches byasanas bsam pa rnam dag byas pa yin/da cha lo mang wa phyin pa'i skabs la dngos yode gnas tshul gyi thoganasayid ches gtsang ma brlag song / da chayid ches rtsa ba nas med ces dang / da dung khos brjod don/ nga dang nga 'dra ba'i bod mi tang yon mang che ba de dag gung khran tang dang / rgya nag layid ches rtsa ba nas brlag pa sha stag yin zhes de 'dra bshad 'dug gang ltar mi rang yin dus lo nas lo 3la te gshibs pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul thoganas so sor dngos su nyams myong gi tshor bayong ba'i skabs la/ skyag rdzun sus bshad kyi yod pa dang / kha gting mi mtshungs pa 'dra mi 'dra sus byed kyi yod pa de shes kyi red/ gang ltar bod nang la yod pa'i nga rang tsho'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag rang bzhin gyi nyams myong rang gi thog nas bsam blo ha cang brtan por bsdad yod 'dug slob sbyong thob ma thag dngos su las rka'i nang zhugs te4 gsar yod pa de 'dra phran bu phran bu yong gi red ma gtogs/ gzhan gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang de dag ha las pa'i sems shugs dang snying stobs chen po 'dug nga rang tsho sku/da mi btsan byol bar cha bzhag na yang / phal cher rgya gar nang la 'bum gcig tsam dang / de nas 523

bal yul dang / 'brug lhag donas mi ri kha dang / yo rob de tsho tshang ma bsdoms pa yin na/ khri bzhi skor zhig yod/ des na bod mi btsan byol ba'i grangs 'bor chig 'bum bzhi khri skor zhig yod/ ma gzhi gzhis chags khag re zung dang / g.yas g.yon de 'dra la sdod mkhan bod pa 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs skyo dang 'ga' zhig yod na yang / spyi yongs kyi thog nas bshad pa yin na/ gnas stangs yag thag chod dang / rdog la 'gril po yag po red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod pa tsho mthun sgril gong bu gcig gyur byas teyag po red ces mang pos bshad kyi yod/ nga rang tsho rang dbang lung pa'i nang la bsdad yo da pas bsam tshul 'dra min ji yod bshad dgos zhes 'bod skul byed kyi yod pa ltar/ rang bzhin gyis bsam tshul 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod pa de tsho gnas tshul khag khag red/ spyi yongs kyi thog nas bod pa yag po red/ der brten nga tsho bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs su rdzogs pa dus tshod dka' las khag po gnyan 'phrang 'di 'dra zhig gi dus skabs 'dir/ tshang mas da lta bar hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas sems shugs bskyed de hur thag byed dgos/ ma 'ongs par nga rang tsho bod kyi bde skyid gang 'dra yong dang ma yong zer ba de bod pa rang nyid la 'khri ba'i 'gan khur zhig red/ 'dzam bu gling gi gang sa gang nas bod par rgyab skyor byed mkhan sku( re las 'o rdo shugs che ru che ru 'gro gi yod nasang / rtsa ba nga rang tsho bod pa rang nyid kyi las 'gan chags yod/ der brten tshang mas gal che shos shes yon gyi thog la do snang byed dgos/ bod nang la yang shes yon gyi thog la do snang byed dgos/ ltod 524

g.yeng gtong rgyu mi 'dug ces rtag tu bshadakod la/ nga tsho btsan byol ba rnams nas kyang shesayon thog la da dung shugs rgyag dgos/ khyed rang tsho nyin re nyin re'i sud krar gyi myong 'dra rgyab te bsdad pa'i skabs la yang zhar dang zhor la gsar 'gyur nyan rgyu dang / tshags par blta rgyu/ nga rang tsho'i shes byas mtshon pa'i bod yig gi gsar shog khag lta rgyu sogs bod mi rgan gzhon tshang mas do snang byed dgos pa dang / de'i nang tshan nas gzhon skyes tshos do snang shugs che tsam byed dgos/ zhar dang zhor la bod kyi gnas stangs thog la do snang byas/ 'dzam bu gling phyi nas bod pa'i thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan gang 'dra yod med/ bsam tshul gang 'dra yod med de tsho'i gras la do snang byed dgos/gnyis nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la skyon shor sa gang 'dra gang 'dra nas yong gi 'dug gam/ de sel thabs gang zhig dgos kyi 'dug gam/ 'di sto zhar dang zhor la do snang byas te skad cha gleng mol byed dgos/ bod mi khyim tshang so so'i nang la dus rgyun ldan nas bod kyi bstan pa chab srid kyi sgor la skad cha rtag par bshad rgyu byung na/ khyim tshang de'i nang la yod pa'i phru gu tshos kyang chung chung skabs nas bod bstan srid stor rna bar rtag par go thub pa dang / khong tsho na tshod longs pa'i skabs la bod kyi bstan srid skor la skad cha shod thub mkhan zhig yong gi red/ khyim tshang so so'i nang la bod kyi bstan srid skor la skad cha ma bshad par de sde pa gzhung gi byus gtogs red cesagayug bzhag na/ gsum bcu'i dus dran lta bu dus dus la bod kyi skor phran bu go ba ma gtogs/ nam rgyun gleng mol gangasang med par brten da lta nga tsho'i mi thog 525

'di las mi thog rjes ma de dag bod kyi shes tshad dang spyi sems chung du phyin/de'i phru gu bu brgyud tsho de las kyang shugs chung du phyin pa yin na yag po med/so nam grong par tos lab pa bzhin/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang gi rje'u zer ba'i mi rigs de lo stong phrag gi ring la lung pa 'dra mi 'dra'i nang la kha 'thor te sdod dgos byung / sdod sa'i lung pa de ga'i yul mi tshos kyang skabs re sdang po byed mkhan byung yod na yang / rje'u mi rigs zer ba de'i lhag bsam la rgya zhen khog mi thog nas mi thog zin nas bsdad de mtha' ma dus rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i nang la.e si ral zhes pa'i rgyal khab de gzhi nas gsar pa chags thub pa byung ba red/ khong tsho'i mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen khog de shin tu shugs chen po 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa yang de de bzhin byas te mi rabs brjes 'gro gi yod kyang mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / sems shugs mu mthud de 'dzin dgos pa ha cang gnad 'gag chen po red/ dper na 49(50751 de tsho'i skabs la rgya dmag thog mar bod la yong dus gdong len byed mkhan gyi mi thog de ha lam rdzogs 'gro gi yod/ nyung shas lhag bsdad pa de tsho yang rgas 'khogs/ nad pa/ rgya mi'i btson khang nang lo nyi shu sum cu bsdad de mi tshe dka' sdug gi 'og la zad bsdad mkhan de gras nyung nyung red/ de nas 59(60761762 de tsho'i skabs rgya mi la gdong len byed mkhan de tsho'i gras kyang nyung du nyung du 'gro gi yod/ de ltar mi sgog brjes 'gro gi yod na yang deng sang bod nang la bod rang dbang gi don dag la shugs rgyag mkhan dang / gdong len byed mkhan mi thog gsar pa 'di dag chags bsdadayod/ gang ltar bod nang la mi thog 526

brjes kyin brjes kyin la/ mi ri gas kyi 'thab rtsod mu mthud de byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan rnams kyang de de bzhin byas te nga chos gzab gzab byed dgos kyi 'dug mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gcig ni bod nang la yin na rtag tu rgya mis bod par thub tshod dang / dbang yod bshad pa de rtag par mthong gi yod/ nga tsho rang dbang lung pa'i nang la stod mkhan la de 'dra'i gnas tshul mthong rgyu med pa yin dus/ bsam blo zhig btang na ma gtogs 'char can byas te ltod yangs btang na mi 'grigs/ nga tsho rgya gar nang skyes pa yin/ rgya gar nang la mi tshe skyel stangs 'di 'dra yin bsam pa'i ngang nas/ bod mi rigs kyi bde sdug brjed pa'i 'gal rkyen yong nyen yod/der brten nga rang tsho rgan pa tshos de snga'i lo rgyus nyams myong gang 'dra byung ba de sto bshad/ gzhon skyes tshos kyang de tsho'i thog la do snang byas te nyan/ nga rang tsho'i bod spyi pa'i don dag gang 'dra chags kyi 'dug gam/ gang 'dra dga' ba 'dug gam/bod btsan byol gzhung la yang ma 'grigs pa'i skyon cha gang 'dug gam/ sel thabs gang 'dra byed dgos kyi 'dug gam/ de tshor sems khur blangs te skyon 'don rgyu gal chen po red/ sems khur blangs pa ma yin pa'i gang byung bshad na dgos pa gangayang med/ sems khur blangs te ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa de dag skad cha bshad/ bsam 'char ston/ 'bod skul byas/ de tsho nges par du byed dgos pa red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag de 'dra zhig red/rgya bod gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i skor la gang 'dra chags bsdad yod dam zer na/ dgu bcu go brgyad kyi lo mgo la gnas tshul phran bu'i re ba yod pa'i 527

bzo 'dra zhig byung / gtso che shos da lta'i srid 'dzin cang tse ming gis bod pa'i thog la bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong giyod pa'i rnam pa zhig jon yong gi 'duga'ob de'i ston mtshams nas gnas tshul de 'gyur te rgya nag gzhung gis lta stangs mkhreg tu phyin song / de la rkyen mang po zhig yod sa red/ bod pa gcig pu ma yin par rgya nag rgyal yongs rang gi nang la byung ba'i gnas tshul de 'dra'i thog nas bar skabs srid byus mkhregs tu phyin te/ rgya nag nang la mang gca'i las 'gul byed mkhan mi grags can de tsho'i gras mang po zhig 'dzin bzung byas/ lo bcu gnyis bcu gsum de 'dra btson la bzhag rgyu'i khrims thag bcad de nan po byed kyi 'dug dgu bcu go dgu lo 'di rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab zer ba gung khran tang gis 'go 'khrid pa'i gzhung 'di btsugs nas lo lnga bcu tham pa phyin pa dang / gnam sde sgo mo che'i gnas tshul byung nas lo bcu 'gro ba de 'dra'i gnas tshul dang / lhag par gzhung gi bzo grwa khag tsho'i nang nas las shor gyi mi mang po chags te dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal 'phrad pa/ deng sang zhing pa'i sa khul nas kyang rgya nag gzhung la ngo grol byed mkhan de 'dra zam mi chad pa yong gi yod pa red/ slob grwa che khag tsho'i nang nas kyang mang gtso dang / rang dbang dgos zer mkhan yang shugs che ru phyin/ yig cha 'grem spel byed mkhan yang mang du phyin par brten/ lo 'di'i nang la rnyog zing chen po de 'dra byung doges kyis khong tsho sems khral dang dngangs skrag byed kyi yod sa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas rgya nag spyi yongs kyi rtsa ba'i srid jus phran bu'i mkhreg tu phyin pa dang /bod don gyi thog lasang rnam 'gyur bstan stangs 528

mkhreg tu phyin 'dug yin na yang 'phral sel 'phral sel gyi gnas tshul tsam ma yin pa'i yun ring po'i thog la bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig chags kyired/ja kyi sa gnas layod pa'i rgya mi'i dpon rigs tsho'i las 'gan gajo rwag de/nyin re nyin re'i nang ngo rgol byed mkhan med pa lhing 'jags byung na/ de tsam gyis kho rang tsho'i dmigasayul 'grub pa ma gtogs/nyin re nyin re ca rwa(la byed mkhan mi yong ba'i ched drag gnon byas te bsdad pa 'dis phugs rgyang ring po la phan gnod gang byed kyi yod med la khong tshor 'gan khur yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang rgya nag dbus gzhung nas bsam blo 'di lta bu gtong thabs med/ gang yin zer na/ mis ngo rgol byed pa de sems nang yid mi rang ba'am/ sems nang mi dga' ba byung te ngo rgol byed pa'i sems shugs che ru 'gro rgyu las chung du 'gro thabs med/ da lta sa gnas sa thog la rgya nag gzhung gis las ka byed stangs 'di dngos gnas byas na mi thog nas mi thog mi rabs nas mi rabs rgya mir ngo sgol byed mkhan shugs che ru che ru 'gro rgyu'i las ka chags yod/ bod mi rtsa med phyin na de ga red ma gtogs/ bod mi zhig lhags phyin chad la nam yang 'khon 'dzin sangs thabs med pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags yong gi yod/ rgya nag dbus gzhung nas rtsa ba'i brtan lhing dang / mthun sgril dgos pa bshad kyi yod/ don dam pa'i brtan lhing dang mthun sgril lag po zhig yong ba la mi'i sems mgu ba zhig byung na brtan lhing dang / mthun sgril de'i jog nas yong gi red/ngas dbu ma'i lam brjod pa 'di rgya bod kha bral du ma phyin par bod rgya nag gi khungs la sdod rgyu dang / nga tsho bod par rang srid rang skyong ming don 529

mtshungs pa zhig gi thog nas nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung / slob sbyong gi skor/dpal 'byor gyi 'du 'god byed rgyu/ de tsho'i gras nga tsho bod pa rang nyid kyi lag par dbang cha cha tshang yod pa zhig dang / 'gan yongs rdzogs bod pa rang gis 'khyer thub pa zhig byung na/ rgya nag gzhung la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa/ bod pa la yang blo bzhag sa yod pa zhig yong gi red bsam te ngas re ba dang 'bad brtson de ltar byed kyi yod/ de la a mi ri kha'i srid gzhung gis mtshon pa'i 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rgyal khab bod pa'i thog la do snang yod mkhan dang /gnad 'gag yod mkhan tshang mas ngas dbu ma'i lam brjod pa 'dir gzhung 'brel yongs bsgrags kyi thog nas rgyab skyor byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas phran bu tshod ma thig pa yong gi yod sa red/ gang ltar mkhregs i lam phyogs 'dzin mkhan rigs gcig yod pa red/ rgya nag gzhung la 'brel ba yag po yod mkhan dang / rgya nag gzhung la sha tsha yod mkhan gyi rgya mi de 'dra nas brjod gsal/ rgya nag rgyal khab kyi rtsa ba'i dmigs yul gang yin zer na/ dus rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i nang la rgya nag rgyal khab stobs shugs ldan pa'i rgyal khabasang dang por sleb rgyu'i dmigs yul de red/ de 'grub pa la phyogs gciganas mi 'bor che ba'i rgyal khab chen po zhigayin pa'i cha rkyen tshang dgos pa de ni rgya nag la tshang yod/ gnyis nas dmag gi nus shugs dgos pa yang rgya nag la yod/ de'i thog la rdul phran gyi mtshon cha yang yod/gsum par dpal 'byor gyi nus pa zhig yod dgos/ da phan lo bco lnga tsam zhig nang la dpal 'byor gyi yar rgyas ha las pa phyin yod/ nye char lo gcig 530

gnyis shig nang phran bu'i dka' ngal 'phrad pa ma gtogs/ gzhan 'das pa'i lo bco lnga tsam de'i nang la yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i myur tshad rgya gar las myur ba phyin yod/ bzhi pa stobs chen rgyal khab nus pa ldan pa zhig yong rgyu'i cha rkyen gal che sho sa de 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la che mthong yod pa zhig dang brtsobakur yod pa zhig cha 'jog yod pa zhig dgos kyi yod/ de rgya nag la khyon nas yod pa ma red/ gang yin zer na rgya nag gis 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang bdal bshig gtong ba dang / lhag par bod kyi thog nas rgya nag rgyal khab la mtshan shas rgyun du yong gi yod pa red/ rgya nag gzhung la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang nas rang bzhin gyis brtsi bkur dang / che mthong yong rgyu'i cha rkyen bsgrub rgyu'i gzhi rtsa gtso bo gcig bod kyi gnas tshul 'di red/ bod kyi gnas tshul thog la rgya nag gzhung gis srid byus yag 11 zhig lag len bkal te/ 11da pa'i dka' ngal sel thub pa zhig 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bstan thub pa'i nyin mo de nas rgya nag la mthong che ru 'gro gi red/ der brten dus rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i nang la rgya nag rgyal khab stobs chen cha 'jog 'pher ba dang brtsi bkur yod pa zhig yong rgyu la bod pa'i gnas tshul 'di gnad 'gag chen po chags yod ces rgya nag la zhen khog yod pa'i mi de 'dra nas bshad mkhan yong gi 'dug de tsho rgyu mtshan yod pa lta bu'i skad cha zhig red/ da lta dza drag gi gnas tshul 'og nas mkhregs bzung byed kyiyod pa'i srid byus 'dis mthun sgril yag tu 'gro rgyur yang phan gyi ma red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'isnang la mthong dang cha 'jog yong rgyur yang phan gyi ma red/ 'di ni 'phral sel 'u thug 531
