thabs zad sdig pa mig btsums lta bu'i srid byus shig red ma gtogs/ phyags rgyang ring po'i rnam dpyod ldan pa'i srid byus shig nam yang min/ der brten 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dug nga'i gnas stangs ni dbu ma'i lam de ga rang gi sgang la bsdad de mu mthud 'bad brtson dang thabs shes byed kyi yod/ da lta'i rgya bod gnyis kyi gnas stangs 'di 'dra zhig gi sgang la bsdad yod/ 'di khyed rang tshor sgrung lta bur bshad na bsam pa dran byung /bar skabs 'das pa'i lo shas nang la ngas a rir tshar gcig gnyis shig phyin pa dang / yu rob nang la tshar kha shas phyin pa red/ ngos rang la mthong tshul shugs che shos gang byung song zer na/ sngon ma 'go stod nyi hong la tshar kha shas phyin pa dang mi 'dra bar nye dus nyi hong la slebs dus kyi gnas tshul la bltas payin na/ chos la do snang byed rgyu shugs che ru phyin 'dug gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos/ de'i nang tshan nas bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang byed mkhan ha cang shugs che ru phyin 'dug nga la mthong tshul gsar pa de 'dra zhig byung / de nas a rir mthong tshul ni/ 'das pa'i lo gnyis gsum zhig nang la a ri'i slob grwa mang po'i slob phrug tsho'i nang la thod don rgyab skyor gyi tshogs pa de 'dra btsugs te lo gnyis gsum nang la tshogs pa ha cang gi mang po chags 'dug slob phrug de tsho la dngos gnas drang gnas bod kyi thog la sems shugs dang / dga' zhen yod pa/ bod pa'i bden don gyi thog la rgyab skyor thabs shes gang yong ci yong byed 'dod yod pa dang / de dang chabs cig bod don thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan slob phrug gzhon skyes 532

mang po zhig gis lag par phreng ba 'khyer te bod kyi chos la ha cang dga' po dang do snang byed kyi 'dug a rir yang do snang byung / lhag par kha sngon 'jar man la nyin brgyad tsam ring lam rim bsdus don la 'grel bshad rgyab te bshad pa red/ de'i ring gtso che shos 'jar man gyi mi phal cher stong phrag bdun brgyad tsam yod sa red/ de nas yu rob kyi lung pa gzhan nas ched mngags yong ste khyon mi khri gcig tsam zhig nyin ma mang po'i ring la bka' chos la ha cang don gnyer chen po byas song / yu rob khul nang chos kyi 'grel bshad byas par nyin re'i chu tshod lnga tsam nyin bstud de don gnyer chen pos nyan rgyu de las sla po zhig ma red/ gang ltar khong tshos bod kyi nang chos de dmigs bsal gyi chos shig yin pa dang / rgyu mtshan 'grel bshad rgyab rgyu yod pa/ lag len bkal na nyin re nyin re'i so lo'i sems kyi zhi bde yong rgyur phan thogs pa zhig gi ngos 'dzin dang do snang shugs chen po byed kyi 'dug des na nga tsho bod kyi nang chos dang 'brel ba'i ri ga gzhung thog la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i thog nas do snang byed mkhan tshos a gsar lta bu ma yin par/ don dam pa'i thog nas der do snang byed shugs che ru che ru 'gro gi yod pa gsal po 'dug de bzhin lo gnyis tsam gong la nga the wan la phyin pa red/ de'i rjes la mi 'ga' zhig gis zer don 7rgyal ba rin po che the wan la ma slebs gong la/ the wan nang gi nang pa mang po zhig gis bod kyi chos spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi gsang sngags chos de gang 'dra yin nam bsam pa'i the tshom yod mkhan mang po yod pa red/7rgyal ba rin po che thelon la slebs nas bod kyi nang chos stor la 'grel bshad 533

rgyab pa la brten nas bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos spyi dang / lhag par gsang sngags kyi chos de rgyu mtshan yod pa zhig dang / tshad thub yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po chags song zhes zer mkhan byung / gang ltar rgya rigs kyi nang nas bod kyi nang chos la do snang byed mkhan shugs chen po 'dug bar skabs lo bcu phrag re zung nang rgya nag nas mi mang po 'dzam bu gling phyi la slebs pa'i rkyen gyis deng sang yi shu'i chos dang / lhag par nang chos la do snang byed mkhan ha cang gi phon chen po 'phel rgyas yong gi 'dug ces zer gyi 'dug der brten nga rang tsho'i bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / de dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi rig gzhung 'di dag 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la dngos gnas drang gnas cha 'jog 'pher ba zhig tan tan red/ des na nga rang cho gad pa rang nyid kyis so so'i chos dang rig gzhung la do snang bdag gces byed rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po 'dug gdan sa tsho'i nang la slob sbyong shugs chen po byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs/bod mi spyi yongs nas slob sbyong la do snang ma byas par mu mthud phyin pa yin na sdug nyes na gang tsam song nas bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos de bod pas ma shes par/ phyi rgyal gyi mis tshur 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu'i nyen khaspedad pas gzab gzab byed dgos/ phyi rgyal gyi mi tshos skad yig gsar pa zhig slob dgos pa sogs ha cang dka' las khag po yod na yang / bod kyi nang chos la 'di 'dra'i.u btsugs rgyab nas slob sbyo nga dang don gnyer byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tso bod pa rnams so so'i skad yig yin pas/ skad yig gzhan dag brgyud dgos pa med na yang phreng ba gcig 'khyer/ ma ṇi 'dra bgrangs/ skabs re dngul 534

gyi rtsis 'dra rgyab/ 'khrug pa rgyag sar 'khrug pa rgyab/ kha gtong sar kha btang /ser sna byed sar ser sna byas/ phrag dog byed sar phrag dog byas te bsdad pa yin na/ snying po gang yang med/ nga rang tsho'i bod kyi chos 'di ngo thog gang 'dra zhig yin pa so sos do snang byas/ slob sbyong byas/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gang 'dra zhig yin pa rtsad dpyod byas/ de shes pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa byas te nga nang pa yin zhes lab na 'grigs pa red/ gzhan mi zhig gis slo bur du khyod kyi chos gang yin zer na/ nga nang pa yin zer lab/ nang pa'i chos gang 'dra red ze ra na/ gang shes zer rgyu las bshad rgyu med na thabs skyo po yin/ khyed rang nang pa'i chos la dad pa byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam zer na/ nga'i pha mas nang chos byed kyi yod stabs/ ngas nang chos byas pa yin zhes bshad na/ rgyu mtshan de khungs dag min/ rgyu mtshan de brtan 11 ma red/ chos tshang mar dad pa dang dga' po yod kyang / nang pa'i chos la khyad chos 'di 'dra zhig 'dug nang pa'i chos la zab khyad 'di 'dra zhig 'dugade'i thog la nga rang gi pha mes nas nang pa yin/ de la brten nas ngas nang pa byed kyi yod ces brjod na/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi rgyu mtshan ldan pa chags pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa nang chos byed dang mi byed so so'i lag pa red/ nang chos byas pa yin na nang chos shes pa bya rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po yod/ sngon ma lo nyi shu tsam gyi gong la nga'i ngo shes nyi hong gi mi gcig yod/ khong nang chos phran bu shes kyi red la/ dbu ma pa dang / sems tsam pa'i lta ba 'dra 535

mi 'dra'i skor la slob sbyong byas pa zhig red/ nyin gcig khong dha ram sa la shod la bod pa'i grwa pa zhig thug byung bas grwa pa de la bod skad khya re khyo re de'i thog nas khyed rang dbu ma pa yin nam/ sems tsam pa yin/ dbu ma pa yin na dbu ma rang rgyud pa yin nam/ thal 'gyur ba yin/ zhes skad cha sdus par grwa pa des lan gang yang rgyag gi mi 'dug ces zer/ de'i bzo 'dra po red/kha nas 'don pa 'dra bton pa tsam gyis mi 'a grigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ni sems kyi nang la skyon gang dang gang yod pa dang / sems kyi nang la yon tan gang dang gang yod pa 'di dag shes pa byas/ skyon gyi rigs de nyung du btang /yon tan gyi rigs de shugs che ru gtong rgyu de 'dra zhig la sangs rgyas kyi chos byed pa zer ba ma gtogs/ phreng ba 'dra lag par 'khyer/ sngags bgrangs pa tsam sangs rgyas kyi chos byas pa la 'gro gi ma red/ de tshor nga rang tsho tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ khyed rang tshos sems la nges pa byed dgos/khyed rang sto tshang ma 'cham po byas/ gcig la dka' ngal 'phrad song na gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byas/ lhag par nad pa dang / dmigs bsal sto gos thog dka' ngal 'phrad pa/ rgas gcong de 'dra'i rigs la nang tshag gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byed dgos/ lta rtogs yag po byed dgos/ nad pa dang / skyo po nyam thag dka' ngal 'phrad mkhan la rogs byas na bsod nams chen po bsags kyi red/ phar phyogs der mchod 'bul ga tshod byas pa las kyang / mi skyo po zhig la rogs byas pa 'di bsod nams che ba thob kyi red/ phan yon che ba yod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho rang 536

la cha bzhag na yang / dge slong na da pa ha cang gi skyoge nga/ gzugs po'i steng btsog pa 'gos bsdad pa zhig la gzhan dag gis rogs byed mkhan ma byung ba'i skabs la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis dge slong nad pa de'i lus bkrus/ gtsang ma bzos pa gnang ba de 'dra byung 'dug de bzhin mi nad pa'i ched du dge 'dun la phul ba'i yo chas btsongs te/ nad pa'i thog la 'gro song btang na 'grigs pa red ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs 'du gder brten skyo po nyam thag tsho la rogs byed rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/nga rang tsho'i mi kha shas kyi gshis ka la mi krog krog byed mkhan zhig mthong na de la mkhas po 'dra byas/ mi skyo po zhig thug na de la mthong chung byed kyi yod pa de nang pa'i chos dang yongs su 'gal ba yin/ mi ga tshod kyi ྅ rwa1 dang / nyam chung la nga tshos lta rtogs byed dgos/ de la brtsi bkur byed dgos/ sngon ma gzhung zhabs rgas po bod nas nga tsho mnyam du yong mkhan zhig yod pa khong gis tshur sgom po byas na phar la yang mjing pa'i sgang la zhag rtsi byug te mjing pa bsgrengs na ma gtogs 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces gsung gi yod/ de dngos gnas bden pa red/ tshur krog grog byas/ thub tshod bshad byed kyi 'dug na/ phar yang nga skyo po min bsam pa'i thog nas rig pa bsgrim dgos/ spyi ra btang nam chung zhig 'dug na de la thub tshod rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med/ mi la ga tshod thub thub kyis rogs byed rgyu dang / sems gnag mi byed pa 'di nga tsho'i chos kyi snying po red shes song ngam/ de khyed rang tsho'i blo la nges pa gyis/bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che// // 537

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 2 tshes 17 sa yos gnam lo gsar tshes nyin stsal ba'i bka' slob/de ring 'di ga theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du ched mngags 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi mang rnams dang / gzhis lus rgya che mi mang bcas la ngos nas lo gsar pa'i 'tshams 'dri dang bkra shis bde legs brtsod rgyuyin/nga rang tsho tshang ma bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag yin pa de'i rgyu mtshan 'god mi dgos par/ rang gi myong ba nas shes gsal yin/gang zhig gal chen po yin zhe na/ mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal dang / 'dod pa'i bde skyid gnyis po 'di rgyu dang rkyen la ltos nas yong ba 'di shes pa bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin pas tshang mas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gang yin dang / bde ba'i rgyu gang yin rtsad dpyod byas nas ngo shes pa byed dgos/ de'i thog dus tshod ces pa nam yang sdod pa med par rtag tu 'gro ba zhig yin cing / lo gsar pa dang / zla ba gsar pa/ nyi ma gsar pa zhig bcas ngang gis yong bas gal che shos dus tshod de dag bde skyid kyi rgyu rkyen la 'gro ba zhig las/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rkyen la mi 'gro ba zhig byed dgos/ ngos nas ngo shes pa'i mi su dang su thug kyang khong tshor dus tshod ni rtag tu 'gro ba zhig yin pas de dag bed spyod yang dag pa btang ste phan pa'i rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yong ba byed dgos zhes brjod kyi yod/ de ring lo gsar pa'i 'tshams 'dri dang bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i skabs su yang khyed rang tshor brjod 'dod byung / nga rang tshos lo gsar skyid po gtong ba'i skabs 'dir nyi ma de ring nas bzung lo gsar pa 'di'i nang 538

bya ba don dang ldan pa zhig byed bsam pa'i bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen po yin/nga rang tsho bod mi mang che ba zhig sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa byed kyi yod/ des na rang nyid kyi dad pa byed pa'i chos 'di ngo shes pa byed dgos/ kha nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ chos la skyabs su mchi/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi zhes brjod pa las/ ngo ma'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog ces pa 'di gang 'dra zhig la brjod kyi yod ma shes na mi 'grigs/ de dag so so'i khyad chos kyi yon tan rnams shes pa byas te/ de'i thog nas dad pa skyes thub pa zhig byung na/ de ni shes nas dad pa thobo pa zhig yin pas don gal chen po yin/ de min lam dang lugs srol lta bur brtsis nas chos byas na rang gi sems rgyud bcos thub rgyu khag po yin/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes su bslab na rang nyid kyi rgyud la chos dkon mchog skye thub pa dang / de bzhin mthar thug sangs rgyas dkon mchog chags thub rgyu yin pa'i sems kyi nang go ba chags te de la dad mos skyes pa yin na/de nyin nas bzung nyin re'i mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig yong bas chos pa zhig yin na chos shes thabs dang / slob sbyong byed rgyu gal chen po yin/nga rang tsho bod pa yin pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i bod rang dbang bsgrub rgyu'i las 'gan nga rang tsho tshang mar 'gan 'khriyod par ma zad/ las rgyu 'bras kyi thog nas bshad na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen gog gi thog nas bshad na'ang 'dra/ las 'gan 'di nga tshor slebs yod/ lhag par bod rgya mi rigs tshang ma bde zhing skyid pa zhig yong ba'i thog 539

nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ nga rang tsho'i jog las 'gan 'di slebs kyi yod pas/ nga tsho'i bsgrub bya ni rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / drang zhing 'os pa zhig yin pas rdzun dang ham pa shod dgos don med/ bden pa bden thog tu 'khyol nges yin la/ bden pa la nus stobs yod pa yin/ dpung stobs zer ba de 'phral sgang nus pa yod pa zhig tu snang yang / phugs gtugs na de la nus pa med/ nus pa yod pa ni bden pa'i dpung stobs yin/ bden pa yod na 'phral du nus pa thon ma thub kyang / bden pa'i ngo bo ni nam yang 'gyur rgyu med la/ sus kyang med pa bzo mi thub/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bden pa'i gnas lugs bajodi na bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar las 'bras chud mi za zhes brjod pa 'di dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul yin/nga tsho rwa1da spyi pa'i don dag gi las 'gan bsgrub rgyu 'di bden don yin/rgyab mdun gang la bshad kyang nga tshos lhag bsam rnam dag gis bden pa bden thog 'khyol ba'i thabs shes 'bad brtson byed rgyu 'di yin/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo bzhi bcu tsam 'gro gi yod pa dang / bod la rtsa ba'i 'gyur ba byung nas lo lnga bcur nye bar 'gro giyod/ de'i ring dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang /nang gi gnas tshul yong stangs/ gnas tshul 'phel rim bcas la bsam blo btangan 'gyur ba ha cang chen po zhig phyinayod/ mig sngar da phan nga tshos bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub thub med kyang / de ltar 'grub thub pa'i rgyu rkyen sogs phyi nang gi mthun rkyen mang po zhig 'das pa'i lo lnga bcu 'am/ bzhi bcu'i ring bskrun yod/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod nang gis da lta'i gnas tshul 540

gcig pur bltas pa yin na dngos gnas blo pham dang / yid thang chad dgos pa'i gnas tshul lta bu 'dug rung / nga tsho bod kyi gnas tshul 'di 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul zhig chags te gnas yod/ der brten 'dzam gling spyi'i 'gyur ba dang bstun te 'phel rgyas 'gro dgos pa zhig chags yod/ nga tsho'i bod don 'di 'dzam gling khyon yongs kyi 'gyur ba 'gro stangs dang / lhag par rgya nag rgyal khab chen 1— de'i nang 'gyur ba 'gro stangs la bltas na/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i bden pa'i don dag 'di 'das pa'i lo sum cu bzhi bcu'i gnas stangs dang bsdur thabs med pa/ bden mtha' gsal la nye ba'i dus la slebs yod pa gsal po yin/ der brten tshang mas dus da lta phan lhag bsam dang snying stobs bskyed de hur thag byas yod / da dung yang snying stobs bskyed de hur thag bya rgyu gal chen po red/de ring 'dir bod nas gnyen 'phrad la 'byor pa kha shas yod pa khyed rang tshor dmigs bsal gyi 'tshams 'dri dang / khyed rang tsho brgyud nas bod nang yod pa'i gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang la dmigs bsal 'tshams 'dri dang bkra shis bde legs brjod rgyu yin/bod nang yod pa'i gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang de dag ni nga tsho rwa1da pa'i don gyi bdag po red/ da phan nga tsho'i bod don 'dzam bu gling 'di'i thog gnas thub pa 'di gtso na gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs dang / lhag bsam 'gyur ba med pa'i thog nas rang tshugs brtan po bzung ste bsdad pa las byung ba yin/ ma 'ongs par yang bod pa'i gnas stangs ji 'dra 541

zhig yong ba'i rtsa ba gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dang / snying stobs la rag lus yod/ der brten da phan tshang mas dngos gnas hur thag byas pa la ngos nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu dang / da dung yang tshang mas zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs dang / lhag bsam bcangs nas 'tshe ba med pa'i thabs lam la brten te bod spyi pa'i don chen bsgrub rgyu gal chen po yin/ de lugs sems 'jags kyis tshang ma blo bde po byas te sdod rogs/ bkra shis bde legs zhes bka' 455// //542

༄༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 7 tshes 19 nyin man spar phan bde gling gzhis chags su bka' slob 455 ba/de ring 'dir zhu rgyu la/ da lta las bsdoms nang zhib cha bkod pa bzhin/da lta phan chad la tshang mas hur thag byas 'dug da dung yang tshang mas gzhis chags kyi sa cha 'di'i snang nas 'tsho shen la phan thabs sgo gang sa nas tshod lta byed rgyu sogs la nus shugs 'don rgyu gal chen po red/ rgya gar nang la nga tshos gzhis chags khag btsugs pa de dag rtsa ba'i phyogs gcig nas sgrig 'dzugs shig chags bsdad yod pa dang / gnyis nas mi thog nas mi thog sa cha gcig gi sgang la bod mi'i sdod sgar chags nas bsdad dus gnad 'gag chen po yod/ dper na/ lnga bcu nga dgu nas da phan lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam 'gro gi yod pa de'i ring gi nyams myong la bltas pa yin na/ bod mi 'ga' shas gnam gshis 'phrod bsten yag sa de 'dra la kha 'jor nas sdod mkhan de tsho'i gras 'phral sel snang ba skyid mdog kha po yod kyang / phugs rgyang ring wa'i thog nas sa cha gcig gi sgang la bod pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gcig nang bsdad pa de dang /kha 'thor nas bsdad pa gnyis po 'di bsdur na/ sa cha gcig gi sgang la sgrig 'dzugs ldan pa'i thog nas bsdad pa 'di legs pa byung yod/ de 'dra yin dus nga tsho'i gzhis chags khag 'di dag hra thag thag dgos pa 'di gzhis mi so so'i khe phan tsam ma yin pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba spyi'i 'gro stangs kyi thog la phanathogs yod pa zhig chags bsdad yod/ der brten gzhis chags khag 'di dag tshags tshud po zhig dang / gal che shos dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs 543

yar rgyas gtong dgos kyiyod pa dang / shes yon 'di dag kyang tshags tshud pa zhig bzo dgos kyi yod/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo bzhi bcu lhagatsam dang / gzhis chags khag 'di dag tshugs nas lo sum cu so grangs shig 'gro gi yod pa de'i ring la phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na.a'u tsam red/ yin na'ang zhib tshags po'i thog nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ lo yun 'di dag gi ring la nga tshos grub 'bras thon pa 'di las lhag tsam zhig dgos tshod red bsam gyi 'dug da ltaston ri sa gzhis chags dang / ma rda par sde gzhis chags/de dang de 'dra ba'i gzhis chags khag 'ga' shas nga rang tshos re ba brgyab pa dang / tshod dpag byas pa nang bzhin zhig phal cher ma 'grub pa'i bzo 'dra zhig red/ da lta sa gnas 'dir cha bzhag pa yin na'ang lo de tsam phyin pa red/ ltos sa tos phyogs kyis 'o rdo lo re phran bu'i phran bu'i drag tu 'gro gi yod na yang / da dung dka' ngal nang bsdad mkhan lta bu zhig chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra yin dus gang bya rgyu 'dug gam/ nam rgyun bod pa'i gshis ka la phyogs gciganas mi mang gis kyang 'phral sel 'grigs tsam 'grigs tsam zhig gi snang la phyin/ dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i skabs la 'brel yod tsho la thob thang rtsod nas rgyu rkyen bshad rgyu de yang skabs re shugs chung drags kyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug las byed tshos kyang dza drag gi dka' ngal ma 'phrad tsam zhig byung na 'grigs pa lta bu dang / 'thus bsdad yod bsam pa'i ngang nas spyi don gyi las ka de zom 'jog ltod yangs 'gro gi med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa dang /sems 'phral yong gi 'dug da dung yang gang bya rgyu 'dug gam/ gtso che shos 544

'di ga sa gnas sa thog la sdod mkhan khyed rang tshos sa cha'i gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i gang byed rgyu 'dug gam/ bsam blo gtong rgyu dang / 'char gzhi bkod rgyu/ de bzhin so nam gyi nyams myong yod mkhan dang / dmigs bsal gyi slob sbyong yod mkhan tsho nas bslab bya 'dra blangs/ nga rang tsho 'di gar lo mang po bsdad pa'i nyams myong 'dra bsags yod pa de 'dra'i thog nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu gang 'dug gam/ 'di nas bsam blo btang / 'char gzhi 'dra bkod/'gro song mthun rkyen de tsho'i gras 'brel yod nang srid las khungs dang / de bzhin shes rig las khungs/ 'phrod bsten las khungs sogs 'brel yod tshor don dag son min la ma ltos pa'i bde ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas tshul bshad rgyu de gal chen po red/ 'brel yod las khungs tshos kyang nges par lta rtogs byed kyi red la/ nga tshos lam sengasam phrag nang nas bton chog rgya che ba med na yang / rogs ram tshogs pa khag la bde sdug bshad sa dang / 'bod skul byed sa yod pa red/ spyir btang bod pa btsan byol bar spyi lo drug cu dang /bdun cu'i nang nga tshor dza drag gi rogs ram byed dgos pa'i dus tshod kyi le'u de rdzogs zin pa red/ yin nayang bar skabs shig nas bod pa btsan byol ba'i gnas tshul 'di gnad 'gag cig chags/ gnyis nas nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu 'di la yang rgyu mtshan zhig mthong ste deng sang 'tham bu gling gi 'phral sel skyob gso spud mkhan rogs ram tshogs pa tsam ma yin par/ gnad che sa de 'dra nas nga tshor rogs ram byed mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho'i sa gnas sa thog nas 'char 545

gzhi yag po zhig bkod/ gung yag po zhig bsgrigs te gnas lugs 'grel bshad yag po byed thub na/ gang la gang tsam gyi rogs ram thob rgyu'i re ba phal cher yod pa red/ des na mi mang tsho'i ngos nas 'khyams te ma bsdad par shugs rgyag dgos/ sdug skad rgyag dgos/ de bzhin las byed pa chos kyang sa gnas sa thog la tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas 'bad brtson byed mus yin kyang / da dung tshang mas shugs rgyab rogs gyis zer rgyu yin/da phan lo 'di tsam phyin na yang / sa gnas 'di'i sgang la lo nas lo bstud dka' ngal lu gu brgyud kyi nang bsdad pa zhig mthong dus/ blo g.yeng dang sems sbag dog po yong gi 'dugaste nga rang tsho thod mi btsan byol ba 'di dag la las 'gan chen po zhig 'khri nas bsdad yod/ bod spyi pa'i don dag gi las 'gan zhig bsgrub dgos kyi yod/ bod mi rigs zer ba 'di thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi rtsa ba zin mkhan mi rigs shig yin pa de 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang nasata lam nag sub 'gro nyen gyi dus tshod gnyan 'phrang de 'dra zhig la slebs yod pa dang / nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung rnying khungs 'dis deng sang gi dus skabs la phan thogs yod pa dang / 'brel ba yod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gal chen po zhig 'tham bu gling 'di'i sgang nas ming med shul med 'gro rgyu'i mtshams la slebs bsdad pa 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i las 'gan bod pas 'khyer dgos kyi yod/ bod nang la yod pa'i bod pa rnams la so so'i chos dang rig gzhung la dga' zhen dang / so so'i chos 546

dang rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu'i 'dod payod na yang / bod pas bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung la dga' zhen byas pa yin na/ kha bral gyi bsam blo btang mkhan dang / gsar brje la ngo log rgyab mkhan red ces lam seng skyon brjod phog mkhan/ bod mis bod pa'i zhen khog byas pa yin na khrims 'gal lta bur bltas te so so'i lung pa'i nang la gnas stangs thabs skyo po de 'dra zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga tsho btsan byol la yod mkhan rnams rang dbang lung pa'i nang la bsdad yod pas so so'i 'phral sel gyi 'tsho thabs gcig pu mayin par/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi chos dang rig gzhung gting zab cig dang / da lta'i dus stod 'dir phan thogs yod pa 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel gyi 'dzin skyong rgyun mthud nas byed mkhan gyi 'os babs nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba la yod pa lta bu zhig chags bsdad yod/ nga tshos de ltar byed pa la sngon la 'phral sel dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal 'di dag sel thub pa zhig dang / dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen gang la gang tsam zhig ma byung na khag po red/ dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshad nges can zhig ma byung na chos dang rig gzhung srung skyob byed rgyu ha cang khag po red/ de ltar na nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags khag yar rgyas yong thabs byed dgos pa 'di so so'i khe phan tsam ma yin pa'i bod mi rigs spyi'i don dag dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / che sa nas bshad pa yin na 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba spus dag po yod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung 'dzin mkhan gyi mi rigs shig yin pas nga tsho'i las 547

'gan 'di rgya chen po zhig dang / phugs rgyang ring po'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig yin/ der brten da lta 'dir yod mkhan tshang mas hur thag byed kyi yod pa ltar/ da dung yin na yang ltod yangs nam yang ma song ba byed rogs gyis zhes bshad 'dod byung /de nas spyi tshogs gang dang gang du yin na'ang 'phrod bsten gal chen po red/ da lta 'dir las bsdoms nang gsal ba bzhin/ ma la ri yā zer ba la sogs pa'i nad yams de tsho'i gras slo bur dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig red/rgyun du nga rang tshos 'phrod bsten yag po byas te lus wa'i bde thang nus shugs yag poyod pa yinata/ de 'dra'i nad 'bu phra rab kyi phyi'i 'gal rkyen 'dra 'phrad pa'i skabs la/ nang gi lus wa'i 'gog srung gi nus pas phan gyi yod pa red/rgyun du gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten thog la do snang byed dgos pa dang gcig de nas lto chas kyi thog la do snang byed dgos pa dang gnyis/ gzugs po phran bu ma bde ba byung ma thag lam seng sman pa gtugs dgos pa bcas ha cang gal chen po red/ 'dir bod lugs kyi sman pa yod pa red/ rgya sman da lta gtan 'jags med pa'i dka' ngal yod kyang / gang ltar mthun rkyen gang yod kyi thog nas lam seng sman bcos byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ de 'dra yin dus gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten gyi thog la khyed rang tshos dus dus la slob gso byed rgyur do snang byed dgos pa dang / de nas lto chas kyi bcud ldang ba dgos pa de gal chen po red/ gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la to chas la sngo tshal gyi rigs de tsho'i gras gal chen po red zer gyi 'dug da lta nga rang tsho'i sa 548

zhing la spyir btang 'bru rigs ma gtogs/ tshal zhing 'debs las byed rgyu'i thog la do snang che ba zhig yong gi med na/ de 'dra'i thog la do snang byas te tshal gyi sne kha mang tsam bod spyod byed thub pa byung na/ des gzugs por phan gyi yod tshod 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa'i snang bar sto chas bcud yod pa zer na lam seng dmar za rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor gyi yod/ de phal cher ma red/ lhag par du tsha ba'i lung pa'i nang la 'phrod bsten ched lto chas sngo tshal rigs 'di shin tu gal chen po red zer gyi 'dug de tsho'i thog la do snang byed dgos/ ngas da lta go thos la mkhris pa'i na tsha dang / mkhris rdo chags pa mang po 'dug zer/de tsho'i gras nam rgyun nas lto chas za stangs kyi thog la 'brel ba yod pa dang /gnam gshis la yang 'brel ba yod kyi red/ de tsho'i gras dmigs bsal gyi mkhas pa dang / do snang yod mkhan tshor skad cha 'dra dris te/ rgyun du gzab gzab byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ nga rang tshos rgyun du na tsha dza drag chen po zhig ma byung bar du rdzod g.yeng byas nas bsdad/ dza drag byung ba'i skabs la sman pa 'dra bsten gyi yod kyang / de dus phyis drags te na tsha kho lam seng sel ma thub mkhan dang / 'gro song chen po gtong dgos pa/ nad pa rang nyid kyang dka' ngal chen po myong dgos pa de 'dra yong gi yod/ sngon tshud nas rgyun du 'phrod bsten gyi thog la yid gzab kyis ltod g.yeng ma song ba bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ sto chas tshal gyi rigs la do snang che tsam byed rgyu de gnad 'gag yod tshod 'dugad lta nga tshor bod sman dang / rgya sman gyi mthun rkyen 'grigs tsam yod 549

pa red/ bod sman gyi khyad cho sa gcig la na tsha sngon 'gog yong rgyur phan thogs chen po yod/ rgyun du pho ba'i me drod gso rgyu'i sman gyis mtshon pas de 'dra'i thog la sman pas kyang do snang byas/ mi so so'i ngos nas kyang dus rgyun du gzugs po bde po yod pa'i skabs la yang rgyun spyod kyis pho sman dang / bad kun gyi sman de 'dra yang yang bsten rgyu de la gnad 'gag cig mthong gi 'dug de ltar byas na na tsha slo bur ba de gras mi yong rgyur sngon 'gog gi phan thogs chen po yod/de nas gal ches shos shig slob sbyong red/ nga tsho rgya gar la btsan byol ba chags nas nga snu'irno las 'gan gal che shos gcigaslob grwa'i shes yon gyi thog la shugs brgyab pa reng/ nga tshos thog mar ma su ri la slob grwa btsugs pa nas bzung / da lta bar du slob sbyong gi thog la grub 'bras gang la gang tsam thon bsdad yod/ dngos gnas spobs pa skyes 'os pa zhig red/ bod nang la yod pa'i deng dus kyi slob sbyong gi gnas tshad de dang / rgya gar la yod pa'i bod pa'i phru gu tsho'i slob sbyong gi gnas tshad bsdur ba yin na/ nga tsho rgya gar la drag pa ma gtogs skyo ba chags med/ sngon ma nas nga tshos slob grwa btsugs ma thub pa'i dka' ngal byas te slob grwa btsugs rgyu'i thog la nus shugs gangayod bsgril ba red/ de nas bar skabs shig nas slob grwa yod pa tsam gyis chog shes pa dang / slob grwa yod pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par shes yon spus dag yag po dgos kyi 'dug slob sbyong spas tshad yag po ma byung na/ slob phrug grangs 'bor mang po yod pa dang / slordzu grwa'i khang pa dang / 'dzin khang yag po yod pas 550

phan thogs de tsam med par brten slob phrug yod pa 'di rnams slob sbyong spas ka dag po yong rgyu de gal chen por 'dzin dgos/ kha sa khas nyin nga tsho rmed cha byung ba bzhin/ dge rgan tshos nus pa 'don rgyu dang / slob phrug tsho'i jog nas yin na yang dmigs bsal so so'i mi tshe gcig gi 'gro stangs dang / de bzhin bod spyi pa'i don dag la 'brel ba yod pa/ gang ltar spyi sgor chos srid gang gi cha nas yin na yang / shes yon shin tu gal chen po yin pa 'di ngos 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i thog nas/ slob phrug tsho'i thog nas do snang byed dgos pa dang / slob phrug gi pha ma tsho dang 'brel yod tshang mas slob sbyong gi jog la do khur byed rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po 'dug mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med na yang / mthun rkyen gang yod pa de'i thog nas slob sbyong la shugs rgyag rgyu gal chen po red ma gtogs/ phru gu'i ngos nas yin na yang le gang 'grigs byas/dge rgan tsho'i ngos nas kyang nyi ma bskyal nas bsdad pa yin na/ slob grwa yod na yang grub 'bras thon thub rgyu khag po red/ de 'dra yin dus phru gu tsho'i jog na sa yin na yang so so'i slob sbyong la do snang byas/ dge rgan tsho'i thog nas kyang tshang mas shugs bskyed nas nus pa bton rgyu gal chen po red/ rgya gar gyi dge rgan tshos kyang bod pa btsan byol ba mnyam du bsdad te las 'gan chen po zhig 'khyer gyi yod pa red/ da dung yang rgya gar gyi dge rgan khyed rang tshos sngar bzhin tshang mas nus pa bskyed rgyu dang / kha shas nas ltod g.yeng dang 'thus shor 'dra yong gi 'dug na/ bskyar du bsam blo btang te shugs rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red ces re 'dun dang 'bod skul byed rgyu yin/551

da lta sngon 'gro'i skabs su spus dag po zhig dang 'thus ma shor ba la nges par du shugs rgyag dgos kyi 'dug nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs ni ma 'ongs par phyi rdzig nang rdzig cig yong ba la nang gi mthun rkyen gtso bo de shes yon red/ da nang zhogs pa bka' chos sar skad cha byung ba bzhin/ phyi'i dngos po yar rgyas dang 'brel ba'i deng dus kyi shes yon dgos pa red la/ nga rang tsho'i pha mes dus nas yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung gi shes yon de yang dgos pa red/ de gnyis zung du 'brel nas phyi dngos po yar rgyas yod pa dang / nang bsam blo yar rgyas yod pa de 'dra'i mi zhig byung ba yin na/ so so la yang mi tshe don dang ldan pa zhig yong gi red la/ mi tshe don dang ldan pa skyel sa'i spyi tshogs de yang don dang ldan pa mig dper 'os pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ 'di ha cang gnad 'gag chen po 'dug nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung dang 'brel ba'i shes yon zer dus/ spyir btang slob grwa'i nang la snga dgong kha 'don skyor sbyang byed pa 'di tsam zhig la ngos 'dzin byas na nor pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zer ba de gzhi yi gnas tshul/ lam gyi gnas tshul/ 'bras bu'i gnas tshul zhes de 'dra'i rnam gzhag sgrom chen po zhig gi thog nas gung bsgrigs te bshad nas snying don rnams khong tsho'i bsam blo'i nang slebs thub pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ don dag blo la med par 'don kha phral 'dra bton pa yin na yang de la ngo mtshar che rgyu dang / ha las rgyu gang yang yod pa ma red/ skabs re slob grwa ba phru gu de 'dra la chos dges gang bslab kyi 'dug ces skad cha dris dus zhal 'don bslab kyi 'dug nga tsho 552

zhal sadon skyor gyi yod ces ha lam chos slob sbyong byed pa de zhal 'don skyor sbyang byed pa 'di yin pa'i bzo 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin gyi 'dug 'di 'dra ma red/ chos slob sbyong zer ba de don dag cig slob dgos pa ma gtogs/ tshig ngag la zin rgyu zhig gi skad cha ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung slob sbyong zer mkhan 'di gting ring po zhig dang / rgya chen po zhig gi thog nas yun bsrings dgos pa zhig yin pas/ de tsho'i jog la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos kyi 'dugardo donayang snying deng dus kyi shes yon yod pa dang chabs cig/ mi ya rabs shig dgos rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po yin/ mi ma rabs shig chags pa yin na/ shes byalenan tan spongad pa yin na yang rtsa ba'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so'i cha nas so so skyid pa yong gi ma red la/ spyi tshogs nang la yang phan thogs yong gi ma red/ der brten shes yon gyi thog nas spyi dang sger gang gi thog la yang phan thogs rlabs po che zhig yong rgyur tshang mas do snang dang 'bad brtson byed dgos zhes brjod rgyu yin/ de nas 'brel yod shes rig las khungs la lab dgos kyiye yod/ su la lab dgos kyi yod na'ang de tsho'i gras de 'dzems thon dang rdzod yangs ma song bar 'phral 'phral zhu skul byed rgyu gal chen po red/denas sa gnas 'dir chang 'thung rgyu la dga' po dang dar so chen po yod lugs go byung / gang 'dra yin nam/ gal te bden pa yin na dga' dga' skyid skyid skabs dang / las ka byas te tsha ba chen po yod pa'i skabs la phran bu phran bu sgom chang 'dra 'thung na ma gtogs/ rgyun gtan nas chang 553

mang po btung ste lang shor byung ba yin na/ nam rgyun bod skad kyi nang chang gi ming la myos chu zer gyi yod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nga la ston par smra ba rnams kyis chang rtsayi rtse mo'i zil pa tsam btung na mi 'grigs zhes nan po byas nas bkag gnang yod/ dper na dge slong nad pa la phyi dro'i kha zas za chog pa gnang yod kyang / chang la dmigs bsal nam yang gnang med/ chang gis blo rnal du mi gnas pa'i skyon gnas chen por gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dmigs bsal nan po byas te bkag gnang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de 'dra yin pa red/ nga rang tsho spyir btang gi mi'i spyi tshogs nang la yang mi chang mang po 'thung mkhan la/ kho thug pa ra bzi/ chang sgye red ces tshang mas bsnyad smod byed sa dang / mthong chung byed pa ma gtogs/ bsngags brjod byed mkhan suyang med/ gal te nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags nang la chang tshod med 'thung mkhan de gras yod pa yin na/ de goms gshis ngan pa yin pas yag po yod ma red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang dang / lhag don gzhon skyes nang la nyal thag 'then mkhan de 'dra kha shas yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig 'dug sdi li dang / dha ram sa lar yang kha shas yod pa'i skad cha 'dug 'di ha cang blo pham gyi gnas tshul zhig red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa tsho'i nang la nyal thag gis rkyen pas dka' ngal 'phrad kyiyod pa dang /de la dam bsgrags chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa btsan byol ba'i spyi tshogs mi 'bum gcig dang gsum khri bzhi khri'i bar mi nyung nyung zhig 554

las med pa de'i nang la ma rabs tha shal gyi gnas tshul de 'dra lhag pa yin na/ dpe mi srid pa'i thabs khyod nga dang / shin tu 'gan ljid po chags kyi yod pa red/ tshang mas der do snang dang gzab gzab byed rogs zer rgyu yin/de bzhin nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs nang la gcig gis gcig la lta rtogs byas/ gcig gis gcig la rogs ram byed rgyu de ha cang gal chen po red/de'i tho༄ dun gcig gis gcig la zon ma byas par lam seng 'khrug pa rgyab zer ba min/ nga rang tsho rwa1da pa'i gshis kur skyon mthong nasang mdun la 'dra chags po byas nas bsdad/ rgyab log la yas 'dug mas 'dug ces rgyab bshad byed pa de 'dra'i thog nas skabs re dkrog gtam lhag pa dang / gang ltar las ka 'thus shor 'gro gi yod/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas skyon sel dang / yo bsrang thad kur nges par du byed dgos/ 'dra chags po dang / spam po byas nas bsdad/ don dag ngo ma'i thog rul phyin na yag rgyu gang yang med/ las kyi sne mor gtogs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mi tshang mas gang ltar las ka gang dang gang yin na'ang rgyab mdun ngo lkog med pa sprus dag po zhig yong thabs la tshang mas khur skyes te shugs rgyag dgos kyi 'dugabod kyi rtsa don gyi gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig chags yod dam zer na/gnas tshul gsar pa zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus la mtshon na/ 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i ring la bod kyi thog rgya nag gzhung gis srid byus 'dzin stangs de skabs re lhug po lta bu dang / skabs re dam po 'dra po de 'dra'i 'gyur dog mang po zhig btang ba red/ ༄ ༄dun snying po rgya nag gzhung 555

gis 'jam rtsub thabs shes gang yong byasayod kyang / bod mi'i bsam blo bsgyur thub yod pa ma red/ bod pa tshos dus da lta bar du rang gi lhag bsam ri lta bu 'gyur ba med par bsdad pa red/ de bsdad pa'i dbang gis rgya nag gzhung gis bod don gyi thog la da lta bar du srid byus rim pa mang po byas pa 'di dag rtsa ba pham nyes phyin pa red/ da cha 'u thug thabs zad kyis bod kyi lung pa'i nang la bod mi rnams grangs nyung mi rigs bzo ched bod nang rgya mi phon chen po zhig slebs thub pa byung na gzhi nas bod don gyi gnas tshul 'di thag gcod cig mi yong ngam bsam nas re ba thabs skyo po 'di 'dra zhig byas nas bsdad yod pa red/ rgya mis bod bcing bkrol btang ba yin zer gyi yod/ bcing bkrol gtong sa'i bod pa rnams dga' zhing mgu ba'i thog nas rgya nag dang gcig sgril yong rgyu dang / rgya nag dang kha bral nam yang mi 'gro ba zhig yong dgos kyang /de yong rgyu'i tshab la bod pa'i thog gdug rtsub drag gnon kho na'i ngang nas bsdad dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di chags pa red/ 'dis ga re'i rtags bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ bod mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / bod mi rigs kyi sems shugs gang 'dra zhig yod pa de mtshon gyi yod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'byung dang 'brel ba'i jog nas bod kyi lo rgyus bshad yong dus/ bod rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung lo nyis stong lhag tsam phyin pa red/ bon gyi lo rgyus dang 'brel nas bshad yong dus/ bod kyi rgyal rabs byung nas ha lam lo bzhi stong lhag tsam zhig dang / bod mi rigs 'di yar rgyas kyi rnam pa thon nas ha lam lo drug stong bdun stong / lo khri yas mas phyin pa'i gnas tshul bshad 556

kyi 'dug nye ba'i cha la rgya nag gi gsar shog gcig gi nang la deng sang nga tshos bed spyod pa'i bod yig 'di ma byung gong la yi ge gcig yod pa'i skad cha bshad kyi 'dug nam rgyun bon wa'i thog nas yi ge de'i ming la dmar yig zer gyi yod pa/ nye char stod khul nas thon pa'i yi ge de dmar yig yin pa dang /dmar yig 'di lo sum stong phyin pa'i lo rgyus can zhig red ces rgya mi'i gsar shog cig nang thon 'dug de ltar yin na/ bod pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba'am gzhi ma de dmar yig de'i jog nas byung ba dang / thon mis de'i steng la yar rgyas btang gnang ba zhig yin pa red/ da lta rdo la bkod pa'i dmar yig 'di lo sum stong lhag phyin pa'i lo rgyus can zhig yod dus nga cho rwa/da pas bed spyod byed pa'i bod yig 'di phal cher lo sum stong bzhi stong phyin pa'i yi ge rnying khungs shig chags bsdad yod/ des na nga rang tsho bod zer ba 'di lo stong phrag mang po'i lo rgyus yod pa zhig dang / lo stong phrag mang po'i ring yar rgyas phyin pa'i mi rigs shig dang / mi rigs de la thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung gting zab yod pa zhig yin/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rgya mi rigs kyi rig gzhung yang ha cang rnying khungs dang / gting ring po'i lo rgyus yod pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho sku/da gangs can ljongs kyi rig gzhung de yang rgya nag gi rig gzhung dang ha lam na tshod mnyam pa 'dra po min nam bsam gyi 'dug de lta bu'i rig gzhung lo rgyus yod pa'i mi rigs gcig gi bsam blo lam seng 'gyur chog chog med pas bsam blo bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu khag po red/ da lta bar du bod rgya che'i mi mang 'di dag gis dngos gnas drang gnas lhag bsam 'gyur ba med pa 'i 557

thog nas so so'i mi rigs kyi la rgya zhen khog zin nas bsdad pa red/'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la 'das pa'i lo bcu bco lnga'i nang la 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod/ u ru sus mtshon pas lung pa mang po zhig gi nang la mang gtso gcig sdud kyi lam lugs med pa chags te mang gtso dang / rang dbang gi lam la 'gro gi yod/ rgya nag rang gi nang la'ang de de bzhin du mang gtso dang / rang dbang dgos kyi yod ces gleng brjod byed pa'i mtho rlabs 'phyur ba dang / shes yon can dang / bsam blo yod mkhan mang po zhig gi bsam blo'i nang la rang bzhin gyis mang gtso dang rang dbang gi thog la don gnyer che ru che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ rgya nag gzhung rang gi ngos nas kyang ma khe si dang le nin ring lugs kyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag la rgyab brten bcol rgyu khungs ma 'khyol ba'i mtshams la slebs bsdad yod/ lta ba'i rnam gzhag la rgyab brten bcol sa med par brten/ da cha mi rigs ring lugs la rgyab brte na bcol te 'gro gi yod/ mi rigs ring lugs la rgyab brten bcol rgyu de nyen kha yod pa zhig red/ rgya nag rang la cha bzhag na phugs rgyang ring po'i jog la des phan gyi yod dam gnod kyi yod cha ma mchis pa zhig red/ rgya nag rang gi nang la bsam blo yod mkhan tshos kyang / da lta'i rgya nag gung khran tang gis 'go 'khrid byed stangs de phyogs gcig nas gcig sdud lam lugs sgang la phyin te rang dbang da nga mang gtso sprod kyi med pa dang / gnyis nas lta ba'i rgyab brten bcol sa mi rigs ring lugs kyi snang la 'gro ba de nyen kha can zhig la brtsi giyod pa red/ gang ltar rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i 558

sgang la gnad yod rgyal khab gcig dang / de la dpag pa'i 'gan khur yod pa'i rgyal khab gcig chags yod/ de la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i skang nas che mthong yod pa zhig dang / cha 'jog yod pa zhig byed pa la/ da lta rgya nag gzhung gi mig rgyang thung thung gi srid byus 'dis nam ring sgrung gis 'khyol thabs med/des na rgya nag rang nyid kyi khe phan la tos nas/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi phyi 'brel gyi srid byus dang / de bzhin rgya nag rgyal khab nang khul gyi srid byus mang po zhig ga le ga ler gu yangs su gtong dgos pa zhig dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig gi sgang la ma 'gro thabs med yong rgyu gang nas bltas kyang shes gsal red/ der brten rgya nag nang la 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red/gnas tshul 'di'i 'og nas deng sang bod don thog la rgya nag rang gi nang nas kyang do snang byed mkhan mang du mang du 'gro gi 'dug lhag par shes yon can gyi nang nas bod kyi jog la rgya nag dbus gzhung gi srid byus 'dzin stangs 'di nor gyi 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug bod rgya nag dang kha ma bral bar mnyam du bsdad de brtan snyings dang mthun sgril yag po zhig yong dgos na da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi srid jus 'di dang / des 'grigs kyi mi 'dug bod kyi thog la rang dbang gi thob thang mang tsam spro da dgos zhes deng sang rgya mi shes yon can dang bsam blo yod mkhan gras kyi nang nas skad cha 'di shugs che ru che ru 'gro gi 'dug 'di 'dra'i bsam tshul yod mkhan gyi nang la/ bod kyi dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs lam yag shos ni/ tā la'i bla mas be|sa 'char 41na pa'i dbu ma'i lam de red ces 'di'i thog la rgyab skyor byed pa'i rnam 'gyur shugs 559

chen po bstan gyi 'dug der brten gang ltar snga phyi la ma tos par bod don la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu'i re ba chen po yod pa red/ ngas nam rgyun bod kyi gnas tshul bde na mtha' gsal 'a nye ba zhig red ces bshad kyi yod/ deng sang rgya nag gzhung gi srid jus dmigs bsal gyi gdug rtsub chen po bye da kyi yod na yang / de yun ring gnas thabs rtsa ba nas med/ nga tsho dad pa la sha tsha ba'i jog nas rgya nag gi srid jus bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu'i skad cha ma red/ rgya nag rang nyid kyi phugs rgyang ring po'i khe phan gyi gnas tshul la tos nas/bod kyi srid jus rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang / gnyis phan gyi bsam blo zhig ma btang na/ da lta'i gti thug gi bsam blo 'di dang / srid jus 'dis phyin chad rgya nag rang la gnod skyon yong rgyur brten/ 'gyur ba 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dugayin na yang 'gyur ba ga dus yong gi red dam zer na / bshad thub rgyu khag po red/ gcig byas na lo kha shas nang 'gyur ba yong srid pa red/ bar skabs rgya nag gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs gang la gang tsam yar rgyas phyin yod/thag nye 'gyangs gang 'dra zhig la 'gyur ba phyin yong lam seng bshad thub rgyu khag po red/ rgyu dang rkyen mang po zhig la ltos pa dang / rgyu dang rkyen mang po zhig la rag lus yod/ nga rang tsho tshang mas sngar bzhin snying stobs skyes/sems shugs ma chag par sdod rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang nas bod pa'i thog la do snang byed mkhan ni ha las pa'i shugs chen po yod/ 'das pa'i lo kha shas kyi nang la bod don gyi thog la rgyab skyor byed mkhan dang / bod kyi don dag 'di bden pa'i don dag yin pa dang / 'di 560

la bden rgyab dgos kyi 'dug zer ba'i 'bod sgra 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la lo re las lo re je che je cher 'gro bzhin pa red/ de dang chabs cig bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di gna' rabs kyi rig gzhung zhig yin pa dang / de yang gting zab po zhig dang phan thogs chen po yod par ngos 'dzin dang / do snang byed mkhan yang shugs che ru che ru 'gro gi 'dug gzhung khag gi nang nas kyang rgya nag gzhung gis bod rgya gnyis phan gyi lam nas bod kyi dka' nga' sel thabs byed dgos kyi 'dug de ni rgya nag rang gi khe phan red ces rgya nag la dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas 'bod skul dang / skul slong byed mkhan yang mang po yod pa red/ der brten rim pas rim pas 'gyur ba 'gro ba'i mtshan ma 'dra po sgo gang sa nas gsal po yod/ tshang ma blo bde po gyis/rgya gar gzhung ni nga rang tsho'i nang khyim gnyis pa lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i pha mes kyi skabs nas rgya gar dang dmigs bsal 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung phyug poyod pa 'di gtso bo rgya gar nas byung ba red/ngas nam rgyun rtag par rgya gar grogs po tshor bshad kyi yod/ nga tsho bod pa dang rgya gar dbar gyi 'brel ba 'di dge rgan dang dge phrug dbar gyi 'brel ba red ces bshad kyi yod/ der brten gna' rabs kyi dus nas bod dang rgya gar 'brel ba nye po chags bsdad yod/ dper na/ bka' 'gyur pu ti brgya lhag tsam zhig dang / bstan 'gyur pu ti nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa 'di rnams pu ti re zung 'dra ma gtogs gzhan rgya gar skad nas bsgyur ba sha stag red/ de ltar rgya gar dang nga tsho dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba yod/ gnyis nas nga tsho 561

btsan byol ba chags nas 'das pa'i lo de rnams kyi ring la gtso che shos rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / 'brel yod sa gnas gzhung khag gis kyang bod pa'i gzhis chags dang / de bzhin shes moni slob sbyong gi thog la dmigs bsal gyis thugs khur chen po bzhes yod/ lhag par paṇa ṭi ta ne+e ru bzhugs pa'i skabs la kho rang nas dmigs bsal gyis thugs khur chen po bzhes yod/ bzhes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / lnga bcu nga drug gi lo la sangs rgyas myang 'das kyi dus chen skabs la ngos rang rgya gar la slebs pa red/ de dus paṇa ṭi ta zhe ru la bod don skor gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig bka' mol byung / skabs der ne+e rus sngon la bod la phar phyir log byas na yag gi red/ bod la phar phyin te drang bden yin min la ma ltos par/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun yod pa de'i thog nas bod rang skyong gi khe phan rtsod dgos/ de bod la log nas rtsod na yag gi red ces ne+e rus bka' slob gnang ba de gzhi bzhag thog nas nga tsho bod la phar log pa red/ lnga bcu nga bdun gyi lo mgor phar log lnga bcu nga bdun gyi lo 'phros dang / lnga bcu nga brgyad/ lnga bcu nga dgu'i phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes shar bar du ne+e rus bka' slob gnang ba'i lam 'di'i sgang nas thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprug byas pa red/ byas pa'i mtha' ma la bod bstan srid spyi pa'i don dag sgrub rgyu phar bzhag 7rgyal ba rin po che'i srog kyang 'tsho dang mi 'tsho'i mtshams la slebs te mtha' ma nor bu gling ka nas bros yong ba red/skabs der sngon la bod kyi rdzokha khul bar du phyin/ to kha nas gang 'gab bsam blo gtong rgyu'i rtsis gzhi byas pa red/ nga tsho lha sa nas thon nas nyin gnyis phyin 562

pa'i rjes la lha sar drag gnon mgo tshugs/ lha sar drag gnon byas rjes rdzo kha khul la rgya mis dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i las 'gul byas par brten/ rdzo kha la yang chags thabs bral te rgya gar la tshur 'byor pa red/ nga spyi zla bzhi pa'i nang rgya gar la 'byor rjes/ spyi zla bzhi pa'i mjug tu ma su rir ne+e ru mjal 'phrad skabs lnga bcu nga drug lor bka' mol byung ba rnams mjug mthud kyis ne+e ru la bka' mol mang po zhu rgyu byung / de dus zhe nu'i dgongs pa la/ khong rang la yang las 'gan zhig chags bsdadaspedad dgongs pa'i dgongs tshul zhig tan tan byung ba'i bzo lta bu zhig 'dug gang ltar lnga bcu nga dgu dug cu nas bzung ste nga tsho'i gzhis chags khag 'di dag dang / gtso che shes nga tsho'i slob grwa khag 'di rnams btsugs pa'i skabs la srid blon ne+e ru khong rang sku sgor gyi ngos nas dmigs bsal gyi thugs snang gnang ste thugs khur chen po bskyed pa red/ nga tsho rwadad mi btsan byol ba rnams kyi 'gro stangs skor la/ rtsa ba'i srid byus spas dag po bting yod par brten/ da cha lo bzhi bcu brgal ba 'gro gi yod na zlong / slob grwa'i skor e yin/ gzhis chags kyi skora.e yin/ de bzhin rgya gar phyi 'brel las khungs nas nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba spyir blta stangs storarme yin/ gang yin rung lam zhig chags te lam 'di brgyud nas rgya gar gzhung gis kyang dmigs bsal gyi bod mir lta rtogs gnang dgos pa zhig dang / nga tshos kyang der dmigs bsal gyi thob thang yod pa lta bur zhu skul byed kyi yod pa red/ dngos gnas byas na slob grwa la mtshon na/ rgya gar rang gi nang la byis pa sa ya mang por dka' ngal 'di ga tsam yod/ mthun 563

rkyen skyo po de 'dra zhig gi snang la bsdad yod/ dper na/ sa cha 'di ga la cha bzhag na/ 'di'i nye skor gyi yul mi 'di dag rgya gar gyiyul mi red/ dngos gnas byas na 'di dag lajobo thang nga tsho las legs pa yod dgos kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul la nga tsho btsan byol ba rnams drag pa lta bu chags bsdad yod/rgya gar gzhung la yul mi'i phru gu sa ya mang wa'i dka' ngal 'di 'dra zhig yod bzhin du/ nga tso bod mi btsan byol ba 'bum gcig tsam zhig gi phru gu khri re zung gi shes yon thog la dmigs bsal gyi thob thang zhu ma 'os pa lta bu zhig red/ 'on kyang phyogs gcig nas nga tsho'i mi rigs gcig rtsa med 'khro nyen yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags yod pa dang / gnyis nas rgya gar gzhung gis nga tshor lnga bcu nga dgu dang / drug cu tham pa'i skabs nas dmigs bsal gyi thugs khur bzhes te 'char gzhi bting yod pa ltar/ gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas da bar du rgya gar gzhung nas gzigs skyong gnang gi yod pa dang / nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang rgya gar gzhung la zhu skul byed rgyu'i spobs pa gzhi rtsa 'di'i thog nas byung yod/ ༄༄ san yang snying rgya gar dbus gzhung nas bod pa'i thog la ha las pa'i bka' drin chen po gnang yod pa dang / de bzhin sa gnas so so'i gzhung gi thog nas kyang gang yong ci yong gis lta rtogs gnang gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nga tshos rgya gar gzhung dang / sa gnas gzhung gi bka' drin dran dgos pa dang / lhag don so so gang du sdod sa'i sa gnas sa thog gi rgya gar yul mi tsho la mthong chung byed pa 'dra po/ brnyas smod rigs rtsa ba nyid nas byed mi rung / skabs re bod pa'i nang pho gsar mo gsar kha shas kyis am 564

phrag nang dngul mang po yod rung med rung / phyi la krog krog byed rgyu de shes/sbag sbag 'dra bzhon te phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas/ gyon gos 'dra chags po gyon te rgya gar yul mi tsho la mthong chung lta bu byas na gtan nas mi 'grigs/ skabs re bod pa'i tshong khang nang rgya gar ba yong na rnam 'gyur sdug cag bstan mkhan de 'dra yong gi yod sa red/ byed stangs de tsho nor 'khrul shin tu chen po red /da lam nye ba'i cha la ku lu'i nang mi gsod kyi gan sa tshul zhig byung / mtha' ma bod pa'i tshong khang mang po zhig la me brgyab te dka' ngal byung yod/ de tsho'i gras ma gzhi gnyis sdug red/ phan tshun tshang mas nor yod na yang / nga rang chorwa 1da pas nam rgyun nas so so'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa 'khyer stangs gzab gzab byed dgos/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas te mi'i lung pa'i nang bsdad yod pas 'gram pa sa la phab nas 'gro bzo sdod mkhas byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ yang don dag 'gag rtsar thug pa'i nga rang tshor tshur brnyas bcos byed mkhan dang / thub tshod byed mkhan byung na/ rgya gar rang dbang lung pa dang /rgya gar khrims kyis dbang bsgyur ba'i lung pa red/ khrims la gtugs sa yod la/ skad cha bshad sa yod/ rgya gar gzhung la yang zhu sa yod la/ sa gnas gzhung la yang zhu sa yod/ 'on kyang rgyun ldan nas nga rang tshos krog krog gang byung ma byung byas/ de tsho yul mi'i blo dang snang ba la ma phyin pa byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas dka' ngal 'phrad pa yin na/ nga rang tsho rang sa nas lan pa'i bzo 'dra po chags yong dus/ bden pa bden sa la 'khyol ba'i skad cha bshad rgyur dka' ngal 'phrad yong gi 'dug de 'dra yin dus nga rang tshos nam rgyun nas 565

nyam chung dang ya rabs byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nam rgyun nas 'gro bzo sdod mkhas dang / nyam chung byed rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ nga tsho thog mar btsan byol ba chags pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung yul chu 'thung nas yul khrims 'khur dgos zhes nga tshos bshad kyi yod/ tshang mas ga dus yin na yang phyi nang gi mi su la yin na yang nyam chung byed dgos pa dang / yang sgos lhag par du rgya gar yul mi tsho la mthun po byed rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po 'dug ma gzhi nga rang tsho bod mi yod sa'i phyogs phal che bar yul mi tsho dang mthun po byas te yag po 'dug sngon ma nga 'dir tshar gcig yong ba'i skabs la/ rgya gar ba tshags par rgyag mkhan kha shas shig gis bod mi btsan byol ba'i nang nas yul mi skyo po de 'dra la tshe g.yog lta bu'i las ka bskul te dka' ngal sprad kyi 'dug ces bshad byung / skabs der nga tsho 'di'i skor la skad cha byung / mjug la de 'dra'i skyon chen po rang med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug yin na yang de dang de 'dra ba'i gnas tshul gang cir gzab gzab byed dgos pa de gnad 'gag chen po 'dug bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' stsal// //566

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 8 tshes 9 nyin sud sir bod rigs mang tshogs la 455 ba'i bka' slob/tshang mar 'tshams 'dri yod/ nga rang tsho'i bod spyi pa'i rtsa don thog dmigs bsal 'gyur ba gsar pa gang yang byung med/ na ning lo stod rgya nag dang 'brel ba zhig yod kyang ston mtshams nas 'brel ba de chad pa red/ da lta'i gnas stangs bod nang rgya nag gzhung nas rtsub spyod byed pa dang / bod nang la bod pa'i rig gzhung dang / chos lugs gnas pa des bod kha bral 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug ces dmar rjen du shod kyi yod pa red/ rgya dang bod gnyis tha dad red/ so so'i skad yig mi 'dra ba yod pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i rig gzhung / goms gshis sogs kyis rgya bod tha dad kyi 13 1 gsal po mtshon gyi yod stabs/ mtha' gcig tu bod rgya nag nas kha bral mi 'gro ba bya mkhan gcig gi ngos nas bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung thun mong ma yin pa zur gsal yod pa des kha bral gyi nyen kha zhig mthongayod pa red la/ de ga ler nyams chags 'gro ba'i thabs shes bya gi yod pa red/ de bzhin khor yug gi gnas stangs dang / rgya mi mang po bod nang 'dzul yong ba sogs dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig chags 'dug 'on kyang dka' ngal sel thabs lam seng bya rgyu khag po 'dug nga tsho bod pa'i thabs shes byed stangs 'di rang rgyal gzhan pham byed pa de 'dra min/ nga tsho'i da lta'i dbu ma'i lam zer ba de rgya la phan thogs pa zhig dang / bod la yang phan jogs pa'i re ba dang / dmigs yul bzung nas bya gi yod par brten/ deng sang rgya nag nang gi shes yon can 567

dang / slob grwa khag gi dge rgan de tsho'i nang la bod kyi bden pa'i gnas tshul de gsal du phyin nas dbu ma'i lam la rgyab skyor byed pa'i rnam pa shugs che ru 'gro ba dang / rgya nag gzhung gis bod pa'i thog la srid jus 'dzin stangs 'di 'grig gi mi 'dug ces skyon brjod kyi rnam pa shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/bden pa'i nus pa brlag thabs med/ drag po'i dpung gis mnan pa'i nus pa ga ler ga ler brlag pa 'am/ yal 'gro rgyu zhig red/ 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu yin par yid ches gtsang ma byas chog pa red/ 'on kyang da lta'i char gnas tshul dza drag chags yod pa dang / dza drag 'di sel thabs 'di 'dra zhig bya dgos zhes shod rgyu khag po 'dug da lta 'dzam gling nang bod pa'i bden pa'i bden rgyab bya mkhan shugs che ru 'gro bzhin pa 'di'i thog da dung 'dzam gling thog gang thub gsal bshad bya rgyus mtshon rgyab skyor bya mkhan de dag brtan po dang /yag po yong ba'i 'bad brtson bya rgyu de gal chen po chags yod/ gzhung khag dang / gros tshogs khag mang po'i nang bod pa'i bden don la rgyab skyor bya mkhan ha cang yag po red/ a ri srid gzhung nas bod don thog dmigs bsal gyi las byed ched btsugs byas pa de yang gnad 'gag chen po 'dug rgya mi'i mang gtso'i las 'gul bya mkhan de tsho ma yin pa'i spyi yongs rgya mi'i slob phrug dang / de min rgya mi'i thog bod kyi bden pa'i gnas tshul gsal bshad bya mkhan yod mus red/ slob grwa che ba de tsho'i nang rgya mi mkhas pa de 'dra yod pa de tsho phal mo ches bod don la sha tsha yod pa dang / rgya nag dbus gzhung gi srid jus 'dzin stangs thog skyon brjod byed kyi yod/ sngon ma nas ngas sa cha gang 568

du yin na'ang rgya mir bod pa'i bden pa'i gnas tshul gsal po bzo rgyu dang /grogs po sgrig dgos zhes shod kyi yod/ mang tshogs nang gi shes yon can tshor gang thub thub kyi gsal bshad bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ dmar po'i gcig sdud lam lugs kyi 'go khrid tsho mang gatsho'i 'os bsdu byas pa dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyun ring po bsdad kyi yod kyang / mang tshogs nang 'brel ba byas nas gsal bshad bya rgyu de gal chen po yod/nga tsho'i lam phyogs dbu mar 'gyur ba med/ dbu ma'i lam de 'u thug thabs zad kyi thabs shes de ma gtogs ma rnyed pa'i gnas tshul ma red/ bod mi tshor nang bsam blo'i thog su la'ang smon ma dgos pa'i shes tshad mtho rwa yod na yang / bod nang phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas med pa rjes lus red/ nga tsho tshang mas yar rgyas 'dod kyi yod/ mi tshang ma'i rmi lam nang du'ang bod rnying pa'i spyi tshogs de bskyar gso byas nas 'brog pa dang / zhing pa byas nas bod la log gi yin bsam pa'i bsam blo gtong mkhan su gcig med/ deng dus dang mthun pa'iyar rgyas 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu de nga tsho tshang ma'i bsam khra'i nang yod pa red/ phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas gtong ba la dngos po'i mthun rkyen nges par du dgos kyi yod/ nga tsho bod pa'i mi rigs de 'jon thang med pa dang / ma shes mkhan min/ dper na/ ltos sa ltos phyogs kyis nga tsho btsan byol ba de rnams mthong rgya thos rgya dang / deng dus kyi lag rtsal/ deng dus shes yon go skabs legs pa byung yod/ bod nang la yod pa de rnams 'gul bskyod rgyag sa byung yod pa ma red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas bod yar rgyas gtong 569

ba la deng dus kyi shes yon dang / lag rtsal/ dngos po'i mthun rkyen sogs gang gi thad nas rgya nag dang mnyam du bsdad pa yin na/ yar rgyas 'gro rgyur khe phan che ba yong gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug rgya nag gzhung nas bod pa'i thog la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong gi thob thang zhig sprad nas chos dang /rig gzhung / nga tsho'i bzang wa'i yon tan de rnams nyams su len rgyu'i go skabs shig byung ba yin na/ dngos po yar rgyasayong thabs su krung ha mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab dang mnyam du mthun po byas te bsdad na gnyis phan yong gi red bsam pa nga'i bsam tshul de 'dra zhig gi thog la bsdad yod/ dbu ma'i lam zer ba de 1973 tsam nas gung sgrig ste da cha gsal po chags yong dus/ rgya gar nang la bod rigs gzhon nu tshogs pas mtshon pa'i mi mang po zhig gis dbu ma'i lam la mos mthun byed kyi yod pa ma red/ nga tsho mang gatsho'i lam la 'gro gi yod pa dang / nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi thob thang rtsod kyi yod pas rgyu mtshanayod pa red/ nga'i ngos nas dbu ma'i lam zhes pa der 'gyur ba gang yang med/ rgya nag gzhung gi phyogs nas nga tshor 'brel ba byas pa yin na ngas gra sgriga.ang sar yin/ spyi pa'i thog la gnas tshul de 'dra zhig ma gtogs gsar pa shod rgyu gzhan med/bod nang la dgon sde sogs kyi nang nga'i dpar nyar mi chog pa dang / nga la ngo sgol byed dgos pa/ de 'dra ma byas na 'ga' shas la nyen kha dang / 'ga' shas la skyon brjod phog pa de 'dra yong gi 'dug de tshor ngas bod nang dza drag gi gnas tshul yod par brten/ khyed rang tshos nga la kha gtong rkya nga byed dgos/570

nga la gnod rgyu gang yang mi 'dug bod nang yod pa'i bod mi gcig gis tā la'i bla mar ngan smras kyis kha btang ba yin na/ de bsam cho'i gting nas kha btang ba red bsam mkhan ha lam 'dzam gling nang yong gi ma red/ de rgya mis dbang yod bshad nas kha btang ba red bsam pa sus yin na yang dran gyi red/kha ma btang bar sdug rus rgyab nas bsdad na nyes brdung gzed rgyu dang / btson du tshud pa/ las ka nas phud pa sogs yong dus nga 'dir sems ma skyid pa yong gi 'dug nga la kha btang bar gang yang yod pa ma red ces shod kyi yod/kha gtong rkyang byed dgos/ rang so so'i bsam blo'i nang so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / rang mi rigs kyi bzang po'i yon tan de rnams yag po bzung thub pa bya rgyu de gal che gi red/ bod nang yod pa de rnams mi rigs kyi lta ba dang /lhag bsam ha las pa'iyag po red/ yin na yang skyon gyi cha gzhon skyes rang blo sna thung thung byas te 'phral sel snang ba skyid po'i ched sprang 'khyams rgyab nas chang tshod med 'thung ba dang / sdug sa nas tha mag nyal thag 'then pa sogs byed kyi yod/ de da ga gis so so'i lus po chud zos/ mi tshe chud zos/ de tsho'i gras rang sa nas nor ba red/ de tshor gzab gzab byed dgos pa zhig red/ lhag bsam yod kyang / lag len skabs skad 'bod byed rgyu dang / ngar po byed pa tsam las so so'i mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / 'phral phugs kyi bde don la bsam blo btang nas so so'i las ma'i thog hur btson byas te grub 'bras jon pa bya gi yin bsam pa'i nus shugs mi 'don pa'i skyon tan tan 'dug de bzhin bodanangayod pa'i bla ma sprul sku'i nang nas dpal 'gyor gyi rjes su rgyugs 571

'gro mkhan de 'dra yod sa red/ de tsho thabs skyo 04 red/ so so rang ngos nas nor gyi yod pa red/ dper na/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dang / de sngon dgon pa'i nang dmag dpung yong nas gtor bshig gtong skabs dka' las chen po rgyab nas sku gsung thugs rten de 'dra sbas bkung byas nas dka' las rgyag mkhan de tsho'i gras nas deng sang sngon ma srog blos btang gis dka' las rgyab nas sbas bkung byas pa'i sku gsung thugs rten de tsho brkus nas tshong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug sngon ma srog blos btang gis sku gsung thugs rten sbas bskung bya mkhan de tsho deng sang sku gsung thugs rten brkus nas nag tshong rgyag mkhan gyi nag chen gras la slebs yong gi yod pa de tshor 'grel bshad rgyag ma shes pa lta bu dpe mi srid pa'i thabs sdug red/ bod nang yod pa'i mang tshogs spyi yongs lhag bsam dang / dad pa dam tshig g.yo ba med pa ha las dgos pa ha cang yag po yin na yang / 'ga' zhig 'phral sel gyi blo sna thung thung dang / 'dod brngams de 'dra'i thog nas 'thus shor 'gro gi med dam bsam pa 'dug de tshor gzab gzab byed dgos zhes ngas rtag tu shod kyiyod/ gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang rnams don gyi bdag po red/ bod zer ba de 'bu ches chung zos byas pa'i ra sprod gsal po gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang nas byas pa red/ 'dzam gling thog bod ces pa'i ming ma brlag pa de bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi bka' drin red/ ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling thog bod ces pa mdzub mo 'dzugs sa yod pa dang rtsa ba brtan po tshugs thub min de yang gzhis lus rgya che'i mi mang la thug yod/ bod nang la yod pa'i mang tshogs spyi yongs rnams 572

ha las pa'iyag po red/ yin na'ang skabs re dza drag med pa'i skabs la rdzod g.yeng 'gro ba dang / mig rgyang thung ba'i skyon lhag gi yod bzo 'dug de bzhin nga cho btsan byol du yod pa tsho da cha lo bzhi bcu phyin pa red/ 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la yod pa'i btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i 'thus sgo tshang shos shig yin na yang / skyon cha'i thog la bsam blo btang na spyi sems 'khyer rgyu'i thog la 'thus shor 'gro gi yod pa'i bzo lta bu 'dug dper na/ rgya gar dang / bal yul sogs nang slob grwa 'grims nas shes yon yod pa de tsho'i gras deng sangs rir rgyugs rgyu'i bsam blo dang / dngangs skrag ma gtogs med pa lta bu 'dug a rir thar thabs ched skyag rdzun yang shod kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dug de tsho zhabs 'dren red/ gra btsun tsho'i nang sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa bon dang bcas pa'i nang slob gnyer bya mkhan sngar las lhag pa'i hur skyed bya mkhan mang po yod pa red/ yin na yang lus la gra chas gyon nas spyod pa rtsing po bya mkhan yang yong gi 'dug gzab gzab byed ma thub tshe ga ler ga ler 'thus shor 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha zhig mthong gi 'dugagros tshogs dang / bka' shag la yang bshad rgyu byu nga / da cha rgya bod 'brel ba'i gnas tshul la cha bzhag na nga tsho gcig pu'i lag par yod pa ma red/ rgya nag gi gang 'dra bya min la rag lus yod pa red/ rgya nag gi 'gul bskyod rgyab min de yang rgyu rkyen mang po zhig la ltos pa las rgya mi re zung gis lam seng lam seng byas chog chog kyang yod pa ma red/ dper na/ rgya nag gi srid 'dzin cang tse min dang / srid blon kru rung chi de tsho'i bsam blo phran 573

bu gu yangs pa yod na yang / tang dang / rig gzhung gi 'go khrid tsho'i nang bsam blo mkhregs po 'dzin mkhan de tsho'i gras kyis go skabs btsal nas nang khul bsam 'char btang nas byed bde po med pa'i gnas tshul zhig yod bzo 'dug gang ltar rkyen mang po zhig la ltos pa yin dus/ rgya bod kyi gnas tshul che sa de tsho'i gras gra sgrig yag po byed dgos/ bsam blo btang nas gung 'grigs po byed dgos/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi 'gyur 'gros 'og nas ga ler ga ler bzo lta chags kyi red ma gtogs/ nga tsho rang gi rang dbang thog nas byas chog chog cig mi 'dug so so'i lag par yod pa so sos bsam blo btang / 'char gzhi sgrig rgyu de tsho'i rigs 'thus shor phyin na su gcig la lag pa 'phyis sa yod pa ma red/ nga rang tshor da lta btsan byol gyi gros tshogs gcig dang / btsan byol gyi srid gzhung zhigayod pa des 'phral sel nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas sdod pa'i ring la'ang phan gyi yod pa red/ 1959 zla 4pa tsam nas nga tshos las ka mang po zhig byas pa red/ grub 'bras kyang gang la gang 'tshams thon yod/ nga tshor spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa dang / de'i nang chos don dang / nang srid/ shes rig zer ba sogs sde tshan so sos las 'gan 'khyer nas/ mi 'dug mi 'dug zer na yang / gang ltar grub 'bras gang 'tshams byung ba de tsho nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa de'i thog nas byung ba red/ bar skabs nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs rtsa ba brtan po yong ched bca' khrims bzos/ de dang mthun pa'i gros tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs gcig yod pa dang /de bzhin las byed pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gcig yod pa dang / de bzhin las byed 574

kyi sgrig gzhi bzos nas lam ston gsal po byas te rjes su yong mkhan tshos bshar bskyod thub pa dgos rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po chags kyi 'dug da lta nga tsho thog ma'i skabs yin stabs 'ga' zhig ran dang ma ran phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang ston 'khri bsgyur bcos btang chog pa zhig red/ sgrig gzhi ga phyod yag po yod na yang gtso bo lag len 'gel mkhan mi de yag po zhig ma byung na mi 'grigs/ phyogs gcig nas lhag bsam dang / ngo lkog med pa'i drang po/ de'i thog shes bya yon tan yod dgos/ thog mar lnga bcu nga dgu lo la rkang pa 'dzugs sa'i sa cha zhig e rag mi rag gi dbu btsugs rgyab pa red/ rkang pa 'dzugs sa byung ste gzhis chags byed pa dang / slob gra khag btsugs pa red/ da cha gang gal chen po 'dug zer na/ spus tshad yag tu gtong dgos/ dper na/ slob grwa spas dag tu gtong rgyu dang / gzhis chags yin na spri/nga mi thog brjes nas dedro sang mi thog gnyis par slebs pa rnams slob grwa 'grims nas skad yig phran bu shes pa dang gzhis chags nang bsdad nas mu mthud 'tsho ba bskyel rgyu'i sems shugs med pa/ pha ma tshos byas pa'i sa zhing gi las ka de phru gu tshos byed 'dod med pa/ ma gzhi gzhi sa chags khag 'phrul chas can du bsgyur rgyu'i 'bad brtson byas yod kyang / bsam pa ltar ma byung ba red/ gzhis chags 'ga' shas thog ma'i mi 'bor las nyung du phyin pa dang / yang 'ga' shas mi 'bor 'phar ba yang yod/ gang ltar nga rang tshos sgrub thub nges shig sgrub ma thub par zhan du zhan du 'gro gi yod pa'i bzo lta bu mthong dus skabs re blo g.yeng yong gi 'dug de bzhin btsan byol 575

gzhung gi las byed pa'i nang la cha bzhag na/ slob grwa sgon nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi las don byed thub mkhan 'jon thang yod pa de tsho rang mgo gang jon 'gro ba dang / de tsam gyi slob sbyong dang / 'jon thang med pa de tsho gnas skabs ngal gso rgyag sa lta bur las byed pa'i nang la zhugs nas ga ler ga ler 'gro sa byung na 'gro mkhan de 'drayong gi 'dug khag gcig ni lhag bsam rnam dag thog nas hur skyed byas te byas pa can de 'dra yang yod pa red/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas dka' ngal zhig yong gi yod pa lta bu 'dug de cho la phran bu'i sems khral 'dugamathun rkyen la cha bzhag na 1959 lo btsan byol du sleb skabs dza drag gi skyob gso'i rogs ram bya mkhan shugs che byung yod pa de'i dus tshod rdzogs pa red/ yin na yang deng sang skyabs bcol ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi don dag cig yin pa'i thog la/ dmigs bsal chos dang rig gzhung la do snang dang / dga' po bya mkhan shugs cher song stabs dngos po'i cha nas rogs ram bya mkhan shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/ rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul dang /rgya nag gi gnas tshul la bstun ma dgos pa nga rang tsho'i lag par yod/ las don thog las byed pa'i ngos nas gzab gzab byed ma thub tshe dka' ngal 'phrad mi yong ngam bsam pa'i sems khral 'dug mato ༄dun snying po shod rgyur/ rtsa ba'i cha nas nga tsho bod pa'i gnas stangs yag po yod na yang stod g.yeng dang /snang chung thog nas 'thus shor 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha med pa ma red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba'i nang la lo bzhi bcu zhe grangs nang sgrom gzhi yag po bslangs pa de ga 576

ler ga ler nyams rgu da 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha med pa ma red/ gal srid nyams rgyud phyin pa yin na deng sang bod pa spyi la 'dzam gling 'di'i steng mthong dang / cha 'jog yid ches da phan ha cang yag po red/ dper na/ spyir stangs a rir 'gro mkhan la cha bzhag na/ bod pa zer dus drang po/ ngo lkog med pa bzang po zhig la rtsis kyi yod/ bar lam bod pa'i nang la 'dra mi 'dra 'ga' shas yong gi yod pas ga ler ga ler rang sa nas mthong bskyel rgyu'i nyen kha yod dus tshang mas gzab gzab byas te rig pa sgrim dgos/ da phan gzhis chags khag la spyi yongs nas bltas na lhag bsam/ mi rigs kyi lta ba ha cang yag po red/ spyi sems yod pa/ bod pa btsan byol gzhung gis 'go 'khrid pa'i 'og tu chig sgril gyis bsdad pa yag po red/ yin na yang skabs re bsam blo'i nang la 'gyur dog 'gro gi 'dug dang mi 'dug brtag dpyad yang nas yang du byas/ bsam blo btang / yang yang tshogs nas go bsdur byas/ go bsdur byed pa'i skabs su stong bshad byas nas phan thogs yod pa ma red/ don dam gyi lag len thog 'thus shor gang 'gro gi 'dug 'thus ma shor ba'i thabs shes gang byed dgos kyi 'dug don gcod dang / khyed tsho'i 'thus mi yod pa tshos rgyus yod jog nas bsam blo btang / go bsdur byas/ de bzhin tshogs pa skyid sdug yod pa tshang mas kyang spyi pa'i don dag la khur 'khyer nas 'thus ga nas shor gyi yod pa dang / yar rgyas gtong sa gang du yod med bsam blo btang nas 'thus ma shor ba zhig ma byas par/ 'grigs yod bsam nas spyi ma sgom la lo zla zhag 'bud byas nas ma phyin par do snang dang / gzab gzab byed dgos 577

pa 'dugang nye charalo ri sa dang / man pata gzhis chags la phyin pa yin/ gnyis kur lab rgyu byung / dang po nga tshos gzhis chags btsugs pa'i skabs kyi re ba rgyab pa'i tshod dpag de ma 'grub pa'i bzo lta bu 'dug gzhis chags khag gi mi mang de rnams byed ka so sos ma thub pa yin 'gro gang ltar bod spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs nang hur thag rbad thag byas nas sdod mkhan mi mang nyam chung rnams red/ phran bu'i thub mkhan de rnams phar 'khyams/ tshur 'khyams byas nas sdod kyi yod pa red/ hob te bltas na gzhis chags nang sdod mkhan de rnams phran bu'i lto gos skyo ba dang / mthong rgya thos rgya skyo ba lta bu 'dug nye char ku lu'i nang 'tsho ba rang 'tsho byas nas sdod mkhan tshor dka' rnyog byung yod/ rnam kun nas yul chu btung nas yul khrims 'khyer dgos skor rtag par shod kyi yod na yang / bsam med 'ga' zhig gis yul pa tshor 'ud shob shod pa dang / sbag sngag bzhon nas yar rgyugs mar rgyugs krog krog byas par brten yul pa tsho'i nang nas kha sangs te bshad 'dug sngon ma slebs pa'i mi rgan pa rnams ya rabs yul pa tsho dang mthun po yag po yod/ bar skabs nas bod pa gsar 'byor pa yin yang rung / mi thog gsar pa de tsho rgyag res tsha po/ yul par mthong chung khyad gsod byas nas da cha bod pa de tsho med na yag po 'dug bsi ma pa'i bsam tshul yong gi 'dug ces bshad 'dug rkyen rtsa ni bod pa nang tshags rgyag res rgyab/ bod pa gcig gis yul mi zhig rogs par 'khridashesang bar bod pa gcig gis gri rgyab nas mi gcig bsad/ yul 578

pa chos yul nub rgyab nas bod pa'i tshong khang tshang ma mer bsregs btang ba red/ de tsho bkra ma shis pa'i gnas tshul red ma gtogs dpa' blo khog dang /byas rjes ma red/ gang ltar bsam blo dang / spyod lam thog 'thus shor 'gro gi yod pa red/ gang ltar 'tsho ba rang 'tsho byas nas sdod mkhan tshos lab rnyog phran bu bzo gi yod pa red/ gzhis chags khag la dka' las rgyab nas sdod mkhan tshor lab rgyu byung / khyed rang tsho sems chung drags nas btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs thog nas gzhi rtsa'i thob thang yod pa rnams lta rtogs bya rgyu dus thog ma byung ba dang / 'thus shor 'gro gi yod pa red/ khyed rang tshos 'brel yod nang srid dang / shes rig 'phrod bsten sogs las khungs khag la lab dgos/ lab mi nus pa byas nas bsdad na 'thus shor 'gro gi red/de bzhin sa gnas sa thog la yod pa'i las byed tshos kyang nga lo kha shas gcig gi las 'gan yin/ de'i ring la 'grigs tsam byung na de nas 'khyur gyi yod bsam nas nyin ma gang 'bud kyi bsam blo btang na 'grigs kyi ma red/ rang nyid 'khyur 'gro gi yod kyang gzhis mi rnams mi tshe bskyal nas sdod dgos stabs de 'dra'i bsam blo btang na thabs skyo bo red/ so so lo shas sdod ring mi mang de dag la bsam blo btang nas yar rgyas yong thabs kyi thabs shes gang yong byed dgos zhes shod rgyu byung /gzhis chags khag de rnams gnas stangs skyo trore dka' ngal zhig 'phrad yong gi 'dug 'dir sud si nang mi thog gsar pa 'tshar longs yo nga bzhin pa red/ khyed tsho'i nang ga tshod min zer na yang mthong rgya che ba yod/ nga tsho'i 579

gzhis chags khag nang 'dzugs skrun byed stangs dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong stangs sogs lag rtsal rnam grangs mang po dgos pa yin stabs/ 'di khul yod pa'i bod rigs gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas dus yun ring po sdod mi thub kyang / lo gcig tsam mam/ zla drug tsam ring btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs nang yong ste gzhis chags sogs nang las ka byed thub na phan thogs chen po yong ba 'dug ces 'bod skul byed kyi yin/ khyed rang tsho gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas de 'dra byed 'dod yod na/ nyon tshud nas 'brel yod las khyangs tshor so so'i lo rgyus nang da lta bar sbyangs pa'i lag rtsal 'di 'dra yod/ de thog nas zhabs 'degs phran bu sgru ba thub na bsam pa yin na dus stod 'di 'dra zhig gi ring la las ga'i bkod sgrig bya rogs byed ces sngon tshud nas yig 'brel byed dgos/ las khungs tshos khyed rang tsho'i las kur 'thus shor mi 'gro bar las ka byed chog chog go sgrig bya rgyu dang / tshur yong nas 'dir sngar mus las ka byas chog pa byas nasag pospenang gi red/ rgya garatang gzhis chags khag gi mi tshor blo bskyed thon thub ched khyed rang tshos las ka byas na phan thogs tan tan yong gi re da bsam gyi 'dug khyed rang tsho'i thog la cha bzhag na yang btsan byol bod rigs mang tshogs kyi khrod du 'tsho ba mnyam spyod byas pa yin na khyed rang tshor yang nyams myong yong gi red/ gcig byas na khyed rang d+ku nang sud sir 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs po 'di'i nang da dung chog mi shes par yas yas byed dgos/ mas mas byed dgos zer mkhan de tsho sdug dka' las che sa zhigagi nang la gang 'tshams bsdad na phan thogs yong gi red/ mi'i 580

mi tshe'i nang la sdug dka' las rgyab nas nyams myong gsog rgyu de don snying ldan pa zhig red/ skyid skyid par mi tshe bskyel mkhan de gnas tshul phran bu zhig 'phrad na lam seng sdug skad kho na rgyab nas sdod mkhan gyi mi zhig yong gi yod par brten khyed rang tsho la'ang phan thogs yong gi red bsam pa 'dug khyed rang tsho'i nang nas rgya gar la bskyod nas gzhis chags khag nang las ka byas kyang rung / yang na dzña ram sa lar las ka byas kyang rung / rgyas rgyas spam mtho med na yang / las byed spyi mtshungs lta gi red/gnyis nas so so'i lus wa'i jog nas dka' las rgyag mi thub kyang /gzhis chags tsho'i nang rogs ram gzhan dag bya rgyu yod pa dper na/ ma rda'i par rde gzhis chags nang 'thung chu'i dka' ngal sel ched chu mdzod rgyag ma thub par bsdad 'dug chu mdzod gnyis tsam gyi rogs ram 'jar man rogs tshogs we kur nas byas 'dug de 'dra'i rogs ram byed thub na mi mang gi bde rtsar thug giyod pa red/ gzhis chags khag gi bod mi mang de rnams phugs rgyang ring wa'i rmang gzhi chagasayod stabs/ de tshor lta rtogs dang zhal 'debs 'bul mkhan byung na yag po red bsam gyi 'dug ngas dge ba la bar chad byas pa min te deng sang dgon pa gra tshang dang / khang tshan de 'dra nas slong mkhan mang po red/ bal yul nang dgon pa rgyag gi yin zer mkhan de tsho yag po red kyang / da lta'i dus tshod der dgon pa gcig pur ngo mtshar che rgyu gang yang med/ 'jar man la ngo shes pa zhig yod khong gis nga la yi ge zhig btang 'byor byung / de'i nang kho rang skabs re rgya gar dang / skabs re bal yul 581

la sdod kyi yod/ bal yul nang da phan lo sum cu lhag tsam ring dgon pa mang po rgyab song / de tsho rgyas spros ha cang chen po 'dug de tsho'i nang slob grwa dang /sman khang rgyag mkhan gcig kyang byung ma song / ye shu'i chos pa gcig gis lo sum cu'i ring dgon pa de tsam zhig rgyab yod na de mnyam slob grwa dang / sman khang tan tan rgyag gi red/ nga rang nang pa zhig yin/ ma rig pa dang / slongs pa'i thog nas skyon mthong ba min nam zhes yi ge 'byor byung / dzña sar gsung chos skabs la lab pa yin/ dgon pa chen po zhig rgyag gi yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba de phyi la yod pa ma red/ nang la dgos pa red/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa zer ba de nang gi gshis rgyud la brten nas sgrub dgos pa ma gtogs/ phyi la khra khra zing zing byas nas sgrub rgyu zhig ma red/ rtsa ba dge 'dun gyi bsten gzhi dgon pa bzhengs na yag po red de/ da lta'i char dgos gal che los dang / yang lci bteg nas bsam gzhigs nan tan byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug rgya gar nang khul gzhis chags khag nang lo nas lo bstud 'thung chu dang / 'phrod bsten gyi dka' ngal yod mkhan de tsho'i thog la khyed rang tshos mthun rkyen sprad thub na dngos gnas dge ba dpag tu med pa dang phan thogs chen po yong sa red/ de ngas khyed rang tshor lab 'dod byung /ngas khyed rang tshor gtam kha gro po gcig dang / rtsa ba chen po dmigs bsal shod rgyu med/ spyi yongs nas bshad na nga tsho bod pa tshang ma spobs pa zhum dgos pa zhig ma red/ bod nang la bltas pa yin yang rung / bod phyi la bltas na yang ha cang yag po red/ ngas khyed rang tshor lo rgyus shig bshad 582

chog rgya gar nas bod la gnyen 'phrad la 'gro mkhan zhig yod/ kho mgo 'tshos po yod/ kho rtse pho brang la chos mjal la 'gro skabs chos mjal zhu mkhan nang rgya mo 'byor ldan gyon chas sogs yag po gyon pa zhig 'dug de'i rnam 'gyur dang byed stangs la bltas na phyi rgyal nas yong ba zhig ma red/ rgya nag rang nas red 'dug rgya mo mo rang dang rogs pa bdun brgyad cig 'dugakhong tshos lha khang de tsho ga 'dra ga 'dra red zer skad cha dris kyi 'dug rtse shar brgyud kyi gzim chung 'gram du slebs skabs dkon gnyer gcig nas 'di tu la'i bla ma'i bzhugs sa red brjod song / rgya mo des to phad nang nas kha btags gcig bton nas de lag tu btegasate gzim chung gi sgo 'gram du pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs nas bsdad song / de'i rogs pa de rnams kyang mnyam du pus mo btsugs nas bsdad song / khong rang ya mtshan chen po skyes byung zer gyi 'dug de bzhin khams dang / a mdo bla ma de 'dra 'ga' shas ngas ngo shes kyi yod/ de tsho'i drung du rgya mi nang chos la do snang bya mkhan/ lhag par du bod kyi nang chos la do snang bya mkhan/ mjo slob thon pa brgya phrag de 'dra yong gi yod pa go rgyu 'dug nga rang tsho rwaped pa'i chos dang rig gzhung 'di dag dus tshod gang 'tshams phyin pa'i skabs la rin thang can zhig yin pa dang / 'dis mi la phan thogs yod pa zhig yin pa gzhi nas mngon yong gi 'dug nga tsho thog mar btsan byol du slebs pa'i skabs mi mas snying rje'i bsam pa dang / mi yag po red bsam pa byed kyi yod/ dus tshod gang 'tshams song rjes bod pa zer dus mig dpe blta sa'i yul dang / rdzun mi shod mkhan/ bag yangs 583

po zhig la brtsi gi 'dug rjes su bod pa khram pa shod mkhan zhig byung na khong cho ton 'jor gyi red bsam gyi 'dug a rir bod mi chig stong gzhis chags su len skabs sa gnas so sor tshogs chung btsugs nas las ka 'tshol rogs bya mkhan de tshos bod par rogs byed pa 'di bod mi btsan byol bar rogs ram byas pa gcig pu min/ bod pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang gi goms gshis bzang wa de yul nang mig dper 'jags thub pa'i ched yin zhes shod mkhan mang po byung / rjes su goms gshis bzang po de par ma 'jags par/ goms gshis sdug pa de tshur 'jags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug spyi yongs kyi thog nas bshad na bod pa zhes lab dus nga tsho spobs pa skye ba zhig tan tan 'dug nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas pho bzhi bcu 'di'i ring la rkang pa 'dzugs sa med pa la rkang pa 'dzugs sa zhig rnyed/ rkang pa 'dzugs sa rnyed pas ma tshad/ 'dzam gling 'di'i steng mthong dang / cha 'jog 'pher ba byung ba'i skabs la da dung gzab gzab bya gi yin na sngar las lhag pa'i 'dzugs skrun dang / sngar las lhag pa'i rgyal kha zhig yong gi red/ nga rang tsho snang ba dag nas ltod g.yeng phyin/legs pa de ma sgrub/ sdug pa de 'jags nas shog bu snum thig lta bu byas te deng sang rgya gar nang gzhon skyesa.e shes (703) na mkhan 'ga' shas yod sa red/ de bzhin tha mag nyal thag 'then mkhan dzña ram sa lar yang yod sa red/ de tsho shin tu thabs sdug red/ nga rang tshos snang med kyi thog nas ga ler ga ler nga tsho spobs pa byed sa'i gzhi rtsabarlag rgyu'i nyen kha tan tan 'dugargan pa tshos rgan pa la dpag pa'i sems khur blangs nas rig pa bsgrims dgos 584
