pa dang / gzhon pa tshos gzhon pa dpag pa'i rig pa bsgrims nas shugs ma rgyab na rim pas 'thus shor chen po phyin/ 'thus shor de tsho'i gras gzugs po la nad na tsha byung nas ra u ru zhes lam seng shes thub pa lta bu min par ga le ga ler lo nas lo bsdud 'thus shor phyin pa de rjes su gzhi nas mngon gsal dod po chags pa'i skabs do snang byung yang phyis drags pa red/ dzña sar tshogs 'du de 'dra tshogs pa'i skabs la skad cha byung / las byed pa gsar zhugs bya mkhan drag pa slebs ma thub par spus tshad zhan du 'gro gi yod kyang /gang zag bye brag pa gcig la nga tshos skyon brjod byed thabs med/ 'das pa'i lo bcu bco lnga'i nang slob grwa che chung khag nang 'dzin grwa 'grims nas yong ba'i skabs su 'brel yod mi sna gtso bor gyur pa tshang mas lta rtogs sems khur yag po byed ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis phru gur bzang po'ispenan tan ma 'jags par/g.yo rdzun shod rgyu dang / nyal thag 'then rgyu de tsho 'jags/ ma tshang med rgyu de la ni/ 'bras bu gang gis ldog par byed/ gsungs pa bzhin lo mang po'i ring 'thus shor phyin pa'i 'bras bu dog tu med pa zhig chags pa red/ lo mang ring la 'thus shor phyin pa de nga tshos gzhi nas mthong dus a kha zer rgyu ma gtogs nga tshos nyes pa dang / chad pa 'gol sa med/ de nga tshos nyams myong du 'khyer nas phyin chad de 'dra mayong ba'i don du rig pa bsgrims dgos rgyu gal chen po 'dug ces 'bod bskul bya gi yod/ 'di khyal la'ang mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas ga ler ga ler goms gshis sdug pa de 'jags/ bzang po de brlag na yag po ma red/ tshang mas gzab gzab byed rogs byed zer 585

rgyu yin/nga tsho spyi'i rtsa don de 7rgyal ba rin po che gcig po'i 'gan khur ma red la/ bod gzhung gcig po'i 'gan khur yang ma red/ bod zer ba de dang /bod rigs zer ba de di bzang po'i ming zhig byung na bod rigs su gtogs pa yongs rdzogs la khe phan yong gi yod pa red/ bod zer ba'i ming de nyams nas mthong chung khyad gsod byed yul zhig chags na bod mi mi re ngo re nga bod pa yin zhes shod mi nus pa chags kyi red/ des na spyi pa'i don la tshang mas rang don rang gces kyis rig pa bsgrims nas gzab gzab byed dgos pa zhig red/gzhan da ga yin/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' 355// //586

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 8 tshes 15 nyina.a ri ni'u yog tu nye skor nas bcar 'dzoms bod mi sum stong skor la stsal ba'i bka' slob/rtsa don gcig gnyis shig zhus payin na/ rtsa ba'i bod rgya'i gnas stangs der 'gyur ba gsar pa gang yang phyin yod pa ma red/ rgya nag gzhung gi gnas stangs mkhregs po zhig byed kyi 'dug nga tsho'i ngos nas byed phyogs de ni tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ dbu ma'i lam phyogs thog 'gro rgyu der 'gyur ba gang yang med/ langs phyogs de ga'i thog bsdad yod pa red/ de nas gal che ba zhig la bka' shag dang / btsan byol gros tshogs/ de bzhin las byed mtho rim 'dzoms pa'i skabs mang po zhig la zhu gi yod/ rgya bod gnyis kyi dka' ngal de nga tsho gcig pu'i lag par yod pa ma red/ gang ltar phyogs gcig nas rgya nag la rag lus yod pa red/ rgya nag gzhung gis bsam blo gu yangs po zhig gtong dang mi gtong gi gnas tshul la thug bsdad yod/ rgya nag gzhung gis srid jus lhug tsam dang bsam blo gu yangs po zhig gtong thub dang mi thu ba zer ba de yang spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul la rag lus bsdad yod/ don dag che sa de rnams rgyal spyi'i 'gyur ba dang / rgya nag nang gi 'gyur ba mang po zhig gi gnas tshul gyi 'og nas 'gro rgyu red ma gtogs nga rang cho rwa1da pa'i ngos nas stangs 'dzin cha tshang byed thub pa zhig dang / nga tshos 'di ga tsam byas na 'di ga tsam yong gi red ces tshod dpag byed thub pa dang / nus pa 'don thu ba pa zhig yod pa ma red/nga tshor btsan byol ba'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ btsan byol 587

gzhung zhig dang / de ga nang bzhin gros tshogs shig yod pa red/ zhib rtsis shig byas na nga tshor sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'di'i drin la brten nas 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i nang la las ka mang po zhig byas yod/ grub 'bras kyang gang la gang 'tshams yag wa dan yod/ de rnams spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa'i cha nas thon pa red ma gtogs/ sgrig 'dzugs med na dper na nga rgyal ba rin po che zhes mi tshos re ba dang rgyab skyor zhig yod na yang / rgyal ba rin po che mi gcig kher rkyang gi thog nas las ka byas pa yin na/ de tsam 'grub thub thabs yod pa ma red/ de tsam yong ba de spyi pa'i bya spa ston gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa dang / sde tshan so sos las 'gan re 'khyor ba la brten nas da lta bar du grub 'bras jon pa red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog la rgyab skyor byed rgyu dang / sha tsha byed rgyu/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs da dung yag po zhig yong thabs la tshang mas gces po dang / zhen khog byas nas bdag po rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red/ yin na yang sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang gi las ka byed mkhan gyi mi'i ngos nas tshad ma longs pa de 'dra yong gi red/ de bzhin lhag bsam ma dag pa de 'dra ha lam yong khag poyin na yang gal te lhag bsam ma dag pa gang byung byed mkhan de 'dra byung ba yin na/ mi sgor pa so so'i ming smos gsal po byas nas skyon brjod byed dgos pa dang / nges par du de 'pho 'gyur gtong ba dang / bsgyur bcos gtong dgos pa de 'dra yod na 'brel yod tshor thad kur lab na'ang 'grigs/ gros tshogs nang la lab kyang 'grigs/ bka' shag la lab na yang rung / mtha' ma nga tsho'i khrims zhib las khungs su gtugs 588

nas lab dgos pa yin yang rung / de nga tshos nges par du byed dgos pa red/bod gzhung la brtsi bkur byed dgos zer ba de'i go ba bod gzhung gi las byed pa yin pa tsam gyis las byed su la yang skyon brjod byed mi chog pa de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ nga rang tshos skabs re nya nyung mnyam bsres byas te/ las byed pa zhig gis ma 'grigs pa byung na/ ming rjen par bton rgyu 'tsher snang byas/mthar thug bod gzhung gis 'grig gi mi 'dug ces kha'i rtse mo nas lab chog chog dang / lab bde po byed pa de nor 'khrul red/ gang ltar spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di nges par du dgos pa red/ de la rgyal khab gzhan pas ngos 'dzin yod kyang med kyang nga rang tsho so so'i mis de la rgyab skyor byed rgyu dang / ngos 'dzin byed rgyu gal chen po yod pa red/ skabs re bod nas yong mkhan 'ga' res rgyal ba rin po che gcig po ma gtogs gzhan blta sa gang yang mi 'dugabod gzhung gis yag po byed kyi mi 'dug zer ba de 'dra shod mkhan yong gi 'dugade tshor ngas bshad kyi yod/ de 'dra ma red/ bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'dis phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags khag nang la cha bzhag na yang bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod par brten bde sdug bshad sa zhig yod pa red/ gang yin rung ma 'grigs pa zhig byung na bshad sa zhig yod pa red/ bshad sa yod pa tsam gyis drin chen po red ces bshad kyi yod/ las byed pa'i nang mi'i spus tshad ma longs pa de 'dra'i dka' ngal tan tan yod pa red/ skabs re sku drag gsar pa zhes bshad mkhan yang yong gi 'dug gang ltar gzhung zhabs las byed pa'i ming gi thog nas mar bka' 589

slob gnang mkhan yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa ma gtogs/ mi mang gi zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan dang / mi mang gi bde don sgrub mkhan/ zhabs 'degs sgrub pa po zhig yin bsam pa'i kun slong dang rnam 'gyur bstan mi shes pa 'dra po/ las rka'i thog sems khur mi len mkhan de 'dra med pa ma red/ yong gi 'dug las byed pa'i thog nas ma 'grigs pa yod pa de tsho'i gras la thad gar 'dzems zon med par gsal po lab dgos pa gnad 'gag chen po red/khyed rang tsho phyi rgyal lung par yod pa rnams/ rgya gar las dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs phran bu yag gi red/ mthong rgya thos rgya'i cha nas kyang che ba yod/ kha sang sud sir yang lab rgyu byung / nga rang tsho rwa1da rigs nang khul nas dgon pa grwa tshang la sogs pas dgon pa rgyag gi yin/ za khang rgyag gi yin zer ba'i thog nas zhal 'debs 'bod skul byed mkhan tshor zhal 'debs sprod kyi yod pa yag po red/ bsod nams gsog pa la ngas bar chad byas pas ga la 'grigs/ yin na yang nga rang tsho kha tsha dgos gtug gi gal chen po gang 'dug zer na/ rgya gar nang la yod pa'i bod mi gzhis chags khag dper na/ te dzu gzhis chags la sogs par bar skabs ma slebs par dus yun gang 'tshams phyin pa red/ nye char phyin pa yin/ khong tsho'i gnas stangs dang po nga tshos tshod dpag dang / re ba rgyab pa nang bzhin ma 'grub par dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad bsdad 'dug gzhis chags khag gi nang la dper na 'thung chu yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / de ga nang bzhin zhing las kyi gnas stangs yar rgyas gtong rgyu/ shing sna 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu la sogs pa/ sman bcos kyi 590

mthun rkyen yag tu gtong rgyus mtshon pa'i rigs mang spro zhig kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnas tshul tan tan red/ de 'dra'i thog la nga rang tsho bod pa phran bu phran bu mthun rkyen sbyor thub mkhan de 'dra byung na ha cang yag po yong gi red/ rgya gar nang yod pa'i gzhis chags khag skyo ba de tsho'i nang la da lta mthun rkyen ma 'deng par dza drag gi gnas tshul chags bsdad yod pa tshor khyed rang tshos phran bu bsam blo gtong thub na yag po 'dug bsam byung / khyed rang tshor ga tshod med lab kyang mthong rgya thos rgya phran bu bsags yod pa red/ gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas a mi ri kha'i nang la thar na gcig dang / ma thar na gnyis zhesaya tshugs rgyab nas tshur yong ba red/ ga le ga ler rgya gar la phar gcig yong thub na yag po 'dug rgya gar nang la yin yang rung / bal yul nang la yin yang rung / gang ltar nga rang tsho'i mang tshogs kyi nang la sman pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu dang / de ga nang bzhin sman rogs kyi thog nas 'phrod bsten gyi las ma'i thog nas spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu/ yang las khungs nang la bsdad nas rtsis zhib byed rgyu la sogs pa dpal 'byor 'du 'god kyi las ka byed rgyu/ de 'dra'i las rigs 'dra mi 'dra'i nang la yun ring po bsdad ma thub kyang / lo gcig tsam/ yang na zla ba drug tsam bsdad pa yin na/ khyed rang tshor rgyas po zhig gi phogs sprad mi thub kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i las byed pa spyi mtshungs kyi thob thang dang blta rtogs byed kyi red/ las byed pa tshos las ka hur thag byed dgos pa dang / las ka byas pa dang chabs cig thob thang dang blta rtogs kyang nges par du gal chen po yin 591

dus blta rtogs byed kyi yod pa red/ spyi 'gre spyi mtshungs shig tan tan yong gi red/ kha sang sud sir yang lab pa yin la de ring 'dir yang lab 'dod byung / khyed rang tsho gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas btsan byol ba dka' ngal che sa zhig gi nang la ngas zhabs 'degs sgrub bsam pa'i kun slong skyes nas thag gcod byung song na/ 'dir don gcod yod pa red/ de ga nang bzhin rgya gar nang la 'brel yod kyi las khungs sde tshan de 'dra zhig gi nang la las ka byed 'dod yod ces sngon tshud nas phar 'brel ba byas/ phar phyogs nas las ka byed sa zhig bkod sgrig byas/ khyed rang tsho dus tshod gtan 'khel nas rgya gar du slebs pa dang lam seng las ka byas chogaspend pa zhig dang / rgya gar nas phyir 'khor mtshams 'di gar las ka byas chog yod pa zhig byung na/ phan thogs chen po yong sa red/ khyed rang tsho.a rir bsdad pa'i skabs la rgya gar nang gi gzhis chags khag de 'dra zhig gi nang la dus yun gang tsam las ka byas nas tshur 'khor yong dus rgya gar nang gi gnas stangs gsal po shes kyi red/yang 'dinas tshur rogs ram tshogs pa yin na'i red/ ngo shes pa de 'dra la nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba'i gnas stangs 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu sogs gang ci'i thad la phan thogs yong gi red/ sgor pa so so'i ngos nas cha bzhag na yang / sdug po skyid po'i mdog 'don yin zer ba bzhin gzhis chags khag nang gi mi mang nyam chung de rnams kyi 'tsho gos gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig gi thog la bsdad yod pa dang / spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs bzung ste gang 'dra byas nas bsdad yod pa shes pa yin na/ khyed rang tshor slob gso dang / nyams myong 592

gi phan thogs chen po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug yang ngas bka' btang ba 'dra po'i thog nas bshad pa min yang / 'bod skul byas na bsam pa dran byung /ngas sngon ma nas lab pa yin/ khyed rang tsho lung pa yar rgyas yod pa dang / slob sbyong gi mthun rkyen gang ci'i cha nas sdig po yod pa'i lung pa'i nang slebs yod/ gzhon skyes pho mo tsho'i nang nas slob sbyong byed thub pa dang /slob sbyong byed rgyur so so'i rnam dpyod dang nus pa yod mkhan tshos 'phral sel dngul phran bu zhig gi don du las ka tsag tsig la mgo 'khorasgas ma bsdad par/slob sbyong rgyun ring tsam dang / spas dag po zhig byed rgyu'i jog la rdzod g.yeng rtsa ba nas gtong rgyu med/ de 'a(gle rogs ram byed mkhan tan tan yong srid kyi red/ slob sbyong bya rgyu 'i go skabs yod pa dang / so so'i ngos nas nus pa yod mkhan tshos yin gcig min gcig slob sbyong gi thog la shugs rgyag dgos/nga rang tsho'i bod lung par da lta'i dus tshod la dka' ngal 'di 'dra zhig 'phrad pa 'di nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir smo bur du byung ba zhig ma red/ mi jog nas mi thog gi ring la rgyu rkyen mang po zhig byung ba gsal po red/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can bkrongs te bod sil por gyur pa'i mtshams de nas bzung da lta'i rkyen ngan bar gyi gtso bo'i sa bon de 'dra zhig nas mar byung ba gsal po red/de rnams kyi rgyu rkyen gcig ni nga rang tsho mthong rgya thos rgya chung drags pa dang /'dzam bu gling 'di 'gyur ba gang 'dra 'gro gi yod pa/ lhag par khyim mtshes nang la 'gyur ba gang 'dra 'gro gi yod pa de rnams la nga rang tshos do snang dang /nyams zhib yag po ma byas par a'u tsam mi yong ngam bsam pa'i jog nas 593

'thus shor phyin pa shin tu gsal po red/ 'das pa de rnams tshar ba red/ der nga tshos 'khyode pa byas nas phan thogs gangayang med/ da cha ma 'ongs par bsam blo gtong dgos/ nga rang 'i mi thog 'di rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa red/ dper na nga rang la cha bzhag na lo drug cu re lngar slebs pa red/ rgya gar la btsan byol ba chags nas lo bzhi bcu phyin pa red/ mi thog 'gyur 'gro gi red/ 'on kyang bod mi rigs mu mthud bsdad dgos pa red/ nga 'i mi thog 'di'i thog la dka' ngal 'phrad yod kyang nga tsho'i mi thog rjes ma'i thog la dka' ngal nyung tsam yong ba dang / nga tsho'i bod mi rigs 'di sra thag thag cig yong thabs la nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'dis phyogs gang sa nas thabs shes byed dgos pa zhig dang / 'bad brtson byed dgos pa zhig red/ mi sger pa so so'i ngos nas kyang lhag bsam rnam dag gi bod spyi pa'i don dag la zhabs 'degs phyogs gang sa nas cung zad tsam las ma byung kyang sgrub dgos pa de nga tsho'i las 'gan red/deyang dpa' blo khog gi thog nas zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu'i skad cha ma yin par/shes bya yon tan gyi thog nas zhabs 'degs sgrub dgos pa red/ nga tsho'i gzhon skyes tsho'i nang nas de 'dra'i slob sbyong gi go skabs yod mkhan tshos nges par du ltod g.yeng ma song bar mtho rim gyi slob sbyong byed rgyu gal chen po yin/gong du zhus pa bzhin/ nga rang cho rwand pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes ma brlag pa byed dgos/ sa gnas dang spyi tshogs gang dang gang du yod pa yin na yang bod pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes ma bral ba dang / gal che shos mi bzang po zhig byed dgos/ da lta bar du lung pa gang du yin na yang bod par smad /mi

ra gtong mkhan ha lam med pa lta bu red/ de ni bod par rgyu yod nas bstod ra btang ba yang min/ bod par dbang yod nas bstod ra btang ba yang min/bod par gshis ka bzang po zhig yod pa'i cha nas bstod bsngags de yong gi yod pa red/ des na mi bzang po'i yon tan de nga rang tsho'i gces nor rtsa ba che shos yin bsam pa'i sgog nas bdag po rgyag rgyu gal chen po red/ gzab gzab ma byas na da lta bod par mi tshos dga' zhen byed pa dang / bsngags brjod byed pa/ mngon par bstod yul de ga le ga ler zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan zhig chags pa yin na shin tu thabs skyong nga red/ bstod bsngags yong rgyu zer ba de las sla po min zhing / zhabs 'dren zer ba de las sla po'i thog nas yong rgyu zhig red/ de 'dra yin dus tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos/ so sos rgyun du dran shes bsten nas bod pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes ma bral ba'i thog nas bod pa'i mig dpe 'os pa zhig dang / mi'i dper 'os pa'i bzang po byed rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ so so rang nyid de 'dra byas pas ma tshad so so'i khyim tshang nang la yang bod pa'i gshis ka bzang po de 'dzin thub pa zhig dang /so so'i bu phrug mi rabs gsar pa rnams la yang de 'dra'i bzang po'i goms gshis brgyud sprod byas te/ nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'di rdzogs pa'i rjes la mi thog gsar pa de rnams bod pa spas gtsang mig dpe 'os pa mu mthud nas yong thub thabs la tshang mas bsam ṭ+wāṃ gtong dgos/ gzhan de ga yin bkra shis bde legs/ zhes bka' sdigapa// //595

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 9 tshes 26 nyin maye sor gzhis chags gsar rnying gi mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/ser skya mi mang rgan byis thun mong jog zhu rgyu la/ da ring 'dir nga phyo khyug tsam thug rgyu'i go skabs byung ba red/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di rnying shos shig dang / gzhi rgya yang che shos shig chags bsdadakod/ de dang 'brel ba'i dgon pa yang che shos khag gnyis chags yod pa red la/ gang ci'i mthun rkyen gyi cha nas drag pa chags bsdad yod pa red/ sa gnas 'dir tshar mang po slebs yod la/ da ring yang skyar nga rang tsho mang tshogs thug rgyu'i go skabs byung bar dga' po byung / thugs rje che zhes zer gyi yin/da lta zhib phra bka' blon gyi thog nas gsal bshad 'dra chags chags dang / spam wa de 'dra ma yin par dngosayod gnas tshul 'grel bshad gsal po byung song / de gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho'i mi'i spyi tshogs nang la las ka gang dang gang yin na yang rang rang so so'i sems kyi nang la yid ches rnyed pa'i thog nas nus pa bton pa yin na las ka tshags tshud po yong gi red/ las ka de sgrub thub kyi red/ sems nangayid ches dang / byed 'dod kyi sems shugs med par nyin ma gang 'khyol dang / 'phral sel le 'grigs tsam 'grigs tsam byas te phyin pa yin na/ de'i 'bras bu la las ka gang 'dra zhig yin na yang tshags ma tshud pa zhig chags yong gi 'dug mi'i sems la yid ches skyes pa dang / mi'i sems nang mos pa skyes pa la nga rang tsho'i dge dang skyon gang yin kyang gsal po byas nas bshad dgos pa de gal chen po 'dug bka' shag 596

dang / spyi 'thus la yang bshad kyi yod/ nga tsho las bsdoms 'dra 'tshogs/mi mang gi tshogs 'du de 'dra 'tshogs pa'i skabs la 'dra chags po sha stag bshad pa yin na nyan mkhan gyi sems nang yid chesade tsam yong gi ma red/ las bsdoms nang la 'grel bshad brgyab pa'i don dag rnams sems la de tsam zug ma thub/ srang lam bar gyi skad cha la yid ches che ba'i bzo 'dra po byas/ gang ltar nga rang tsho spyi pa'i don dag la 'thus shor dang / skyon cha lhags yong gi 'dugad lta bka' slon nas lab pa bzhin/ rgya nag gzhung gi rtsa ba'i srid byus yin min gang ltar yang 'brel yod khag gi gnas tshul nang gsal ltar na/ nga tsho btsan byol thod mi'i gong bu gcig gyur gyi nus pa gtor bshig gtong rgyu'i las ka ched du gnyer nas go sgrig thabs shes byed kyi yod pa'i rnam pa thon yong gi 'dug/ de 'dra zhig gi dus tshod la slebs yod pa red/ nga rang tsho nang tshags rtsa ba'i lhag bsam ma dag pa min na yang / so so'i sems nang la nga tsho'i 'gro stangs 'diyin bsam pa zhig dang / rdog la bsgril ba'i bsam blo med na phyi logs nas de 'dra'i thabs shes byed mkhan la go skabs rnyed kyi red/ gnyis nas phyi logs nas thabs shes byed mkhan de tsho'i gras la dpal 'byor gyi 'gro song gtong rgyu yod pa red/ de 'dra'i nus shugs gang la gang 'tshams slebs yong gi 'dug gang ltar nga rang sto ser skya mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i nang spyi sems thog la shugs nus bsgril thabs la nga rang tsho yang yang skad cha bshad/ yang yang go bsdur byas/ go bsdur byed pa'i skabs la phyi gsal nang gsal byas nas bshad rgyu de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga 597

tshor legs cha yod la/ skyon cha yang yod pa red/ legs cha bshad de sems shugs bskyed thabs byed dgos pa dang / skyon cha bshad de ma byung sngon 'gog gi thabs shes bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug bka' blon gyis 'grel bshad brgyab pa de tsho yag po byung song / de tsho khyed rang tshos gal chen por brtsis rbe sems la nges pa byed dgos/ da lta bka' blon gyis lab pa de'i snang la ngas dmigs bsal kha snon bshad dgos gang yang mi 'dug mdo don snying po nga tsho bod mi rnams gnad don mang po zhig dang 'brel nas btsan byol ba chags bsdad yod pa red/ snga mo lhang la rde sha'i btsag byol ba mang po byung ba red/ de dang 'dra ba yul lung mang por btsan byol ba yod na yang / de tsho'i gnas stangs dang nga tsho'i gnas stangs mi 'dra ba yin/ nga tsho btsan byol ba rnams so so'i lung pa'i nang la rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gnod pa byung ste yul gyar phyin pa ma red/ yang na so so'i lung pa'i nang la nga rang tsho lta ba ma mthun par nang 'khrug shor nas nga tsho tshur bros yong ba yang ma red/ nga rang tsho'i bod lung par rgya nag gzhung gis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i rjes la sa gnas sa thog la dngos su las ka byed stangs de bod pa'i goms gshis dang / bod pa'i bsam blo dang / bod pa'i re 'dun la rtsa ba nyid nas ma brtsis pa/ rgya mi rang gi rang shed kho na'i sgang nas srid byus bskyangs par brten bod par dka' ngal chen po 'phrad de bod mi btsan byol ba chags pra red/ de'i rkyen gyis las 'gan shin tu lci po zhig nga tsho'i sgang la slebs bsdad yod/ nga tsho btsan byol ba'i las 'gan rim pa gtso thob de bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa nyams med rgyun 'dzin 598

thub pa zhig byed dgos/ bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa rgyun 'dzin byed pa de phyogs gcig nas bod pa'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi rigs brgyud dang 'brel ba yod/gtso che shos nga rang tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung 'di dag dang / de rnams gang la bsten sa'i bod pa'i skad yig rnam pa zur gsal dang / 'bur thon yod pa 'di dag la thug bsdad yod pa red/ nga rang tsho lha/da mi btsan byol ba rnams rgya gar rgyal khab chen po 'di'i nang gi sa cha gang sa gang la bod pa kha gram ste sim phyin pa yin na/ bod pa'i rnam pa bzung 'dod yod na yang bzung thub kyi ma red/ dper na nga rang chos mthong gsal red/ blom r+bhe khul dang / ka li ka ta'i nang la mi thog kha shas phyin pa'i bod pa de 'dra yod/ ka rdor khul la nam rgyun yongs grags rgya gar khams pa zer ba de snga bod nas yong bsdad pa phyed ka bod pa yin pa'i bzo 'dra po/ phyed ka rgya gar yin pa'i bzo 'dra po /de 'dra mang po zhig yod pa red/ bod pa btsan byol ba rnams lnga bcu nga dgu'i lo la rgya gar nang sa gnas gang sa gang la kha gram/ rgya gar yul mi mnyam du 'dres nas phyin pa yin na 'phral sel gzhis chags kyi 'dzugs bskrun gsar pa byed mi dgos pa/ shing nags gcod bregs byed rgyus mtshon pa'i lo nas lo bstud dka' ngal 'di tsho byed mi dgos pa/ rgya gar dbus gzhung nas kyang mthun rkyen gang la gang 'tshams sprad na 'grigs 'gro ba zhig red/ yin na yang de 'dra byas na nga tsho'i rtsa don la ran gyi yod pa ma red/ de la brten nas bod mi btsan byol ba rnams sa cha zur ga la gcig gi thog la khe gtsang gzhis chags byas nas sdod thub pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces niha ru bzhugs pa'i 599

skabs la rgya gar dbus gzhung la zhus/ ne+e nus rgya gar mnga' sde yongs rdzogs la phyag bris gnang / de 'dra'i thog nas ma'i sor khul nas sa cha gang 'tshams gnang gtan 'khel ba red/ ma'i sor nang snyan grags chen po yod pa sku zhabs ni ja ling ka pa khong 1956 lo nas ngas ngo shes kyi yod/ mjug la sku zhabs ni ja ling ka pa mnga' sde'i gtso 'dzin gnang ba'i skabs la sngon ma lnga bcu nga drug nas ngo shes pa yin dus kho rang la sa cha 'di bod mir 'phrod po dang / yag po 'dug da dung sa ston gang 'tshams gnang rogs zhes bskyar du 'bod bskul zhus nas mtha' ma'i dus la nga tsho 'dir gzhis chags gsar rnying khag bsdoms yong dus sa rgya chen po 'di chags pa red/ mi 'bor gang la gang 'tshams 'phar/ gang ltar rgya gar nang bod mi gzhis chags khongs nas 'di che shos chags pa red/ nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba rnams rgya gar nang sdod stangs de bod pa rang gi grong sde 'dra po zhig chags thub na/ mdor na mi brgyud tshun chad gtsang ma bsdad thub pa dang / rang bzhin gyi khor yug de yang bod pa'i rnam pa yod pa zhig chags yong gi red/ bod pa'i rnam pa yod pa'i khor yug nang la skyes te 'tshar longs byed mkhan gyi mi thog gsar pa tsho yang rang shugs kyis bod pa'i dri ma 'jags bsdad mkhan zhig yong rgyu yin dus nga tshos gzhis chags byed stangs de gal chen po zhig la brtsis te/ bod pa'i gzhis chags zur gsal 'dzugs thabs la 'bad rtsol byas/ phyogs gcig gi gnas tshul 'di red/nga tsho btsan byol ba chags rjes las 'gan rim pa gnyis pa de lha khang 600

dang dgon pa bzhengs rgyu mayin par/ gal che shos shig sngon la slob gra 'dzugs rgyu gal chen po 'dug ces slob gra khag btsugs pa red/ skabs der thod nas rgya gar du slebs pa dge 'dun pa stong phrag lnga drug cig yod pa'i nang nas drag drug brgyab ste ris med dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgya tsam zhig ma 'ongs pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin skyong gi don du bslab pa slob gnyer yod pa'i chos sgar zhig rtsa 'dzugs thabs shes byas pa red/ yin na yang skabs der sbag sa'i sa cha der mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa/ sa cha khug skyog tsha ba che ba/ mkha' rlung zhan pa sogs kyi gnas stangs 'og la dge 'dun chig stong lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas ha lam phyed ka lhag tsam nad pa chags pa'i dka' ngal chen po byung /gang ltar yang snying skabs der nga tshos gzhis chags khag tsho'i nang la slob gra dang / gtan 'jags slob gra khag btsugs rgyu la shugs brgyab pa red/de'i rtsa don gang yin zer na/ nga tsho bod pa btsan byol ba rnams la dmigs bsal gyi las 'gan zhig mongad pa de dang 'brel nas nga sa 'char gzhi bkod/ go rim bsgrigs te lag len bkal ba red/ da cha 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam phyin pa'i ring la gzhi nas nga tshos phyi mig cig bltas payin na/ gzhis chags kyi sa cha 'di dag thog mar nags gseb/ glang chen sdod sa zhig yod pa red/ de 'dra'i nags tshal sa stong 'dir bod pa gnam gshis bsil sa nas 'byor bsdad mkhan gyi mi tshos thog mar shing nags gcod 'breg byed rgyu dang / shing rtsa bkog rgyu/ gsar sbol byed rgyu sogs ngaka' ngal chen po dang len byas pa'i 'og nas nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di dag btsugs 601

pa red/ nga rang tsho so i lag par gzhis sa'i sa cha slebs pa'i rjes la de'i nang rim pas rim pas sbag sa nas gdan sa gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i dge 'dun pa de tsho sgo rgyu dang / de bzhin gyi sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa'i chos se dgon se rim pas 'dzags rgyu'i go skabs zang ba red/ pad nor rin /rngapa/ ཿཿpa ri ri ri//sbo po che lta bu la cha bzhag na/ dang po 'dir chung chung 'ig ma gtogs med na yang / rin po ches gzhis chags 'di ga'i nang la nus shugs bsgril nas 'dzugs bskrun gnang ba la rjes su yi rangs yod/ gang ltar bad nor rin po ches sa cha 'di'i sgang la.u tshugs bskyon te bzhugs pa'i 'bras bur so so rang bdag gi gtsug lag khang dang / slob sbyong gi sde tshan khag yod pa 'di dag nga rang tsho btsan byol ba'i las 'gan chen po bsgrub pa'i cha shas shig dang /de'i nang gi don dag 'gangs chen zhig chags yod/ gang ltar da phan wi dag gi ring la nga tshor gang la gang 'tshams kyi grub 'bras thon bsdad yod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba gzhis chags byed pa 'di lnga bcu nga dgu dang / drug cu tham pa 'di d+ku skabs 'byor pa'i mi 'di dag gi 'gro stangs bzo thub tsam zhig gi don dag la gzhis chags byas pa ma red/ lnga bcu nga dgu'i zla ba bzhi pa'i nang nga tsho rgya gar la 'byor/ skabs der mi sa ma ri dang / sbag sa/ bal yul bcas nas slebs pa'i bod mi khri brgyad tsam zhig yod pa red/ de dus nga sto bod pa'i nang la bsam tshul 'dra min kha shas byung / 'ga' zhig gis bod pa rgya gar lho phyogs tsha ba'i dkyil la phyin na dka' ngal chen po yong gi red/ de las hi ma la ya'i ri brgyud bsil sa la bsdad na yag gi red zer 602

mkhan byung / yin na'ang / phyogs gcig nas sa bsil sar bod mi mang po mnyam sdod gzhis chags thub pa'i sa cha thob re med pa dang / gnyis nas nga rang cho nad mi rigs chags 'jig gi mtshams la slebs pa'i skabs 'dir sa cha tsha grang gi skad cha bshad rgyu bsdad yod pa ma red/ sngon la nga tsho rkang pa 'dzugs sa zhig dang / bod pa gang mang mnyam du rub nub byas nas sdod thub pa'i sa cha byung rogs byas na de gal che ba 'dug ces dang / sngon la rkang pa 'dzugs sa'i sa cha ma thob na sa bsil sar kha 'thor du bsdad na mi thog nas mi thog mjug mthud thub pa yong gi ma red ces skabs der nga tshos bsam blo de 'dra btang ba red/ nam rgyun rtag par bshad mus ltar/ nga tshos re ba bzang shos shig la rgyag dgos kyang gra sgrig byed stangs sdug shos shig gi sgang la bsam blo btang ste/ de dus nas nga tshos las ga'i go rim bsgrigs pa red/sdug shos zer ba de nga tsho btsan byol ba mi thog nas mi thog mi rabs nas mi rabs lo brgya phrag 'ga' shas bsdad dgos pa byung na yang bsdad thub pa zhig dang / lo brgya phrag gi ring la bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa zin thub pa zhig dmigs yul la bzhag ste 'char gzhi bting pa red/ dper na/ da ring tshogs 'du 'di'i nang la de snga gzhis chags thog mar tshugs pa'i skabs dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi rnams ha lam rdzogs tshar ba red/ 'dir gzhis chags thog mar tshugs pa'i skabs shing gcod bregs byed sa dang / sa cha khru slog rgyag sa la phyed ka ltad mo dang / phyed ka sems shugs kyi thog nas blta skor la phyin pa yin/ rmos glang de tshor ltad mo yang chen po 'dug de dus ngo shes pa de 603

'dra mang po yod/ snying rje/ grong gseb pa spro'o lags ha las pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis dka' las rgyag mkhan de 'drayod/ rjes su 'di khul slebs pa'i skabs la brtsad gcod byed kyi yod/ de dus spo bo gcig yod/ brgya dpon gcig yod/ mang che ba rdzogs tshar ba red/ snying rje/ nga rang yang lo drug cu'i nang la slebs te rgas yong gi 'dug la/ de snga 'dzugs bskrun byed mkhan mi rgan pa mang po rdzogs 'gro gi yod pa red/ da cha mi thog gsar pa gzhon skyes tsho rkang 'gan khur mkhan chags bsdad yod/ nga tshos gzhis chags zur gsal btsugs pa'i 'bras bu la da cha mi thog brjes 'gro gi yod na yang bod pa'i rnam pa mu mthud nas zin thub pa zhig chags bsdad yod/'dis nga tsho'i dmigs yul gcig 'grub yod/ khyed rang tsho mi thog gzhon pa rnams nas de snga nga tshos thog mar 'char gzhi bting pa'i skabs kyi bsam cho de ga rang mu mthud bzung ste/ nga tsho btsan byol pa'i las 'gan bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung / de dang 'brel ba'i bod pa'i skad yig bod pa'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa rgyun 'dzin thub mkhan gyi bod bsngag sngo nog byed kyiyin bsam pa'i 'du shes kyi thog nas sa cha 'di ga'i sgang la shugs rgyag rgyu de gal chen po red/ skabs der thog mar gzhis chags byed dus gathorwa 1 zhing las byas/de nas rum thag bzo gras mtshon pa'i bzo las tsag tsig gi las / rim pas 'phrul chas la brten nas lag shes mang tsam byed thub na bsam pa'i re ba brgyab pa red/ phyugs las kyi thog nas 'o ma thon skyed byung ba ma gtogs/ phyur ba dang / mar gyi thon skyed khungs 'khyol po ma byung ba red/604

gtso bo sa zhing sgang la shugs rgyag dgos dus zhing las 'phrul chas can la bsgyur rgyur shugs brgyab pa red/ de la dmigs yul rgyu mtshan gnyis yod/rgyu mtshan gcig ni so nam 'phrul las can la bsgyur thub na las chod che ba dang / thon 'bab che ba zhig yong rgyu dang / rgyu mtshan gnyis pa de ma 'ongs pa la shes yon ldan pa'i zhing pa bzo dgos/ skabs der dpung pa sa 'og la bcug nas las ka byed mkhan tsho slob sbyong med pa'i zhing pa rgas pa tsho red/ khong tsho'i rjes la yong mkhan mi thog gzhon pa tsho slob sbyong yod pa'i thog la zhing las byed mkhan zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces nga tshos dmigs yul de bzung ste zhing las 'phrul chas can du bsgyur rgyu'i thabs shes byas pa red/bar skabs kyi gnas tshul la zhib 'jug byas pa'i snang tshul la/ gzhis chags nang gi gzhon skyes slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams yod pa zhig yin na phyi logs la 'phur nas 'gro rtsis byed pa ma gtogs/ gzhis chags nang la sdod 'dod de tsam med mkhan dang / gnyis nas bar skabs a mi ri kur gzhis chags gang 'tshams 'gro rgyu'i go skabs yong dus gzhon skyes mang po zhigaya mi ri kur 'gro gi yin zer ba las/ nga tsho ༄1da pa btsan byol ba'i bsti gnas a ma de rgya gar nang la yod pa nga de'i nang la bsdad nas shugs rgyag gi yin zer mkhan nyung nyung chags kyi 'dug de la blo pham gyi 'dug tshang ma a mi ri kur 'gro thub thabs yod pa ma red/ gzhi rkang a mi ri shar phyin pa'i bod pa tsho yang lung pa gsar pa zhig gi nang la slebs du sa rim pas so 605

the'u3rngomis (1zhe shebisna 11sbe ༷) rags na ga 'dra bas 'dug rgya gar dang / bal yul nang sdod mkhan nam rgyun bod pa'i zhen khog dang / bod pa'i lta ba de tsam med mkhan de grasa.a mi ri gar slebs pa'i rjes la gzhi nas so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / mi rigs kyi 'du shes gsar pa zhig slebs te yag po lta 'dugayin na yang nga rang tsho bod mi btsan byol ba'i bsti gnasa.a ma rgya gar nang la chags bsdad yod pa 'dir shugs rgyag dgos kyi 'dug gnyis nas slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams thon pa yin na des so nam gyi las ka byed rgyu ha lam ma 'os pa'i bzo 'dra po byed pa de nor 'khrul red/ 'dzam gling yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa d+ku nang la tshad ma'i slob sbyong thon pa'i mi mang po yod pa tshos 'phrul 'khor bed spyod byas te so nam las ka byedakyi yod pa ma gtogs/ so nam gyi las ka shes yon med pas byed dgos pa zhig ma red/ bod mi yongs rdzogs shes yon can bzo dgos/ mi yongs rdzogs shes yon can chags pa'i rjes la so nam gyi las ka shes phro med pa zhig gis byed dgos byung na spyi tshoges 'di'i nang la so nam gyi las ka byed mi dgos pa red dam/ de yong shes kyi ma red pa/ slob sbyong thon pa'i rjes la gtso bo rgya gar nang gi gzhis chags sa cha 'di ga'i snang la shugs rgyag dgos/ shes yon yod pa'i lag rjes la rnam grangs mang i thog nas yar rgyas gtong ba dang / rnam grangs mang i thog nas dgos mkho sgrub thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/ shes yon byung ba'i mtshams la phyi la bon 'gro rgyu rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ 'di gnad 'gag chen po 'dug/06

da lta bka' blon gyis gsal bshad gnang ba bzhin/ rgya nag rang gi gnas stangs yang ha lam zla re bzhin du 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa red/ da lta rgya nag gung khran tang gi srid gzhung 'dis dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong thabs la shugs rgyag gi yod pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ gung khran tang gi srid gzhung la mi mang gi rgyab skyor yong ba'i dmigs yul zin gyi yod pa red/ rgya nag rang gi nang la mang ga na gnyer byed mkhan dang / gtam brjod rang dbang la don gnyer byed mkhan 'gog thabs med par mang du 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og nas rgya nag la 'gyur ba ma phyin par thabs med pa zhig red/ bod don jog la cha mtshon na/ da lta'i rgya nag gzhung gi srid byus 'dis rgya nag rgyal khab kyi mtshan mthong la gnod pa ma gtogs phan thogs rtsa ba nyid nas yod pa ma red/ 'dzam gling gi mi tshos rgya nag la yid ches dang / cha 'jogayong rgyur yang gnod kyi yod pa red/ des rkyen pas the wan dang zla bsgril gtong rgyu'i thog la'ang 'gal rkyen chen po chags kyi yod pa red/ de tsam du ma zad rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab khongs la zla bsgril zin pa'i tong kong la cha bzhag na/ da lta hong kong nang la yod pa'i mi mang po'i bsam blo'i nang la the tshom dang dngangs skrag 'og la bsdad yod pa ha cang gsal po red/ gang ltar yang snying bod pa'i gnas tshul 'dis rgya nag gi mthong dang cha 'jog la mtshan shas sdug shos shig chags bsdad yod pa red/ bod kyi nang la rgya nag gzhung gi bsgrub bya gtso tho de brtan ltings mthun bsgril gnyis po de yin pa red/ brtan lhings dang mthun bsgril yong ba la 607

sems kyi nang nas mo1sa pa dang yid ches thob dgos pa ma gtogs/ 'jigs snang gi 'og nas brtan snyings mthun bsgril yong mi thub/ mi'i sems la g.yo 'gul thebs pa la yid tshims nas gaskusgo 'gul thebs dgos pa las/ dbang yod bshad nas mi'i sems la 'gyur ba 'gro mi thub/ da lta rgya mi gung khran gyis mi'i lus la dbang yod bshad nas sgrig gcun thub kyi yod kyang / mi'i sems la dbang yod bshad nas sgrig gcun thub thabs med/ da lta gung khran tang gis gcig sdud ring lugs 'og nas thabs shes de byed kyi yod/ de ltar phyi dang nang gi gnas tshul gang la bltas pa yin na'ang rgya nag gzhung la 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi re da/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i bden mtha' yang gsal la nye ba red bsam gyi 'dug yin na yang nga rang tsho'i gra sgrig byed stangs de da gin lab pa bzhin/ mi thog nas mi thog 'gor na yang nga tshos thabs shes byed thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ dper na/ nga la cha bzhag na lo rgas yong gi yod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i skabs la lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi red/da lta lo sgang tshang rtsis pa yin na drug cu re bzhi yin pa red/ da dung ma 'ongs pa la lo bzhi bcu bsdad thub pa'i dbang du btang ba yin na/ drug cu re bzhi nas bdun cu don bzhi/ brgyad cu gya bzhi/ dgu bcu go bzhi/ brgya dang bzhi ha lam khag po red/ de ni 'dod ma 'dod kyi skad cha min par dngos yod gnas tshul red / mi thog rgan pa rdzogs 'gro gi red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che yang rdzogs 'gro gi red/ rdzogs pa'i dus tshod la slebs pa yin na yang / nga tsho bod mi rigs bsdad dgos pa red/ nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod 'di yang mi thog 608

gcig gi 'thab rtsod ma yin par/ mi rigs shig gi 'thab rtsod red/ dper na/ rgya gar rang dbang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i skabs la yang mi thog nas mi thog sbrel te rtsod gleng byas pa ltar/ nga rang sa kyang phugs rgyang ring po'i bsam blo btang nas gra sgrig byed dgos/ nga rang tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms bkra shis lo legs kyi nyi ma shar ba'i nyin mo de nga tshos 'dir 'dzugs bskrun byas pa 'di dag skor kha sa pad nor rin po che dang bka' mol byung / rgya gar ni sngar nas sangs rgyas kyi chos yod pa'i lung pa gcig red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang che ru 'gro gi yod pa dang /rgya gar nang la yang gang la gang 'tshams do snang byed mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ sngar bod pas 'dzugs bskrun 'di dag byas pa red ces dran gso thebs thub pa de 'dra'i ched du nga rang tshos 'dzugs bskrun byas pa 'di dag rgya gar gzhung dang / mi mang la phan pa byas te bzhag na phun sum tshogs pa red ma gtogs 'gal ba gang yang mi 'dug nga rang tsho'i bsam khra'i nang la mgyogs po rang gcig yong / mgyogs po rang gcig yong bsam nas 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyu'i thog la 'thus shor phyin pa yin na zla ba gcig gyong phog yo gcig gyong phog yo lnga dang / lo bcu grong phog nas 'thus shor 'gro gi 'dug nga tsho gzhis chags kha shasanang la shing sna 'debs 'dzugs byed rgyu sogs de 'dra'i rigs kha shas 'bras bu son par lo bcu bco lnga 'gor gyi red/ gangayong bsam nas phyi bshol le lo byas te 'thus shor yong gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug nga tshos 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyu'i thog la da gin lab pa bzhin/ mi jog nas mi 609

thog bsdad dgos byung na yang yar rgyas ldan pa/ gzi brjid ldan pa/ tshags tshud po zhig gi thog nas bsdad thub pa'i bsam blo btang nas 'bad rtsol byed dgos kyi 'dugaslob sbyong thog la da gin bka' blon gyis gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ngas dmigs bsal kha ston bshad dgos gang yang mi 'dug tshang mas slob sbyong thog la hur bskyed byed dgos/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i pha ma slob sbyong de tsam byed mi myong ba zhig gi phru gus skad yig gang 'tshams shes/ yi ge bris klog shes pa byung na slob sbyong yag po yod bsam pa de 'dra dran srid kyi red/ de 'dra bsam na mi 'grigs/ nga tsho'i bod phrug tshos gzhi rim slob sbyong thogadamigs bsal rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi slob sbyong tshad mtho por slebs dgos pa de gal chen po red/ spyi tshogs nang logs la phan thogs byed thub pa dang / ma 'ongs par bod la nga tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i mtshams la las rigs mang wa'i nang la sa phyod chen po'i zhabs 'degs sgrub thub pa yong ba la rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi slob sbyong nges par du dgos pa red/ slob sbyong spyir btang tsam gyis de 'dra'i rlabs chen po'i zhabs 'degs sgrub thub rgyu khag po red/ de ltar na rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi slob sbyong thog la shugs rgyag rgyu gal chen 11 red/de nas ngas 'dir lab 'dod yod pa zhig la/ nga rang tsho bod kyi rig gzhung ya rabs bzang wa'i spyod pa zhes pa 'di ni rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'brel ba yod pa red/ tshang mas las rgyu 'bras zer ba'i skad cha bshad kyi 610

yod na yang / de tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i nus pa ldang gi ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa la 〈be sbyong byed dgos/ slob sbyong byas pa de lag len bkal nas nyams len byas te mang du thos pa'i lung gi yon tan yod pa dang / tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan yod pa de 'dra zhig gi steng nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos/ 'di byed mkhan ni gra sa khag dang / ris med chos snar khag nang slob sbyong byed mkhan 'di dag yin/ khong chos bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung gting zab 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ngoms rgyu yod pa'i gzhung lugs rnams la lo bco lnga nyi shu slob sbyong byas te bstan pa'i rtsa ba zin gyi yod pa red/ yin na yang thabs skyo ba zhig la rākha gnyer byed sa'i bsti gnas khag nang lo nas lo rtsel slob sbyong byed mkhan gras la mi tshang drag pa'i phru gu btang gi yod pa ma red/ deng sang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / bkra shis lhun po/ da lta 'dir rnying ma'i chos sgar/ pad nor rin po che'i dgon pa sogs slob gnyer yod pa de tsho'i nang la slob gnyer byed mkhan phal mo che bod nas gsar 'byor dang / yang na la dwags khul nas yong ba/ 'brug dang / 'bras ljongs khul nas yong ba bcas kyis phon chen po byung ba ma gtogs/ rngo rang tsho gzhis chags rang gi nang nas slob sbyong mthar bskyal nas thon mkhan kha shas tsam las shin tu nyu nga nyung red/mig tos deyag po mi 'dug nga rang bo da mi'i slob phrug tshang ma gra pa byed dgos pa ma red/ da lta'i char bod mi nyung na mi 'grigs pas bod mi mang 61 1

tsam byas na yag gi red/ yin na yang slob phrug tsho'i nang chos kyi bag chags yod pa/ chos dad kyi thog la do snang yod pa de 'dra tan tan yong mdog kha po red/ 'di tsho'i rigs la chung chung skabs nas lam ston byas/ chos kyi bag chags phran bu yod bsdad pa de ma nyams pa'i thog nas ga le ga ler ris med chos sgar tsho'i nang la zhugs/ chos kyi slob sbyong mtha' bskyal nas slob sbyong thon thub pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug nga rang ཿ'i bu gso khang yas mas dang /slob gra khag nang la yod mkhan gyi phru gu tshos slob gra'i nang la slob sbyong byas phyin/ gdan sa khag dang / ris med chos sgar khag nang 'dzul nas chos kyi bslab pa slob gnyer byas na mi 'grigs pa lta bu gang yang ma red/ gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong yod pa'i thog la khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste bshad gra chen po tsho'i nang la bslab pa slob gnyer byed thub pa byung na shin tu yag po yong gi red/ 'di yang khyed rang tshor khral 'gel byas nas gra 'phyag rgyab pa'i bzo 'dra po gang yang ma red/ khyed rang tshos mos pa yod pa de 'dra yod na mos pa de ma brlag par/ de dang mthun pa'i lam ston byed rgyu de gal chen po red bsam gyi 'dug 'di gcig bshad snying 'dod song / gzhan dmigs bsal zhu yag mi 'duganam rgyun rtag par ngas bshad mus ltar/ btsan byol gzhung zhig yod pa 'dir yas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug mas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pa red/ yag po zhig bsam blo btang na bshad sa zhig yod pa de drin chen po red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs khyon nas med na/ da lta 'dir khyed rang tsho 612

gzhis sgar spyi yongs kyi thog dka' ngal zhig 'phrad pa yin na dzña ram sa lar zhus zer gyi yod pa red/ sngon la don dag yong gi yod rung med rung bshad sa zhig yod bsam nas blo bzhag sa zhig 'dug gam/ nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gang yang med na gzhis sgar 'di tshugs thub kyi ma red la/ tshugs nasayod bsdad pa 'dir dka' ngal zhig 'phrad song na/ yang na ldi li la phyin te rgya gar gzhung gi 'brel yod las khungs so sor gcig zhu rgyu red/ yang na thong lor la phyin nas mnga' sde'i gzhung la zhu rgyu red/ sgrig 'dzugs byas nas lta rtogs byed mkhan zhig med na dka' ngal red/ de bzhin gzhis chags so so'i nang la yang spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig dang / don gcod/ bde don bcas yod payin dus bshad sa zhig yod/ bshad sa med pa las bshad sa yod pa de yag gi red/ nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa yin dus bod mi rgya gar nang la yod pa lta ci smos te/ a mi ri kur yod bsdad mkhan/yo rob/ nyi hong / o se ṭi li ya/ u ru su dang / sog po phyi nang gang sa gang la 'brel ba mthud thub kyisku1da pa red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gong bu'i nus pa zhig med na/ ma'i sor khul 'dir bod mi khri re zung yod pa'i nus pa'i jog nas 'dzam bu gling gang sa gang la bod pa yod sa tshang mar 'brel ba bya rgyu khag po red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa'i dbang gis bod mi sdod sa mal le stong phrag mang pos chod pa yin na'ang / bod pa tshang mar phan tshun 'brel ba mthud de bod gangs can pa gcig gyur la tshang ma bsdad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di gnad 'gag 613

shin tu chen po chags kyi yod pa red/spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i nang la las ka byed mkhan mi bye brag pa nas 'thus sgo ma tshang ba tan tan yong gi red/ de yong ba'i skabs la gzhis 'go so so'i jog nas ma 'grigs pa yod na'ang rung / dzña ram sa la'i las khungs tsho'i nang las byed 'brel yod tshos ma 'grigs pa yod na'ang rung / ming smos byas te ther 'don gsal po byed dgos/ las byed pa 'di yis nor 'khrul 'di 'dra zhig byas song / mi mang gi thog la brdabs gsigs 'di 'dra zhig btang song / snyog brngan 'di 'dra zhig zas song / byed thub pa'i las ka ma byas par 'thus shor 'di 'dra phyin song zhes gsal po byas te/ yin gcig min gcig lab dgos/ 'go bka' blon gyi thog nas ma 'grigs pa byung ba yin na'ang rung / sus ma 'grigs pa byung rung / ma 'grigs pa de gsal po byas nas shod dgos/ do bdag so so'i thog nas gsal bshad dag 'bud byed rgyu yod pa yin na gsal bshad byed kyi red/ gsal bshad byas pa'i mtshams la tshang ma ༄ ༄dugs sangs 'gro gi red/ gsal bshad byung ba yin na dkrog gtam bshad gzhi med pa chags kyi red/ yang gsal bshad byed rgyu med pa dang / ca dngag nor 'khrul byas pa zhig yin na/ do bdag so i ngos nas dgongs dag ces lab nas dag gi yod na ni dgongs dag ces lab dgos/ dgongs dag ces lab nas dag yag med pa zhig yin na ni gnas dbyung gtong dgos kyis yod/ gnas rim phab dgos kyi e yod/ phogs bcag dgos kyi' yod/ mtha' ma gzhung zhabs gral nas phud dgos kyis 614

yod/ byed rgyu red ma gtogs thabs shes gang yang bsdad yod pa ma red/ mi sgor gyis ma 'grigs pa byung ba la 'dzems zon byas te/ bod gzhung gis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces zer ba de nor 'khrul red/ bod gzhung gis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug zer ba 'dir 'dzems bag byed dgos/ mi sgor pa zhig gis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug na'ang 'dra/ bla ma gcig gis ma 'grigs pa yod na'ang 'dra/ mkhan po gcig gis ma 'grigs pa yod na'ang 'dra/ las byed pa su dang su zhig gis ma 'grigs pa yod na'ang ming smos byas te/ 'dis 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces 'dzems zon ma byas par gsal po lab na yag po 'dug de gnad 'gag gcig chags kyi 'dug gal srid 'brel sku(da las khungs shig la lab nas bdag po rgyag gi mi 'dug na nga tshor khrims khang yod pa red/khrims zhib khang la kha mchu btsugs na 'grigs/ dacadas gnas rang rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas ma 'os/ ma drang pa zhig byung yod na kha mchu brgyab nas bden pa bden sar 'khyol ba nges par du byed dgos/ shes song ngam de gnad 'gag chen po 'dugagra btsun gyi spyod lam skor la/ lus la gra chas gyon bsdad mkhan/ spyod lam de khyim pa bsun 'byin byed mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dug na sngon ma dha ram sa lar yang lab rgyu byung / hun sur la'ang sngon ma lab pa yin/ gzhis 'go bde don dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu tshogs pa khyed rang tshor sa gnas so so so sor sgrig 'dzugs yod pa red/ khyed rang tshos gra pa khyad mtshar gang byung ma byung byed mkhan de 'dra 'dug na gra pa der lam seng khyed rang chos sgar 615

gang nas yin nam dris te/ chos sgar gang nas yin pa der phar rtsis sprad/chos sgar de'i las byed tshor 'dis 'di 'dra byed kyi 'dug 'dis sangs rgyas kyi na bza' bzhes te mtshan shas bzo gi 'dug ces rtsis sprod byas na yag po 'dug deng sang skya min ser min/ khungs 'di yin med bsdad mkhan/ rtags cha lugs phyed ka gra pa yin pa'i bzo 'dra po/ phyed ka skya bo yin pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra'i thog nas zhabs 'dren zhus/ zhabs 'dren zhus pa'i mtshan shas de dge 'dun spyi la yong gi yod pa 'di yag po mi 'dug de rigs la tshang mas do snang byed dgos kyi 'dugade nas dmigs bsal 'os bsdu'i skor la nga tsho ga le ga ler 'os bsdu ran pa yin dus de'i thog la mi mang gis do snang byed dgos pa'i skor gsal bshad yag po byung song / de gnad 'gag chen po 'dugad lta 'dir rgya gar gyi dge rgan tsho la dmigs bsal gyi 'tshams 'dri yod/ ngas nam rgyun rtag par bshad kyi yod/ bod mi btsan byol ba yod sa la khyed rang tsho rgya gar dge rgan las byed pa tsho yang gnas skabs shig btsan byol ba'i gras la mnyam du bsdad nas so so'i mi tshe'i dus tshod yag shos de bod mi btsan byol ba'i slob gra'i nang la bskyal gyi yod pa red/ khyed rang cho tshang ma bka' drin chen po yin zhes ngas rtag par bshad kyi yod/ bka' drin chen po yin pas khyed rang tsho la thugs rje che zer gyi yin/ rgya gar dge rgan 'ga' shas da cha rgas sku(la la phyin pa dang / 'ga' shas 'das zin pa tan tan yod pa red/ de tsho tshang mar nga tshos bka' drin rjes dran byed dgos pa red/ 616

rgya gar gzhung gi paṇ+ḍi ta niha ru bzhugs pa'i skabs la bod pa'i slob gra zur du btsugs pa'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang dmigs yul nges pa can yod pa 'di nges par du shes dgos/ de shes pa'i thoganas thod pa'i slob gra 'di dag dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul zhig chags yod bsam pa'i ngos 'dzin yode pa'i thoganas hur thag byed rogs zhes zhu rgyu yin/ wade pa'i phru gu tshang ma la slob sbyong dgos kyi yod ces nga tshos rgya gar gzhung la rtag par zhu gi yod pa red/ rgya garayul pa'i phru gu sa ya mang po zhig la mthun rkyen med pa'i dka' ngal de 'dra zhig yod pa'i thog la bod pa'i phru gu tshor slob sbyong dmigs bsal dgos kyi yod ces zhu rgyu de dngos gnas zhu ma 'os pa lta bu/ sems nang la 'tsher snang yong gi 'dug ste/ nga tsho'i bod mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsa med shul med 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa dang / bod dang rgya gar sa 'dres chags bsdad yod/gnyis nas bod kyi rig gzhung 'di rgya gar na sa byung ba'i rig gzhung red/ ji tsam bod mi'i rnam pa de ma yal ba zhig dang / bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi bsam cho de ji tsam gnas pa de srid du rgya gar gyi srung skyob chags bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra'i 'phral phugs mang po'i gnad 'gag chen po yod pa yin dus/ rgya gar gyi dge rgan tshos da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yang hur thag byed rogs zhu rgyu yin/ khyed rang tsho'i bka' drin nam yang brjed mi yong / thugs rje che zer zhu rgyu yin/deng sang dus tshod 'gro gin 'gro shin la bod rigs dge rgan mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ ngas go thos la khyed rang sto mang po zhig yag po yod pa'i 617

skad cha 'dug re zung re zung de tsam gyi sems khur med bsdad mkhan/ nyin ma gang 'khyol byed mkhan de 'dra yang yong srid pa red/ de 'dra kha shas yod sa red/ de cho'i gras kyis gzab gzab byas nas bsam blo gtong rogs byed/gang ltar nga rang tsho'i phru gu 'di rnams shin tu gal chen po chags bsdad yod/slob sbyong zer ba 'di nyin re nyin re'i 'dzin gra tshogs/ de nas rgyugs sprod byed pa'i skabs la rgyugs 'phrod tsam byung ba zhig gi 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ phru gu'i bsam blo'i nang la slob tshan gang dang gang yin pa de'i gnad don sems nang 'jags pa zhig dang / sems nang 'jags nas mi tshe bskyel ba'i skabs la phan thogs yod pa zhig dgos pa red ma gtogs/ 'phral sel le gang 'grigs la phyin pa yin na 'grigs kyi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus khyed rang dge rgan tshos hur thag 'bad thag byed rogs zhes dmigs bsal zhu rgyu yin/de nas da lta bod mi btsan byol ba'i nang la gzhon nu'i sgrig 'dzugs shig dang / bud med kyi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ da lta phan chad la sgrig 'dzugs de gnyis pos phyogs mang po zhig gi nang la hur thag byas/ byas rjes gang la gang 'tshams thon te yag po byung / sa gnas 'di ga'i sgog la yang khyed rang tsho gzhon nu'i sgrig 'dzugs dang / bud med kyi sgrig 'dzugs jog nas skabs su babs pa'i las rigs mang po'i thog la khyed rang tshos do snang dang sems khur byas/ yag po byung 'dug bsngags brjod yod/ da dung yin na'ang bzang po'i las ka gang dang gang yin kyang yar rgyas 'gro rgyur 618

mtha' med pa zhig red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la bya ba mang po zhig la 'go btsugs pa'i skabs la rdzig po zhig byas/ de nas lo gcig song / gnyis song / lo bcu song / bco lnga nyi shu phyin pa'i skabs la kho 'char can lta bu zhig la phyin te/ de tsam gyi nus pa thon rgyu dang / de tsam gyi dang dod med mkhan zhig yong gi 'dug bag chags sam/ mig tos ngan pa zhig yong gi 'dug de 'dra la ma song bar mu mthud nas dang po'i dmigs yul ji ltar yod pa nang bzhin mtha' bskyal nas mjug skyong byed rgyu gal chen po red /de nas 'phrod bsten gyi las ka byed mkhan phyi lugs kyi sman pa tsho dang /bod lugs kyi sman pa tsho nas nga tsho sa cha chen po 'di'i sgang la bod mi phon chen po zhig bsdad yod pa 'di dag gi 'phrod bsten gyi thog la rgyun du sems khur chen po blangs te slob ston yag po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho rwaped pa'i gshis ka la dza drag ma byung na mgo na ba'i bzo 'dra po'i rigs snang med lus te 'thus shor 'gro gi yod/ nam rgyun rtag par ngas bshad mus ltar/ spyir btang shod rgyun la mgo na gi 'dug lab na pag rgyag tshad zo/ nyal sdod zer ba de 'dra byas na ltod yangs la 'gro gi 'dug de 'dra nam yang byed mi rung / phran bu'i ma bde ba byung ma thag lam senga.em rje bsten te bcos thabs byed thub na/ na tsha chung dus bcos thabs byed las sla ba red/ de min na tsha thog mar yong ba'i skabs la a'u tsam min nam bsam nas ltod yangs byas/ na tsha gzhi lci po chags zin pa'i skabs la phyi lugs kyi sman pa bsten na'ang bcos 619

thabs med pa/ bod pa'i sman pa bsten na'ang bcos thabs med pa chags tshar na las ka tshang ma bakhro nyes dras thal la phyin tshar dus shin tu phangs po red/ bla ma de 'dra'i sar skyabs 'jug zhu gi yod pa red de bla mas gnang thub rgyu khag po red/ dang po nas na tsha sngon 'gog byed rgyu'i thog la tshang mas gzab gzab byed kyi yin na na tsha ma yong ba dang / na tsha byung ba yin na'ang gzhi ljid po ma yong bar phan gyi red/ de tshor tshang mas do snang byed rogs zhes zer rgyu yin/da khyed rang tsho nyi mas 'tshig dka' las khag yod pa red/ bkra shis bde legs/ thugs rje che// zhes 455// //620

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 10 tshes 4 nyin hun sur rab rgyas gling rgyud smad gra tshang du ser skya mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'di gar byang rtse chos rje rin po che dang / mkhan po las zur/bla sprul dge bshes grwa mang khyon chen po zhig phebs yod pa dang / de min gzhis chags kyi slob phrug tsho dang / ser skya mi mang spyi byings/ gzhis 'go dang /las ka byed mkhan tsho bcas 'dzoms pa'i sa 'dir dmigs bsal mang po zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug sngon ma nas mang po zhus yod/ spyir btang bshad pa yin na mi phal che bas gnas tshul shes kyi yod pa red/ shes pa 'di lag len bkal dang ma bkal gyi gnas tshul ma gtogs/ spyi yongs kyi 'gro stangs phal che bas shes kyi yod tsang mang po zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug de snga mi sa ma ri dang / sbag sar slebs thub ma song / de min rgya gar byang rgyud cam pa/ ku lu khul la lam bzo byed sa'i sa gnas khag dang / gzhis chags khag tshugs yul/ slob gra khag bcas la do gal chen po brtsis te thengs mang po phyin pa yin/ skabs der mi mang tsho dngos gnas 'joms bsdad pa'i skabs red/ltos sa ltos 'jog gi ngos rang gte po'i dkyil gyi gzugs bzang yin pa'i khul gyi skad cha mang po bshad yod/ tshang mas sems shugs bskyed de hur thag byas pa red/ 'di'i le'u de rdzogs pa lta bu yin/da lta bka' blon gyis bshad pa'i gnas tshul ltar/ nga rang tsho skad cha gang bshad nayang drang po drang bzhag phyi gsal nang ga sal byas te bshad na yag po red/ 'dra chags po byas te/ las bsdoms dang tshogs 'du'i skabs 621

su yag yag sha stag bshad/ skyon cha yod pa de tsho mngon gsal med par sbas te bzhag na snying po gang yang med/ da lta 'dir bka' blon gyis gnas tshul mang po bshad pa'i nang legs pa'i cha yang yod/ yang phran bu'i skyon cha dang /yang nyen kha yong srid pa'i gnas tshul de tsho'i gras gsal bshad yag po byung song / ngas kha ston byed dgos pa yang mi 'dug nga tshos 'dzam bu gling gi lung pa khag dang / rgyal khab khag spyi tshogs gang dang gang la bltas pa yin na'ang / shes yon tshad longs pa dang / shes yon gyi thog nas thabs thes byed thub pa/ nam 'phangs bcad thub mkhan gyi mi yod sa'i lung pa rnams yar rgyas che ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi bya ba tshags tshud pa yod/ shes yon gyi thog la de tsam do snang mi byed pa'i lung pa rnams gnas stangs skyo ba chags bsdad yod/ nga rang tsho bod rang la cha bzhag na yang / nga rang sbyor da lta rkyen ngan thabs sdug 'di 'dra zhig yong ba 'di phyogs gcig nas nga rang tsho'i sngon bsags las kyi 'bras bu red/ yin na'ang de'i 'phral rkyen gyi nang la nga rang cho༄ bad pa rang nyid kyi sgod yangs/ 'thus shor/ mgo ma 'tshos mthong rgya thos rgya chung drags pa/ shes bya yon tan gyis ma ldang par 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi gnas tshul rtogs ma thub pa dang / 'brel ba byed ma thub pa'i thog nas 'thus shor phyin pa ha cang gsal po red/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigs 'tsho thub pa dang / btsan byol ba'i mi rigs 'tsho thub pa'i rtsa don gcig shes yon la thug yod par brten/ nga tshos phyi lo 1960 nang dang 1970nang la slob gra tshugs e thub kyi re ba brgyab nas 'bad brtson byas pa/ da 622

cha de'i rim pa brgal nas slob sbyong spas dag po yong rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos/bod pa'i pha ma de tsam gyi slob sbyong sdud pa tshos phru gus yi ge 'bri klog shes pa tsam dang / phyi rgyal gyi skad yig 'bri klog 'pher tsam byung na phru gur shes yon yod snyam pa'i bsam tshul yong srid pa red/ 'di ma red/ dper na nga rang tsho bod pa la cha bzhag na'ang / bod yig 'bri klog shes pa tsam gyis bod pa'i shes yon yod pa la cha bzhag gi ma red/ de bzhin du deng dus kyi shes yon yang tshad longs pa zhig yod dgos/ so sos ma thub na de ga red ma gtogs/thub na rigs gcig rkang 'dzin thon thub pa byed rgyu 'di gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho btsan byol ba'i nang la yang phan thogs chen po yong gi red la/ ma 'ongs pa la gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i mtshams la yang phan jogs chen po yong gi red/ de bzhin phyi rgyal khag la 'gro mkhan tsho yang shes yon yag po med na dka' ngal chen pospend/ ma gzhi deng sang rgya gar gzhis chags kyis yid ma tshims par/ a mi ri kur 'gro gi yin zhes shor shor byed kyi yod/ bod pa rdzun ma de 'dra yang thon yong gi yod pa red/ ma gzhis mi ri shar slebs tshar ba kha shas yag po 'dug rgya gar dang bal yul nang sdod pa'i skabs la de tsam gyi sems shugs dang / mi rigs kyi lta ba med mkhan zhig phyi rgyal du slebs rjes gzhi nas so so'i mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / sems shugs shig slebs kyi 'dug yin na'ang rgya gar la yod pa'i bod mi 'di dag nga tsho rtsa ba'i rten gzhi chags bsdad yod/ rtsa ba 'di yag po zin rgyur nga tsho tshang mas 'gan 'khyer dgos pa ma gtogs/ 'di 'phral sel lta bu dang /623

'di las lhag sa gcig la 'phur rgyu byung na 'phur chog chog byas nas bsdad payin na nor 'khrul red/ nga tshor slob grwa thon thub pa mang po yod kyang rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi thog nas nus pa thon thub mkhan nyung nyung red/ rgya gar nang la las /a'o tsam byed mkhan de tsho yang phyi rgyal du za khang gi g.yog rgyugs nas sdod kyi yod/ gang ltar spyi tshogs de tsho'i nang la so so rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi gnas tshad medan las ka bzang ba thob ma thub pa de 'dra'i dka' ngal 'dug phyogs gang du bltas na yang shes yon tshad mtho wa zhig dang / rang skya 'pher ba dgos pa 'di shin tu gal chen po 'dugade nas da gin bka' blon gyis lab pa bzhin/ nga rang tsho ༄1da pa rang nyid kyi nang nas bod kyi chos 'byung / rgyal rabs la sogs par slob sbyong dang /nyams zhib byed dgos/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi nang la legs cha yod la skyon cha yang yod/ de tsho'i gras la deng dus kyi dpyad pa byed stangs nang bzhin blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas nyams zhib byed dgos/ da phan phyi rgyal gyi mi'i nang nas bod pa'i gnas tshul la nyams zhib byed mkhanayong gi yod kyang / nga cho gengad pa'i nang nas nyams zhib byed mkhan mi 'dug 'di gras nges par du dgos kyi 'dug phyi rgyal du bod pa tsho la yang lab kyi yod/ khyed rang tsho'i phru gu mtho rim slob grwa gang la gang 'tshams thon pa de tsho'i gras rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi mkhas pa'i slob sbyong byed thub pa byung na yag po red/ so so rang sa nas mthun rkyen sgrub thub kyi med na yang thabs shes byed rgyu yod 'gro zhes 'bod skul byed kyi yod la/ rgya gar nang la yin na'ang de de bzhin byed rgyu 624

gal chen po 'dugaslob sbyong yod pa yin na'ang rtsa ba'i mi'i lhag bsam gyis rgyab 'khyogs pa zhig ma byung na mi 'grigs/ slob sbyong phran bu yod pa'i rkyen gyis bsam rgyu dran rgyu mang po zhig chags/ re ba mang po zhig slebs/ re ba tshang ma 'grub ma thub/ re dogs kyi rnam rtog lu gu brgyud byas pa'i 'bras bu la so so skyid pa gang yang med mkhan/ spyi tshogs la yang phan thogs med pa byung na snying po gang yang med/ shes bya yon tan yod pa des spyi la yin na'ang phan jogs yod pa gcig dang / sgor so so la yin na yang phan thogs yod pa zhig yong ba la lhag bsam yod dgos/ lhag bsam zer ba 'di ya rabs spyod bzang gi don dag red/ nga tshos byis pa chung chung 'gro sa'i 'dzin gra nas bzung ste 'dzin gra rim pa'i nang la slob sbyong sprod pa 'di bde skyid kyi don la sprod kyi yod pa red/ bde skyid zer ba de nga tsho'i thob thang red/ bde skyid yong ba'i rtsa ba ni sems zhi zhing dul ba yin/ sems ma zhi na bde skyid yong thabs med/ skye ba snga phyi dang / las rgyu 'bras rnams khas blangs rung ma blangs rung / gang ltar mi tshe skyid po yong ba la sems pa bzang po byed dgos pa 'di ra sprod 'pher ba yin/ 'dzam bu gling spyi dang nga rang tsho'i khyim mtshes phan tshun gang la bltas na yang ra sprod gtong thub pa zhig red/ mi'i mi tsher dgos mkho bde skyid red/bde skyid yong ba'i rtsa ba sems bzang po byed dgos/ sems bzang po byung ba yin na mi tshe don dang ldan pa byung ba red/ sems pa ma rung khog bcug gi mi la bde skyidayong thabs khyon nas med/ khyim tshang nang layin na'ang skyid 625

pa yod ma red/ pha ma sems pa nag po yod pa'i khyim tshang nang la skyes pa'i phru gu yang bsod nams dman pa/ ga dus yin na'ang sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / ga dus yin na yang ma skyid pa byas nas bsdad dgos pa chags kyi red/ de 'dra'i mi sems pa nag po yod mkhan gyi khyim tshang gang du yod sa'i grong sde de yang skyid pa yong gi ma red/ rgya gar rgyal khab chen po 'dir de sngon lhan rdi lta bu dngos gnas drang gnas kyi mi rnam dpyod can/ snying stobs can/gzhan phan lhag bsam can de 'dra mang po thon pa'i lung pa yin yang / deng sang chab srid kyi las ka byed mkhan mi bzang po 'ga' zhig yod kyang / mang po zhig lhag bsam gyis ma ldang par yul nang dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod/ rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / sa gnas gzhung so so nas 'gro song shin tu chen po gtong gi yod kyang / mi mang ྅ rwa/ rnams ni da dung skyo dze byas nas bsdad 'dugade'i rtsa ba ga res lan pa red zer na lhag bsam gyis lan pa red/ lhag bsam gyis phyug pa zhig ma byung na/ mi che'i nang la skyid pa zhig dang / gra 'grigs pa zhig mi yong ba brgya cha brgya tham pa thag chod pa red/ chos khas blangs rung ma blangs rung / mi tshe skyid pa zhig yong ba la mi lhag bsam bzang po zhig byed dgos zer ba'i bslab bya 'di phru gu'i rgyud la nges shes 'drongs pa bzo rgyu gal chen po red/ bslab bya byed mkhan dge rgan gyi kha nas byams brtse byed dgos/bzod pa byed dgos bshad na yang / so so'i rnam 'gyur de dang mthun pa med na phru gus yid ches byed kyi ma red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis don spyod pa dang /don mthun pa zhes gsungs yod pa ltar/ dge rgan so sos kyang 'dzin gra'i 626

nang la phru gu de'i mi che'i mdun lam gyi las 'gan yod bsam pa'i thog nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis sems khur blangs nas slob khrid byed pa dang chabs cig phru gu tshor lhag bsam gal chen po yin pa dang / gzhan phan gyi bsam pa gal chen po yin pa ngo sprod byas na/ phru gu'i bsam khra'i nang rgan lags kyis byed stangs de'i thog nas bslab bya byed pa 'di dngos gnas red bsam pa'i sems la yid ches dang / de la don gnyer slebs rgyu zhig yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus dge rgan tsho shin tu gal chen po red/ deng sang slob grwa'i dge rgan bod rigs mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ bod rigs dge rgan tshos rang don rang gces kyis khur chen po len dgos/ bod pa'i dge rgan re zung thebs chag de 'dra 'dug ces go gi 'dug gzab gzab byas na ma gtogs/ phogs rang bsam bsdad pa ma gtogs/ sems khur blangs nas phru gu'i don dag la slob khrid byed rgyu de tsho'i gras 'phral sel nyin ma gang 'khyol byas na yag po ma red/ rgya gar dge rgan tsho la cha bzhag na/ re zung re zung ni thebs chag de 'dra yong gi yod pa red/ spyi byings de tsho ni 'das pa'i lo yun de dag gi ring la bod mi btsan byol ba yod sar bsdad nas bod phrug gi shes yon thog la zhabs 'degs hur thag sgrub yod/ ha cang bka' drin chen po red/ rgya gar dge rgan mang po zhig 'das grongs phyin tshar ba red/ gang ltar khyed rang tsho nas da lta bar du byas rjes nges can bzhag yod pas/ da res go skabs zin nas ngas khyod rang tsho la thugs rjeche zhu gi yod la/ da dung ma 'ongs pa la yang tshang mas hur skyed byed rogs zer rgyu yin/bod pa'i dge rgan tsho nas 627

rang don rang gces kyi bsam blo gtong dgos/ de nas pha ma tshos kyang so so'i phru gu tshor zhen skul byed rgyu dang / rang sbyong gi go skabs sprod rgyur pha ma chos khur mnyam len byed rgyu gnad 'gag chen po 'dugadage 'dun pa tsho spyisku1ngas ni ha cang yag po red/ yin na'ang zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan de 'dra kha shas kha shas yong gi yod pa red/ kha seng lugs bsam gzhis chags la lus la grwa chas gyon nas rnam 'gyur ma mdzes pa byed mkhan de 'dra 'dug na gzhis 'go dang / brgya dpon/ bcu dpon/ spyir btang mi mang zhig yin na yang de la khyed rang ga nas yin pa zhes skad cha dris/gra sa gra tshang 'di yin zer gyi 'dug na/ der rtsis sprod byed dgos/ 'dis 'di 'dra byed kyi 'dug ces lab na yag po 'dug dha ram sa lar yang de 'dra byas na yag po 'dug ces skad cha byung / gra sa gra tshang so so dang / mkhan po tsho dang / dge bsgos tshos lab kyi yod na yang / gdan sa'i gling grol tshar dus 'khrab mkhan de 'dra yong dus mi mang rang gis khur mnyam len byas te lam seng brda spyor byas na gnad 'gag 'dug gang ltar dge 'dun pa rnams spas dag po dgos pa 'di shin tu gal chen po 'dug gzhi rkang hur brtson sdun pos slob gnyer byed stangs sogs ha las payag wa 3da/ phyin chad mthud ka rgyag stangs 'di la nga tshos bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / der nyams zhib byed mkhan byung na yag po med dam bsam gyi 'dugad shin spyi 'thus kyi skor la bka' blon gyis 'grel bshad rgyab song /de gnad 'gag cig chags kyi 'dug rtsa ba spyi 'thus nang dang / gang dang gang 628

nas yin kyang bod gzhung gis ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i skyon cha lhags pa rtsal 'don byas te bshad pa 'di ha cang gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho rgya gar nang la rtsa ba mang gtso'i lam la 'gro gi yod pa dang / mang gtso'i ka ba gsum zhes pa cha tshang nga tshos lag len bkal gyi yod pa red/ yin na yang dngos yod gnas tshul la/ gzhung gi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan gyi tshogs pa dang / kha gtad kyi tshogs pa tshad longs pa so so yod pa yin na/ chab srid kyi tshogs pa srid dbang 'dzin mkhan der ngo rgol shog khag gis skyon brjod byas/ skyon brjod de rgyu mtshan ldan pa dang / yid ches 'pher ba byung ba'i mtshams la 'os bsdu byas/ 'os bsdu'i rgyal pham gyi thog nas gzhung srid 'dzin mkhan brjes bsgyur byed dus tshags tshud po dang yag po zhig yong gi yod pa red/ da lta nga tshor 'di yod pa ma red/ gros tshogs kyi nang la 'thus mi tshos skyon brjod byed dgos kyang / byed stangs thad da lta nga tshor btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di dbu 'phangs smad gzhi lta bu byas pa yin na de yag po rang mi 'dug phan gyi mi 'dug nga tshor btsan byol gzhung zhig yod pa dang med pa las yod pa drin che gi red/ rgya nag gzhung gis kyang 'di la do gal chen po rtsi gi 'dug dper na gzhan dag phar bzhag ngas rgya nag gzhung gi 'go khrid la yi ge bris te skabs re rgya nag gzhung tshab brgyud nas btang ba'i skabs la brjod bya 'grigs 'dug kyang de'i las shog 'di 'grigs mi 'dug der bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang zer ba'i las rtags 'dug ces bshad kyi 'dug 'di dpe mtshon gcig red/ rdo don snying po spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gcig 629

yod pa yin na des tshang mar blta thub kyi yod pa dang / spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig med na so so rang mgo gang thon byas nas bsdad rgyu ma gtogs spyi pa der lab sa gang yang yod ma red/ nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba shar ni'u dzi leṇ+ḍa dang / nub ke na ḍa dang / a mi ri da byang sog yul la sogs pa rgyal khab sum cu so grangs shig nang la bod pa kha 'thor nas bsdad yod kyang / rgya gar nang nga tshor spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa 'di'i thog nas bod mi yongs rdzogs la 'brel ba mthud nas bsdad kyi yod pa red/ des phan gyi 'dug do bdag so so la yang so so'i sems kyi nang la nga tshor spyi pa so so'i lus lta bu gcig yod snyam pa'i blo bzhag sa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ spyi pa'i gong bu'i nus pa thon pa la spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod dgos pa dang / spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de'i nus pa thon pa zhig yong ba la mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor yod dgos/mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor yong ba la yid ches yod dgos/ mang tshogs kyi yid ches brlag gzhi'i gnas tshul thon pa yin na/ gzhi lji po dang bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig chags kyi 'dug da lta bka' blon gyis zer ba ltar spyi 'thus yong mkhan tsho btsan byol ba'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i thog la lhag bsam rtse gcig yod mkhan dang / nga tshor skyon brjod byed skabs kyang nga tsho'i las ka byed bzhin pa de tsho tshags tshud du gtong rgyu dang / nus pa thon du gtong ba'i don du skyon brjod byed pa ma gtogs/ btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'di gnya' gcog rgyu dang / dma' phab rgyu'i don du ma song ba zhig dgos/ nga tshor chab srid kyi tshogs pa hra thag thag gnyis yod payin na rbad de gnas tshul khag khag red/630

skabs re ngas rtsed mo dang sbrags bshad kyi yod/ nga tshor da lta rdog khres 'khyer mkhan rta legs pa zhig kyang med/ drel legs pa zhig kyang med/ bong bu thebs chag cig yod pa de med pa las yod pa bka' drin che gi red/ nga tsho'i spyi 'thus gros tshogs 'di khrims bzo dang / chab srid kyi srid byus gtan 'bebs byed mkhan de red/ 'di'i nang la yod pa'i mi tsho nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang gi a tig yang tig lhag bsam gyis phyug pa/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi bsam blo gtong thub mkhan/ bsam blo 'khor thub mkhan de tsho'i gras slebs thabs byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug 'di yong ba la rgyun ldan nas mi mang so sos do snang byed dgos pa ma gtogs 'os bsdu byed khar/ su yag gi red su yag gi red ces par par phyin/ tshur tshur phyin pas mi 'grigs/ dngul gyis thabs shes byed mkhan de 'dra yang yong ma srid pa ma red/ spyir btang gi 'gro stangs la bden pa yod pa'i mi des phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs byed kyi med/ rang gi bsam blo'i nang la gdeng 'khel nas bsdad kyi yod/ bden pa de tsam med mkhan de so so'i sems kyi nang bden pa'i slobs pa med stabs phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs mang po byed kyi yod/ de dngos yod gnas tshul red/ phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs mang po byed mkhan de phugs la so so rdzun ma chags rgyu gsal po red de/ 'phral sel skabs rer khe bzang rag gi yod/ de tsho'i gras la gdan sa'i dge 'dun pa dang / mi mang tshang mas dus rgyun ldan nas bsam blo btang / brtag dpyad byas/ do snang byed dgos/ nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs 'di'i nang gi mi dngos gnas lhag bsam yod pa/ spyi sems yod 631

pa de tsho'i gras spyi 'thus nang la slebs thub pa byed rgyu 'di gnad 'gag chen po 'dugade nas nga rang tsho'i nang tshags rnyog dra yod pa de tsho'i gras yong srid pa zhig red/ thog mar lnga bcu nga dgu lo la nga tsho ma su rir 'byor/ de nas drug cu tham pa'i lo la tshur dzña ram sa lar yong pa red/ de dus ḍal la ha'o ser bod pa'i gzhis chags gcig tshugs pa red/ shel hor nas bod pa kha shas kyi thog nas rnyog dra zhig byung / de nas ka rdor khul la yang rnyog dra byung ba red/ mi'i spyi tshogs kyi nang la rnyog dra yong ba de chos nyid red/ yong gin yong gin sel gyin sel gyin byas nas 'gro rgyu red ma gtogs/ yong ma srid pa gang yang ma red/ de dus kyi rnyog dra de tsho'i gras la rgya mi gung khran dang 'brel ba gang yang yod pa ma red/ de bzhin go ming tang la yang 'go stod 'brel ba phal cher yod pa ma red/ bar skabs shig nas nga chos ngad pa'i nang la rnyog dra yong ba'i skabs la the bon bod sog las khungs dang 'brel ba yod mkhan 'dra po/ rim pas pe cing gi phyogs nas kyang 'brel ba de 'dra byed kyi med dam snyam pa'i bzo lta zhig yong gi 'dug lhag don da gin bde srung bka' blon gyis lab pa bzhin/ bar skabs rgya mi'i gsang ba'i las byed pa'i tshogs 'du de 'dra'i sa la gros chod bzhag pa'i yig cha 'ga' shas nga tshor lag gon byung ba'i nang la/ bod mi btsan byol ba'i nang dkrug shing rgyag dgos pa dang / bod pa btsan byol ba'i sgrig 'dzugs gtor bshig gtong dgos zer ba de 'dra'i gnas tshul gsal po bkod 'dug de tsho'i gras la nga tshos dmigs bsal 632

gyi do snang zhig ma byas na ma 'grig mkhan zhig chags yong gi 'dug nga tsho bod mi nang khul gyi rnyog dra la gnad 'gag de tsam med kyang / rgya bod gnyis dbar dka' rnyog yod pa de dang 'brel nas byung ba yin na/ de la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos pa zhig red/rgya bod gnyis kyi gnas stangs ni dmigs bsal gsar pa zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug nga tsho'i bsam blo gtong stangs dang / lam phyogs ni dbu ma'i lam zer ba de ga'i sgang la 'gro gi yod/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rgyal khab mang po zhig gis nga tsho'i lam phyogs de'i thog la rgyab skyor byed ma bde ba med pa ltar/ de'i jog la sems khur blangs nas rgya nag gzhung la 'bod skul byed kyi yod/ tā la'i bla mas rang btsan rtsod kyi yod ma red/ kha bral skad cha bshad kyi yod ma red/ de brgya cha brgya tham pa thag chod pa red/ rgya bod gnyis skad cha bshad rgyu 'di rgya nag gi khe phan la thug yod/ rgya nag rang nyid kyi brtan lhings dang / gcig gyur yong rgyu'i jog la phan thogs yod pa zhig red/ de 'dra yin dus twa la'i bla ma dang mnyam du bka' mos gnang na yag po red ces 'bod skul lo nas lo bstud byed kyi yod pa red/ nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi dpon rigs gcig rgya nag la phyin na ha lam skad cha 'di 'char can bshad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus rgya nag gzhung gis yin na'ang gang ltar de'i thog la do snang byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul gcig chags bsdad yod/gal che shos ni nga rang tsho rwa1da mi rang nyid kyi lhag bsam dang / sems shugs ngo mtshar skye ba 'di yin/ ngas gnas tshul nges 'drongs shig nas go 633

thos la/ lo gcig gnyis kyi gong la rgya nag nang yod pa'i bod pa'i slob phrug tsho'i nang la mi rigs kyi lta ba gang 'dra yod med dang / rang btsan gyi bsam blo gang 'dra yod med skor/ gsang ba'i thog nas nyams zhib gcig byas yod tshod 'dug phru gu tshos so so'i ming bris mi dgos par so so'i 'dod pa gang yod pa der rtags rgyag rgyu'i nyams zhib cig byas yod pa 'dra/ rgya nag nang la da lta slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i bod pa'i phru gu khri kha shas shig yod pa'i nang nas brgya cha dgu bcu tham bas bod rang dbang la 'dod pa byas 'dug brgya cha bcus der ngo rgol byas 'dug rang skyong ljongs kyi nang la brgya cha drug cus rang btsan gyi thog la sems shugasayod pa dang / brgya cha nyi shus ca ༄rtel/ brgya cha nyi shu bar gnas kyi gnas tshul thon 'dug phal cher gnas tshulade bden pa red/ rgya mi las byed pa kho rang tshos nyams zhib byed pa'i skabs/ rang skyong jongs nang gi gnas tshul de yang rang gi pha ma spun mched tshor zhed snang dang / dngangs skrag gis byas pa ma gtogs/ dngos yod gnas tshul la bod rang dbang gi sems shugs yod mkhan brgya cha drug cu las brgal gyi red ces tshod dpag byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug rgya nag nang la slob sbyong byed par nga tsho rwa1da pa'i phru gu gtong rgyu'i 'char gzhi de 1984485 tsam la gtan 'khel byas yod/ skabs der paṇa chen rin po che nas bod phrug rgya nag nang la btang ba tshor shes bya yon tan yag po yong gi red de/ bod rang nyid kyi skad yig goms gshis de tsho'i gras brjed 'gro gi red ces paṇa chen rin po ches ngo sgol gnang yod pa red/ rgya nag nang la slob sbyong byed mkhan bod pa'i 634

phru gu snga rjes phyin pa der tshor gzhi nas mi rigs kyi lta ba dang / mi rigs kyi sha zhen shugs che ru phyin pa'i gnas tshul gsal po 'dugabod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs ni ha las pa'i mkhregs po dang / mi rigs kyi lta ba shugs chen po de 'dra zhig yod pa red/ rgya nag rang gi nang la yang mang gajo rwargan gnyer gyi las 'gul shugs che ru phyin nas 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pa dang / rang dbang mang gtso'i go skabs phran bu che ru phyin pa'i skabs la bden pa'i gnas tshul rtogs rgyu'i go skabs kyang bzang du phyin/ de 'dra'i thog nas bar skabs rgya mi rtsom pa wa de 'dras rgya yig thog bod kyi gnas tshul skor bris pa'i dpe deb jon yod/ deb de gang mtshams gzu bor gnas pa lta bu 'dug dha ram sa la nas bshad pa dang / rgya nag gzhung gis lab pa gnyis ma'i rjes su ma 'brangs par skyon brjod byas/ rang nyid kyis zhib 'jug byas pa'i mthong tshul 'grel bshad byas pa de tsho gang la gang 'tshams kyi yag po yod pa lta bu 'dug 'di tsho'i gras rgya rigs kyi bsam blo'i nang la 'gyur ba thebs kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul gsal po red/ chos phyogs la mtshon na yang rgya rigs nang la bod kyi chos la do snang gsar pa slebs kyi yod pa red/ bod pa'i thog la do snang slebs/ bod pa'i bden pa'i gnas tshul shes yong dus rim pas bod don gyi thog la sha tsha rgyab skyor dang / gdung sems mnyam skyed byed pa'i gnas tshul 'di yong gi 'dug phyogs gang ci'i gnas tshul la bltas yong dus dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'dir nus pa zhig bon gyi yod pa red/ dper na/ deng sangs me ri ma'i gtsug lag slob grwa chen mo mang po'i nang la rgya 635

rigs slob phrug slob gnyer byed mkhan ha lam 'bum brgal ba yod pa red/slob grwa chen mo rgya rigs yod sa 'ga' shas nang la bod pa'i slob phrug de 'dra yang yod pa red/ khong tsho par tshur 'brel ba byung / sgor gyi thog nas grogs po nang tshags chags te bod kyi skor la go bsdur bgro gleng byed pa'i skabs rgya mi'i slob phrug gcig gis khyod rang tsho'i bod kyi lo rgyus dang / khrims lugs bshad yong dus bod rang btsan gtsang ma red/ yin na'ang nga rgya rigs yin pa'i cha nas de rtsa ba nas blo la chud kyi mi 'dug ces bshad 'dug de bden pa red/ kho la khag yod ma red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la brten nas ngas da lta dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'dir rgya rigs gnas tshul shes mkhan/ blo gzu bor gnas mkhan tshang mas blo mos rgyab skyor byed kyi 'dug de tsho nga tsho'i mthun pa'i phyogs red/ 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red/ bod kyi thog la rgya nag gzhung gis da lta'i srid byus zin stangs 'di rgya nag rang gi nang la yang rtag par ngo tsha kha skyengs yong gi yod/ rgya nag gzhung la dgos rgyu ni brtan zhing dang / gcig bsgril dgos kyi yod pa red de/ da lta'i srid byus 'dis bod pa'i bsam cho'i nang la na tsha che ru phyin/ bod pa'i bsam blo'i nang la rgya mir ma dga' mkhan shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/ 'dis rkyen pas phugs rgyang ring po'i brtan snying dang / gcig sgril la gnod kyi yod pa deng sang rgya mi'i dpon rigs mang po zhig gis gnas tshul 'di shes kyi yod na yang / khong tsho'i nang mkhregs po byed mkhan rigs gcig dang / lhug tsam byed mkhan rigs gcig bcas bsam tshul khag gnyis yod bzo 'dug bar skabs rgya nag dang gzhung 636

'brel min pa'i 'brel ba zhig yod pa de na ning ston dus nas chad pa red/ de la rgyu rkyen mang po yod pa red/ bar skabs rgya nag gi phyi 'brel la pham nyes phyin pa'i thog nas kyang dka' ngal zhig 'phrad/ nang khul du yang bsam 'char mthun ma mthun mang po zhig byung ba de 'dra'i thog nas nam rgyun nga tshor 'brel ba byed mkhan de lnga'i) gras gnas skabs byed khag po chags pa zhig phal cher yin pa'i bzo 'dug gang ltar rdo don snying po da lta ngas zhus pa bzhin 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi red/ 'gyur ba ma phyin par thabs yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus nga tsho'i dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'di 'phral phyags gang cir thabs shes yag shos chags yod/dbu ma'i lam gyi dgos pa rgyu mtshan gzhan gcig la/ ma 'ongs par nga tsho'i bod la chos dang rig gzhung phyug po yod pa'i chog shes te lung pa skyo po byas nas bsdad na 'grigs thabs med/ lung yar rgyas 'gro dgos/ nga rang tsho gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i mtshams la bod kyi zhing pa dang /'brog pa'i mi tshe skyel stangs de snga nang bzhin yi ge na gcig ma shes par bsdad mkhan de 'dra rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red/ gang ltar ma 'ongs pa'i bod de deng dus dang mthun pa'i lung pa zhig bzo dgos/ dngos po yar rgyas 'gro dgos/dngos po yar rgyas 'gro ba la rgya nag rgyal khab dang skyid sdug mnyam du bsdad na khe phan yod/ de yang rgya nag nang la chab srid kyi 'gyur ba yag po phyin/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod par blta stangs de bod pa'i job thang khag la ngos 'dzin byas/ snga mo maco dmi tung yod pa'i skabs la yang bod la rgya nag gi zhing chen 637

spyi mtshungs su la blta gi med ces bshad yod/ de bzhin kru an len gyis paṇ+ḍita ne+e te ru la rgya nag dbus gzhung gis bod 'di rgya nag gi zhing chen zhig la ngo sa 'dzin byed kyi med/ bod kyi gnas stangs 'di dmigs bsal can zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod ces bshad yod/ nga rang tsho bod rigs nang nas nga phod kyis nga la 'di 'dra gsung myong / da cha bod rgya nag gi cha shas la phyin pa red/ yin na yang cha shas la 'gro stangs de dbus gzhung dang / sa gnas gzhung gi dbar gros mthun bzhag nas phyin pa red/ rgya nag gi zhing chen gzhan dag dang dbus gzhung gi dbar gros mthun bzhag pa gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus bod kyi gnas tshul 'di dmigs bsal can zhig red ces nga phod kyis gsung gi yod/ rgya nag dbus gzhung gis bod pa'i chab srid kyi thog la dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul yin pa ngos len byas/ de la cha 'jog dang 'brel ba'i blta stangs yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ nga tsho'i dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong rgyu de tsho'i thog la phan gyi red bsam gyi 'dugagang ltar rgya nag la yang khe phan yod pa/ nga tsho bod pa la yang khe phan yod pa zhig yong thub kyi red bsam nas ngas dbu ma'i lam la 'bad brtson byed pa'i gnad don de yin/ spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul de 'dra zhig red/khyed rang tshang ma la mtshams 'dri yod/ hur thag byed dgos/ nga rang tsho 'dir so so snang ba dag nas bsdad pa ma gtogs bsam blo zhib tshags po btang ba yin na bod rje gnya' khri btsan po dang / mes dbon rnam gsum nas bzung ste dus da lta bar du nga tsho bod mi rigs zhes pa 'dzam gling 'di'i 638
