sgang la zu ra gsal zhig yod pa 'di da cha gnas dang ma gnas nyen kha'i sa mtshams la slebs yod/ gnad don 'di ha cang 'gangs chen po red/ bod nang la cha bzhag na/ lha sa grong khyer gyis mtshon pa'i gzhis ka rtse dang / rgyal rtse/ chab mdo sogs grong khyer che khag mang che ba ha lam rgya yul dang / rgya grong la 'gyur tshar yod pa red/ grong khyer de tsho'i nang la yod pa'i bod pa tsho nyin re'i lto chas bza' stangs ni 'bras dang / kring mog lta bu las/ pag za mkhan nyung ba/ gyon gos ni rgya chas sha stag 'tshem khang dang / za khang /stong khang gang du phyin rung mang che ba rgya mi sha stag nyin zhag gcig gi nang bed spyod byed rgyu'i skad yig ni rgya skad dang rgya yig spyod rgyu las/ bod skad 'gro rgyugs med pa chags/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og nas bod pa'i goms gshis cha tshang 'gyur 'gro gi yod pa red/ bod yul rgya yul la bsgyur gyi 'dug ces ngas sngon ma nas bshad yod/ gang ltar grong khyer che khag de tsho'i gras phal cher de 'dra chags yod tshod 'dug 'di tsho dngos gnas rang bod chags 'jig gi mtshams la slebs pa red/ yin na'ang bod kyi mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa rtsa med phyin pa yin na rgya nag la yang phyags nas 'gyod pa bskyed rgyu ma gtogs phan thogs gang yang yod pa ma red/ bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gnas pa'i thog nas kha bral 'gro rgyu'i dngangs skrag byed mi dgos pa zhig nga tshos byed thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug da lta rgya nag gzhung gis bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'di gnas pa yin na kha bral 'gro gi red bsam pa'i dngangs skrag byas te nga tsho'i chos dang rig gzhung med pa bzo gi yod pa 'di nor 'khrul 639

red/ chos dang rig gzhung gnas nas bod pa tsam du ma zad rgya nag la yang phan/ hi ma la yi ri brgyud kyi sa khul tshang ma la yang phan thogs pa/ de tsam du ma zad che sa 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la yang gang la gang 'tshams phan thogs pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ de 'dra'i nus pa yod pa chos dang rig gzhung 'di skyob pa'i srid byus shig zin/ de'i 'og nas kha bral la ma 'gro bar/bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis rgya nag rgyal khab la phan pa zhig dang / rgya nag rgyal khab kyi mtshan mthong la phan pa/ rgya nag rgyal khab kyi rnam dpyod la phan pa zhig byed thub na mkhas pa red/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung 'dis bod mi rigs zur gsal yin pa'i rnam 'gyur thon gyi 'dug pas/ de med pa bzo dgos zhes lab na ha cang glen pa red/ mig rgyang thung thung gi byed stangs red/ gang ltar ga ler ga ler 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bden pa'i gnas tshul 'di gsal po zhig chags thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug tshang mas sems shugs ma chags pa bya dgos/ che sar bsam blo gtong dgos/ nga sto bod pa'i gshis ka la dza drag medan ltod yangs byed pa de 'dra min par gzab gzab byed dgos/ che sa nas 'thus ma shor ba byung ba yin na chung sa'i dka' ngal de tsho ga ler ga ler sel thub kyi red/ tshang ma blo bde po byas nas bzhugs/bkra shis bde legs/ zhes lcal// // 640

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1999 zla 10 tshes 7 nyin hon sur rab rgyas gling du ser skya mang tshogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/bka' chos dngos gzhi tshar nas mjug tu dge ba tshe dbang byed rgyu yin/hon sur gzhis chags la yang skyar slebs te da ring 'dir khyed rang tsho mi mang sngon ma nas ngo shes pa'i rgas po rgas mo mang po zhig thug pa la dga' po byung /gzhi rkang khyed rang tsho dang / nga tsho tshang ma rgas 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo bzhi bcu 'gro gi yod pa dang / de rjes skyes pa'i phru gu tsho yang phru gu'i pha ma chags yod pa red/ yin na yang phyogs gcig nas nga rang tsho'i bod kyi don dag 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'brel ba yod par brten/ nga tshos bod rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod byas pa dang chabs cig bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba zhig yod pa 'di dag nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel rgyun 'dzin thub pa byed rgyu don gal chen por brtsis te tshang mas 'bad rtson thabs shes byas pa red/ 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i ring la phyi mig bltas pa yin na nga rang tshos bod bstan srid kyi don dag la sman pa'i zhabs 'degs gang la gang 'tshams bsgrubs yod/ 'dir gzhis chags nang yod pa'i 1stong lags rmo'o lags tshos dus yun 'di'i ringal bod spyi pa'i don dag la sems shugs bskyed/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms min gyi dka' ngal la ma ltos par lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas zhum pa med pa'i 'bad rtsol byas pa rtsa ba chen po red/ don go chod yod pa red/ de dang chabs cig gzhon skyes 'tshar longs 641

byed mkhan tsho yang sngon la mthun rkyen cha thams cad nas phun sum tshogs pa nga rang tsho'i 'dod pa khengs pa zhig khag po yin na yang / slob gra khag nang slob sbyongs byed rgyu'i go skabs byung ba dang / sman bcos mthun rkyen la mtshon na phyi lugs kyi sman bcos dang / bod rang gi gna' rabs sman gzhung nas bshad pa'i sman bcos mthun rkyen 'grigs tsam zhig yod pa'i ngang nas mi rabs gsar pa rnams 'tshar longs byed kyi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i gzhis chags nang mi rabs gsar pa 'tshar longs byed mkhan 'di cho rwa1ga mar nga tshos gzhis chags 'dzugs pa'i skabs kyi dmigs yul bzung ba bzhin/ rgya gar grong khyer ka li ka ta dang / rtsom sgo'i/ sdi li sogs grong khyer de tsho'i nang skyes te 'tshar longs byed mkhan gyi phru gu tsho dang mi 'dra bar bod pa'i goms gshis kyi dri ma shugs che ba yod pa red/ 'di nga tshos dang po nas gzhis chags zur pa 'dzugs pa'i dgos pa dang / dmigs yul red/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra la brten nas nga tshos bod pa rang nyid khe gtsang gi gzhis chags btsugs pa'i lag rjes la gzhis chags tsho'i nang nas mi rabs gsar pa 'tshar longasayong mkhan tshor rang nyid bod pa yin bsam pa'i 'du shes rmi lam tshun chad la yod pa zhig dang / bod pa'i 'du shes de yod pa'i thog nas bod pa rang gi khyad chos dang /bod pa'i ngo bo thun mong ma yin pa de gang yin pa/ nga tsho 'dir btsan byol ba chags dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yin pa de tsho la rang bzhin gyis do snang dang /brtag dpyad byed dgos pa zhig red/ nga tshos bod spyi pa'i don dag rang dbang gi don dag la 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang zung du 'brel 642

ba'i gnad don la brten nas 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i ring 'bad rtsol byas pa red/ jog mar lnga bcu nga dgu dang / drug cu tham pa de tsho'i skabs la nga tsho'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so de gnas tshul sdug shos shig 'byung srid pa'i dbang du btang nas gra sgrig byed rgyu dang / re ba de gnas tshul bzang shos shig la re ba brgyab ste thabs shes byas pa red/ phyogs gang ci'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ bden mtha' gsal la nye ba'i phyogs su 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa yin nayang / da dung mu mthud nas nga rang tsho lo gang la gang 'tshams bsdad dgos pa byung rung / bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa ma yal ba zhig dang / bod rang gi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa 'di dag mi rabs nas mi rabs rgyun 'dzin thub pa/ de tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la deng sang bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang gsar pa zhig slebs yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i dus skabs 'dir bod mi btsan byol ba tshos bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung gi khyad chos 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mig dpe ston thub pa dang / ngo sprod byed thub pa'i go skabs je bzang je bzang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og la nga rang tsho tshang mas bod pa'i mi go chod pa zhig dang / bod pa'i mtshan mthong la rgyar phan pa'i las don byed thub pa byung na de ni chos kyi bya ba dang / ya rabs spyod bzang dang 'brel ba yod pas/ so so rang nyid kyi 'di phyi'i don dag la shugs kyis phan bsdad yod pa red/ dper na/ 'tshe ba chos su smra ba dang / 'tshe ba dang du len mkhan zhig yin na/ bsgrub rgyu spyi pa'i don dag sgrub kyi yod kyang / las ngan 643

bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal rang nyid kyis myong dgos/ nga rang tshos ya rabs byed pa dang / bsam pa bzang po byed pa/ gcig gis gcig la thub tshod mi byed pa/ mgo bskor mi gtong ba/ drang po drang bzhag byed pa/ga tshod thub thub kyis mi la phan pa bsgrub pa 'di dag nga rang tsho'i chos kyi snying po yin pa dang / 'di tsho'i gras bod pa'i goms gshis dang / bod pa'i khyad chos yin/ da lta bar du 'das pa'i lo bzhi bcu'i ring la nga tsho tshang mas dka' las rgyab nas hur thag byas pa red/ byas pa'i grub 'bras kyang nga rang tshos mig gi mthong rgyu yod pa zhig dang / 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la bod mi btsan byol bar mi mthong cha 'jog 'os pa zhig chags bsdad yod pas/ da dung yin na yang nga rang tsho tshang mas hur bskyed byed rgyu gal chen po red/ gzhis chags 'di'i nang la thog ma nas yod pa'i mi da cha rgas po rgan mo chags pa khyed rang tshos da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ mi tshe don go chod pa red/ thugs rje che zer rgyu dang / da lta 'tshar longs byed bzhin pa'i phru gu tsho la yang nga rang sto ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam yag po zhig yong thub pa la nga rang tsho tshang mas sems shus bskyed nas 'bad brtson byed dgos/da lta 'dir tshe dbang byed rgyur chos kyi ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig byas na/ nga rang sto bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos de theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba zhig red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snying po de lta ba dang / spyod pa gnyis su 'dus/ lta ba ni rten 'byung gi lta ba yin/ rten 'byung zer ba ni nga rang tshos mthong zhing / nyams su myong ba'i phyi dang nang gi chos gang dang gang 644

yin na yang / rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba dang / rgyu dang rkyen tsam la brten nas grub pa/ rgyu rkyen tsam la brten nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs 'gro ba de 'dra zhig la rten 'byung zhes bshad kyi yod/ nga tshos rten 'byung gi don 'brel bshad rgyag stangs 'di deng sang tshan rig pas 'grel bshad rgyag stangs de dang shin tu mthun gyi sku(da pa red/de nas spyod pa ni 'tshe ba med pa yin/ 'tshe ba med pa'i spyod pa zer ba 'di'i don dag snying po de/ rab la byung na gzhan la phan btags/ gal te gzhan la phan btags thub kyi mi 'dug na/ gzhan la gcasad pa gtan nas mi byed pa 'di yin/ spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa zer ba 'di 'tshe ba las g.yol thub tsam dang / 'tshe ba med tsam ma yin par gzhan la gus pa dang / brtse ba'i blo bskyed/ rang la bde skyid gal chen po yod pa bzhin gzhan gyi bde skyid gal chen por brtsis te gzhan la gnod cing sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rigs rtsa ba nas mi byed pa zhig dgos pa yin/ nga rang tsho sangs rgyas kyi chos nyams su len mkhan zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa yod mkhan zhig yin na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ chos la skyabs su mchi/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi zer bzhin du/ lag len thog tam pa bshad/ thub tshod bshad/mgo bde dran 'phrul/ rgyab mdun ngo kog mi mtshungs pa de 'dra byas pa yin na kha nas skyabs 'gro bton pa de rdzun rang red/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun la snying thag pa nas skyabs su bsten gyi yod na/ lag len thog sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba byed 645

rgyu de gal chen po yin/ dper na/ nga rang tsho mi phal pa phan tshun dga' po nye po yin na/ dga' nye'i mi de'i ngo la bltas te spyod lam de dang bstun dgos pa spyir btang gi 'gro stangs shig red/ des na ston pa bka' drin can mnyam med shākya seng ge/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ de la snying nas dad pa dang mos pa yod mkhan zhigayin na de'i bka' shes pa byas / bka' de dang bstun nas nyams su len dargos/ de'i bka' spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa 'di'i thog nas dus rtag tu drang po byas/ snyoms chung byas/ gzhan la gnod pa ma skyel ba/ ya rabs spyod bzang byed dgos/ lta ba rten 'byung gis ya rabs byed dgos pa dang / blo zhum mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad kyi yod/blo gu yangs po dang / rgya chen po bzo gi yod pa red/ dper na/ nga rang tshor to gos kyi dka' ngal dang / mi shi rkyen chags lta bu'i dka' ngal zhig byung ba yin na/ dka' ngal de gcig pur bltas te bsdad pa yin na sems khral che ru che ru 'gro rgyu red/ dka' ngal 'di rten 'byung red/ rgyu dang rkyen mang po zhig la brten nas byung ba red/ bcos su sku(da pa ma red bsam pa yin na blo tod rdzod 'dra po zhig yong gi red/ rang la yag po gcig byung na yang /rkyen du ma la brten nas byung ba red/ yag po red/ 'on kyang de tsam gyis zhen chags byed rin med pa lta bu/ yang sdug pa gcig byung na yang rkyen sna tshogs thog nas byung ba dang / mthar gtugs na so so'i byed las dang 'brel ba yod pas ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa tshang ma'i le khag gzhan la dkri sa med pa zhig chags kyi yod/ rten 'byung gi lta ba 'dis gnas tshul gang dang gang yin 646

rung de rgyu rkyen gyi gzhan dbang la brten nas byung bar bshad kyi yod pa red/des bsam khra'i nang la dga' sdug chen wa'i 'khrug rkyen mi yong bar phan thogs chen po yod pa red/ rab la gzhan la phan btags dgos/ gal te phan btags ma thub kyang gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snying po red/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rten 'byung gi lta ba'i thog nas 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod pa red/ 'di khyed rang tsho tshang ma'i sems la nges pa byed dgos/sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa yod na de shes dgos/ slob sbyong byed dgos/de snga bod nang gi goms gshis la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos slob sbyong byed mkhan bshad gra tsho'i nang gi gra pa yin pa lta bu/ spyir btang gra pa byings nas 'don kha khral shes na 'grigs pa 'dra po/ mi mang nang la chos kyi slob sbyong byed rgyu'i 'brel ba gang yang med pa lta bu zhig mthong gi yod/ 'di nga chos nor pa red/nga rang tsho rgya gar nang btsan byol ba chags skabs na gzhon tshang mas slob grwa 'grims dgos/ mi tshang mas slob sbyong byed dgos zhes bshad pa bzhin/ nga rang tsho tshang mas sangs rgyas kyi chos bslab dgos pa zhig dang / shes dgos pa zhig red/ lhag don khyim tshang so so'i nang gi pha ma tshos rgyas bsdus la ma ltos par sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi go don rags rim rtogs thub pa byung ba yin na zhogs pa yar langs nas skyabs 'gro bton/ yon chab 'dra phul/ mchod me 'dra phul/ spos 'dra phul byed pa'i skabs la phru gu tshor de'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog gang 'dra yin pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gang 'dra yin pa sogs 'grel bshad rgyag thub na phru gu'i 647

bsam cho'i nang la rang shugs kyis nges thub pa dang / phru gu tshor yang do snang slebs thub pa yong gi red/ phru gu'i bsam blo'i nang ston pa bka' drin can gyi sku 'dra dang / ston pa ye shu/ de bzhin khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa'i sku 'dra'i mdun la mchod me phul ba dang / sgos phul ba la khyad par phye ma shes na ha nang skyong nga red/ khyim tshang so so'i nang gi pha ma tshos sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gnad don dang / 'dzam gling nang chos lugs gzhan dag mang po yod pa/ de tshos kyang rang rang so so'i gdul bya la phan gyi yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / chos lugs gzhan dag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang yod pa bcas nges par du shes dgos/ dper na/ nga rang la cha bzhag na/ nga sangs rgyas kyi chos pa zhig red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la shes nas dad pa thob pa zhig yin pa'i khul yin/ de 'dra'i jog nas bltas pa na/ chos lugs gzhan dag tsho yang na rtag mtha'/ yang na chad mthar lhung yod/ chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra'i dgos don de mi la phan dgos kyi yod pa red/ de'i cha nas dpyad zhib byas pa yin na/ rtag chad kyi mthar lhung pa'i lta ba zhig yin na yang thad gar don du 'gyur gyi yod na dgos don cha shas shig tshang gi yod pa red/ chos lugs 'dra mi 'dra yod pa 'di dag gis skye bo 'bum phrag sa ya mang po la sngar 'das pa'i dus su phan pa bsgrubs yod pa dang / deng skabs kyang phan bzhin pa yin stabs/ nga tshos brtsi bkur dang / gus zhabs byed dgos/ yin na yang so so'i chos kyi khyad chos rnams shes dgos rgyu gnad 'gag chen po yod/ rgyu mtshan shes nas thob pa'i dad pa de brtan po yong gi red/ rgyu 648

mtshan ma shes na blun po chu sna gar 'khrid chags nyen yod/ pha ma tshos do snang byas te nang pa'i chos kyi gnad 'gag shes thub pa byung na bla ma dang / dge bshes gcig la bsten ma dgos par phru gu tshor khyim tshang nang du pha mas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi go brda sprod thub pa yong gi red/ de 'dra byung ba yin na/ mi rabs nas mi rabs la sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa brtan po gnas thub pa'i phan thogs tan tan yong gi red/ de byung na chos kyi slob gnyer dmigs bkar byed sa'i chos sde khag la gsar zhugs byed mkhan shugs ma thub kyis mang po yong gi red/ gang yin zer na/ phru gu'i bsam cho'i nang sangs rgyas kyi chos de slob sbyong byed dgos kyi 'dug de gnad 'gag chen po 'dug bsam pa na/slob sbyong byed sa'i bsti gnas la dad pa skye rgyu dang / de la zhugs 'dod yong gi red/ de 'dra med na da lta dgon pa gang 'tshams yod na yang / 'di tsho'i nang gsar pa zhugs mkhan ma byung na ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu lta bur 'gyur nyen yod/ bar skabs nga rang tsho'i nyams myong la bltas pa yin na/ dper na smad rgyud gra tshang dang / gdan sa khag tsho'i nang la slob gnyer byed mkhan phal mo che bod nas gsar 'byor tsho ma gtogs/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags nang la skyes te 'tshar longs byed mkhan gyi mi rabs nang nas nyung shas ma gtogs mi 'dug nga tshos mthud ka rgyag stangs dang / mtshams sbyor byed stangs yag po ma shes pa'i 'thus shor phyin 'dug dgoni khag nas gsar zhugs pa tshor dmigs bsal gyi blta rtogs byed srol med pa dang / khyim tshang khag dang / slob grwa'i dge mkhan tshos 'grel bshad lam ston byed rgyu gang ci nas 649

'thus shor 'gro gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug gang ltar phru gu lo chung chung nas slob grwar phyin/ gzhi rim gyi slob sbyong byas/ spyir btang gi shes yon rnams bslabs/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang yod mkhan dang / shes 'dod yod mkhan/ khyim pa pho mo'i khongs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos bslab 'dod yod pa yin na wa ra ṇa si'i slob gnyer khang lta bur zhugs na 'grigs/ der rab byung yod la/ rab byung min na yang zhugs chog pa zhig bzos yod pa red/yang phru gu bu bu mo'i nang la sangs rgyas kyi chos slob 'dod yod pa dang / de yang rab tu byung ba'i rten nas slob sbyong byed 'dod yod pa de 'a dra tan tan yong gi red/ ngas ngo shes pa de 'dra yang 'ga' shas yod/ khong tshor dang po chos la bag chags phran bu yod pa de mu mthud nas gnas thub pa dang / bag chags de shugs che ru 'gro rgyu'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i khar/ 'gal rkyen 'phrad de gang 'tshams shig nas chos kyi do snang brlag 'gro mkhan de 'dra yong gi 'dugade 'thus shor red/ de skor nga rang tshor byed stangs gcig tshang gi mi 'dugade tsho'i thog la slob gra'i dge rgan tsho dang / pha ma tshos do snang byed dgos kyi 'dug de bzhin bshad gra dgon pa gra tshang tshos kyang slob phrug gsar pa yong mkhan tsho'i gras la lta stangs gang 'dra zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug gam/ 'di skor bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho'i gzhis chags khag gi bu phrug gra sar zhugs mkhan mang po med pa'i rgyu rkyen de phru gur chos la do snang med nas byung ba red dam/ chos la do snang yod na yang / dgon pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gro stangs la yid ma rangs par byung ba gang yin zhib 'jug byed dgos/650

phru gur chos la do snang med pa'am/ yod kyang brlag nas gra sar gsar zhugs ma byas na gnas tshul khag khag red/ de phal cher ma red bsam gyi 'dug chos la do snang tan tan yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ nga rang tsho btsan byol ba'i spyi tshogs nang la cha bzhag na/ phyi lo drug cu tham pa'i lo nang dang bsdur na/ deng sang chos dad che ru phyin med dam bsam gyi 'dug gzhon skyes tsho'i nang lag par phreng ba bzung mkhan mang du 'gro gi yod pa lta bu 'dug nga rang tsho bod mi tsam du ma zad/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud/ nub la dwags nas shar mon bar du sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang gsar pa shugs che ru 'gro gi 'dugade tshor bltas na bod phrug tsho'i chos kyi do snang brlag pa lta e yin snyam/ 'on kyang nga tshos mthud ka yag po rgyag ma shes pa'i skyon zhig yong gi yod bzo 'dugad ring 'dir dgon pa'i las sne mang po yebs yod pa dang / slob phrug mang po yod stabs 'phros bshad lta bur zhus pa yin/ kha sang lugs bsam gzhis chags la'ang ngas 'grel bshad rgyab pa yin/ gang ltar mi mang tshos zhar dang zhor la sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di gang 'dra yin pa do snang dang / slob sbyong byas nas shes thabs bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ de chos kyi ngo sprod lta bu yin /(de nas tshe dbang gi rim pa rnams stsal/)da lta gsol ja bzhes pa'i ring 'dir ngas gnas lugs zhu rgyu zhig yod/da lta dpe mdzod kyis mchog rin po che 'dir phebs yod pa red/ de'i gnad don ni/ gdan sa gsum nang gi mkhas pa dang / slob gnyer ba rig pa bkra ba snubarno nang nas rim pas tshan rig shes mkhan gang 'tshams shig byung na snyam/651

tshan rig gi gnas tshul cha tshang nga tshos shes dgos don med kyang / sems kyi rnam gzhag dang / 'dzam bu gling gi rnam gzha dngos po'i rdul phra rab kyi rnam gzhag sogs 'di tsho'i gras la nga tshos tshan rig gi sde tshan dmigs bsal gyi mkhas pa de 'dra mnyam du ga le ga ler go bsdur byed rgyu dang / gra 'grigs na dpe mdzod nas 'gan khur blangs te dus tshes nges can zhig ring slob tshun rang slob khrid byed rgyu byung na zhes lo shas sngon nas bsam tshul byung ba ltar/ da lams mchog rin po che 'di khul yong ba'i gnas tshul de red/ma gzhi yig cha zhig kyang rin po ches bzos 'dug gang ltar deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang 'dirayongs grags la tshan rig ces lab na bden don gtan la phab mkhan zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red la/ yin pa'ang red/ spyir btang tshan rig pas brtag dpyad byed yul gtso bo gzugs can gyi chos yin par brten/ sangs rgyas kyi lta grub rnam gzhag dang bsdur ba yin na 'di gzhi rgya chung chung red/ tshan rig pa'i nang la'ang lci yang lta bu'i sde tshan gnyis 'dugayang ba de'i nang nas sems kyi rnam gzhag dang / de tsho'i gras bshad yong gi yod pa dang / lci ba de'i nang nas gzugs can dngos po rang gi rdul phra i rnam gzhag la sogs pa 'di tsho'i gras shes pa dang ma 'brel ba'i dngos po'i rnam gzhag bshad kyiyod pa red/ spyir btang tshan rig pas da lta bar du 'brel ba chen po yod pa'i ye shu'i chos dang / de dang de 'dra ba'i chos lugs phal mo che la sgro btags red cesata lam khungs med pa la brtsi gi yod pa red/ gang ltar tshan rig pas dngos po'i bden don btsal te rdzas kyi 'gyur ba la brten 652

nas phan gnod 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul rnams shes te 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la dngos po yar rgyas shin tu chen po phyin yod/ dper na/nga rang tshor na tsha dza drag 'dra po byung na/ deng dus kyi sman khang la 'gro dgos/sman khang nas brtag dpyad byed pa dang / sman bcos byed pa 'di dag nga tsho'i sman gzhung ltar sman pa'i rgyal po'i gsung la brten pa ma yin par/ mi phal 4pa gcig gis brtag dpyad byas/ brtag dpyad lan mang byas nas shes pa zhig red/ rigs 'ga' shas la nor 'khrul yong gi yod pa red/ da lta 'phral sel phan na yang ma 'ongs pa la lo bcu nyi shu'i rjes la gnod pa'i rang bzhin canayong gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang spyi yongs kyi cha nas 'tham bu gling 'dir deng dus kyi sman bcos 'di dag yongs su grags shing grub pa dang / mi mang po la phan jogs yod pa nga tshos shes gsal red/ de thams cad mngon shes kyi skad cha min par mi phal pa gcig gis brtag dpyad lan grangs du ma byas pa'i grub 'bras red/ brtag dpyad byed skabs sems can mang por tshod lta byed kyi yod pa de thabs skyo po red ma gtogs/ gang ltar brtag dpyad byas nas shes pa red/ dper na/ nga rang tshos bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i sgra 'dzin 'khor lo la sogs pa 'di dag mngon shes kyi thog nas bzos pa min par/brtag dpyad mang po byas nas shes pa sha stag red/ gang ltar dngos yod gnas tshul la 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la tshan rig pas bden don btsal nas rnyed pa'i dngos po mis bed spyod byas te mi la kha yod lag yod phan thogs yod pa mig mthong lag zin yin par tshang mas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa dang / khas 653

len byed kyi yod pa red/ cha 'jog byed kyi yod pa red/spyir btang nga rang tsho sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi thog nas yod pa la med par bshad na skur 'debs log lta dang / med pa zhig yod par bshad na/ sgro 'dog log lta zhes gsungs yod/ sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi 'gro stangs ni brtag dpyad byas nas dngos yod gnas tshul gang yod pa de khas blangs dgos pa red/ chos lugs gzhan dag cho'i nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig la tshan rig gi thog nas brtag dpyad byed skabs de tsho rnam rtog gi sgro btags pa red ces bshad kyi yod/ spyir btang tshan rig dar sa'i lung pa tsho'i nang la gna' rabs nas yod pa'i chos lugs phal mo che la tshan rig pas ngos 'dzin byed kyi med pa red/ nub phyogs lung pa'i nang la tshan rig dang chos zhes lab na ha lam 'brel ba med pa 'am/ de gnyis mthun thabs med pa lta bu'i blta tshul dang mthong tshul zhig yod pa red/nga rang chung chung skabs nas tshan rig gi 'gro stangs dang / 'phrul chas rigs la dga' po yod/ gang ltar shes bya'i rnam grangs 'dra min shes 'dod chung chung skabs nas yod/ tshan rig gi bshad stangs de tsho'i thog la do snang yod par brten/ lo bco lnga nyi shu'i gong la tshan rig pa de 'dra mnyam du 'brel ba byas pa yin/ de byed dus nub phyogs pa'i mi ngas ngo shes pa de 'dra gcig gnyis kyis nga la dngos su tshan rig zer ba de chos kyi dgra red/ nub phyogs lung pa'i nang la chos med pa bzo mkhan tshan rig pa red/ der 'brel ba byed rgyur gzab gzab byed dgos ces nga la de 'dra bshad myong / yin na yang nga 654

rang la blo gdeng gang yod zer na/ nga tshos dngos yod gnas tshul gtan la phab nas bden don btsal gyiyod par brten grub mtha' 'og ma 'og ma'i 'dod tshul la grub mtha' gong ma gong mas lung dang rig pa'i sgrub byed bkod nas bkag yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/ da lta nga rang tsho 'chad nyan byed bzhin pa'i sngags kyi skor la mtshon na/ gzhi dngos wa'i gnas tshul de la brten nas lam bgrod pa'i rim pa dang / de la brten nas 'bras bu mngon du byed lugs bshad kyi yod/ de tsam du ma zad theg pa chen pa'i chos kyi spyi'i 'gro stangs la cha bzhag na/ gzhi bden pa gnyis/ lam thabs shes gnyis/ 'bras bu sku gnyis zhes gang ltar gzhi la yod pa zhig gi steng nas lam dang / 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul bshad pa ma gtogs/ gzhi la med pa zhig bshad kyi med/dngos yod gnas tshul btsal nas bden don gtan la phab kyi yod par brten tshan rig par 'brel ba mu mthud nas byas te/ rim pas tshan rig pa ngo shes mang po byung ba red/ tshan rig pa tshos 'jig rten chags tshul dang / rdzas kyi rang bzhin gzugs can phra mo'i rnam bzhag bshad stangs la bltas na/ nga tshos dus kyi thung mtha' skyes bu nad med gcig gi se gol gtogs pa'i yun sum brgya drug cu la bgos pa dang / phra rab kyi rdul dang / rdul phran dang /de nas lcags rdul/ chu rdul/ nyi rdul/ ri bong gi rdul zer ba de tsho'i gras ha cang rags pa red/ tshan rig pa tshos 'grel bshad byed stangs rigs kha shas nas nga tshor cho sad dang / phan thogasayong gi 'dug tshan rig pas gzugs can dngos po phra mo'i mtharagatugs te brtag dpyad byed skabs dngos po bden 655

pa zhig ngos zin thub pa mi 'dug ces bshad kyi 'dug sangs rgyas kyi chos nang lo stong phrag gong chos thams cad btags don btsal nas rnyed rgyu med par gsungs yod/ tshan rig pas kyang gzugs can gyi dngos po btags don btsal nas rnyed rgyu med pa zhig mthong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i ngang nas skabs re thams cad sems kyi rtog btags lta bu bshad kyi 'dug bshad stangs de lta ba'i thog la slebs kyi yod pa red/ gang ltar yang snying deng sang tshan rig tshad mthon por slebs te gzhi nas lta ba dang 'brel ba yod pa chags yong gi yod/ snga mo yin na lta ba ces lab na sems kyi rnam rtog gis bzos pa lta bu dang / tshan rig ces lab na brtag dpyad byed rgyu yod pa lta bur ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod kyang / deng sang nye ru phyin yod/ gzugs can gyi dngos por brtag dpyad byed thub pa'i tshad las brgal yong dus lta ba'i sgang la phyin na ma gtogs 'gro sa med pa zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ tshan rig pas btsal nas rnyed rgyu med pa de 'dra gang byas song bsam pa'i bzo 'dra zhig gi sgang la bsdad kyi yod pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos nas rten 'byung zhes ming gi dbang gis yod tsam zhes gsungs yod/ khong tshos sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang /klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa zer gyi yod pa ma red/ kho rang tshos brtag dpyad byas/brtag dpyad byas pa'i 'bras bur yul dngos po bden pa ba gcig mi 'dug zer ba zhig gi sgang la slebs yong gi 'dug sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'gro stangs lta ba dang / grub mtha'i nang nas gzhi dngos po'i gnas tshul gsungs pa de tsho'i gras 'grel bshad byed dus tshan rig pa tsho'i nang nas der do snang slebs 656

yong gi 'dug dper na/ nga tsho tshan rig pa dang mnyam du thug jog mar tshogs thengs dang 1— de 'tshogs pa'i skabs la/ tshan rig pa kha shas kyi rnam 'gyur la khyed rang tsho chos pa red/ chos pa mnyam du nga tsho tshan rig pas gang bshad dgos/ nga tsho go bsdur byed rgyu'i gzhi rtsa yod pa ma red zer ba lta bu'i rnam 'gyur bstan yong gi 'dug sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'brangs pas 'jig rten bkod pa po dang / gang zag rang dbang gis grub pa'i bdag khas len gyi med pa dang / stod bcud thams cad rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba/ rkyen la brten nas 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong gi yod pa sogs bshad pa'i tshe gzhi nas 'dir do snang zhig slebs te khyed rang tshos sangs rgyas kyi chos 'grel bshad khyad mtshar zhig rgyag gi 'dug ces tshogs thengs dang po las gnyis pa la do snang che ru phyin gong / tshogs theng gnyis pa gsum pa nas/ kho rang tsho'i bshad gzhi 'di'i skor la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos nas 'grel bshad gang 'dra zhig rgyag gi red ces gzhi nas tshur dris yong gi 'dug pa ma zad/ tshogs dbar gyi ja 'thung ba'i skabs la'ang skad bsgyur thub bstan sbyin pa brgyud nas da gin twa la'i bla mas 'grel bshad 'di 'dra zhig rgyab song / de gang 'dra red ces do snang tshur byed pa zhig dngos su byung / gang ltar tshan rig pa dngos gnas tshad mthon por slebs pa/ bsam blo gtong mkhan de tsho'i gras kyi shar phyogs kyi lta ba la do snang byed kyi 'dug de'i nang tshan nas nang pa'i chos la do snang byed mkhan yang kha shas kha shas yong gi 'dug tshan rig pa thams cad kyis nang pa khas len gyi med na yang / tshan rig pa'i nang nas nyung shas blo gzu bor 657

gnas pa dang / shes tshad mtho rwang yod mkhan de 'dra nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang byed kyi 'dug tshan rig pa tshos dus rabs nyi shu pa rdzogs te dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang la tshan rig mu mthud nas yar rgyas 'gro gi red/tshan rig mu mthud nas yar rgyas phyin pa dang mnyam du yar rgyas 'gro thub mkhan gyi chos nang pa ma gtogs yod pa ma red ces kha gcig grags bshad kyi 'dug de nas kha sang ngas zhus pa ltar/ spyir btang gi chos lugs gzhan dag nang la dad pa dang / shes rab gnyis po de 'brel med lta bu/ shes rab ni rnam dpyod kyi rtsal gyi thog nas yong ba dang / dad pa ni rtse gcig pa'i bsam tshul zhig ma gtogs/ shes rab kyis grogs byas pa'i dad pa zer ba'i tha snyad med pa'i bzo 'dra po 'dug sangs rgyas kyi chos nas shes rab kyis grogs byas pa'i dad pa bshad pa 'di la yang khong tsho mang po gcig gis ngo mtshar skyes kyi 'dug gang ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'gro stangs 'di la tshan rig pas do snang gsar pa byed stangs de 'dra byed kyi 'dugade nas yang na ning tshan rig gi tshogs 'du gcig dzña ram sa lar 'tshogs pa yin/ de'i sar shar phyogs pa rgya mi gcig gnyis shig dang / nyi hong gi mi gcig gnyis shig yod/ nyi hong gi skye dman zhig 'dug skye dman de tshan rig pa ma red/ mo rang 'dir do snang byas te zur nyan du yong pa'i gras red/ tshogs 'du nyin ma gnyis phyin/ nyin ma gsum pa der nyi hong nas yin pa'i.a lcags des nga la skad cha bshad rgyu zhig yod zer/ skad cha bshad 658

rgyu la mo rang shar phyogs nyi hong gi mi yin/ da lta bar du so so'i bsam blo'i nang la shar phyogs kyi lta ba dang / grub mtha'/ chos zhes pa 'di la dad pa byed rgyu dang / smon lam rgyag rgyu de 'dra gcig ma gtogs/ dngos po'i gnas tshul gtan la phab kyi yod pa red bsam gyi med/ shes kyi med/ nub phyogs pa'i tshan rig gis dngos wa'i gnas tshul gtan la phab pa'i nus payod pa dang /dngos po'i gnas tshul gtan la phab pa'i sgog nas kha yod lag yod kyi mi la phan thogs sbyin thub mkhan zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ da res 'dir tshogs 'dur nyin ma gnyis phyin pa'i mtshams la/ shar phyogs pa'i lta ba 'di dngos po'i gnas tshul 'tshol mkhan zhig dang / da ngos po'i gnas tshul btsal nas gtan la phab mkhan zhig yin pa gsal po mthong song / des nga rang gi sems la g.yo 'gul chen po thebs byu nga zhes bshad byung / gang ltar nga rang tsho'i sangs rgyas kyi chos spyi dang / lhag par phyogs glang / chos grags kyis dbu tshad kyi gzhung gsungs pa'i dngos po'i rnam bzhag gtan la 'bebs lugs/dper na/ rnam 'grel gyi mgo nas rang bzhin rtags kyi 'brel ba'i skor dang /sel 'jug dang / sgrub 'jug zer ba 'di dag gis dngos yod gnas tshul bshad kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ rnam rtog gis sgro btags pa'i skad cha ma red pa/ gang ltar dbu tshad kyi gzhung nas gsungs pa 'di dag yul gyi gnas lugs brtag dpyad byed stangs la nus pa ha cang chen po yod pa shin tu gal chen po red/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos/ de'i nang tshan nas theg chen gyi chos la de lta bu'i nus pa che na po yod na yang / da lta bar du 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang 659

la nus pa mngon ma thub par bsdad pa red/ da cha nus pa mngon thub pa zhig ga le ga ler yong gi red/ de yong ba'i don du dbu tshad kyi gzhung gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la lo nas lo bstud de slob gnyer byas pa'i mi tshos 'grel bshad bya rgyu nus pa che shos yod/ mthun rkyen tshang yod/ de min gyi dpe cha kha shas kha shas klog myong ba tsam gyis khag po red/ nub phyogs pa'i mkhas pa tsho la mthong chung byas pa lta min ste/ nub phyogs pa'i mkhas pa tshos lo rgyus dang / de lo ga dus byung ba/ mtshan gang 'dra gang 'dra yin pa sogs ha las pa'i nges po dang / mang po gsung rgyu yod bsdad pa de tsho'i gras ha cang yag po red/ de lta bu'i zhib 'jug byas pa tsam gyis shin tu yag po red/ yin na yang nga rang tsho mtshan nyid pas dpe cha bltas pa nang bzhin gcig nas gnyis su bgrangs pa'i rgyu ma phu 'ded kyi thog nas dpyad pa byed rgyu'i nus pa de khag po red/ bod pa yag shos yin/ bod pa nang bzhin ha lam yong ngam mi yong ngam/ da lta'i gnas skabs la 'byon mi yong / gzhan dag rngadzor bzhag skad yig rang gi thog nas khag po yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gtan la phab pa la bod kyi skad yig 'di ha las pa'i phyug po dang / ha cang yag po red/ brda dag ming tshig cha tshang gtan la 'khel bsdad yod pa'i dge mtshan dang /khyad chos chen po yod/ gang ltar yang snying da lta'i char bod pa'i mkhas pa tsho drag shos chags bsdad yod/ da lta bar skyon cha rjes lus gang thebs yod dam zer na/ tshan rig pa dang mnyam du 'brel ba byed stangs shes kyi yod pa ma red/ 'di la nga tshos slob sbyong zhig byed dgos/ 'di phyogs sngar rtsod pa 660

ma red/ bden don 'tshol gyi yod pa red/ phyogs snga'i 'dod pa shes dgos/dper na/ dpal chos kyi grags pas mu stegs pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa gcig gi dge phrug la bzhugs/ zhabs phyi zhus te mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' sbyangs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ de bzhin du nga rang tshos kyang sngar gyi 'das pa'i grub mtha' 'di tso gnad chen po red de/ deng sang bya ba byed mkhan yod pa ma red/ mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' kha shas las mang po zhig deng sang yod pa ma red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la 'tsho gnas med mkhan gyi grub mtha' rnying khungs de 'dra sbyang gin bsdad pa las/ da lta 'tham bu gling 'di'i snang la 'tsho gnasatsede bzhin pa'i ye shu'i chos la sogs pa'i chos lugs mi 'dra ba tsho'i lta grub gang 'dra gang 'dra yin pa gtso che ba che ba de tsho'i gras slob sbyong byed rgyu dang / de yang dgag pa rgyag rgyu'i don du min par/ khyad par gang yod pa de dag nga tshos shes pa byed dgos/ ji tsam gyi khyad par shes pa de tsam gyis phan thogs yod/ mu stegs gzhan gyi gzhung lugs la/ /ji lta ji ltar rnam bsam pa/ /de lta de ltar mgon khyod la/ /bdag gi yid ni dad par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa brtan du 'gro ba dang / dad pa zab tu 'gro ba zhig tan tan yong gi red/ de nas gal che shos sangs rgyas kyi lta grub dang 'brel ba yod mkhan gyi tshan rig de tsho'i gras slob sbyong byed thub na rang rang so so'i dad pa brtan du 'gro ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos la gting nas ngo mtshar skyes pa de 'dra'i phan thogs yong gi red/ bstan pa spyi'i zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu la yang phan jogs yong gi 661

red/ ma 'ongs pa la bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang la sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'di ltar yod/ tshan rig gi 'gro stangs 'di 'dra red ces 'grel bshad byed thub pa byung na/ bod pa'i mi rabs gsar pa 'tshar longs yong mkhan tsho la sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngo sprod zab shos shig chags kyi red bsam gyi 'dug bod pa'i spyi tshogs 'di mur ma bsdad par 'gyur 'gro gi red/ da lta nga tsho rgya gar nang la 'gyur 'gro gi yod pa red la/ ma 'ongs par gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i mtshams la yang 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ de 'dra'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi chos ngo sprod byed skabs tshan rig gi 'dod tshul shes pa'i thog nas 'grel bshad byas payin na nyan mkhan gyi blo la 'jug che ba dang / zab pa dang / sems la nges shes che ba skyes thub pa'i phan thogs chen po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dugade ltar na/ nga tshos ga le ga ler tshan rig gi slob sbyong go sgrig cig dha ram sa la dpe mdzod nas byed thub na yag po 'dug ces thog ma'i bsam blo yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ zhib phra rin po che nas ngo sprod gnang gi red la/ khyed rang tsho zhib phra'i bka' mol yong gi red/ de'i gnad 'gag de dag zhus na bsam byung / gzhan bod pa'i snang ba la snga mo shing 'brug dmag byung ba'i skabs la dbyin jir bstan dgra phyi gling zer gyi yod pa red/ bstan dgra phyi gling pa zhes bstan pa'i dgra bo sdug shos shig la brtsi gi yod pa dang /rgya nag gong ma la gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po zhes dad pa 'dra po byed kyi yod pa red/ da cha bstan dgra phyi gling pa ga tshod thabs sdug na yang /rang dbang yod pa dang / mang gtso yod pa/ khrims kyi dbang bsgyur ba'i lung 662

pa dngos gnas yag po yod pa red/ gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i yul khams la khrims ni med/ rang dbang ni med/ mang gtso ni med/ha cang khag po zhig la bsdad yod/ tshan rig pa zer na nub phyogs pa gcig pu'i skad cha mayin par 'dzam bu gling spyi'i gnas tshul dang / 'dzam bu gling spyi'i shes yon zhig chags bsdad yod/ spyir btang slob grwa'i nang la yod pa'i phru gu tshos tshan rig bslab pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sbyang myong mkhan/ dbu tshad kyi gzhung shes mkhan zhig gis tshan rig slob sbyong byas pa yin na tan tan legs pa shes kyi red la/ go ba gting zab khrod rgags thub pa yong gi red/ dri ba yang mang po zhig thon thub kyi red/ dwogs gcod dngos su byed thub kyi red/tshan rig slob khrid byed pa'i skabs la dbu tshad shes mkhan mi gcig gis dri ba dris/ dogs pa blangs pa yin na tshan rig slob 'khrid byed mkhan kho rang la'ang tan tan blo bskyed yong rgyur phan thogs yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug ngo sprod zhu rgyu de ltar yin pas dgongs par bcangs dgos/ zhes stsal/ (de nas tshe dbang 'phro skyong bskyangs// //)663
